title: Beyond the Transcriptome: Chromatin-Informed Prediction of Cell-State-Dependent Perturbation Responses
summary: Predicting transcriptional responses to genetic perturbations is central to understanding gene function. Existing predictors primarily rely on transcriptomic measurements, although chromatin accessibility provides complementary information about the cellular context in which perturbations act. Using this information requires linking chromatin context to specific perturbations and accounting for baseline differences between independently sampled control and perturbed populations. We propose ChromaPert, a chromatin-informed framework for predicting state-dependent perturbation responses. ChromaPert combines molecular and DNA-informed locus priors with paired control RNA--ATAC features to jointly represent target identity and measured cellular context. Its Chromatin-Guided Response Router (CGRR) builds a source bank of control-derived expression offsets and retrieves relevant sources using perturbation/locus or control-ATAC similarity. These offsets account for baseline differences, while conditional transport flow learns the remaining response. Across three unseen-target and held-out-state settings on K562 CAT-ATAC and Perturb-Multiome, ChromaPert achieves the highest all-gene response correlation among evaluated methods. When transferring known perturbations to held-out states, it improves correlation by 23.2% across all genes and 46.2% for the twenty most responsive genes over the strongest respective baselines. Correct RNA--ATAC pairing improves recovery of chromatin-associated response slopes over shuffled pairing, while cross-state predictions retain state-specific responses to the same perturbation.

AI.tldr: 提出染色质信息驱动的扰动响应预测框架ChromaPert，通过配对RNA-ATAC特征与染色质引导的响应路由，在未见靶点和留出状态设定下取得最优的全基因响应相关性。
AI.motivation: 预测遗传扰动的转录响应是理解基因功能的核心，但现有预测器主要依赖转录组测量，忽略了染色质可及性所携带的细胞状态上下文信息。利用这一信息需解决两个问题：将染色质上下文与特定扰动关联，以及校正独立采样的对照与扰动群体之间的基线差异。
AI.method: ChromaPert将分子层面与DNA序列衍生的位点先验，与配对的对照RNA-ATAC特征结合，联合表征靶标身份与实测细胞上下文。其染色质引导响应路由模块（CGRR）构建对照来源的表达偏移源库，并通过扰动/位点相似性或对照ATAC相似性检索相关来源，以校正基线差异；剩余响应则由条件传输流学习。
AI.result: 在K562 CAT-ATAC与Perturb-Multiome数据上，于三种未见靶点和留出状态设定中，ChromaPert在所有评估方法中取得最高的全基因响应相关性；将已知扰动迁移至留出状态时，全基因相关性较最强基线提升23.2%，响应最强的二十个基因提升46.2%。正确的RNA-ATAC配对相较打乱配对能更好恢复染色质相关响应斜率，且跨状态预测仍保留同一扰动的状态特异性响应。
AI.conclusion: 染色质上下文信息结合基线偏移校正可显著提升扰动响应预测的准确性与跨状态泛化能力，且RNA-ATAC配对关系对捕捉染色质关联响应具有关键作用。

title: Truecell reproduces R Seurat's single-cell analysis outputs natively in the Python ecosystem
summary: Single-cell RNA-sequencing analyses predominantly use either Seurat (R) or Scanpy (Python), with the choice often driven by programming language preference. However, by default, these tools produce divergent variable features, neighbour graphs, clusters, and marker genes. Laboratories requiring Python, which supports most deep-learning, foundation-model, and agent tools, must re-implement Seurat analyses in a framework that does not replicate Seurat's results. Truecell was developed as a Python implementation of the Seurat interface, preserving function names, arguments, default settings, and the object model to facilitate seamless transfer of analyses. In eighteen paired end-to-end evaluations against R Seurat, deterministic outputs matched to floating-point precision, and fold-change order was identical across all nine differential expression tests. In a three-arm benchmark on three datasets, with fixed user parameters and 20 seeds per tool, Truecell more closely reproduced Seurat's clustering than a Seurat-configured Scanpy in all 12 combinations of dataset and resolution settings. Truecell's marker genes and enriched pathways were also closer to Seurat's than Scanpy's were, and pseudobulk DESeq2 reproduced Seurat's gene lists with a Jaccard index ranging from 0.95 to 1.00. This agreement reflects fidelity to Seurat rather than biological correctness.

AI.tldr: Truecell 是 Seurat 的 Python 重实现，保持接口与默认参数一致，在 18 组端到端比较中确定性输出与 R Seurat 匹配到浮点精度，聚类、标记基因与富集通路也比 Seurat 配置下的 Scanpy 更接近 Seurat。
AI.motivation: 单细胞 RNA 测序分析主要依赖 R 的 Seurat 或 Python 的 Scanpy，选择常出于语言偏好。但两者默认产生的可变特征、近邻图、聚类和标记基因存在差异。需要 Python（以支持深度学习、基础模型和智能体工具）的实验室若要用 Python 复现 Seurat 分析，缺少能忠实复刻 Seurat 结果的框架。
AI.method: 开发 Truecell，作为 Seurat 接口的 Python 实现，保留函数名、参数、默认设置和对象模型。评估包括：18 组配对端到端比较（对比 R Seurat）；9 项差异表达检验的倍数变化排序比较；3 数据集、3 组实验、每工具 20 个随机种子的基准，比较 Truecell、Seurat 配置的 Scanpy 与 Seurat 在聚类等结果上的一致性；以及伪批量 DESeq2 基因列表比较。
AI.result: 18 组配对端到端评估中，确定性输出与 R Seurat 匹配到浮点精度，9 项差异表达检验的倍数变化排序完全一致。3 数据集基准中，固定用户参数、每工具 20 个种子下，Truecell 在全部 12 种数据集与分辨率设置组合中都比 Seurat 配置的 Scanpy 更接近 Seurat 聚类。Truecell 的标记基因和富集通路也更接近 Seurat；伪批量 DESeq2 复现 Seurat 基因列表的 Jaccard 指数为 0.95–1.00。
AI.conclusion: Truecell 能高保真复现 Seurat 的分析结果，为偏好 Python 的实验室提供无缝迁移路径。但该一致性反映的是对 Seurat 的忠实度，而非生物学正确性。

title: Scaling subjects in cross-modal alignment: video decoding with EEG foundation model
summary: Naturalistic visual decoding from EEG has long been constrained by cohort size: existing scaling literature caps out at a few dozen subjects, leading prior work to conclude that scaling subject cohorts yields minimal performance gains. Training a cross-modal EEG--video contrastive encoder on a cohort larger by more than an order of magnitude, we find the axis is productive but has an onset. Below $S\approx50$ --- the entirety of the range prior work occupies --- no model improves meaningfully over an untrained encoder; above it, decoding rises log-linearly in subject count with no saturation at the top of our ladder, on a fitted stimulus-feature probe and on fit-free movie-moment retrieval alike, and the gain transfers to a second, unseen film. How far the axis carries then depends on initialisation more than on capacity: an encoder initialised from an EEG foundation model scales ${\sim}1.6\times$ faster per doubling of the cohort than randomly initialised encoders at two depths, is the only one still converting subjects into retrieval accuracy at the top of the ladder, and converges on a fraction of the alignment compute. Subject scaling on shared naturalistic stimuli is thus an effective and currently unsaturated frontier for scaling EEG foundation models.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过训练大规模跨模态EEG-视频对比编码器，发现自然视觉解码中受试者规模扩展存在"阈值效应"（约50人以上），且性能随人数对数线性提升、无饱和迹象；初始化方式（尤其是EEG基础模型初始化）比模型容量更决定扩展效率。
AI.motivation: 以往基于EEG的自然视觉解码受限于受试者队列规模，已有扩展性研究最多仅涉及数十名受试者，因而得出"扩大受试者队列对性能提升甚微"的结论。本文旨在重新审视这一结论，检验受试者数量这一维度是否被低估。
AI.method: 在比以往大一个数量级以上的受试者队列上，训练跨模态EEG-视频对比编码器；在不同受试者规模S、不同初始化方式（随机初始化 vs. EEG基础模型初始化）和两种深度下进行扩展实验；评估指标包括拟合的刺激特征探针和无需拟合的电影片段检索任务，并检验对第二部未见影片的迁移能力。
AI.result: 在S≈50以下（即以往研究覆盖的全部范围）没有模型能显著超越未训练编码器；超过该阈值后，解码性能随受试者数量呈对数线性上升，且在统计阶梯顶端仍未饱和，该增益可迁移至未见的第二部影片。由EEG基础模型初始化的编码器在队列翻倍时的扩展速度约为随机初始化编码器的1.6倍，是唯一在顶端仍能将受试者数量转化为检索精度的模型，且对齐计算量仅为一部分。
AI.conclusion: 共享自然刺激下的受试者规模扩展是训练EEG基础模型的一个有效且当前尚未饱和的前沿方向；初始化策略而非模型容量决定了该扩展轴的实际收益上限。

title: Compiling Semi-Ring Dynamic Programming to Tier-Aware 3D-DRAM Processing-in-Memory
summary: Processing-in-Memory (PIM) on monolithic 3D (M3D) DRAM is a promising answer to the memory wall for data-intensive dynamic programming (DP), yet extracting its performance today demands hand-written kernels: the programmer must pick a tile size, place data across non-uniform-latency memory tiers, partition work between heterogeneous processing units, and insert the right broadcasts and queues by hand. We present GenMLIR, an MLIR compiler that automates this mapping for tier-aware 3D PIM. GenMLIR encodes the semi-ring generalized grid update, the algebraic form shared by all-pairs shortest path (APSP) and sequence alignment, as a first-class IR abstraction, and lowers it through four GenDRAM-aware pass groups that derive blocked tiling, tier-aware placement, tile-to-PU assignment, and explicit communication. We also characterize precisely which DP recurrences the abstraction admits and which it does not. On the GenDRAM architecture, GenMLIR-generated code runs up to 5.8 (APSP) and 16.7 (alignment) faster than a lowering without compiler support, and 1.2-1.4 faster than a standard affine-tiling PIM compiler we also implement, reaching 90-100% of an achievable-performance bound. It expresses these workloads in 4-9 lines instead of 300-500 and compiles in a negligible fraction of runtime.

AI.tldr: GenMLIR是一个MLIR编译器，将半环广义网格更新抽象为一等IR，通过四组GenDRAM感知pass自动完成分块、分层放置、PU分配与通信生成，在3D PIM DRAM上加速动态规划负载。
AI.motivation: 单片3D DRAM上的存内计算（PIM）是缓解数据密集型动态规划访存墙的有力方案，但当前提取其性能需要手写内核：程序员必须手动选择分块大小、在非均匀延迟的多层存储间放置数据、在异构处理单元间划分工作，并手工插入广播与队列。
AI.method: 提出GenMLIR，一个面向分层感知3D PIM的MLIR编译器。将半环广义网格更新（APSP与序列比对共用的代数形式）编码为一等IR抽象，经四组GenDRAM感知pass组降级，分别推导分块tiling、分层感知数据放置、tile到PU的分配以及显式通信；并精确刻画该抽象可容纳与不可容纳的DP递推。
AI.result: 在GenDRAM架构上，GenMLIR生成代码相比无编译器支持的降级最高加速5.8倍（APSP）和16.7倍（比对），相比自实现的标准仿射tiling PIM编译器快1.2–1.4倍，达到可达性能上界的90–100%；表达这些负载仅需4–9行代码（而非300–500行），编译时间占运行时间可忽略。
AI.conclusion: GenMLIR证明通过将DP的代数结构抽象为一等IR并结合架构感知的降级流程，可自动化单调3D PIM上的映射，在显著降低编程成本的同时获得接近上界的性能。

title: Optimization of Deep Learning Model for Denoising Dose Profiles in Proton Therapy
summary:
Proton therapy offers a dosimetric advantage over conventional radiotherapy through the Bragg peak, enabling precise dose delivery to the tumour while sparing surrounding tissue. Monte Carlo (MC) simulation provides the most accurate dose calculation but is computationally expensive for clinical workflows. A promising compromise is to simulate with a reduced number of primary histories and recover a high-quality dose distribution through a deep learning denoising step.
  In this work, we take a 3D multiscale U-Net from recent literature as a case study and investigate two improvements critical for clinical deployment. First, we replace the standard MSE training objective with a differentiable $γ$-index-based loss, extended to native 3D operation, and demonstrate that directly optimising the clinical evaluation metric yields a mean Gamma Passing Rate of 99.47\% at 2mm/2\% and 95.67\% at 1mm/1\% on the test set, compared to 92.10\% and 71.13\% for MSE. Second, we apply L1-norm structured filter pruning to reduce the model's memory footprint, achieving a 13.3\% parameter reduction with negligible performance loss under partial pruning, and 20\% reduction under full-block pruning after fine-tuning.

AI.tldr: 本文以3D多尺度U-Net为案例，研究质子治疗蒙特卡洛剂量去噪模型的两项改进：用可微3D γ-index损失替代MSE，并采用L1范数结构化滤波器剪枝压缩模型。
AI.motivation: 质子治疗的蒙特卡洛剂量计算虽最精确，但计算开销大；用少量初级粒子历史模拟再经深度学习去噪是有前景的折中方案，但需解决临床部署中的两个关键问题：训练目标与临床评价指标不一致，以及模型内存占用过大。
AI.method: 第一，将标准MSE训练目标替换为可微的γ-index损失，并扩展到原生3D操作；第二，对模型施加L1范数结构化滤波器剪枝，以降低内存占用。
AI.result: 直接优化临床评价指标后，测试集平均γ通过率在2mm/2%下达99.47%、1mm/1%下达95.67%，而MSE分别为92.10%和71.13%；部分剪枝实现13.3%参数减少且性能损失可忽略，全块剪枝经微调后参数减少20%。
AI.conclusion: 以临床指标为导向的可微损失能显著提升剂量去噪质量，结构化剪枝可在几乎不损失性能的前提下压缩模型，二者对质子治疗蒙特卡洛去噪模型的临床部署具有重要意义。

title: Adversarial RL for Port-Scan Evasion: Attacker Feature Visibility in Edge-Deployed IDS
summary: Machine learning-based intrusion detection systems (IDS) are increasingly used in resource-constrained Internet of Things (IoT) environments, yet their robustness is often evaluated against static attacks rather than adversaries that adapt to detection feedback. This paper investigates adaptive port-scan evasion against ML-based IDS models deployed on a Raspberry Pi 3B+. We implement a live Zeek-based IDS pipeline with XGBoost, a multi-layer perceptron, and a 1D convolutional neural network trained on TON_IoT telemetry, and use a Deep Q-Network (DQN) adversary to learn evasive combinations of probe timing, TCP flags, and payload size under black-box, gray-box, and white-box feature-visibility settings. Although the deployed IDS models detect conventional port scans at 91.1--99.8%, DQN final-50-episode evasion rates range from 61.9% to 98.3% across feature-visibility settings. Greater feature visibility does not monotonically improve evasion, and its effect is model-dependent: against XGBoost, the black-box agent achieves 92.9% evasion, compared with 61.9% and 76.9% for gray-box and white-box agents, respectively, whereas 1D-CNN is most vulnerable under white-box access at 98.1%. Because standard DQN can overestimate action values, we additionally spot-check representative conditions using Double DQN. The gray-box condition remains unstable in this check, providing no evidence that overestimation bias alone explains the observed instability. These results show that limited feature knowledge can still enable effective adaptive evasion against static edge-deployed IDS models, motivating more robust defenses for IoT edge environments.

AI.tldr: 本文在树莓派3B+上构建Zeek+XGBoost/MLP/1D-CNN的IoT入侵检测流水线，用DQN对抗智能体学习端口扫描规避策略，发现特征可见度越高并不意味着规避率越高，且该效应依赖模型，说明静态边缘IDS易被自适应规避攻击。
AI.motivation: 现有基于机器学习的IoT入侵检测系统（IDS）多针对静态攻击评估鲁棒性，而缺乏对能够依据检测反馈进行自适应调整的对手的研究；边缘部署场景下的自适应规避风险尚未被充分刻画。
AI.method: 在Raspberry Pi 3B+上部署基于Zeek的实时IDS流水线，采用TON_IoT数据训练XGBoost、多层感知机（MLP）与一维卷积神经网络（1D-CNN）；使用Deep Q-Network（DQN）作为对抗智能体，在黑盒、灰盒、白盒三种特征可见度设定下学习探针时序、TCP标志与负载大小的规避组合；并针对DQN动作价值高估问题，用Double DQN对代表性条件进行抽查验证。
AI.result: 部署的IDS对常规端口扫描检测率为91.1%–99.8%；DQN最后50回合规避率在61.9%–98.3%之间。特征可见度提升并不单调改善规避效果且依赖模型：针对XGBoost，黑盒智能体规避率达92.9%，灰盒与白盒分别为61.9%和76.9%；1D-CNN在白盒访问下最脆弱，为98.1%。Double DQN抽查中灰盒条件仍不稳定，未发现高估偏差单独解释该不稳定性的证据。
AI.conclusion: 有限的特征知识即可实现对静态边缘部署IDS模型的有效自适应规避，静态评估低估了实际威胁，亟需面向IoT边缘环境设计更鲁棒的防御机制。

title: Part of the Strassen algorithm can speed up matrix multiplication in a parallel pebbling game
summary: We present a novel variant of the Strassen algorithm called the Partial Strassen algorithm, which uses a fraction of the Strassen steps to perform matrix multiplication in less time than traditional implementations. The memory footprint required to implement this algorithm is provably small whether used with a single thread or in a multi-threaded context. Data comparing the Partial Strassen algorithm at depths one, two, and three with BLAS matrix multiplication show that the three-level Partial Strassen algorithm is able to perform matrix multiplication in $80\%$ the time of BLAS with $2.25$ times the memory requirement, with a theoretical improvement of $75\%$ for sufficiently large matrices. The Partial Strassen algorithm is also compared against an implementation of the traditional Strassen algorithm, and is shown to be more performant with increasing matrix size due to decreased memory consumption. An open source implementation of the Partial Strassen algorithm for arbitrary depth and rectangular matrix multiplication is also included.

AI.tldr: 提出部分Strassen算法，用少量Strassen步骤实现更快的矩阵乘法，内存占用小，三级时耗时仅为BLAS的80%。
AI.motivation: 传统Strassen算法虽降低时间复杂度，但内存开销大、缓存效率低，限制了实际性能；需要兼顾速度与内存占用的改进方案。
AI.method: 设计Partial Strassen算法，仅使用部分Strassen递归步骤进行矩阵乘法，支持单线程与多线程，并给出任意深度及矩形矩阵乘法的开源实现。
AI.result: 三级Partial Strassen耗时约为BLAS的80%，内存需求为2.25倍，理论对大矩阵可提升75%；相比传统Strassen，随矩阵增大性能更优，内存消耗更低。
AI.conclusion: Partial Strassen在速度与内存之间取得更佳折中，适合实际大规模矩阵乘法，且已开源可供复用。

title: A Review Of Robotic World Models For Dynamic Environments Based On Factor And Scene Graphs
summary: Models based on graphs have emerged in robotics as a powerful foundation for internal world representations, where factor and scene graphs are among the most prominent model types found in the related literature and in successful robotic solutions. Initially, many of these models were assuming static environments as a simplification. Herein, factor graphs mainly provide uncertainty-aware geometric estimations while scene graphs enable a structured semantic abstraction. However, real-world robotic environments are often dynamic, posing severe challenges for purely static world representations. Therefore, this review presents a comprehensive view on how dynamic aspects of real-world environments can be addressed in such graph-based world models. We organize our assessments around three main aspects: (I) suitable representations, (II) pipelines to construct and update the representations, and (III) their exploitation for downstream tasks. We review approaches that are either based on factor or scene graphs, but put special emphasis on novel approaches that combine both types to form hybrid models. We mainly analyze how different types of dynamics can be modeled herein, and categorize common architectural patterns. Finally, emerging trends and open challenges are identified, including uncertainty propagation from learned perception through the representation layers, the observability of dynamic-entity motion and scale under minimal sensing, scalable lifelong maintenance, and the lack of datasets and evaluation protocols that ground world-model quality in downstream task performance under dynamics.

AI.tldr: 这是一篇综述，系统梳理了图式世界模型（因子图与场景图及其混合模型）如何应对真实机器人环境中的动态性。
AI.motivation: 基于图的世界模型（因子图、场景图）在机器人领域已成为内部世界表示的重要基础，但早期多以静态环境为简化假设；真实环境常具动态性，对纯静态表示构成严峻挑战，因此亟需系统性地审视动态性问题。
AI.method: 围绕三个方面组织评述：(I) 合适的表示；(II) 构建与更新表示的流程；(III) 面向下游任务的利用。综述覆盖因子图与场景图方法，并着重于二者结合形成的混合模型，分析可建模的动态类型并归纳常见架构模式。
AI.result: 系统比较了因子图（不确定性感知的几何估计）与场景图（结构化语义抽象）在动态建模中的地位，归纳出混合模型的常见架构模式与动态类型分类。
AI.conclusion: 指出新兴趋势与开放挑战，包括学习感知到表示层的不确定性传播、最小感知下动态实体运动与尺度的可观测性、可扩展的终身维护，以及缺乏将世界模型质量与动态条件下下游任务性能关联的数据集与评测协议。

title: Tokka-Bench: Evaluating Tokenizers Across 100 Natural and 20 Programming Languages
comment: 5 pages, 5 figures. Code and data: https://github.com/bgub/tokka-bench. Interactive dashboard: https://tokka-bench.streamlit.app/
summary: Large language models rely on subword tokenizers whose quality varies across languages, yet no standardized multi-metric framework exists for broad comparative evaluation. We introduce Tokka-Bench, an open-source framework that evaluates tokenizers on five complementary metrics -- bytes per token, unique token coverage, subword fertility, word-split rate, and vocabulary composition -- across 100 natural languages (30+ scripts) and 20 programming languages, using language-aware segmentation adapted to each writing system. Comparing seven BPE tokenizers (GPT-2, GPT-4, gpt-oss, Llama 3.1, Gemma 3, Qwen3, and Kimi K2) within individual languages, we find that vocabulary allocation strategy matters more than raw vocabulary size, and that programming-language efficiency has converged among recent tokenizers despite divergent natural-language profiles. The framework, data, and interactive dashboard are publicly available.

AI.tldr: 提出开源框架 Tokka-Bench，用五项互补指标在100种自然语言（30+书写系统）和20种编程语言上系统评测分词器，发现词表分配策略比词表规模更关键。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型依赖子词分词器，但其质量在不同语言间差异显著，而现有研究缺乏标准化的多指标框架来进行广泛的比较评测。
AI.method: Tokka-Bench 采用五项互补指标——每词元字节数、唯一词元覆盖率、子词生育率、词切分率、词表构成，并针对每种书写系统采用语言感知的分词方式，在100种自然语言和20种编程语言上评测七个 BPE 分词器（GPT-2、GPT-4、gpt-oss、Llama 3.1、Gemma 3、Qwen3、Kimi K2）。
AI.result: 在单一语言内部比较显示，词表分配策略比词表原始规模更重要；近期分词器在编程语言效率上已趋于收敛，尽管其自然语言表现差异明显。
AI.conclusion: Tokka-Bench 提供了标准化、多指标、跨语言的分词器评测方案，并公开框架、数据与交互式看板，为分词器设计与选择提供依据。

title: Pre-training, Reasoning, Benchmarking: X-ray Report Generation on CheXpert Plus Dataset
summary: X-ray image-based Radiology Report Generation (RRG) constitutes a critical research direction within medical artificial intelligence, with great potential to alleviate clinicians' diagnostic workload and shorten patient waiting periods. Despite substantial advances over recent years, the field faces evident bottlenecks stemming from insufficient standardized benchmarks and inadequate domain adaptation of generic large models. Notably, the newly released CheXpert Plus dataset is provided without accompanying baseline implementations and evaluation results, which impedes standardized training, quantitative evaluation and fair comparison among follow-up algorithms. To mitigate this limitation, we establish a comprehensive benchmark encompassing prevailing X-ray report generation models and Large Language Models on CheXpert Plus. This benchmark delivers a reliable comparative foundation for upcoming methods and enables researchers to rapidly identify state-of-the-art approaches within this domain. Beyond benchmark construction, we rethink X-ray RRG under the paradigm of large models and propose a novel framework termed MambaXray-PRB. Our framework improves report generation performance and enhances model interpretability via multi-stage large-model pre-training and multi-modal Chain-of-Thought reasoning. The pipeline consists of three successive phases: self-supervised auto-regressive modeling, X-ray-report contrastive learning, and post-training optimization for reasoning and report generation. Extensive experiments on IU X-ray, MIMIC-CXR, and CheXpert Plus datasets validate the effectiveness of MambaXray-PRB for radiology report generation. The source code of this paper is available on https://github.com/Event-AHU/Medical_Image_Analysis

AI.tldr: 本文针对X-ray报告生成缺乏标准化基准及通用大模型领域适配不足的问题，在CheXpert Plus上构建了包含主流模型与LLM的综合基准，并提出MambaXray-PRB框架，经三阶段大模型预训练与多模态思维链推理提升报告生成性能与可解释性。
AI.motivation: X-ray影像报告生成（RRG）可减轻临床诊断负担、缩短患者等待时间，但该领域存在标准化基准不足与通用大模型领域适配不佳的瓶颈。特别是新发布的CheXpert Plus数据集未提供基线实现与评测结果，阻碍了标准化训练、量化评估与公平比较。
AI.method: 工作分为两部分：一是构建综合基准，在CheXpert Plus上集成主流X-ray报告生成模型与大语言模型，为后续方法提供可靠对比基础；二是提出MambaXray-PRB框架，采用多阶段大模型预训练与多模态思维链（Chain-of-Thought）推理，流程包含自监督自回归建模、X-ray-报告对比学习、面向推理与报告生成的后训练优化三个阶段。
AI.result: 在IU X-ray、MIMIC-CXR和CheXpert Plus三个数据集上的大量实验验证了MambaXray-PRB在放射学报告生成任务上的有效性，同时基准为研究者快速识别领域内最先进方法提供了支撑。源码已开源于https://github.com/Event-AHU/Medical_Image_Analysis。
AI.conclusion: 本文通过构建CheXpert Plus标准化基准并提出MambaXray-PRB框架，在提升X-ray报告生成性能的同时增强了模型可解释性，为RRG领域的标准化评测与后续研究提供了可靠基础与方法参考。

title: Connectome-Based Modeling of Mutation-Specific Amyloid-$β$ Aggregation in Familial Alzheimer's Disease
summary: Familial amyloid-$β$ (A$β$) variants alter aggregation kinetics, but their interaction with structural brain connectivity remains incompletely understood. We developed a mutation-aware mechanistic model coupling a coarse-grained monomer--oligomer--fibril aggregation--fragmentation system to graph diffusion on the 540-node Budapest Reference Connectome component. Experimental A$β_{42}$ nucleation scores scaled primary nucleation rates for seven variants relative to wild type. Robustness was examined using mutation-score uncertainty, alternative kinetic mappings, global sensitivity analysis, seed and edge-weight perturbations, degree-preserving randomized connectomes, spatial propagation analysis, synthetic ABC-SMC parameter recovery, posterior prediction, and Chemical Langevin simulations. E22G showed the earliest threshold crossing and greatest cumulative oligomer burden, whereas A2V was delayed under the selected mapping. Mutation rankings persisted across tested network perturbations, although regional burden patterns depended on topology. Connectome distance from seed regions was associated with later oligomer arrival (Spearman $ρ\approx0.92$). Under inferred parameter uncertainty, the mean timing-rank correlation was 0.990 and cumulative-burden ordering was preserved in every posterior draw, while exact peak-amplitude ordering was less stable. Stochastic ensemble medians retained the deterministic ordering despite overlap among trajectories. Within this proof-of-concept framework, mutation-dependent kinetics primarily influence aggregation timing and cumulative burden, while connectivity shapes spatial propagation. Nominal background rates, model-time units, and synthetic parameter recovery limit interpretation to mechanistic comparisons rather than clinically calibrated prediction.

AI.tldr: 该研究构建了一个突变感知的机制模型，将粗粒化Aβ单体–寡聚体–纤维聚集–断裂系统与540节点Budapest参考连接组的图扩散耦合，用于比较家族性Aβ变异的聚集动力学与脑结构连接性的相互作用。结果显示突变主要影响聚集时间与累积寡聚体负担，而连接性主要塑造空间传播模式。
AI.motivation: 家族性Aβ变异已知会改变聚集动力学，但其与脑结构连接性的相互作用尚不完全清楚。作者希望建立一个可将分子层面的突变效应与全脑网络传播联系起来的机制框架。
AI.method: 构建突变感知机制模型：将粗粒化单体–寡聚体–纤维的聚集–断裂动力学系统与540节点Budapest参考连接组上的图扩散相耦合；用实验Aβ42成核分数对7种变异相对野生型的主要成核速率进行标定。通过突变分数不确定性、替代动力学映射、全局敏感性分析、种子与边权重扰动、度保持随机化连接组、空间传播分析、合成ABC-SMC参数回收、后验预测以及Chemical Langevin模拟进行稳健性检验。
AI.result: E22G表现出最早的阈值跨越和最大的累积寡聚体负担，而A2V在所选映射下延迟。突变排序在各类网络扰动下保持一致，但区域负担模式依赖拓扑结构。种子区域的连接组距离与寡聚体到达时间呈强相关（Spearman ρ≈0.92）。在推断参数不确定性下，时间秩相关的均值为0.990，累积负担排序在每个后验抽样中均保持，而精确峰值幅度排序较不稳定。随机系综中位数仍保留确定性排序，尽管轨迹之间存在重叠。
AI.conclusion: 在该概念验证框架内，突变依赖的动力学主要影响聚集时间和累积负担，而连接性塑造空间传播。由于名义背景速率、模型时间单位以及合成参数回收的限制，结果应解释为机制性比较，而非临床校准预测。

title: An Interleaved Parallel Dependent Quantization Hardware Architecture for H.266/VVC
summary: While dependent quantization in H.266/VVC delivers a high compression ratio, its strong serial nature and high complexity result in poor real-time performance, making it difficult to deploy in practical scenarios. To improve the real-time performance of dependent quantization with minimal degradation to its compression performance, we propose a interleaved parallel dependent quantization hardware architecture with low BDBR loss, which achieves four-channel parallel dependent quantization by time-division multiplexing most combinational logic. This architecture adopts the proposed intra-CG context simplification scheme and the encoding scheme that skips decAbslevel during rate estimation. The proposed design incurs a BDBR loss of only 0.42% under the All Intra configuration and 0.38% under the Random Access configuration, respectively. Implemented in Verilog HDL, the dependent quantization hardware architecture achieves quantization speeds of 4K@33.2, 91.4, 331.2, and 454.1 fps at QP = 22, 27, 32, and 37, respectively, when implemented on the Xilinx XCZU19 FPGA. When implemented on ASIC using the TSMC 28nm process standard cell library, the corresponding quantization speeds reach 4K@84.0, 231.0, 837.0, and 1147.7 fps.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种交织并行依赖量化硬件架构，通过时分复用组合逻辑实现四通道并行，在极小BDBR损失下大幅提升H.266/VVC依赖量化的实时性。
AI.motivation: H.266/VVC中的依赖量化虽压缩率高，但串行性强、复杂度高，实时性能差，难以在实际场景中部署，因此需要在尽量不损失压缩性能的前提下提升其实时性。
AI.method: 提出交织并行依赖量化硬件架构，通过时分复用大部分组合逻辑实现四通道并行依赖量化；采用提出的intra-CG上下文简化方案，以及在进行码率估计时跳过decAbslevel的编码方案。
AI.result: 在All Intra配置下BDBR损失仅0.42%，Random Access配置下仅0.38%。Verilog HDL实现后，在Xilinx XCZU19 FPGA上，QP=22、27、32、37时量化速度分别为4K@33.2、91.4、331.2、454.1 fps；在TSMC 28nm工艺标准单元库的ASIC实现中，对应速度达4K@84.0、231.0、837.0、1147.7 fps。
AI.conclusion: 该架构以可接受的压缩性能损失为代价，显著提升了依赖量化的实时性能，在FPGA和ASIC实现中均达到较高的4K量化帧率。

title: FaceKit: a Toolkit for Interpretable Facial Phenotyping, Synthetic Image Generation and Privacy Analysis in Rare Diseases
summary: Many rare genetic diseases are associated with recognizable craniofacial features. However, traditional approaches for describing facial morphology rely largely on qualitative clinical observation and free-text descriptions, which are often subjective, non-standardized, and difficult to reproduce across observers and institutions. Although the Human Phenotype Ontology (HPO) provides controlled terms for describing facial features, these terms are typically categorical rather than quantitative and may vary depending on examiner experience and interpretation. Here, we present FaceKit, a computational framework for quantitative facial phenotyping from frontal facial photographs. FaceKit extracts standardized measurements of facial landmarks and derived 120 morphological features, then reports feature-level z-scores representing deviation from population reference distributions. The reference distributions are built from the FairFace dataset spanning diverse ancestral groups. We evaluated FaceKit on a curated subset of the GestaltMatcher Database covering 50 rare-disease cohorts. In addition to quantitative facial analysis, FaceKit includes synthetic facial image generation to support rare disease model development and data augmentation. We also performed privacy evaluation to assess whether synthetic images reveal identifiable information from real patient photographs and could compromise patient privacy. Across disease case studies, FaceKit-derived quantitative measurements captured known facial features associated with rare genetic disorders and provided objective support for clinical phenotyping. Together, these results establish FaceKit as a useful tool for quantitative phenotyping, and has the potential to improve rare disease diagnosis, support genotype-phenotype studies, and enable more reproducible clinical characterization across diverse patient populations.

AI.tldr: FaceKit：一个从正面照片进行定量面部表型分析的计算框架，输出120个形态特征的z分数，并支持合成人脸生成与隐私评估。
AI.motivation: 罕见遗传病常伴可识别的颅面特征，但传统面部形态描述依赖定性临床观察与自由文本，主观性强、缺乏标准化，跨观察者和机构难以复现。HPO虽提供受控术语，但多为分类性而非定量，且受检查者经验影响。
AI.method: FaceKit从正面面部照片提取标准化面部关键点测量值并衍生120个形态特征，计算特征级z分数以表示相对人群参考分布的偏离；参考分布基于涵盖多样祖先群体的FairFace数据集构建。在GestaltMatcher数据库中精选的50个罕见病队列子集上评估，并加入合成人脸生成以支持模型开发与数据增强，同时进行隐私评估以判断合成图像是否泄露真实患者可识别信息。
AI.result: 在多个疾病案例研究中，FaceKit衍生的定量测量能捕捉到与罕见遗传病相关的已知面部特征，并为临床表型分析提供客观支持；隐私评估用于衡量合成图像的隐私风险。
AI.conclusion: FaceKit是有效的定量表型分析工具，有望改进罕见病诊断、支持基因型-表型研究，并在多样患者群体中实现更可复现的临床刻画。

title: A Deployment-Aware Feasibility Framework for Machine Learning-Based IoT Intrusion Detection Across Edge, Fog, and Cloud Architectures
comment: 8 pages, 3 figures, 7 tables. Published in the 2026 IEEE 15th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
summary: The rapid growth and heterogeneity of Internet of Things (IoT) environments have exposed fundamental limitations in traditional rule-based and signature-based intrusion detection systems. This paper presents a quantitative deployment-aware analysis of machine learning (ML)-based intrusion detection approaches across edge, fog/gateway, and cloud architectures. Unlike prior surveys that primarily emphasize detection accuracy, this work defines representative quantitative deployment capability envelopes extracted from experimental and system-level studies and introduces a structured Deployment Feasibility Score (DFS) model. The proposed framework maps ML techniques to architectural layers based on computational demand, memory footprint, and latency sensitivity using a weighted ordinal scoring mechanism. The analysis demonstrates that lightweight statistical and linear models are most suitable for edge deployment, ensemble and clustering-based methods align with fog/gateway environments, while deep and optimization-driven models are best suited for cloud infrastructures. By formalizing deployment feasibility through quantitative grounding and structured evaluation, this work provides practical guidance for selecting intrusion detection solutions under real-world architectural constraints, supporting more informed and deployment-conscious IoT security design.

AI.tldr: 本文对基于机器学习的物联网入侵检测方法进行部署感知的定量分析，提出部署可行性评分（DFS）模型，将ML技术映射到边缘、雾/网关与云架构层，为实际部署选型提供指导。
AI.motivation: 物联网环境快速增长且高度异构，传统基于规则和签名的入侵检测系统暴露根本性局限。既有综述多聚焦检测精度，忽视真实架构约束下的部署可行性，缺乏量化的部署能力评估。
AI.method: 定义从实验与系统级研究中提取的代表性定量部署能力包络，提出结构化部署可行性评分（DFS）模型；基于计算需求、内存占用与延迟敏感性，采用加权序数评分机制，将ML技术映射到边缘、雾/网关、云三层架构。
AI.result: 轻量级统计与线性模型最适合边缘部署；集成与聚类类方法契合雾/网关环境；深度与优化驱动模型最适合云基础设施。
AI.conclusion: 通过量化依据与结构化评估形式化部署可行性，本工作为在真实架构约束下选择入侵检测方案提供实用指导，支持更具部署意识的物联网安全设计。

title: What Bloats Your Floats? Right-Sizing Numerical Precision for Scientific Computing
comment: Accepted at SC '26: The International Conference for High Performance Computing, Networking, Storage, and Analysis, November 15-20, 2026, Chicago, IL, USA. 15 pages, 10 figures, 4 tables
summary: While FP64 (binary64) remains the standard representation of real numbers in scientific computing, hardware trends increasingly favor low-precision formats optimized for AI workloads. This shift prioritizes throughput and energy efficiency over full-precision capabilities. We challenge the necessity of high-precision arithmetic in PDE-governed simulations, where spatial and temporal discretization errors introduce a physical noise floor that masks the lower-order bits of the FP64 format, rendering them irrelevant. We propose a criterion based on the Signal-to-Noise Ratio (SNR) with respect to spatial and temporal refinements to evaluate the impact of safe precision reduction on scientific computations. Finally, we present an automated dataflow-centric workflow for targeted lowering within mixed-precision subgraphs in complex scientific applications. Large-scale evaluations of weather and climate applications show that strategic precision reduction on GPUs achieves up to 1.8x speedup without compromising physical fidelity.

AI.tldr: 本文挑战PDE科学计算必须使用高精度算术的传统观点，提出基于信噪比（SNR）的精度降低评估准则，并给出数据流中心的自动混合精度下变换工作流，在天气与气候应用中实现最高1.8倍加速且不损失物理保真度。
AI.motivation: FP64仍是科学计算中实数表示的标准，但硬件趋势日益偏向面向AI负载优化的低精度格式，强调吞吐与能效而非全精度能力。作者质疑PDE模拟中高精度算术的必要性：空间与时间离散误差引入物理噪声底，掩盖了FP64格式的低阶有效位，使其实际无关紧要。
AI.method: 提出一种基于信噪比（SNR）的判据，针对空间与时间加密来评估安全精度降低对科学计算的影响；同时提出一种以数据流为中心的自动化工作流，在复杂科学应用的混合精度子图中进行定向降低精度（lowering）。
AI.result: 对天气与气候应用的大规模评估表明，在GPU上策略性降低精度可获得最高1.8倍加速，同时不损害物理保真度。
AI.conclusion: 在PDE主导的模拟中，高精度算术并非必要；基于SNR准则的定向混合精度降低可在保持物理保真度的前提下显著提升GPU性能，为科学计算中的低精度化提供了可行路径。

title: SAFE: Unified Slip and Fracture Detection with Low-Cost Acoustic Sensing in Robotic Grasping
summary: Manipulating fragile objects remains challenging as robots must understand the state of what they grasp, such as slip or fracture, to respond appropriately, especially when material properties are unknown. In this paper, we present SAFE: a low-cost, general-purpose sensing approach that detects both slip and fracture in real time using two passive polyvinylidene fluoride (PVDF) acoustic sensors and motor proprioception, without relying on vision or prior material knowledge. The sensors are mounted on a compliant Fin Ray gripper, and a unified HistGradientBoosting classifier reports the state (normal, slip, or fracture) from a 79-dimensional feature vector. Under leave-one-grasp-out cross-validation, SAFE achieves an Alert-F1 of 0.884 with near-zero slip-fracture confusion, and ablations confirm that acoustic sensing is indispensable. An adaptive grasp controller built on this detection layer runs at 104 Hz on a Jetson Orin Nano, achieving 91.3% success across 46 closed-loop robot trials spanning diverse object categories, while each fixed-force strategy drops to 0% on object conditions that mismatch its preset. It further reaches 82.4% success on novel objects unseen during training, demonstrating robust, failure-aware grasp control without object-specific calibration.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SAFE系统，利用两个被动式PVDF声学传感器与电机本体感觉，在未知材料属性的情况下实时检测抓取中的滑移与断裂，并结合自适应抓取控制器实现失败感知的闭环抓取。
AI.motivation: 机器人操作易碎物体时需掌握抓取状态（如滑移或断裂）才能做出恰当响应，而材料属性未知使这一问题更加困难；现有方法多依赖视觉或先验材料知识，成本高且泛化性差。因此需要一种低成本、通用且不依赖视觉与材料先验的实时状态检测方案。
AI.method: 采用两个被动式聚偏氟乙烯（PVDF）声学传感器，安装于柔性Fin Ray夹爪上，结合电机本体感觉信号；构建79维特征向量，使用统一的HistGradientBoosting分类器输出正常、滑移或断裂三种状态；在该检测层之上构建自适应抓取控制器，运行于Jetson Orin Nano平台，频率达104 Hz。
AI.result: 留一抓取交叉验证下，SAFE的Alert-F1达0.884，滑移与断裂之间几乎无混淆，消融实验证实声学传感不可或缺；在46次涵盖多类物体的闭环机器人试验中成功率为91.3%，而各固定力策略在与其预设不匹配的物体条件下成功率降至0%；对训练未见的新物体成功率为82.4%。
AI.conclusion: SAFE证明了仅凭低成本被动声学传感与本体感觉即可实现鲁棒、失败感知的抓取控制，无需视觉、材料先验或针对特定物体的标定，具备良好的通用性与实用潜力。

title: Child ASR Adaptation with Adult Retention: An Empirical Study
summary: Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) systems often underperform for children and non-native speakers, while adapting adult ASR models to child speech can cause adult-speech forgetting. We study child ASR adaptation with adult retention across Arabic and English. We compare full fine-tuning, LoRA, and post-hoc weight-space merging across encoder--decoder, encoder--CTC, and AudioLLM-based ASR systems. Experiments use Arabic native and non-native child speech, English MyST child speech, and adult benchmarks from MGB-2 and LibriSpeech test-clean. We evaluate recognition quality with WER and quantify the adaptation--retention trade-off using Retention Index, Child Adaptation Gain, and Adaptation Recovery. Results show that child adaptation is necessary, especially for non-native Arabic and English child speech, but direct adaptation often reduces adult ASR performance. Bilingual adaptation is more stable than language-specific adaptation. Weight-space merging often improves the trade-off, especially for encoder--CTC, Whisper, and AudioLLM-based ASR, with LERP favoring adult retention and TIES recovering stronger child gains. For the encoder--decoder model, direct bilingual fine-tuning remains strongest in raw WER.\footnote{Code, and models are available at https://github.com/qcri/Child-ASR-Adaptation.

AI.tldr: 研究跨阿拉伯语和英语的儿童语音识别自适应与成人语音保持问题，比较全量微调、LoRA与事后权重空间合并三类方法在编码器-解码器、编码器-CTC及AudioLLM类ASR系统上的表现。
AI.motivation: ASR系统对儿童和非母语说话人表现欠佳，将成人ASR模型适配到儿童语音时又会导致成人语音能力遗忘，需要在儿童适配与成人保持之间取得平衡，且该问题在阿拉伯语等多语言场景下研究不足。
AI.method: 在阿拉伯语与英语上开展儿童ASR适配实验，对比全量微调、LoRA和事后权重空间合并（LERP、TIES）三类策略，覆盖编码器-解码器、编码器-CTC和基于AudioLLM的ASR三种架构；数据包括阿拉伯语母语与非母语儿童语音、英语MyST儿童语音，以及MGB-2和LibriSpeech test-clean成人基准；用WER评价识别质量，并用Retention Index、Child Adaptation Gain和Adaptation Recovery量化适配-保持权衡。
AI.result: 儿童适配是必要的，对非母语阿拉伯语和英语儿童语音尤为明显，但直接适配常降低成人ASR性能；双语适配比单语适配更稳定；权重空间合并常能改善权衡，尤其在编码器-CTC、Whisper和AudioLLM类ASR上，其中LERP更利于成人保持，TIES能恢复更强的儿童增益；对编码器-解码器模型，直接双语微调在原始WER上仍最强。
AI.conclusion: 儿童ASR适配需在儿童增益与成人保持间权衡，双语适配和事后权重空间合并（LERP偏向保持、TIES偏向儿童增益）是有效策略，但不同架构的最优方案存在差异，编码器-解码器模型仍以直接双语微调的WER最优。

title: Autonomous Driving Research Requires a Community-Driven Data Paradigm
summary: Autonomous driving has made remarkable progress, with recent AI advances enabling commercial deployments that are reshaping urban mobility. Yet the field remains far from its universal social promise: autonomous systems that can operate robustly anywhere, anytime, for anyone. We posit that this gap is not merely a modeling problem, but a problem of the prevailing data paradigm. Current research relies heavily on a few benchmark datasets with limited spatial and scenario coverage, even though the community has collectively produced over 600 autonomous driving datasets across nearly 50 countries. However, this abundance has not translated into broad research impact: most datasets remain significantly underused due to fragmentation, limited visibility, incompatible protocols, and benchmark incentives that concentrate attention on a few dominant datasets. We therefore argue that autonomous driving research requires a collaborative, community-driven data paradigm. Such a paradigm would improve the discovery, reuse, integration, and evaluation of diverse datasets; make underexplored data easier and more rewarding to study; and lower the barrier for new contributors. We outline its key principles, illustrate an early realization, and call for collaboration across academia and industry to transform fragmented datasets into shared community infrastructure for anytime-anywhere autonomy.

AI.tldr: 该论文主张自动驾驶研究应从依赖少数基准数据集转向协作式、社区驱动的数据范式，以释放现有600多个数据集的潜力，实现“随时随地为任何人”的通用自动驾驶。
AI.motivation: 自动驾驶虽已取得显著进展并进入商业部署，但距离“随时随地、面向任何人”的通用社会承诺仍有差距。作者认为这一差距不仅是建模问题，更是当前数据范式的问题：研究过度依赖空间与场景覆盖有限的少数基准数据集，而社区已积累近50个国家的600多个数据集，却因碎片化、可见性不足、协议不兼容及基准激励集中而被大量闲置。因此需要转变数据范式。
AI.method: 论文属于立场/观点类工作。作者提出以“协作式、社区驱动的数据范式”为核心主张，阐述其关键原则，展示一个早期实现案例，并呼吁学术界与产业界共同合作。该范式旨在改善多样数据集的发现、复用、整合与评估，降低新贡献者门槛，并让未被充分探索的数据更易研究、更具回报。
AI.result: 论文提出并勾勒了社区驱动数据范式的关键原则，给出了一个早期实现的示例，用以说明该范式的可行性。文中未报告量化实验结果，重点在于论证现有数据范式的局限并提出替代方案。
AI.conclusion: 作者得出结论：应将碎片化的自动驾驶数据集转化为共享的社区基础设施，以支撑“随时随地”的自动驾驶。实现这一目标需要学术界与产业界协同合作，推动数据范式的根本性转变。

title: Adaptive Workflow Intelligence: A Cognitive Architecture for Context-Driven Enterprise Automation
comment: 12 pages, simulation-based evaluation of adaptive workflow agents
summary: Enterprise systems increasingly rely on automated workflows, yet many AI-driven solutions remain brittle under non-stationary conditions, evolving policies, and delayed operational feedback. While reinforcement learning and large language model (LLM) agents offer partial adaptability, they do not by themselves provide persistent reflection mechanisms or straightforward integration with policy-constrained enterprise operations. This paper introduces Adaptive Workflow Intelligence (AWI), a cognitive architecture for context-driven enterprise agents organized around a four-layer Perception-Cognition-Action-Reflection (PCAR) loop. AWI treats reflection as a mechanism for continuous policy refinement and combines hybrid reasoning with reflective memory and feedback-driven adaptation to support decision making under environmental drift and operational constraints. We evaluate AWI in a simulated enterprise decision workflow characterized by delayed outcomes and a controlled regime shift. In a drift-and-delay stress test, guardrail-constrained adaptive approaches recover more rapidly than static automation while maintaining policy compliance. Within this setting, AWI's reflective components modestly reduce behavioral oscillation and feedback variance, illustrating the stability-agility trade-off introduced by reflective policy adaptation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出自适应工作流智能（AWI），一种面向企业智能体的认知架构，以"感知-认知-行动-反思"（PCAR）四层循环为核心，将反思机制用于持续策略精炼，并在带延迟反馈与制度突变的仿真企业决策流程中验证其稳定性与合规性。
AI.motivation: 企业系统日益依赖自动化工作流，但现有AI方案在非平稳条件、策略演化与延迟反馈下表现脆弱；强化学习与LLM智能体虽具备部分适应性，却缺乏持久反思机制，也难以与受策略约束的企业运营直接集成。因此需要一种兼顾适应性与合规性的认知架构。
AI.method: 提出AWI认知架构，组织为感知-认知-行动-反思（PCAR）四层闭环；将反思作为持续策略精炼机制，融合混合推理、反思记忆与反馈驱动适应，以支持环境漂移与运营约束下的决策。在具有延迟结果和受控制度突变的仿真企业决策工作流中进行评估，并开展"漂移-延迟"压力测试。
AI.result: 在漂移与延迟压力测试中，受护栏约束的自适应方法相比静态自动化能更快恢复，同时保持策略合规；在此设定下，AWI的反思组件适度降低了行为振荡与反馈方差，体现了反思式策略适应所带来的稳定性-敏捷性权衡。
AI.conclusion: AWI表明反思机制可作为持续策略精炼的有效手段，在受约束的企业环境中兼顾适应性与合规性；但其收益体现为温和的稳定性提升，而非显著的性能跃升，稳定性与敏捷性之间的权衡是反思式适应的固有特征。

title: A Bayesian Mirror Architecture for Emergent Consciousness: Circular Hierarchies, Self-Manifolds, and Hybrid Event-Self Binding
summary:
We present a foundational formulation of the Bayesian Mirror Architecture (BMA), a self-referential generative framework in which sensory abstractions, meta-abstractions, and a self-latent interact through circular recursion. The defining constraint is a closed update S_t <- H_{t-1}, where a hybrid event-self latent H_t binds self-representations to abstract world models and reinjects this coupling into the self-state. Consciousness, in a restricted sense, is not an optimization objective nor a semantic label, but an architectural property of systems possessing this circular structure.
  Because inference operates over posterior beliefs, BMA's intrinsic state space is a space of probability measures equipped with optimal-transport geometry. Stability and coherence are formulated in the 2-Wasserstein metric on P_2, yielding coordinate-free notions of self-stability and hybrid coherence along belief trajectories. We define a Causal Learning Regime (CLR) via bounds on Wasserstein belief drift together with an integration index capturing sustained coupling between self and world latents. CLR diagnoses whether the environment contains learnable causal structure; it is not a marker of consciousness.
  Global strict contractivity is not required: BMA may exhibit multiple coherent basins. We define self-manifolds basin-wise as supports of invariant measures under local Wasserstein contractivity. We identify Wasserstein epsilon-necks, transport bottlenecks where basins decouple, yielding a unique realized continuation in a vanishing-conductance limit. We interpret this selection as choice: internally determined yet externally unpredictable at finite resolution. Learning proceeds via variational free-energy minimization, with stability and agency emerging from what the environment affords to learn.

AI.tldr: 提出贝叶斯镜像架构(BMA)，一个基于圆环递归的自指生成框架；用最优传输几何刻画稳定性与连贯性，在Wasserstein度量下定义因果学习机制(CLR)、自流形与传输瓶颈，并给出"选择"的解释。
AI.motivation: 为"意识"提供一种非目标函数、非语义标签的架构性解释：仅将其视为具备圆环递归结构系统的属性，并为自指生成过程建立严格的几何与概率论基础。
AI.method: 1) 构建闭环更新约束 S_t <- H_{t-1}，混合事件-自我隐变量 H_t 将自我表征与世界模型耦合后回注自状态；2) 在概率测度空间 P_2 上以2-Wasserstein度量定义自稳定性与混合连贯性；3) 以Wasserstein信念漂移上界与整合指数刻画因果学习机制(CLR)；4) 用局部Wasserstein收敛下的不变测度支撑定义自流形，识别Wasserstein ε-瓶颈，并在电导趋零极限下给出唯一实现延续；5) 通过变分自由能最小化进行学习。
AI.result: BMA无需全局严格收敛，可存在多个连贯吸引盆；自流形按盆地定义为不变测度支撑；ε-瓶颈使盆地解耦，并在消失电导极限下筛选出唯一实现轨迹，该筛选被解释为"内部决定、有限分辨率下外部不可预测"的选择；稳定性与能动性由环境可学结构涌现。
AI.conclusion: CLR仅诊断环境中是否存在可学习的因果结构，并非意识标志；意识在该理论中是具备圆环递归结构系统的架构性质而非优化目标；BMA为自指生成、多盆地稳定性与选择性延续提供了统一的几何化形式框架。

title: Feedback to the primary visual cortex is highly concentrated on the central visual field representation
comment: 24 pages, 3 figures (2 figures in the main text, 1 figure in supplementary material)
summary: Retrograde tracer injections in marmoset monkeys revealed a striking feature of neural circuitry in primate visual system: among neurons projecting to the primary visual cortex (striate cortex, V1), the proportion of extrastriate feedback neurons relative to thalamic feedforward neurons decreases markedly with visual field eccentricity. This supports the Central-Peripheral Dichotomy theory, which proposes fundamentally distinct computational specializations --- visual recognition and attentional selection, respectively --- in the central and peripheral visual fields.

AI.tldr: 在狨猴中，逆向示踪显示投射到V1的细胞中，纹状外反馈神经元相对丘脑前馈神经元的比例随视野偏心度显著下降，支持中央-外周二分理论。
AI.motivation: 探究灵长类视觉系统皮层回路的组织是否存在与视野偏心度相关的系统性梯度，并为"中央-外周二分理论"（中央视野偏向视觉识别、外周视野偏向注意选择）提供解剖学证据。
AI.method: 在狨猴（marmoset monkey）上进行逆向示踪剂注射，定量分析投射至初级视皮层（纹状皮层，V1）的神经元来源，比较纹状外（extrastriate）反馈投射与丘脑（thalamic）前馈投射神经元在不同视野偏心度下的比例。
AI.result: 随视野偏心度增加，投射到V1的神经元中纹状外反馈神经元与丘脑前馈神经元的比例明显降低。
AI.conclusion: 灵长类视觉通路中前馈与反馈成分的构成随偏心度呈现梯度变化，构成一种此前未被充分认识的回路特征，为中央-外周二分理论提供了支持性解剖证据。

title: BenchmarkAnything: Agent-Driven Construction of Simulator-Ready Microarchitecture Benchmarks
summary:
The selection of benchmark workloads is of paramount importance in computer architecture, as it establishes the yardstick against which architectural innovations are measured and guided. Yet for decades, the SPEC benchmark suites, comprising merely tens of workloads, have been the de facto standard in academic architectural research, where they are frequently treated as a principal evaluation and optimization target. When a suite this small is relied upon so heavily, it risks architectural overfitting; as our research and prior studies demonstrate, an overly narrow focus can mislead design decisions by overvaluing certain innovations, producing cores that excel on SPEC benchmarks yet underperform on broader, realistic workloads.
  To mitigate this overfitting, adopting a large, comprehensive benchmark suite is the natural solution. However, the immense engineering effort required to strip software into the clean, interference-free binary executables demanded by simulators often makes this highly impractical. In this work, we demonstrate that AI agents provide an elegant solution to this challenge. Rather than manually curating yet another static benchmark suite, we introduce an agent-driven workflow capable of autonomously transforming arbitrary open-source repositories into simulator-ready executables. This automated approach makes workload collection highly scalable, allowing us to rapidly harvest hundreds of diverse applications from public repositories into our benchmark suite. Through a comparative analysis of our agent-generated suite against SPEC, we show that it not only achieves higher-fidelity performance assessments but also uncovers novel architectural insights that traditional, static suites fail to expose.

AI.tldr: 该论文指出现有SPEC基准套件规模过小易导致体系结构过拟合，提出用AI智能体自动将开源仓库转化为模拟器可执行文件的自动化工作流，从而大规模收集数百个多样化应用，构建出比SPEC更真实、更能揭示新体系结构洞见的基准套件。
AI.motivation: 基准负载的选择对计算机体系结构研究至关重要，它决定了衡量与引导体系结构创新的标尺。然而数十年来，仅含数十个工作负载的SPEC基准套件成为学术界事实上的标准，并常被当作主要的评估与优化目标。当如此小的套件被过度依赖时，会产生"体系结构过拟合"风险：研究过度聚焦于狭窄负载，会高估某些创新的价值，导致设计出的核心在SPEC上表现优异，却在更广泛、更真实的工作负载上性能不佳。因此需要缓解这种过拟合。
AI.method: 采用大型、全面的基准套件是缓解过拟合的自然方案，但将软件剥离为模拟器所需的干净、无干扰的二进制可执行文件需要巨大工程投入，极不现实。作者提出用AI智能体解决这一难题：不再手工整理又一个静态基准套件，而是引入一种智能体驱动的工作流，能够自主地将任意开源代码仓库转化为模拟器可执行文件。该自动化方法使工作负载收集高度可扩展，从而能快速从公共仓库采集数百个多样化应用纳入基准套件。
AI.result: 通过将智能体生成的基准套件与SPEC进行对比分析，作者表明其套件不仅能实现更高保真度的性能评估，还能揭示传统静态套件无法暴露的新颖体系结构洞见。
AI.conclusion: AI智能体驱动的自动化工作流可有效缓解因SPEC等小型静态基准套件过度依赖而造成的体系结构过拟合问题，实现可扩展的大规模真实工作负载采集，提供更高保真度的性能评估并带来新的体系结构洞见。

title: CircuitATLAS: Agentic reasoning over a systems neuroscience knowledge graph for target discovery in circuitopathies
summary: Drug discovery for neurological disease has traditionally centered on the molecules altered by disease. But the molecules that cause pathology are not necessarily the best points from which to reverse it. Here, we ask which otherwise unaltered molecular control points can be engaged to restore pathological neural circuits toward functional states. We present CircuitATLAS, a provenance-grounded systems-neuroscience knowledge graph and agentic framework for target discovery in circuitopathies. It structures literature-derived relationships across diseases, phenotypes, electrophysiology, circuits, brain regions, cell types and molecular effectors, while deliberately excluding direct disease-gene and disease-protein edges to reduce shortcut reasoning. The graph contains 3.83 million nodes and 7.66 million edges, including 5.31 million LLM-extracted relations, and incorporates structured datasets such as the Human Cell Atlas and new multimodal in vivo measurements. We then introduce an agentic workflow that reasons from measurable disease phenotypes through their circuit and cellular substrates to molecular interventions, therapeutic feasibility and clinical constraints. Finally, we introduce a human-governed in vivo lab-in-the-loop linking hypothesis generation to experimental iteration. Within this framework an agent nominated ATP1A3, the neuronal alpha3 Na+/K+-ATPase, as a control point on cortical excitability; interneuron-restricted expression of ATP1A3 abolished the beta- and gamma-band response to a focal 4-aminopyridine challenge in vivo, and the validated target was then carried into a structure-guided small-molecule campaign terminating in a defined assay to resolve the direction of modulation. CircuitATLAS thus provides a framework for discovering therapeutics based not only on what is molecularly disrupted in disease, but on what can be controlled to restore circuit function.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CircuitATLAS——一个面向神经环路病变（circuitopathies）靶点发现的溯源型系统神经科学知识图谱与智能体框架，并配套人机协同的体内实验闭环，成功发现并验证了ATP1A3作为皮层兴奋性调控节点。
AI.motivation: 神经系统疾病药物发现传统上聚焦于疾病中被改变的分子，但致病分子未必是逆转病理的最佳干预切入点。作者转而提出一个核心问题：哪些本身未被改变的分子调控节点可被用于将病理神经环路恢复至功能状态。
AI.method: 构建CircuitATLAS知识图谱，整理文献中跨疾病、表型、电生理、环路、脑区、细胞类型和分子效应器的关系，并有意排除疾病-基因、疾病-蛋白直接边以减少捷径推理；图谱含383万节点和766万边，其中531万条为LLM抽取关系，并整合Human Cell Atlas等结构化数据集及新型多模态在体验证数据。随后设计智能体工作流，从可测量疾病表型经由环路与细胞基质推理至分子干预、治疗可行性与临床约束；并引入人机共控的in vivo lab-in-the-loop闭环，将假设生成与实验迭代相衔接。
AI.result: 在该框架中，智能体提名ATP1A3（神经元α3 Na+/K+-ATPase）作为皮层兴奋性的调控节点；中间神经元限制性表达ATP1A3可消除体内对局灶4-氨基吡啶刺激的β和γ波段响应。经验证的靶点随后进入结构导向的小分子筛选，最终形成明确的测定方案以判定调控方向。
AI.conclusion: CircuitATLAS提供了一个治疗发现框架，其依据不仅在于疾病中哪些分子被破坏，更在于哪些分子可被调控以恢复环路功能。

title: Visible-Spectrum Optical Covert Channels in Commodity Smart Lighting
summary: Smart light-emitting diode (LED) bulbs are networked devices that produce information-carrying output. This study asks whether that light can carry digital data through changes small enough to be difficult for a person in the room to notice. To explore this covert communication channel, we tested an unmodified smart bulb (Philips WiZ A19) using a camera as the receiver. Binary data were encoded programmatically in nearly matched color and brightness changes. Because the differences were deliberately small across 16 million color steps, the receiver periodically measured known reference states and used them to compensate for changes in the camera and background room illumination. The color method successfully transmitted the short message 'hi' using a color difference (E) of 0.5, a standard measure of perceptual color distance. The receiver recovered 99% of the transmitted bits, and the complete message passed an integrity check. The brightness method remained decodable at the smallest nonzero integer difference tested, alternating between dimming settings 56 and 54, with 96.2% mean bit accuracy across two runs. When both binary symbols were assigned to the same brightness in a control experiment, accuracy fell to approximately chance. These results show that the visible output of an ordinary smart bulb can serve as a low-rate data channel without hardware modification. Camera color drift can overwhelm small signals unless the receiver is recalibrated during transmission, sudden changes in ambient light can disrupt decoding, and longer messages require stronger error correction. The color experiment operated at a difference below a conventional threshold for human color discrimination. The corresponding perceptual limit for the brightness method has not yet been established experimentally.

AI.tldr: 研究利用未经改造的智能灯泡（Philips WiZ A19）和相机接收端，通过极小的颜色与亮度变化构建隐蔽光通信信道，成功传输并解码短消息。
AI.motivation: 智能LED灯泡是联网设备并产生可承载信息的可见光输出，作者希望探究这种光能否通过人眼难以察觉的微小变化来传递数字数据，从而形成一种隐蔽通信信道。
AI.method: 使用未改装智能灯泡，相机作为接收端，将二进制数据编程编码为接近匹配的颜色与亮度变化；在1600万色阶中人为设定极小差异，接收端周期性测量已知参考状态以补偿相机与房间背景照明变化；开展颜色法、亮度法及同亮度对照实验。
AI.result: 颜色法以感知色距ΔE=0.5成功传输短消息“hi”，接收端恢复99%比特并通过完整性校验；亮度法在最小非零整数差（调光56与54）下仍可解码，两次运行平均比特准确率96.2%；对照实验中两个二进制符号设为同一亮度时准确率降至约随机水平。
AI.conclusion: 普通智能灯泡的可见光输出可在无硬件改装条件下作为低速率数据信道；相机颜色漂移会淹没小信号，需传输中重校准；环境光突变会干扰解码，长消息需更强纠错。颜色实验差异低于常规人眼色辨别阈值，亮度法的相应感知极限尚待实验确定。

title: vLLM-Omni Technical Report: A Unified Serving Runtime for Omni-Modality Generation
summary:
Interaction with intelligent systems is expanding beyond text-centric chatbots and coding agents. Speech-native assistants, visual generation and editing, world-model environments, and robot action loops require models that emit text, audio, images, video, and actions. These models differ in execution pattern: multi-stage autoregressive omni and TTS pipelines, iterative diffusion or flow-matching generators, and longer-lived world-model or robot loops that carry state across steps. As a result, serving is no longer a single text decode loop, but a heterogeneous multi-stage workflow with cross-stage transfer, streaming, and session-shaped interaction.
  Existing inference stacks are typically optimized for one architecture family. LLM servers deepen autoregressive scheduling and KV management, while diffusion stacks deepen denoising and parallel generation. Neither provides a shared control plane for pipelines that emit speech, pixels, or actions through separate generators, so production deployments often fall back to ad-hoc composition across disjoint runtimes.
  We present vLLM-Omni, a unified serving runtime for omni-modality generation. vLLM-Omni organizes each workload as a multi-stage pipeline under a single orchestrator that admits requests, advances them across stages, and demultiplexes streaming outputs. Specialized engines and stage replicas provide compute; a connector carries heavy payloads on the data plane; and session-oriented control supports long-lived duplex, world-model, and robot workloads.
  This report covers the architecture (stage-level KV paths, replica pools, multi-hardware platforms, and efficiency stack) and OpenAI-compatible and OpenPI APIs for omni, TTS, image/video, world-model, robot, and duplex workloads. We evaluate on the multimodal nightly CI on H100 (TTS and MiniCPM-o on H200), focused on Qwen3-Omni.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 vLLM-Omni，一个面向全模态生成（文本、音频、图像、视频、动作）的统一服务运行时，将异构多阶段工作负载组织在单一编排器下，实现请求准入、跨阶段推进、流式输出解复用，并支持长时双工、世界模型与机器人会话型任务。
AI.motivation: 智能系统交互已从纯文本聊天机器人和编码智能体扩展到语音原生助手、视觉生成与编辑、世界模型环境及机器人动作循环，要求模型同时输出文本、音频、图像、视频与动作。这些模型执行模式各异：多阶段自回归 omni/TTS 流水线、迭代式扩散或流匹配生成器，以及跨步骤携带状态的长时间世界模型或机器人循环。服务因此不再是单一文本解码循环，而演变为带跨阶段传输、流式与会话形态交互的异构多阶段工作流。现有推理栈通常只针对单一架构族优化：LLM 服务器深耕自回归调度与 KV 管理，扩散栈深耕去噪与并行生成，二者均未提供覆盖语音、像素、动作等独立生成器的共享控制平面，导致生产部署常退化为跨割裂运行时的临时拼凑。
AI.method: vLLM-Omni 将每个工作负载组织为单一编排器下的多阶段流水线，编排器负责请求准入、跨阶段推进与流式输出解复用。专用引擎与阶段副本提供算力；连接器在数据平面承载大负载；面向会话的控制机制支撑长时双工、世界模型与机器人工作负载。报告覆盖架构层面，包括阶段级 KV 路径、副本池、多硬件平台与效率栈，并提供 OpenAI 兼容 API 与 OpenPI API，服务 omni、TTS、图像/视频、世界模型、机器人及双工工作负载。
AI.result: 在 H100 上的多模态 nightly CI 中进行评测（TTS 与 MiniCPM-o 在 H200 上），重点考察 Qwen3-Omni。
AI.conclusion: vLLM-Omni 以统一编排器与共享控制平面整合异构多阶段生成流水线，配合专用引擎、阶段副本、数据平面连接器与会话控制，覆盖 omni、TTS、图像/视频、世界模型、机器人及双工等负载，并通过 OpenAI 兼容与 OpenPI API 对外服务，缓解了现有推理栈按架构族割裂、部署依赖临时拼凑的问题。

title: Context-Aware Adaptive Pesticide Spraying for Agricultural Robots under Changing Weather and Terrain Using Vision-Language Models
comment: Accepted for publication in Computers and Electronics in Agriculture
summary: Precision pesticide spraying is essential for optimizing application efficiency and ensuring uniform chemical distribution. Spraying performance is influenced by multiple factors, including environmental conditions such as temperature and wind speed, pesticide type, and the robot's capability to accurately perceive crops and target spray locations. Existing approaches predominantly emphasize crop detection and rely on predefined spraying parameters, whereas human operators dynamically adjust their spraying strategies by considering environmental conditions, region-specific crop characteristics, and the type of pesticide being applied. In this study, we propose a context-aware adaptive spraying framework based on Vision-Language Models (VLMs), which enables robots to leverage spatial reasoning and integrate information from multiple sources, including crop type, pesticide type, and weather data, to make adaptive and optimized spraying decisions. Subsequently, a trajectory-tracking controller based on Model Predictive Path Integral (MPPI) control is employed to ensure precise navigation and accurate spraying at crop locations. The comparative results demonstrate that the proposed method improves accuracy by at least 30% in detecting crop rows. In addition, the experimental evaluations conducted in two environments further demonstrate the robot's ability to flexibly adjust spraying volume and travel speed, while reducing pesticide drift.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于视觉语言模型（VLM）的上下文感知自适应喷洒框架，结合MPPI轨迹跟踪控制，实现精准农药喷洒。
AI.motivation: 精准喷洒对提升农药施用效率与均匀性至关重要，但喷洒效果受温度、风速、农药类型及机器人感知能力等多因素影响。现有方法多聚焦作物检测且依赖预设喷洒参数，而人类操作员会依据环境、区域作物特征和农药类型动态调整策略，二者存在差距。
AI.method: 提出基于VLM的上下文感知自适应喷洒框架，使机器人能够进行空间推理并融合作物类型、农药类型和天气数据等多源信息，做出自适应优化喷洒决策；随后采用基于模型预测路径积分（MPPI）控制的轨迹跟踪控制器，保证精准导航与在作物位置的准确喷洒。
AI.result: 对比结果表明，所提方法在作物行检测方面精度至少提升30%；在两种环境下的实验评估进一步证明，机器人能够灵活调整喷洒量与行进速度，同时减少农药漂移。
AI.conclusion: 将VLM驱动的上下文感知决策与MPPI轨迹跟踪相结合，可有效提升精准喷洒的自适应性与作业质量，减少农药漂移，具有良好的应用潜力。

title: When Forgetting Looks Like Improvement: Metric Masking in Streaming Diarizer Adaptation and the Price of Rehearsal
summary: Small-data adaptation can improve speech detection while degrading speaker attribution. We study this discrepancy in a released streaming diarizer adapted on 7.5 h of two-party conversation and evaluated across six corpora. Adaptation substantially improves in-domain diarization performance and transfers to an independent corpus. However, this improvement is not consistent across evaluation scenarios as the additional confusion is mainly associated with impaired temporal identity consistency rather than speaker-count errors. A local-remapping diagnostic reveals different patterns of identity degradation across corpora, indicating that adaptation may alter how streaming models maintain speaker assignments over time. Rehearsal reduces the observed degradation but reduces the cross-domain transfer performance. These results highlight the need to jointly evaluate detection accuracy, identity consistency, and retention behavior when adapting streaming diarization systems.

AI.tldr: 小数据适配能提升流式说话人分离的语音检测性能，却会损害说话人身份归属；这种退化主要体现为时间身份一致性受损而非说话人数估计错误，重放策略可缓解退化但会削弱跨域迁移。
AI.motivation: 作者关注小数据适配中"检测性能提升但说话人归属退化"这一矛盾现象，希望厘清该不一致性的来源，并明确流式说话人分离系统适配时应如何评估。
AI.method: 在一个已发布的流式说话人分离系统上，使用7.5小时两人对话数据进行适配，并在六个语料库上评估；通过局部重映射（local-remapping）诊断分析身份退化模式，并对比重放（rehearsal）策略的影响。
AI.result: 适配显著提升域内分离性能并可迁移到独立语料；但改进在不同评估场景下并不一致，额外混淆主要与时间身份一致性受损相关，而非说话人数错误；局部重映射显示不同语料存在不同的身份退化模式；重放能减少退化，却降低跨域迁移性能。
AI.conclusion: 适配可能改变流式模型随时间维持说话人指派的方式；因此适配流式说话人分离系统时，有必要联合评估检测准确率、身份一致性与保留行为。

title: PanoPed: Beyond Bounding Boxes for Sim-to-Real Panoramic Pedestrian Tracking
summary: Full-sphere panoramic cameras let fixed monitoring systems and mobile robots track people in every direction, but a planar bounding box does not fully describe where a person is on the sphere. We introduce PanoPed, a sim-to-real benchmark for pedestrian tracking on the full sphere. PanoPed-S contains 108,000 frames from fixed, quadruped-mounted, and drone-mounted cameras, with synchronized masks, depth, camera poses, and 3D pedestrian states. PanoPed-R adds 28,002 real frames from fixed cameras, 16,247 of them densely annotated. We find that an ERP rectangle cannot uniquely determine the spherical center and angular extent of the visible person, while the detector's visual query still carries information about them. Inspired by the sextant's use of angular measurements to locate objects, we propose Sextant, a plug-and-play angular localization head with only about 0.035M parameters. It reuses a frozen detector, keeps track identities unchanged, and needs no extra image encoder. Sextant gives the best result in our PanoPed-S test comparison, raising the strongest baseline, MOTIP, from 47.30 to 49.49 HOTA, with gains on all eight test sequences. Without fine-tuning on real data, the same synthetic-trained heads improve MOTIP and HAT by 0.96-1.14 HOTA on real video, and both seeds improve every real sequence. HAT+Sextant scores best among the compared systems that add no localization image encoder.

AI.tldr: 本文提出全景行人跟踪仿真到真实基准 PanoPed 及即插即用角定位头 Sextant，仅约 0.035M 参数，在 PanoPed-S 与真实视频上均提升 HOTA。
AI.motivation: 全景观测中平面矩形框无法唯一确定行人在球面上的中心与角范围，现有跟踪方法缺少合适的球面定位表示与评测基准。
AI.method: 构建 PanoPed 基准：PanoPed-S 含固定、四足、无人机相机共 108,000 帧，配同步掩码、深度、相机位姿与三维行人状态；PanoPed-R 含 28,002 真实固定相机帧，其中 16,247 帧稠密标注。提出 Sextant 角定位头，复用冻结检测器、保持轨迹身份、无需额外图像编码器。
AI.result: PanoPed-S 测试中 Sextant 将最强基线 MOTIP 从 47.30 提升至 49.49 HOTA，八个测试序列全部增益；合成数据训练的 Sextant 不微调即提升真实视频中 MOTIP 与 HAT 0.96–1.14 HOTA，两个随机种子在每个真实序列均提升；HAT+Sextant 在未增加定位图像编码器的系统中表现最佳。
AI.conclusion: ERP 矩形不足以唯一描述球面行人位置，但检测器视觉查询仍含相关角信息；角定位头 Sextant 以极小参数实现有效球面定位，并具备良好仿真到真实泛化能力。

title: Accelerating Floating-Point Satisfiability Solving via Gradient Normalization
summary:
Satisfiability Modulo Theories (SMT) solvers are foundational to software verification, program analysis, and compiler testing, particularly over the theory of Quantifier-Free Floating-Point (QF_FP). While recent optimization-based SMT solvers have successfully applied gradient descent to continuous relaxations of logical formulas, they are fundamentally bottlenecked by gradient domination, a phenomenon where a small subset of difficult clauses hijacks the optimization trajectory, preventing the solver from satisfying the broader formula and trapping it in local minima.
  To overcome this, we present GradSAT, a novel framework that bridges optimization-based SMT solving with Multi-Task Learning (MTL). GradSAT reformulates the constraint satisfaction process by treating each SMT clause as an independent MTL task. By applying dynamic gradient normalization (GradNorm), GradSAT actively balances the gradient magnitudes across all clauses at runtime, systematically penalizing dominant gradients and accelerating lagging clauses to ensure uniform convergence. GradSAT implements this through a highly optimized, two-stage hybrid pipeline. First, a GPU-accelerated PyTorch backend leveraging symbolic compilation and operator fusion navigates the continuous relaxation to a high-quality basin. Second, the candidate assignment is handed off to a bit-precise local search engine to rapidly resolve the exact, rigorous assignment. By stabilizing the continuous search dynamics, GradSAT mitigates the brittleness of prior gradient-based solvers and provides a robust, highly parallelizable architecture for complex constraint solving.

AI.tldr: GradSAT 将 SMT 子句满足问题建模为多任务学习，通过 GradNorm 动态梯度归一化缓解梯度支配问题，并采用 GPU 连续松弛搜索与位精确局部搜索的两阶段流水线求解 QF_FP 约束。
AI.motivation: 现有基于优化的 SMT 求解器将梯度下降应用于逻辑公式的连续松弛，但受困于梯度支配现象：少数困难子句主导优化轨迹，导致求解器无法满足整体公式并陷入局部极小值。作者旨在解决这一瓶颈，提升 QF_FP 理论下求解过程的稳定性与鲁棒性。
AI.method: GradSAT 将约束满足过程重构为多任务学习框架，把每个 SMT 子句视为独立任务，运行时利用 GradNorm 动态归一化各子句的梯度幅度，抑制主导梯度并加速滞后子句以实现均匀收敛。实现上采用两阶段混合流水线：第一阶段使用 GPU 加速的 PyTorch 后端，结合符号编译与算子融合，在连续松弛空间导航至高质盆地；第二阶段将候选赋值交给位精确局部搜索引擎，快速求解严格精确的赋值。
AI.result: 通过稳定连续搜索动态，GradSAT 缓解了以往梯度类求解器的脆弱性，并提供了一个稳健、高度可并行化的复杂约束求解架构。
AI.conclusion: 将 SMT 子句满足重新表述为多任务学习并结合动态梯度归一化，可有效缓解梯度支配，为基于优化的 SMT 求解提供更稳定、可扩展的两阶段求解范式。

title: Beyond Baseline Severity: Temporal and Disease-Specific Predictors of Depression Outcomes Following Mindfulness Interventions
summary: Depression severity among patients with chronic or acute medical conditions is influenced by a complex interaction of baseline psychological state, demographic characteristics, clinical context, and engagement with behavioral interventions. This paper presents an interpretable machine-learning analysis of a multi-center longitudinal clinical cohort to predict Beck Depression Inventory-II (BDI-II) scores at 12 and 24 weeks following mindfulness-based intervention participation. The study uses demographic variables, clinical condition information, hospital-center identifiers, baseline BDI-II scores, and therapy engagement measures to model short-term and long-term depression outcomes. Missing follow-up outcomes were addressed using a model-based stochastic imputation procedure to preserve the modest sample size while maintaining outcome variability. Five regression models were evaluated, spanning regularized linear regression and tree-based ensemble methods. Ridge Regression achieved the best 12-week performance with an RMSE of 5.186 and R^2 of 0.474, while LightGBM achieved the best 24-week performance with an RMSE of 5.038 and R^2 of 0.525. Beyond prediction accuracy, the analysis reveals three clinically relevant patterns: baseline severity remains the strongest overall predictor, short-term outcomes are more strongly associated with clinical and hospital context, and long-term outcomes show greater dependence on behavioral adherence and demographic factors. Disease-specific and hierarchical subgroup analyses further indicate that predictors differ substantially across and within clinical categories. These findings support the use of interpretable, context-aware modeling to inform personalized mental-health support following mindfulness-based interventions.

AI.tldr: 该研究对多中心纵向临床队列进行可解释机器学习建模，用人口学、临床情境、基线BDI-II及治疗依从性等变量预测正念干预后12周与24周的抑郁严重程度，并揭示不同时间尺度上的预测因子差异。
AI.motivation: 慢性或急性躯体疾病患者的抑郁严重程度受基线心理状态、人口学特征、临床情境与行为干预参与度等多因素复杂交互影响；需要探讨可解释且能区分短期与长期结局的预测模型，以支撑个体化心理健康支持。
AI.method: 基于多中心纵向临床队列，纳入人口学变量、临床疾病信息、医院中心标识、基线BDI-II评分及治疗参与度指标；采用基于模型的随机插补处理缺失随访结局；比较五类回归模型（正则化线性回归与树集成方法），并进行疾病特异性和分层亚组分析。
AI.result: 12周结局以Ridge Regression最优（RMSE=5.186，R²=0.474）；24周结局以LightGBM最优（RMSE=5.038，R²=0.525）。基线严重度为整体最强预测因子；短期结局更依赖临床与医院情境因素，长期结局更依赖行为依从性与人口学因素；预测因子在不同临床类别间及类别内差异显著。
AI.conclusion: 可解释、情境感知的机器学习建模可用于识别正念干预后抑郁结局的时间特异性预测因子，为个性化心理健康支持提供依据；但样本量有限且依赖插补，结果需进一步外部验证。

title: Structure alone supports efficient visual computation in the Drosophila visual system
summary: Understanding the extent to which measured synaptic wiring determines computation remains a central challenge. Here, we couple the proofread adult Drosophila melanogaster connectome to an anatomically faithful model of its eye. Visual information is inputted in the eye model, then passed to the connectome, and finally read from a Kenyon-cell-centered linear decoder. This creates a connectome-only model in which the anatomical graph and eye geometry are fixed and only scalar synaptic gains and neuronal thresholds may be learned. The model supports multitask vision, including color discrimination, shape classification, and numerical discrimination that follows a ratio-dependent scaling characteristic of approximate number perception. To test whether precise connectivity is consequential under wiring economy, we compare the biological graph to randomized ensembles that increasingly preserve biological synaptic constraints. At matched wiring cost, the biological network consistently yields higher accuracy, whereas less constrained rewiring surpasses it at the cost of inflated wiring. These findings indicate that the measured connectivity and eye geometry jointly set efficient operating points for visual computation.

AI.tldr: 将成体果蝇连接组与解剖学忠实的复眼模型耦合，构建仅连接组模型，在固定解剖图谱与眼几何下仅学习突触增益和阈值，即可支持颜色辨别、形状分类和近似数量感知等多任务视觉。
AI.motivation: 核心问题是：测量到的突触连接在多大程度上决定计算功能；同时需检验在布线经济性约束下，精确连接是否具有实质意义。
AI.method: 把经人工校对（proofread）的成体果蝇连接组与解剖学忠实的眼模型相连；视觉信息先输入眼模型，再传入连接组，最后由以Kenyon细胞为中心（Kenyon-cell-centered）的线性解码器读出。模型仅可学习标量突触增益与神经元阈值，解剖图与眼几何固定。并与逐级保留生物突触约束的随机化连接组集合进行对比。
AI.result: 该模型支持多任务视觉，包括颜色辨别、形状分类及符合近似数量感知的比率依赖标度的数量辨别。在相同布线成本下，生物网络始终取得更高准确率；约束更少的重连虽可超越它，但代价是布线成本膨胀。
AI.conclusion: 测量得到的连接性与眼几何共同为视觉计算设定了高效的运行点。

title: ReSAFT: An Efficient Stuck-at Fault-Tolerant Scheme for ReRAM-based Process-in-Memory Accelerators
summary: Analog ReRAM-based process-in-memory (PIM) accelerators provide high parallelism and energy efficiency for deep convolutional neural networks (CNNs) inference. However, their susceptibility to permanent faults, such as stuck-at high (SaH) and stuck-at low (SaL) resistance states, poses a major challenge by permanently corrupting the CNN weights mapped to conductance values of ReRAM cells and degrading inference accuracy, which leads to system unreliability in safety-critical applications. In this paper, we propose a fault-tolerant scheme for analog ReRAM-based PIM accelerators to tackle stuck-at faults (SAFs) with minimal redundancy overhead to recover classification accuracy degradation. The proposed scheme contains a redundancy-based hardware solution alongside fault-aware mapping method for ensuring reliable analog computation in ReRAM crossbar. We analyze the impact of varying number of redundant rows and columns on accuracy and design metrics. Subsequently, a multi-objective optimization (MOO) problem is formulated and solved to efficiently determine the number of redundant rows and columns, considering trade-offs among various design metrics. Furthermore, a fault-aware weight mapping is proposed for dual-crossbar structures to further compensate for the accuracy degradation caused by SAFs. Simulation results show that, for the SimpleNet model using the MNIST dataset, the inference accuracy is recovered by approximately 22.39%, on average, across four configurations of optimal solutions, each offering a trade-off between reliability and area, energy consumption, and latency overheads. The mean-time-tofailure (MTTF) improves by about 61x on average compared to the baseline. These selected configurations also reduce energy and area overheads by 32%, on average, in comparison to row-only and column-only configurations.

AI.tldr: 提出面向模拟ReRAM存内计算加速器的容错方案，结合冗余硬件与故障感知映射，以最小开销恢复CNN推理精度。
AI.motivation: 模拟ReRAM存内计算(PIM)加速器为CNN推理提供高并行度和能效，但存在永久性故障(如SaH/SaL阻变)，会永久损坏映射到电导值的CNN权重、降低推理精度，导致安全关键应用中的系统不可靠。需在最小冗余开销下恢复分类精度。
AI.method: 方案包含两部分：(1) 冗余硬件方案，分析不同冗余行/列数量对精度和设计指标的影响，构建并求解多目标优化(MOO)问题以确定冗余行/列数，权衡可靠性与面积、能耗、延迟；(2) 面向双crossbar结构的故障感知权重映射，进一步补偿SAF引起的精度退化。
AI.result: 在MNIST数据集上的SimpleNet模型中，四种最优解配置平均恢复推理精度约22.39%；平均无故障时间(MTTF)相比基线平均提升约61倍；与仅行和仅列配置相比，所选配置平均降低能耗和面积开销约32%。
AI.conclusion: 所提容错方案能以最小冗余开销有效应对SAF，在精度、可靠性、面积、能耗和延迟间实现多种权衡，适用于安全关键的模拟ReRAM PIM加速器。

title: CredLeakBench: Evaluating Credential Leakage and Recovery in LLM Agents
summary: Language model agents are increasingly deployed to automate everyday digital chores from managing emails and social media to handling banking and bills allowing users to step away from supervision. However, this capability also exposes sensitive information to phishing. Safe execution requires distinguishing malicious requests from genuine ones without simply refusing to act. Despite its practical importance, this problem remains underexplored and it is unclear whether current agents or existing defenses can achieve it. To study this problem, we first propose CredLeak-Bench, a comprehensive benchmark designed to evaluate how effectively and securely agents automate human workflows when confronted with phishing and identity verification. The benchmark covers both user-directed authentication and autonomous inbox monitoring, where agents are not explicitly instructed to log in. It systematically varies deceptive cues and pairs phishing scenarios with legitimate counterparts, enabling joint evaluation of information leakage and utility on genuine tasks. Within a sandboxed environment, leakage is measured through actual submissions of information rather than agents' self-reported behavior. Our evaluation reveals that all tested models are vulnerable to leakage. Agents also disclose sensitive information during autonomous inbox monitoring, demonstrating that phishing can induce disclosure without a user request to authenticate. Furthermore, most evaluated mitigations that reduce leakage also impair performance on genuine tasks, exposing a security utility trade off in existing defenses. These findings show why reducing leakage alone is insufficient: effective defenses must prevent unauthorized disclosure while preserving legitimate task completion. CredLeak-Bench provides a controlled framework for measuring both objectives and evaluating progress toward secure, useful agents.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 CredLeak-Bench 基准，用于评估语言模型智能体在钓鱼攻击与身份验证场景下的信息泄露与任务效用，发现所有测试模型均存在泄露风险，且现有防御难以兼顾安全与效能。
AI.motivation: 语言模型智能体日益被用于自动化邮件、社媒、银行账单等日常事务，使用户可以脱离监督。但这一能力也使敏感信息暴露于钓鱼攻击之下。安全执行要求智能体区分恶意请求与真实请求，而非简单拒绝执行。该问题实际重要性高却研究不足，目前尚不清楚现有智能体或防御手段能否胜任。
AI.method: 提出 CredLeak-Bench 综合基准，评估智能体在钓鱼与身份验证情境下自动化人类工作流时的有效性与安全性。基准涵盖用户定向认证与自主收件箱监控（智能体未被明确指示登录）两类场景，系统性地变换欺骗性线索，并将钓鱼场景与合法对照场景配对，从而联合评估信息泄露与真实任务效用。在沙箱环境中，泄露以实际提交的信息来衡量，而非智能体的自我报告行为。
AI.result: 评估显示所有被测模型均存在泄露脆弱性；智能体在自主收件箱监控过程中也会披露敏感信息，说明钓鱼无需用户发起认证请求即可诱导泄露。此外，多数能降低泄露的缓解措施同时会损害真实任务表现，暴露出安全与效用的权衡。
AI.conclusion: 仅降低泄露不足以保证安全：有效防御必须在阻止未授权信息披露的同时保持合法任务的完成能力。CredLeak-Bench 提供了可同时衡量这两个目标的受控框架，用于评估迈向安全且有用智能体的进展。

title: Democratizing MoE inference on commodity GPUs with CoMoE
summary:
Deploying Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models relies heavily on Expert Parallelism, which generates intense inter-GPU communication. Consequently, state-of-the-art inference systems require high-bandwidth, P2P interconnects (e.g., NVLink) in datacenter GPUs to handle massive token routing, making deployment prohibitively expensive. Consumer GPUs offer comparable compute power at significantly lower cost, promising to democratize MoE inference for individuals and enable privacy-preserving local deployments. However, their bandwidth-limited (only weak PCIe bus bandwidth) and host-mediated interconnects (no P2P support) introduce severe communication bottlenecks.
  We present CoMoE, a communication-efficient MoE inference system that resolves this mismatch through novel host-centric routing. Our key insight is that the unique communication topology provides the opportunity to elevate the host to an active routing hub, which can fundamentally reduce communication volume and eliminate global synchronization-induced stalls. Specifically, for token dispatch, we introduce host-backed token multicast to write shared tokens to the host exactly once, eliminating outbound transmission redundancy. For token combine, we propose a fine-grained, token-level aggregation mechanism using host staging buffers, which replaces rigid global synchronization and mitigates straggler effects. Evaluation on RTX 5090 GPUs shows that CoMoE improves inference throughput by up to 1.46x, approaching the performance of NVLink-capable A800 GPUs at only 23.4% of the hardware cost.

AI.tldr: CoMoE：面向消费级GPU的通信高效MoE推理系统，通过"以主机为中心的路由"将主机提升为主动路由枢纽，在无P2P、弱PCIe带宽条件下大幅降低通信开销。
AI.motivation: MoE部署依赖专家并行，产生大量跨GPU通信；SOTA推理系统需NVLink等高带宽P2P互连的数据中心GPU，成本高昂。消费级GPU算力相当但价格低廉，有望实现MoE本地化、隐私保护部署，但其PCIe带宽受限且经主机中转、不支持P2P，造成严重通信瓶颈。因此需要解决算力可用与互连受限之间的错配问题。
AI.method: 核心思想为host-centric routing，把主机变为主动路由枢纽。其一，token dispatch阶段采用host-backed token multicast，将共享token仅向主机写入一次，消除出站传输冗余；其二，token combine阶段提出基于主机暂存缓冲的细粒度、token级聚合机制，替代刚性全局同步，缓解长尾（straggler）效应。
AI.result: 在RTX 5090 GPU上评测，CoMoE将推理吞吐提升最高1.46倍，性能接近具备NVLink的A800 GPU，而硬件成本仅为后者的23.4%。
AI.conclusion: 通过将主机重新定位为主动路由中心，CoMoE有效缓解消费级GPU在弱PCIe、无P2P互连下的通信瓶颈，使低成本GPU集群能够支撑高性价比、可本地化部署的高效MoE推理。

title: Taming an End-to-End Autonomous Driving Policy for Urban Navigation of Quadruped Robots
comment: Accepted to IROS 2026 Workshop on AI Meets Autonomy
summary: We present Go2-DrivoR, a goal-conditioned adaptation of the end-to-end autonomous driving trajectory planning framework DrivoR for urban navigation with quadrupedal robots. By conditioning trajectory generation on a local-frame subgoal through a goal token and adapting the vehicle-centric scoring formulation, the method extends DrivoR to short-horizon goal-conditioned local planning without redesigning its core decoders. Specifically, we redefine drivable-area compliance for sidewalk-oriented navigation and reformulate the original ego progress term as goal-conditioned ego progress. Trained exclusively on TartanGround simulation data, Go2-DrivoR improves waypoint-conditioned planning performance on unseen simulation environments and transfers zero-shot to open-loop real-world trajectory prediction.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Go2-DrivoR，将端到端自动驾驶轨迹规划框架 DrivoR 适配到四足机器人城市导航，通过目标 token 将轨迹生成条件化于局部坐标系下的子目标，并改造车辆中心评分公式，实现短时域目标条件局部规划，无需重新设计核心解码器。方法重新定义人行道导航的可行驶区域约束，并将自车进度项重构为目标条件自车进度。仅在 TartanGround 仿真数据上训练，在未见仿真环境中提升路点条件规划性能，并零样本迁移至真实世界开环轨迹预测。
AI.motivation: 将成熟的自动驾驶端到端规划框架迁移到四足机器人城市导航，避免从零设计新架构；同时解决原框架以车辆为中心、面向长时域驾驶，难以直接用于人行道场景与短时域目标条件局部规划的问题。
AI.method: 在 DrivoR 基础上引入目标 token，把局部坐标系子目标作为条件注入轨迹生成；改造评分公式，重新定义面向人行道的可行驶区域合规性，并将原自车进度项改为目标条件自车进度；保持核心解码器不变，仅训练于 TartanGround 仿真数据。
AI.result: 在未见过的仿真环境中，路点条件规划性能得到提升；并实现向真实世界开环轨迹预测的零样本迁移。
AI.conclusion: 表明通过目标条件化与评分公式适配，可低成本复用自动驾驶规划框架于四足机器人导航，且仿真训练具备一定的仿真到现实泛化能力。

title: Emo-Jev: Probabilistic Reasoning for Emotion Classification with Jev
summary: Jev offers an alternative interface for language understanding: given an input and predefined questions, it returns probabilistic decisions rather than free-form responses. Whether this interface can support effective reasoning for text classification against leading LLMs remains an open questions. We introduce Emo-Jev, a training-free framework with two complementary implementations. Emo-Jev-D decomposes classification into task-specific atomic judgments and composes their probabilities into a final prediction. Emo-Jev-SC constructs multiple judgment paths from complementary perspectives and aggregates their predictions into a consensus decision. We evaluate Emo-Jev on eight datasets spanning sentiment analysis, emotion recognition, sarcasm detection and humor detection, comparing against direct Jev classification and five SoTA LLMs under input/output and chain-of-thought reasoning. Standard Jev achieves 62.93\% average macro-F1 versus 67.28\% for the strongest LLM baseline, with lower observed latency and generally lower cost.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练的 Emo-Jev 框架（含分解式 Emo-Jev-D 与多视角共识式 Emo-Jev-SC），将文本分类转化为 Jev 接口下的概率化原子判断与推理路径聚合，在八个情感类数据集上验证其有效性。
AI.motivation: Jev 以概率化决策替代自由文本生成，为语言理解提供了新接口，但该接口能否在文本分类任务上实现有效推理、并匹敌主流 LLM，尚缺乏系统验证。
AI.method: 免训练框架。Emo-Jev-D 将分类拆解为任务特定的原子判断，并把各判断概率组合为最终预测；Emo-Jev-SC 从互补视角构建多条判断路径，并将其预测聚合为共识决策。在八 个数据集（情感分析、情绪识别、讽刺检测、幽默检测）上，与直接 Jev 分类及五种 SoTA LLM 在输入/输出与思维链两种推理方式下对比。
AI.result: 标准 Jev 平均 macro-F1 为 62.93%，最强 LLM 基线为 67.28%；Jev 在延迟上更低、成本总体更低。
AI.conclusion: Emo-Jev 表明 Jev 接口结合原子分解与多路径共识可在免训练条件下支撑文本分类推理，在效率上具备优势，但准确率与领先 LLM 仍存在差距。

title: MoR-MLLM: Mixture of Recursions for Efficient Multimodal Large Language Models
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have demonstrated remarkable reasoning capabilities across vision and language tasks. However, their massive computational and memory demands hinder real-world deployment. While recent efforts reduce costs by employing lightweight language backbones, existing paradigms remain computation-dense due to their static sparsity and depth allocation, which cannot adapt to the semantic complexity of each token. To this end, we propose MoR-MLLM, a computation-sparse MLLM based on the recent Mixture-of-Recursions (MoR) framework. MoR-MLLM introduces adaptive per-token recursion, allowing the model to dynamically adjust its recursive depth and allocate more computation to visually or linguistically challenging tokens while skipping redundant operations for simpler ones. To stabilize the training of recursive sparsity in multimodal settings, we further design a three-stage MoR-Tuning strategy and an entropy-regularized loss to encourage diverse routing distributions. Extensive experiments show that compared with recent advanced tiny MLLMs, our proposed MoR-MLLM can greatly reduce the training memory and computation complexity while retaining high performance on various vision-language tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出 MoR-MLLM，基于 Mixture-of-Recursions 实现按 token 自适应递归的计算稀疏多模态大模型，配合三阶段 MoR-Tuning 与熵正则损失，在保持性能的同时大幅降低训练内存与计算复杂度。
