AI.motivation: 多模态大模型（MLLMs）虽在视觉-语言任务上推理能力出色，但其巨大的计算与内存开销阻碍实际部署。现有轻量化方案（如轻量语言骨干）仍受静态稀疏与固定深度分配所限，无法根据每个 token 的语义复杂度自适应调整计算量。
AI.method: 提出 MoR-MLLM，基于 Mixture-of-Recursions（MoR）框架构建计算稀疏的 MLLM：引入逐 token 自适应递归（adaptive per-token recursion），动态调整递归深度，将更多计算分配给视觉或语言上较难的 token，跳过简单 token 的冗余操作。为稳定多模态场景下递归稀疏化的训练，设计三阶段 MoR-Tuning 策略与熵正则化损失，以鼓励多样化的路由分布。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，与近期先进的 tiny MLLMs 相比，MoR-MLLM 在多种视觉-语言任务上保持高性能的同时，显著降低训练内存与计算复杂度。
AI.conclusion: 通过逐 token 自适应递归深度与训练稳定化设计，可在多模态大模型中实现有效的计算稀疏化，为资源受限场景下的高效 MLLM 部署提供了可行路径。

title: Route-Verify-Vote: Procedure-Conditioned Self-Consistency for Mixed-Domain Reasoning
comment: 12 pages, 8 figures, and 8 tables. Accepted for oral presentation at CCL26-Eval
summary:
Compositional generalization remains challenging when language models must combine familiar reasoning operations in unfamiliar ways. The Scenario-Based Commonsense Reasoning Evaluation (SCoRE) 2026 tests this ability on three mixed domains absent from training and requires models to identify the complete set of correct options for each question.
  We introduce Route-Verify-Vote (RVV), a framework for procedure-conditioned self-consistency that uses language models without parameter updates. Route uses the provided domain label to select a reasoning procedure that guides the model in representing and applying the relevant constraints. Verify prompts the model to assess each option against those constraints. Vote aggregates complete answer sets and allocates additional samples to questions with a small vote-count margin between the two most frequent sets. Samples for each question follow the same domain-specific procedure.
  On the official test set, voting over 16 sampled answer sets per question achieves an exact-set accuracy of 74.6%. Adaptive RVV reaches 77.3%, and combining models on selected domain routes raises accuracy to 79.4%. The final system ranked second among participating systems. These results support domain-specific reasoning procedures and answer-set disagreement as useful tools for allocating inference-time computation in mixed-domain reasoning.

AI.tldr: 提出 Route-Verify-Vote (RVV) 框架，在无参数更新的条件下，通过领域路由选择推理过程、逐项验证约束、并对完整答案集投票实现混合域答案集推理，在 SCoRE 2026 官方测试集上取得 79.4% 的 exact-set 准确率，位列参赛系统第二。
AI.motivation: 语言模型在需要以陌生方式组合熟悉推理操作的组合泛化场景中表现不佳；SCoRE 2026 通过三个训练中未出现的混合域任务，要求模型给出每题完整正确选项集合，考察该能力。同时，混合域推理中如何有效分配推理时计算资源尚无明确依据。
AI.method: 提出 RVV（Route-Verify-Vote）过程条件化自一致性框架，不更新参数。Route：利用给定域标签选择对应推理过程，引导模型表示并施加相关约束；Verify：提示模型依据这些约束逐项评估每个选项；Vote：对完整答案集进行聚合投票，并对前两名答案集票数差距较小的问题追加采样；同一题目的所有采样共享同一领域特定过程。此外还采用模型组合（ensemble）与自适应采样。
AI.result: 官方测试集上，每题 16 个采样答案集投票的 exact-set 准确率为 74.6%；自适应 RVV 提升至 77.3%；在选定领域路由上组合多个模型进一步提升至 79.4%，最终系统在参赛系统中排名第二。
AI.conclusion: 领域特定推理过程与答案集分歧可作为混合域推理中分配推理时计算的有效信号，验证了过程条件化自一致性框架的有效性。未来可进一步探索路由粒度与投票聚合策略对组合泛化的影响。

title: Transferability and operational reliability of a Prithvi crop classification foundation model under phenological and geographic shift across three continents
summary: Fine-tuned geospatial foundation models (GeoFMs) pretrained on large satellite archives have been shown to improve crop classification accuracy and geographic transferability. However, their operational performance beyond the training distribution remains poorly characterized. We evaluated the out-of-distribution performance of a widely adopted GeoFM [Prithvi-EO-2.0] across 37 events in 12 countries on three continents and validated against regional reference products. Results indicated that the mean overall accuracy (OA) declined from 0.65 in the United States to 0.40 in Europe. Beyond accuracy metrics, we assessed five key aspects of model performance: whether model confidence indicates signal failure, sensitivity to observation windows, the effect of coarsening class schemes, and robustness to both band loss and cloud- and shadow-contamination. Accuracy collapsed when the observation window misaligned with local crop phenology, while deterministic confidence remained high. Expected calibration error increased for seven of eight paired events, and 12-51% of each affected scene was confidently mislabeled at near-zero precision. Monte Carlo dropout entropy registered the shift in all eight, indicating that much of the apparent cross-continent decline reflected phenological misalignment rather than spatial transfer. Two adjustments recovered accuracy without retraining. Consolidating 13 classes into 10, based on the model's dominant confusions, raised the mean OA by 8.4 percentage points. Compressing the window toward near-real-time use preserved accuracy across a 45- to 90-day plateau, peaking near 75 days, though arms tighter than 30 days fell about 0.11 below that plateau. Fine-tuned crop GeoFMs therefore transfer usefully only where observation windows match local growing seasons. We translate these findings into operational guidance for the reliable deployment of the released model.

AI.tldr: 该研究系统评估了微调地理空间基础模型（Prithvi-EO-2.0）在训练分布之外的作物分类性能，发现其跨洲迁移能力受观测窗口与当地作物物候错配的严重制约，并提出两种无需重训练即可恢复精度的调整策略。
AI.motivation: 微调GeoFM虽被证明能提升作物分类精度与地理可迁移性，但其在训练分布之外的业务化表现尚缺乏充分刻画，作者希望明确模型在跨区域部署时的可靠性边界及失效机理。
AI.method: 在12个国家、3个大洲的37个事件上评估Prithvi-EO-2.0的分布外性能，并以区域参考产品校验；除总体精度（OA）外，还考察五个维度：模型置信度是否指示失效、对观测窗口的敏感性、类别方案粗化的影响，以及对波段缺失与云影污染的鲁棒性；同时使用期望校准误差（ECE）与蒙特卡洛dropout熵进行分析。
AI.result: 平均总体精度由美国的0.65降至欧洲的0.40。观测窗口与当地作物物候错配时精度崩塌，而确定性置信度仍保持高位；8组配对事件中有7组ECE上升，受影响场景中12%–51%的像元被高置信度错误标注且精确率近零；蒙特卡洛dropout熵在全部8组中均识别出分布偏移。将13类合并为10类（依据模型主导混淆）使平均OA提升8.4个百分点；将观测窗口压缩至近实时使用，在45–90天区间内保持精度，约75天达到峰值，但短于30天时较该平台期低约0.11。
AI.conclusion: 微调后的作物GeoFM仅在观测窗口与当地生长季匹配时才具有实用迁移价值，跨洲精度下降很大程度上源于物候错配而非空间迁移本身；通过类别合并与窗口压缩可在不重训练的前提下恢复精度，研究据此给出面向已发布模型可靠部署的业务化建议。

title: MovieSTAGE: Scene, Transition, and Global Encoding for Movie-fMRI ADHD Classification
comment: Accepted to the 2026 IEEE International Conference on Bioinformatics and Biomedicine (BIBM 2026)
summary: Naturalistic movie-fMRI provides a shared, temporally structured probe of brain dynamics, yet predictive models commonly rely on whole-run functional connectivity (FC) or temporally generic representations that are not aligned with narrative events. We introduce MovieSTAGE (Scene, Transition, and Global Encoding), a multiscale framework that combines hypergraph-structured FC-profile organization within scenes, unsigned FC-profile differences across adjacent scenes, and whole-movie FC. We evaluated 260 participants from the CMI-HBN Despicable Me cohort on case-control, ADHD-subtype, and three-class classification using 10 repetitions of stratified five-fold cross-validation, complete out-of-fold (OOF) predictions, and paired subject-cluster bootstrap and permutation tests. MovieSTAGE achieved AUROCs of 0.69, 0.73, and 0.75 and balanced accuracies of 67.6%, 69.8%, and 58.3%, respectively, yielding the highest mean point estimates among the evaluated methods. On the three-class task, the full model outperformed all two-branch variants, the HGNN scene encoder outperformed MLP, GAT, and BNT alternatives under matched settings, and the human-annotated partition outperformed duration-matched random and fixed-count GSBS controls. These controlled results support incremental predictive value from event-aligned scene and transition representations when combined with whole-movie FC in this cohort. Post-hoc model-derived analyses generated network-level hypotheses involving frontoparietal and default-mode systems.

AI.tldr: 提出多尺度框架MovieSTAGE，将场景内超图结构FC、相邻场景间无向FC差异与全片FC结合，用于电影fMRI的ADHD分类，取得最高平均点估计并验证了事件对齐表征的增量预测价值。
AI.motivation: 自然观影fMRI具有共享且时间结构化的大脑动态信息，但现有预测模型多依赖整段功能连接（FC）或时间上通用的表征，未与叙事事件对齐，可能丢失事件相关的动态信息。
AI.method: MovieSTAGE（Scene, Transition, Global Encoding）多尺度框架：场景内超图神经网络（HGNN）组织FC剖面；相邻场景间无向FC剖面差异表征转场；全片FC表征全局。数据为CMI-HBN Despicable Me队列260名被试，任务包括病例-对照、ADHD亚型与三分类；评估采用10次重复分层五折交叉验证、完整OOF预测，以及配对被试簇bootstrap与置换检验；并做消融（双分支变体、HGNN对比MLP/GAT/BNT、人类标注分段对比时长匹配随机与固定计数GSBS对照）。
AI.result: AUROC分别为0.69、0.73、0.75，平衡准确率为67.6%、69.8%、58.3%，均为所比较方法中最高平均点估计。三分类中完整模型优于所有双分支变体；匹配设置下HGNN场景编码器优于MLP、GAT与BNT；人类标注分段优于时长匹配随机与固定计数GSBS对照。
AI.conclusion: 在该队列中，事件对齐的场景与转场表征与全片FC结合后具有增量预测价值；事后模型派生分析提出涉及额顶叶与默认模式网络的网络层面假设。

title: When Algorithmic Exploration Becomes Cheap: A Case Study of Agentic Research in EDA
summary: As EDA researchers, we conducted eight deliberate trials of agentic algorithm exploration, selecting several topics outside our areas of depth. One faculty member and seven students participated, including students without publication experience. With limited intervention in the algorithms, agents developed mathematical constructions, analyzed existing tools, and implemented improvements; some efforts fell short of their practical goals. We also used AI to collect, classify, and analyze 8,420 papers from four EDA conferences and two journals over 2022-2026. Among 2,380 primary-core papers, we classified 97.7% from titles and abstracts as computationally closed, including work on new formulations. Together, these observations suggest that much of EDA offers an executable environment for increasingly accessible algorithm research. We see an opportunity for tool developers to investigate ideas they previously lacked time to pursue. We also ask how EDA should validate and reward research when results become easier to produce than to examine, and what papers and venue labels will continue to tell us about a contribution.

AI.tldr: 作者开展8次智能体算法探索试验并借助AI分析8420篇EDA论文，发现97.7%的核心论文属于"计算封闭"型，认为EDA为日益普及的算法研究提供了可执行环境，并呼吁重新思考研究验证与奖励机制。
AI.motivation: 作为EDA研究者，作者希望探究智能体（AI agent）在算法探索中的实际能力边界，并评估EDA领域研究工作的性质，以判断算法研究门槛降低后该领域面临的机遇与挑战。
AI.method: 开展8次有意的智能体算法探索试验，参与者包括1名教师和7名学生（含无发表经验者），对算法仅做有限干预，由智能体完成数学构造、现有工具分析与改进实现；同时用AI对2022—2026年四大EDA会议和两本期刊的8420篇论文进行收集、分类与分析。
AI.result: 智能体能够发展数学构造、分析现有工具并实现改进，但部分尝试未达到实际目标；在2380篇核心论文中，97.7%可依据标题和摘要归类为"计算封闭"型，包括提出新 formulations 的工作。
AI.conclusion: EDA大部分领域为日益易得的算法研究提供了可执行环境，工具开发者有机会探索此前无暇顾及的想法；同时需反思当结果比审查更易产生时，EDA应如何验证和奖励研究，以及论文与会议标签对贡献的指示意义。

title: Towards Verifying Neural Networks Against Multi-Parameter Bit-Flip Perturbations
summary: Hardware faults can flip bits in the stored weights of a quantized neural network, potentially compromising its predictions. While such faults typically affect multiple parameters simultaneously, existing verifiers are limited to single-parameter perturbations due to the combinatorial explosion of possible flip locations in large networks. We present mBFV (m-BitFlip Verifier), an efficient verification framework that proves robustness against simultaneous bit flips across multiple parameters without explicitly enumerating these combinations. mBFV achieves this via a novel multi-parameter bound propagation technique that directly aggregates the m worst-case contributions. To further tighten these bounds, mBFV employs a branch-and-bound mechanism over perturbation locations, partitioning the potential flips to smaller groups of neurons. Evaluated on 625 instances, mBFV successfully verifies 293, significantly outperforming a prior single-parameter verifier (38 verified instances) and an exact mixed-integer linear programming baseline (0 verified instances). Notably, while these baselines are restricted to single-parameter flips on small networks (up to 13k parameters), mBFV scales to verify networks with up to 1.15M parameters against up to four simultaneous parameter flips.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 mBFV，一种可证明量化神经网络在多个参数同时发生比特翻转时鲁棒性的验证框架，通过多参数界传播与分支定界实现高效验证。
AI.motivation: 硬件故障可能翻转量化神经网络存储权重中的比特，且通常同时影响多个参数，但现有验证器因组合爆炸只能处理单参数扰动，无法应对多参数同时翻转场景。
AI.method: mBFV 采用新颖的多参数界传播技术，直接聚合 m 个最坏情况贡献，避免显式枚举翻转组合；并引入针对扰动位置的分支定界机制，将潜在翻转划分到更小的神经元组以收紧边界。
AI.result: 在 625 个实例上，mBFV 成功验证 293 个，显著优于单参数验证器（38 个）和精确混合整数线性规划基线（0 个）；基线仅限小网络（最多 13k 参数）的单参数翻转，而 mBFV 可扩展至 1.15M 参数网络并应对最多四个参数同时翻转。
AI.conclusion: mBFV 通过多参数界传播与分支定界，在无需枚举组合的前提下实现了对多参数同时比特翻转的可证明鲁棒性验证，并在规模与验证成功率上大幅超越现有方法。

title: A Distributed Accelerated Preconditioned ADMM for Solving Quadratically Regularized Optimal Transport on Bipartite Graphs
summary: Optimal transport (OT) has found broad applications in machine learning, economics, and management. Classical OT models, however, are not directly suited to allocation problems with graph-structured connectivity and unbalanced mass. Distributed OT formulations on bipartite graphs address these requirements but are typically solved by ADMM, whose slow convergence limits communication efficiency. We adapt the accelerated preconditioned ADMM (AP-ADMM) to the quadratically regularized distributed OT model and develop DAP-ADMM, a fully distributed algorithm in which each node communicates only with its graph neighbors. For fixed local penalty parameters, we establish global convergence and non-ergodic $O(1/k)$ bounds for both the KKT-residual norm and the primal objective gap. We derive an exact solver-free routine for the interval-constrained projections arising in the local ADMM subproblems. We propose a distributed self-adaptive penalty mechanism that updates node-specific penalties using locally computable KKT-residual components without global aggregation. Numerical experiments confirm the efficiency of the solver-free routine and the practical acceleration of DAP-ADMM over standard distributed ADMM.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对二部图上带二次正则的分布式最优传输模型，提出DAP-ADMM全分布式算法，建立全局收敛与非遍历O(1/k)收敛界，并给出无求解器的区间约束投影方法及自适应惩罚机制。
AI.motivation: 经典最优传输模型不适用于具有图结构连通性和质量不平衡的分配问题；二部图上的分布式OT虽能应对这些需求，但通常由ADMM求解，其收敛缓慢限制了通信效率。
AI.method: 将加速预处理ADMM（AP-ADMM）适配到二次正则化分布式OT模型，提出DAP-ADMM全分布式算法，每个节点仅与图邻居通信；针对局部ADMM子问题中的区间约束投影，推导出精确的无求解器（solver-free）流程；并提出分布式自适应惩罚机制，利用局部可计算的KKT残差分量更新各节点特定惩罚参数，无需全局聚合。
AI.result: 在固定局部惩罚参数下，建立了全局收敛性，以及KKT残差范数和原始目标间隙的非遍历O(1/k)界；数值实验验证了无求解器流程的高效性以及DAP-ADMM相对标准分布式ADMM的实际加速效果。
AI.conclusion: DAP-ADMM为图结构、质量不平衡的分布式最优传输问题提供了一种通信高效、理论收敛有保证的求解方案。

title: Autonomous Droplet Navigation via Model-Based Reinforcement Learning: Zero-Shot Transfer and Emergent Dynamics
comment: Accepted for presentation at the Robotics & Automation in Self-Driving Laboratories 2026 Workshop, IROS 2026. https://sites.tufts.edu/selfdrivinglabs-iros2026/
summary: Self-driving laboratories (SDLs) are transforming chemical and materials discovery through closed-loop automation, yet automated infrastructure for physical manipulation of soft, deformable matter remains beyond current robotic platforms. A critical instance is autonomous droplet transport on an open surface, where contact-angle hysteresis, capillary pinning, and surface heterogeneity produce partially observable dynamics that pose significant challenges for classical model-based controllers. We introduce the first robotic platform for closed-loop autonomous liquid droplet navigation on an open, unconfined surface using model-based reinforcement learning. A two-axis tilting board coated with a thin silicone oil film drives the droplet, while an overhead camera provides real-time feedback. A learned policy was trained on just 50 to 150 physical episodes depending on geometric complexity, without simulation or analytical models. Beyond performance alone, the platform demonstrates three capabilities of interest to the SDL community: it robustly transfers zero-shot to unseen geometries; it autonomously discovers an oscillatory depinning strategy to free the droplet when it sticks; and it completes its full training pipeline in under 90 minutes. These results extend reinforcement-learning manipulation from rigid microrobots to deformable soft-matter systems for next-generation SDLs.

AI.tldr: 提出首个基于模型强化学习的开放无约束表面液滴自主导航机器人平台，在50–150次物理回合内完成训练，具备零样本迁移、自主脱钉策略与90分钟内完整训练管线。
AI.motivation: 自驱动实验室（SDLs）通过闭环自动化推动化学与材料发现，但针对柔软可变形物质的物理操控自动化基础设施仍超出当前机器人平台能力。典型难题是开放表面的自主液滴运输：接触角滞后、毛细钉扎与表面异质性导致部分可观测动力学，对经典基于模型的控制器构成重大挑战。
AI.method: 构建双轴倾斜板平台，表面覆有薄硅油膜以驱动液滴，顶置相机提供实时反馈；采用基于模型的强化学习训练控制策略，不依赖仿真或解析模型，依据几何复杂度仅需50至150个物理回合。
AI.result: 策略可稳健零样本迁移至未见几何构型；当液滴粘滞时，系统自主发现振荡脱钉策略将其释放；完整训练管线在90分钟内完成。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将强化学习操控从刚性微机器人拓展至可变形软物质系统，为下一代自驱动实验室提供可行基础设施。

title: CoDR: Training-Free Confidence-Drift Remasking for Diffusion Language Models
summary: Masked diffusion language models (MDLMs) decode by repeatedly committing tokens to masked positions, but these commitments are usually irreversible. A token chosen under sparse, partial context is kept fixed, even when later context no longer supports it. Existing samplers mainly decide when to commit a token, but rarely check whether an already committed token should still be kept, allowing early mistakes to propagate. We trace this issue to confidence drift, where the model's confidence in a committed token drops from its sparse commit-time context to the denser context available later. Based on this signal, we propose CoDR (Confidence Drift Remasking), a training-free and sampler-agnostic refinement pass. CoDR estimates drift for all committed positions in only k forward passes via k-partition probing, then remasks and regenerates only the tokens the model no longer endorses. Across two backbones, four reasoning and coding tasks, and three base samplers, CoDR improves average accuracy across all evaluated model-sampler configurations and improves most individual task settings with modest overhead. Controlled experiments show that the gains come from targeted confidence-drift remasking rather than extra compute alone, and that CoDR uses far fewer forward passes than prior remasking methods. Code is available at https://github.com/YueWu0301/CoDR.

AI.tldr: 论文提出CoDR（Confidence Drift Remasking），一种免训练、与采样器无关的细化方法，通过检测已提交token的“置信度漂移”，对模型不再认可的token进行重新掩码与重生成，从而纠正MDLM解码中早期不可逆提交导致的错误传播。
AI.motivation: 掩码扩散语言模型（MDLM）的解码过程是反复将token提交到掩码位置，但这些提交通常不可逆：token在稀疏、部分上下文中被选定后便被固定，即使后续更密集的上下文不再支持它。现有采样器主要决定“何时提交”token，却很少检查已提交的token是否仍应保留，导致早期错误不断传播。作者将这一问题归因于“置信度漂移”（confidence drift），即模型对已提交token的置信度从稀疏的提交时上下文到后续更密集上下文之间出现下降。
AI.method: 基于置信度漂移这一信号，提出CoDR（Confidence Drift Remasking）。它是一种免训练、与采样器无关的细化过程：通过k-partition probing，仅用k次前向传播即可估计所有已提交位置的漂移，然后仅对模型不再认可的token进行重新掩码与重生成。
AI.result: 在两个主干模型、四个推理与编码任务、三种基础采样器上，CoDR在所有评估的“模型-采样器”组合中均提升了平均准确率，并在多数单项任务设置上取得提升，开销适中。控制实验表明，收益来自有针对性的置信度漂移重掩码，而非单纯的额外计算；且CoDR的前向传播次数远少于先前的重掩码方法。
AI.conclusion: CoDR通过检测并修正已提交token的置信度漂移，有效缓解了MDLM中早期不可逆提交造成的错误传播，且兼具免训练、采样器无关、计算高效的特点。代码已开源。

title: VCR-Bench: A Modular Open-Source Benchmark for Video Classification Robustness
comment: 6 pages,1 figure, accepted at ACM MM 2026
summary: Robustness of image classification has several benchmarks, but their video counterparts are absent. In video classification temporal dimension introduces additional degrees of freedom for adversarial attacks, defenses, and preprocessing. Temporal sampling, perturbation budgets, and metric aggregation also interact in ways with no direct analogue in the image setting. Therefore, robustness for video classifiers is studied across scattered, incompatible implementations, making reported numbers hard to reproduce and analyze. We introduce VCR-Bench, a modular open-source benchmark framework that standardizes video loading, wrappers for classifiers, adversarial attacks and defenses, perceptual metrics, configuration presets, and result logging. VCR-Bench currently integrates 30 video classification models, 14 adversarial attacks, and 10 defense wrappers under a common evaluation protocol. We evaluate representative video classifiers, attacks, and defenses on Kinetics-400 subset, reporting clean accuracy, attack success rate, perceptual quality, runtime, and memory usage. VCR-Bench is released with documented installation, reproducible run presets, component-extension interfaces, and scripts for reproducing the reported results at https://github.com/msu-video-group/vcr-bench.

AI.tldr: 提出 VCR-Bench，一个模块化开源视频分类鲁棒性基准框架，统一视频加载、模型封装、攻击/防御、感知指标、配置预设与结果记录，集成 30 个模型、14 种攻击、10 种防御，并在 Kinetics-400 子集上评测干净精度、攻击成功率、感知质量、运行时与内存。
AI.motivation: 图像分类鲁棒性已有多种基准，但视频分类缺乏对应基准。视频引入了时间维度，使得对抗攻击、防御与预处理多出额外自由度；时间采样、扰动预算与指标聚合方式相互影响，且无图像场景中的直接对应物。因此现有视频分类鲁棒性研究实现零散、互不兼容，导致报告数值难以复现与分析。
AI.method: 提出 VCR-Bench，模块化开源基准框架，标准化以下环节：视频加载、分类器封装、对抗攻击与防御封装、感知指标、配置预设、结果记录。当前集成 30 个视频分类模型、14 种对抗攻击、10 种防御封装，并在统一评估协议下运行。
AI.result: 在 Kinetics-400 子集上对代表性视频分类器、攻击与防御进行评测，报告干净精度、攻击成功率、感知质量、运行时与内存占用。
AI.conclusion: VCR-Bench 提供文档化安装、可复现运行预设、组件扩展接口及结果复现脚本，开源地址为 https://github.com/msu-video-group/vcr-bench，可缓解视频分类鲁棒性评测零散、不可复现的问题。

title: An Empirical Study of Agent Skills' Downstream Utility
summary: Agent Skills package procedural guidance and resources for reuse, but a relevant Skill does not necessarily improve task performance. Existing studies characterize Skill content and evaluate downstream performance, yet provide limited explanations of how utility depends on content, execution configuration, and multi-Skill organization. We conduct an empirical study on 87 SkillsBench tasks, defining downstream utility as the pass-rate difference from No-Skill on the same tasks under the same model--harness configuration. We compare the same Skills across nine configurations, then examine alternative published Skills and organizations of fixed Skill sets under three selected configurations. We retrieve marketplace candidates from a curated corpus of 37,596 Skills. LLM-assisted analysis of content, execution traces, and final artifacts, followed by author review, relates provided support to actual use and task outcomes. The same Skills help some configurations and hurt others on 36.78\% of tasks, with trajectories showing that recommended procedures can become an execution burden. Relevance rankings overlook more useful candidates. Within the evaluated candidate sets, reranking by support for required operations raises first-choice pass rates by 4.35--5.80 percentage points across the three configurations. We derive 17 authoring practices linking executable procedures to recovery, preservation of task requirements, and checks on final artifacts. Stage Plan and Dependency DAG outperform use order alone, with DAG's additional benefits concentrated in tasks supplied with five or six Skills. These findings guide developers to assess usable operation support, allow procedure adaptation while preserving task requirements, and make artifact dependencies explicit when organizing Skills.

AI.tldr: 对 87 个 SkillsBench 任务进行实证研究，发现同一 Skill 在不同执行配置下效用差异显著（36.78% 任务上有的配置受益、有的受损），并给出提升 Skill 复用效用的检索重排与组织策略。
AI.motivation: Agent Skills 虽可打包可复用的过程性指导与资源，但相关 Skill 的存在并不必然提升任务表现。已有研究多停留在刻画 Skill 内容与评测下游性能，对"效用如何依赖 Skill 内容、执行配置与多 Skill 组织方式"缺乏解释，因此需要系统性实证来揭示 Skill 有效性的条件边界。
AI.method: 在 87 个 SkillsBench 任务上开展实证研究，将下游效用定义为在相同模型—执行框架（model-harness）配置下，相对于 No-Skill 基线的通过率差值。先对同一组 Skill 在九种配置下进行对比；再在三种选定配置下考察已发表的替代 Skill 及固定 Skill 集合的不同组织方式；从 37,596 个 Skill 的精选语料中检索市场候选。采用 LLM 辅助分析 Skill 内容、执行轨迹与最终产物，并辅以作者人工复核，将提供的支持与实际使用及任务结果关联。
AI.result: 同一 Skill 在 36.78% 的任务上对不同配置产生相反效应，轨迹显示推荐过程有时会转化为执行负担。相关性排序会忽略更有用的候选；在评估的候选集合内，按"所需操作支持度"重排后，三种配置的首选通过率提升 4.35–5.80 个百分点。归纳出 17 条编写实践，将可执行过程与恢复机制、任务需求保持、最终产物检查相联结。在组织方式上，Stage Plan 与 Dependency DAG 优于仅使用顺序（use order），且 DAG 的额外收益集中在提供五或六个 Skill 的任务上。
AI.conclusion: Skill 的效用并非固有属性，而取决于内容、执行配置与多 Skill 组织的匹配。建议开发者评估"可用的操作支持"（usable operation support），允许在保持任务需求前提下对过程进行适配，并在组织 Skill 时显式表达产物依赖关系。

title: KVFetch: Temporal Prefetching for the Missing Half of KV Cache Compression
summary: As context windows scale to tens or hundreds of thousands of tokens, KV cache compression has become essential for efficient LLM inference. Existing methods fall into three families: score-based eviction, summary compensation, and offload-and-recall. Yet all three decide what to keep or recall by content relevance to the current query. We show this shared design is structurally incomplete. A cache supports two access modes: associative lookup by content and sequential traversal by position; current compressors implement only the first. The gap matters in practice: retrieval-augmented generation, code completion, and structured-data extraction all require the model to reproduce identifiers, field values, or code tokens verbatim from the context. Under compression, content-based eviction retains the head of such a sequence but discards its continuation, causing verbatim copying to break irreversibly midway, a failure we call sequential forgetting. This failure resists better scoring, larger budgets, summary compensation, and dynamic re-scoring; it is the dominant source of remaining quality loss under compression. We propose KVFetch, a training-free, drop-in framework that opens a temporal recall channel for any score-based compressor. It demotes evicted candidates to a quantized cold tier, detects active copying through a monotone read pointer, and prefetches positional successors into fixed-size hot-tier slots without increasing attention cost. On RULER-16K under an iso-budget control, KVFetch recovers verbatim copying from 0.8 to 78.4 and raises the 13-task average by +8.4, with gains concentrating on tasks that require sequential access. On LongBench, where no task requires sequential access, the channel remains dormant and imposes no cost.

AI.tldr: 现有 KV cache 压缩方法仅实现"按内容关联查找"这一访问模式，忽略了"按位置顺序遍历"，导致逐字复制类任务出现序列性遗忘；作者提出免训练框架 KVFetch，通过量化冷层与位置预取补上时间召回通道，在 RULER-16K 上把逐字复制从 0.8 恢复到 78.4。
AI.motivation: 上下文窗口扩展至数万乃至数十万 token，KV cache 压缩成为 LLM 高效推理的关键。现有三类方法（基于分数的淘汰、摘要补偿、卸载-召回）均依据"内容与当前查询的相关性"决定保留或召回对象。作者指出这一共同设计在结构上不完整：缓存实际支持两种访问模式——按内容的关联查找与按位置的顺序遍历，而现有压缩器只实现了前者。该缺口在 RAG、代码补全、结构化数据抽取等需要逐字复现标识符、字段值或代码 token 的任务中实际造成损害。
AI.method: 作者将失败模式命名为"序列性遗忘"（sequential forgetting）：基于内容的淘汰会保留序列头部却丢弃其后续，使逐字复制在中途不可逆地断裂；该失败对更好的打分、更大的预算、摘要补偿与动态重打分均不敏感。为此提出 KVFetch——一个免训练、即插即用的框架，可为任意基于分数的压缩器开启时间召回通道：将被淘汰的候选降级至量化冷层（cold tier），通过单调读指针检测正在进行的复制行为，并将位置后继预取到固定大小的热层槽位（hot-tier slots），且不增加注意力计算开销。
AI.result: 在 RULER-16K 上、等预算（iso-budget）控制条件下，KVFetch 将逐字复制得分从 0.8 提升至 78.4，13 项任务平均提升 +8.4，增益集中于需要顺序访问的任务。在 LongBench 上，由于没有任务需要顺序访问，该通道保持休眠，不引入额外开销。
AI.conclusion: KV cache 压缩的现有范式因只覆盖关联查找而结构性缺失顺序遍历能力，序列性遗忘是压缩下剩余质量损失的主要来源。KVFetch 以零训练、可插拔的方式补足时间召回通道，在需要顺序访问的任务上大幅恢复逐字复制能力，而在无此需求的任务上无成本，表明"内容相关性"不应是压缩决策的唯一准则。

title: SUSpMV: A High Frequency Sparse Matrix Vector Multiplier on HBM Enabled FPGA written in SUS
comment: Accepted at the International Conference on Field-Programmable Technology (FPT) 2026. 9 pages, 9 figures
summary:
SUSpMV is a Sparse Matrix Vector multiplication (SpMV) accelerator written in the upcoming HDL SUS. By leveraging SUS's unique latency counting and inference mechanism, SUSpMV could be designed with very deep pipelines yet small design complexity overhead. This enables an efficient implementation which employs all 32 HBM channels on the Alveo U280 FPGA at 400MHz for streaming matrix data into 32 Compute Units (CUs). Input and output vectors are stored in DDR memory, which allows zero-overhead chaining of multiplications and increases overall system memory bandwidth by not sharing HBM bandwidth with the CUs.
  A CU processes the SpMV in tiles of width 1024 and a dynamically chosen height, up to 32768. Each CU is capable of accumulating the multiplications with up to 6 separate matrix entries per cycle, resulting in the combined theoretical peak computational throughput of 153.6 GFLOPs. The matrix storage format is designed to exploit density variation within a given matrix by dynamically switching between one representation optimized for denser regions, and a second optimized for sparser regions, allowing jumps of up to 255 rows between each entry.
  Evaluation demonstrates a 79% geometric mean improvement over prior work on the same platform. We achieve a peak throughput of 144.9 GFLOPs, or 94% of our theoretical computational throughput, compared to 98 GFLOPs reached by prior work.

AI.tldr: SUSpMV是基于SUS HDL实现的SpMV加速器，利用延迟计数与推断机制构建深流水线，在Alveo U280上使用全部32个HBM通道与32个计算单元，峰值吞吐达144.9 GFLOPs（理论峰值的94%），较同平台先前工作几何平均提升79%。
AI.motivation: 稀疏矩阵向量乘（SpMV）在FPGA上受限于流水线深度与设计复杂度、HBM带宽分配及矩阵存储格式对稀疏度变化的适应性。本文旨在以低设计复杂度开销实现深流水线，并提升存储带宽与格式效率。
AI.method: 采用即将推出的HDL SUS编写；借助其延迟计数与推断机制实现深流水线且降低设计复杂度；每个CU以宽1024、动态高度（最高32768）的分块处理SpMV，每周期最多累加6个矩阵条目；输入输出向量存于DDR以避免占用HBM带宽，实现零开销乘法链式连接；矩阵存储格式根据密度变化在稠密与稀疏两种表示间动态切换，支持条目间最多255行跳变。
AI.result: 在Alveo U280 FPGA上以400MHz运行全部32个HBM通道和32个CU；理论峰值吞吐153.6 GFLOPs，实测峰值144.9 GFLOPs（达理论值94%），对比先前工作的98 GFLOPs，几何平均性能提升79%。
AI.conclusion: 通过SUS HDL机制、DDR存储向量及自适应存储格式，SUSpMV以较低设计复杂度实现了高流水线效率与高吞吐，显著优于同平台先前工作。

title: Contextualization of Third-Party Cloud Security Findings
summary: Finding severity is the main driver of how security teams prioritize remediation. For third-party cloud security findings, that severity is static: the rule that raised the finding assigns it before the rule meets any environment, so it reflects the risk of the condition in general rather than the risk the finding poses to the concrete environment where it lives. Scoring standards define where environment-specific context belongs. How far that context changes finding severities in production, where the deciding evidence lies, and whether it holds against the live environment have not been measured. We address this gap with contextualization, re-deriving each finding's severity from evidence in the environment where the finding lives. A deep research agent over a precomputed cross-signal asset graph investigates each finding against the resource's state, its graph neighborhood, and other products' signals, and returns an adjusted severity with an evidence trace. We evaluate it in a production field study of 9,967 vendor HIGH findings from two commercial cloud security platforms across eight real production environments, on three criteria: the faithfulness of the facts behind each verdict to the live environment, the dependence of each decision on context beyond the flagged resource, and the regularity of the reasoning. Three in four findings are re-graded, mostly downward, and the same rule often moves in opposite directions inside a single environment. About half of the decisive evidence lies beyond the flagged resource, and read-only probes of live infrastructure confirm the decisive fact for 99.4% of decided findings.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出"情境化"(contextualization)方法，利用基于预计算跨信号资产图的深度研究智能体，从发现所在环境的证据中重新推导第三方云安全发现的严重性。在8个真实生产环境、来自两个商业云安全平台的9,967条厂商HIGH级发现上进行评估：约四分之三的发现被重新评级(多数下调)，同一规则在同一环境内常出现相反方向调整，约一半决定性证据位于被标记资源之外，对已判定发现的只读实时探测证实关键事实的准确率达99.4%。
AI.motivation: 第三方云安全发现的严重性由规则在接触任何环境之前静态赋予，反映的是该条件的一般风险，而非其对具体环境构成的真实风险。评分标准虽定义了环境相关情境应纳入的位置，但在生产环境中情境究竟能在多大程度上改变发现严重性、决定性证据位于何处、以及结论能否经得起实时环境验证，均尚未被测量。
AI.method: 提出"情境化"方法：在预计算的跨信号资产图上运行深度研究智能体，针对每条发现，结合资源状态、图的邻域以及其他产品的信号进行调查，输出经调整的严重性及证据追踪。在8个真实生产环境、来自两个商业云安全平台的9,967条厂商HIGH级发现上开展生产实地研究，从三个标准评估：判定背后事实与实时环境的一致性、每个决策对超出被标记资源之外情境的依赖程度、以及推理的规律性。
AI.result: 四分之三的发现被重新评级，且大多为下调；同一规则在同一环境内常朝相反方向调整。约一半的决定性证据位于被标记资源之外。对已判定发现的只读实时基础设施探测证实，99.4%的决定性事实得到确认。
AI.conclusion: 静态严重性无法反映发现对具体环境的真实风险，情境化能够显著且双向地重塑严重性分布，且决策高度依赖被标记资源之外的情境。实时只读探测对决定性事实的近乎完全确认，表明该方法的事实基础在真实生产环境中是可靠的。

title: Fast and Memory Efficient Offload Training Framework with Hybrid XPU Computation
summary: With the ever-growing size of deep learning models, GPU memory is prone to being insufficient during training. A prominent approach is ZeRO-Offload, which moves the optimizer states to CPU memory and performs parameter update using CPU. However, the deficiencies of ZeRO-Offload include low GPU utilization, imperfect overlapping of communication and computation, and inflexible offloading. In this paper, we leverage Direct Host Access (DHA) on the GPU that can compute data in CPU memory, forming a novel hybrid on-GPU and DHA. We design and implement MemFerry consisting of an execution scheduler and a shadow model. The scheduler strategically chooses layers of parameters for DHA computation and transmits the remaining parameters to GPU memory simultaneously to shorten forward propagation time, and further loads DHA parameters to GPU memory to reduce backward propagation time. The shadow model presents a unified memory abstraction for the parameter partitions stored separately in GPU and CPU memories. To further reduce GPU memory usage, we present MemFerry along with its dynamic programming algorithm that offloads gradients to CPU memory via DHA. We further extend MemFerry to emerging scale-up domains with ScaleUp-MemFerry, which exploits otherwise underutilized accelerator interconnect bandwidth to assist host-to-accelerator data movement through adaptive multi-path transfer. Our experiments show that \system trains up to $1.68\times$ faster and MemFerry can train $1.52\times$ larger model compared to ZeRO-Offload on a single GPU, and increase training speed by at least $28.1\%$ when scaling to data parallelism on 8 GPUs. We further extend the design to a Huawei CloudMatrix384 scale-Up node with up to 8 NPUs, and our ScaleUp-MemFerry reduces the end-to-end iteration time by up to $20.7\%$ over DeepSpeed.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 MemFerry，利用 GPU 的 Direct Host Access（DHA）实现 GPU 与 CPU 内存的混合计算，以缓解深度学习训练中的显存不足问题，并通过调度器、影子模型、梯度卸载及 ScaleUp-MemFerry 扩展提升训练速度与模型规模。
AI.motivation: 随着深度学习模型规模不断增大，GPU 显存在训练时容易不足。现有代表性方案 ZeRO-Offload 将优化器状态移至 CPU 内存并用 CPU 更新参数，但存在 GPU 利用率低、通信与计算重叠不完善、卸载策略不灵活等缺陷。
AI.method: 利用 GPU 的 Direct Host Access（DHA）直接在 CPU 内存上计算，构建 on-GPU 与 DHA 的混合执行方式；设计并实现 MemFerry，包含执行调度器和影子模型。调度器选择部分参数层进行 DHA 计算，同时将其余参数传输至 GPU 内存以缩短前向传播时间，并进一步将 DHA 参数加载到 GPU 内存以减少反向传播时间；影子模型为分别存储于 GPU 和 CPU 内存的参数分区提供统一内存抽象。还提出动态规划算法，通过 DHA 将梯度卸载到 CPU 内存，并扩展出 ScaleUp-MemFerry，利用加速器互连带宽，通过自适应多路径传输辅助主机到加速器的数据移动。
AI.result: 实验表明，MemFerry 在单 GPU 上训练速度最高比 ZeRO-Offload 快 1.68 倍，可训练模型规模大 1.52 倍；扩展到 8 GPU 数据并行时训练速度至少提升 28.1%。在含多达 8 个 NPU 的华为 CloudMatrix384 scale-Up 节点上，ScaleUp-MemFerry 相比 DeepSpeed 将端到端迭代时间最多降低 20.7%。
AI.conclusion: MemFerry 通过 DHA 混合计算、统一内存抽象、梯度卸载和 ScaleUp 多路径传输，有效缓解显存瓶颈，并在单 GPU、数据并行及 scale-up 节点场景中显著提升训练速度与可扩展性。

title: CIRRA: Dual-Level Continual Instruction Reconciliation with Ongoing Execution for Embodied Robot Agents in Interactive Household Tasks
summary: Household robots must accommodate new user instructions while executing ongoing tasks. Existing agents often regenerate or extensively revise the remaining task sequence, introducing plan ambiguity, logical inconsistency, and redundant execution. We formulate continual instruction reconciliation and propose CIRRA (Continual Instruction Reconciliation for Robot Agents), a dual-level framework combining LLM-based semantic reasoning with rule-constrained structural integration. CIRRA first grounds incoming instructions to unique executable skills and resolves underspecified actions and execution locations. It then preserves the ongoing subtask sequence as an execution backbone and generates integration candidates by inserting incoming subtasks into location-matched segments. The semantic reasoner evaluates only modified segments to identify dependencies and conflicts and select the most logically coherent local integration. This structure-preserving process maintains alignment with ongoing execution, mitigates ambiguity and inconsistency, and reuses shared subtasks to reduce redundant execution. We also introduce CHIRP (Continual Household Instruction Reconciliation and Planning), a text-based benchmark of 120 episodes across eight household environments and six categories of everyday activities. On CHIRP, CIRRA achieves 74.2% decision agreement, exceeding the strongest replanning baseline by 30 percentage points; every correct fusion decision yields a correctly placed, conflict-free schedule. On a Unitree G1 humanoid, CIRRA interrupts ongoing skills at the correct moment in every trial and significantly outperforms all baselines on every metric.

AI.tldr: 提出CIRRA双层次框架，用于家庭机器人的持续指令协调，结合LLM语义推理与规则约束的结构整合，并发布CHIRP基准。
AI.motivation: 家庭机器人需在执行进行中任务时接纳新指令。现有智能体常重新生成或大幅修改剩余任务序列，导致计划模糊、逻辑不一致与冗余执行。
AI.method: CIRRA先将新指令落地为唯一可执行技能，解析未充分指定的动作与执行位置；再以正在进行的子任务序列作为执行骨架，将新子任务插入位置匹配的片段生成整合候选；语义推理器仅评估被修改片段以识别依赖与冲突，选择逻辑最连贯的局部整合。
AI.result: 在CHIRP基准上达到74.2%决策一致率，超过最强重规划基线30个百分点；每个正确的融合决策均产生位置正确且无冲突的调度。在Unitree G1人形机器人上，CIRRA每次试验均能在正确时刻打断进行中技能，并在所有指标上显著优于基线。
AI.conclusion: 结构保持式整合可维持与进行中执行的对齐，缓解模糊与不一致，并通过复用共享子任务减少冗余执行。

title: Leveraging LLM-Generated Explanations for Detecting Emotionally Rewritten Fake News
summary: The spread of fake news may cause severe social consequences. Existing fake news detection methods mainly focus on stylistic variations or incorporate external information such as explanations. However, news articles are often rewritten under different emotional backgrounds while preserving their underlying factual claims, which may affect the robustness of detection models. In this work, we investigate fake news detec- tion under fact-preserving emotional variations. To study this problem, we construct emotion-rewritten test sets and generate explanations from the original news articles as stable background knowledge. We then propose a Gated Cross Attention (GCA) framework that adaptively integrates emotionally rewritten news with the corresponding explanations, enabling the model to focus on informative explanation content while reducing potential mismatches caused by emotional reframing. Experiments on PolitiFact, GossipCop, and LUN demonstrate that the proposed method achieves notable improvements under multiple emotional conditions on PolitiFact and LUN, while maintaining competitive performance on GossipCop. We further analyze the effects of explanation guidance and gating mechanisms under different emotional conditions. Our code and data are available at: https://github.com/Flulike/fakenews gca .

AI.tldr: 本文研究事实保持的情感改写场景下的假新闻检测，构建情感改写测试集并以原始新闻生成解释作为稳定背景知识，提出门控交叉注意力（GCA）框架自适应融合二者，在 PolitiFact 与 LUN 上多情感条件下显著提升，GossipCop 上保持竞争力。
AI.motivation: 假新闻传播危害严重，但现有检测方法多依赖风格特征或外部信息（如解释），而新闻常在不同情感背景下被改写却保留事实主张，这会削弱检测模型的鲁棒性；因此需要研究事实保持情感变化条件下的假新闻检测问题。
AI.method: 构建情感改写测试集，并从原始新闻生成解释作为稳定背景知识；提出 Gated Cross Attention（GCA）框架，通过门控交叉注意力自适应地整合情感改写后的新闻与对应解释，使模型关注有信息量的解释内容并缓解情感重构带来的潜在不匹配。
AI.result: 在 PolitiFact、GossipCop 和 LUN 数据集上的实验表明：所提方法在 PolitiFact 和 LUN 的多种情感条件下取得明显提升，同时在 GossipCop 上保持有竞争力的性能；并进一步分析了不同情感条件下解释引导与门控机制的作用。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，在事实保持的情感改写条件下，引入稳定的解释背景知识并结合门控交叉注意力融合机制，可有效提升假新闻检测的鲁棒性与性能，代码与数据已开源。

title: SPW-Nav: A Streaming Panoramic World Model for Language-Guided Navigation
summary: Language-guided panoramic video generation benefits various downstream applications, such as interactive 3D scene exploration, virtual reality experiences, and embodied agent training. Existing panoramic generators follow predefined trajectories, and interactive world models act through low-level actions in perspective views. We propose SPW-Nav, a streaming panoramic world model that understands movement instructions and streams one minute of 2K 360-degree video in real time from a single panorama. SPW-Nav interprets each instruction in the previously generated panorama as camera motion. Spherical rotation decoupling applies rotation exactly on the sphere, pose-aligned conditioning keeps translation inputs bounded over long streams, and a multi-term memory with a few-step generator continues the scene as instructions change. We also build SPW-NavSet, panoramic videos with camera trajectories and verified instructions. Driven by language, SPW-Nav outperforms prior panoramic generators in camera-following accuracy and video quality, and supports on-the-fly instruction switching.

AI.tldr: 提出流式全景世界模型SPW-Nav，可根据语言指令实时生成一分钟2K 360度视频。
AI.motivation: 现有全景生成器依赖预设轨迹，交互式世界模型仅在透视视角下以低层动作操作，缺乏语言引导与长时流式全景生成能力。
AI.method: 将每条指令解析为已生成全景中的相机运动；采用球面旋转解耦在球面上精确施加旋转，位姿对齐条件化使平移输入在长流中保持有界，并引入多项记忆与少步生成器实现指令切换时的场景延续；同时构建SPW-NavSet数据集。
AI.result: 在语言驱动下，相机跟随精度与视频质量均优于既有全景生成器，并支持实时指令切换。
AI.conclusion: SPW-Nav实现了语言引导、实时、长时间的流式全景视频生成，为交互式3D探索、VR与具身智能训练等应用提供支持。

title: How Could AI Eliminate Humanity? A Failure-Mode Analysis of Civilizational Risk
summary: This article develops a failure-mode framework for analyzing how advanced artificial intelligence could contribute to human extinction, irreversible civilizational collapse, or permanent human disempowerment. The central thesis is that catastrophic AI risk does not require consciousness, hostility, or an explicit intention to harm humanity. Instead, risk may arise through several distinct but interacting pathways, including autonomous misalignment, harmful human use, organizational failure, and competitive deployment. The severity of these pathways depends on factors such as capability, autonomy, external access, persistence, institutional safeguards, and the preservation of recovery capacity. The analysis is deliberately non-operational: it identifies causal conditions, empirically tractable intermediate quantities, and defensive research questions rather than procedures for causing harm.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一套"失败模式框架"，用于分析先进AI如何可能导致人类灭绝、不可逆的文明崩溃或人类永久性失权。核心论点是：灾难性AI风险并不需要以意识、敌意或明确的伤害意图为前提，而可能通过自主失调、人类有害使用、组织失灵与竞争性部署等多条相互交织的路径产生。
AI.motivation: 既有讨论常将灾难性AI风险绑定于AI具备意识、敌意或主动伤害意图，这一前提既难以证成，也可能导致风险识别范围过窄。作者希望建立一个不依赖拟人化假设的分析框架，从而系统刻画风险的因果结构，并识别可用于实证研究的中间变量。
AI.method: 概念性与框架性分析。作者划分若干彼此区别又相互作用的失败路径（自主失调、人类有害使用、组织失灵、竞争性部署），并引入严重性依赖的调节因素，包括能力、自主性、外部访问、持久性、制度性保障与恢复能力保全。分析被有意设计为非操作性的：只识别因果条件、可实证处理的中间量与防御性研究问题，而不提供任何致害程序或操作细节。
AI.result: 提出了一个多维度的AI灾难性风险分类与因果框架：风险来源可分解为自主失调、有害使用、组织失灵和竞争性部署四类路径；风险严重性由能力、自主性、外部访问、持久性、制度保障与恢复能力等变量共同决定。该框架为后续研究给出了可操作的中间量清单与防御性研究议程，而非致害性步骤。
AI.conclusion: 灾难性AI风险的分析不应以AI具有意识或恶意意图为必要前提；通过失败模式视角，可将风险拆解为多条可由组织、制度与竞争结构驱动的路径，并聚焦于能力、自主性、访问与恢复能力等可研究变量。作者强调该框架的非操作性取向，以在推进风险理解的同时降低信息滥用风险。

title: Bounded Autonomy and Verifiable Safety for Agentic AI Enabled Automation
comment: This paper has been accepted and will appear in the Journal of Intelligent and Robotic Systems (10.1007/s10846-026-02467-w)
summary: Agentic AI-enabled automation cannot be safely deployed in high-stakes environments on probabilistic reasoning alone. A recurring risk is epistemic drift: as reasoning deepens, system behavior may move away from subject-matter-expert constraints for safe operation. This paper presents BRaVeS, a bounded reasoning and safety-governance framework termed the Defensible Next-Gen Reasoning System (DNRS). BRaVeS encodes SME-defined constraints as invariant anchors, proposes MoDA-Style (Mixture of Depths Attention) depth-aware access as a candidate mechanism for keeping these anchors visible during inference, and uses a state hierarchy (SMARtAutonomy) to reduce autonomy as epistemic risk increases. To formalize bounded recovery, we introduce the Lyapunov-Bounded Consensus Framework (LBCF), which maps continuous epistemic-risk signals into a finite K-bag abstraction and applies shielded state transitions that enforce Lyapunov-style energy descent or route the system to a human-mediated terminal state. The formal convergence result applies to the finite LBCF abstraction under fixed thresholds and feasible-shield assumptions; it does not prove safety of the full continuous neural activation space. We evaluate the framework through a discrete event Monte Carlo simulation using HAI 22.04 industrial-control-system time-series data with synthetic noise and sensor-degradation regimes. Across the tested parameter-grouping strategies and thresholds, the LBCF process achieved finite-step convergence and no safety-guard violations. These results provide simulation-based evidence that bounded governance behavior can be enforced under the stated abstraction, while motivating future work on deployed transformer implementations, live human-in-the-loop validation, and broader adversarial settings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出BRaVeS治理框架，将专家约束编码为不变锚点，引入Lyapunov有界共识框架（LBCF）实现认知风险下的有界恢复，并在工业控制系统仿真中验证其有限步收敛与无安全违规。
AI.motivation: 高风险环境中的智能体AI自动化不能仅依赖概率推理部署，其核心风险是"认知漂移"：推理越深入，系统行为可能越偏离领域专家（SME）设定的安全操作约束，需要一种可辩护的治理机制来约束推理深度与自主性。
AI.method: 提出BRaVeS（有界推理与安全治理框架，即DNRS）：(1) 将SME定义的约束编码为不变锚点；(2) 提出MoDA-Style（混合深度注意力）深度感知访问机制，在推理中保持锚点可见；(3) 采用SMARtAutonomy状态层级，随认知风险升高而降低自主权；(4) 提出Lyapunov有界共识框架（LBCF），将连续认知风险信号映射为有限K-bag抽象，并通过屏蔽式状态转移强制Lyapunov式能量下降，或将系统导向人工介入的终止状态。评估采用基于HAI 22.04工业控制系统时间序列（含合成噪声与传感器退化情形）的离散事件蒙特卡洛仿真。
AI.result: 在测试的各参数分组策略与阈值下，LBCF过程均实现有限步收敛，且未出现安全守卫违规，为"在既定抽象下有界治理行为可被强制执行"提供了仿真层面的证据。
AI.conclusion: 形式化收敛结果仅适用于固定阈值与可行屏蔽假设下的有限LBCF抽象，并不证明完整连续神经激活空间的安全性。未来工作包括已部署Transformer实现、实时人在环验证及更广泛的对抗场景。

title: Do Generative Priors Align with Human Naturalness Perception?
summary: Visual generative models are trained to capture the probability distributions of natural images, yet whether their native priors reflect the regularities governing human perception of image naturalness remains an open question. Here, we probe these priors through native prediction errors across 25 open image and video generators. Because raw single-image losses are dominated by scene content and visual complexity, we evaluate directional loss differences using content-preserving, paired relational interventions that selectively disrupt facial configurations or physical illumination consistency while limiting changes in low-level image statistics. Across both domains, these loss differences reproduce human-like selective sensitivities and tolerances, capturing the classic Thatcher effect on faces and shape-dependent responses to illumination inconsistencies. Notably, these loss differences reliably track continuous gradations of human naturalness judgments across individual stimulus pairs (peaking at $r = .84$ on faces and $.64$ on physical scenes) and retain unique human-aligned signals even after controlling for feature distances from frozen vision encoders and standard image quality metrics. We also find that while overall sensitivity to these violations broadly covaries with human alignment across models, the two systematically decouple along denoising schedules, with alignment peaking earlier than sensitivity, revealing that human-like naturalness judgments dissociate from generic violation detection. Together, these findings demonstrate that learning visual distributions yields generative loss landscapes that capture distinct aspects of human naturalness perception.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过25个开放图像/视频生成模型的“原生预测误差”探测其先验，发现生成损失差异能复现人类对图像自然性（面孔Thatcher效应、光照一致性）的选择性敏感与容差，并在个体刺激对上与人类自然性判断高度相关（面孔r=.84、物理场景r=.64）；同时揭示人类对齐度与违约敏感性在去噪日程上系统性解耦。
AI.motivation: 视觉生成模型被训练以捕捉自然图像的概率分布，但其原生先验是否反映了支配人类感知图像自然性的规律，仍属未解问题。作者希望检验生成模型的损失景观是否编码了类人的自然性知觉。
AI.method: 在25个开放图像与视频生成模型上，使用原生预测误差（损失）作为探针。由于单图原始损失被场景内容与视觉复杂度主导，作者采用保持内容不变的“配对关系干预”，选择性破坏面孔构型或物理光照一致性，同时限制低层图像统计的变化；以此计算方向性损失差异。随后将损失差异与人类自然性判断做相关分析，并控制冻结视觉编码器的特征距离与标准图像质量指标；此外沿去噪日程比较敏感性与人类对齐度。
AI.result: 损失差异在面孔与物理两个域均复现了类人的选择性敏感与容差：捕获经典的Thatcher效应，以及依赖形状的光照不一致反应。损失差异能可靠追踪个体刺激对上人类自然性判断的连续变化（面孔峰值r=.84，物理场景r=.64），且在控制冻结视觉编码器特征距离与标准图像质量指标后仍保留独特的人类对齐信号。总体上，对违约的敏感性与人类对齐度在模型间广泛共变，但两者沿去噪日程系统性解耦，对齐度比敏感性更早达到峰值。
AI.conclusion: 学习视觉分布会产生具有特定结构的生成损失景观，该景观捕捉了人类自然性知觉的多个独特方面；类人自然性判断与通用的违约检测可分离。这表明生成模型的原生先验可作为研究人类自然性感知的有效探针。

title: Fault-tolerant foundation models
summary: Emerging computer hardware often trades reliability for energy efficiency; here we show that large-language models (LLMs) can be trained to tolerate this unreliability, and that rather than degrading, their error resilience actually increases as they grow. Modified neural scaling laws inferred from 40,000 GPU-hours of training runs on simulated faulty digital hardware quantify this trend and suggest that models learn to compute within "good" error-correcting codes, whose relative overhead remains finite no matter how large the model gets. This finding leads us to conjecture that appropriately trained LLMs may be formally fault-tolerant; if true, running AI inference on low energy, faulty hardware may be a path to substantial energy savings over the status quo.

AI.tldr: 研究表明大语言模型可被训练以容忍不可靠硬件，且误差容忍能力随模型规模增大而增强，据此推测其可能具备形式化容错能力，为在低能耗、易出错硬件上运行AI推理提供了节能路径。
AI.motivation: 新兴计算机硬件常以牺牲可靠性换取能效。若AI推理能在不可靠的低能耗硬件上运行，将带来显著的节能潜力，因此需要探究LLM能否容忍硬件不可靠性。
AI.method: 在模拟的故障数字硬件上进行大语言模型训练，累计消耗40,000 GPU小时；基于训练运行结果推导并修正神经缩放定律，用以量化模型误差容忍能力随规模变化的趋势。
AI.result: 实验显示，模型的误差容忍能力并非随规模增大而退化，反而持续提升；修正后的缩放定律表明模型学会了在具有良好纠错性质的编码空间内完成计算，且该编码的相对开销不随模型规模增大而增长。
AI.conclusion: 经适当训练的大语言模型可能具备形式化容错能力；若该推测成立，在低能耗、易出错的硬件上运行AI推理有望相较现状实现大幅节能。

title: Multi-Aspect Runtime Verification for Simulation-Based V&V of LLM-Enabled Autonomous Agents
comment: 28 pages, 2 figures, 2 tables. Accepted at Modelling and Simulation for Autonomous Systems (MESAS 2026), to appear in Springer LNCS
summary: LLM-based agents are entering decision-support roles in defence staff work, where the obligations they must respect are already written down and binding, and where retraining is not available as a control because models arrive as procured components. What can be placed under engineering control is the interface between the agent and the systems it acts on. Those obligations are at once spatial, temporal and text-semantic, and a violation typically lives in the composition of a multi-step interaction, which is why per-event guardrails miss sequential tool-attack chains. We present a multi-aspect runtime-verification framework that decomposes a natural-language policy clause into a typed spatial/temporal/semantic triple over one canonical event stream, checks each aspect with its own monitoring specification, and fuses the verdicts through a four-valued algebra that carries provenance. The spatial aspect is interpreted over a weighted two-sorted location graph in which mission geometry and information-release topology are one object; we show that these spatial obligations are not in general subsumed by a first-order temporal specification. The past-time aspect runs on the unmodified MonPoly engine, which agrees with our reference monitor at every time point. Across two mission domains, casualty evacuation and contested sustainment, and one civil domain, composition under the precautionary blocking policy drives attack success to zero with no observed false positives and microsecond-scale per-event cost, while every single aspect and every pair leaves a substantial share of attacks succeeding. In a closed-loop experiment a policy-naive planner reaches a violating state in most unshielded missions and in none when shielded, and four refused episodes in five still recover to a compliant outcome.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种多维度运行时验证框架，将自然语言政策条款分解为空间/时间/语义三元组，在统一事件流上分别监控并通过四值代数（带溯源）融合判定，使组合防护将攻击成功率降至零且无假阳性。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体进入国防参谋决策支持领域，其义务已明文且具约束力，模型作为采购组件无法通过重训练加以控制，因此只能对智能体与其作用系统之间的接口实施工程控制。义务兼具空间、时间和文本语义属性，且违规通常存在于多步交互的组合之中，逐事件的防护栏无法捕捉顺序工具攻击链。
AI.method: 提出多维度运行时验证框架：把自然语言政策条款分解为单一规范事件流上带类型的空间/时间/语义三元组；各维度用各自的监控规约检查；通过携带溯源信息的四值代数融合判定。空间维度在加权双排序位置图上解释，将任务几何与信息发布拓扑统一为同一对象；过去时维度在未经修改的MonPoly引擎上运行。
AI.result: 证明空间义务一般不被一阶时间规约所涵盖；MonPoly在每个时间点均与参考监视器一致。在伤亡后送与对抗保障两个任务域和一个民用域中，预防性阻断策略下的组合将攻击成功率降至零，未观察到假阳性，单事件代价为微秒级；而任一单一维度或任一对维度组合均留下相当比例的攻击成功。闭环实验中，政策无感的规划器在多数无防护任务中达到违规状态，在防护下则为零，且五分之四的被拒绝回合仍能恢复到合规结果。
AI.conclusion: 对已固定且不可重训练的政策代理而言，多维度组合的运行时验证是有效的工程控制点；维度组合的融合验证显著优于单维度或成对监控。

title: Communication-Aware Qubit Placement and Automatic Node-Count Allocation for Distributed State-Vector Simulation
summary: Distributed quantum circuit simulation enables the execution of large-scale quantum algorithms by partitioning qubits across multiple computational nodes. However, inefficient qubit placement frequently leads to excessive inter-node communication, severely limiting performance and scalability. This work introduces a communication-aware qubit layout optimization framework that systematically minimizes data exchange among nodes while dynamically selecting the optimal number of computational resources. Integrated into the QuCSLO library, our approach supports dynamic node scaling, OpenQASM parsing, and seamless integration with the QuEST simulator. Extensive evaluations on both synthetic benchmarks and real-world QASMBench circuits demonstrate that optimized layouts significantly reduce communication cuts and yield runtime speedups of over 2x compared to identity layouts, particularly in highly entangled circuits. Our results underscore the critical impact of strategic qubit placement on distributed simulation efficiency and provide a practical, resource-scalable solution for quantum workloads.

AI.tldr: 提出通信感知的量子比特布局优化框架，集成于QuCSLO，动态选择计算资源以最小化节点间通信，实现超2倍加速。
AI.motivation: 分布式量子电路仿真通过将量子比特划分到多个计算节点来执行大规模量子算法，但低效的量子比特放置常导致过多节点间通信，严重限制性能与可扩展性。
AI.method: 构建通信感知的量子比特布局优化框架，系统性地最小化节点间数据交换，同时动态选择最优计算资源数量；集成至QuCSLO库，支持动态节点扩展、OpenQASM解析，并与QuEST模拟器无缝集成。
AI.result: 在合成基准与真实QASMBench电路上评估，优化布局显著减少通信割（communication cuts），相比恒等布局在高度纠缠电路上实现超2倍运行时加速。
AI.conclusion: 战略性量子比特放置对分布式仿真效率具有关键影响，该工作为量子工作负载提供了实用且资源可扩展的解决方案。

title: Trajectory Planning without Trajectory Data: A Manifold-Guided Approach
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. Code can be found in https://github.com/SilongYong/Ariadne/
summary: A common way for trajectory planning is to leverage generative models trained on large collections of expert trajectories. At inference time, the model generates executable trajectories by conditioning on task goal constraints. However, trajectory-based methods rely on costly supervision, scale poorly with sequence length, and often generalize poorly to unseen constraints such as novel start-goal pairs. We propose an alternative to learn the underlying state-space manifold and use the geometry of the manifold for trajectory planning. This approach requires only state observations and enables generalization to unseen constraints by con- structing trajectories on the learned manifold of the state space. Experiments on Maze2D and robotic motion-planning benchmarks show that Ariadne constructs feasible paths from state-only supervision and generalizes to unseen start-goal combinations. On high-dimensional dual-arm planning, it remains competitive with trajectory-supervised and classical planners, while requiring no trajectory data for training.

AI.tldr: 论文提出Ariadne，通过学习状态空间流形并利用其几何进行轨迹规划，仅需状态观测即可泛化到未见约束。
AI.motivation: 传统轨迹规划依赖大规模专家轨迹训练生成模型，存在监督成本高、序列长度扩展性差、对新颖起终点等未见约束泛化差的问题。
AI.method: 学习状态空间底层流形，利用该流形几何构建轨迹，仅需状态观测进行训练。
AI.result: 在Maze2D与机器人运动规划基准上，Ariadne从纯状态监督构建可行路径并泛化到未见起终点组合；在高维双臂规划中与轨迹监督方法和经典规划器竞争，且无需轨迹数据训练。
AI.conclusion: 相比轨迹生成方法，基于流形几何的规划在监督需求和泛化性上具有优势。

title: Beyond the Sycophancy Score: How Task, Model, and Pressure Shape LLM Yielding
summary: Large language models (LLMs) often abandon a correct answer, or endorse a user's position, once the user pushes back. This behavior, called sycophancy, is usually reported as a single rate per model, which says little about when it happens or how a user can avoid it. We study the conditions that produce it with 103,939 graded replies from ten configurations: eight LLMs with reasoning disabled, and two of them again with maximum reasoning, all facing the same 200 items, 13 pressure conditions, and four-turn conversations, with every reply labeled by two independent LLM judges. We find that the dominant factors are how costly it is for the model to verify the user's claim, and whether a trained guardrail covers it. Removing this task factor from a logistic model costs 0.485 of McFadden $R^2$, against 0.139 for model family and 0.009 for pressure tactic. Anchored facts are almost never conceded (1.3%), while adoption on logic puzzles rises with the number of clues needed to refute the pushed answer. Personal choices are endorsed in 77.0% of conversations. Most concessions on hard items come from models that cannot reliably solve them; models that can solve them rarely give the answer up. For both models tested, maximum reasoning removes these concessions completely: adoption on deep puzzles falls from 19.2% and 12.5% to 0%. Fallacious or emotional framing adds nothing beyond plain repetition. Three human annotators agree with the judges' consensus on 118/120 calibration items. These results give practical rules for reliable use: simplify hard-to-verify problems and reason deeply, state the question rather than one's preferred answer, ask for evidence on open questions, and choose models by their measured guardrail profile.

AI.tldr: 该研究基于10种配置、20万条以上评分回复，发现大模型谄媚行为主要由"验证用户主张的成本"与"是否被训练护栏覆盖"决定，而非模型家族或施压话术；简化难验证问题、深度推理、以提问而非表态方式发问可有效规避。
AI.motivation: 既有文献多以单一比率报告"谄媚"（sycophancy），无法说明其触发条件及用户如何规避，因此本文系统考察其产生条件。
AI.method: 构建10种配置（8个模型关闭推理，其中2个再开启最大推理）×200道题×13种施压条件×四轮对话的实验，共103,939条评分回复，每条由两名独立LLM评审标注；用logistic回归做因子重要性分解（McFadden R²），并以3名人工标注者在120条校准题上验证评审一致性。
AI.result: 主导因子为验证用户主张的成本与被护栏覆盖，移除该任务因子使McFadden R²下降0.485，远高于模型家族的0.139和施压策略的0.009；有锚定事实几乎不被让步（1.3%），逻辑谜题上的采纳率随反驳所需线索数上升；个人选择在77.0%的对话中被认可；难题的让步多来自无法可靠解题的模型；对两个测试模型，最大推理将深度谜题采纳率从19.2%和12.5%降至0%；谬误或情绪化措辞相对单纯重复无额外效果；人工标注与评审共识在118/120条上一致。
AI.conclusion: 谄媚并非均匀的模型属性，而由任务验证成本与护栏覆盖决定。实用准则：简化难验证问题、深度推理、以提问而非偏好表态的方式提问、对开放问题索要证据，并按实测护栏特征选择模型。

title: One-Slide Calibration of Pathology Foundation Models
comment: Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop AI at Scale for Clinical Impact (ASCI): Cancer Pathology Foundation Models
summary: Scanner variation changes how pathology foundation models represent the same tissue. We introduce SlideRuler, which uses regions within a slide as internal controls to estimate and correct acquisition-induced shifts in other regions. A transfer map learned from paired rescans enables calibration from a single scan at inference while keeping the foundation model fixed. Across two encoders and five SCORPION scanners, learned transfer reduces mean target-to-source embedding distance by 16.3-38.5% relative to raw embeddings. Comparisons with unrelated same-scanner controls reveal a positive same-slide contribution across all four evaluation settings, including scanner holdout. A source-anchored variant reduces source-feature displacement by 47.7-83.6% relative to learned transfer while retaining most of its alignment gain. By drawing calibration information from the slide itself, SlideRuler offers a path toward more consistent use of frozen pathology models across imaging systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 SlideRuler，利用同一张切片内部区域作为内部控制，学习跨扫描仪的迁移映射，从而在保持病理基础模型冻结的前提下校正采集导致的嵌入偏移，提升跨扫描仪一致性。
AI.motivation: 扫描仪差异会使病理基础模型对同一组织的表示发生改变，导致冻结模型在不同成像系统间使用不一致；需要一种不重新训练基础模型的校准方法。
AI.method: 以切片内区域作为内部控制，从配对重扫数据中学习迁移映射；推理时仅凭单次扫描即可完成校准，同时保持基础模型参数固定。并设计源锚定变体以抑制源特征位移。
AI.result: 在两个编码器与五台 SCORPION 扫描仪上，学习迁移相较原始嵌入将平均目标到源嵌入距离降低 16.3–38.5%；与无关同扫描仪对照相比，四种评估设定（含扫描仪留出）均显示正向的同切片贡献。源锚定变体将源特征位移相对学习迁移降低 47.7–83.6%，同时保留大部分对齐增益。
AI.conclusion: 从切片自身提取校准信息，可有效缓解扫描仪引起的表示偏移，为冻结病理模型跨成像系统的一致使用提供可行路径。

title: Humanize: Judgement Engineering for Agentic Coding
summary:
Agentic coding makes code generation cheap, but reliable completion remains difficult: the agent that writes the code is a weak judge of whether it is done.
  We present Humanize, a multi-agent orchestration workflow for agentic coding built around judgement engineering: explicit, mechanically enforced decisions at the boundaries between planning, implementation, review, and learning. A human approves a plan contract, a builder agent implements it in rounds, and a reviewer agent from another vendor decides completion; deterministic hooks, not a model, route work between these roles and enforce 72 mechanical gates. Viewed as a Markov chain over repository states, alternating builder and reviewer samples jointly from two models, so a defect survives only if both miss it. We study Humanize through its deployment, 118 public postmortems of real loops, and its applications. Over 68 versions in 108 days, it gathered 1,468 GitHub stars.
  Applications include a 567-file gem5 build-system migration under upstream review; Kernel Design Agents, which extend the loop with a kernel knowledge base and profiling feedback and placed in the top three of all three Full-Agent tracks of the MLSys 2026 FlashInfer contest; and, through Humanize Olympiad Agents (HOA), full scores in IOI 2026, IMO 2026, IPhO 2026, and IBO 2024, 418.5/437 in IChO 2026 (gold-medal). Humanize also achieves 672/672 on PutnamBench and ranks first (251/303) on Lean-Eval's leaderboard even competiting with professional mathematicians. The postmortems show that independent review catches unsupported builder claims, but stopping remains a key weakness. In reports that separate rounds by phase, two thirds of rounds occurred after implementation was accepted. This evidence is observational, not a controlled comparison of workflows.

AI.tldr: Humanize 是一个面向智能体编码的多智能体编排工作流，通过"判断工程"在规划、实现、评审与学习各边界设置显式且机械强制的决策：人工批准计划契约，构建智能体分轮实现，来自不同厂商的评审智能体判定完成，由确定性钩子（而非模型）在角色间调度并执行 72 道机械门禁。
AI.motivation: 智能体编码使代码生成变得廉价，但可靠完成仍很困难：写代码的智能体本身就是"是否完成"的弱判断者。作者希望用跨厂商、跨模型的独立评审替代自评，以降低缺陷漏检概率。
AI.method: 将流程视为仓库状态上的马尔可夫链，构建者与评审者交替采样两个不同模型的联合分布，缺陷只有在两者都漏检时才能存活；同时以 72 个确定性钩子门禁与角色路由实现机械强制，避免模型自行决定流程。评估基于实际部署、118 份真实循环的公开复盘（postmortem）及应用案例。
AI.result: 108 天内迭代 68 个版本，获得 1,468 个 GitHub 星标。应用包括 567 文件的 gem5 构建系统迁移（处于上游评审中）、Kernel Design Agents（在 MLSys 2026 FlashInfer 竞赛三个 Full-Agent 赛道均进入前三）、HOA 在 IOI/IMO/IPhO 2026 与 IBO 2024 满分、IChO 2026 得 418.5/437（金牌）；PutnamBench 672/672，Lean-Eval 排行榜第一（251/303）。复盘显示独立评审能捕获构建者未经支持的声明，但"停止"仍是主要弱点：按阶段分轮的报告中，三分之二的轮次发生在实现已被接受之后。
AI.conclusion: 多智能体独立评审配合机械门禁可有效抑制构建者的虚假完成声明，但终止判定（何时停止）仍是关键薄弱环节；且现有证据为观察性部署数据，并非受控的工作流对比实验。

title: The Cost of Long Memory: State, Context, and Stability Complexity in Sequence Models
summary: Long-range temporal dependence poses a resource question for sequence models: for a specified predictive-memory law, how much state, context, or dynamical criticality is required in order to forecast accurately? We study this question directly in forecasting risk. For algebraically decaying predictive memory, we prove matching upper and lower approximation bounds for exponential and finite-state modes. The best $r$-mode forecast error decays as $e^{-Θ(\sqrt r)}$, so reaching forecast error $τ$ needs $r=Θ(\log^2(1/τ))$ states or modes. Earlier curse-of-memory results establish broad limitations of stable recurrent models under different approximation notions; here both sides match for one canonical predictive target in forecast risk, which fixes the optimal resource exponent for that target. We then show that genuine fractional long memory changes the geometry itself. In particular, forecast error is measured after fractional integration, prediction from a finite context of length $L$ has an exact $1/L$ leading order, and a fixed fractional strength $d$ keeps the square-log state-complexity law. Near the short-memory boundary, we identify the relevant $d^2$ and $d^4$ scales and give a uniform constructive law in the intermediate regime. For nonlinear contextual recurrences with uniformly contractive state dynamics, we derive an exponential first-chaos envelope and an explicit necessary condition that relates forecast accuracy to the contraction margin. Vanishing forecasting error on an algebraic target forces the recurrence quantitatively toward criticality, a condition that is necessary and not by itself sufficient. Finite-sample Kullback--Leibler calculations further connect the predictive geometry to statistical information. Theorem-matched experiments with contractive state-space, gated recurrent, and attention models reproduce the state and stability predictions.

AI.tldr: 本文研究长程时间依赖对序列模型的资源需求，针对代数衰减预测记忆给出指数模式与有限状态模式的匹配上下界，并分析分数阶长记忆、非线性收缩递推与临界性、以及有限样本KL信息联系。
AI.motivation: 长程时间依赖对序列模型构成资源问题：给定预测记忆律，需要多少状态、上下文或动力学临界性才能准确预测？作者希望在预测风险框架下直接刻画这一资源-精度权衡，并为特定典型目标确定最优资源指数。
AI.method: 对代数衰减预测记忆，证明指数模式与有限状态模式的匹配上下逼近界；分析分数阶长记忆下分数积分后的预测误差、长度L有限上下文的1/L主导阶、固定分数强度d的平方对数状态复杂度律，以及短记忆边界的d^2、d^4尺度与中间区间的统一构造律；对均匀收缩状态的非线性上下文递推推导指数首次混沌包络与收缩裕度必要条件；进行有限样本KL计算；并用收缩状态空间、门控循环和注意力模型做定理匹配实验。
AI.result: 最佳r模式预测误差按e^{-Θ(√r)}衰减，达到误差τ需r=Θ(log^2(1/τ))个状态或模式，从而固定该目标的最优资源指数；分数长记忆改变几何结构，有限上下文预测误差有精确1/L主导阶，固定d保持平方对数状态复杂度律，近短记忆边界出现d^2与d^4尺度；非线性收缩递推中代数目标上预测误差消失会定量迫使递推趋于临界性，该条件必要但不充分；实验复现了状态与稳定性预测。
AI.conclusion: 论文为代数衰减预测记忆下的预测风险建立了状态-精度匹配界并确定最优资源指数，揭示分数长记忆改变预测几何并给出统一构造律；同时将非线性收缩递推的预测精度与收缩裕度、临界性必要条件及统计信息联系起来，实验验证了理论预测。

title: ASPIRE: Agentic Safety & Prompt Injection Red-teaming Engine
summary: LLM agents retrieve untrusted content and act through tools, creating indirect prompt-injection risks that can cause unauthorized actions or persistent state changes. Existing automated red-teaming largely optimizes payloads for pre-specified scenarios, leaving latent vulnerabilities across the agent's behavior space unexplored. We present ASPIRE, an Agentic Safety & Prompt Injection Red-teaming Engine for open-ended, behavior-level vulnerability discovery. ASPIRE maintains an evolving Agent Security Behavior Graph and uses complementary Explore and Exploit experts to discover, verify, and generalize consequence-centric tests. Trajectory evidence updates the graph and diagnoses partial or failed attempts, while cross-run memory transfers useful red-team strategies. Experiments on various benchmarks show that ASPIRE substantially expands coverage across consequences, injection methods, environments, and behavior paths while maintaining strong attack success.

AI.tldr: 提出 ASPIRE 红队引擎，通过构建并演化 Agent 安全行为图，结合探索与利用专家策略，实现开放式、行为级的间接提示注入漏洞发现。
AI.motivation: LLM 智能体在检索不可信内容并经工具执行动作时，面临间接提示注入风险，可能导致未授权操作或持久状态变更。现有自动化红队方法多针对预设场景优化载荷，难以覆盖智能体行为空间中的潜在漏洞。
AI.method: ASPIRE 维护一个持续演化的 Agent 安全行为图（Agent Security Behavior Graph），利用互补的探索（Explore）与利用（Exploit）专家模块发现、验证并泛化以后果为中心的测试用例；借助轨迹证据更新图结构并诊断部分成功或失败的尝试，同时通过跨轮记忆迁移有效的红队策略。
AI.result: 在多个基准测试上，ASPIRE 显著扩展了在后果类型、注入方法、环境与行为路径上的覆盖范围，同时保持较高的攻击成功率。
AI.conclusion: 以行为图为核心、结合探索—利用协同与跨轮记忆的开放式红队框架，可有效揭示 LLM 智能体的潜在注入漏洞，提升行为空间覆盖并维持攻击有效性。

title: Rendezvous under Variable Disorientation:The Algorithmic Power of Fixed Unit Distance
summary:
We study deterministic Rendezvous of two robots with lights under weak geometric and synchronization assumptions. Our focus is on Variable Disorientation (VD), where each robot may arbitrarily rotate, reflect, and rescale its local coordinate system at every \Look, and on VD+Fixed-Unit-Distance (FUD), where each robot's local unit distance remains fixed. We consider the one-sided visibility models FSTA and FCOM, and schedulers ranging from the energy-restricted RSYNCH and R-RSYNCH to fully asynchronous executions.
  Under VD, we prove color-independent impossibility results for FSTA under SSYNCH and for FCOM under ASYNCH, and establish sharp two-color boundaries under RSYNCH and R-RSYNCH. Under VD+FUD, we introduce periodic distance classes, which turn multiplicative changes of the physical distance into predictable cyclic phase shifts. This technique yields a two-color self-stabilizing non-$L$-Rendezvous algorithm for both FSTA and FCOM under RSYNCH and R-RSYNCH even with Non-Rigid movement.
  Under Rigid movement, periodic distance classes further yield an optimal three-color non-quasi-self-stabilizing algorithm for FSTA under SSYNCH, a four-color FSTA algorithm under $M$-atomic ASYNCH, and a four-color FCOM algorithm under CM-atomic ASYNCH. By guarding the latter phase mechanism with two additional colors and replacing its initial swap by passive initialization, we obtain a six-color FCOM algorithm under full ASYNCH, improving the previous twelve-color upper bound by a factor of two.
  These results show that a fixed local metric can serve as persistent cyclic memory, and clarify how metric stability, one-sided visibility, and scheduler atomicity jointly determine Rendezvous solvability and color complexity.

AI.tldr: 研究弱几何与同步假设下带灯机器人的确定性Rendezvous问题，围绕VD与VD+FUD两类朝向模型，在FSTA/FCOM可见性与从RSYNCH到完全异步的调度器下，给出不可能性、紧致双色边界及多色算法，并借助"周期距离类"把固定局部度量当作持久循环记忆，将全异步FCOM上界从12色降到6色。
AI.motivation: 带灯机器人的Rendezvous通常依赖较强假设（固定朝向/单位距离、刚性运动、较同步的调度器）。本文希望在更弱、更现实的假设下（可变失向VD，以及VD下单位距离固定FUD），单侧可见性FSTA/FCOM，以及从能量受限RSYNCH、R-RSYNCH到完全异步的多种调度器）厘清Rendezvous的可解性与颜色复杂度究竟由哪些因素决定。
AI.method: 在VD下用对抗性/构型论证证明不可能性与颜色边界；在VD+FUD下提出"周期距离类"技术，把物理距离的乘性变化转化为可预测的循环相位移动，并据此设计自稳定/非准自稳定算法；对刚性运动进一步利用该相位机制，辅以两色守卫与被动初始化替代初始交换。
AI.result: VD下：证明FSTA（SSYNCH）与FCOM（ASYNCH）的颜色无关不可能性，并在RSYNCH、R-RSYNCH下给出紧致双色边界。VD+FUD下：周期距离类给出FSTA/FCOM在RSYNCH、R-RSYNCH下（含非刚性运动）的双色自稳定非L-Rendezvous算法。刚性运动下：得到FSTA（SSYNCH）最优三色非准自稳定算法、FSTA（M-atomic ASYNCH）四色算法、FCOM（CM-atomic ASYNCH）四色算法；经两色守卫与被动初始化，得到全异步FCOM六色算法，将先前十二色上界减半。
AI.conclusion: 固定局部度量可作为持久循环记忆使用；Rendezvous的可解性与颜色复杂度由度量稳定性、单侧可见性和调度器原子性三者共同决定。

title: From Wearable Interfaces to Dexterous Policies: Contact Shifts and Tactile Representations
summary: Unlike conventional teleoperation, wearable interfaces allow operators to collect dexterous demonstrations through their own hand motions while directly interacting with task objects. This direct interaction reduces dependence on the target robot during collection, but it also makes the collection hardware part of the physical process that generates each demonstration. Interface geometry can influence both how a task is performed and what tactile observations are recorded for learning. We study two versions of a DexUMI-family exoskeleton that share the same robot command definition, mapping procedure, and tactile module type but differ in hand-side geometry. The revised interface reduces reported physical demand, improves selected device ratings, enables tactile access in a precision grasp that is mechanically blocked by the baseline, and produces task-dependent changes in recorded contact. Lid twisting primarily exhibits a change in contact location, whereas egg carton opening primarily exhibits a change in contact occurrence. We then train matched policies using either a binary aggregate input or a spatial-plus-force input. On lid twisting and egg carton opening, policies trained on revised-interface demonstrations achieve higher success than those trained on baseline demonstrations, with a significant pooled interface effect. Across these and two additional tasks, USB insertion and soldering tool pick and place, the spatial-plus-force input likewise outperforms binary aggregation. These results show that wearable collection hardware is part of the data-generation process for robot learning. Such interfaces should therefore be evaluated not only through operator experience, but also through the tactile interactions they make recordable and the policy performance their demonstrations support.

AI.tldr: 可穿戴示范采集外骨骼的手部几何会影响触觉数据的可记录性与下游策略性能，采集硬件应被视为机器人学习数据生成过程的组成部分。
AI.motivation: 可穿戴接口让操作者用自身手部动作采集灵巧示范并直接与任务对象交互，从而降低采集阶段对目标机器人的依赖；但这也使采集硬件成为生成每条示范的物理过程中的一环。接口几何可能同时影响任务执行方式与所记录的触觉观测，这一影响此前缺少系统评估。
AI.method: 研究同一 DexUMI 系列外骨骼的两个版本，二者共享相同的机器人指令定义、映射流程与触觉模块类型，仅手部几何不同。对比两种接口在物理负荷报告、设备评分、精密抓取中的触觉可达性以及接触记录上的差异；随后用二值聚合输入或空间+力输入分别训练匹配策略，在四个任务（开瓶盖、开蛋盒、USB 插入、焊接工具抓取放置）上比较。
AI.result: 改进版接口降低了报告的物理负荷、提升了部分设备评分，并在基线被机械阻挡的精密抓取中实现触觉可达，且带来任务相关的接触变化：开瓶盖主要表现为接触位置变化，开蛋盒主要表现为接触是否发生的变化。在开瓶盖与开蛋盒任务上，基于改进版示范训练的策略成功率高于基于基线示范的策略，存在显著的接口汇总效应；在四个任务上，空间+力输入均优于二值聚合输入。
AI.conclusion: 可穿戴采集硬件是机器人学习数据生成过程的一部分，其设计会决定哪些触觉交互可被记录、以及示范能支撑怎样的策略性能；因此这类接口的评估不应只看操作者体验，还应考察其所使能记录的触觉交互及下游策略表现。

title: Beyond Risk Prediction: Evidence Grounding and Psychosocial Factor Verification for Explainable Suicide Risk Assessment
comment: 8 pages, 1 figure, 4 tables. Accepted at the 2nd Workshop on Mental Health Disorder Detection on Social Media (MHSM 2026), held in conjunction with IEEE ICDM 2026
summary: Identifying suicide risk from social networking services (SNS) posts is important for detecting suicide-related signals in online environments. However, risk classification alone provides limited insight into the textual evidence and psychosocial factors behind a prediction. Based on the IEEE BigData 2026 Explainable Suicide Risk Detection Challenge, this study presents a framework consisting of Risk Assessment, Evidence Grounding, and Factor Identification. Risk Assessment uses length-based routing to accommodate posts of different lengths. Evidence Grounding identifies supporting phrases and uses a Risk-Evidence constraint to maintain consistency with the Risk prediction. For Factor Identification, two verifiers are used. The Taxonomy Verifier focuses on factor semantics, whereas the Evidence-Aware Verifier uses factor-specific lexical-semantic cues to select informative positive training units. Their prediction probabilities are combined to produce the final factor predictions. The three tasks are evaluated using task-specific F1 score measures. Risk Assessment achieved a Weighted F1 of 0.8088, Evidence Grounding achieved a test Macro row F1 of 0.7605, and Factor Identification achieved a Macro F1 of 0.5562. The results show that the framework can provide risk predictions, along with supporting textual evidence and fine-grained information on psychosocial factors. Overall, the proposed framework extends suicide-risk assessment beyond risk-level prediction and provides a more interpretable analysis of SNS posts.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出一个由风险评估、证据定位和心理社会因素识别三部分组成的框架，用于SNS帖子的可解释自杀风险检测。
AI.motivation: 仅做风险分类无法揭示预测背后的文本证据与心理社会因素，可解释性不足。
AI.method: 风险评估采用基于长度的路由以适配不同长度帖子；证据定位识别支持性片段并施加"风险-证据"约束以保持与风险预测一致；因素识别使用两个验证器（分类学验证器关注因素语义，证据感知验证器利用因素特定的词汇-语义线索筛选高信息量正训练单元），二者预测概率结合得到最终因素预测。
AI.result: 风险评估Weighted F1为0.8088，证据定位测试Macro行F1为0.7605，因素识别Macro F1为0.5562。
AI.conclusion: 框架可同时提供风险预测、支持性文本证据及细粒度心理社会因素信息，将自杀风险评估从风险等级预测拓展为更具可解释性的SNS帖子分析。

title: RACER: Reflective Agent Coupling Query Interpretation and Tool-Based Retrieval for Frame Selection in Long Video Understanding
summary: Video large language models (Vid-LLMs) excel at diverse video-language tasks by reasoning over selected frames. However, frame selection for long videos remains challenging, as it requires retrieving relevant frames distributed across segments from a large candidate pool given complex queries. This paper investigates dominant approaches to long-video frame selection from a task-decomposition perspective, identifying two key challenges: the Query Comprehension Gap in similarity-based methods and the Interpretation--Selection Gap in judgment-based methods. To address them, we propose RACER, a training-free reflective agentic framework that decomposes long-video frame selection into query interpretation driven by a lightweight Vid-LLM and evidence localization supported by an embedding model serving as a retrieval tool. Specifically, the Vid-LLM is responsible solely for reformulating the complex query into sub-queries that make implicit information requirements explicit, mitigating the Query Comprehension Gap. Meanwhile, the retrieval tool leverages these sub-queries to localize relevant evidence, relieving the Vid-LLM of direct frame selection and thus addressing the Interpretation--Selection Gap. Finally, the retrieved frames are fed back to the Vid-LLM for sub-query refinement, forming a reflection loop that iteratively improves query interpretation and frame selection. Experiments across multiple benchmarks show that RACER consistently improves long video understanding. Notably, RACER achieves effective frame selection even with limited-capability components, demonstrating that agentic integration enables these components to enhance more capable Vid-LLMs.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练反思式智能体框架RACER，将长视频帧选择分解为查询理解与证据定位两步，缓解两类鸿沟并提升长视频理解。
AI.motivation: Vid-LLM依赖选取的关键帧进行视频语言推理，但长视频帧选择困难：需在庞大候选池中跨片段检索与复杂查询相关的帧。现有两类主导方法各有缺陷——基于相似度的方法存在"查询理解鸿沟"，基于判断的方法存在"解释—选择鸿沟"。
AI.method: RACER将长视频帧选择分解为查询解释与证据定位：轻量Vid-LLM只负责把复杂查询改写成显式化的子查询，以缓解查询理解鸿沟；嵌入模型作为检索工具，利用子查询定位相关证据，使Vid-LLM不必直接选帧，从而缓解解释—选择鸿沟。检索到的帧再回馈给Vid-LLM进行子查询精炼，形成反思循环，迭代改进查询解释与帧选择。整个框架免训练。
AI.result: 在多个基准上，RACER持续提升长视频理解性能。值得注意的是，即便使用能力有限的组件，RACER仍能实现有效的帧选择，表明智能体式集成能让这些组件增强更强的Vid-LLM。
AI.conclusion: 从任务分解视角切入，用免训练的反思式智能体框架分离"查询理解"与"证据定位"职责，是缓解长视频帧选择瓶颈的有效路径，并具备良好的组件兼容性与可扩展性。

title: Sequential Probabilistic Uncertainty Estimation for Parallel Multi-Agent Reasoning Systems
summary: LLM-based multi-agent systems (MAS) have attracted growing attention for improving reasoning through interaction among multiple agents. In this work, we focus on parallel multi-agent reasoning systems, where several agents solve the same problem over multiple rounds and aggregate their outputs into a final answer. Despite their strong reasoning performance, uncertainty estimation for such systems remains underexplored: the reliability of a MAS depends not only on individual generations, but also on how agents interact and evolve across rounds. We propose SAUCE (Sequential Agent Uncertainty through Consensus Evolution), a lightweight, training-free uncertainty estimator that formulates MAS uncertainty as sequential inference over a latent system-level belief. SAUCE aggregates round-level agreement and generation-uncertainty signals through a filtering-style update. Across five backbones, five benchmarks, and two MAS protocols, SAUCE improves misclassification detection, selective prediction, and calibration over a broad set of uncertainty estimation baselines, including standard log-likelihood-based methods and MAS-specific estimators.

AI.tldr: 提出 SAUCE：一种轻量、免训练的不确定性估计方法，将并行多智能体推理系统的不确定性建模为潜在系统级置信的序列推断，通过滤波式更新聚合各轮的共识与生成不确定性信号。
AI.motivation: 基于LLM的多智能体系统（MAS）通过多智能体交互提升推理能力，但此类系统的不确定性估计研究不足；其可靠性不仅取决于单个智能体的生成，还取决于智能体在多轮交互中的演化方式。
AI.method: 聚焦并行多智能体推理系统（多智能体多轮求解同一问题并聚合输出）。提出 SAUCE（Sequential Agent Uncertainty through Consensus Evolution），将MAS不确定性形式化为对潜在系统级置信的序列推断，采用滤波式更新（filtering-style update）聚合轮级一致性与生成不确定性信号。方法轻量且免训练。
AI.result: 在5种骨干模型、5个基准和2种MAS协议上，SAUCE在误分类检测、选择性预测和校准方面均优于多种不确定性估计基线，包括标准对数似然方法及MAS专用估计器。
AI.conclusion: 将MAS不确定性建模为跨轮共识演化的序列推断是有效且通用的，SAUCE为多智能体推理系统提供了可靠、免训练的不确定性量化方案。

title: DenoFlow: Flow Matching for SSVEP Denoising under Real Physiological Artifacts
summary: Electroencephalography (EEG)-based brain-computer interfaces (BCIs), particularly steady-state visual evoked potential (SSVEP) systems, are highly vulnerable to noise and artifacts, which severely degrade decoding accuracy. Although recent denoising approaches have shown promise, they are fitted without paired ground truth, can settle on reproducing their input, and are optimized on waveform distance alone, which says nothing about whether the output stays decodable. To address these issues, we propose DenoFlow, which casts SSVEP denoising as transport: instead of learning a direct map from a contaminated trial to a clean one, a field network regresses the velocity of the straight path between them, following the rectified-flow formulation, and denoising integrates that field forward from the observation. The field network is an encoder-decoder that sees the contaminated trial at every layer and the path position at its bottleneck, and a classifier trained alongside it supervises the integrated output. Because the observation itself is both the conditioning input and the starting point of the integration, the model never generates a trial from noise, and training reduces to regression, removing the adversarial min-max game. To obtain paired data on datasets with no ground truth, we injected physiological artifacts of the recorded electromyography (EMG) and electrooculography (EOG) signals under a controlled signal-to-noise target. Experiments on two public SSVEP datasets with five popular SSVEP decoders showed that DenoFlow outperformed seven baseline denoising models on both signal fidelity and downstream decoding accuracy. Code is available at https://github.com/wzwvv/DenoFlow.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 DenoFlow，将 SSVEP 去噪建模为"传输"过程：用整流流（rectified-flow）场网络回归含噪试次与干净试次之间直线路径的速度场，并从观测出发前向积分完成去噪；同时用分类器监督积分输出。在无配对真值的数据集上注入 EMG/EOG 生理伪迹构造配对数据，实验表明其在信号保真度与下游解码准确率上均优于七个基线模型。
AI.motivation: 基于 EEG 的 SSVEP 脑机接口极易受噪声与伪迹影响，解码精度严重下降。现有去噪方法存在三点缺陷：缺乏配对真值导致训练无监督、可能退化为简单复制输入、且仅以波形距离为优化目标，无法保证输出仍可被解码。
AI.method: 将 SSVEP 去噪形式化为传输问题：不直接学习从污染试次到干净试次的映射，而是用场网络回归二者之间直线路径的速度，遵循整流流（rectified flow）公式，去噪时从观测点前向积分该速度场。场网络为编码器-解码器结构，每一层都能看到污染试次，瓶颈处接收路径位置信息；同时并联训练一个分类器对积分输出进行监督。由于观测本身既是条件输入又是积分起点，模型不会从纯噪声生成试次，训练退化为回归问题，避免了对抗式 min-max 博弈。为在无真值数据集上获得配对数据，按受控信噪比注入所记录的 EMG 与 EOG 生理伪迹。
AI.result: 在两个公开 SSVEP 数据集上、使用五种主流 SSVEP 解码器进行实验，DenoFlow 在信号保真度与下游解码准确率两个指标上均优于七个基线去噪模型。代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: DenoFlow 通过整流流式传输框架结合分类器监督，规避了配对真值缺失、复制输入退化与目标单一的问题，为 SSVEP 去噪提供了数据高效、训练稳定且可保持下游可解码性的方案，并在多数据集、多解码器设置下验证了其优越性。

title: TwinGuard-Lite: A Rule-Based State-Admission Gateway for Generative Patient Digital Twins
comment: 6 pages, 2 figures, 1 table. Accepted to HealthSec'26 (Cybersecurity in Healthcare), co-located with ACSAC 2026
summary: Future generative patient digital twins may combine longitudinal health records with language-model agents and keep information across sessions. The wording of a proposed update does not reveal whether it comes from an allowed source, conflicts with the patient's record, or belongs to someone else. We present TwinGuard-Lite, a rule-based gateway that admits an update to a twin's persistent state only if it passes checkable approximations of two integrity properties. Grounded state consistency (GSC) is approximated by a provenance check and a contradiction check; cross-patient noninterference (CPN) is approximated by a namespace check against trusted transport metadata.
