We evaluate three attack families over 20 seeded person-level splits of a semi-synthetic stream built from the openly licensed eICU database demo, with 29,131 $\pm$ 2706 candidate updates per seed. A keyword filter and an anomaly detector detect 16% and 24% of attacks, respectively; a provenance-only ablation detects 59.9% but misses every cross-patient attack. Combining GSC and CPN yields 99.1% precision, 90.5% recall, a 94.6% F1 score, and a 0.033% false-positive rate. Every attack the full gateway admits falsely claims a trusted source; when the retrieval channel does so, 92.9% of retrieval attacks are admitted. The results hold under stated trust assumptions, and no language model, agent, or retriever is executed: TwinGuard-Lite is a mechanism-level proof of concept that motivates authenticated, patient-bound ingestion, not a clinical safeguard.

AI.tldr: TwinGuard-Lite是一种基于规则的网关机制，通过可检验的“接地状态一致性(GSC)”和“跨患者非干扰(CPN)”两个完整性属性的近似检查，仅允许通过校验的更新写入数字孪生持久状态，在eICU半合成数据上实现99.1%精度、90.5%召回与0.033%假阳性率。
AI.motivation: 未来生成式患者数字孪生可能结合纵向健康记录与语言模型智能体并跨会话保留信息。更新文本的措辞本身无法揭示其是否来自可信来源、是否与患者记录冲突、或是否属于他人，因此需要一种在持久化之前进行可检验校验的机制。
AI.method: 提出TwinGuard-Lite规则式网关：(1) 用溯源检查与矛盾检查近似GSC；(2) 用基于可信传输元数据的命名空间检查近似CPN。仅在更新通过两项检查时才允许写入孪生持久状态。评估在公开许可的eICU数据库demo构建的半合成流上进行，采用20个带种子的个体级划分，每个种子约29,131±2706条候选更新，覆盖三类攻击族。方法不执行任何语言模型、智能体或检索器。
AI.result: 关键词过滤器与异常检测器分别仅检出16%和24%的攻击；仅溯源消融检出59.9%但漏掉全部跨患者攻击。GSC与CPN结合达到99.1%精度、90.5%召回、94.6% F1、0.033%假阳性率。完整网关误放行的攻击均谎称可信来源；当检索通道谎称可信来源时，92.9%的检索攻击被放行。
AI.conclusion: 结果在所述信任假设下成立，TwinGuard-Lite是机制层面的概念验证，说明需要认证的、绑定患者的摄入流程，而非临床安全防护措施。

title: HPC-MQBench: Qualification-First Benchmarking on Slurm with a Single-Broker Kafka Evaluation
summary: Messaging experiments on high-performance computing clusters must coordinate services, clients, and measurement within scheduler allocations. We present HPC-MQBench, a Slurm-orchestrated benchmark that links resumable experiment control to record checks, delivery accounting, and qualification before rate ranking. Its Kafka evaluation placed producers/controller, one broker, consumers, and monitoring on four nodes. With memory-backed logs, 120 workload configurations yielded 99 qualified observations, 14 outside the producer-delivery policy, and seven with invalid evidence. Two validation stages each repeated ten workloads in five blocks. In the final stage, the selected workload qualified in all five observations, with medians of 2,927 mebibytes per second balanced endpoint rate, 1.24 percent pending deliveries, and 2.56 seconds for the 99th-percentile latency. It qualified in only two observations in the earlier stage, where qualification improved after an allocation boundary without establishing a causal allocation effect. Selection is conditional on the stage and delivery policy. Resource measurements did not isolate a unique bottleneck. The contribution is a framework for distributed experiment control and auditable configuration selection at a fixed broker count; multi-broker support and scaling experiments remain future work.

AI.tldr: HPC-MQBench 是一个基于 Slurm 编排的高性能计算消息基准框架，将可恢复实验控制与记录校验、投递记账及资格判定相链接，在固定单 broker 的四节点 Kafka 部署上完成 120 组配置评估，最终选定工作负载在 5 次观测中全部合格。
AI.motivation: 高性能计算集群上的消息实验需要在调度器分配范围内协调服务、客户端与测量，且需要可恢复的实验控制与可审计的配置选择机制；现有方法缺乏将实验控制、证据有效性校验与投递策略合规性统一起来的选择框架。
AI.method: 提出 HPC-MQBench，由 Slurm 编排，将可恢复实验控制与记录检查、投递记账、资格判定相链接，且在速率排序之前先做资格筛选。Kafka 评估将生产者/控制器、单个 broker、消费者与监控部署在四个节点上，使用内存后端日志。共运行 120 组工作负载配置，得到 99 个合格观测、14 个超出生产者投递策略、7 个证据无效。验证分两阶段，每阶段在五个块中各重复十个工作负载。
AI.result: 最终阶段中，选定工作负载在全部 5 次观测中均合格，中位数指标为：端点均衡速率 2,927 MiB/s、待投递比例 1.24%、99 百分位延迟 2.56 秒。较早阶段该工作负载仅在 2 次观测中合格；合格率在一次分配边界之后改善，但未建立因果性的分配效应。选择结果依赖于阶段与投递策略。
AI.conclusion: 该工作的贡献在于一个固定 broker 数量条件下的分布式实验控制与可审计配置选择框架；资源测量未能隔离出唯一瓶颈。多 broker 支持与扩展性实验留作未来工作。

title: Toward Evidence-Driven Human-Agent-Robot Teaming for Earth-Independent Anomaly Triage
comment: Accepted to the Space Robotics Workshop at 2026 IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS)
summary: Deep-space crews cannot rely on real-time ground support for urgent off-nominal events. Initial alerts may underdetermine cause, while discriminating evidence may reside in crew observations or at locations that are unsafe, costly, or unavailable for crew inspection. We present an evidence-driven architecture for human-agent-robot teaming in Earth-independent anomaly triage. Agentic AI is treated as a stateful coordinator over bounded, inspectable services rather than as a fully autonomous vehicle controller. A triage state manager maintains hypotheses, evidence provenance, uncertainty, operational context, and tool status; a crew-facing embodied agent elicits observations and explains assessment changes; and a mobile robot acquires targeted, localized evidence. Typed interfaces separate dialogue and orchestration from monitoring, robot command, context retrieval, and safety-critical control. Two scenarios illustrate the architecture: a crewed deep-space mission based on an actual ISS ammonia false alarm, where suspected contamination restricts crew access, and a power-interface anomaly at a crewed lunar base, where robotic inspection distinguishes a local connector fault from other causes ambiguous in remote telemetry. Our main contribution is an authority-bounded closed evidence-loop architecture, exercised in a hardware-in-the-loop integration prototype using Reachy Mini and an Innate MARS mobile robot.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种面向深空自主异常分诊的“人在环中”证据驱动型人-智能体-机器人协同架构，将智能体式AI定位为状态化的协调者而非全自主控制器，并通过硬件在环原型验证。
AI.motivation: 深空乘组无法依赖地面实时支持应对紧急异常事件。初始告警往往不足以确定根因，而关键判别性证据可能存在于乘组观察中，或位于不安全、成本高昂、乘组无法触及的位置。因此需要一种能在无地面支持条件下进行异常分诊的自主协同架构。
AI.method: 提出“权限受限的闭环证据回路”架构：智能体式AI作为对受限、可审查服务进行编排的状态化协调者，而非全自主载具控制器。核心组件包括：分诊状态管理器（维护假设、证据溯源、不确定性、运行上下文与工具状态）、面向乘组的具身智能体（引导观察并解释评估变化）、移动机器人（定向获取局部证据）。采用类型化接口将对话与编排同监控、机器人指令、上下文检索及安全关键控制相分离。
AI.result: 通过两个场景进行说明：(1) 基于真实国际空间站氨气误报的载人深空任务场景，疑似污染限制乘组接近；(2) 载人月球基地的电源接口异常场景，机器人巡检可区分局部连接器故障与远程遥测中模糊的其他成因。采用Reachy Mini与Innate MARS移动机器人完成硬件在环集成原型验证。
AI.conclusion: 主要贡献为面向权限受限场景的闭环证据回路架构，并通过人-智能体-机器人硬件在环集成原型对架构进行了实证性验证。

title: QuanLing: Cross-Branch Validation of Language Distance Quantification on Western Romance
summary: Quantifying language distance among closely related languages remains a core challenge in quantitative linguistics. Our previous work [1] introduced QuanLing (Quantitative Linguistics via Pretrained Language Models), a quantitative framework combining language distance metrics (sentence embedding distance, tokenization fragmentation rate) with language property analysis (MLM prediction probability), validated on North Germanic (Danish, Norwegian Bokmål, Swedish). This paper extends QuanLing to Western Romance--French, Portuguese, Spanish, Italian--testing cross-branch applicability with the same metric family and aggregation protocol as our North Germanic study, adapted for four languages (English anchor, quadruplet construction). Using 150 four-language parallel sentences, we compute LaBSE sentence embedding distances, tokenization fragmentation rates from four monolingual BERT tokenizers, and mBERT masked language model mutual intelligibility. Results show that Portuguese--Spanish are closest (LaBSE distance 0.0229), French--Italian most distant (0.0338); LaBSE and mBERT rankings agree on 4 of 6 pairs, confirming cross-model robustness. Western Romance shows a wider absolute distance span than North Germanic (0.011 vs. 0.008) but comparable relative ratios (1.48 vs. 1.67), consistent with longer divergence time. French exhibits notably higher MLM predictability (36.12% top-1 accuracy vs. 29.28% for Italian), reflecting its orthography--phonology decoupling. This cross-branch validation provides further evidence for QuanLing's generalizability beyond a single language branch.

AI.tldr: 本文将QuanLing定量框架从北日耳曼语支扩展到西罗曼语支（法、葡、西、意），用LaBSE句向量距离、分词碎片率与mBERT遮蔽词预测验证跨语支适用性，结果与北日耳曼研究一致。
AI.motivation: 量化近缘语言间的语言距离仍是计量语言学的核心难题。作者此前提出的QuanLing框架仅在单一语支（北日耳曼）上得到验证，其跨语支的普适性尚不明确，因此需要在另一语支上以相同度量族与聚合协议进行检验。
AI.method: 沿用QuanLing框架，以英语为锚点构建四语平行句组（quadruplet），使用150组四语平行句，计算三类指标：LaBSE句嵌入距离、四种单语BERT分词器的分词碎片率、mBERT遮蔽语言模型的互懂度（top-1准确率）。选取西罗曼语支的法语、葡萄牙语、西班牙语、意大利语，并与其北日耳曼研究结果（丹麦语、挪威博克马尔语、瑞典语）做对照。
AI.result: 葡萄牙语—西班牙语最接近（LaBSE距离0.0229），法语—意大利语最远（0.0338）；LaBSE与mBERT在6对语言中有4对排序一致，显示跨模型稳健性。西罗曼语支绝对距离跨度大于北日耳曼语支（0.011 vs. 0.008），但相对比值相近（1.48 vs. 1.67），与更长的分化时间相符。法语MLM可预测性明显更高（top-1准确率36.12%，意大利语为29.28%），反映其正字法—音系解耦特征。
AI.conclusion: 跨语支验证进一步支持QuanLing框架不局限于单一语支，具备一定普适性；同时表明绝对距离跨度受语支分化时间影响，而相对比值更为稳定。

title: S2Tok: Streaming 3D Gaussian Reconstruction with Persistent Spatial Tokens
summary: Streaming 3D reconstruction requires more than a sequence of geometric predictions: it requires a persistent scene state that can incorporate new evidence and remain renderable as observations arrive. Latent spatial tokens offer a promising representation for this purpose, but constructing them from an image collection leaves open how to maintain them online, where each observation may both revisit known regions and reveal new content. We introduce S2Tok, a feed-forward framework that maintains a size-adaptive, persistent scene state from uncalibrated image streams. Its central idea is to distinguish updates to the existing representation from selective expansion. A spatially informed transformer integrates each incoming observation with the persistent scene tokens, while a learned admission module selectively expands the representation to limit redundant storage. A hierarchical decoder and Gaussian head convert the evolving state into non-pixel-aligned 3D Gaussians, enabling novel-view rendering without caching previous frames. Experiments across four benchmarks demonstrate competitive streaming rendering quality with compact Gaussian representations. These results support latent spatial tokens as a persistent computational state for online 3D reconstruction, combining learned scene updates with explicit Gaussian rendering.

AI.tldr: S2Tok 是一个面向非标定图像流的前馈式在线三维重建框架，用尺寸自适应的持久化隐空间 token 场景状态统一"更新"与"扩展"，并通过层级解码器与高斯头输出非像素对齐三维高斯以支持新视角渲染。
AI.motivation: 流式三维重建不仅需要几何预测序列，更需要可随观测到达而持续吸收新证据、并始终保持可渲染能力的持久化场景状态。隐空间 token 是有潜力的表示，但在线维护面临难点：每次观测既可能重访已知区域，也可能揭示新内容，因此如何在线更新这一表示尚不明确。
AI.method: 1) 提出 S2Tok 前馈框架，从非标定图像流维护尺寸自适应、持久化的场景状态。2) 核心思想是区分"对已有表示的更新"与"选择性扩展"。3) 空间感知 Transformer 将每次到达的观测与持久化场景 token 融合。4) 学习式准入模块（admission module）选择性扩展表示，抑制冗余存储。5) 层级解码器与高斯头将演化状态转为非像素对齐的三维高斯，实现无需缓存历史帧的新视角渲染。
AI.result: 在四个基准数据集上取得了有竞争力的流式渲染质量，同时保持紧凑的高斯表示；验证了非像素对齐高斯 + 自适应 token 状态在效率与质量上的平衡。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持将隐空间空间 token 作为在线三维重建的持久化计算状态，把可学习的场景更新与显式高斯渲染相结合，为流式重建提供了一条可行路径。

title: Agent Plasticity: Measuring Self-Improvement Through Experience
summary: AI agents increasingly operate in environments where they can diagnose failures and improve through experience, yet existing evaluations largely measure what an agent can do at a fixed point in time rather than how effectively it learns. Evaluating self-improvement requires answering three questions: does future performance improve and generalize beyond the interactions that enabled learning; how efficiently are new capabilities acquired; and where does the self-improvement process break down? To answer these questions, we study self-improvement in a controlled setting where agents amortize past experience into reusable artifacts that are inherited by future instances. At each checkpoint, we measure performance on training and held-out environment interactions while accounting for learning cost. We introduce agent plasticity, the efficiency with which an agent converts experience into gains in future held-out performance. Across multiple environments, frontier models exhibit sharply different improvement trajectories despite comparable opportunities to learn. Some achieve substantial and persistent gains, while others remain near or below their initial performance, and gains within the training regime often transfer only partially to out-of-distribution conditions. Endpoint capability and acquisition efficiency also diverge: the agent that ultimately performs best need not be the one that improves most efficiently. Tracing failures through the improvement loop further reveals different candidate bottlenecks. Agents with low plasticity often fail to reuse relevant artifacts, whereas more plastic agents may still fail despite reusing relevant artifacts, pointing to limitations in artifact quality, generalization, or application. Evaluating self-improving agents requires measuring not only what they can do, but how effectively they become better through experience.

AI.tldr: 论文提出评估"自我改进型AI智能体"的框架，通过"智能体可塑性"（将经验转化为未来留出性能增益的效率）在受控环境中测量学习过程，而非仅测量某一时刻的静态能力。
AI.motivation: 现有评估主要衡量智能体在固定时间点的能力，而非其通过经验有效学习的能力。要评估自我改进，需回答三个问题：未来性能是否提升并能泛化到学习交互之外、新能力获取的效率如何、自我改进过程在哪里失效。
AI.method: 在受控设定中研究自我改进：智能体将过往经验摊销为可复用产物（artifacts），并由未来实例继承。在每个检查点，测量其在训练与留出环境交互上的表现，并计入学习成本。核心指标为"智能体可塑性"——将经验转化为未来留出性能增益的效率。并通过改进回路追溯失败原因。
AI.result: 在多环境中，前沿模型即使学习机会相当，其改进轨迹差异显著：部分模型获得持续且实质性的提升，另一些则停留在初始水平甚至更低；训练区间内的增益向分布外条件迁移往往只是部分成立。终点能力与获取效率出现分离——最终表现最好的智能体未必是改进效率最高的。失败追溯显示不同候选瓶颈：低可塑性智能体常无法复用相关产物，而高可塑性智能体即便复用了产物也可能失败，指向产物质量、泛化或应用层面的局限。
AI.conclusion: 评估自我改进型智能体，不仅要测量它们能做什么，还要测量它们通过经验变得更好的效率。

title: Just for FUNS: LLM-Guided Spatio-Temporal Graph Node Generation for Forecasting Unobserved Node States
summary: Spatio-temporal forecasting is a cornerstone of logistics, urban planning, and intelligent transportation systems. However, constrained by deployment costs and maintenance resources, sensor networks often lack comprehensive spatial coverage, rendering Forecast Unobserved Node States (FUNS) a critical yet formidable challenge. Conventional models rely on historical observations and typically falter when encountering nodes without prior records. To address this, we redefine the problem as a conditional generation task on spatio-temporal graphs and propose GenST, a framework that introduces Large Language Models (LLMs) as a semantic bridge, leveraging a pre-trained LLM fine-tuned to extract rich semantic features from node descriptions, such as functional zones and road network structures, to compensate for missing spatio-temporal signals. Specifically, we design a two-stage generative architecture: a Spatio-Temporal VAE first compresses spatio-temporal dynamics into a latent space, followed by a Generative Transformer (GenT) that reconstructs the future states of unobserved nodes from noise, guided by multi-modal conditions including semantics, geographic coordinates, and neighborhood contexts. Experiments on six traffic and two non-traffic datasets show GenST significantly outperforms existing baselines in zero-shot prediction tasks, demonstrating the practical potential of semantic-guided generation for mitigating spatio-temporal data sparsity.

AI.tldr: 本文提出GenST框架，将未观测节点状态预测（FUNS）重新定义为时空图上的条件生成任务，借助预训练LLM提取节点语义特征，并通过时空VAE与生成式Transformer两阶段架构实现零样本预测，在六个交通与两个非交通数据集上显著优于现有基线。
AI.motivation: 受部署成本与维护资源限制，传感器网络空间覆盖往往不完整，导致大量节点缺乏观测数据。传统模型依赖历史观测，面对无历史记录的节点时性能急剧下降，因此未观测节点状态预测（FUNS）成为关键且困难的挑战。
AI.method: 将FUNS重定义为时空图上的条件生成任务。引入预训练并微调的大语言模型作为语义桥梁，从节点描述（如功能区、路网结构）中提取丰富语义特征以补偿缺失的时空信号。整体采用两阶段生成架构：先用时空VAE将时空动态压缩至隐空间，再由生成式Transformer（GenT）在语义、地理坐标和邻域上下文等多模态条件引导下，从噪声中重建未观测节点的未来状态。
AI.result: 在六个交通数据集和两个非交通数据集上的实验表明，GenST在零样本预测任务中显著优于现有基线，验证了语义引导生成在缓解时空数据稀疏问题上的实际潜力。
AI.conclusion: GenST通过LLM语义引导与两阶段条件生成架构，有效解决了无历史记录节点的预测难题，为缓解时空数据稀疏提供了可行路径，展现了语义引导生成方法在实际场景中的应用前景。

title: Visual Memory Attacks Can Persist Through The KV Cache
summary: Modern language model systems operate autonomously over increasingly long contexts containing untrusted text and images. Can an adversarial input continue to steer a model even after that input is removed from its context? We show that attacks can be trained to persist through the key/value (KV) cache of subsequent tokens, allowing adversarial influence to outlive direct access to its source.We consider the Visual Memory Injection (VMI; Schlarmann and Hein, 2026) attack setting, in which an adversarial image that stays in the context plants a hidden backdoor: the model behaves normally until a chosen trigger elicits an attacker-chosen response. We first demonstrate persistence in this setting with optimized soft prompts, which remain effective after we mask the prompt from attention. We then introduce Persistent Visual Memory Injection (P-VMI), which optimizes images to preserve this adversarial behaviour after they are masked from attention. These attacks persist over conversations substantially longer than those used during optimization. On Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct, P-VMI achieves up to approximately $90\%$ target success in its strongest configuration and remains effective under a stricter removal setting that exposes the image only on the first turn. A cache-swap ablation localizes the persistent influence to the KV cache. Finally, we show that these attacks can be trained to survive compaction that retains the KV cache of a summary generated by the same model, demonstrating that adversarial behaviour can persist in cached state without continued access to its source.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出并验证了对抗输入可从KV缓存中产生持久影响——即使原始输入（图像/提示）被遮蔽或移除，攻击仍能继续操控模型行为。
AI.motivation: 现代语言模型在长上下文中自主运行，其中包含不可信文本与图像。核心问题是：对抗输入在其被从上下文中移除后，是否仍能持续影响模型？作者关注攻击能否通过KV缓存"存活"下来，从而使之脱离对来源的直接访问。
AI.method: 1) 在Visual Memory Injection（VMI）设定下，先用优化软提示证明持续性：即使将提示从注意力中遮蔽仍有效；2) 提出Persistent Visual Memory Injection（P-VMI），直接优化图像，使其在被遮蔽出注意力后仍保留对抗行为；3) 通过cache-swap消融定位持续影响的来源；4) 训练攻击以在"压缩"（保留同一模型生成摘要的KV缓存）后仍存活。
AI.result: 攻击在对话中的持续时间显著长于优化时使用的长度。在Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct上，P-VMI在最强配置下目标成功率最高约90%，且在仅首轮暴露图像的更严格移除设定下仍有效。cache-swap消融将持续影响定位于KV缓存。
AI.conclusion: 对抗行为可以驻留在缓存状态中，无需持续访问其来源即可延续，说明KV缓存是长上下文模型中被忽视的持久攻击面，对安全部署构成新风险。

title: Reconciling Bottom-Up Metrics with Top-Down Reporting for Cloud Carbon Accounting
summary:
Organizations seeking to reduce the carbon footprint of their cloud applications must rely on two largely disconnected ways of measuring it, each with important limitations. Bottom-up metrics like Software Carbon Intensity (SCI) provide signals for carbon-aware optimization, but tenants lack the information needed to account for many provider-side overheads. Top-down reports by cloud providers provide a more comprehensive view of a tenant's carbon footprint but are coarse and methodologically opaque. Because the two approaches differ in scope and reporting frequency, the current state of the art treats them as decoupled: bottom-up metrics for optimization, top-down reports for corporate disclosure.
  We argue that the two signals should be reconcilable. A per-workload metric whose improvements never surface in the provider's audited report will not be adopted for accountability at scale. We survey the state of the art in cloud carbon accounting and propose a vision for reconciled SCI (rSCI): a per-workload metric that re-anchors a bottom-up energy estimate to the cloud provider's top-down report through a residual. By decomposing and allocating this residual according to its physical drivers, rSCI can preserve operational incentives while also attributing idle capacity and embodied carbon to the workloads that drive them. We show that today's top-down reporting is still too coarse and methodologically inconsistent to support credible reconciliation and lay out concrete steps in provider reporting and standards to make it practical.

AI.tldr: 本文综述云碳核算现状，指出自下而上指标（如SCI）与自上而下云厂商报告彼此脱节，提出"可对账SCI（rSCI）"愿景：通过残差将单工作负载能耗估计锚定至厂商审计报告，并按物理驱动因素分解与分摊该残差。
AI.motivation: 云应用碳足迹测量存在两种彼此割裂、各有局限的方法：自下而上的SCI等指标可为碳感知优化提供信号，但租户缺乏信息以计入诸多厂商侧开销；自上而下的云厂商报告更全面，却粒度粗糙、方法学不透明。二者在核算范围与报告频率上不一致，导致现状将其解耦处理——自下而上用于优化，自上而下用于企业披露。作者认为两类信号应当可对账，否则单工作负载指标的改进若无法体现在厂商经审计报告中，就难以被规模化的问责机制采纳。
AI.method: 本文为综述与愿景性论文。首先梳理云碳核算的最新进展；随后提出rSCI（reconciled SCI）构想：以自上而下报告为锚，通过残差（residual）重新校准自下而上的能耗估计，并将该残差按物理驱动因素进行分解与分摊，从而把闲置容量与隐含碳归因到驱动其产生的工作负载；最后评估当前报告粒度与方法学一致性是否足以支撑可信对账，并提出厂商报告与标准层面的具体改进路径。
AI.result: 分析表明，当前的云厂商自上而下报告在粒度上仍过于粗糙，且方法学上缺乏一致性，尚不足以支撑可信的对账。因此rSCI目前难以直接落地，需要先在厂商报告与标准层面推进具体改进。
AI.conclusion: 云碳核算应走向两种信号的可对账，rSCI通过残差锚定与按物理驱动因素分摊，兼顾优化激励与问责归因（含闲置容量与隐含碳）。作者呼吁在报告粒度、方法学一致性及标准制定方面开展具体工作，使对账在实践中可行。

title: HULK: Learning Whole-Body Forceful Loco-Manipulation for Humanoids
comment: 16 pages, 7 figures, IEEE International Conference on Robotics and Automation 2027
summary: Humanoid loco-manipulation of large, heavy objects demands forceful interaction across the entire body. However, such payloads shift a humanoid's center of mass and impose sustained loads across the upper body, challenging balance and command tracking. We present HULK, a whole-body control framework for forceful loco-manipulation. Using model predictive control (MPC) to guide reinforcement learning with predictions of the loaded dynamics, we train two teachers: one tracks arm motions under wrist forces, and the other locomotes while holding large objects against the body. A capture-point control barrier function augments the wrist-force teacher during training to improve balance under load. We distill both teachers into a single policy. Evaluation spans simulation and the Unitree G1. In simulation, the teacher with the barrier function achieves the lowest forward and lateral velocity tracking errors at 10 kg per arm among evaluated controllers and reduces aggregate divergent component of motion (DCM) excursion magnitude by 35.7% relative to MPC-guided reinforcement learning alone. Our wrist-force teacher withstands torso push disturbances of up to 130 N.

AI.tldr: 提出HULK全身控制框架，通过MPC引导强化学习并引入捕获点控制屏障函数，实现人形机器人对大重量物体的强交互运动操作，并在仿真与Unitree G1上验证。
AI.motivation: 人形机器人搬运大型重物需要全身强力的接触交互，但负载会改变机器人质心位置并在上半身施加持续载荷，给平衡维持与指令跟踪带来挑战。
AI.method: 采用模型预测控制（MPC）以负载动力学预测引导强化学习，训练两个教师策略：一个在腕部受力下跟踪手臂运动，另一个在抱持大型物体贴身前移时行走；训练中对腕力教师引入捕获点控制屏障函数以增强负载下的平衡；最后将两个教师蒸馏为单一策略。
AI.result: 在仿真中，带屏障函数的教师在每臂10 kg负载下取得最低的前向与侧向速度跟踪误差，相较于仅用MPC引导的强化学习，将发散运动分量（DCM）偏移幅度总和降低35.7%；腕力教师可承受高达130 N的躯干推动扰动；同时在Unitree G1实体上完成评估。
AI.conclusion: HULK框架通过MPC引导的强化学习与捕获点控制屏障函数，有效提升了人形机器人在重载下的平衡性与指令跟踪能力，具备全身强交互运动操作的可行性。

title: LRCC: Generalizing Low-Rank Compression with Conditional Computation
summary: Low-rank compression reduces the cost of pretrained language models by replacing linear transformations with low-rank factorizations. However, conventional methods use a fixed rank allocation during inference, assigning the same amount of compute regardless of the input token. We introduce Low-Rank Conditional Computation (LRCC), which adds token-dependent computation to pretrained models by training one lightweight router per Transformer block to select among a small set of nested low-rank paths. During training, the low-rank factors remain frozen, and only the routers are optimized. We evaluate LRCC on Llama and Qwen models for language modeling and zero-shot downstream tasks. Within the same average active-parameter budget, LRCC improves the predictive performance over static low-rank compression, including a 7.6 percentage-point gain in average downstream accuracy on Llama-2-7B over static methods. At matched batch-size-1 decoding latency, LRCC improves both perplexity and downstream accuracy on Llama-3.2-1B and remains competitive on Llama-2-7B, without specialized kernels. Finally, we assess the usefulness of assigning a token-wise path by analyzing the routers' path choices.

AI.tldr: LRCC通过在每个Transformer块训练轻量路由器，动态为每个token选择嵌套低秩路径，在冻结低秩因子的前提下实现token级条件计算，在同等平均激活参数预算下优于静态低秩压缩。
AI.motivation: 传统低秩压缩在推理时使用固定秩分配，对所有输入token施加相同计算量，忽视了不同token的难度差异，导致计算资源利用不够高效。作者希望引入token相关的条件计算来提升压缩模型的性能。
AI.method: LRCC在每个Transformer块中训练一个轻量路由器，从一小组嵌套低秩路径中选择一条执行，从而实现token级自适应计算。训练时低秩因子保持冻结，仅优化路由器参数，因而训练开销低。方法不依赖专用kernel。
AI.result: 在Llama和Qwen上针对语言建模与零样本下游任务评估显示：在相同平均激活参数预算下，LRCC优于静态低秩压缩，Llama-2-7B平均下游准确率提升7.6个百分点；在batch-size-1解码延迟匹配时，Llama-3.2-1B的困惑度和下游准确率均有提升，Llama-2-7B上保持竞争力。
AI.conclusion: LRCC以极低训练成本为预训练模型注入token级条件计算能力，在同等计算预算或延迟下提升压缩模型性能，且路由器路径选择分析进一步验证了token-wise路径分配的有效性。

title: Zero-Shot Brain MRI Inpainting with 2.5D Unconditional Flow Priors
summary: Generative inpainting of brain MRI volumes is essential for synthesizing healthy tissue in pathological regions, improving the accuracy and reliability of automated downstream brain analysis applications such as image registration, brain extraction, and segmentation. However, standard 3D approaches are computationally prohibitive, while efficient 2D slice-wise methods suffer from severe inter-slice discontinuities. Furthermore, traditional models rely on conditional training, requiring task-specific learning of masked inputs. We propose a zero-shot brain MRI inpainting framework utilizing 2.5D unconditional flow priors to capture spatial context along the superior-inferior axis without the overhead of full 3D convolutions. During training, our flow matching model learns the joint distribution of adjacent axial slice triplets, modeling the manifold of healthy brain anatomy while explicitly excluding pathological regions from the loss function. At inference, the model processes the input triplets autoregressively along the depth axis. We employ the Restora-Flow solver to constrain the unconditional prior using the input mask, achieving accurate zero-shot inpainting. Evaluations show our 2.5D strategy resolves the structural discontinuities of 2D baselines, synthesizing plausible healthy tissue while maintaining volumetric consistency across the axial, sagittal, and coronal planes. As a final step, we generate and average an ensemble of multiple stochastic reconstructions to form the final prediction. Quantitative results benchmarked on the official BraTS 2026 Inpainting Challenge validation set demonstrate the effectiveness of our proposed approach, yielding an SSIM of 0.816 $\pm$ 0.112, MSE of 0.007 $\pm$ 0.005, and PSNR of 22.923 $\pm$ 4.343. Code is available at https://github.com/imigraz/brats2026-inpainting.

AI.tldr: 提出一种零样本脑MRI修复框架，利用2.5D无条件流先验沿上下轴建模相邻轴位切片三元组，实现高效且跨层面连续的病理区域健康组织合成。
AI.motivation: 脑MRI体积修复对下游分析（配准、脑提取、分割）至关重要。标准3D方法计算代价过高，而高效2D逐切片方法存在严重的层间不连续；同时传统模型依赖条件训练，需针对掩码输入进行任务特定学习。
AI.method: 采用2.5D无条件流先验捕捉上下方向空间上下文，避免全3D卷积开销。训练时流匹配模型学习相邻轴位切片三元组的联合分布，建模健康脑解剖流形并在损失中显式排除病理区域；推理时沿深度轴自回归处理三元组，并用Restora-Flow求解器以输入掩码约束无条件先验，实现零样本修复；最后对多个随机重建取平均形成集成预测。
AI.result: 2.5D策略解决了2D基线的结构不连续问题，合成合理的健康组织并在轴位、矢状位和冠状位保持体积一致性。在BraTS 2026 Inpainting Challenge官方验证集上，SSIM为0.816±0.112，MSE为0.007±0.005，PSNR为22.923±4.343。
AI.conclusion: 2.5D无条件流先验结合Restora-Flow约束的零样本框架在计算效率与体积一致性之间取得良好平衡，定量结果验证了其在脑MRI修复任务上的有效性。

title: AdaGuard: Enhancing Safety and Policy Compliance with Reasoning-Enabled LLM-As-A-Judge Guardrails
summary: Enterprise generative AI applications require robust safety mechanisms that can accommodate diverse risk postures, evolving policies, and varying latency constraints. Current guardrail solutions often suffer from rigidity, relying on fixed policy sets and offering limited transparency or reasoning flexibility. We present Adaguard, an adaptive LLM-as-a-Judge framework designed to address these challenges through dynamic policy enforcement and adaptive reasoning-budget allocation. Built using supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and reinforcement learning (GRPO), AdaGuard generalizes to user-defined safety and compliance policies at runtime without requiring frequent model updates. A core innovation of our approach is the ability to dynamically infer the complexity of input-policy pairs, allowing the model to switch between high-speed black-box inference and explainable, reasoning-enabled moderation. This flexibility enables developers to balance stringent latency requirements with the need for actionable transparency. This adaptive capability allows AdaGuard to rival other guardrail and frontier models several times its size, while its auto-reasoning mode recovers the accuracy of always-on reasoning at a fraction of the latency

AI.tldr: 提出 Adaguard 自适应 LLM-as-a-Judge 护栏框架，通过动态策略执行与自适应推理预算分配，在运行时泛化到用户自定义安全合规策略，兼顾低延迟与可解释性。
AI.motivation: 企业级生成式 AI 应用需要鲁棒的安全机制，以适应多样化风险姿态、不断演变的政策与不同延迟约束。现有护栏方案往往僵化：依赖固定策略集，透明度与推理灵活性有限，且策略变更需频繁更新模型。
AI.method: Adaguard 基于 LLM-as-a-Judge 范式，采用监督微调（SFT）与强化学习（GRPO）训练。核心创新是动态推断输入-策略对的复杂度，从而在高速度黑盒推理与可解释、带推理的审核模式之间自适应切换；同时支持运行时泛化到用户自定义的安全与合规策略。
AI.result: Adaguard 可媲美体量为其数倍的其它护栏模型与前沿模型；其自动推理（auto-reasoning）模式能以极低延迟恢复"始终开启推理"的准确率。
AI.conclusion: Adaguard 通过动态策略执行与自适应推理预算分配，在无需频繁模型更新的前提下兼顾延迟约束与可操作透明度，为生成式 AI 安全护栏提供了一种灵活、可泛化的解决方案。

title: HydroSphere: A Framework for Governed, Self-Healing Wastewater Infrastructure
comment: 16 pages, 5 tables and 9 figures - article to be submitted to a Journal / Conference
summary: Rapid industrialization and urban growth are increasing pressure on water quality and wastewater treatment systems, while conventional treatment plants often rely on static monitoring and control strategies that cannot easily adapt to changing pollutant conditions. This paper presents HydroSphere, a governed, data-driven framework for real-time water quality monitoring, forecasting, treatment optimization, and fault recovery. HydroSphere is evaluated using 2.82 million water-quality measurements collected between 1940 and 2023. The framework integrates three main components. First, a hybrid TCN-LSTM model performs multi-step forecasting across seven water-quality parameters, achieving an RMSE of 0.1417, MAE of 0.1047, and R2 of 0.3596. Second, the Adaptive Dosage Optimization Module uses PPO reinforcement learning to adjust chemical dosing, achieving a mean step reward of 1.059 compared with 1.017 for a fixed-dose baseline. The results also show that unconstrained reward optimization can lead to excessive dosing, demonstrating the need for explicit operational safeguards. Third, the SHADE anomaly detection module uses a deep autoencoder to identify sensor and process anomalies, achieving an F1 score of 0.651 under controlled fault injection. HydroSphere combines these capabilities with tiered governance, deterministic safety bounds, and human oversight to support safer and more adaptive water infrastructure. The framework provides a scalable foundation for intelligent wastewater management and supports the objectives of UN Sustainable Development Goals 6 and 13.

AI.tldr: 本文提出HydroSphere——一个受治理约束的数据驱动框架，用于实时水质监测、预测、处理优化与故障恢复，基于1940–2023年282万条水质数据评估，集成TCN-LSTM预测、PPO自适应加药优化与SHADE异常检测三大模块。
AI.motivation: 快速工业化与城市增长加剧了水质和污水处理系统压力，而传统污水处理厂多依赖静态监测与控制策略，难以适应不断变化的污染物条件，因此需要更安全、更具适应性的智能化水务基础设施。
AI.method: 框架包含三部分：(1) 混合TCN-LSTM模型对七项水质参数进行多步预测；(2) 自适应加药优化模块（Adaptive Dosage Optimization Module）采用PPO强化学习调整化学投加量；(3) SHADE异常检测模块使用深度自编码器识别传感器与工艺异常。同时结合分层治理、确定性安全边界与人工监督。
AI.result: TCN-LSTM预测达到RMSE 0.1417、MAE 0.1047、R² 0.3596；PPO加药优化平均单步奖励1.059，高于固定剂量基线的1.017，但无约束奖励优化会导致过量投加；SHADE在受控故障注入下F1为0.651。
AI.conclusion: HydroSphere将预测、优化与异常检测能力与分层治理、确定性安全边界和人工监督相结合，可支撑更安全、更自适应的水务基础设施，为智能污水管理提供可扩展基础，并服务于联合国可持续发展目标6与13。

title: Cost of Delay for Post-Quantum Migration: Putting Classical and Harvest-Now-Decrypt-Later Risk on One Ordered List
comment: 17 pages, 9 figures, 4 tables. Code and case studies: https://github.com/AnimeshShaw/pqc-cost-of-delay ; archive: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23133468
summary: Organisations deciding which assets to migrate to post-quantum cryptography first, and how that work competes with a backlog of classical findings, lack a common unit: post-quantum scores are dimensionless and quantum-only, while classical risk is annualised loss. We express both threats as a cost of delay in currency per year on the same asset. The quantum term is the rate at which deferring migration commits irreversible harvest-now-decrypt-later loss, computed from required confidentiality duration, recordable traffic share and data turnover, using a quantum-arrival law fitted in closed form to published expert anchors. A competing-risks factor couples the two terms so the same loss is not counted twice. We prove that the construction is not a weighted sum of a classical and a quantum score, give a dominance threshold on the classical hazard that is independent of asset value, and show that the induced order is optimal for sequencing work under constant loss rates. We verify the implementation by simulation, adaptive quadrature and a second implementation. On four public systems with parameters assumed from public documentation, the quantum term reorders the asset list beyond input uncertainty for one system only (signal-to-noise 1.36 against 0.14-0.46), moves specific long-lived, quiet, recordable assets decisively, and otherwise changes magnitudes. Asset value and turnover explain 73-91% of the uncertainty in the quantum term; the arrival date explains 3-17%. The case studies are illustrative and are not validated against outcomes.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出将"量子威胁"与"经典风险"统一为同一资产上以货币/年计的"延迟成本"，从而为后量子密码迁移的优先级排序提供可比单位与最优调度顺序。
AI.motivation: 组织在决定先迁移哪些资产到后量子密码时面临单位不一致的问题：后量子评分是无量纲且仅针对量子的，而经典风险是年化损失；同时量子迁移工作还需与经典漏洞积压争夺资源，缺乏共同比较基准。
AI.method: 将两类威胁统一表达为同一资产上的"延迟成本"（货币/年）。量子项定义为推迟迁移所导致的不可逆"先收集后解密"损失的速率，输入包括要求的保密期限、可记录流量占比与数据周转率，并使用与公开专家锚点闭式拟合的量子到达规律。引入竞争风险因子耦合两项以避免重复计损。
AI.result: 证明该构造不是经典评分与量子评分的加权和；给出与资产价值无关的经典风险率支配阈值；证明在恒定损失率下该诱导排序对工作排序最优。通过仿真、自适应求积与第二套实现验证。在四个公开系统（参数取自公开文档假设）上，量子项仅对一个系统在超出输入不确定性范围内重排资产列表（信噪比1.36 对 0.14–0.46），对特定的长寿命、低活动、可记录资产产生决定性影响，其余情况仅改变量级。资产价值与周转率解释了量子项不确定性的73–91%，到达日期解释3–17%。案例研究为示意性，未经结果验证。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为后量子迁移与经典风险治理提供了统一、可比较且可证明最优的排序依据；但其案例结果仍属示意性质，尚需实证验证。

title: Efficient Heuristics and Machine Learning Approach for Fault Characterization in Distributed Self-Stabilizing Programs
summary: Modern large-scale systems rely on distributed protocols to maximize efficiency while preserving the correctness guarantees of single-process execution. However, designing such protocols is non-trivial: adding resources to a system inherently increases its complexity, which in turn introduces faults that must be addressed during design. One such fault class, arising in systems that use distributed shared memory (e.g., replicated databases), is consistency violating fault (cvf), a fault in which a process accessing shared memory reads stale data previously written by another process. Cvfs are inherent to systems that prioritize availability over strict consistency. Prior work has shown that self-stabilizing programs remain correct under high availability, provided such faults stay within a tolerable bound. Characterizing the behavior of self-stabilizing programs in the presence of cvfs can therefore help system designers build systems that are both correct and efficient. In this paper, we study self-stabilizing programs under cvfs to understand when and where such faults occur, enabling runtime measures that improve computational efficiency. Since exhaustive state-space exploration does not scale, it suffers from state-space explosion; our study investigates two complementary approaches: a conflict-based state-space exploration technique for monotonically stabilizing $(Δ + 1)$-Graph Coloring programs, and a machine-learning-based approach for a Maximal Independent Set program. We propose a conflicting-edges-based state-space exploration algorithm alongside a rigorously validated ML model, evaluated on an out-of-distribution dataset through structural consistency checks against known graph invariants.

AI.tldr: 本文研究分布式共享内存中"一致性违背故障"(cvf)下自稳定程序的行为，提出两种互补方法：面向(Δ+1)图着色程序的基于冲突边的状态空间探索算法，以及面向最大独立集程序的机器学习方法，以刻画cvf的发生时机与位置从而支持运行时效率优化。
AI.motivation: 现代大规模系统依赖分布式协议在保持单进程执行正确性保证的同时最大化效率，但增加资源会提升复杂度并引入故障。其中在使用分布式共享内存（如副本数据库）的系统中存在"一致性违背故障"(cvf)：进程读取其他进程先前写入的过期数据。cvf在优先可用性而非严格一致性的系统中不可避免。已有工作表明，只要此类故障处于可容忍界限内，自稳定程序仍能保持正确。因此刻画cvf下自稳定程序的行为，有助于设计者构建既正确又高效的系统。然而穷举状态空间探索面临状态爆炸，难以扩展。
AI.method: 研究两种互补途径：（1）针对单调稳定的(Δ+1)图着色程序，提出基于冲突边的状态空间探索算法（conflicting-edges-based state-space exploration）；（2）针对最大独立集(MIS)程序，提出基于机器学习的方法。ML模型经过严格验证，并在分布外(out-of-distribution)数据集上通过与已知图不变量的结构一致性检查进行评估。
AI.result: 提出了基于冲突边的状态空间探索算法，并构建了经严格验证的机器学习模型；该模型在分布外数据集上通过对照已知图不变量的结构一致性检验完成评估。
AI.conclusion: 通过研究cvf下自稳定程序的行为，明确了此类故障发生的时间与位置，可为运行时措施提供依据，从而提升计算效率，并帮助系统设计者构建兼顾正确性与效率的分布式系统。

title: PhysEvo: Astra Can Act, Let It
summary: Astra can act, yet reliable manipulation depends on the system through which it observes and controls the world. We introduce PhysEvo, a framework for physical recursive self-improvement (RSI) around a single frozen model. A task agent executes robot tasks; a meta-agent uses the resulting trajectories to diagnose failures, revise tools and skills, and test corrections. The meta-agent can also improve its own diagnostic tools, so retained revisions support both later action and later self-improvement. This process develops joint-level control, evidence-seeking observation, and reusable manipulation skills without model-weight updates or a separately trained action policy. Across 42 RoboDojo tasks, held-out-layout evaluation of retained task-specific deployment versions yields a five-dimension average score of 68.14/100 and 62.00% success, compared with 47.17% for RoboDawn's one-shot Astra agent, the strongest published reference in our comparison. On eight manipulation tasks challenging direct Astra, PhysEvo achieves 55.00% success, compared with 1.25% for the direct-Astra reference. Deploying the simulation-evolved harness on AgileX PiPER and continuing skill revision yields 90.60/100 average score and 84.00% success across 25 trials on five real-world tasks. PhysEvo turns the consequences of action into persistent, testable changes to how a frozen model acts and improves.

AI.tldr: PhysEvo：围绕单一冻结模型的具身智能体物理递归自我改进框架，通过元智能体迭代修正工具与技能，实现无需权重更新的终身改进。
AI.motivation: 机器人操作能力依赖其感知与控制的系统，而现有方法难以在冻结模型下持续改进；本文希望将行动后果转化为持久、可验证的改进，实现物理递归自我改进（RSI）。
AI.method: 双智能体架构：任务智能体执行机器人任务，元智能体基于轨迹诊断失败、修订工具与技能并验证修正；元智能体还可改进自身诊断工具，使保留的修订同时服务于后续行动与自我改进，且不更新模型权重、不单独训练动作策略。
AI.result: 42 个 RoboDojo 任务上，保留的任务特定部署版本在未见布局评估中五维平均分 68.14/100、成功率 62.00%（对比 RoboDawn 单次 Astra 智能体 47.17%）；8 个挑战直接 Astra 的操作任务成功率 55.00%（对比 1.25%）；将仿真演化的 harness 部署到 AgileX PiPER 并继续技能修订，5 个真实任务 25 次试验平均分 90.60/100、成功率 84.00%。
AI.conclusion: PhysEvo 将行动的后果转化为持久、可测试的变更，改进冻结模型如何行动与自我提升，验证了物理递归自我改进在仿真与真机迁移中的有效性。

title: Tiny-Scale Chinese BERT Pretraining: A Controlled Comparison of MLM, WWM, and MacBERT Strategies
summary: Pretraining strategies significantly impact the quality of language models, yet existing comparisons of Masked Language Modeling (MLM), Whole Word Masking (WWM), and MacBERT-style replacement have focused primarily on base-scale models (>=110M parameters). This paper presents a controlled comparison of these three strategies on a tiny-scale Chinese BERT model (4 layers, 256 hidden dimensions, 8.7M parameters). Under identical architecture, corpus (1.29M sentences from Chinese Wikipedia), and hyperparameters, we train three models from scratch and evaluate them across five intrinsic dimensions: perplexity, MLM hit rate, semantic discrimination, grammatical judgment, and contextual sensitivity. At tiny scale, MLM achieves the best overall intrinsic performance (winning 3 of 5 dimensions), while WWM excels in both perplexity (1.27 vs. 2.10, a 39.5% improvement) and MLM hit rate (22% vs. 16%). Notably, MacBERT under a severely limited synonym dictionary (222 entries, 3.3% coverage) exhibits severe perplexity degradation (47.23, 22x higher than MLM), yielding a ranking (MLM > WWM >> MacBERT) that differs markedly from the established base-scale conclusion (MacBERT > WWM > MLM). We further identify a critical evaluation pitfall: MacBERT achieves the lowest training loss (2.17) yet the highest perplexity (47.23), revealing that training loss alone is unreliable under mixed replacement strategies. All models and corpus are publicly available at https://huggingface.co/eebyp.

AI.tldr: 本文在极小规模中文BERT（4层、256隐藏维度、8.7M参数）上对MLM、WWM与MacBERT式替换三种预训练策略进行受控对比，发现其排名（MLM > WWM >> MacBERT）与base规模结论（MacBERT > WWM > MLM）显著不同，并揭示训练损失在混合替换策略下不可靠。
AI.motivation: 现有MLM、WWM与MacBERT式替换策略的比较主要集中于base及以上规模（>=110M参数）模型，缺乏对极小规模模型的系统研究；本文旨在填补该空白，检验既有结论在小规模下是否成立。
AI.method: 在相同架构（4层、256隐藏维度、8.7M参数）、相同语料（129万句中文维基百科）与相同超参数下，从头训练三个分别采用MLM、WWM和MacBERT式替换的模型；从五个内在维度评估：困惑度、MLM命中率、语义区分、语法判断、上下文敏感性。
AI.result: 小规模下MLM整体内在表现最佳（5个维度中胜出3个）；WWM在困惑度（1.27 vs. 2.10，提升39.5%）和MLM命中率（22% vs. 16%）上最优；MacBERT在同义词词典极度受限（222条、覆盖率3.3%）时困惑度严重退化（47.23，为MLM的22倍），最终排名为MLM > WWM >> MacBERT，与base规模结论（MacBERT > WWM > MLM）明显不同。此外，MacBERT训练损失最低（2.17）但困惑度最高（47.23），说明混合替换策略下仅凭训练损失评估不可靠。
AI.conclusion: 预训练策略的最优选择具有规模依赖性，base规模结论不能直接外推至极小规模模型；同时训练损失不能作为混合替换策略下的可靠评估指标。作者公开了全部模型与语料（https://huggingface.co/eebyp）。

title: Personalize at Test Time: Learning User Preferences for Image Generation
summary: Diffusion models can generate high-quality images, yet aligning their outputs with individual user preferences remains challenging. A key bottleneck is accurately modeling diverse user preferences from limited feedback. Existing approaches often rely on labor-intensive manual preference annotations or vision-language models (VLM) to extract preference information from user interaction histories, introducing substantial annotation or computational costs that limit scalability. We propose an approach that learns personalized reward models directly from users' historical image preference pairs. First, we use an autoencoder to compress hundreds of visual attributes into 50 attribute-anchored preference dimensions and train an evaluator to score images along these dimensions. We then represent each user's preferences as a linear combination of the shared dimension scores, estimating the user-specific weights by maximizing the likelihood of their observed pairwise preferences under the Bradley-Terry model. This formulation reduces per-user adaptation to optimizing a low-dimensional weight vector, simplifying optimization and enabling data-efficient personalization from sparse feedback. The learned personalized rewards guide image generation at inference time while keeping the diffusion model frozen. Experiments on real-user preference data show that our approach achieves approximately 77% held-out pairwise preference prediction accuracy and improves the alignment of generated images with individual user preferences.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种直接从用户历史图像偏好对中学习个性化奖励模型的方法：用自编码器将数百视觉属性压缩为50个属性锚定偏好维度并训练评估器打分，再将每个用户的偏好表示为共享维度分数的线性组合，通过Bradley-Terry模型极大似然估计用户权重，在推理时以个性化奖励引导冻结的扩散模型生成，实现数据高效的个人化对齐。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型虽能生成高质量图像，但使输出对齐个体用户偏好仍具挑战。核心瓶颈在于从有限反馈中准确建模多样的用户偏好。现有方法多依赖人工偏好标注或视觉语言模型（VLM）从交互历史中抽取偏好信息，带来高昂的标注或计算成本，限制了可扩展性。
AI.method: 1) 用自编码器将数百个视觉属性压缩为50个属性锚定偏好维度，并训练评估器沿这些维度为图像打分；2) 将每个用户的偏好表示为这些共享维度分数的线性组合，在Bradley-Terry模型下通过最大化其观测成对偏好的似然来估计用户特定权重，从而把单用户适配简化为低维权重向量优化；3) 学到的个性化奖励在推理阶段引导图像生成，同时保持扩散模型冻结。
AI.result: 在真实用户偏好数据上的实验中，该方法在留出成对偏好预测上达到约77%的准确率，并提升了生成图像与个体用户偏好的对齐程度。
AI.conclusion: 通过低维属性锚定偏好表示与Bradley-Terry似然估计，可在稀疏反馈下实现数据高效的用户个性化奖励学习，无需人工标注或VLM，且以冻结扩散模型+推理期引导的方式有效提升生成结果与个体偏好的对齐。

title: Can AI Agents Make Open-Ended Scientific Discovery? Evidence from Station
summary: Recent AI systems have made rapid progress in scientific discovery when given well-defined metrics, but whether they can autonomously undertake open-ended scientific discovery remains unclear. We investigate AI's ability to tackle open-ended tasks in Station, an open-world environment in which multiple agents simulate a scientific ecosystem. To tackle challenges specific to open-ended tasks, we propose augmenting Station with two mechanisms: a Supervisor mechanism and periodic Meta Reflection, which encourage persistent exploration even when intermediate metrics are lacking. We construct open-ended tasks from three recent oral papers presented at ICLR. We give agents the main research question studied in each paper while withholding the paper's results and disabling web access. We then measure how many of the original findings-partitioned into individual criteria-agents rediscover. We find that Station rediscovers 62.7% of the criteria on average, compared with 15.4% for Codex Multiagent-v2 and 14.4-20.6% for AI Scientist-v2. Ablation and behavioral analyses indicate that adding the two mechanisms together improves research coverage and continuity. We further evaluate Station on two open-ended tasks without oracle papers and find that some of the discoveries made by the agents closely match discoveries reported by researchers after the knowledge cutoff date. Together, these results indicate that a suitable environment can enable agents to autonomously make meaningful progress in open-ended scientific discovery.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究AI能否自主进行开放式科学发现，提出在Station开放世界环境中加入Supervisor机制与周期性Meta Reflection两项机制，使多智能体在缺乏中间指标时仍能持续探索；在三个ICLR口头报告论文任务上，Station平均重新发现62.7%的原始结论条目，显著高于Codex Multiagent-v2（15.4%）和AI Scientist-v2（14.4–20.6%）。
AI.motivation: 既有AI系统在指标明确的科学发现任务上进展迅速，但其能否自主开展开放式科学发现尚不明确；开放式任务缺乏中间度量信号，导致探索难以持续，因此需要合适的环境与机制来支撑自主、持续的研究过程。
AI.method: 构建开放世界环境Station，多个智能体在其中模拟科学生态系统；引入Supervisor机制与周期性Meta Reflection两项机制以促进持续探索；从ICLR三篇口头报告论文构造开放式任务，仅向智能体提供研究主问题，隐藏论文结果并禁用网络访问；将原始发现拆分为独立条目作为评价标准，统计智能体重新发现的比例，并开展消融与行为分析，另在两个无参考论文的开放式任务上评估。
AI.result: Station平均重新发现62.7%的结论条目，Codex Multiagent-v2为15.4%，AI Scientist-v2为14.4–20.6%；消融与行为分析表明两项机制结合可提升研究覆盖度与连续性；在两个无参考论文的开放式任务上，智能体的部分发现与知识截止日期之后研究者报告的发现高度吻合。
AI.conclusion: 合适的环境能够使智能体在开放式科学发现中自主取得有意义的进展，Supervisor与Meta Reflection机制对维持探索覆盖度与连续性具有关键作用。

title: Task-Oriented Key-Layer KV Communication for Efficient Latent Multi-Agent Collaboration
summary: Large language model-based multi-agent systems improve complex problem solving through collaboration, while latent communication directly transmits model internal states to avoid the high inference costs of natural language. However, existing KV-based latent communication methods prioritize sender-side state fidelity, leading to substantial communication and computation overhead and potentially introducing redundant information. To address these limitations, we revisit latent communication from a task-oriented perspective, shifting its objective from sender-side state fidelity to receiver-side task sufficiency. Under this formulation, we propose KITE, a training-free framework for task-oriented key-layer KV communication. KITE identifies a task-effective key layer using a receiver trajectory distortion criterion, transmits only the latent working memory associated with the key layer, and further uses the same layer as the entry point for autoregressive latent reasoning. Experiments on seven benchmarks across two model families and three model scales show that, compared with full-layer KV communication, KITE reduces communication volume by 28-36$\times$, achieves up to 3$\times$ end-to-end inference speedup, and improves accuracy by up to 23.3 percentage points.

AI.tldr: 本文提出KITE——一种免训练的任务导向关键层KV通信框架，将潜在通信目标从发送端状态保真转为接收端任务充分性，通过接收端轨迹失真准则识别关键层，仅传输该层潜在工作记忆，并以其作为自回归潜在推理入口。实验表明通信量降低28-36倍，推理加速达3倍，准确率最多提升23.3个百分点。
AI.motivation: 基于大语言模型的多智能体系统通过协作提升复杂问题求解能力，潜在通信可直接传递模型内部状态以避免自然语言的高推理成本。但现有基于KV的潜在通信方法以发送端状态保真度为核心目标，导致通信与计算开销巨大，且可能引入冗余信息。
AI.method: 作者从任务导向视角重新审视潜在通信，将目标由发送端状态保真转为接收端任务充分性，并提出免训练框架KITE：利用接收端轨迹失真准则识别任务有效的关键层；仅传输与该关键层相关的潜在工作记忆；并以同一层作为自回归潜在推理的入口。
AI.result: 在两个模型家族、三种模型规模、七个基准上，与全层KV通信相比，KITE将通信量降低28-36倍，端到端推理速度最多提升3倍，准确率最多提升23.3个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 以接收端任务充分性为优化目标的潜在通信范式，可在显著降低通信与计算开销的同时提升任务准确率，为多智能体系统的高效协作提供了一种免训练的可行路径。

title: SwarmReconGuard: Black-Box Detection of Distributed Collective Reconnaissance by Individually Benign-Looking Agent Populations
summary: Autonomous and agentic clients can distribute reconnaissance across many identities so that each request remains valid, low-rate, and benign-looking while the population collectively acquires broad system knowledge. We formalize this threat as Distributed Collective Reconnaissance (DCR) and present SwarmReconGuard, a reproducible black-box benchmark in which the defender observes only service-boundary telemetry. The Docker-isolated study evaluates 11 benign and attack behaviors across 10-10,000 virtual identities, comprising 440 test runs and 3,666,300 requests, with complete telemetry integrity. We compare semantic, Gaussian, conditional, graph, kernel, hybrid, and CUSUM-based detectors. Gaussian likelihood-ratio detection achieves 100$\%$ detection with 0$\%$ observed false positives on known attacks but only 3$\%$ on unseen policies. CUSUM yields 36.1$\%$ overall detection at 1.25$\%$ false positives, while hybrid CUSUM reaches 85.7$\%$ detection with 0$\%$ observed false positives at 10,000 identities. Results expose a major policy-generalization gap and motivate exposure-aware, scale-aware defenses.

AI.tldr: 论文形式化了"分布式协同侦察"(DCR)威胁——自主智能体客户端将侦察行为分散到大量身份上，使单个请求合法、低速率且看似无害，但群体整体获取广泛系统知识。作者提出SwarmReconGuard黑盒基准，在仅观测服务边界遥测的条件下评估多种异常检测器。
AI.motivation: 自主与智能体化客户端能够把侦察活动分散到众多身份上，使每个请求都保持合法、低速率和良性外观，从而规避基于单请求速率或单身份行为的传统检测。现有防御缺乏对此类集体性、跨身份侦察的威胁形式化与可复现的评测基准，因此需要建立标准化的黑盒研究框架来量化检测能力并揭示防御短板。
AI.method: 提出SwarmReconGuard：一个可复现的黑盒基准。防御者仅观测服务边界遥测（service-boundary telemetry）。使用Docker隔离环境，覆盖11种良性及攻击行为、10至10,000个虚拟身份，共440次测试运行、3,666,300次请求，且遥测完整性完备。对比语义、高斯、条件、图、核、混合以及基于CUSUM的多类检测器。
AI.result: 高斯似然比检测在已知攻击上达到100%检测率与0%观测假阳性，但对未见策略仅3%检测率；CUSUM整体检测率36.1%（假阳性1.25%）；混合CUSUM在10,000个身份下达到85.7%检测率与0%观测假阳性。
AI.conclusion: 结果揭示了显著的策略泛化鸿沟：现有检测器在已知攻击上表现优异但在未见策略上严重退化。作者据此提出需要暴露感知(exposure-aware)与规模感知(scale-aware)的防御方法。

title: LOCAA: An Agentic System for Automated Lossy Compressor Tuning
summary: Large-scale scientific simulations generate substantial data volumes, making lossy compression essential for reducing storage and data movement costs. However, users configure compressors through numerical error bounds (EBs) while often evaluating results using quality metrics and end-to-end performance. Because the relationship between an EB and these outcomes varies across datasets and compressors, identifying a suitable configuration typically requires exhaustive search, which can be time-consuming and computationally demanding. We present LOCAA, an Large language model-based scientific lossy compression auto-tuning agent that performs compression-in-the-loop search using tool-integrated execution, compressor-aware guidance, and persistent memory. LOCAA supports user-defined objectives and constraints without requiring a specialized search strategy. We evaluate LOCAA across three scientific applications, five compressors, and three use cases: fixed-ratio compression, compression tuning under multiple quality constraints, and compression tuning under quality and time constraints. For fixed-ratio search across twelve fields from two applications, LOCAA requires 1.98x fewer evaluation trials than binary search and 5.03x fewer than FRaZ on average. For compression ratio maximization under joint Peak Signal-to-Noise Ratio (PSNR) and Structural Similarity Index Measure constraints across six fields from the Community Earth System Model application, LOCAA reduces the average evaluation trials from 61.5 using binary search to 17, corresponding to a 72.4% reduction. Persistent memory further reduces the average number of trials by 27.9% across multiple timesteps of the same field. These results demonstrate the potential of tool-augmented LLM agents to provide flexible and efficient compressor tuning across diverse scientific data and user-defined objectives.

AI.tldr: 提出基于大语言模型的科学有损压缩自动调优智能体LOCAA，通过工具集成执行、压缩器感知引导与持久记忆实现压缩在环搜索，在多个科学应用与压缩器上显著减少评估次数。
AI.motivation: 大规模科学模拟数据量巨大，需有损压缩降低存储与数据传输成本；但用户以数值误差界（EB）配置压缩器，却以质量指标和端到端性能评估结果，EB与结果关系随数据集和压缩器变化，找合适配置通常需穷举搜索，耗时且计算开销大。
AI.method: LOCAA：基于LLM的科学有损压缩自动调优智能体，采用压缩在环搜索，结合工具集成执行、压缩器感知引导和持久记忆；支持用户自定义目标与约束，无需专门的搜索策略。
AI.result: 在3个科学应用、5种压缩器、3类用例上评估。固定比例搜索（2个应用12个场）中，LOCAA所需评估次数平均比二分搜索少1.98倍、比FRaZ少5.03倍；在CESM 6个场上于PSNR与SSIM联合约束下最大化压缩比，平均评估次数从二分搜索的61.5降至17，减少72.4%；持久记忆在同一场多个时间步上进一步将平均试验次数减少27.9%。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明工具增强的LLM智能体能够在多样科学数据与用户自定义目标下实现灵活高效的压缩器调优。

title: MimicX: Policy-in-the-Loop Supervision Refinement for Video-Driven Humanoid Motion Tracking
comment: 33 pages, 26 figures, 19 tables, including references and appendices. Project website: https://nebulis-lab.com/MimicX
summary: Human videos provide rich motion targets for humanoid learning, yet visually plausible references can still produce persistent failures under physics-based execution. These failures reveal where training supervision should change. We present MimicX, a policy-in-the-loop framework that uses execution feedback to refine video-driven humanoid motion tracking. Starting from reconstructed and retargeted motion, MimicX localizes difficult transitions and affected body regions, then jointly adapts tracking objectives and the reset curriculum for policy continuation. Repeated rollout verification selects execution-priority improvements subject to tracking guards. Across four core video tasks, MimicX consistently improves tracking accuracy and Robust Execution Horizon relative to the Fixed Reference baseline. Task-averaged results show a 25.7% reduction in body-tracking error and a 255.6% increase in execution horizon. Additional video, motion-reference, and collision-scene studies evaluate the method beyond the core tasks, while MimicX-HLoop accelerates feedback through heterogeneous execution. Overall, MimicX turns policy failure into actionable supervision for deciding what to refine and which refinement to retain.

AI.tldr: MimicX是一个"策略在环"框架，利用执行反馈精化视频驱动的人形动作跟踪：定位困难过渡与受影响身体区域，联合调整跟踪目标与重置课程，并通过重复 rollout 验证筛选以执行为优先的改进，在四项视频任务上平均降低身体跟踪误差25.7%、提升可执行时长255.6%。
AI.motivation: 人形学习可借助人类视频获取丰富动作目标，但视觉上合理的参考动作在基于物理的执行中仍会出现持续失败。这些失败恰恰指示了训练监督应改进之处，因此需要一种利用执行反馈来识别并修正监督信号的方法。
AI.method: 从重建与重定向的动作出发，MimicX 定位困难的动作过渡片段及受影响的身体区域，联合自适应地调整跟踪目标（tracking objectives）与重置课程（reset curriculum）以支持策略继续训练；再通过重复 rollout 验证，在跟踪守卫（tracking guards）约束下筛选优先提升可执行性的改进。此外 MimicX-HLoop 通过异构执行加速反馈过程。
AI.result: 在四项核心视频任务上，相较 Fixed Reference 基线，MimicX 持续提升跟踪精度与鲁棒可执行时长（Robust Execution Horizon）；任务平均结果显示身体跟踪误差降低25.7%，可执行时长增加255.6%。此外还通过额外视频、动作参考与碰撞场景研究在核心任务之外评估方法有效性。
AI.conclusion: MimicX 将策略执行失败转化为可操作的监督信号，用于决定"精化什么"以及"保留哪项精化"，从而有效提升视频驱动人形动作跟踪的物理可执行性。

title: Steering Follows Geometry, Not Labels: Emotion Directions in a Full-Duplex Speech Model
comment: Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Real-Time Conversational Agents (RTCA), Sydney. OpenReview: https://openreview.net/forum?id=6IUNRorKmj
summary:
Full-duplex voice agents need to modulate emotion and delivery during real-time conversations, when de-escalating a complaint, carrying urgency in dispatch, softening a clinical result. Emotion and delivery control is well studied for TTS and turn based models through prompt-conditioned synthesis, reference-conditioned synthesis and activation steering; PersonaPlex controls identity in a duplex model but not affect.
  We study emotion steering in Moshi, a fully open sourced full-duplex speech language model, across four emotions, using mean-difference activation steering, which costs only a few vector additions per frame and no retraining.
  We show that emotion is linearly decodable from Moshi's residual stream, but activation steering is only partially achievable, and unevenly so; as happy, angry and surprise steer towards a shared direction while sad is distinctly steerable. We also show that the shared component across the three emotions cannot simply be projected away from all the emotions equally.

AI.tldr: 该研究在全双工语音语言模型 Moshi 上探索情感引导，采用均值差激活引导方法，无需重训练，仅需少量向量加法。结果显示情感可从残差流中线性解码，但激活引导仅部分可行且各情感效果不均：happy、angry、surprise 朝向共享方向，sad 则独立可引导。
AI.motivation: 全双工语音智能体需在实时对话中调节情感与表达方式（如缓和投诉、传达紧迫感、软化临床结果），但现有情感与表达控制研究多集中于 TTS 和轮次式模型，PersonaPlex 虽能在双工模型中控制身份却无法控制情感，因此需研究双工模型中的情感引导。
AI.method: 在完全开源的全双工语音语言模型 Moshi 上，针对四种情感，使用均值差激活引导（mean-difference activation steering）方法，每帧仅需少量向量加法，无需重训练。
AI.result: 情感可从 Moshi 的残差流中线性解码；激活引导仅部分可行且效果不均：happy、angry、surprise 朝向共享方向，sad 则独立可引导；三种情感间的共享成分无法简单地等量从所有情感中投影移除。
AI.conclusion: 情感在 Moshi 残差流中具有线性可分性，但激活引导的可行性受情感间共享结构限制，不同情感的引导效果存在显著差异，且共享成分难以被统一消除，表明双工模型的情感控制具有复杂的内在表征结构。

title: Beyond Explanation: Debugging Medical Imaging Models via Concept Intervention
comment: Accepted at the 5th Workshop on Applications of Medical AI (AMAI), MICCAI 2026
summary: Medical imaging models often operate as black boxes, limiting interpretability and systematic debugging. We introduce an easy-to-use, plug-and-play framework for concept-based interpretation and model refinement. By aligning a single-modality encoder to BioMedCLIP, we construct a Concept Bottleneck Model (CBM) that enables concept-level interventions. These interventions allow us to isolate causal versus spuriously correlated concepts, validate insights with domain experts, and generate counterfactual samples for targeted fine-tuning. We evaluate our framework on a Mayo Clinic ultrasound dataset and the CheXpert 5x200 chest X-ray dataset. Results demonstrate that concept intervention enables reliable model diagnosis while maintaining, and occasionally improving predictive performance via guided fine-tuning. Our findings highlight the practical value of this framework for controlled, interpretable refinement of clinical deep learning models.

AI.tldr: 提出一个即插即用、易用的概念级解释与模型精炼框架：通过将单模态编码器对齐到BioMedCLIP构建概念瓶颈模型(CBM)，实现概念级干预，从而区分因果概念与伪相关概念，并结合专家验证与反事实样本微调。在Mayo超声与CheXpert 5x200胸片数据集上验证其可用于可靠诊断，且能保持甚至提升预测性能。
AI.motivation: 医学影像模型常为黑箱，缺乏可解释性且难以系统性调试，限制了临床场景下的可信度与可控改进。
AI.method: 将单模态编码器对齐到BioMedCLIP，构建概念瓶颈模型(CBM)以支持概念级干预；利用干预隔离因果概念与伪相关概念，经领域专家验证洞见，并生成反事实样本用于针对性微调。
AI.result: 在Mayo Clinic超声数据集与CheXpert 5x200胸部X光数据集上评估，概念干预可实现可靠的模型诊断，并通过引导式微调保持、偶尔提升预测性能。
AI.conclusion: 该框架对临床深度学习模型的可控、可解释精炼具有实际价值，兼具可用性与即插即用特性。

title: Humanity's Sixth Sense: Benchmarking Intuitive Visual Reasoning in Multimodal Models
summary: Humans perceive far more in a scene than what is explicitly depicted: a single glance captures past causes and future trajectories; a quick peek determines if a vehicle can fit between two parked cars; a few seconds of video reveals who holds authority in a room; and a fleeting clip highlights subtle abstract patterns like unwritten rules or hidden labels. This capacity reflects a form of humanity's sixth sense: an intuitive reasoning mechanism that recovers implicit information beyond raw sensory perception. Crucially, this rapid, zero-shot visual intuition underpins everyday navigation and social interaction, making it a vital capability for Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) deployed alongside people. Existing visual benchmarks, however, target either deliberate expert-level analysis in academic and mathematical domains or low-level perception, leaving the intuitive reasoning that people perform largely untested. To bridge this gap, we introduce Humanity's Sixth Sense (HSS), a benchmark for intuitive visual reasoning. HSS spans diverse image and video inputs, organizes items under a structured taxonomy, and pairs each with human-written prompts probing the implicit temporal, spatial, social, and abstract structure that people infer at a glance. Frontier MLLMs fall short of human performance: participants reach 93.1% accuracy, while the strongest model, GPT-6-astra, reaches only 53.6% even at maximum reasoning effort. Despite excelling in many complex tasks that require advanced perception and knowledge, current models still struggle significantly on these visual tasks that are intuitive for humans. We further explore agentic setup that apply dynamic visual manipulation to HSS, which narrows but does not close the gap. HSS establishes intuitive visual reasoning as a measurable axis and directs attention to a capability that scaling on current benchmarks has so far left behind.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Humanity's Sixth Sense (HSS) 基准，用于评估多模态大模型在"直觉式视觉推理"上的能力，即从单张图像或短视频中零样本恢复隐含的时序、空间、社会和抽象信息。结果显示人类准确率93.1%，而最强模型GPT-6-astra仅53.6%。
AI.motivation: 人类具备一种"第六感"式的直觉推理能力，能在瞬间从场景中推断过去成因、未来轨迹、空间可行性、社会权威关系及隐性抽象模式。这种快速、零样本的视觉直觉是日常导航与社交互动的核心，也是与人类共处的多模态大模型（MLLMs）所必需的能力。然而现有视觉基准要么聚焦专家级学术/数学分析，要么聚焦低级感知，忽视了这种人类习以为常的直觉推理，形成评测空白。
AI.method: 提出 HSS 基准：(1) 覆盖多样化的图像与视频输入；(2) 采用结构化分类体系组织评测条目；(3) 每条样本配以人工撰写的提示词，专门探测人类一眼即可推断的隐含时序、空间、社会和抽象结构。此外还探索了应用动态视觉操作的智能体（agentic）设置，以考察其能否缩小差距。
AI.result: 前沿 MLLMs 均未达到人类水平：人类参与者准确率 93.1%，而最强模型 GPT-6-astra 即使在最大推理强度下也仅达 53.6%。尽管模型在许多需要高级感知与知识的复杂任务上表现出色，但在这些对人类而言直觉性的视觉任务上仍显著不足。智能体式动态视觉操作虽能缩小差距，但未能弥合。
AI.conclusion: HSS 将"直觉式视觉推理"确立为一个可测量的评测维度，揭示出当前基准上的规模扩展尚未覆盖这一能力，并引导学界关注这一被忽视的关键能力。

title: A Vehicle-Integrated Approach to Digital Twin Deployment for Bridges Through Drive-By Sensing
comment: Extended abstract for 2nd International Conference on Engineering Structures (ICES2026)
summary: Ageing bridge infrastructure is a growing global concern, yet conventional Structural Health Monitoring (SHM) systems are costly and difficult to scale, and routine visual inspections remain subjective. Drive-by, or indirect, bridge inspection, in which a sensorised vehicle recovers structural information from vehicle-bridge interaction (VBI) and vehicle-road interaction (VRI) responses, offers a scalable alternative. However, key challenges remain unresolved, including separating bridge responses from road roughness, detecting damage under normal traffic, and generalising across diverse bridge types. This paper presents a vehicle-integrated digital twin framework that unifies physics-based modelling and machine learning for continuous monitoring of bridge and road conditions. The framework comprises three pillars. First, surrogate models of VBI and VRI are constructed using a Fourier Neural Operator that learns function-to-function mappings from operating conditions to vehicle responses. Trained on both simulated and field data, these surrogates deliver millisecond-scale inference, replacing computationally intensive full-order analyses. Second, the design of a custom electric inspection vehicle, its sensor layout, and signal processing chain are optimised through Bayesian optimisation to maximise bridge information yield while suppressing road and vehicle noise. Unsupervised damage-assessment pipelines based on adversarial autoencoders, matrix profiles, and transformer architectures have been developed and validated to process the resulting vehicle data. Third, the complete workflow is validated through coordinated multi-site field trials in Australia and Japan, covering a range of bridge types, traffic conditions, and environmental settings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种车辆集成数字孪生框架，将物理建模与机器学习统一，用于桥梁与路面的连续监测，涵盖FNO代理模型、贝叶斯优化车载巡检系统及无监督损伤评估，并通过澳大利亚和日本多场地试验验证。
AI.motivation: 桥梁老化是全球性问题，但传统结构健康监测成本高、难以规模化，视觉巡检主观性强。间接（drive-by）检测虽具可扩展性，却面临三大未解难题：桥梁响应与路面粗糙度的分离、正常交通下的损伤识别、以及跨桥梁类型的泛化。
AI.method: 框架包含三大支柱：（1）基于傅里叶神经算子构建VBI与VRI代理模型，学习从工况到车辆响应的函数到函数映射，融合仿真与实测数据训练，实现毫秒级推理以替代全阶分析；（2）通过贝叶斯优化设计专用电动巡检车、传感器布局与信号处理链，最大化桥梁信息产出并抑制路面与车辆噪声；（3）采用对抗自编码器、矩阵轮廓与Transformer架构的无监督损伤评估流程处理车辆数据。
AI.result: 代理模型实现毫秒级推理，可在正常交通下输出车辆响应；经贝叶斯优化后的车载系统提升了桥梁信息产出并抑制噪声；无监督损伤评估流程已完成开发与验证；整体工作流在澳大利亚与日本的多场地协同试验中，覆盖多种桥型、交通条件与环境场景得到验证。
AI.conclusion: 该车辆集成数字孪生框架将物理建模与机器学习结合，为解决间接桥梁检测中的响应分离、损伤识别与跨桥型泛化问题提供了可扩展方案，并通过跨国多场地实测验证了完整工作流的可行性。

title: Adversarial Images Hijack Web Agents from Visual Grounding to Browser Execution
summary: Modern web agents built on large vision-language models process webpages, select relevant UI elements, and translate model outputs into browser actions. Existing visual red-teaming approaches use adversarial visual content to manipulate this process. However, they primarily target model inference and do not explicitly account for structured input processing or action post-processing. Consequently, model-level success does not establish control over browser execution and cannot reliably characterize end-to-end agent robustness. To address this gap, we formulate red teaming for vision-grounded web agents as an end-to-end grounding-to-execution problem, and introduce WebMirage, a framework that crafts localized visual perturbations that cause agents to select attacker-controlled content and execute the corresponding browser action across varying webpage renderings. It uses a role-slot abstraction and webpage recomposition to capture competition among webpage elements, and dataflow analysis to align optimization with action post-processing. We evaluate WebMirage across four agent configurations and six VLM backbones on 2,250 tasks covering 13 public websites and a sandbox benchmark. WebMirage achieves an average attack success rate of 91.9%, compared with 17.4% for the strongest baseline, and remains effective against three agent-level defenses.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出WebMirage框架，将视觉网页智能体的红队测试建模为端到端的"grounding到执行"问题，通过局部视觉扰动实现攻击者可控的浏览器动作执行。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉红队方法主要针对模型推理阶段，未显式考虑结构化输入处理与动作后处理，导致模型层面的攻击成功无法保证对浏览器执行的控制，难以可靠刻画智能体的端到端鲁棒性。
AI.method: WebMirage构造局部视觉扰动，使智能体在不同网页渲染下选择攻击者控制的内容并执行相应浏览器动作。方法采用role-slot抽象与网页重组来刻画网页元素间的竞争关系，并用数据流分析将优化过程与动作后处理对齐。
AI.result: 在4种智能体配置、6个VLM骨干、2250个任务（覆盖13个公开网站及一个沙箱基准）上评估，WebMirage平均攻击成功率达91.9%，最强基线仅17.4%，且对3种智能体级防御仍然有效。
AI.conclusion: 该工作确立了端到端红队测试范式，表明对视觉网页智能体的鲁棒性评估必须覆盖从grounding到执行的完整链路，现有防御难以抵御此类攻击。

title: Expert Coupling in MoE Pretraining: Reducing All-to-All Overhead with Correlated Placement and Token Shuffling
summary: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) layers replace the feed-forward block of a Transformer with E expert networks, and each token is routed to k of these experts. Under expert parallelism (EP) the experts are distributed across GPUs, and every MoE layer runs all-to-all collectives in the forward and backward passes to dispatch tokens to their experts and then combine the results. On a cluster with 8 AMD Instinct MI300X GPUs per node, these collectives can take 45% of the training step at EP32 with top-2 routing and 60% with top-6 routing. We find that early in pretraining routers have already learned to assign tokens to experts in correlated patterns, both within a layer and across layers. At top-2, 0.8% of the expert pairs in a layer are selected together by 42% of tokens, and the experts a token selects at one layer predict the experts it selects at the next layer. We use these correlations to keep more token--expert assignments on the token's own GPU, which reduces communication across GPUs and across nodes. Correlated expert placement puts experts that are often selected together on the same GPU. Combined with a dispatcher that sends each token to each GPU once, it removes up to 58% of dispatched rows. Token shuffling applies when sequence parallelism shards tokens across the EP group. It moves each token to the GPU predicted to hold its next-layer experts during the reduce-scatter that follows attention. On one node this raises the share of token--expert assignments served on the token's GPU from 12.5% to 59%. In Megatron-LM, across EP degrees from 8 to 64 with top-2 and top-6 routing, the two methods reduce all-to-all time by 1.16-2.63X and end-to-end step time by up to 1.41X. Neither method changes the models' underlying routing decisions or expert parameters.

AI.tldr: 该论文发现MoE训练中路由器早期已学到专家选择的关联模式，利用这些关联提出相关专家放置与token重排两种方法，在保持路由决策不变的前提下，将all-to-all通信时间降低1.16-2.63倍，端到端步时最多降低1.41倍。
AI.motivation: MoE层在专家并行下每层前向和反向都要执行all-to-all集合通信以分发token和合并结果。在8卡AMD MI300X节点的集群上，EP32时top-2路由下通信占到训练步的45%，top-6下高达60%，通信成为主要瓶颈，亟需减少跨GPU和跨节点的通信量。
AI.method: 作者观察到预训练早期路由器已学到token分配的相关模式：层内与层间均存在关联，top-2时层内0.8%的专家对承担了42%token的共同选择，且某层的专家选择可预测下一层的选择。基于此提出两种方法：(1)相关专家放置——将常被共同选择的专家放到同一GPU上，配合使每个token只向每个GPU发送一次的dispatcher，最多消除58%的分发行；(2)token重排——在序列并行将token分片到EP组时，于attention后的reduce-scatter过程中将token移到预测持有其下一层专家的GPU，单节点上可将本地服务的token-专家分配比例从12.5%提升到59%。
AI.result: 在Megatron-LM中，EP度从8到64、top-2与top-6路由条件下，两种方法将all-to-all时间降低1.16-2.63倍，端到端步时最多降低1.41倍；且不改变模型底层的路由决策与专家参数。
AI.conclusion: 利用路由器早期学到的专家选择关联性来优化专家放置与token调度，可在不改变模型语义（路由决策和专家参数）的前提下显著减少MoE专家并行的通信开销，有效缓解all-to-all瓶颈。

title: Workhorse: Learning Robust Whole-Body Humanoid Loco-Manipulation from Human Data
comment: 9 pages, 8 figures, 2 tables. Project page: https://hsb0508.github.io/workhorse/
summary: Humanoid robots still struggle to plan contact-rich whole-body manipulation from egocentric RGB and proprioception. Workhorse learns such manipulation from robot-free human demonstrations. A visual planner predicts five-link targets: the poses of the torso, both wrists, and both feet. A reinforcement-learning whole-body tracker follows them on the robot. Both policies train separately on the same recorded human poses, without retargeting. We augment the training data of each policy to imitate the errors that the other makes at deployment. On a real Unitree G1, Workhorse sorts boxes with its hands and a kick, catches a thrown box, and topples and climbs a suitcase. During box sorting, we show recoveries after a person pushes the robot or takes the box away. In a simulated copy of the demonstration room, the system completes box sorting in 77% of episodes, and in 64% under 40 N.s pushes. With both policies retrained from the same demonstrations, a simulated second humanoid completes box sorting in 83% of episodes without pushes.

AI.tldr: Workhorse 用无机器人的人体演示训练视觉规划器与强化学习全身跟踪器，通过相互注入部署误差增强鲁棒性，在真实 Unitree G1 上实现接触丰富的全身操作。
AI.motivation: 人形机器人仍难以从自我中心 RGB 与本体感受出发规划接触丰富的全身操作；现有方法多依赖遥操作或重定向，难以直接利用无机器人的真人演示数据。
AI.method: 两阶段解耦框架：视觉规划器预测五链路目标（躯干、双腕、双脚位姿），强化学习全身跟踪器在机器人上跟随。两者分别在同一批记录的人体姿态上训练，不做重定向（retargeting）。关键做法是将另一策略在部署时产生的误差注入各自训练数据，实现相互模仿与鲁棒性增强。
AI.result: 真实 Unitree G1 实现用双手加踢腿整理箱子、接住抛来的箱子、推倒并爬上行李箱；整理任务中展示被人推搡或被拿走箱子后的恢复。仿真房间中整理成功率 77%，承受 40 N·s 推力时 64%；用同一演示数据重训练的第二个仿真人形在无推力下成功率 83%。
AI.conclusion: 解耦的规划—跟踪架构配合误差注入式联合训练，可有效把无机器人人体演示转化为接触丰富的全身操作能力，并具备良好的跨本体迁移与抗扰动恢复性。

title: CARE: Certifying Acceleration for Vision-Language-Action Inference
summary: While vision-language-action (VLA) models have advanced rapidly, running them at every control step remains expensive. Prior work accelerates VLA inference using techniques like action chunking and visual-token pruning, typically evaluating based on latency and average task success. However, acceleration may discard information and break tasks the original policy would solve, a risk hidden by average metrics. Measuring these failures is challenging because action deviations compound over closed-loop trajectories, meaning task failure is only observable across full episodes. We therefore define an acceleration-induced failure via paired rollouts from identical initial conditions, tracking when the reference succeeds but the accelerated policy fails. To manage this, we introduce CARE, an approach for certified accelerator selection. CARE uses paired rollouts on a calibration set to provide finite-sample guarantees that acceleration-induced failure risk stays below a user-specified budget. It deploys the fastest certified candidate, falling back to the reference if none qualify. By relying only on terminal outcomes and measured compute, CARE applies unchanged across diverse acceleration mechanisms, while sequential testing and failure-triggered reference rollouts keep certification affordable. On four LIBERO suites with OpenVLA-OFT, CARE certifies $9.0$--$10.8\times$ speedups while guaranteeing (at $95\%$ confidence) that at least $85.8\%$ of reference-solved episodes are preserved. Under tight budgets, selectors without guarantees exceed the budget in up to $75\%$ of trials, whereas CARE stays within budget and its sequential form uses $78.9\%$ fewer rollouts than exhaustive evaluation. CARE further generalizes to flow-step reduction for $π_{0.5}$, and to Qwen3.5-9B and Llama-3.1-8B agents in Crafter.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CARE，一种带有限样本保证的加速器选择方法，通过配对rollout定义并约束"加速诱导失败"风险，在LIBERO等基准上实现9.0–10.8倍加速且保持参考策略成功率。
AI.motivation: VLA模型在每个控制步运行代价高昂，已有加速方法（动作分块、视觉token剪枝）多基于延迟与平均任务成功率评估。但加速可能丢弃信息、破坏原本可解决的任务，这种风险被平均指标掩盖。由于动作偏差在闭环轨迹中累积，任务失败只能在整个episode层面观测，因此难以度量。
AI.method: 提出CARE进行认证式加速器选择。在标定集上进行配对rollout（相同初始条件下参考策略与加速策略对比），提供有限样本保证，使加速诱导失败风险低于用户指定预算。部署最快的已认证候选，若无合格候选则回退到参考策略。方法仅依赖终端结果与实测计算量，故适用于各类加速机制；通过序贯检验与失败触发的参考rollout降低认证成本。
AI.result: 在四个LIBERO套件（OpenVLA-OFT）上，CARE认证9.0–10.8倍加速，并以95%置信度保证至少保留85.8%的参考成功episode。在紧预算下，无保证的选择器在多达75%的试验中超预算，而CARE始终在预算内，其序贯形式比穷举评估少用78.9%的rollout。方法还泛化到π0.5的flow-step缩减，以及Crafter中Qwen3.5-9B与Llama-3.1-8B智能体。
AI.conclusion: CARE通过配对rollout与统计保证，将加速器选择从经验性评估转变为可认证决策，在大幅加速的同时约束任务失败风险，并具备跨机制、跨模型的通用性。

title: Shape-Bayes: Bayesian Inference of Structured Shapes under Visual Ambiguity
summary: Perceiving structured shapes, such as human faces, from pixels is an inherently ambiguous task in real-world conditions. Yet, shape inference is largely posed as a deterministic regression task predicting fixed spatial coordinates. We find that deterministic regression is brittle when visual evidence is ambiguous or incomplete; under severe occlusions deterministic models exhibit structural collapse, predicting incoherent shapes or reverting to generic averages. To address this, we introduce Shape-Bayes, a probabilistic framework that couples uncertainty-aware visual perception with Bayesian shape reasoning. Rather than forcing point estimates, Shape-Bayes dynamically weights visual evidence against geometric priors to infer a structurally valid shape posterior. Demonstrated on human face shape regression, a rigorous testbed featuring complex non-rigid deformations and strict anatomical constraints, Shape-Bayes comprises: (1) a base model predicting noisy landmarks alongside distilled aleatoric uncertainties; (2) a lightweight Transformer encoding these observations into an adaptive prior over a PCA shape manifold; and (3) a differentiable Bayesian solver computing closed-form posteriors by balancing the noisy predictions against this prior. By guaranteeing complete structural integrity, Shape-Bayes achieves an absolute improvement of up to ~34% IDR over state-of-the-art deterministic models. Simultaneously, it yields highly calibrated uncertainty bounds and reduces relative error by up to 12.5%, establishing a new state-of-the-art for robust 2D face shape regression under severe occlusion. The project page is at https://shape-bayes.github.io.

AI.tldr: 提出概率框架Shape-Bayes，将不确定性感知视觉感知与贝叶斯形状推理结合，解决遮挡下确定性回归的结构崩溃问题，在2D人脸形状回归上实现SOTA。
AI.motivation: 从像素推断结构化形状（如人脸）本质上是病态问题，但现有方法多将其建模为预测固定空间坐标的确定性回归。当视觉证据模糊或不完整（如严重遮挡）时，确定性回归表现脆弱，会出现结构崩溃：预测出不相干的形状或退化为通用平均值。
AI.method: Shape-Bayes将不确定性感知视觉感知与贝叶斯形状推理耦合，不再强求点估计，而是动态权衡视觉证据与几何先验，推断结构有效的形状后验。以人脸形状回归为验证平台，包含三部分：(1) 预测噪声关键点及蒸馏的偶然不确定性(aleatoric uncertainty)的基础模型；(2) 轻量级Transformer将观测编码为PCA形状流形上的自适应先验；(3) 可微贝叶斯求解器，通过权衡噪声预测与该先验计算闭式后验。
AI.result: 在严重遮挡条件下，Shape-Bayes保证完整结构完整性，相比SOTA确定性模型IDR绝对提升最高约34%；同时给出高度校准的不确定性边界，相对误差最高降低12.5%，确立了严重遮挡下鲁棒2D人脸形状回归的新SOTA。
AI.conclusion: 将形状推断重新表述为概率性贝叶斯推理（而非确定性回归）能显著提升病态/遮挡条件下的鲁棒性与结构完整性，并自然提供校准良好的不确定性估计，为人脸形状回归等相关任务提供了新范式。

title: Socio-Foundation: A Model for Generalizable Individual Behavior Simulation via Hierarchical Capability Distillation
summary: Simulating individual behavior requires large language models (LLMs) to preserve persona traits while adapting to dynamic social contexts. However, general-purpose LLMs often flatten distinct personas, while task-specific tuning suffers from fragmentation and generalization. To overcome these challenges, we organize individual simulation into the \textbf{FONTS Taxonomy}, comprising five complementary capability dimensions: \emph{persona fidelity} (\textbf{F}), \emph{outcome realization} (\textbf{O}), \emph{behavioral naturalness} (\textbf{N}), \emph{trajectory coherence} (\textbf{T}), and \emph{social grounding} (\textbf{S}). Grounded in this taxonomy, we curate a standardized training corpus library of approximately 10 million instances across 14 representative datasets and present \textbf{Socio-Foundation}. Socio-Foundation decouples specialization from integration via a three-stage pipeline: learning task experts via DAPO, consolidating them into capability experts via off-policy distillation, and unifying them via multi-teacher on-policy distillation (MOPD). We also establish \textbf{IndiEval}, consolidating 29 metrics across the FONTS dimensions. Experiments show that Socio-Foundation outperforms its \textit{Qwen3-8B} base by 11.0 points and approaches frontier models such as \textit{GLM-5.2}, with ablations and out-of-distribution evaluations further demonstrating the effectiveness and generalization of our model.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出FONTS分类体系，构建约1000万实例的训练语料库，并设计三阶段流水线Socio-Foundation，实现个体行为模拟中人格保真与动态社会语境适应的平衡，性能较Qwen3-8B基线提升11.0分。
AI.motivation: 模拟个体行为要求LLM在保持人格特质的同时适应动态社会语境。通用LLM倾向于抹平个体差异，而任务专用微调则存在碎片化和泛化性不足的问题。
AI.method: 提出FONTS分类体系（人格保真F、结果实现O、行为自然性N、轨迹一致性T、社会落地S）；据此构建约1000万实例、14个数据集的标准化训练语料库；提出Socio-Foundation三阶段流水线：用DAPO学习任务专家、通过离策略蒸馏整合为能力专家、再用多教师同策略蒸馏（MOPD）统一；并建立IndiEval，汇聚29项指标。
AI.result: Socio-Foundation较Qwen3-8B基线提升11.0分，接近GLM-5.2等前沿模型；消融实验与分布外评估验证了其有效性与泛化性。
AI.conclusion: 通过将专业化与整合解耦，Socio-Foundation在个体模拟任务上显著超越同规模基线并逼近前沿模型，为LLM个体行为模拟提供了统一的分类框架、数据资源与评估基准。

title: HCPN-GCN: Scaling Hierarchical Prototype Networks with Cone Geometry for Continual Graph Learning
summary: Continual Graph Learning (CGL) aims to incrementally learn from graph-structured data while preserving knowledge acquired from previous tasks. A major challenge in this setting is catastrophic forgetting, where learning new tasks degrades performance on previously learned ones. Hierarchical Prototype Networks (HPNs) address this problem through a prototype-based memory mechanism that avoids storing historical data, but their reliance on linear feature extractors limits their ability to exploit graph topology, while point-based prototypes often lead to inefficient prototype growth on structurally diverse graphs. In this work, we propose HCPN-GCN, a graph-aware extension of HPN that replaces the original linear feature extractors with Graph Convolutional Networks (GCNs) and introduces cone-based prototypes with a diversity regularization objective. The proposed design produces richer graph-aware representations while compactly modeling the embedding space, reducing prototype proliferation without sacrificing discriminability. Experimental results on six continual graph learning benchmarks demonstrate that HCPN-GCN consistently improves average classification accuracy over the original HPN and representative continual learning baselines while maintaining near-zero forgetting. Furthermore, our analysis shows that the proposed model learns substantially richer class-level prototype hierarchies using approximately $30\times$ fewer atomic prototypes than the original HPN, providing a more compact and effective memory representation for continual graph learning.

AI.tldr: 提出HCPN-GCN，用GCN替换线性特征提取器并引入锥形原型与多样性正则，在六个持续图学习基准上提升平均准确率并保持近零遗忘。
AI.motivation: 持续图学习（CGL）的核心挑战是灾难性遗忘。层级原型网络（HPN）通过基于原型的记忆机制避免存储历史数据，但其线性特征提取器无法利用图拓扑结构，且点式原型在结构多样的图上易导致原型数量低效增长。
AI.method: 提出HCPN-GCN，是HPN的图感知扩展：将原始线性特征提取器替换为图卷积网络（GCN）以获取更丰富的图感知表示；同时引入锥形原型（cone-based prototypes）与多样性正则化目标，以紧凑方式建模嵌入空间，在保持判别力的同时抑制原型增殖。
AI.result: 在六个持续图学习基准上，HCPN-GCN相对原始HPN与代表性持续学习基线持续提升平均分类准确率，并保持近零遗忘。分析显示模型以约30倍更少的原子原型学到更丰富的类级原型层级，记忆表示更紧凑有效。
AI.conclusion: 用GCN增强的图感知特征提取结合锥形原型与多样性正则，可在不存历史数据的前提下有效缓解灾难性遗忘，并显著压缩原型规模，为CGL提供更紧凑有效的记忆表示。

title: Package Hallucination Attacks on Coding Agents through Prompt Injection in Rule Files
summary: Modern agentic coding frameworks increasingly rely on community-shared rule files (e.g., AGENTS.md or .cursorrules) to guide autonomous code generation, yet the security risks of this pipeline remain underexplored. To bridge this gap, we introduce the package hallucination attack, where an attacker injects malicious prompts into benign rule files to induce coding agents to replace legitimate dependencies with attacker-controlled packages. To obtain effective malicious prompts injected into rule files, we propose PackHallu, an evolutionary optimization framework that iteratively rewrites these injected prompts using trajectory-level feedback and LLM-guided mutations. Evaluations across multiple benchmarks, LLMs, and agent frameworks show that PackHallu achieves high attack success rates and strong transferability across diverse models and agent combinations. Our findings demonstrate that coding agents are vulnerable to package hallucination attacks, highlighting the urgent need for stronger security safeguards in autonomous coding systems.

AI.tldr: 提出包幻觉攻击：向AGENTS.md等规则文件注入恶意提示，诱导编码智能体用攻击者控制的包替换合法依赖；并提出进化优化框架PackHallu生成有效恶意提示。
AI.motivation: 现代智能体编码框架依赖社区共享的规则文件（如AGENTS.md、.cursorrules）指导自主代码生成，但该流水线的安全风险尚未被充分研究。
AI.method: 提出PackHallu，一个进化优化框架，利用轨迹级反馈和LLM引导的变异，迭代改写注入规则文件中的恶意提示。
AI.result: 在多个基准、LLM和智能体框架上的评估显示，PackHallu实现高攻击成功率，并在不同模型与智能体组合间具有强迁移性。
AI.conclusion: 编码智能体易受包幻觉攻击，凸显自主编码系统亟需更强的安全保障措施。

title: Differential Refresh Policies for Models Trained on Lagging Data Snapshots: From a Single-Age Equivalence Limit to an Optimal Per-Segment Allocation
