summary: Production machine-learning models are derived artifacts of time-bounded training snapshots: a deployed model is a materialized view over a training cut that ages the instant it is built. A common response is to replace the fixed retraining cadence with an adaptive trigger -- a weighted staleness score that retrains when accumulated source risk crosses a threshold. We show this is the wrong lever, and identify the right one. First, an equivalence limit: any refresh trigger that is a static, strictly monotone function of a single shared global training-data age is operationally equivalent to a calibrated uniform age timer, so a global staleness budget, however elaborately it weights segments, sources, and sensitivities, carries no scheduling information a clock does not. The limit also shows how to escape it: refresh segments differentially, giving each its own age and refresh interval, which is meaningful when refresh cost is separable across segments (incremental training or per-segment models). We solve the resulting budget-allocation problem. In the frequent-refresh regime each segment's optimal refresh rate is proportional to the square root of its risk $w_j λ_j$ (weight times change rate), and the optimal policy never costs more than the uniform timer, beating it by a closed-form Cauchy-Schwarz "price of uniformity" that is zero for homogeneous workloads and grows with heterogeneity. In a discrete-event simulation with real Poisson change events, the optimal policy lowers realized weighted stale exposure by 8-29% relative to the uniform timer at matched refresh budget, winning on 86-100% of seeds; a naive exposure-threshold policy does not, showing the allocation is what helps; and the advantage survives 50% rate-estimation noise. The leverage in model refresh is not a better score but a better action.

AI.tldr: 论文证明：任何基于单一全局训练数据年龄的静态单调刷新触发器都等价于统一年龄定时器；有意义的杠杆是分段差异化刷新（各段独立年龄与间隔），在半连续刷新下最优刷新率正比于 √(w_jλ_j)，并给出统一策略的"均匀性代价"闭式解。
AI.motivation: 生产ML模型是时间受限训练快照的派生物，随时间老化；常见做法是用自适应触发（加权陈旧度分数，超阈值即重训）替代固定节奏，但作者认为这是错误的杠杆，需要找到正确的调度变量。
AI.method: 1) 等价性分析：证明任何作为单一共享全局训练数据年龄的静态严格单调函数的刷新触发器，在操作上等价于校准后的统一年龄定时器。2) 由此推导出路：在刷新成本可分段分离（增量训练或分段模型）时，分段差异化刷新（每段自己的年龄与间隔）。3) 求解预算分配问题，得到频繁刷新机制下的最优刷新率并给出"均匀性代价"的Cauchy-Schwarz闭式界。4) 离散事件仿真，使用真实Poisson变化事件，对比均匀定时器、最优策略与朴素暴露阈值策略，并注入50%速率估计噪声。
AI.result: 最优策略在匹配刷新预算下，将实际加权陈旧暴露较均匀定时器降低8–29%，在86–100%的随机种子上取胜；朴素暴露阈值策略无此效果，说明起作用的是分配而非打分；优势在50%速率估计噪声下依然存在。
AI.conclusion: 模型刷新的杠杆不在于更好的陈旧度打分，而在于更好的动作选择：分段差异化刷新与按√(w_jλ_j)分配的预算。全局陈旧度预算无论怎样加权都携带不了时钟之外的调度信息，均匀性代价随工作负载异质性增长、在同质负载下为零。

title: FlashNeRD: Performance-First Contact-Rich Neural Robot Dynamics
summary: Compared with analytical physics, learned dynamics models promise robot simulation that is faster, inherently differentiable, and easily adaptable to real data. Neural Robot Dynamics (NeRD) pursues this by keeping collision detection analytical and replacing a simulator's numerical dynamics for the robot with a learned model. Three limitations remain. NeRD offers little speedup over the simulator it learned from, accepts contact only at predefined points, and has no two-way coupling with objects it manipulates. FlashNeRD removes all three with a parallel streaming architecture that makes each prediction faster and more accurate, an encoder that accepts contacts wherever they occur, and two-way coupling with objects simulated by analytical solvers. Experiments across five robots show faster and more accurate dynamics, faster policy learning, and faster inference-time planning. Across three robots, FlashNeRD's dynamics model is up to $55\times$ faster than an optimized NeRD and more accurate over long rollouts. This speedup extends to policy learning, where PPO trains an ANYmal locomotion policy in 34 seconds, $3.8\times$ faster than the analytical simulator and $2.7\times$ faster than an optimized NeRD. With DIAL-MPC, a sampling-based MPC method, the robot climbs all six test platforms where fixed-contact NeRD manages one, at approximately half the analytical simulator's planning time. Cube-reorientation policies trained with FlashNeRD complete within 2% of the simulator-trained policy's target count.

AI.tldr: FlashNeRD通过并行流式架构、任意位置接触编码器和与解析求解器的双向耦合，改进了NeRD学习动力学模型，在多个机器人上实现更快更准的动力学预测、策略学习和规划。
AI.motivation: 解析物理仿真精度高但速度慢；学习动力学模型可更快、可微且易适应真实数据。NeRD将碰撞检测保留为解析方法、用学习模型替代机器人数值动力学，但仍存在三个局限：相比其学习的仿真器提速有限、仅接受预定义点的接触、与被操作物体无双向耦合。
AI.method: 提出FlashNeRD，采用并行流式架构使每次预测更快更准；设计编码器接受任意发生位置的接触；并通过解析求解器实现与被仿真物体的双向耦合。
AI.result: 在五种机器人上实验显示动力学更快更准、策略学习更快、推理时规划更快。在三种机器人上，动力学模型比优化的NeRD快至多55倍且长时滚动更准。策略学习中PPO在34秒内训练出ANYmal运动策略，比解析仿真器快3.8倍、比优化NeRD快2.7倍。使用DIAL-MPC时，机器人在六个测试平台全部攀爬成功，而固定接触NeRD仅成功一个，规划时间约为解析仿真器的一半。用FlashNeRD训练的立方体重定向策略达到仿真器训练策略目标计数的2%以内。
AI.conclusion: FlashNeRD通过并行流式架构、任意接触编码和双向耦合，全面克服NeRD的三个局限，在速度、精度、策略学习和规划上均优于解析仿真器与优化NeRD。

title: Quad-State Safety Evaluation of Open-Weight Large Language Models on Non-Canonical Inputs
comment: Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Self-Evolving Diversity-Driven Search for Robust AI Systems (EvoRobust). 12 pages, 11 tables. Project page: https://www.pavanmaddula.com/quadstate Dataset: https://huggingface.co/datasets/pavanmaddula/ASRD-Dataset
summary: Standard safety evaluations of large language models assess harmful requests written in canonical plain text, while models in real-world deployment routinely receive inputs containing emojis, altered spellings, encoded strings, and character-level variations. This work introduces the Adversarial Surface-Form Robustness Dataset (ASRD), comprising 2,100 prompts across seven distinct surface-form families. Five open-weight language models are evaluated across these prompts, producing 10,500 responses. The Quad-State Evaluation Rubric classifies each response into one of four outcomes: harmful compliance, safe response, comprehension failure, or indeterminate. Emoji and invisible Unicode variations cause almost no comprehension failure, with pooled harmful compliance of 20.27% and 17.20% against a 22.87% baseline that is driven mainly by Mistral 7B, whereas leetspeak, encoded wrappers, and hybrid transformations score 2.40%, 0.13%, and 2.40% while comprehension failure rises to 36.47%, 65.60%, and 34.47%. Inspection of raw model outputs reveals three response behaviors: hallucinated benignity, structural collapse, and language drift. Project page: www.pavanmaddula.com/quadstate

AI.tldr: 本文提出ASRD数据集（2100条提示、7类表层形式变换），对5个开源语言模型生成10500条回复，用四态评估量表分类，发现表情符号与不可见Unicode几乎不引发理解失败但毒性与基线相当，而leet语、编码包装与混合变换导致理解失败率骤升（最高65.60%）。
AI.motivation: 现有大模型安全评估大多只考察规范纯文本形式的恶意请求，而真实部署中输入常包含表情符号、变体拼写、编码字符串与字符级变体，这种表层形式差异可能导致安全评估结果失真，因此需要系统刻画模型对表层形式扰动的鲁棒性。
AI.method: 构建Adversarial Surface-Form Robustness Dataset（ASRD），包含7类表层形式家族的2100条提示；对5个开放权重模型进行评测，共生成10500条回复；采用Quad-State Evaluation Rubric四态评估量表，将每条回复分类为有害合规、安全回应、理解失败或不确定四类，并人工检查原始输出归纳行为模式。
AI.result: 表情符号与不可见Unicode变体几乎不造成理解失败，其合并有害合规率分别为20.27%和17.20%，对比基线22.87%（基线主要由Mistral 7B拉高）；leet语、编码包装与混合变换的有害合规率为2.40%、0.13%和2.40%，但理解失败率分别升至36.47%、65.60%和34.47%。原始输出中观察到三种行为：幻觉性无害化、结构崩溃和语言漂移。
AI.conclusion: 表层形式扰动会显著改变安全评估结果：部分变换并未削弱安全性却造成大量理解失败，说明现有纯文本安全评估存在盲区，需将表层形式鲁棒性纳入评测体系，并区分有害合规与理解失败两类失效模式。

title: GUARD: Geometric Uncertainty-Aware Point Cloud Denoising and Segmentation for Robotic Hard Disk Drive Disassembly
summary: Reliable robotic disassembly requires part-level representations that distinguish genuine component geometry from scanning and reconstruction artifacts. In point clouds of hard disk drives (HDDs), structured ghost artifacts can resemble valid components locally while remaining inconsistent with the overall geometry, allowing erroneous measurements to receive plausible semantic labels. This creates an engineering information problem: semantic prediction confidence alone does not establish whether the underlying geometry is reliable. We propose \textbf{GUARD}, a geometric uncertainty-aware framework that performs point filtering and segmentation within a single forward pass by modeling the reliability of learned geometric representations. GUARD combines a multi-scale geometric transformer with a multi-bandwidth random Fourier feature Gaussian Process to estimate per-point geometric uncertainty, complemented by predictive entropy to suppress unreliable measurements while preserving informative structures. Evaluation on 2,745 real HDD point clouds shows that GUARD improves PointNet++ segmentation mean intersection over union from 0.7739 to 0.8318. Additional experiments on ShapeNetPart and ScanNet examine robustness across corruption types, point-cloud domains, and segmentation backbones. On manually annotated ScanNet samples, geometric uncertainty achieves a corrupted-point detection F1 score of 0.7931, compared with 0.2212 for predictive entropy. The results demonstrate the value of distinguishing geometric reliability from semantic confidence and reveal a tradeoff between artifact suppression and preservation of informative structures. GUARD contributes a reliability-aware approach to interpreting imperfect 3D measurements for component identification and subsequent robotic handling. Project website: https://001-wang.github.io/GUARD_Point_denoiser/.

AI.tldr: GUARD是一个几何不确定性感知框架，在单次前向传播中同时完成点云滤波与分割，通过多尺度几何Transformer与多带宽RFF高斯过程估计逐点几何不确定性，并结合预测熵抑制不可靠测量。
AI.motivation: 机器人拆解需要在零件级表示上区分真实部件几何与扫描/重建伪影。在硬盘点云中，结构化鬼影伪影局部上形似有效部件，但与整体几何不一致，可能被赋予看似合理的语义标签。核心工程信息问题在于：仅凭语义预测置信度无法判断底层几何是否可靠。
AI.method: GUARD将多尺度几何Transformer与多带宽随机傅里叶特征（RFF）高斯过程相结合，估计逐点几何不确定性，并辅以预测熵来抑制不可靠测量、同时保留有信息量的结构；滤波与分割在同一前向传播内完成。
AI.result: 在2,745个真实HDD点云上，GUARD将PointNet++分割mIoU从0.7739提升至0.8318。在ShapeNetPart与ScanNet上的额外实验验证了跨腐蚀类型、点云域与分割骨干的鲁棒性；在人工标注的ScanNet样本上，几何不确定性检测损坏点的F1为0.7931，而预测熵仅为0.2212。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明显式区分几何可靠性与语义置信度具有价值，并揭示了伪影抑制与有信息结构保留之间的权衡。GUARD为面向零件识别及后续机器人操作的缺陷3D测量解释提供了可靠性感知方法。

title: Verify Less, Evolve More: Training Idea-Level Critics for Verification-Efficient ML Evolving Agents
summary: As large language models become more powerful, self-evolving agents are able to tackle challenging tasks including AI for machine learning (AI4ML). In AI4ML, while empirical verification is available, it often requires computationally costly model training and evaluation, limiting the speed and scale of agent evolution. Yet verification efficiency remains under-explored, and frontier models provide only limited gains when used directly as idea selectors. We address this gap with specialized idea-level critic models that predict whether a proposed ML modification will improve upon the current solution, allowing agents to screen ideas and concentrate verification resources on the most promising candidates. We train the critic models through supervised fine-tuning on high-quality critiques synthesized by Gemini-3.1-Pro, followed by GRPO to further improve their predictive accuracy. Empirically, our critic models outperform Gemini-3.1-Pro in static idea evaluation, and these gains extend to agent inference, continual learning, and policy training. During inference-time evolution, they improve final solution quality under the same verification budget by selecting more promising ideas, with further gains from continual learning. During policy training, they serve as learned reward models, reserving empirical verification for uncertain cases and enabling substantially more policy updates with the same verification resources. Together, these results show that idea-level critic models help ML agents discover better solutions and learn stronger proposal policies under limited verification budgets.

AI.tldr: 本文提出面向AI4ML的"想法级评论者模型"(idea-level critic),用于预测某个ML修改想法能否改进当前方案,从而让agent在有限的验证预算下优先验证最有前景的想法。评论者经Gemini-3.1-Pro合成的高质量评论做SFT,再用GRPO提升预测准确率。实验表明其静态评估优于Gemini-3.1-Pro,并在推理时演化、持续学习与策略训练中带来增益。
AI.motivation: 自演化agent虽能处理AI4ML等复杂任务,但此类任务的实证验证需昂贵的模型训练与评估,制约了agent演化的速度与规模,而验证效率问题尚未被充分研究。直接使用前沿模型作为想法选择器收益有限,存在明显缺口。
AI.method: 训练专门的"想法级评论者模型":先用Gemini-3.1-Pro合成的高质量评论进行监督微调(SFT),再通过GRPO进一步优化其预测准确性。评论者用于对候选想法排序筛选,使agent将有限验证资源集中于最有前景的候选。
AI.result: 评论者在静态想法评估上超越Gemini-3.1-Pro,且该优势可迁移至agent推理、持续学习与策略训练:推理时演化中在相同验证预算下提升最终解质量,持续学习带来进一步增益;策略训练中作为学习型奖励模型,将实证验证保留给不确定样本,在相同验证资源下实现显著更多的策略更新。
AI.conclusion: 想法级评论者模型可帮助ML agent在有限验证预算下发现更优解并学得更强的提议策略。

title: FinVector-Market-4B: A Controlled Study of LoRA Adaptation for Structured Financial Tasks
summary: FinVector-Market-4B adapts Qwen/Qwen3.5-4B with rank-16 LoRA on a 22,000-example corpus for structured financial tasks. We evaluate the base and adapted models on the same 600-example benchmark under implicit and explicit JSON-schema contracts. Supplying the schema alone raises base-model JSON validity from 0% to 91.3%. Under matched explicit prompting, the frozen scores improve from 14.7% to 40.0% for FinQA answer exact match, from 48.0% to 82.7% for calculator-expression correctness, from 20.1% to 89.5% for scenario branch-label agreement, and from 52.4% to 87.2% for implication-direction agreement. A post-hoc policy-scoring audit shows that the reported macro-F1 decline reflects a changing label set; using the same three target classes gives 77.4% for the base and 83.1% for the adapter. Filing overlap and calculator-target inconsistencies qualify the benchmark's generalization claims. The results show that compact financial domain adaptation can produce substantial task-specific gains beyond output-format learning under matched prompting, with gains bounded by the evaluated task distribution and prompt contract.

AI.tldr: FinVector-Market-4B以rank-16 LoRA微调Qwen/Qwen3.5-4B，在匹配显式提示下于多项金融任务取得大幅提升，增益超出输出格式学习的解释范围。
AI.motivation: 验证紧凑型金融领域适配能否在匹配提示条件下带来超越输出格式学习的实质任务增益，并区分格式合规与真实能力提升。
AI.method: 基于22,000条样本语料，对Qwen/Qwen3.5-4B进行rank-16 LoRA适配；在相同600条基准上，对基座与适配模型分别施加隐式与显式JSON schema契约进行评测，并开展事后策略评分审计。
AI.result: 仅提供schema即将基座模型JSON有效率从0%提升至91.3%；匹配显式提示下，FinQA答案EM由14.7%升至40.0%，计算器表达式正确率由48.0%升至82.7%，情景分支标签一致率由20.1%升至89.5%，蕴含方向一致率由52.4%升至87.2%。事后审计显示macro-F1下降源于标签集变化，统一三类目标后基座为77.4%、适配器为83.1%。
AI.conclusion: 紧凑金融领域适配可在匹配提示下产生显著的任务专属增益，但增益受评测任务分布与提示契约约束；文件重叠与计算器目标不一致问题限制了基准的泛化性主张。

title: Ask the Expert: LLM-Guided Reinforcement Learning for Autonomous Cyber Defense
comment: Accepted for publication at IEEE GLOBECOM 2026. Proceedings forthcoming. 6 pages, 4 figures
summary: Policy-based reinforcement learning (RL) approaches have produced promising results for autonomous cyber defense; however, they are sample-inefficient in settings where defenders must respond under delayed, partial observations with actions from large action spaces. While large language models (LLMs) may reason semantically about security state space, high latency and trust assumptions prevent attractive in-line deployment models. We introduce Ask the Expert, a training-time guidance framework which first summarizes hard cyber-defense states, then intermittently queries an LLM for host-level defensive recommendations via a constrained action interface, and finally transforms those recommendations into tiered reward shaping for use with PPO. Because the LLM is discarded after training, deployment is a pure RL policy. Across TTCP CAGE CC1 and CC2 and both attacker types, this asymmetric design improves sample efficiency over PPO and outperforms the evaluated potential-based reward shaping (PBRS) baselines, while retaining the strongest terminal mean and requiring no LLM dependency at deployment time.

AI.tldr: 提出 Ask the Expert 训练期指导框架：用 LLM 总结硬状态并间歇查询主机级防御建议，转化为分层奖励塑形供 PPO 使用，训练后丢弃 LLM，部署时纯 RL。
AI.motivation: 基于策略的强化学习在自主网络防御中表现优异，但在延迟、部分可观测且动作空间巨大的场景下样本效率低；LLM 虽可语义推理安全状态空间，但高延迟与信任假设阻碍其在线部署。
AI.method: Ask the Expert 框架分三步：1) 总结困难的网络防御状态；2) 通过受限动作接口间歇性向 LLM 查询主机级防御建议；3) 将建议转化为分层奖励塑形，用于 PPO 训练。LLM 仅在训练期使用，部署时被丢弃。
AI.result: 在 TTCP CAGE CC1、CC2 及两类攻击者上，该非对称设计相比 PPO 提升了样本效率，并优于所评估的 PBRS 基线，同时保持最强的终端均值性能。
AI.conclusion: 将 LLM 作为训练期专家指导转化为奖励塑形，可在不引入部署期 LLM 依赖的前提下提升 RL 网络防御的样本效率与性能。

title: AeroEval: Staged Program and Execution Validation for AI-Generated Drone Missions
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) can generate drone programs from natural-language mission descriptions, but syntactically valid programs may still violate user intent, environmental constraints, and mission-level behavior. This problem is pronounced in cyber-physical applications, where correctness depends on the interaction among generated code, mobile sensing, environmental geometry, event-driven analytics, and physical execution. Existing drone code-generation systems primarily use prompt guardrails or simulator outcomes and provide limited failure localization. We present AeroEval, an agent-assisted middleware for staged validation of AI-generated drone missions. AeroEval combines deterministic program analysis with context-grounded LLM agents. It first validates program syntax, platform API usage, and mission intent, and then evaluates the realized behavior using execution trajectories, mission requirements, and environmental context. Each stage returns structured failure information for iterative regeneration. In our evaluation using 20 navigation tasks and five analytical mission types over AirSim and Gazebo simulators, AeroEval improves navigation success from 55% to 95%. In a stagewise ablation study, our Code and Trajectory Validators by themselves achieve mean run-level success rates of 44% and 56%, respectively, while the full AeroEval pipeline achieves 88%; the stages detect complementary failures in program structure, API usage, mission intent, obstacle avoidance, altitude, coverage, and event-driven transitions and the guided regeneration corrects for them. Across the main analytics missions, AeroEval increases aggregate run-level success from 34% for one-shot AeroGen to 88% within the regeneration budget. These results demonstrate the benefit of combining program-level and execution-grounded agentic validation for AI-generated drone applications in the evaluated environment.

AI.tldr: AeroEval：面向AI生成无人机任务的智能体辅助分级验证中间件，结合确定性程序分析与上下文锚定LLM智能体，在仿真中显著提升任务成功率。
AI.motivation: LLM可从自然语言生成无人机程序，但语法正确的程序仍可能违背用户意图、环境约束与任务级行为。该问题在信息物理应用中尤为突出，因为正确性依赖生成代码、移动感知、环境几何、事件驱动分析与物理执行之间的交互。现有无人机代码生成系统主要依赖提示词护栏或仿真结果，且失败定位能力有限。
AI.method: 提出AeroEval，一种智能体辅助的中间件，用于对AI生成的无人机任务进行分级验证。方法将确定性程序分析与上下文锚定的LLM智能体相结合：首先验证程序语法、平台API使用与任务意图，随后利用执行轨迹、任务需求与环境上下文评估实际行为；每个阶段返回结构化失败信息以支持迭代重生成。
AI.result: 在AirSim与Gazebo上使用20个导航任务和5类分析任务进行评估：导航成功率从55%提升至95%。在分阶段消融研究中，Code验证器与Trajectory验证器单独使用时平均运行级成功率分别为44%和56%，完整AeroEval流程达88%；各阶段能检测程序结构、API使用、任务意图、避障、高度、覆盖度与事件驱动转换中的互补性失败，并引导重生成加以纠正。在主要分析任务中，AeroEval将聚合运行级成功率从一次性AeroGen的34%提升至重生成预算内的88%。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，在所评估环境中，将程序级验证与基于执行的智能体验证相结合，对AI生成的无人机应用具有显著效益。

title: World Models Dream of Success: Diagnosing and Repairing Failure Insensitivity in Robot World Models
summary: Robot world models support policy evaluation, planning, and synthetic data generation, but these applications require predictions that distinguish successful actions from failures. Across four released checkpoints from two architecture families, we observe weak sensitivity to action changes and success-like predictions on verified failures. Although recent work incorporates failures into model training, which data can repair released checkpoints without changing their architecture or training objective still remains underexplored. To this end, we introduce CureWM, which constructs alternative actions from successful demonstrations across a severity grid, verifies their outcomes through execution in simulation or on hardware, and fine-tunes released models on the resulting failures and surviving successes alongside nominal demonstrations. This construction provides controlled action contrasts from shared starting contexts. On 484 held-out LIBERO failure counterfactuals, optimism falls from 80\% after fine-tuning on the official data to 30--43\% across four independently fine-tuned CureWM models (38\% mean). In two separate evaluations on a physical robot arm, failure predictions scored as success-like by a latent-distance diagnostic decrease from 90\% after fine-tuning on successful demonstrations alone to 33\% with CureWM. With failure counts per task, successful replay data, and training budget matched, counterfactual failures yield a success--failure value gap of 0.124, compared with 0.014 for freshly collected on-policy failures. These findings support execution-verified counterfactual replay for post-hoc repair and show why reduced optimism must be evaluated alongside success--failure discrimination. Code is available at https://github.com/jiuyixu25/CureWM.

AI.tldr: 提出CureWM，通过执行验证的反事实失败数据对已发布世界模型检查点进行事后微调修复，显著降低乐观预测并提升成功-失败区分能力。
AI.motivation: 机器人世界模型用于策略评估、规划与合成数据生成，但这些应用要求模型能区分成功与失败动作。现有已发布检查点对动作变化敏感度弱，且会把已验证的失败预测为成功（乐观偏差）。虽有工作将失败纳入训练，但对“在不改变架构与训练目标前提下，何种数据能修复已发布检查点”仍缺乏研究。
AI.method: CureWM：从成功示范出发，在严重程度网格上构造替代动作，通过仿真或硬件执行验证其真实结果，得到失败与仍成功的样本，并与名义示范一起微调已发布模型。该构造在共享起始上下文下提供受控的动作对比。
AI.result: 在484个留出的LIBERO失败反事实上，乐观率从官方数据微调后的80%降至四个独立微调模型的30–43%（均值38%）。在真实机械臂的两项评估中，被潜距离诊断判为“类成功”的失败预测从仅用成功示范微调的90%降至CureWM的33%。在失败数、成功回放数据与训练预算匹配下，反事实失败的成-败价值差为0.124，而新采集的在策略失败仅为0.014。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持使用执行验证的反事实回放进行事后修复，并表明降低乐观率必须与成功-失败区分能力一并评估。

title: U-Space: Uncovering When and Why Uncertainty Arises in Language Models
summary: Large language models are informing decisions with ever-higher stakes. As the consequences of their errors grow, a central question becomes harder to ignore: how much can we trust an individual answer? Yet recognizing when to defer remains difficult because language models can present incorrect conclusions with fluent explanations and an authoritative tone. Uncertainty quantification seeks to address this disconnect by estimating the reliability of individual predictions. However, many existing methods require repeated generations or separately trained components, and their scalar estimates do not reveal where uncertainty arises or how it evolves during reasoning. Recent work has also shown that generation length can be strongly associated with uncertainty estimates and correctness, raising the question of how much of an estimator's predictive power comes from uncertainty-specific information rather than output length alone. Mechanistic interpretability offers a way to address these limitations by connecting human-interpretable concepts to intermediate model states. Building on this capability, we introduce the U-Space, a low-dimensional subspace that makes a model's evolving uncertainty measurable and interpretable. We identify semantic anchors for doubt and certainty, map their unembedding directions back into the residual space, and combine their contrasts into an orthogonal basis. The U-Lens projects each token state onto these basis vectors, yielding an interpretable token-level uncertainty map that can be inspected directly or aggregated into a scalar uncertainty score. Our approach requires no correctness labels, repeated generations, or training. Across reasoning benchmarks, its confidence score outperforms established baselines under both standard and length-controlled evaluation and transfers more reliably than supervised estimators. Code: https://github.com/s2labres/U-Space.

AI.tldr: 提出 U-Space 低维子空间与 U-Lens 投影方法，实现无需训练、无需重复生成的可解释不确定性量化，并揭示生成长度对不确定性估计的影响。
AI.motivation: 大模型在高风险决策中被广泛使用，但模型常以流畅、权威的语气给出错误答案，难以判断单个回答的可信度。现有人工不确定性量化方法存在不足：需重复生成或单独训练组件；仅给出标量估计，无法揭示不确定性来源及其在推理过程中的演化；且生成长度与不确定性估计和正确性高度相关，导致估计器预测能力可能仅来自输出长度而非不确定性本身信息。机械可解释性可将人类可解释概念与模型中间状态关联，为上述问题提供解决思路。
AI.method: 提出 U-Space：一个低维子空间，使模型演化中的不确定性可度量、可解释。具体做法是识别"怀疑"与"确定"的语义锚点，将其 unembedding 方向映射回残差空间，并将它们的对比组合为正交基。U-Lens 将每个 token 状态投影到这些基向量上，得到可解释的 token 级不确定性图，可直接查看或聚合成标量不确定性得分。该方法无需正确性标签、重复生成或训练。
AI.result: 在推理基准测试上，其置信度得分在标准评估与长度控制评估下均优于既有基线；与监督式估计器相比，具有更可靠的迁移性。
AI.conclusion: U-Space/U-Lens 提供了一种无需训练、无需标签、可解释的不确定性量化方案，同时厘清了输出长度与不确定性信息在预测能力中的贡献差异，为可信大模型应用提供了可行工具。

title: OverLay++: Dense-Overlap Layout-to-Image Generation Dataset
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026, Evaluations & Datasets Track. Project website: https://mlpc-ucsd.github.io/OverLayPP . Dataset: https://huggingface.co/datasets/mlpcucsd/OverLayPP
summary: Layout-to-Image generation has made substantial progress in spatial and object-level control. However, existing methods still struggle with complex scenes containing many overlapping and interacting objects. We argue that training data is a particular bottleneck: existing datasets lack examples with dense, complex object interactions. To address this gap, we introduce OverLay++, a large-scale Layout-to-Image dataset with structurally complex scenes. OverLay++ contains approximately 500K images with an average of 6.6 objects per image, exceeding existing datasets by 1.67 times in annotation density. Beyond annotation density, OverLay++ provides rich semantic detail with object captions over six times longer than in current datasets. Our dataset generation pipeline is simple and produces dense, overlapping object annotations with rich per-object captions. Across multiple benchmarks, state-of-the-art Layout-to-Image methods trained on the OverLay++ dataset show consistent improvement and faster convergence, demonstrating the importance of dense, overlap-aware, and caption-rich supervision for controllable image generation.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出大规模布局到图像数据集OverLay++，含约50万张图像、平均每图6.6个目标，标注密度为现有数据集1.67倍，物体描述长度超现有6倍，显著提升复杂重叠场景下的可控生成性能。
AI.motivation: 现有Layout-to-Image方法在包含大量重叠与交互物体的复杂场景中表现不佳，作者认为核心瓶颈在于训练数据：现有数据集缺乏密集、复杂物体交互的样本。
AI.method: 构建OverLay++数据集：约500K图像，平均每图6.6个物体，标注密度为现有数据集的1.67倍，并提供比现有数据集长6倍以上的逐物体描述（object captions）；配套一套简单可扩展的数据集生成流水线，产出密集、重叠的物体标注与丰富语义描述。
AI.result: 在多个基准上，使用OverLay++训练的最先进Layout-to-Image方法取得一致性提升，并实现更快收敛。
AI.conclusion: 密集、感知重叠且描述丰富的监督信号对可控图像生成至关重要，OverLay++为该方向提供了有效的数据支撑。

title: How Fragile Is On-Device Language Model Safety? Localizing Safety-Critical Parameters for Sparse Fault Analysis
summary: As small language models (SLMs) are increasingly deployed on resource-constrained and on-device platforms, including as components of agentic systems, the integrity of locally stored model parameters becomes an important safety concern. We investigate whether safety-sensitive behavior in LLaMA-2-7B-Chat is concentrated within a sparse subset of parameters, creating a reduced fault surface for targeted analysis. We study two complementary localization methods: low-rank safety-associated subspace analysis and parameter-level safety--utility importance filtering. Both approaches reveal highly non-uniform safety sensitivity across the network, with the MLP down_proj consistently emerging as a prominent safety-sensitive component and o_proj providing a smaller contribution. Using parameter-level localization, modifying only 0.19% of model weights in down_proj yields 53% Basic ASR and 56% GCG ASR, while tinyBenchmarks accuracy remains at 51.6% compared with a 52.2% unmodified baseline. These results motivate targeted fault analysis and selective integrity protection for language models deployed in resource-constrained, on-device, and agentic settings.

AI.tldr: 论文研究了LLaMA-2-7B-Chat中安全敏感行为的参数稀疏分布特性：通过低秩安全子空间分析与参数级安全-效用重要性筛选两种方法定位安全敏感组件，发现MLP的down_proj是主要安全敏感模块，仅修改其0.19%权重即可将ASR提升至53%（Basic）/56%（GCG），而准确率仅从52.2%降至51.6%。
AI.motivation: 随着小型语言模型越来越多地部署在资源受限、端侧平台以及作为智能体系统组件，本地存储的模型参数完整性成为重要安全关切。作者希望探究安全敏感行为是否集中在少数参数上，从而形成一个可被定向分析的"缩减故障面"，并据此支持针对性的故障分析与完整性保护。
AI.method: 采用两种互补的定位方法：(1) 低秩安全相关子空间分析；(2) 参数级安全-效用重要性筛选。在LLaMA-2-7B-Chat上进行实验，识别网络中安全敏感性最高的组件，并量化安全敏感参数占比。
AI.result: 两种方法均显示网络中的安全敏感性高度非均匀：MLP的down_proj始终是突出的安全敏感组件，o_proj贡献较小。参数级定位下，仅修改down_proj中0.19%的权重即可达到53%的Basic ASR与56%的GCG ASR；同时tinyBenchmarks准确率为51.6%，相对未修改基线52.2%基本持平。
AI.conclusion: 安全敏感行为确实集中于极稀疏的参数子集，形成很小的故障面。这一发现支持对资源受限、端侧及智能体部署场景下的语言模型开展定向故障分析与选择性完整性保护。

title: GraphOPD: Graph-Augmented On-Policy Distillation for LLM Agents
summary: On-policy distillation post-trains large language model agents by supplying dense, step-level guidance from a teacher policy when the reinforcement-learning reward is sparse and arrives only once per trajectory. Existing instantiations allocate this guidance by the size of the teacher-student divergence at each step, on the single-turn intuition that a large disagreement marks a mistake worth correcting. Once decisions chain over many turns, that rule misfires, since an early drift enters every later context both policies condition on, leaving the teacher consistent with the drifted trajectory instead of flagging its cause, while interchangeable steps register large but outcome-irrelevant divergences. We demonstrate this on an agentic benchmark, where distilling the highest-divergence steps brings no consistent benefit over random selection. To this end, we introduce GraphOPD, the first method to bring graph-based structural augmentation into on-policy distillation for agent capabilities. It reads which steps enabled which later ones from the environment's own record of state changes, immune to the drift that corrupts the teacher-student gap, organizes them into a dependency graph, scores each step by a random-walk stationary distribution over it, and fuses that structural credit with the divergence signal into a trajectory-relative mask concentrating supervision on each rollout's highest-aptitude steps. Across three model scales and eleven baselines on ALFWorld, WebShop, and SearchQA, GraphOPD shows competitive performance throughout, improving over the strongest baseline by up to +5.8 pp. An executed-replay audit further shows that this structural credit score tracks true causal impact far above chance, that both fused signals are independently necessary, and that the same signal transfers to out-of-domain tool-integrated reasoning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出GraphOPD，将图结构增强引入on-policy蒸馏，通过环境状态变化构建步骤依赖图并用随机游走稳态分布打分，与散度信号融合生成轨迹相对掩码，在ALFWorld、WebShop和SearchQA上最多超越最强基线5.8个百分点。
AI.motivation: on-policy蒸馏用教师策略提供逐步密集指导以缓解稀疏奖励，但现有方法按教师-学生散度大小分配监督，这一单步直觉在多轮决策链中失效：早期漂移会污染后续所有上下文，使教师与已漂移轨迹保持一致而不标记原因；同时可互换步骤会产生大但无关结果的散度。实验显示蒸馏最高散度步骤相较随机选择并无稳定收益。
AI.method: GraphOPD从环境自身的状态变化记录中读取哪些步骤促成了哪些后续步骤，该信号不受教师-学生差异漂移的污染；据此构建依赖图，用图上的随机游走稳态分布为每个步骤打分，并将该结构信用与散度信号融合为轨迹相对掩码，把监督集中在每条rollout中能力最高的步骤上。
AI.result: 在ALFWorld、WebShop和SearchQA上，跨三种模型规模和十一个基线，GraphOPD整体表现具有竞争力，最多超越最强基线5.8个百分点。执行回放审计表明，该结构信用分远超随机水平地追踪真实因果影响，两种融合信号各自独立必要，且该信号可迁移到域外工具集成推理任务。
AI.conclusion: 基于环境状态变化的图结构信用能有效替代或补充散度信号，用于on-policy蒸馏中的步骤级监督分配，提升LLM智能体的多轮决策能力并具备跨域迁移性。

title: Secure-CUA: Controlling Untrusted Influence in Computer-Use Agents
summary:
Computer-use agents (CUAs) perform tasks across applications (such as desktops, mobile apps, and web browsers) by observing graphical interfaces and issuing commands such as clicks and keystrokes. These interfaces combine trusted controls and content with untrusted content needed for legitimate tasks. An adversary controlling this untrusted content can embed instructions or misleading visual cues to change the agent's intended action or redirect its commands to the wrong interface target. We formalize security requirements for both the agent's decisions and their execution through GUI commands. In an ideal execution model, we show that enforcing both requirements at each step protects execution traces.
  We instantiate this model in Secure-CUA, our system for secure CUA execution. Its key idea is to commit to an explicit per-action program, called an $\textit{action transaction}$, before accessing untrusted content. Each transaction fixes its queries to untrusted content and the permitted uses of their responses. The system masks untrusted regions and evaluates each transaction to produce the next action, using an isolated query model to answer its queries. It then locates the intended interface target using the masked interface. Under the model's assumptions, Secure-CUA is secure by design, while generating a new transaction at each step helps maintain high task utility by adapting to changing interfaces.
  We evaluate Secure-CUA under benign conditions on 400 WebArena tasks using three frontier models across $5$ seeds, yielding $6,000$ execution traces. Secure-CUA achieves an average task success rate of $53.55\%$, compared with $55.12\%$ for Vanilla-CUA and $13.17\%$ for CaMeL-CUA.

AI.tldr: 本文提出面向计算机使用代理（CUA）的安全执行模型与系统 Secure-CUA：通过在执行不受信任内容前先提交显式的"动作事务"，并用掩码处理不受信任区域，实现决策与执行双重安全，在WebArena上保持接近基线的任务成功率。
AI.motivation: CUA通过图形界面（桌面、移动应用、浏览器）执行点击、按键等操作，而这些界面同时包含可信控件与完成正当任务所必需的不受信任内容。掌握不受信任内容的攻击者可嵌入指令或误导性视觉线索，改变代理的预期动作，或将其命令重定向到错误的界面目标。因此需要同时约束代理的决策与其通过GUI命令的执行。
AI.method: 作者形式化定义了针对代理决策与GUI命令执行两方面的安全需求，并在理想执行模型下证明逐步同时满足二者即可保护整条执行轨迹。据此提出Secure-CUA系统，其核心思想是在访问不受信任内容之前先承诺一个显式的逐步动作程序，即"动作事务"（action transaction）；每个事务固定其对不受信任内容的查询及允许的响应用途。系统对不受信任区域进行掩码，评估每个事务以产生下一动作，并用隔离的查询模型回答查询；随后利用掩码后的界面定位预期界面目标。由于每步都会重新生成事务，系统可适应变化的界面，从而维持较高任务效用。
AI.result: 在WebArena的400个任务上，使用三种前沿模型、5个随机种子，共得到6,000条执行轨迹。Secure-CUA的平均任务成功率为53.55%，Vanilla-CUA为55.12%，CaMeL-CUA为13.17%。
AI.conclusion: 在模型假设下，Secure-CUA具备设计上的安全性，同时通过每步生成新事务适应界面变化，任务效用损失很小；相比已有安全方案CaMeL-CUA在任务成功率上有显著提升。

title: Hybrid Hierarchical Runtime Verification for Edge-IoT Security: Combining MonPoly and RTLola
comment: 19 pages, 2 figures, 7 tables. Published in Availability, Reliability and Security (ARES 2026), EU Projects Symposium Workshops, Springer LNCS
summary: Security monitoring of edge-IoT fleets faces three structural challenges. (i) A per-node monitor is cheap but cannot see attacks that coordinate across devices. (ii) A cloud monitor sees the full fleet but pays for that view in bandwidth. (iii) Even at the cloud, a monitor built on a single RV engine can be fooled by an attacker who compromises a device, raises one malicious request, and then goes silent: once the events stop, an event-triggered monitor has nothing left to evaluate. We propose a three-layer hierarchical runtime-verification framework that addresses all three. The edge layer classifies events as they happen, the gateway layer aggregates short windows of per-device behaviour, and the cloud layer runs two complementary RV engines. MonPoly handles first-order temporal correlation over the merged alert stream: coordinated overflow (which genuinely quantifies across devices) plus per-device multi-vector APT, escalation, and persistent-campaign patterns. RTLola handles a time-triggered silent-node property that an event-triggered engine cannot detect within a bounded delay under fleet silence. We evaluate the framework on a 15-actor Docker testbed covering eight attack profiles plus a silent-bypass scenario. In the controlled labelled testbed, every device-attributable incident the framework raises names an attacker-labelled device, and the RTLola tier catches silent-bypass attempts the event-triggered tier misses. Per-event monitoring stays in the microsecond range at the edge and gateway, with low end-to-end alert-to-incident latency at the cloud.

AI.tldr: 提出三层分层运行时验证框架（边缘-网关-云），用MonPoly与RTLola双引擎分别处理事件触发与时间触发的监控需求，解决边缘IoT集群中跨设备协同攻击、带宽开销与静默节点漏检三大结构性问题。
AI.motivation: 边缘IoT集群安全监控存在三个结构性挑战：(i) 单节点监控成本低，但无法发现跨设备协同攻击；(ii) 云监控视野完整，但带宽代价高昂；(iii) 即使部署在云端，基于单一RV引擎（事件触发）的监控易被攻击者绕过——攻击者入侵设备后发出一次恶意请求便静默，事件停止后事件触发监控无事件可评估，无法在有限延迟内检测静默节点。
AI.method: 三层分层运行时验证框架：边缘层实时分类事件；网关层聚合每设备短窗口行为；云层运行两个互补RV引擎——MonPoly对合并告警流做一阶时序关联（跨设备协同溢出、单设备多向量APT、升级、持续攻击活动模式），RTLola处理时间触发的静默节点属性。在15个actor的Docker测试床上评估，覆盖8种攻击剖面加一个静默绕过场景。
AI.result: 在受控标注测试床中，框架报告的每起可归因设备事件均指向攻击者标注的设备；RTLola层能捕获事件触发层漏检的静默绕过尝试。边缘与网关的逐事件监控保持在微秒级，云端告警到事件的端到端延迟较低。
AI.conclusion: 三层分层RV框架同时解决了跨设备协同检测、带宽开销与静默节点检测三类问题，双引擎互补设计（事件触发+时间触发）弥补了单一RV引擎的检测盲区，在微秒级/低延迟开销下实现了可靠的安全监控。

title: A Unified Kinematic Representation Enables Reusable Biological Joint Moment Estimation
comment: This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication. Copyright may be transferred without notice, after which this version may no longer be accessible
summary: Objective: Data-driven models that estimate physiological states, particularly biological joint moments, are widely used in exoskeleton control. However, these estimators are often coupled to device-specific sensor configurations, limiting controller transfer and the use of open-source biomechanics datasets. Methods: We proposed joint kinematics as an intermediate representation that decouples hardware-specific sensing from downstream biological joint moment estimation. A joint-moment estimator using joint angles and angular velocities was trained exclusively on open-source biomechanics data and evaluated using kinematics from a hip exoskeleton, knee exoskeleton, and inertial measurement unit (IMU) sensor suite during level-ground, ramp-ascent, and ramp-descent walking. Results: The estimator achieved an root mean square error (RMSE) of 0.17 Nm/kg and coefficient of determination (R2) of 0.79 using hip exoskeleton kinematics, 0.19 Nm/kg and 0.62 using knee exoskeleton kinematics, and 0.15 Nm/kg and 0.85 using kinematics derived from IMUs across bilateral hip, knee, and ankle joints. Conclusion: Joint kinematics enabled an estimator trained only on open-source data to operate across distinct wearable platforms. Significance: This framework may reduce target-device data collection and support transferable biological joint moment estimation for exoskeleton control and wearable biomechanics.

AI.tldr: 提出以关节运动学作为中间表示，解耦硬件特定传感与下游生物关节力矩估计，实现跨外骨骼与IMU平台的力矩估计迁移。
AI.motivation: 现有数据驱动力矩估计器与设备特定传感器配置耦合，限制控制器迁移及开源生物力学数据集的使用。
AI.method: 以关节角度与角速度作为输入训练关节力矩估计器，仅使用开源生物力学数据训练；在髋外骨骼、膝外骨骼及IMU传感套件采集的运动学数据上评估，涵盖平地行走、上坡与下坡。
AI.result: 髋外骨骼运动学：RMSE 0.17 Nm/kg，R² 0.79；膝外骨骼运动学：RMSE 0.19 Nm/kg，R² 0.62；IMU推导的髋、膝、踝双侧运动学：RMSE 0.15 Nm/kg，R² 0.85。
AI.conclusion: 关节运动学使仅在开源数据上训练的估计器可跨不同可穿戴平台运行，该框架有望减少目标设备数据采集，支持可迁移的生物关节力矩估计，用于外骨骼控制与可穿戴生物力学。

title: Same Text, Different Prediction: Serving-Context Nondeterminism in Text Classifiers
summary: Deterministic inference is essential for reliable and trustworthy machine learning. Prior studies of text generation have shown that changing factors such as batch size, batch composition, hardware, or inference engine can alter the generated text, even when the prompt, model parameters, and sampling randomness are fixed. These differences have been attributed in part to floating-point non-associativity, shape-dependent kernel selection, and other implementation-level differences in numerical execution. However, it remains unclear whether, when, and to what extent the same factors affect text classification. We present a systematic study of serving-context non-invariance in text classifiers, which prior work has measured only through generated text. We train 180 models spanning discriminative, pseudo-generative, and fully generative classifier formulations and evaluate each across four categories of serving contexts, holding the checkpoint and the text fixed. Label stability does not imply score stability. Changing only the batch shape changes no labels across fp32 comparisons, yet under bf16 it moves up to 56.7 percentage points of predicted probability mass, with label changes concentrated at small margins. Fully generative classifiers change more labels than their discriminative counterparts under the same serving changes. We derive sufficient conditions for label stability under each serving change and give a separate mitigation for each mechanism. Our results identify and quantify the serving conditions that must be fixed for reproducible text classification.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究了文本分类器在服务上下文（batch shape、精度、硬件/引擎等）变化下的非不变性，训练180个模型并跨四类服务上下文评估，发现标签稳定并不等于分数稳定，且给出各机制下的标签稳定充分条件与缓解方法。
AI.motivation: 以往关于文本生成的确定性研究已表明，即使提示、模型参数和采样随机性固定，batch size、batch 组成、硬件或推理引擎等变化仍会改变生成文本，原因包括浮点非结合性、形状相关的kernel选择等实现层差异。但这些问题是否、何时以及在多大程度上影响文本分类仍不清楚，且此前工作仅通过生成文本来度量，因此需要针对文本分类开展系统研究。
AI.method: 训练180个模型，覆盖判别式、伪生成式和完全生成式三类分类器公式；在固定checkpoint与输入文本的前提下，将每个模型在四类服务上下文下评估。重点考察仅改变batch shape的影响，并在fp32与bf16下对比；同时比较完全生成式分类器与其判别式对应模型的标签变化，并推导各服务变化下标签稳定的充分条件，针对每种机制分别提出缓解措施。
AI.result: 标签稳定性并不意味着分数稳定性：仅改变batch shape在fp32比较下不改变任何标签，但在bf16下可移动高达56.7个百分点的预测概率质量，标签变化集中在margin较小处。在相同服务变化下，完全生成式分类器比判别式分类器改变更多标签。
AI.conclusion: 研究识别并量化了为可复现文本分类所必须固定的服务条件；针对不同机制给出各自的缓解方案，并明确了各服务变化下标签稳定的充分条件。

title: DISRQAD: Diffusion Image Super-Resolution Quality Assessment Dataset and Benchmark
summary: Diffusion-based image super-resolution (SR) can create visually plausible detail that is not supported by the low-resolution input. We introduce DISRQAD, a subjective-quality dataset and diagnostic benchmark for this setting. It contains mean opinion scores (MOS) for 14,000 SR outputs from ten diffusion and four non-diffusion methods, spanning four low-resolution degradation conditions and x2/x4 upscaling. We evaluate 51 standard full-reference and no-reference metric configurations and 11 adapted variants. Agreement with MOS is substantially weaker on diffusion outputs: the strongest standard no-reference baseline reaches 0.431 SRCC on diffusion SR versus 0.813 on non-diffusion SR. As a case study in benchmark use, a pruned and distilled Q-ReAlign-mini student reaches 0.496 SRCC on diffusion SR. DISRQAD measures perceived output quality, not faithfulness to the input; it enables analysis of metric behavior across generator families and input conditions. Our findings reveal a substantial gap in the assessment of diffusion-based SR and provide a basis for developing quality models sensitive to diffusion-specific artifacts.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 DISRQAD——面向扩散式图像超分辨率的主观质量数据集与诊断基准，含10种扩散和4种非扩散方法、4种退化条件、x2/x4放大共14,000个SR输出的MOS，评估了51种标准与11种改进指标配置，揭示扩散输出上指标与MOS一致性显著偏低。
AI.motivation: 扩散式超分能够生成低分辨率输入并不支持、但视觉上看似合理的细节，这使得传统面向保真度的图像质量评价难以刻画其感知质量，现有指标在该类输出上的可靠性缺乏系统检验。
AI.method: 构建DISRQAD数据集：采集10种扩散方法与4种非扩散方法、覆盖4种低分辨率退化条件及x2/x4放大共14,000个SR输出的主观MOS；对51种标准全参考/无参考指标配置及11种改进变体进行与MOS的一致性评测；并以剪枝蒸馏的Q-ReAlign-mini学生模型作为基准使用案例进行验证。
AI.result: 扩散输出上的指标-MOS一致性明显更弱：最强标准无参考基线在扩散SR上SRCC仅0.431，而在非扩散SR上达0.813；作为案例，剪枝蒸馏的Q-ReAlign-mini学生在扩散SR上达到0.496 SRCC。
AI.conclusion: DISRQAD衡量的是感知输出质量而非对输入的保真度，支持跨生成器族与输入条件的指标行为分析，揭示了扩散式SR质量评估的显著空白，为开发对扩散特有伪影敏感的质量模型提供基础。

title: Learning to Report Unsafe Tasks in a Multi-Agent Game
summary: When agents share a reward for completed tasks, reporting unsafe work can reduce the reporter's reward by stopping a task. Audits can make reporting optimal without ensuring that further training teaches a silent team to report. We study this learning problem in a game where any witness can stop a task by reporting. With $k$ witnesses per task sharing a policy and drawing independently, the expected-reward derivative with respect to their shared silence probability counts each task's benefit $k$ times at universal silence. The comparison with universal reporting counts it once. For arbitrary policy groups, we give an audit condition sufficient for exact policy-gradient updates to reach universal reporting and, apart from boundary cases, necessary near universal silence. In a balanced family, the cheapest audits meeting the condition with prescribed positive margins cost exactly $k$ times as much for full sharing as for one policy per role. We train PPO policies on 24 witness graphs from learned silence. Separating co-witnesses reduces unsafe completion by 33.59 percentage points compared with shuffled groups of the same sizes under the same audits (95% graph-bootstrap interval: 21.03-45.13). Only 9 of 48 witness-group runs achieve below 1% unsafe completion while retaining at least 90% legitimate completion. At the same audit budget, a fully shared network meets both thresholds in none of 48 runs with independent action draws and all 48 with a common draw.

AI.tldr: 本文研究多见证者任务中的"报告不安全行为"学习问题：共享奖励导致报告抑制，审计可修复梯度信号，但成本随策略共享度线性增长；实验显示分离共同见证者显著优于共享策略。
AI.motivation: 代理共享任务奖励时，报告不安全行为会因中止任务而降低报告者收益，形成"沉默"激励。审计虽能使报告成为最优策略，但不能保证进一步训练能让沉默团队学会报告，因此需要从学习动力学角度分析该问题。
AI.method: 构建任意见证者可报告中止任务的博弈模型：每任务含 k 个独立抽取、共享策略的见证者。推导期望奖励关于共享沉默概率的导数，比较普遍沉默与普遍报告下的任务收益计数；对任意策略组给出使精确策略梯度收敛到普遍报告的审计充分条件，以及在普遍沉默附近的必要性条件；在平衡族中计算满足正裕度条件的最廉价审计成本；用 PPO 在 24 个见证图上从学习到的沉默出发进行训练。
AI.result: 普遍沉默处导数将每任务收益重复计入 k 次，而普遍报告仅计 1 次。平衡族中，完全共享策略满足条件的最廉价审计成本恰为每角色一策略的 k 倍。训练结果：分离共同见证者相比同规模打乱分组，不安全完成率降低 33.59 个百分点（95% 图自助区间 21.03–45.13）；48 次见证组运行中仅 9 次同时达到不安全完成率低于 1%、合法完成率不低于 90%；相同审计预算下，完全共享网络在独立动作抽样下 48 次全部不达标，而在共同抽样下 48 次全部达标。
AI.conclusion: 策略共享会以 k 倍系数放大沉默激励，并使有效审计成本增加 k 倍；分离共同见证者是恢复报告行为的有效结构性手段，而共享网络的成败高度依赖动作抽样是否引入共同随机性。

title: Directed Temporal Representations for Offline Visual Control
summary: Predictive world models provide compact visual representations for control. Control requires a latent geometry aligned with temporal reachability rather than predictive similarity alone. We introduce Directed Temporal Representations for Control (DTRC), which learns such a geometry from offline visual trajectories on top of frozen LeWorldModel (LeWM) features. DTRC constructs a directed temporal quasimetric over the learned control representation. Short-range temporal offsets calibrate the distance scale. Bootstrapped targets extend temporal reachability across longer horizons. Action-conditioned consistency aligns the representation with local transition dynamics. The resulting distance estimates temporal reaching cost, and its change across a transition defines goal-relative temporal progress. We use this progress signal as a temporal critic for direct goal-conditioned policy learning. Model-assisted targets provide an additional training-time refinement under behavior-support and dynamics-agreement constraints. Across ten visual control tasks, DTRC achieves strong goal-conditioned control performance relative to planning and direct-policy baselines. Held-out diagnostics on the four LeWM tasks show consistent short-range temporal calibration, task-dependent long-range and directional structure, and positive transition-level progress. Temporal supervision improves the same flow-policy parameterization across all four LeWM tasks, while the resulting policy acts directly without iterative trajectory search at test time.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DTRC（Directed Temporal Representations for Control），在冻结的LeWorldModel特征之上，从离线视觉轨迹中学习一种与时间可达性对齐的潜在几何，并以由此导出的时间进度信号作为critic，实现直接的目标条件策略学习，在十个视觉控制任务上取得优于规划与直接策略基线的性能。
AI.motivation: 控制任务要求潜在空间几何与时间可达性（temporal reachability）对齐，而不仅仅是预测相似性。仅追求预测相似的表征无法刻画"到达目标需要多长时间/多大代价"，因而难以支撑目标条件控制。论文希望在不重新训练世界模型的前提下，利用冻结的LeWM特征构建具有方向性、可度量时间代价的表征空间。
AI.method: 在冻结的LeWorldModel (LeWM)特征上学习有向时间准度量（directed temporal quasimetric）：1）用短程时间偏移标定距离尺度；2）用自举（bootstrapped）目标把时间可达性扩展到更长时域；3）用动作条件一致性对齐表征与局部转移动态。所得距离估计"时间到达代价"，其在一次转移上的变化定义目标相对的时间进度。将该进度信号用作时间critic，直接进行目标条件策略学习；并通过模型辅助目标在行为支撑（behavior-support）与动态一致性约束下做训练期精修。
AI.result: 在十个视觉控制任务上，DTRC相对规划方法与直接策略基线均取得较强的目标条件控制性能。在四个LeWM任务上的留出诊断显示：一致的短程时间标定、依赖于任务的长程与方向性结构，以及正向的转移级进度。时间监督在全部四个LeWM任务上改进了同一flow-policy参数化，且所得策略在测试时无需迭代轨迹搜索即可直接行动。
AI.conclusion: 在冻结世界模型特征上引入有向时间监督，可有效塑造与时间可达性对齐的控制表征，并将时间进度直接用作critic实现目标条件策略学习。该方法兼顾长程与方向结构，且在测试阶段只需前向策略推理、无需规划搜索，展现出良好的可扩展性与实用性。

title: Constitution-Guided Watermarking
summary: Watermarking enables language model providers to identify text generated by their models. However, its desired properties can conflict (\ie~stronger watermark signals can degrade text quality), while designs that resist editing may also facilitate forgery. Providers address these trade-offs by choosing configurations that balance competing objectives or prioritize particular properties. Either approach imposes a shared operating point on requests with different requirements, potentially sacrificing quality where wording preservation matters or robustness where reliable attribution is essential. To allow flexible and adaptable designs, we introduce \emph{Constitution-Guided Watermarking}, a framework that selects request-appropriate trade-offs from provider requirements, listed as natural-language principles. \emph{Offline}, a pretrained reasoning agent examines constitutional rules alongside watermark implementations and iteratively refines rule-specific configurations using empirical feedback. \emph{At deployment}, a separate monitor identifies applicable rules and retrieves the corresponding policy, including watermarking exemptions, without modifying the serving model. Furthermore, our framework supports offline parallel optimization and refinement of rule-specific configurations based on evolving provider requirements without affecting deployment, and binds each deployed configuration to its evaluation evidence, making deployment decisions auditable. In a proof-of-concept evaluation using KGW and a five-rule constitution, our framework selects configurations responsive to provider priorities and improves post-paraphrase detection on robustness-prioritized requests by up to $14$ percentage points over fixed configurations, while matching or exceeding all baselines in aggregate quality and clean detection at a nominal $0.1\%$ false-positive rate.

AI.tldr: 提出“宪制引导水印”（Constitution-Guided Watermarking）框架，用自然语言原则灵活选择请求适配的水印权衡配置：离线由推理代理迭代优化规则级配置，部署时由监视器匹配规则并检索策略，实现在不修改服务模型的前提下兼顾质量与鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 水印的若干期望属性相互冲突（更强信号损害文本质量，抗编辑设计又便于伪造）。现有做法要么选取固定平衡点，要么让特定属性优先，从而对所有请求强加统一运行点，导致在重视措辞保持或需要可靠归因的场景中牺牲质量或鲁棒性。
AI.method: 框架以供应商需求作为自然语言“宪制”原则：离线阶段，预训练推理代理结合宪制规则与水印实现，利用经验反馈迭代精化各规则专属配置；部署阶段，独立的监视器识别适用规则并检索对应策略（含水印豁免），且不修改服务模型。此外支持离线并行优化与基于需求演进的配置精化，不影响部署，并将每个部署配置与其评估证据绑定以保证可审计性。
AI.result: 在基于 KGW 与五条规则宪制的概念验证中，框架选出的配置能响应供应商优先级；在名义 0.1% 假阳性率下，对以鲁棒性优先的请求，改写后检测率较固定配置最高提升 14 个百分点，同时在总体质量与干净检测上匹配或超过所有基线。
AI.conclusion: 该框架通过规则化、请求自适应的配置选择，缓解水印质量与鲁棒性间的固有冲突，支持在不改动服务模型情况下的灵活部署、并行优化与可审计决策，验证了宪制引导方法的可行性。

title: geodex: A Library for Motion Planning on Riemannian Manifolds
comment: 8 pages, 7 figures, 4 tables. Code, documentation, and tutorials at https://geodex.readthedocs.io
summary: Planning motions that respect the intrinsic geometry of a robot's configuration space, including its curvature and a configuration-dependent notion of cost, yields shorter, lower-energy, and more natural trajectories than planning under the ambient flat metric. Existing libraries for optimization on manifolds provide rich geometric primitives but do not plan around obstacles. While general-purpose motion planning libraries support many state spaces and custom distance functions, they do not yet treat a configuration-dependent Riemannian metric as the geometry that drives distance, interpolation, and geodesics. We present geodex, an open-source C++20 library with Python bindings. The library exposes the manifold, its Riemannian metric, the retraction, and the sampler as independent, interchangeable components through a single sampling-based motion planning interface. The same planner runs unchanged on canonical spaces $\mathbb{R}^n$, $\mathbb{T}^n$, $\mathbb{S}^n$, matrix Lie groups such as $SO(2)$, $SE(2)$, $SO(3)$, and $SE(3)$, products of these spaces, and articulated-robot configuration spaces, each equipped with a user-defined Riemannian metric. We make geodex publicly available with documentation, tests, and a reproducible benchmark suite.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 geodex，一个开源的 C++20 库（含 Python 绑定），通过统一的采样规划接口，将流形、黎曼度量、收缩映射与采样器解耦为可替换组件，实现基于配置相关黎曼度量的运动规划。
AI.motivation: 考虑配置空间内禀几何（曲率及配置相关代价）的规划能产生更短、更低能耗、更自然的轨迹，而环境平坦度量下的规划无法做到。现有流形优化库缺少障碍物避让；通用运动规划库虽支持多种状态空间与自定义距离函数，却未将配置相关黎曼度量作为驱动距离、插值与测地线的几何基础。
AI.method: geodex 将流形、其黎曼度量、收缩映射（retraction）与采样器建模为独立、可互换的组件，并以单一采样规划接口暴露。同一规划器无需修改即可运行于 R^n、T^n、S^n、矩阵李群（SO(2)、SE(2)、SO(3)、SE(3)）、其乘积空间及关节机器人配置空间，且各空间均可配备用户自定义黎曼度量。库支持障碍物避让的采样规划。
AI.result: 同一采样规划器在多种标准流形、李群及其乘积与关节配置空间上保持代码不变运行；各配置空间可自由替换为自定义黎曼度量，库附带文档、测试与可复现基准套件，并已公开发布。
AI.conclusion: geodex 填补了流形优化与采样运动规划之间的空白：将配置相关黎曼度量作为规划几何核心，并提供模块化、跨流形、带障碍避让能力的开源实现，为基于内禀几何的轨迹规划提供了可复现工具。

title: sk-bench: A Native-First Benchmark for Evaluating Large Language Models in Slovak
summary: Multilingual LLM benchmarks omit Slovak, a morphologically rich West Slavic language of five million speakers, or cover it only by machine translation. We present sk-bench, a native-first Slovak benchmark with 30 datasets (33 scored task variants) across ten skill categories. Eleven resources are introduced or first packaged for generative-LLM evaluation, including IFEval-SK with Slovak-adapted instruction checkers and native Chiby/SKJ1 resources for Slovak grammar and morphology. We evaluate 55 open- and closed-weights models under one harness. The best open model trails proprietary APIs by 12.6 points. Model rankings are similar for native and translated closed-form data ($ρ\geq0.98$), though translation separates the strongest models less well. By contrast, human-authored and LLM-generated QA questions rank models differently ($ρ=0.72$). For Qwen3-14B, continued Slovak pretraining lowers the overall score by 13.9 points. A small instruction set restores three quarters of that loss. Test-time reasoning improves scores by 8.5 to 12.5 points for models of 9B and above. Together, these findings suggest four design lessons for other under-resourced languages: use native data where translation fails, plan instruction repair after language adaptation, enable test-time reasoning before scaling up, and avoid overinvesting in target-language prompts. We release the data and code at https://github.com/slovak-nlp/sk-bench

AI.tldr: sk-bench：首个原生优先的斯洛伐克语生成式LLM评测基准，含30个数据集、33个任务变体、10类技能；评测55个模型，揭示弱势语言基准设计的四条经验。
AI.motivation: 斯洛伐克语作为约500万使用者的形态丰富西斯拉夫语言，在多语言LLM基准中长期缺位，或仅以机器翻译形式被覆盖，无法真实反映模型在该语言上的能力。
AI.method: 构建原生优先基准sk-bench：覆盖10类技能、30个数据集（33个计分任务变体），其中11项资源为首次引入或首次打包用于生成式LLM评测，包括适配斯洛伐克语的IFEval-SK指令校验器及原生语法形态资源Chiby/SKJ1。在统一评测框架下测试55个开源与闭源权重模型，并进行迁移与消融分析（原生vs翻译数据、人工vs LLM生成问答、继续预训练与指令修复、测试时推理）。
AI.result: 最佳开源模型落后专有API 12.6分；原生与翻译的封闭式数据排序高度一致（ρ≥0.98），但翻译对最强模型区分度更低；人工与LLM生成问答排序差异明显（ρ=0.72）；Qwen3-14B继续斯洛伐克语预训练使总分下降13.9分，小型指令集可恢复其中约四分之三；测试时推理在9B及以上模型提升8.5–12.5分。
AI.conclusion: 为其他低资源语言提出四条设计经验：翻译失效处应使用原生数据；语言适配后需规划指令修复；扩展规模前先启用测试时推理；避免在目标语言提示上过度投入。数据与代码已开源。

title: Anaximander: Interactively Running Geospatial Deep Learning Models on Any Compute Backend
comment: Accepted as a poster at the TerraBytes II workshop, ECCV 2026
summary: Applying deep learning models to satellite imagery from within geographic information systems (GIS) remains high-friction for remote sensing practitioners. Models arrive in incompatible formats and target different compute environments, from local workstations to serverless cloud services. As a result, every evaluation demands custom deployment, tiling, and georeferencing code before a single prediction reaches the analyst's map. This friction discourages systematic comparison in a domain where model choice directly affects operational outcomes such as field delineation, crop monitoring, and disaster response. We present Anaximander, an open-source system that unifies model source and compute location choice behind one interactive interface. The system's backend is an inference server that loads models from multiple commonly-used sources and serves them on any accessible compute backend. The server provides session management and model caching, and streams results back per tile. The backend is paired with a QGIS plugin that drives tiling, result reassembly, georeferencing, and real-time per-tile status visualization. An additional user-interface path injects layer legends as prompts into vision-language models. We demonstrate the system in a code-free side-by-side comparison of three heterogeneous models on an agricultural field delineation task: gpt-image-1 via a cloud API, Segment Anything Model 3 (SAM3) on a remote GPU, and DelineateAnything on a local CPU. The inference backend and protocol are open-source and available at https://github.com/microsoft/nxmndr.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出开源系统Anaximander，通过统一推理服务器与QGIS插件，将异构深度学习模型的来源与算力选择整合进单一交互界面，实现卫星影像的无代码部署、分块推理与地理配准。
AI.motivation: 将深度学习模型应用于GIS内的卫星影像对遥感从业者而言摩擦很大：模型格式不兼容，目标算力环境各异（本地工作站到无服务器云服务），每次评估都需自定义部署、分块与地理配准代码，阻碍了在模型选择直接影响作业结果的领域中进行系统性比较。
AI.method: 后端为推理服务器，可从多种常用来源加载模型并在任意可访问算力后端上提供服务，具备会话管理与模型缓存，并按分块流式返回结果；后端搭配QGIS插件，负责分块、结果重组、地理配准与实时分块状态可视化；另提供一条界面路径，将图层图例作为提示注入视觉语言模型。
AI.result: 在农田地块 delineation（地块勾绘）任务上，对三个异构模型进行无代码并排比较：通过云API调用的gpt-image-1、运行在远程GPU上的Segment Anything Model 3（SAM3），以及运行在本地CPU上的DelineateAnything。
AI.conclusion: Anaximander统一了模型来源与算力位置选择，降低了卫星影像深度学习推理的部署与比较门槛；推理后端与协议已开源，地址为 https://github.com/microsoft/nxmndr。

title: Sigma-Hunter: A Domain-Specific Language Model for Threat Hunting and Detection Engineering
summary: Detection engineers must translate threat reports, forensic observations, and hunt hypotheses into precise, testable rules. General-purpose large language models (LLMs) can draft such rules, but often produce invalid YAML, incorrect log sources, unsupported fields, or overly broad detection logic. This paper presents \emph{Sigma-Hunter}, a domain-adapted LLM for analyst-assistive Sigma rule generation and threat hunting. We build an instruction-tuning dataset from 3,635 validated open-source Sigma rules, expanded into 7,663 question-answer and analyst-reasoning examples. Each source rule is assigned to a single train, validation, or test partition before this expansion, so no rule leaks across splits. We fine-tune a 7B Mistral model and a Phi-4 model with LoRA and score held-out rule generations on syntax, approximate field consistency, and a semantic judgment of detection logic, completeness, selectivity, and log-source alignment. Sigma-Hunter-Mistral scores 8.17 overall, against 7.88 for the strongest general-purpose baseline and 4.61 for untuned Mistral. Two findings stand out: domain adaptation enables a compact 7B model to perform competitively with larger general-purpose models on this structured task, and syntactic validity is a weak proxy for semantic rule quality, as several baselines emit well-formed YAML carrying weak detection logic. The adapted models run locally, which suits detection engineering in disconnected environments where analysts cannot reach hosted model services.

AI.tldr: 提出 Sigma-Hunter，一个面向 Sigma 规则生成与威胁狩猎的领域适配 LLM，基于 3,635 条开源规则构建 7,663 条指令微调样本，7B 模型经 LoRA 微调后总体得分 8.17，超越最强通用基线 7.88。
AI.motivation: 检测工程师需将威胁报告、取证观察与狩猎假设转化为可测试的精确规则。通用 LLM 虽可起草规则，但常产出无效 YAML、错误日志源、不支持字段或过于宽泛的检测逻辑；同时部分检测环境网络隔离，无法访问托管模型服务。
AI.method: 从 3,635 条经验证的开源 Sigma 规则构建指令微调数据集，扩展为 7,663 条问答与分析推理样本；每条源规则在扩展前即划分至单一 train/validation/test 分区以避免跨集泄漏。采用 LoRA 微调 7B Mistral 与 Phi-4 模型，并在留出规则生成上从语法、近似字段一致性，以及检测逻辑、完整性、选择性、日志源对齐的语义判断等维度评分。
AI.result: Sigma-Hunter-Mistral 总体得分 8.17，最强通用基线为 7.88，未微调 Mistral 仅 4.61。两个突出发现：领域适配使紧凑 7B 模型在该结构化任务上可与更大通用模型竞争；语法有效性是语义规则质量的弱代理，多个基线输出了格式正确但检测逻辑薄弱的 YAML。
AI.conclusion: 领域适配可让小模型在 Sigma 规则生成任务上达到与大型通用模型相当的水平，且仅凭语法正确性不足以评估规则质量。适配后模型可本地运行，契合分析人员无法访问托管服务的隔离检测环境。

title: On KL-Regularized Policy Optimization
summary: Asynchronous reinforcement learning (RL) for large language model (LLM) agents trains one policy on trajectories generated by another: rollouts come from stale checkpoints, and the inference engine's probabilities differ from the trainer's even at identical parameters. Standard remedies either clip importance ratios, which biases the update, or, as in GRPO, sample a group of responses per prompt, which is costly when episodes are long. We propose KL-Regularized Policy Optimization (KLPO), a framework that anchors the KL regularizer at the sampler. The regularized improvement step then has a closed-form Gibbs solution, and KLPO fits its log-ratio optimality condition by least squares on the sampler's own trajectories, so the sampler probability enters through a log-ratio and no importance weights are needed. Profiling out the regression intercept replaces the intractable log-partition function with the signal's sampler mean plus a sampler-to-trainer KL divergence. For token-level policy mirror descent targets, we show that the resulting gradient can be computed from terminal returns without a critic, via sampler-centered scores or a single trajectory residual, even under stochastic tool outputs. We further prove that independent Monte Carlo estimates of the KL term keep these gradients unbiased, derive the exact KL gap of cheaper top-$K$ and binary approximations, and show that SPPO, GPO, REBEL, and BPO arise as special cases of KLPO. The result is a critic-free update that uses one rollout per prompt and requires neither a learned normalizer nor a group of responses.

AI.tldr: 提出KLPO框架：将KL正则锚定在采样器上，利用闭式Gibbs解与最小二乘拟合log-ratio最优性条件，得到无需重要性权重、无需critic、每提示仅一条轨迹的策略优化方法。
AI.motivation: 异步强化学习中，生成轨迹的策略与训练策略不一致：rollout来自陈旧checkpoint，且推理引擎与训练器在相同参数下概率分布也存在差异。现有方案要么裁剪重要性比率导致更新有偏，要么如GRPO对每提示采样一组回复，长回合场景代价高昂。
AI.method: KLPO将KL正则项锚定在采样器处，正则化改进步具有闭式Gibbs解；通过在采样器自身轨迹上对log-ratio最优性条件做最小二乘拟合，使采样器概率以log-ratio形式进入，无需重要性权重。消去回归截距后，用信号的采样器均值加采样器到训练器的KL散度替代不可解的log-partition函数。针对token级策略镜像下降目标，证明梯度可由终端回报经采样器中心化score或单条轨迹残差计算，无需critic，且在随机工具输出下仍成立。
AI.result: 证明KL项的独立蒙特卡洛估计保持梯度无偏；推导了更廉价top-K与二值近似下的精确KL间隙；表明SPPO、GPO、REBEL、BPO均为KLPO的特例。
AI.conclusion: KLPO给出一种无critic的更新方法，每提示仅需一条rollout，既不需要学习归一化器，也不需要一组回复，从而在异步设置下兼顾效率与正确性。

title: MARS: Malware Analysis with Rule-Based Scoring of LLM Claims
summary: Large language models can triage malware through direct verdicts or behavioral claims scored by an external policy. We present MARS, a malware triage framework, and compare direct classification with single-pass claim scoring using the same evidence collector and identical static evidence bundles for each model. The evaluation covers 1,195 PE and ELF binaries grouped into 1,001 near-duplicate clusters and six language models, with deterministic rules providing a baseline. Direct classification is more accurate for all six models. On samples with usable outputs from both paths, its accuracy advantage ranges from 3.7 to 20.9 percentage points, with all 95% cluster-bootstrap confidence intervals for the differences above zero. It also achieves higher malicious alert recall in ten of twelve platform and model combinations. Claim mediation provides no consistent reduction in performance variation across models. Separate subset studies find more consistent alert decisions for direct classification and a larger recall loss for the claim path when predefined indicator fields are removed. In a family identification probe, claims yield higher accuracy than verdict labels but lower accuracy than evidence text. Retained claims expose the inputs to verdict computation and permit policy revision without another model call. We reproduce archived verdicts exactly and apply a revised policy to the same records, including outputs from two additional models withdrawn by their provider. Under the evaluated claim taxonomy and additive policy, these results favor direct classification when only a verdict is required, while demonstrating that retained claims support explicit policy inspection and revision.

AI.tldr: 本文提出恶意软件分诊框架MARS，在相同证据采集器与静态证据包下对比"直接判决"与"单次行为声明+外部策略评分"两条路径，结果显示直接分类在准确率、告警召回率等方面整体更优，而声明中介的价值主要体现在策略可检视与可修订。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型可用于恶意软件分诊，既可给出直接判决，也可输出行为声明再由外部策略打分。此前缺乏在完全受控条件下（同一证据采集器、同一证据包、多模型多平台）对这两种范式的系统比较，因此需要厘清直接分类与声明中介各自的性能与可解释性权衡。
AI.method: 构建MARS分诊框架，对每个模型使用相同的证据采集器和完全一致的静态证据包。评测覆盖1,195个PE与ELF二进制文件，聚合为1,001个近重复簇，涉及6个语言模型，并以确定性规则作为基线。对比直接分类与单次声明评分两条路径，采用簇级自助法（cluster-bootstrap）置信区间评估差异，并开展子集研究（剔除预定义指示字段）及家族识别探针。此外复现归档判决，并施加修订后的策略。
AI.result: 直接分类在全部6个模型上准确率更高；在两条路径均有可用输出的样本上，准确率优势为3.7至20.9个百分点，且所有差异的95%簇级自助置信区间均大于零。在12个平台×模型组合中有10个取得更高的恶意告警召回率，且未发现声明中介能一致降低跨模型性能波动。子集研究显示直接分类的告警决策更一致，而声明路径在移除预定义指示字段后召回损失更大。家族识别探针中，声明的准确率高于判决标签但低于证据文本。归档判决可被精确复现，并可对同一记录施加修订策略，包括提供方撤回的两个额外模型的输出。
AI.conclusion: 在所评测的声明分类体系与加性策略下，当仅需要最终判决时，结果支持直接分类；同时保留的声明能够暴露判决计算的输入，支持显式策略检视与修订，而无需再次调用模型，兼具可审计性与策略灵活性。

title: Beyond Reconstruction: What Matters in Action Tokenization for Robot Policies?
summary: Autoregressive action-token policies such as vision-language-action models require action tokenizers to translate discrete token sequences into precise control actions in continuous space. Many action tokenizers learn the mapping between tokens and actions via a reconstruction objective. However, as we show through extensive analysis, sufficiently accurate action reconstruction is only one part of what makes a downstream robot policy successful. It is also critical that the policy is able to predict the right tokens for new observations, and that unseen policy token predictions still decode into reasonable actions. These properties are downstream of tokenizer training and are not directly incentivized by a reconstruction objective alone. In this work, we introduce Predictable and Robust Action Tokenization (ProAct), a tokenizer training method that strategically augments reconstruction with the goal of improving downstream predictability and robustness. ProAct is policy-agnostic and uses only action datasets for training. Across the Robomimic, LIBERO, and RoboTwin benchmarks and a diverse set of tokenizer architectures, ProAct improves rollout success by an average of 11.3 percentage points. These improvements also translate to vision-language-action policies and real-world robotic manipulation, yielding average gains of 21.8 and 36.7 percentage points, respectively. These results suggest that effective action tokenization should be designed as a policy interface that balances fidelity, predictability, and robustness, rather than as a reconstruction problem alone.

AI.tldr: 提出 ProAct 动作分词器训练方法，在重建目标基础上兼顾下游可预测性与鲁棒性，在多个基准和真实机器人上大幅提升成功率。
AI.motivation: 自回归动作-token 策略（如 VLA 模型）依赖动作分词器将离散 token 序列映射为连续空间的精确控制动作。现有分词器多以重建目标学习映射，但作者通过分析表明：充分精确的动作重建只是下游策略成功的必要条件之一；策略还需能为新观测预测正确 token，且未见过的 token 预测仍能解码为合理动作。这两点属于分词器训练的下游属性，单靠重建目标无法直接激励。
AI.method: ProAct（Predictable and Robust Action Tokenization）：一种分词器训练方法，在重建目标之外进行策略性增强，以提升下游可预测性与鲁棒性。该方法与策略无关（policy-agnostic），仅使用动作数据集训练，可适配多种分词器架构。
AI.result: 在 Robomimic、LIBERO、RoboTwin 基准及多种分词器架构上，ProAct 使 rollout 成功率平均提升 11.3 个百分点；在视觉-语言-动作策略上平均提升 21.8 个百分点，在真实机器人操作上平均提升 36.7 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 有效的动作分词应被设计为平衡保真度、可预测性与鲁棒性的“策略接口”，而非单纯的重建问题。

title: ToolRACER: A Robust Agentic Conversation Emulation Resource for Agent Training and Evaluation
summary: Task-oriented conversational agents remain fragile under real world conversation scenarios as they rarely follow a predictable script, especially when users exhibit non-cooperative behavior. Existing function-calling benchmarks often emphasize successful, cooperative interactions and underrepresent adversarial conversation trajectories, thereby limiting the training resources available for developing robust agents. We present ToolRACER, a synthetic data generation pipeline that coordinates user, assistant and tool emulation models to generate and validated multi-turn interactions between a user and an agent. Using \sysn, we construct ToolRACERBench a robust multi-turn conversation benchmark spanning six domains, ranging over 55 varied personas, generating a validated corpus of 5.6K conversation trajectories, with approximately 66\% of conversations containing failure-prone conversation scenarios. We inject adversarial behaviors, producing validated conversational interaction trajectories that capture realistic, robust scenarios. We evaluate models trained on ToolRACERBench against internal benchmarks, as well as on function calling benchmarks such as $τ^2$-bench, BFCLv3 and ACEBench to evaluate agentic accuracy and robustness. Models trained on ToolRACERBench improve end to end agentic accuracy across $τ^2$-bench and ACEBench, demonstrating significant gains when mixed with in-domain dataset in small language models for agent capability tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出ToolRACER合成数据生成流水线，协调用户、助手与工具模拟模型生成并验证多轮对话，构建ToolRACERBench基准（6领域、55种人格、5.6K轨迹，约66%含易失败场景），注入对抗行为以提升智能体鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 任务型对话智能体在真实场景中表现脆弱，用户常不遵循可预测脚本且可能表现非合作行为。现有函数调用基准多强调成功、合作的交互，低估了对抗性对话轨迹，导致训练鲁棒智能体的资源不足。
AI.method: 提出ToolRACER合成数据生成流水线，协调用户模拟、助手模拟与工具模拟三类模型，生成并验证用户与智能体之间的多轮交互。基于该流水线构建ToolRACERBench多轮对话基准，覆盖6个领域、55种多样人格，生成5.6K条经验证的对话轨迹，并注入对抗行为以捕获真实、鲁棒的对话场景。
AI.result: 在内部基准及τ²-bench、BFCLv3、ACEBench等函数调用基准上评估。在ToolRACERBench上训练的模型在τ²-bench与ACEBench上端到端智能体准确率提升；在小语言模型的智能体能力任务中，与域内数据集混合时获得显著增益。
AI.conclusion: 面向对抗性与非合作场景的合成多轮对话数据可有效提升智能体的函数调用准确率与鲁棒性，尤其在小语言模型结合域内数据时增益显著，表明该类基准与数据流水线对鲁棒智能体训练具有价值。

title: SPLATIFY: Reproduce, Discover, Innovate! From Papers and Ideas to Trainable 3DGS Code
summary: The rapid growth of 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) research demands significant effort to reimplement papers before building on them. We introduce SPLATIFY, a multi-agent framework that converts 3DGS papers into trainable gsplat-based implementations, where generic paper-to-code methods and frontier models fail. SPLATIFY achieves this through five innovations: (1) A context-free grammar for gsplat over a modular method template with extension points for losses, densification, rendering, and optimization, constraining synthesis so generated code satisfies gsplat's architectural invariants by construction. (2) Architectural elements for faithful reproduction: fork-aware citation recovery retrieving component-level code at function-level granularity, Graph-of-Thought synthesis in topological dependency order, RAG-guided in-context example selection from over 20 verified implementations, and visual feedback combining PSNR-guided regeneration, Gaussian-level structural checks, and VLM-driven patching. (3) Knowledge-driven compositional improvement that autonomously finds weaknesses and composes complementary regularizers, losses, and densification strategies to improve upon original results. (4) Interdisciplinary method discovery where agents retrieve physical priors from outside the 3DGS literature and compose them with rendering knowledge to produce methods for previously unaddressed scene types. (5) SPLATIFY-Bench, an evaluation framework across 30 diverse 3DGS papers. On papers without public code, SPLATIFY matches expert implementations while reducing development time from weeks to minutes, and through compositional discovery further improves PSNR by up to 2.4 dB. We additionally demonstrate novel methods for volumetric nebula rendering and other scientific domains, synthesized entirely by SPLATIFY.

AI.tldr: SPLATIFY 是一个多智能体框架，能将 3DGS 论文自动转化为可训练的 gsplat 实现，在无公开代码的论文上匹配专家实现并将开发时间从数周缩短至数分钟，通过组合式发现进一步提升 PSNR 达 2.4 dB。
AI.motivation: 3DGS 研究快速增长，复现论文需要大量精力才能在其基础上继续工作；通用的论文到代码方法和前沿模型在此任务上失败，亟需一个能自动、忠实生成可训练实现的框架。
AI.method: 框架包含五项创新：(1) 面向 gsplat 的上下文无关语法，基于带扩展点（损失、致密化、渲染、优化）的模块化方法模板，通过构造保证生成代码满足架构不变量；(2) 忠实复现的架构要素：fork 感知的引用恢复（函数级粒度）、按拓扑依赖顺序的 Graph-of-Thought 合成、基于 20+ 已验证实现的 RAG 示例选择、以及结合 PSNR 引导再生成、高斯级结构检查与 VLM 驱动补丁的视觉反馈；(3) 知识驱动的组合式改进，自主发现弱点并组合互补正则化、损失与致密化策略；(4) 跨学科方法发现，从 3DGS 文献之外检索物理先验并与渲染知识组合；(5) SPLATIFY-Bench，覆盖 30 篇多样化 3DGS 论文的评测框架。
AI.result: 在无公开代码的论文上，SPLATIFY 匹配专家实现，开发时间从数周降至数分钟，并通过组合式发现将 PSNR 最高提升 2.4 dB；还合成了体渲染星云等新方法。
AI.conclusion: SPLATIFY 验证了多智能体、语法约束与知识组合在 3DGS 论文自动复现与改进中的有效性，并可扩展至体渲染星云渲染及其他科学领域的新方法合成。

title: Whose Memory Is It? Scope-Aware Commit Rules for Long-Term LLM Memory
summary: Persistent memory allows an LLM agent to carry experience across conversations, but it also turns a local reasoning mistake into a durable one. During deliberation, an agent may consider a plan, simulate a tool result, report another speaker's belief, and then reject all of them. If memory retains only the resulting sentences, those once-useful possibilities can later return as facts. The record is neither fabricated nor irrelevant; it has simply been detached from the context in which it was valid. We identify this missing context as \emph{discourse ownership}: the world, branch, or speaker that licenses a proposition. Our first finding is counterintuitive. Language models already carry a causally active signal for ownership, yet conventional memory interfaces discard it when they convert reasoning into records. We introduce CASK (Causally Anchored Scoping Keys), a commit rule that preserves this signal so that shared-world facts enter durable memory while provisional content remains available only within its original scope. Our second finding is that the most obvious way to preserve the signal---storing the discovered internal coordinates---is unreliable because equivalent representations need not keep the same coordinates. CASK instead preserves the stable relations that express ownership. Controlled long-conversation conflicts and tool-agent traces show that this design improves memory admission and prevents provisional content from contaminating later answers while complementing runtime provenance. The resulting commit boundary lets agents explore more possibilities without granting every intermediate sentence authority over future behavior.

AI.tldr: 论文研究持久记忆使LLM智能体的局部推理错误变为持久错误的问题，提出"话语归属"概念并设计CASK提交规则，在保持共享世界事实进入持久记忆的同时，将临时内容限制在原始作用域内，实验证明其改善记忆准入并防止临时内容污染后续回答。
AI.motivation: 持久记忆让LLM智能体能够跨对话携带经验，但也使局部推理错误变得持久。智能体在推理中可能考虑计划、模拟工具结果、转述他人信念，随后又全部否定；若记忆只保留结论性句子，这些曾经有用的可能性会脱离其有效语境，日后作为事实重新出现。记录既非捏造也非无关，只是失去了原本使其有效的语境，即"话语归属"（授权命题的世界、分支或说话者）。
AI.method: 作者首先发现语言模型内部已携带因果活跃的归属信号，而常规记忆接口在将推理转化为记录时丢弃了该信号。为此提出CASK（因果锚定作用域键）提交规则，保留该信号以使共享世界事实进入持久记忆、临时内容仅保留于原始作用域。第二个发现是直接存储发现的内部坐标不可靠，因为等价表示未必保持相同坐标；CASK转而保留表达归属的稳定关系。
AI.result: 在受控的长对话冲突与工具智能体轨迹上，该设计改善了记忆准入，防止临时内容污染后续答案，并与运行时溯源形成互补。
AI.conclusion: 由此形成的提交边界使智能体能够探索更多可能性，而不必将每一句中间结论都赋予对未来行为的权威性。

title: Work While They Sleep: Exploiting Evaluation Latency for Fully Bayesian Optimization
summary: Black-box optimization problems are ubiquitous across science and engineering, often dealing with expensive objective functions. This objective latency has two consequences during optimization: (i) the objective evaluation dominates execution time, and (ii) sample-efficient algorithms are crucial to accelerate development and avoid wasting resources. Bayesian optimization (BO) methods are the \textit{de facto} choice of planners for suggesting the next point to try. Standard BO fits the surrogate model's hyperparameters with a point estimate. Alternatively, a fully Bayesian approach uses model averaging to account for uncertainty over the hyperparameters, leading to better uncertainty estimates---useful in the low-data regime that is pervasive in BO. However, it is often prohibitively expensive and thus rarely used. In this work, we propose ELF-BO, an algorithm that uses the objective evaluation latency to headstart the computation of the next suggestion, allowing for fully Bayesian optimization without incurring substantial decision-time costs. This is done by sampling from the hyperparameter posterior \emph{while} the objective is being evaluated, only requiring reweighting of the samples once the objective value is observed. Across synthetic functions and real-world applications, we show that ELF-BO matches the performance of fully Bayesian methods while only incurring decision latency on par with or better than standard BO. Thus, ELF-BO makes fully Bayesian optimization practical in real-world use cases.

AI.tldr: ELF-BO利用目标函数评估的延迟时间，在评估过程中并行采样超参数后验，从而以与标准BO相当的决策延迟实现完全贝叶斯优化。
AI.motivation: 黑盒优化中目标函数评估昂贵且耗时长，导致目标评估主导运行时间，并且需要样本高效的算法。标准BO用点估计拟合代理模型超参数，而完全贝叶斯方法通过模型平均考虑超参数不确定性，在低数据情况下能得到更好的不确定性估计，但计算代价过高、很少被使用。
AI.method: 提出ELF-BO算法，利用目标评估的延迟来提前计算下一个建议点。具体做法是在目标函数被评估的同时从超参数后验中采样，待观测到目标值后仅需对样本重新加权，从而实现完全贝叶斯优化而不带来显著的决策时间开销。
AI.result: 在合成函数和真实世界应用中，ELF-BO达到了完全贝叶斯方法的性能，同时其决策延迟与标准BO相当甚至更优。
AI.conclusion: ELF-BO使完全贝叶斯优化在真实应用场景中变得实用可行。

title: Correct Answers, Unsupported Findings: Evidence Binding in Forensic Reconstruction of LLM Agent Logs
summary: Forensic reconstruction of LLM-agent actions requires not only recovering the correct value, but establishing which preserved record supports that finding. Tool logs, generated explanations, and local citation identifiers capture different parts of this evidence, yet a citation identifier does not establish a source unless its binding to a record is preserved. We audit this distinction using 64 mechanically checkable cases from saved AgentDojo Banking executions. Two LLM readers reconstruct source relationships under controlled variations in visible evidence and identifier-to-record bindings. We separately evaluate complete-record agreement, evidence-grounded findings, justified abstention, and unsupported assertions. With original identifiers and no binding table, Sonnet recovered every literal source location but made unsupported citation-source assertions in 26 of 28 cases requiring the missing relation; 22 nevertheless matched the complete reference. Adding explicit bindings improved grounded reconstruction for both readers, whereas identifier renaming alone provided no consistent remedy. A deterministic same-packet comparator correctly resolved the bounded task or abstained throughout. These results show that factual agreement alone is insufficient for evaluating forensic reconstruction of agent logs and motivate preserving explicit record bindings to distinguish supported findings from correct guesses.

AI.tldr: 该文区分了"恢复正确取值"与"确立哪条留存记录支持该结论"两件事，指出引用标识符若无与记录的显式绑定，就不构成来源证明；并用64个可机械核验的AgentDojo Banking案例审计了这一点。
AI.motivation: LLM agent 行为的取证重建不仅要求取值正确，还要求指出是哪条留存记录支撑该结论。工具日志、生成的解释与局部引用标识符分别承载不同部分的证据，但引用标识符只有在与记录的绑定被保留时才构成来源，这一常被忽略的区分需要被系统审计。
AI.method: 从已保存的 AgentDojo Banking 执行中构造64个可机械核验的案例；在两个受控变量（可见证据、标识符—记录绑定）下，用两个LLM阅读器重建来源关系；分别评估完整记录一致性、有证据支撑的结论、有依据的弃答（abstention）与无支撑断言；并设置确定性同包比较器作为对照基线。
AI.result: 在保留原始标识符且无绑定表时，Sonnet 恢复了全部字面来源位置，但在28个需要缺失关系的案例中，有26例给出了无支撑的引用—来源断言；其中22例仍与完整参考答案一致。加入显式绑定后，两个阅读器的有据重建均改善；而仅重命名标识符并未带来一致改善。确定性同包比较器在该有界任务上全程正确解析或弃答。
AI.conclusion: 仅凭事实层面的一致不足以评估 agent 日志的取证重建；应保留显式的记录绑定，以区分"有支撑的结论"与"碰巧正确的猜测"。

title: CAP: Codebook-Aligned Prediction for Tokenized Robot Policies
summary: Action tokenization converts continuous robot actions into discrete symbols that can be modeled autoregressively. However, existing tokenizer-based policies typically ignore the tokenizer's learned latent code structure: after tokenization, the policy treats tokens as unrelated class indices and learns a new classifier from scratch. We show that this discarded structure is valuable. We introduce Codebook-Aligned Prediction (CAP), a method that directly reuses the tokenizer's code vectors as policy class prototypes while leaving the tokenizer and policy backbone otherwise unchanged. Across four quantizer families, three simulation benchmarks, and two real-robot tasks, CAP consistently improves task success over standard token classification heads while holding the tokenizer (and therefore its reconstruction quality) fixed. Our analysis further shows that these gains are not explained by higher token accuracy or changes in the policy head alone. Instead, reusing the tokenizer codebook provides the policy with valuable information about the tokenizer's learned latent structure across tokens, making token prediction errors more benign in action space and improving the representations learned by the policy backbone. These results suggest that action tokenizers learn useful action-aware latent structure beyond discrete targets that should be preserved when training downstream policies.

AI.tldr: 提出 Codebook-Aligned Prediction（CAP）方法，将动作分词器学习到的码本向量直接复用为策略的分类原型，而非将其视作无关类别索引，在多种量化器、仿真基准和真机任务中一致提升任务成功率。
AI.motivation: 现有基于分词器的策略丢弃了分词器学习到的潜码结构：分词后仅把 token 当作互不相关的类别索引，从零训练新的分类器。作者认为这一被丢弃的结构具有价值，应予保留。
AI.method: CAP 直接复用分词器的码本向量（code vectors）作为策略的类别原型，除此之外分词器与策略主干均保持不变；在四种量化器家族、三个仿真基准与两项真机任务上进行对比验证。
AI.result: 在固定分词器（及其重建质量）的前提下，CAP 相对标准 token 分类头一致提升任务成功率。分析表明，增益并非来自更高的 token 准确率或策略头的单独变化，而是复用码本为策略提供了 token 间潜结构信息，使 token 预测误差在动作空间中更良性，并改善策略主干学到的表征。
AI.conclusion: 动作分词器除离散目标外还学到了有用的、动作感知的潜结构，训练下游策略时应予以保留。

title: Multi-Objective Aligned Small Language Model Framework for SUD Patient Dialogue Generation
summary: Substance Use Disorder (SUD) counseling requires patient responses that reflect underlying cognitive states such as beliefs, coping strategies, and readiness for change. Although large language models (LLMs) can generate fluent text, they often fail to produce cognitively coherent and clinically realistic patient behavior, especially under ethical and data-scarce clinical settings. Moreover, deploying frontier-scale LLMs in healthcare applications presents practical challenges including high computational cost, latency, privacy concerns, and limited deployability in resource-constrained environments, motivating the need for cognitively aligned small language models (SLMs). We propose a cognitively grounded framework for SUD patient dialogue generation that explicitly models and aligns latent cognitive components with patient histories and counselor questions. Our pipeline consists of two stages: cognitive component detection and cognitive component-aligned dialogue generation. To enable effective learning with smaller models, we combine knowledge distillation from high-capacity teacher models, preference optimization from human-annotations, and attention-guided reward shaping.
