Extensive evaluations using automatic scores like BERTScore, ROUGE, METEOR and BLEU, and LLM-as-judge hit-metrics against both human and teacher-model references show that cognitively informed fine-tuning substantially improves cognitive realization and alignment over a generic instruction-tuned baselines and mental health domain specific SLMs, with particularly strong gains for open-ended cognitive components.

AI.tldr: 提出认知驱动的SUD患者对话生成框架，通过认知成分检测与对齐生成两阶段，结合知识蒸馏、偏好优化与注意力引导奖励塑造，使小语言模型在认知表达和对齐上显著优于通用及心理健康领域SLM基线与微调模型。
AI.motivation: SUD咨询需要患者回复反映信念、应对策略、改变意愿等潜在认知状态。LLM虽能生成流畅文本，却难以产生认知连贯且临床真实的行为；同时前沿大模型在医疗场景面临高算力成本、延迟、隐私与资源受限部署难题，因此需要认知对齐的小语言模型。
AI.method: 构建认知落地框架，显式建模并将潜在认知成分与患者病史、咨询师问题对齐。流程分两阶段：认知成分检测与认知成分对齐的对话生成。为支持小模型有效学习，结合高容量教师模型的知识蒸馏、基于人工标注的偏好优化及注意力引导的奖励塑造。
AI.result: 使用BERTScore、ROUGE、METEOR、BLEU等自动指标，以及以人类和教师模型为参考的LLM-as-judge命中指标评估。结果显示，认知信息微调在认知实现与对齐上显著优于通用指令微调基线和心理健康领域专用SLM，对开放式认知成分增益尤为突出。
AI.conclusion: 认知落地的小模型微调路线可有效提升SUD患者对话的认知真实性与临床对齐度，并在资源受限条件下具备较好可部署性，为心理健康对话系统提供可行方案。

title: TopoCurve: Geometry-Aware Topology Reasoning via Bézier Curves in Autonomous Driving
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026 (main track). 15 pages, 4 figures
summary: Topology reasoning jointly detects 3D lanes and traffic elements from multi-view images and infers their structural connectivity. Current methods model lanes as discrete polylines, lacking smoothness, analytical tangent directions, and global spatial support for attention, while providing sparse topology supervision. We propose TopoCurve, a geometry-driven architecture for 3D topology reasoning grounded in a structured parametric lane representation. Lanes are modeled as endpoint-fixed cubic Bézier curves, enabling continuous geometry with exact endpoints and analytically defined directionality. We exploit this shared curve geometry across the entire pipeline. Endpoint distance and tangent alignment are encoded with multi-scale Fourier features and injected into the topology head. Sampled curve points serve as geometry-aligned references for deformable cross-attention spanning the full lane. Parallel curve-anchored attention branches provide diverse predictions for one-to-many topology supervision. These components form a tightly coupled cascade where representation enables geometric reasoning, guides feature aggregation, and supports denser supervision. TopoCurve achieves 50.6 OLS on the OpenLane-V2 benchmark without any post-processing, establishing a new state-of-the-art among end-to-end camera-only methods, and outperforms all existing approaches on endpoint detection (56.8 vs. 52.6 on DET_p).

AI.tldr: 本文提出TopoCurve，一种基于结构化参数化车道表示的几何驱动3D拓扑推理架构，将车道建模为端点固定的三次贝塞尔曲线，在OpenLane-V2上达到50.6 OLS的新SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有方法将车道建模为离散折线，缺乏平滑性、解析切向方向和用于注意力的全局空间支撑，同时仅提供稀疏的拓扑监督。作者希望引入更贴合几何本质的车道表示来改进3D车道与交通要素的拓扑推理。
AI.method: 提出TopoCurve架构：车道建模为端点固定的三次贝塞尔曲线，具备连续几何、精确端点与解析方向性；端点距离与切线对齐用多尺度傅里叶特征编码并注入拓扑头；采样曲线点作为几何对齐参考用于可变形交叉注意力，覆盖整条车道；并行曲线锚定注意力分支为单到多拓扑监督提供多样预测。各组件构成紧耦合级联。
AI.result: 在OpenLane-V2基准上，无需任何后处理即达到50.6 OLS，在纯相机端到端方法中刷新SOTA；端点检测DET_p达56.8，优于所有现有方法（对比52.6）。
AI.conclusion: 基于参数化贝塞尔曲线的几何驱动表示能有效统一车道表示、特征聚合与监督，验证了表示—几何推理—特征引导—密集监督紧耦合级联设计的有效性，为3D拓扑推理提供了新的SOTA方案。

title: Enabling Dynamic Computation in Looped LMs
summary: Looped LMs are parameter efficient and promise dynamic computation (saving memory and FLOPs on easy tokens). However, state-of-the-art open Looped LMs trained with this dynamic computation capability (Ouro models) do not realize it in practice as each loop iteration (depth) requires its own level of KV-cache, necessitating all loop computations. Moreover, Ouro's early-exit prior is enforced on each token equally, which results in static lower-depth like processing of all tokens regardless of difficulty. In this work, we propose a simple "best-available" KV caching strategy that works out-of-the-box, creating a new frontier in the performance vs depth space. Our approach enables up to 30% reduction in FLOPs and KV memory while retaining full-depth performance, showing the true flexibility of Looped LMs. Furthermore, training looped LMs with awareness about this KV caching strategy improves performance and efficiency. Finally, we apply a small but effective fix to the early-exit prior enforcement objective that makes tokens exit at truly heterogeneous depths based on effort. Our findings are validated on Ouro models as well as smaller looped LMs pre-trained from scratch.

AI.tldr: 提出"best-available" KV缓存策略，使Looped LM实现真正的动态计算，在保持全深度性能的同时减少30% FLOPs与KV内存，并改进早退先验使token按难度异质退出。
AI.motivation: Looped LM理论上参数高效且支持动态计算（简单token可省内存与FLOPs），但现有SOTA开源模型（Ouro）在实践中无法兑现：每次循环迭代（深度）需独立KV-cache，导致必须执行全部循环；且早退先验对所有token一视同仁，造成所有token被静态地按较低深度处理，与难度无关。
AI.method: 1）提出即插即用的"best-available" KV缓存策略，在性能-深度空间中开辟新前沿；2）在训练Looped LM时引入对该KV缓存策略的感知，以提升性能与效率；3）对早退先验施加目标做小而有效的修正，使token依据实际计算难度在真正异质的深度退出。
AI.result: 在Ouro模型及从零预训练的较小Looped LM上验证：在保留全深度性能的前提下，FLOPs与KV内存最高减少30%；训练时引入缓存策略感知进一步提升性能与效率；早退目标修正使token退出深度呈现异质性。
AI.conclusion: 该工作通过KV缓存与早退目标的改进，首次让Looped LM的动态深度计算在实践中真正可行，兼顾性能、效率与灵活性。

title: The Best Optimizer Depends on Batch Size
summary: A plethora of new adaptive optimizers are designed to efficiently estimate and use minibatch gradient statistics to shape parameter updates, but they are typically benchmarked at a single batch size. Hyperparameter scaling rules promise to preserve performance as batch size and gradient noise change, suggesting that the best optimizer at one batch size should remain the best at another. We challenge this approach to developing and evaluating optimizers by showing: (1) no principled scaling rule for Muon works consistently across training settings, and (2) the best optimizer for language model pretraining changes with batch size even after extensive hyperparameter tuning.

AI.tldr: 该论文挑战了"优化器性能可跨批次大小迁移"的假设：Muon缺乏一致的缩放规则，且在充分调参后，语言模型预训练的最佳优化器仍随批次大小变化。
AI.motivation: 当前大量新型自适应优化器通过估计并利用小批次梯度统计量来塑造参数更新，但通常仅在单一批次大小下进行基准测试，并依赖超参数缩放规则假定其性能可跨批次大小与梯度噪声保持一致。作者质疑这一开发与评估范式，认为其可能掩盖优化器在不同批次大小下的真实差异。
AI.method: 作者测试了Muon等优化器是否存在能跨训练设置一致有效的原理性缩放规则，并在不同批次大小下进行语言模型预训练，对包括Muon在内的多种优化器进行大规模超参数调优后对比其性能。
AI.result: 研究发现：(1) 对于Muon，不存在能跨训练设置一致有效的原理性缩放规则；(2) 即使经过充分的超参数调优，语言模型预训练的最佳优化器仍会随批次大小改变。
AI.conclusion: 仅在单一批次大小下基准测试并依赖缩放规则推断优化器优劣的做法不可靠；优化器的评估应覆盖多种批次大小，且现有优化器在跨批次大小泛化方面仍存在根本性不足。

title: Automotive Hardware Attacks: An Architect's Guide to TARA
summary: Threat analysis and risk assessment (TARA) according to ISO/SAE 21434 treats implementation-level hardware attacks inconsistently. We show that two of the three attack-feasibility approaches exemplified in the standard rate every attack path that requires physical access as very low by construction, independent of the implementation, while the third can assign the same path any of the four ratings, depending on the assumed state of attacker knowledge and on the attacker profile. This paper presents a hardware-aware extension of the TARA that covers side-channel analysis (SCA), fault-injection attacks (FIA), and abuse of debug and test interfaces. It adds an attacker model for physical access over the vehicle lifecycle; a path-dominance relation on the attack-potential factors that identifies when a simpler path makes a sophisticated one irrelevant; a three-level hardware relevance gate (H0 to H2) with an explicit decision rule that fixes whether resistance of a hardware step may be argued, must be documented, or must be demonstrated by test; and a rating rule under which a hardware step receives no credit for implementation-specific resistance until the required evidence exists. The gate is positioned relative to cybersecurity assurance levels and targeted attack feasibility. The method is applied to a reference gateway architecture, and its structural inputs are examined on ten published attacks on automotive components. In seven of the ten studies, the demonstrated attack included a debug, programming, boot, diagnostic, or update mechanism, whereas only four studies included an attack on a cryptographic computation.

AI.tldr: 本文指出ISO/SAE 21434的TARA方法对硬件层攻击（侧信道、故障注入、调试/测试接口滥用）处理不一致，提出一种硬件感知的TARA扩展，包含物理访问攻击者模型、攻击路径支配关系、三级硬件相关性门控（H0–H2）及证据驱动的评级规则，并在参考网关架构与十项已公开车载攻击上验证。
AI.motivation: 标准中示例的三种攻击可行性评估方法对硬件攻击的评级不一致：其中两种将所有需要物理访问的攻击路径武断地评为极低，与实现无关；第三种则因攻击者知识状态与画像不同而可给出四种评级中的任意一种。这种不一致使实现级硬件攻击（SCA、FIA、调试与测试接口滥用）无法被一致地纳入TARA。
AI.method: 提出硬件感知的TARA扩展：1）覆盖整车生命周期的物理访问攻击者模型；2）在攻击潜力因子上定义路径支配关系，识别简单路径使复杂路径失效的情形；3）三级硬件相关性门控H0–H2，以显式判定规则确定硬件步骤的抗性是可论证、须记录还是须经测试证明；4）评级规则规定在所需证据存在前，硬件步骤不得因实现特定抗性而获得加分；并将门控与网络安全保障等级及针对性攻击可行性对齐。
AI.result: 方法应用于一个参考网关架构，并在十项已公开的车载部件攻击研究上检验其结构性输入：其中七项所演示的攻击涉及调试、编程、启动、诊断或更新机制，而仅四项涉及对密码计算的攻击。
AI.conclusion: ISO/SAE 21434现有攻击可行性方法对硬件攻击的评级存在系统性缺陷；所提出的硬件感知TARA扩展通过物理访问攻击者模型、路径支配关系、H0–H2门控与证据门槛规则，为硬件抗性的主张提供一致且可审计的处理方式，实证结果显示调试/编程/启动/诊断/更新等接口是车载攻击的主导入口，密码计算攻击相对少见。

title: Embedded Evaluation of Task Admission Coalescing in Decentralized Multi-Robot Systems
summary: Multi-robot task allocators in dynamic missions commonly admit newly released tasks immediately, potentially invoking allocation for each new arrival. We evaluate task-admission coalescing as a mechanism for controlling allocator processor work while accounting for target-service latency, using CBAA, ACBBA, PI, and HIPC as a representative MRTA suite. The study comprises a 3,000-mission AGX Orin campaign with measured computation delay, 3,000 paired zero-compute missions, and a 96-mission Pololu 3pi+ RP2040 allocator hardware-in-the-loop campaign. Immediate (Eager) admission is compared with thresholds of two, four, and eight tasks and a four-task policy with a 10-s waiting bound across three arrival rates. Across the AGX experiments, coalescing reduces both allocator calls and processor work in 31 of 48 evaluated conditions, although the magnitude of the saving varies by allocator. The principal cost appears under sparse arrivals, where four-task batching increases online-target mean latency by 20.08-23.57 s, predominantly through admission waiting. Bounded admission reduces mean work in ten of twelve allocator-load conditions, including a 19.35% reduction with a 1.40-s mean latency increase for high-arrival HIPC. RP2040 experiments show that this tradeoff can become more favorable as processor constraints tighten. Across four matched medium-arrival HIPC scenarios, Count b=4 reduces mean RP2040 work by 59.85% and service latency by 39.47%, while the corresponding AGX cases increase latency by 27.69%. These results show that the usefulness of task-admission coalescing depends on arrival intensity, allocator-specific behavior, and the relative cost of computation on the execution platform.

AI.tldr: 该研究评估了多机器人任务分配中的"任务准入合并"机制，发现在计算资源受限平台上合并能大幅降低处理器工作量并改善时延，但收益高度依赖任务到达强度与分配器类型。
AI.motivation: 动态任务场景下的多机器人任务分配器（MRTA）通常对新发布任务立即准入，导致每有新任务到达就可能触发一次完整分配计算，造成处理器负担。作者希望评估"任务准入合并"能否在可控的目标服务时延代价下，有效控制分配器的计算工作。
AI.method: 以 CBAA、ACBBA、PI、HIPC 四类典型 MRTA 分配器为对象，开展三组实验：(1) AGX Orin 平台 3,000 任务的实测计算时延实验；(2) 3,000 个配对的零计算任务实验；(3) Pololu 3pi+ RP2040 平台 96 个任务分配器硬件在环实验。对比"立即准入(Eager)"与阈值 2/4/8 任务、以及带 10 秒等待上界的 4 任务策略，覆盖三种任务到达率。
AI.result: AGX 实验中，48 个条件中有 31 个条件经合并后同时降低了分配器调用次数与处理器工作量，但节省幅度因分配器而异。主要代价出现在稀疏到达情形：4 任务批处理使在线目标平均时延增加 20.08–23.57 s，主要源于准入等待。有界准入在 12 个分配器-负载条件中的 10 个降低了平均工作量，如高到达率 HIPC 下工作量降低 19.35%、平均时延仅增加 1.40 s。RP2040 实验表明处理器约束越紧该权衡越有利：4 个匹配的中等到达率 HIPC 场景中，Count b=4 使平均工作量降低 59.85%、服务时延降低 39.47%，而对应 AGX 情形时延反而增加 27.69%。
AI.conclusion: 任务准入合并的有效性取决于任务到达强度、分配器的具体行为，以及执行平台上计算的相对成本；在资源受限平台上该机制收益更显著。

title: Dialect-Robust Speech Language Models with Synthetic Pseudo-Dialect Augmentation
comment: 7 pages, 1 figure, 7 tables. Accepted to IEEE SLT 2026
summary: Speech Language Model (SLM) performance often degrades on dialects due to data scarcity. Conventional text-to-speech (TTS) augmentation struggles to cover diverse dialects as it requires a certain amount of real dialect speech. We propose synthesizing pseudo-dialect speech by converting LLM-generated dialect text via a standard-language TTS model, requiring zero real dialect speech. Additionally, we introduce intermediate standard-text prediction during training, acting as semantic normalization for downstream tasks. We evaluate dialect understanding via dialect-to-English speech translation across Japanese, German, and Chinese dialects. Compared to synthetic standard speech baselines, pseudo-dialect augmentation improves scores for Japanese (from 25.38 to 26.24) and German (from 31.57 to 32.47). Furthermore, the intermediate standard-text prediction effectively bridges the semantic gap, boosting performance to 28.26 for Japanese and from 11.67 to 16.37 for Chinese. These results suggest that our approach scales to various languages without requiring speech resources specific to each dialect.

AI.tldr: 提出零真实方言语音的伪方言语音合成与中间标准文本预测方法，提升SLM方言理解能力。
AI.motivation: 语音语言模型（SLM）在方言场景下性能下降，根源是方言数据稀缺；传统TTS数据增强仍依赖一定量真实方言语音，难以覆盖多样方言，因此需要一种不依赖真实方言语音的可扩展方案。
AI.method: 1）伪方言语音合成：用LLM生成方言文本，再经标准语TTS模型合成为语音，实现零真实方言语音；2）训练中引入中间标准文本预测，作为面向下游任务的语义归一化机制；3）在日语、德语、汉语方言上以方言到英语的语音翻译任务评估方言理解。
AI.result: 相对合成标准语音基线，伪方言增强将日语从25.38提升至26.24、德语从31.57提升至32.47；加入中间标准文本预测后可进一步弥合语义鸿沟，日语提升至28.26，汉语从11.67提升至16.37。
AI.conclusion: 该方法无需各方言专属语音资源，即可跨语言扩展，表明其在多语言方言理解上具有良好可扩展性。

title: Depth-to-RGB: Repurposing a Frozen Depth Estimator for Geometry-Guided Compositing
summary: Reference-based object compositing inserts or replaces an object using a background image, a reference image, and a 2D compositing mask. These inputs guide appearance and placement but leave the completed scene's geometry implicit, which can distort object structure or alter the surroundings. Our Depth-to-RGB (D2R) framework predicts composite depth for a scene not yet observed in the RGB inputs. It learns reference-conditioned corrections to a frozen depth estimator using encoder features of paired completed scenes as targets. The unchanged decoder maps the corrected representation to the intended scene's depth, which a separately trained renderer holds fixed during RGB synthesis. Under matched architecture and training, encoder-feature supervision reduces OOD Stage-1 AbsRel by 31.4% relative to decoded-depth supervision. We also introduce AnyInsertion++ with paired in-distribution and category-disjoint splits to evaluate generalization beyond compositing training categories. The complete D2R system leads 12 open-source and 3 closed-source baselines in estimator-derived geometry and photometric quality on both paired splits. On category-disjoint data, D2R reduces AbsRel by 43.7% and improves PSNR by 2.4 dB over the matched RGB baseline. Across three unpaired benchmarks, D2R leads both identity metrics and reduces mean CLIP reference cosine distance by 55% relative to the strongest baseline. Project page: https://shjo-april.github.io/Depth2RGB/

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Depth-to-RGB (D2R) 框架，通过参考条件化的深度修正与编码器特征监督，为参考图像物体合成任务预测尚未观测场景的合成深度，在几何与光度质量上超越多个开源与闭源基线。
AI.motivation: 参考图像物体合成仅以背景图、参考图和2D合成掩码为输入，场景几何是隐式的，容易导致物体结构扭曲或周边环境改变。因此需要显式预测合成后场景的深度几何以保证结构一致性。
AI.method: D2R 框架：以冻结的深度估计器为基础，学习参考条件化的深度修正；以配对完整场景的编码器特征作为监督目标，修正后的表示经由不变的解码器映射到目标场景深度，并由单独训练且固定的渲染器完成RGB合成。提出 AnyInsertion++ 数据集，含配对同分布与类别不相交两种划分以评估泛化。对比12个开源和3个闭源基线。
AI.result: 在匹配架构与训练下，编码器特征监督相比解码深度监督将 OOD Stage-1 AbsRel 降低31.4%。完整D2R系统在两种配对划分的几何与光度质量上领先全部基线；在类别不相交数据上，AbsRel 降低43.7%、PSNR 提升2.4 dB。三个非配对基准上身份指标领先，平均CLIP参考余弦距离较最强基线降低55%。
AI.conclusion: 显式建模并监督合成深度可有效提升参考图像物体合成的几何一致性与泛化能力，D2R在多个设定下均优于现有基线。

title: PAIR: Bridging Perception and Action in Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models map visual observations and language instructions to continuous robot actions. This task requires a transition from representations that describe the scene and instruction to representations that support action generation. Many continuous-action VLAs leave this transition implicit and supervise it mainly through the final action-prediction loss. We introduce PAIR, a framework that learns a shared perception-action representation between these two spaces. During training, a Masked Action Autoencoder encodes expert action chunks into horizon-aligned Action Latent Tokens. A Bridge Module extracts task-relevant features from the current visual-language representations. PAIR aligns these features with the Action Latent Tokens to form Bridge Tokens that preserve task information and capture the structure of expert actions. The Bridge Tokens are then projected into the action-token space and injected into the initial Action Tokens, providing an action-ready starting point for Action Expert refinement. At inference, the autoencoder is removed, and the Bridge Tokens are generated only from the current observation and instruction. Experiments on LIBERO, LIBERO-Plus, and CALVIN ABC-D show gains for the evaluated OpenVLA-OFT and VLA-Adapter models. On LIBERO-Plus, PAIR raises VLA-Adapter's success rate from 59.1% to 64.2%. On CALVIN, it increases VLA-Adapter's average completed sequence length from 4.42 to 4.53. Across seven real-world tasks, PAIR raises OpenVLA-OFT's success rate from 51.4% to 65.0%. Representation analyses show that Bridge Tokens retain task information while making continuous-action information accessible before Action Expert refinement. These results support a shared intermediate representation as a useful interface between perception and action in continuous-action VLAs.

AI.tldr: PAIR 通过引入"桥接令牌"这一共享的感知-动作中间表示，显式建模视觉语言到连续动作的过渡，在多个仿真与真实基准上提升 VLA 模型成功率。
AI.motivation: 现有连续动作 VLA 模型从描述场景与指令的表示到支持动作生成的表示之间的过渡是隐式的，仅依靠最终动作预测损失进行监督，缺乏显式的中间表示引导。
AI.method: 训练时，Masked Action Autoencoder 将专家动作块编码为与时间跨度对齐的 Action Latent Tokens；Bridge Module 从当前视觉-语言表示中提取任务相关特征，并与 Action Latent Tokens 对齐形成 Bridge Tokens；Bridge Tokens 被投影到动作令牌空间并注入初始 Action Tokens，为 Action Expert 提供可动作的起点。推理时移除自编码器，Bridge Tokens 仅由当前观测与指令生成。
AI.result: 在 LIBERO、LIBERO-Plus、CALVIN ABC-D 上，OpenVLA-OFT 与 VLA-Adapter 均获得提升：LIBERO-Plus 上 VLA-Adapter 成功率由 59.1% 升至 64.2%；CALVIN 上平均完成序列长度由 4.42 升至 4.53；在七个真实任务上，OpenVLA-OFT 成功率由 51.4% 升至 65.0%。
AI.conclusion: 表示分析表明 Bridge Tokens 在 Action Expert 精炼前既保留任务信息又使连续动作信息可访问。结果支持将共享中间表示作为连续动作 VLA 中感知与动作之间的有效接口。

title: SNR-Gated LSTM-Conditioned Diffusion Model for MIMO Channel Estimation
comment: 5 pages, 5 figures. Accepted by and presented at the 2026 IEEE 104th Vehicular Technology Conference (VTC2026-Fall)
summary: Accurate and low latency channel estimation is critical for modern MIMO systems, particularly under mobility, where channels exhibit structured sparsity and strong temporal correlation. This paper proposes a time-series conditioned diffusion framework for channel estimation that performs denoising in the angular domain. Starting from least squares (LS) observations, we train a diffusion denoiser whose conditioning information is encoded by a long short-term memory (LSTM) network over a short observation sequence, enabling the model to exploit temporal dynamics beyond per-snapshot estimation. To robustly balance observation fidelity and learned generative priors across a wide signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) range, we introduce a learnable SNR-gated late-fusion shortcut that injects the network input into the final decoding stage through a sigmoid gate with trainable center and scale. To reduce inference latency, we adopt deterministic denoising diffusion implicit model (DDIM) style reverse updates with SNR-adaptive truncation and step allocation, which significantly reduces the number of reverse diffusion steps at high SNR while maintaining strong performance in low SNR regimes. Simulations on time-evolving standardized channel models demonstrate that the proposed method achieves consistent performance gains over existing diffusion-based channel estimation baselines, while retaining low latency through SNR-adaptive inference.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种时序条件扩散框架，在角域进行信道去噪，结合LSTM时序编码、可学习SNR门控晚期融合捷径以及SNR自适应DDIM推理，实现MIMO信道估计的高精度与低时延。
AI.motivation: 现代MIMO系统在移动场景下信道呈现结构化稀疏与强时间相关性，要求信道估计兼具高精度与低时延。已有扩散类方法多基于单快照估计，未充分利用时间动态，且在高SNR下推理步数多、时延高，难以在宽SNR范围内兼顾观测保真与生成先验。
AI.method: 以最小二乘（LS）观测为起点，在角域进行扩散去噪；用LSTM对短观测序列编码条件信息，捕捉时间动态，超越单快照估计。引入可学习SNR门控晚期融合捷径，通过带可训练中心与尺度的sigmoid门将网络输入注入最终解码阶段，稳健平衡观测保真与生成先验。推理采用确定性DDIM式反向更新，并结合SNR自适应截断与步数分配以降低时延。
AI.result: 在时变标准化信道模型仿真中，所提方法相较现有扩散类信道估计基线取得一致性能增益；通过SNR自适应推理，在高SNR下显著减少反向扩散步数并保持低时延，同时在低SNR区间维持良好性能。
AI.conclusion: 该框架将时序条件扩散与SNR自适应推理相结合，在角域去噪中有效融合时间动态与生成先验，兼顾宽SNR范围下的估计精度与推理时延，为高移动MIMO信道估计提供了高效方案。

title: Understanding and Mitigating Token-Pruning-Induced Vulnerabilities in VLMs
summary: Token-Pruning accelerates Vision-Language Models by removing redundant visual tokens, yet its safety implications remain underexplored. In this work, we present the first comprehensive safety evaluation of Token-Pruning mechanisms and find that: most pruning strategies significantly degrade safety as pruning ratios increase, whereas Query-based Compression shows the opposite, with extreme pruning (up to 99.8%), unexpectedly improves model safety. This sharp contrast prompts a key question: How do different Token-Pruning strategies reshape model safety behavior, and is it possible to enhance safety without sacrificing acceleration? To answer this, we identify an unrecognized mechanism, termed Pruning-Induced Malicious Amplification, where removal of background tokens triggers a side effect: forcing the model's attention to collapse onto a few retained malicious anchors within the foreground, inadvertently amplifying their toxic semantics under jailbreak. To address that, we propose an inference-time and plug-and-play Safety-Aware Pruning (SAP) mechanism that counteracts such dominance via three steps: (1) identifying malicious anchors, (2) restoring pruned benign tokens, and (3) reallocating excessive attention from malicious anchors to benign tokens. Extensive experiments across three safety and four utility benchmarks demonstrate that SAP mitigates pruning-induced vulnerabilities, i.e., reducing ASR by up to 62%, without compromising efficiency or utility.

AI.tldr: 本文首次系统评估 Token-Pruning 对视觉语言模型安全性的影响，发现多数剪枝策略会随剪枝率上升显著降低安全性，而 Query-based Compression 在高剪枝率下反而提升安全；作者据此提出"剪枝诱导恶意放大"机制，并设计即插即用的推理期安全感知剪枝（SAP），在三个安全基准与四个效用基准上将 ASR 最多降低 62%，且不损失效率与效用。
AI.motivation: Token-Pruning 通过移除冗余视觉 token 加速 VLM，但其安全影响尚未被充分研究。作者希望回答：不同剪枝策略如何重塑模型安全行为，以及能否在不牺牲加速的前提下提升安全性。
AI.method: 提出"剪枝诱导恶意放大"机制：背景 token 被移除后，模型注意力坍缩至前景中少量保留的恶意锚点，在越狱场景下放大其有害语义。为此提出推理期、即插即用的安全感知剪枝（SAP），包含三步：(1) 识别恶意锚点，(2) 恢复被剪枝的良性 token，(3) 将恶意锚点上过度的注意力重新分配给良性 token。
AI.result: 在三个安全基准与四个效用基准上的大量实验表明，SAP 缓解了剪枝引入的脆弱性，ASR 最多降低 62%，同时不损害效率与效用。
AI.conclusion: Token-Pruning 的安全影响因策略而异，Query-based Compression 在极端剪枝下反而提升安全；"剪枝诱导恶意放大"是导致安全性下降的关键机制，SAP 可有效且高效地消除该风险。

title: Belief-Space Planning with Planner-Conditioned Estimator Error under Intermittent Observations
summary: Belief-space planners with separately designed or off-the-shelf estimators may have access to state-relevant information the estimator does not observe. Consequently, even an estimator that minimizes mean-squared error under its own information can have a nonzero error mean when conditioned on planner information. When future corrections are intermittent and stochastic, differences between accepted and rejected error means introduce additional uncertainty terms to correction events that zero-mean assumptions ignore. In this paper, we propose a belief-space planning approach that predicts, propagates, and penalizes planner-conditioned estimator error along evaluated trajectories. A planner-conditioned estimator-error model combines affine error dynamics with a moment recursion that preserves stochastically-induced correction uncertainty. We describe a method by which to predict estimator error dynamics within specified operating regimes and incorporate predicted error moments into a task-weighted quadratic risk objective. We evaluate the approach in simulation for a tilt-rotor VTOL landing on a ship deck using receding-horizon planning. We find that conditioning on planner information reduced error-prediction loss for a command-blind EKF by 13.4% relative to a planner-ignorant model, with strongly regime and horizon-dependent forecasting abilities. In a small set of 16 paired closed-loop trials, the planner lowered the median terminal task gauge from 1.60 to 0.99, and predicted estimator error beyond 2s within a factor of 1.3, versus a 5.7-fold underprediction by covariance-only planning.

AI.tldr: 提出一种信念空间规划方法，能预测、传播并惩罚规划器条件化的估计器误差，并将其纳入任务加权二次风险目标，在倾斜旋翼VTOL舰船降落仿真中显著降低终端任务代价。
AI.motivation: 信念空间规划器与独立设计或现成的估计器之间存在信息不对称：估计器可能无法观测到规划器所掌握的状态相关信息。因此，即便估计器在自身信息下最小化均方误差，其在规划器信息条件下的误差均值也可能非零。当未来修正具有间歇性和随机性时，被接受与被拒绝修正的误差均值差异会引入额外不确定性，而零均值假设会忽略这些项。
AI.method: 提出规划器条件化的估计器误差模型，将仿射误差动力学与保留随机诱导修正不确定性的矩递推相结合；给出在指定运行工况内预测估计器误差动力学的方法，并将预测误差矩纳入任务加权二次风险目标；采用滚动时域规划进行求解。
AI.result: 在倾斜旋翼VTOL舰船甲板降落的仿真中评估：相对规划器无感模型，条件化于规划器信息使命令盲EKF的误差预测损失降低13.4%，且预测能力强烈依赖于工况与时域。在16组配对闭环试验中，规划器将终端任务度量的中位数从1.60降至0.99，并在2秒以后将估计器误差预测控制在1.3倍以内，而仅用协方差的规划则低估误差达5.7倍。
AI.conclusion: 规划器条件化的估计器误差预测与传播能有效降低误差预测损失并改善闭环任务性能，优于忽略规划器信息或仅依赖协方差的规划方法。

title: OnlineQAT: On-Policy Distillation for Ultra-Low-Bit Large Language Models
summary: Quantization-aware training (QAT) can recover much of the accuracy lost when large language models are compressed below four bits. Existing re- covery stages, however, are commonly optimized on fixed completions or teacher-generated answers, whereas the deployed quantized model condi- tions on prefixes generated by itself. Quantization errors can therefore move the model into states that are absent from offline recovery data. We introduce OnlineQAT, a two-stage framework that first obtains a usable low-bit initialization through block-wise QAT and then performs on-policy distillation (OPD) on student-generated responses. At each visited pre- fix, a frozen full-precision teacher provides a sampled reverse-KL training signal. On Qwen3-1.7B, OnlineQAT obtains the best average among the compared quantized methods: 57.28 at W3A16 and 32.52 at W2A16, im- proving over ReasoningQAT by 2.90 and 0.44 points, respectively. The results suggest that student-visited states provide a useful recovery signal beyond fixed-completion training, particularly at three bits.

AI.tldr: 提出 OnlineQAT 两阶段框架：先块级 QAT 获得低比特初始化，再对自生成响应做在策略蒸馏（OPD），用冻结全精度教师提供采样的 reverse-KL 信号。Qwen3-1.7B 上 W3A16 平均 57.28、W2A16 平均 32.52，较 ReasoningQAT 分别提升 2.90 和 0.44 分。
AI.motivation: 现有低比特（<4bit）量化恢复阶段通常在固定补全或教师生成答案上优化，而部署的量化模型实际以自生成前缀为条件。量化误差会使模型进入离线恢复数据中未覆盖的状态，导致恢复信号与推理时分布不匹配。
AI.method: 两阶段框架：第一阶段通过块级（block-wise）QAT 获得可用的低比特初始化；第二阶段在学生在策略采样生成的响应上进行在策略蒸馏（OPD），在每个访问到的前缀处由冻结的全精度教师提供采样的 reverse-KL 训练信号。
AI.result: 在 Qwen3-1.7B 上取得所比较量化方法中的最佳平均值：W3A16 为 57.28，W2A16 为 32.52，分别较 ReasoningQAT 提升 2.90 和 0.44 分。
AI.conclusion: 学生实际访问的状态能提供超越固定补全训练的有效恢复信号，尤其在 3 比特设置下增益更为明显。

title: RDGSplat: Render-Dedicated Geometry for Novel View Synthesis
summary: 3D foundation models enable efficient novel view synthesis by carrying a Gaussian head on the representation they already use for reconstruction. However, the views they render fall short of the geometry they recover, because that geometry is estimated under a metric objective and never scored on how it renders. Recent methods alleviate this by updating the backbone weights, but they thereby discard the metric predictions the model was built for and must be repeated for every new backbone. To this end, we propose RDGSplat, a framework that decodes a second geometry dedicated to rendering from a frozen 3D foundation model, leaving its metric predictions intact. In particular, we devise Render-Dedicated Geometry Decoding, which duplicates the pretrained decoders and optimizes the duplicates under photometric supervision alone. Then, a Target-Pose Conditioned Adapter is introduced to reformulate the representation those decoders read, conditioned on the target camera pose rather than the target image. Extensive experiments show that RDGSplat improves novel view synthesis across three feed-forward backbones on four benchmarks, with every pretrained weight frozen. On RE10K, it raises WM2.0 from 20.918 to 24.266\,dB while training 205.5\,M added parameters against a frozen 1.4\,B backbone, and the depth and pose the same model predicts are unchanged.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出RDGSplat框架，在冻结3D基础模型的前提下，通过解码一个专用于渲染的第二几何来提升新视角合成质量，同时保持原始度量预测不变。
AI.motivation: 3D基础模型通过在其重建表示上挂载高斯头实现高效新视角合成，但其渲染视角与所恢复几何不匹配，原因在于几何是在度量目标下估计的，从未以渲染效果作为评分标准。现有方法通过更新骨干权重来缓解，但这会丢弃模型的度量预测，且每换一个骨干都需重训。
AI.method: 提出RDGSplat框架：1）Render-Dedicated Geometry Decoding，复制预训练解码器，仅在光度监督下优化副本；2）Target-Pose Conditioned Adapter，以目标相机位姿（而非目标图像）为条件重构这些解码器所读取的表示。整个过程冻结所有预训练权重。
AI.result: 在四个基准、三种前馈骨干上均提升新视角合成效果。在RE10K上，WM2.0从20.918 dB提升至24.266 dB，仅额外训练205.5M参数（冻结1.4B骨干），且同一模型预测的深度与位姿保持不变。
AI.conclusion: RDGSplat通过解耦渲染专用几何与度量几何，在不牺牲基础模型度量预测能力、无需重复训练的前提下，显著提升新视角合成质量，验证了冻结骨干加轻量渲染解码方案的可行性与有效性。

title: Not Every Call Needs a Frontier Model: Per-Call-Site Evaluation of Small Language Models in a Deployed Agentic Home-Automation System
comment: 17 pages, 2 figures, accepted in NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on SLMs for Agentic Systems, Paris,
summary: An agentic system issues several structurally different kinds of LLM calls. It routes intent, classifies actions, grounds language in a device registry, plans multi-agent pipelines and writes the Python code those pipelines run. The difficulty of these call sites varies by an order of magnitude, yet in practice a single model, chosen for the hardest site, serves all of them. In this work, we evaluate 9 models from 0.8B to a frontier hosted model across the five call sites of a deployed open-source home-automation framework (Wactorz), using its unmodified production prompts and two real Home Assistant installations (280 cases, 2520 scored calls). We find that capability is not ordered the same way at every site, and that larger models are not uniformly better: one 4B model is worse than its 2B sibling at grounded actuation. Paired testing shows the best local model to be statistically indistinguishable from both hosted models at four of five sites. Only code generation separates them, against a small hosted model (p = 0.039) as well as a frontier one (p = 0.002). Aggregate accuracy also hides a safety failure specific to actuation, where small models resolve the accuracy/refusal trade-off in degenerate ways: one model (Gemma4 E2B) actuates on 87.2% of requests for devices the site does not own, while another refuses every request it receives. Routing each site to its best local model reaches 91.8% against 95.4% at no per-call cost. In a live deployment judged by a user, hosting only the two generative sites matches hosting everything (39/43 against 39/43) for 28% of the spend, and the actuation gap the benchmark predicted appears as exactly one case in twenty-six. Benchmark, harness and all records are released at https://github.com/waldiez/slm-callsite-eval.

AI.tldr: 该研究在真实开源家庭自动化框架Wactorz的五个LLM调用位点上评测9个模型（0.8B至前沿托管模型，共2520次打分调用），发现能力排序并非跨位点一致，大模型不总是更好；按位点路由至最佳本地模型可达91.8%，且仅托管两个生成式位点即可匹配全托管效果并节省72%开销。
AI.motivation: 智能体系统包含意图路由、动作分类、设备注册表接地、多智能体流水线规划与Python代码生成等结构上不同的调用位点，难度相差一个数量级；但实践中往往只用为最难位点选定的单一模型服务所有位点，缺乏对"一位点一模型"可行性与代价的实证评估。
AI.method: 使用部署中的开源家庭自动化框架Wactorz的未修改生产提示，在两个真实Home Assistant安装上构建280个案例、2520次打分调用，对5个调用位点评测9个模型（0.8B至前沿托管模型），采用配对统计检验，并对比聚合准确率与逐位点表现，另做安全失败分析与真实用户判定的在线部署成本实验。
AI.result: 能力排序在位点间不一致，模型规模并非单调增益：某4B模型在接地致动上劣于其2B同门。配对检验显示最佳本地模型在五分之四位点上与两个托管模型统计上不可区分，仅代码生成有显著差异（对小托管模型p=0.039，对前沿模型p=0.002）。聚合准确率掩盖了致动特有的安全失败：Gemma4 E2B对非自有设备的请求中87.2%仍执行致动，另一模型则拒绝所有请求。逐位点路由至最佳本地模型达91.8%，对比95.4%且无逐次调用成本。在线部署中仅托管两个生成式位点即与全托管持平（39/43 vs 39/43），成本为28%，基准预测的致动差距在26例中恰好出现1例。
AI.conclusion: 调用位点级评测比聚合指标更能反映真实部署中的性能与安全权衡；按位点选择模型可在几乎不损失准确率的前提下显著降低成本，并暴露被平均指标掩盖的安全退化，因此应避免"以最难位点的模型统一服务所有位点"的做法。基准、测试框架与全部记录已开源。

title: LASER: Latent Space Adjoint Matching for Support-Constrained Entropy-Regularized Offline RL
summary: While offline reinforcement learning (RL) enables policy optimization from static datasets without costly online interaction, it remains bottlenecked by the risk of executing out-of-distribution (OOD) actions. Recent approaches mitigate this by learning a behavior-cloning policy through flow matching and then performing RL within its constrained latent space. However, naively optimizing the latent policy can easily cause the policy to collapse into a brittle mode or exploit sharp artifacts of the learned critic. In this work, we find that entropy regularization is essential in latent-space RL for addressing these challenges. We introduce LASER, a novel offline RL algorithm that applies latent-space adjoint matching to achieve entropy-regularized latent-space RL with expressive flow policies while avoiding backpropagation through time. Through comprehensive experiments on 40 challenging OGBench tasks with varying dataset qualities, we show that LASER achieves state-of-the-art performance. Notably, LASER uses fixed method-specific hyperparameters across all tasks and outperforms the evaluated baselines, including those with task- and dataset-specific tuning, which highlights the robust applicability of LASER. Project website: https://mit-realm.github.io/laser/.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LASER，一种在流匹配策略的隐空间中进行熵正则化离线强化学习的算法，通过隐空间伴随匹配避免时间反向传播，在40个OGBench任务上取得SOTA且用固定超参。
AI.motivation: 离线RL受限于执行分布外（OOD）动作的风险。近期方法通过流匹配学习行为克隆策略并在其受限隐空间中做RL，但朴素地优化隐策略容易导致策略坍缩为脆弱的单一模式，或利用学到的critic的锐利伪影。作者发现熵正则化对解决这些问题至关重要。
AI.method: 提出LASER，一种新颖的离线RL算法，采用隐空间伴随匹配（latent-space adjoint matching），在具有表达力的流策略上实现熵正则化的隐空间RL，同时避免通过时间的反向传播（BPTT）。
AI.result: 在40个具有不同数据质量的挑战性OGBench任务上进行全面实验，LASER达到最先进性能。值得注意的是，LASER在所有任务上使用固定的方法特定超参数，仍优于包括经过任务和数据集聚类调参的基线，凸显其稳健适用性。
AI.conclusion: 熵正则在隐空间RL中不可或缺；LASER通过隐空间伴随匹配实现了无需BPTT的熵正则化隐空间RL，并以固定超参在多样任务上取得SOTA，展示了强鲁棒性与广泛适用性。

title: Black-Box Adversarial Patch Attacks on VLAs via Ancestor VLM Exploitation
summary: Vision-Language-Action models (VLAs) are increasingly deployed in safety-critical physical environments, yet their adversarial robustness remains poorly understood. Existing attacks typically assume white-box access or rely on surrogate VLAs, which rarely holds in real-world deployments. Our key insight is that most VLAs are adapted from a publicly released pretrained vision-language model (VLM), inheriting two capabilities essential for action generation: visual perception and instruction-conditioned grounding. Therefore, this paper explores a previously unaddressed question: can an adversary attack deployed VLAs using only their ancestor VLMs? To this end, we propose three adversarial patch attacks that disrupt the inherited capabilities: a vision disruption attack that corrupts the projected visual tokens through relative and absolute terms, an instruction-grounded semantic evidence suppression attack that removes the visual evidence required for instruction-grounded concepts, and a joint attack that unifies both objectives under a two-phase curriculum. Experiments across different VLA families on both simulation and static real-world images show that patches optimized on the ancestor VLM cause substantial degradations in VLA task success rates, demonstrating that VLAs inherit adversarial vulnerabilities alongside their foundational capabilities. This effect is not uniform: it is strongest on tasks that require precise instruction-grounded localization, and nearly vanishes on policies whose adaptation rewrites the shared visual-semantic representation or whose action head iteratively smooths perturbations away. By characterizing the boundary conditions of vulnerability inheritance and providing analysis of why the inheritance effect holds or fails, we advance the understanding of safety for VLA-involved systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出仅利用VLA的祖先预训练VLM进行对抗补丁攻击，验证VLA继承了基础模型的对抗脆弱性。
AI.motivation: VLA越来越多部署于安全关键环境，但其对抗鲁棒性研究不足。现有攻击多假设白盒访问或依赖替代VLA，在实际部署中难以成立。作者的关键洞察是：多数VLA由公开预训练VLM适配而来，继承了视觉感知与指令条件化定位两项对动作生成至关重要的能力，因此提出仅用祖先VLM攻击已部署VLA这一此前未被研究的问题。
AI.method: 提出三种对抗补丁攻击，分别破坏VLA继承自祖先VLM的能力：(1)视觉破坏攻击，通过相对项与绝对项破坏投影后的视觉token；(2)指令定位语义证据抑制攻击，移除指令定位概念所需的视觉证据；(3)联合攻击，用两阶段课程统一上述两个目标。攻击补丁在祖先VLM上优化，再迁移到VLA。
AI.result: 在多个VLA家族上、仿真与静态真实图像的实验中，祖先VLM上优化的补丁导致VLA任务成功率显著下降。该效应不均匀：对需要精确指令定位的任务最强，而当适配过程重写了共享视觉-语义表示、或动作头迭代平滑掉扰动时，效应几乎消失。
AI.conclusion: VLA在继承基础能力的同时也继承了对抗脆弱性，且该脆弱性继承存在边界条件。通过刻画这些边界条件并分析继承效应成立或失效的原因，本文推进了对涉及VLA系统安全性的理解。

title: Fast Planning for Multi-object Multi-target Throwing
comment: Accepted to IROS 2026. 8 pages, 9 figures. Zhengming Zhu and Yang Liu contributed equally. Video Summary: https://liuyangdh.github.io/momt-video
summary: Robot throwing has emerged as a promising technique for improving efficiency in logistics and warehouse automation, by enlarging the workspace and speeding up the process. To significantly increase the throwing system's throughput, we develop strategies for throwing multiple objects in one swipe. Such multi-object multi-target throwing (MOMT) leverages the large degrees of freedom of anthropomorphic hands. The key is to quickly generate fast and feasible throwing motions, which involves a complex trade-off between short trajectory duration and short planning time. We solve this problem in two stages. Offline, we build a model of the feasible set by combining object's inverted flying dynamics and the robot's kinematics and dynamics. Online, we generate feasible throws through fast solution matching and filtering of object's valid detach state and robot's feasible state that can compose sequences of throws in less than 5 ms. We validate the framework on a 7-DoF manipulator equipped with a multi-fingered hand. In simulation, coordinated two-object throwing reduces execution time by up to 46% compared to independent single-object planning, and this improvement is maintained when scaling to three objects. Real-world experiments with two objects confirm a 29% reduction; the remaining gap to the theoretical 50% is attributed to inter-throw transition overhead. When target positions are randomly changed mid-execution, the system re-plans and successfully reaches the new targets within 100 ms latency without stopping the robot. These results establish the first unified planning framework for MOMT throwing -- demonstrating scalability to multiple objects in simulation and real-world feasibility on two-object tasks -- advancing the frontier of high-throughput robotic manipulation. A video summarizing the method and the hardware experiments is available at https://liuyangdh.github.io/momt-video

AI.tldr: 本文提出首个面向多物体多目标抛掷（MOMT）的统一规划框架，利用拟人手的高自由度，通过离线构建可行集模型与在线快速匹配滤波，在5 ms内生成可行的连续抛掷序列，实现高吞吐量机器人抛掷。
AI.motivation: 机器人抛掷可扩大工作空间并加速物流与仓储自动化流程，但单物体抛掷吞吐量有限。为显著提升系统吞吐量，需实现在一次挥动中抛掷多个物体，而难点在于兼顾短轨迹时长与短规划时间的快速可行抛掷动作生成。
AI.method: 采用两阶段求解：离线阶段，结合物体反向飞行动力学与机器人运动学和动力学，构建可行集模型；在线阶段，通过快速解匹配，并对物体的有效脱离状态与机器人可行状态进行过滤，组合成抛掷序列，生成时间小于5 ms。在配备多指手的7自由度机械臂上验证该框架。
AI.result: 仿真中，协调的双物体抛掷相比独立单物体规划，执行时间最多缩短46%，且扩展至三物体时改进仍保持；真实世界双物体实验确认执行时间减少29%，与理论值50%的差距归因于抛掷间过渡开销。当目标位置在执行中途随机改变时，系统无需停止机器人即可在100 ms延迟内重新规划并成功到达新目标。
AI.conclusion: 该工作建立了首个MOMT抛掷的统一规划框架，在仿真中展示了向多物体的可扩展性，并在双物体任务上验证了真实世界可行性，推动了高吞吐量机器人操作的前沿。

title: One Frame, Full Heartbeat: ECG-Free 4D Cardiac Cine MRI Synthesis via Radial-Decomposed Flow Matching
summary: Cine cardiovascular magnetic resonance (CMR) captures the cardiac cycle as a four-dimensional (4D) sequence, but standard acquisition requires electrocardiogram (ECG) gating and repeated breath holds. Visual realism alone does not establish accurate patient-specific ejection fraction (EF) or ventricular volumes. We present PhaseFlow3D, a generative framework that synthesizes a complete 4D cine sequence from a single end-diastolic (ED) three-dimensional (3D) volume without ECG. To capture asymmetric systolic and diastolic dynamics, it represents the cardiac cycle as a piecewise linear phase anchored at ED and end-systolic (ES) time points. At inference, a population-level canonical template supplies this phase without patient-specific temporal information. A phase-conditioned rectified flow model generates a cardiac motion trajectory in latent space. Radial Contraction Decomposition converts each latent state into a 3D displacement field, combining a physics-informed radial component for centripetal myocardial contraction with an image-conditioned residual for rotation and out-of-plane motion. Each frame is generated by directly warping the ED volume, bypassing variational autoencoder decoding. On the combined ACDC and M&Ms benchmark, PhaseFlow3D achieves the lowest EF mean absolute error, the only positive left-ventricular volume-curve $R^2$, and the best distributional quality among compared methods. Ablations confirm each component's contribution. Downstream evaluations demonstrate the utility of the synthesized sequences and displacement fields for segmentation, pathology classification, label propagation, and myocardial strain analysis.

AI.tldr: PhaseFlow3D从单张ED三维体数据、无需ECG即可合成完整4D心脏电影序列，通过相位条件rectified flow与径向收缩分解生成位移场并直接warp ED体，在EF、容积曲线等指标上取得最优表现。
AI.motivation: 标准CMR电影采集依赖ECG门控与多次屏息，且视觉逼真并不等于能准确反映患者特异性的射血分数与心室容积，需一种无需ECG、能生成具有生理准确性4D序列的方法。
AI.method: 将心动周期表示为以ED和ES为锚点的分段线性相位；推理时用群体级规范模板提供相位；采用相位条件rectified flow在隐空间生成运动轨迹；Radial Contraction Decomposition将隐状态转为三维位移场，结合物理启发的径向收缩分量与图像条件残差（刻画旋转与离面运动）；每帧通过直接warp ED体生成，绕过VAE解码。
AI.result: 在ACDC与M&Ms联合基准上，PhaseFlow3D获得最低的EF平均绝对误差、唯一为正的左心室容积曲线R²，以及对比方法中最佳的分布质量；消融实验证实各组件贡献；下游任务（分割、病理分类、标签传播、心肌应变分析）验证了合成序列与位移场的实用性。
AI.conclusion: 无需ECG、仅凭单张ED三维体即可合成生理准确的4D心脏电影序列，位移场与序列在多项下游临床相关任务中具有应用价值。

title: BEACON-SP: Ontology-Grounded GraphRAG Framework for Clinical Suicide Risk Assessment
summary: We present BEACON-SP, an ontology-grounded Graph Retrieval-Augmented Generation (GraphRAG) framework for clinician-facing decision support in behavioral health settings such as suicide prevention, where effective assessment requires integrating heterogeneous clinical, behavioral, social, and temporal evidence. BEACON-SP combines patient knowledge graphs with ontology-guided retrieval to support multi-hop reasoning across diagnoses, medications, risk and protective factors, life events, and temporal relationships. The framework is enabled by a comprehensive suicide prevention ontology that integrates the Three-Step Theory, the Integrated Motivational-Volitional Model, and the Suicide Social Determinants of Health Ontology into a unified representation of patient risk factors. We construct ontology-grounded patient knowledge graphs and evaluate BEACON-SP for clinician-facing question answering. Compared with a vector-based retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) baseline on a 1,500-query benchmark spanning 15 clinical categories and 100 patients, BEACON-SP improves completeness, clinical relevance, and evidence grounding under a corrected comparative evaluation protocol, with a small gain on factual accuracy. In paired criterion-level comparisons, GraphRAG is preferred in 76.4% of cases. These results demonstrate the potential of ontology-guided GraphRAG to provide structured, contextualized patient evidence for clinical decision support.

AI.tldr: 提出本体驱动的GraphRAG框架BEACON-SP，面向行为健康临床决策支持，在自杀预防场景中通过患者知识图谱与本体引导检索实现多跳推理，相比向量RAG基线在多项指标上更优。
AI.motivation: 行为健康（如自杀预防）的评估需整合临床、行为、社会与时间等多源异构证据，传统检索方法难以满足多跳推理与证据溯源需求。
AI.method: 将患者知识图谱与本体引导检索相结合；构建整合三步理论、整合动机-意志模型及自杀健康社会决定因素本体的统一自杀预防本体，据此构建本体支撑的患者知识图谱，并用于面向临床医生的问答。
AI.result: 在覆盖15个临床类别、100名患者的1500条查询基准上，采用校正后的对比评估方案，BEACON-SP在完整性、临床相关性和证据支撑方面优于向量RAG基线，事实准确性小幅提升；配对标准层面比较中GraphRAG在76.4%的案例中被偏好。
AI.conclusion: 本体引导的GraphRAG可为临床决策支持提供结构化、情境化的患者证据，具有应用潜力。

title: REFIT: Recognize, Fix, and Test Wearable Sensor Placement Shifts without Labels
summary: We present REFIT, an input calibration for frozen activity-recognition models whose inertial sensors are worn differently at deployment than in training. When users move a watch to the other wrist or put a strap sensor back on turned, the model sees the same motion on changed axes. REFIT undoes such shifts without labels or retraining. It describes them by families of axis transforms, such as reflections and rotations, and fits each family to the user's data so that simple statistics match those of the training data. The family that removes most of the mismatch names the shift. REFIT fixes the shift by applying the best member of that family before the frozen model and re-estimating its normalization statistics. It tests the fixed model with a label-free accuracy estimate and asks the user to re-wear the sensor when it is low. Experiments on real left/right sensor pairs and on real and simulated re-attachment show that REFIT outperforms label-free test-time adaptation methods on every dataset and restores most of the accuracy lost to re-attachment. It names injected shifts far more reliably than a confidence-based selector. After a correction over all signed permutations of the axes, the estimate separates successful from failed corrections.

AI.tldr: REFIT是一种面向冻结活动识别模型的输入校准方法，用于解决部署时惯性传感器佩戴方式与训练时不一致（如换腕、反向重新佩戴）导致的坐标轴变换问题。它无需标签和重训练，通过轴变换族拟合与归一化统计重估计修正偏移，并用无标签精度估计判断是否需要用户重新佩戴传感器。
AI.motivation: 活动识别模型的惯性传感器在部署时的佩戴方式常与训练时不同，例如手表换到另一只手腕或绑带传感器反向重新佩戴，导致同一动作在改变后的坐标轴上被模型观测到，从而造成识别性能下降。现有方法依赖标签或重训练，难以在实际部署中直接应用，因此需要一种无需标签、无需重训练的输入校准方案。
AI.method: REFIT用轴变换族（如反射、旋转）描述传感器佩戴偏移，并将每个变换族拟合到用户数据，使简单统计量与训练数据匹配；匹配最好、消除最多不匹配的变换族即识别出偏移类型。随后将最优变换族成员应用于冻结模型之前，并重新估计其归一化统计量以完成修正。修正后的模型使用无标签精度估计进行评估，若精度过低则提示用户重新佩戴传感器。
AI.result: 在真实左右传感器配对以及真实与模拟重新佩戴实验中，REFIT在每个数据集上均优于无标签测试时自适应方法，并恢复了重新佩戴造成的大部分精度损失；其识别注入偏移的可靠性显著高于基于置信度的选择器；对所有轴的有符号排列进行校正后，该估计能够区分成功与失败的修正。
AI.conclusion: REFIT为冻结活动识别模型提供了一种无需标签和重训练的输入校准途径，可有效应对传感器佩戴方式变化带来的轴变换偏移，并通过无标签精度估计支持用户干预，在多种真实与模拟场景中验证了其有效性和可靠性。

title: Trust a Few: The Weakest Assumptions a Protocol Needs
summary: Protocol verifiers check whether a protocol meets a security goal under stated trust assumptions, such as that a key is never leaked, a value is fresh, or a channel is authentic. They do not say which of those assumptions the goal needs. Rowe, Guttman and Liskov asked for the weakest assumptions under which a protocol achieves a goal and left the question open. We answer it for assumptions about keys, values and channels. Call a run that violates the goal an attack, and the assumptions that would rule it out its stopping set. The least a protocol must trust to meet a goal is exactly the set of minimal ways to stop all of its minimal attacks. Several such sets may exist. The answer becomes unique once either/or assumptions are allowed, and it is a single set exactly when every minimal attack is stopped by a single assumption. A Galois connection between assumptions and goals explains why: a goal may end in "or", but its hypothesis may not. The same structure gives the trust needed by a conjunction of goals and an exact condition under which composed protocols need no extra trust. To compute the answer, a loop asks a verifier whether a candidate suffices, records what stops each attack it reports, and recomputes the candidates. Deciding whether some trust of at most k assumptions suffices is NP-hard. With a bounded analyser of our own and with CPSA, the loop finds the weakest trust for 18 goals over ten protocols and their variants, and on each it agrees with evaluating every trust using the same verifier. The answers include an assumption that our model of the adopted fix of Kerberos PKINIT states but the client's authentication of the server does not need, and channel assumptions under which Needham-Schroeder meets its goal in a bounded model.

AI.tldr: 该论文回答了Rowe, Guttman和Liskov提出的开放问题：在何种最弱信任假设下协议能达成安全目标。作者针对密钥、值和信道假设给出理论刻画，并设计与验证器交互的求解循环，在18个目标和十个协议及其变体上计算最弱信任，与穷举评估结果一致。
AI.motivation: 协议验证器在既定信任假设下检查协议是否满足安全目标，但不说明目标需要哪些假设。Rowe、Guttman和Liskov询问协议达成目标所需的最弱假设，并将其留作开放问题。本文旨在回答围绕密钥、值和信道假设下的这一问题。
AI.method: 将违反目标的运行称为攻击，能排除该攻击的假设集合称为停止集；协议为达成目标所需的最小信任恰是停止所有最小攻击的所有极小方式组成的集合。引入“或”假设使答案唯一，并用假设与目标之间的Galois连接解释：目标可以以“或”结尾，但其假设不可以。该结构还刻画了目标合取所需信任及组合协议无需额外信任的精确条件。计算上采用循环：询问验证器某候选是否充分，记录停止每次报告攻击的假设，并重新计算候选。
AI.result: 判定是否存在至多k个假设的信任充分是NP难问题。作者使用自带有界分析器和CPSA，在十个协议及其变体的18个目标上找到最弱信任，且每个结果与使用同一验证器穷举评估所有信任一致。结果包括：模型所采用的Kerberos PKINIT修复中声明但客户端认证服务器并不需要的假设，以及有界模型中Needham-Schroeder满足其目标所需的信道假设。
AI.conclusion: 论文给出协议达成安全目标所需最弱信任假设的完整理论刻画与可计算框架，证明该问题在一般情形下NP难，同时通过有界分析器和CPSA验证其方法在多个协议与目标上的正确性与实用性。

title: Co-Evolving Robot Orchestrators and Policies through Deployment
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) policies trained on large datasets are capable within their training domains, yet they still fail to generalize to the variety of situations a robot meets in real-world deployment. Agentic robot systems complement the policy with a vision-language model (VLM) orchestrator that learns when to call the policy, how to instruct it, and when to use scripted skills instead. However, because the harness is built around a frozen policy that has limited language steerability, the orchestrator can avoid the policy's failures but never overcome them. The policy becomes the bottleneck of the whole system. Fine-tuning the policy can remove this bottleneck, but updating it alone decouples it from an orchestrator tuned to its old behavior. We propose Robo-COP, in which the orchestrator and policy co-evolve during deployment. Robo-COP curates skill demonstrations from its own executions, fine-tunes the policy when this data can address recurring failures, and adopts each new policy only after it improves the skills it was trained for. Across ten simulated RoboLab tasks, Robo-COP raises mean held-out success from 64.8% to 73.8% over the same harness with a frozen policy, while fine-tuning on a fixed schedule without verification reaches only 65.8%. On three real-world tasks, Robo-COP raises held-out success from 38.3% to 50.0%. Robo-COP turns deployment into a self-improving flywheel in which robots learn by doing, with each improvement in execution producing better data for the next round of learning. Videos and code are available at https://robo-cop.pages.dev/.

AI.tldr: 提出Robo-COP框架，让VLA策略与VLM编排器在部署中共同进化，通过自采集技能演示、按需微调与验证采纳，将部署变为自我改进的闭环。
AI.motivation: 现有智能体机器人系统由VLM编排器协调冻结的VLA策略，但冻结策略语言可操控性有限，编排器只能规避其失败而无法克服，策略成为系统瓶颈；单独微调策略又会使其与旧行为下调优的编排器脱节。
AI.method: Robo-COP在部署过程中让编排器与策略协同演化：从自身执行中筛选技能演示数据，当数据能解决反复出现的失败时微调策略，并且只有在新策略在其训练技能上取得提升后才予以采纳。
AI.result: 在10个模拟RoboLab任务上，平均留出成功率从冻结策略的64.8%提升至73.8%，而按固定计划无验证微调仅达65.8%；在3个真实任务上，留出成功率从38.3%提升至50.0%。
AI.conclusion: Robo-COP将部署转变为自我改进的飞轮，机器人通过实践学习，执行的每次改进都产生更好的数据以供下一轮学习。

title: The Persona Hierarchy Model: Understanding Contextual Generalization in Fine-Tuning LLMs
summary: Language models are routinely fine-tuned under a fixed context, such as a generic system prompt, persona or domain-specific instruction, yet the learned behavior sometimes stays confined to that context and sometimes broadly generalizes to unseen contexts. We propose the Persona Hierarchy Model to explain this: a shared default persona influences behavior across contexts. Under this model, fine-tuning that modifies the shared persona promotes broader transfer, whereas changes to local personas remain more context-specific. Across 120 fine-tuned models spanning four behaviors and 15 training contexts, generalization narrowness positively correlates with the similarity between the training context's persona and the default persona (Pearson's r = 0.72 for Qwen3-4B). Prior fine-tuning under the default context can broaden generalization in subsequent training under other contexts. Aligning contextual responses with default-persona responses produces stronger effects. Finally, we propose persona-preserving regularization (PPR) to confine undesired contextual generalization. In RL, PPR cuts reward hacking from 42-55% to at most 0.2% under every evaluated prompt while retaining accuracy gains. These results support the Persona Hierarchy Model as an explanation for contextual generalization and can motivate future controls on unintended generalization for better alignment of LLMs.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"人格层级模型"(Persona Hierarchy Model)，用以解释微调行为为何有时局限于特定上下文、有时却广泛泛化；并据此提出人格保持正则化(PPR)以约束非预期的上下文泛化。
AI.motivation: 语言模型通常在固定上下文（如通用系统提示、人格设定或领域指令）下进行微调，但所学行为有时被限制在该上下文中，有时却能泛化到未见上下文，这种差异缺乏统一解释，也缺乏对非预期泛化的控制手段。
AI.method: 提出人格层级模型：模型存在一个共享的"默认人格"，跨上下文影响行为。基于该模型：(1) 在4种行为、15种训练上下文、共120个微调模型上检验泛化狭窄性与"训练上下文人格—默认人格"相似度的相关性；(2) 检验先在默认上下文微调能否拓宽后续其他上下文的泛化；(3) 将上下文响应与默认人格响应对齐；(4) 提出人格保持正则化(PPR)用于RL中约束非预期的上下文泛化。
AI.result: 泛化狭窄性与训练上下文人格和默认人格的相似度正相关（Qwen3-4B上 Pearson r = 0.72）；在默认上下文下的先前微调可拓宽后续其他上下文的泛化；将上下文响应与默认人格响应对齐效果更强；在RL中，PPR将奖励攻击(reward hacking)从42–55%降至各评估提示下至多0.2%，同时保持准确率增益。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持人格层级模型作为上下文泛化的解释机制，并为未来控制LLM非预期泛化、改进对齐提供了可行方向。

title: R-CNN-Based Chess Position Recognition
summary: Performing chess game position recognition solely from a single image of a three-dimensional board requires predicting the position and orientation of the board relative to the camera, the occupancy of squares and the piece type, which includes its colour. We propose an R-CNN-based framework with independent components for piece recognition and board geometry estimation, whose predictions are combined to reconstruct the position. For piece recognition, we adapt Faster R-CNN using a class-weighted objective and a deeper classification head. The detector operates directly on the input image, retaining alternative piece hypotheses that are subsequently refined using constraints on piece counts and square occupancy. For board detection, we introduce an octagonal arrangement of eight labelled boundary keypoints, predicted using the keypoint head of Mask R-CNN. These provide redundant correspondences for homography estimation and encode board orientation. The estimated homography maps representative points from the piece boxes to an 8x8 grid. On a synthetic dataset, the modifications to piece detection increase mean average precision from 61.59% to 90.14%. Of the predicted board keypoints, 97.11% are within 1% of the image diagonal of their labelled targets. Using ground-truth piece boxes with the predicted homographies gives correct square assignments for every test position. The complete framework recovers 76.61% of test positions exactly and 96.49% with at most one incorrect square.

AI.tldr: 提出基于R-CNN的框架，从单张三D棋盘图像中同时估计棋盘几何与棋子类别，重建棋局位置。
AI.motivation: 仅凭单张三维棋盘图像识别棋局，需同时预测棋盘相对相机的位姿与朝向、格子占用及棋子类型（含颜色），任务耦合度高、难度大。
AI.method: 框架含独立组件：棋子识别与棋盘几何估计。棋子识别改进Faster R-CNN，采用类加权目标与更深分类头，直接处理输入图像并保留备选假设，再用棋子数量与格子占用约束细化。棋盘检测引入八个带标签的八边形边界关键点，用Mask R-CNN关键点头预测，提供冗余对应关系用于单应估计并编码棋盘朝向；估计的单应将棋子框代表点映射到8×8网格。
AI.result: 合成数据集上，棋子检测改进使mAP从61.59%提升至90.14%；97.11%的预测棋盘关键点误差在图像对角线1%以内；用真值棋子框配合预测单应，所有测试位置均正确分配格子；完整框架精确恢复76.61%测试位置，允许至多一个错误格子时达96.49%。
AI.conclusion: 该R-CNN框架通过分离棋子识别与棋盘几何估计并融合结果，能有效从单张三D棋盘图像重建棋局位置，在精确恢复率与容错恢复率上均表现良好。

title: Shared-Roadmap Generation and Evaluator for Multi-Agent Path Planning Using Heterogeneous Graph Neural Network
summary: Multi-agent path planning (MAPP) in continuous environments often relies on roadmaps to balance safety and search efficiency. However, traditional roadmap generation methods, such as lattice grids or standard sampling-based approaches, frequently face a trade-off between graph density and the likelihood of finding feasible, high-quality solutions. In this paper, we propose a scalable heterogeneous Graph Neural Network (GNN) framework for the automated generation and evaluation of shared multi-agent roadmaps. Our model covers the representation of waypoints, agent locations, and task locations as distinct nodes in a heterogeneous graph, allowing it to reason over global connectivity and inter-agent interactions. By training on occupation density maps aggregated and collected from expert solver trajectories, the GNN learns to identify critical points of interest and prune redundant nodes and edges. This process produces a compact, coordination-aware roadmap that is invariant to task permutations and is reusable for multi-agent pick and delivery tasks. Experimental results demonstrate that our framework can reduce planning effort and can potentially find better solutions, reaching at least 40% reduction in runtime and in graph size for dense roadmaps.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种可扩展的异质图神经网络框架，用于自动生成与评估共享多智能体路网图，以缓解传统路网图在密度与解质量间的权衡问题。
AI.motivation: 连续环境下的多智能体路径规划（MAPP）常依赖路网图（roadmap）来平衡安全性与搜索效率，但传统路网图生成方法（如栅格图或标准采样方法）往往面临图密度与可行高质量解概率之间的权衡：图越密，搜索代价越高；图越稀，越易丢失可行解。因此需要一种能自动生成紧凑且协调性感知的共享路网图的方法。
AI.method: 作者构建可扩展的异质图神经网络（GNN）框架，将路点、智能体位置和任务位置建模为异质图中的不同类型的节点，从而对全局连通性和智能体间交互进行推理。模型以专家求解器轨迹聚合得到的占用密度图为训练信号，学习识别关键兴趣点并剪除冗余节点与边，生成紧凑、协调性感知且对任务排列不变的路网图，可复用于多智能体取送（pick and delivery）任务。
AI.result: 实验表明，该框架能够降低规划开销并有望找到更优解；在稠密路网图场景下，运行时和图规模至少减少 40%。
AI.conclusion: 利用异质 GNN 从专家轨迹中学习剪枝策略，可自动生成紧凑、可复用且任务排列不变的共享路网图，有效提升 MAPP 的规划效率与解质量，尤其在稠密路网图条件下收益显著。

title: Algorithmic Scratchpads and Curriculum Staging for Arithmetic Reasoning in Tiny Transformers
comment: 16 pages, 5 figures. Code and benchmark datasets available at https://github.com/SoKasl/AIMathLab
summary: Autoregressive Large Language Models (LLMs) frequently struggle with deterministic multi-step algorithmic tasks such as multi-digit multiplication and long division. In this paper, we investigate the mechanics of multi-step arithmetic in compact "Tiny" Transformers (~10.6M non-embedding parameters, 49.3M total) trained on synthetic data across four basic operations (+, -, *, /) unrolled as step-by-step scratchpads. First, we establish the necessary training foundations: (1) dataloader sequence padding creates an 83% gradient starvation artifact that collapses accuracy from 40% to 1%, remediated via continuous sequence packing; (2) linguistic pretraining is an essential prerequisite (<= 2.0% without it); and (3) modern architectural primitives (RoPE, RMSNorm, SwiGLU) and Sparse Mixture of Experts (MoE) substantially improve additive reasoning over baseline GPT-2. Second, we demonstrate that algorithmic scratchpad formulation directly dictates success. Introducing a deterministic Digit-by-Digit Long Division scratchpad within a 4-stage Hierarchical Developmental Curriculum dramatically elevates single-digit division from 4.0% to 86.7% accuracy on a 4,000-problem held-out benchmark. In contrast, multi-digit multiplication remained challenging: detailed error analysis revealed that while the model correctly computed single-digit sub-products and place-value zeros, our FOIL scratchpad failed because it forced a simultaneous summation of up to nine multi-digit terms in a single step without pairwise intermediate accumulation. Finally, we identify two key boundaries: performance collapses to 0.00% on unseen 4-digit operands, and unbuffered training induces catastrophic forgetting, collapsing division accuracy from 86.7% down to 0.00%.

AI.tldr: 本文在约10.6M非嵌入参数的Tiny Transformer上研究多步算术的机理，发现连续序列打包、语言预训练、现代架构原语是训练基础，而确定性逐位长除法scratchpad配合分层课程可将单位数除法从4.0%提升至86.7%；多位乘法因FOIL scratchpad迫使单步求和多达九个多项而失败，且性能在未见4位数与无缓冲训练下分别崩溃至0.00%。
AI.motivation: 自回归大语言模型在确定性多步算法任务（如多位乘法、长除法）上表现不佳。作者希望厘清紧凑"Tiny"Transformer在多步算术中的具体机理，找出影响成功的关键训练因素与算法表示，并界定性能崩溃的边界。
AI.method: 在合成数据上训练约10.6M非嵌入参数（总计49.3M）的Tiny Transformer，覆盖+、-、*、/四则运算，并将运算展开为逐步scratchpad。实验包括：(1) 对比dataloader填充与连续序列打包；(2) 检验语言预训练的必要性；(3) 引入RoPE、RMSNorm、SwiGLU及Sparse MoE；(4) 设计确定性逐位长除法scratchpad，并在4阶段分层发育课程下训练；(5) 采用FOIL scratchpad处理多位乘法并进行错误分析；(6) 测试未见4位操作数与无缓冲训练的影响。
AI.result: (1) dataloader序列填充造成83%梯度饥饿伪影，使准确率从40%崩溃至1%，用连续序列打包可修复；(2) 无语言预训练时准确率≤2.0%；(3) 现代架构原语（RoPE、RMSNorm、SwiGLU）与Sparse MoE相较GPT-2基线显著改善加法推理；(4) 逐位长除法scratchpad配合4阶段分层发育课程，在4,000题留出基准上把单位数除法从4.0%提升至86.7%；(5) 多位乘法仍困难，错误分析显示模型能正确计算单位数子积与占位零，但FOIL scratchpad因要求单步同时求和多达九个多项且无两两中间累加而失败；(6) 在未见4位操作数上性能崩溃至0.00%，无缓冲训练导致灾难性遗忘，除法准确率从86.7%降至0.00%。
AI.conclusion: 紧凑Transformer的多步算术能力高度依赖数据打包、语言预训练与架构原语等训练基础，且scratchpad的算法形式直接决定成败：逐位长除法配合分层课程可大幅提升除法准确率，而FOIL式多步求和表示不适合多位乘法。模型在长度泛化与持续训练稳健性上存在明确边界——未见4位操作数即完全失效，无缓冲训练会引发灾难性遗忘。

title: Faster PMNS Multi-precision Multiplications Using Truncated Montgomery Technique
summary: The Polynomial Modular Number Systems (PMNS) aim to represent elements of fields or rings of large characteristics using polynomials satisfying bounds on some parameters (degree, absolute values of the coefficients). Those PMNS, while some conditions are fulfilled, using convenient parameters and implementation features, allow some speed-ups in cryptographic computations. Recent works (Meloni \emph{et al.} \cite{MeloniPV25}) propose better speed-ups by improving the parameter generation of the system, and by using multi-precision polynomial coefficients, i.e. coefficients stored using several machine words. In this work, we first present PMNS schoolbook software implementation better in some context than the Toeplitz state-of-the-art counterpart of \cite{MeloniPV25}, taking advantage of smaller memory cost by being free to choose a smaller $n$ parameter, minimizing at the same time the complexity of the multiplication. This implementation for 4096 bit modulo size shows element size smaller by 11\% and 20 \% speed-up. We thus present a new improvement on the PMNS, applying to the \textsl{internal reduction} an approach similar to the truncated Montgomery reduction technique presented by Didier \emph{et al.} in \cite{DidierEGR24}. In the context of software implementations using \texttt{AVX512} instruction set extension, and modulo size up to 8192 bits, this new approach allows speed-ups up to 15\% in modular multiplication computation, in comparison with conventional approaches.

AI.tldr: 该文改进多项式模数系统(PMNS)的软件实现：提出在特定场景优于Toeplitz方案的教科书式乘法实现，并将截断Montgomery约简思想引入内部约简，在AVX512下实现最高15%的模乘加速。
AI.motivation: PMNS可用于表示大特征域/环中元素，通过多项式参数(次数、系数绝对值)约束及合适参数与实现特性获得密码计算加速。近期工作虽通过改进参数生成和多精度系数获得更好加速，但仍有优化空间，尤其在内存开销与乘法复杂度、内部约简效率方面。
AI.method: 1) 提出PMNS教科书式软件实现，可自由选择更小的n参数，降低内存开销并最小化乘法复杂度；2) 将类似Didier等人提出的截断Montgomery约简技术应用于PMNS的内部约简；3) 在AVX512指令集扩展、模数规模至8192位的软件实现环境中验证。
AI.result: 教科书式实现在4096位模数规模下，元素尺寸缩小11%，速度提升20%；引入截断Montgomery式内部约简后，在AVX512、模数至8192位条件下，模乘计算相较传统方法提速最高15%。
AI.conclusion: 通过合理选择较小n参数并改进内部约简，可有效降低PMNS实现的内存开销并提升模乘性能，为高性能大整数模运算提供新途径。

title: RoboRender: Robot-Oriented Video Generation for Visual Sim-to-Real Transfer
summary: Simulation enables large-scale, low-cost robot data generation, but policies trained in simulation often fail to transfer to the real world due to the sim-to-real visual discrepancies. Existing approaches often rely on intermediate representations, which can discard rich semantic information or require additional perception modules at deployment. We address this visual sim-to-real gap with RoboRender, a framework that converts simulated trajectories into photorealistic RGB videos for policy learning. RoboRender trains a robot-oriented video generation model conditioned on simulated depth videos, language instructions, and robot RGB mask videos, preserving simulator geometry, robot motion, and action labels while synthesizing realistic textures, backgrounds, and distractors. The generated RGB videos are paired with simulator-provided states and actions to train policies for zero-shot real-world deployment. On robot video test sets, our video model outperforms depth-conditioned video generation baselines in generation quality. In real-world experiments across pick-and-place, articulated-object manipulation, and mobile manipulation tasks, policies trained on RoboRender-generated data achieve a 71% average success rate, outperforming raw simulation renderings and conventional visual domain randomization by approximately 7.1x and 3.6x, respectively. We further show that policy performance improves with more generated videos per simulation trajectory, increasing opening-task success by 65 percentage points. These results demonstrate that generative video rendering mitigates the visual sim-to-real gap for zero-shot policy transfer. Project website: https://robo-render.github.io/.

AI.tldr: RoboRender 将仿真轨迹转化为以深度视频、语言指令和机器人 RGB 掩码为条件的照片级真实 RGB 视频，用生成视频配合仿真状态与动作训练策略，实现零样本真机部署。
AI.motivation: 仿真可大规模、低成本地生成机器人数据，但仿真训练的策略因视觉 sim-to-real 差异难以迁移到真实世界。现有方法依赖中间表示，会丢失丰富语义信息，或需在部署时增加额外感知模块。
AI.method: 训练面向机器人的视频生成模型，以仿真深度视频、语言指令和机器人 RGB 掩码视频为条件，在保留仿真几何、机器人运动与动作标签的同时合成真实纹理、背景和干扰物。生成 RGB 视频与仿真提供的状态、动作配对，用于训练策略进行零样本真机部署。
AI.result: 在机器人视频测试集上，生成质量优于深度条件视频生成基线。在抓取放置、铰接物体操作和移动操作的真机实验中，生成数据训练的策略平均成功率达 71%，分别约为原始仿真渲染和常规视觉域随机化的 7.1 倍和 3.6 倍。每条仿真轨迹生成更多视频可提升策略性能，开启类任务成功率提升 65 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 生成式视频渲染能有效缓解视觉 sim-to-real 差距，支持零样本策略迁移。

title: ARCS: Towards Precise Text-to-SQL via Structured Disambiguation
summary: As text-to-SQL systems move beyond demonstrations toward real-world deployment, ambiguity in user questions becomes a primary source of errors. Such ambiguities are often subtle, domain- or data-specific, and can silently cause system outputs to deviate from the user's true intent. Ambiguity is traditionally addressed through conversational clarification, which is often inefficient, cognitively demanding, and poorly aligned with real-world user workflows. We propose structured disambiguation, a new paradigm in which ambiguity is resolved through explicit, constrained interactions rather than free-form dialogue. We construct ARCS (Ambiguity Resolution Corpus for SQL), the first text-to-SQL benchmark featuring naturally occurring, unconstrained ambiguities over real-world databases, with complete annotations of all valid ambiguity points, interpretations, and SQL queries. Experimental results show that text-to-SQL remains challenging in the presence of ambiguity: gpt-6-sol achieves only 51% end-to-end execution accuracy, and no open-source model exceeds 27%.

AI.tldr: 本文提出结构化消歧（structured disambiguation）新范式与ARCS基准，用于解决text-to-SQL中的自然歧义问题，实验显示现有模型在该基准上表现不佳。
AI.motivation: text-to-SQL系统走向真实部署时，用户问题中的歧义成为主要错误来源；这类歧义细微、依赖领域与数据，会静默导致输出偏离用户真实意图。传统对话式澄清效率低、认知负担重，且与真实用户工作流不匹配。
AI.method: 提出结构化消歧范式，通过显式、受限的交互而非自由对话来消解歧义；并构建ARCS（Ambiguity Resolution Corpus for SQL）——首个包含真实数据库上自然发生、无约束歧义的text-to-SQL基准，完整标注所有有效歧义点、歧义解释及对应SQL查询。
AI.result: 实验表明，text-to-SQL在歧义存在时仍极具挑战：gpt-6-sol仅达到51%的端到端执行准确率，开源模型均未超过27%。
AI.conclusion: 歧义是text-to-SQL真实部署的关键瓶颈，结构化消歧与ARCS为这一问题提供了新的研究范式与评测基础，现有模型在该方向仍有很大提升空间。

title: StableGrasp: Reconstructing Physically Stable Human Hand Grasps from Single Images
summary: Reconstructing a physically stable human grasp from a single RGB image is challenging because physically modeling grasps is itself difficult, and the problem requires estimating not only a visually constrained hand pose but also a control target that stabilizes the grasp. Existing methods either model only visual hand geometry without considering physics, or rely on less plausible physical modeling, which limits the physical validity of the resulting grasps. In this paper, we present StableGrasp, a differentiable simulation-based optimization framework that explicitly separates the visual hand pose from the control target that determines the grasping forces. Our method jointly optimizes hand geometry and control by minimizing the kinetic energy of the grasp in a differentiable simulator, while regularizing the hand geometry to preserve visual consistency and geometric plausibility. The reconstructed grasps are substantially more stable under rigorous physical simulation, while remaining visually consistent with the input images and geometrically plausible. Experiments show that our approach produces far more stable grasps than alternative hand-control strategies, benefiting visual-only grasp reconstruction pipelines by turning their outputs into physically stable grasps.

AI.tldr: 本文提出StableGrasp，一个基于可微分仿真的优化框架，通过分离视觉手部姿态与决定抓取力的控制目标，联合优化手部几何与控制量，从而从单张RGB图像重建出物理稳定的抓取。
AI.motivation: 从单张RGB图像重建物理稳定的人手抓取极具挑战：物理建模本身困难，且问题不仅要估计受视觉约束的手部姿态，还需估计能稳定抓取的控制目标。现有方法要么只建模视觉手部几何而忽略物理，要么采用可信度较低的物理建模，导致抓取的物理有效性受限。
AI.method: 提出StableGrasp可微分仿真驱动的优化框架，显式将视觉手部姿态与决定抓取力的控制目标分离；在可微分仿真器中通过最小化抓取的动能来联合优化手部几何与控制量，同时对易几何施加正则化以保持视觉一致性与几何合理性。
AI.result: 在严格物理仿真下，重建的抓取稳定性显著提升，同时保持与输入图像的视觉一致性及几何合理性。实验表明，相比其他手部-控制策略，本方法产生的抓取稳定得多，并能将纯视觉抓取重建流程的输出转化为物理稳定的抓取。
AI.conclusion: 通过将视觉姿态与控制目标分离并借助可微分仿真联合优化，可在保证视觉与几何合理性的同时大幅提升抓取的物理稳定性，为视觉抓取重建提供有效的物理后处理增强。

title: When the Governor Becomes the Disturbance: Control-Generated Disturbance and Cost-Aware Backoff in Governed Tool-Using Agents
comment: Includes ancillary experimental data and a Python script for reproducing numerical summaries. Code: https://github.com/CriticalAttentionSystems/CASAgentGovernor
summary: Supervisory governors can interfere with the tool-using agents they regulate. We study this possibility in a controlled file-recovery environment where increases in regulatory intensity trigger experimentally imposed tool failures. A cost-blind governor can turn these failures into persistent blocking that prevents task completion. We compare this governor with a backoff rule that reduces intervention probability using a moving average of known induced events. On a hand-coded stochastic-policy agent, the failure pattern appears under both result replacement and execution of corrupted tool arguments. For the persistent policy, adaptive backoff improves completion relative to a fixed weak governor with approximately matched intervention frequency. A Gemini 2.5 Flash experiment comprising 576 episodes across 6 tasks also shows reduced blocking and improved completion under backoff; among the tested settings, intermediate backoff strength achieves the highest observed aggregate success. These results identify an interaction between intervention cost and persistent action blocking, together with a possible mitigation. The cost mechanisms are imposed and their induced events are directly observable to the backoff rule; applicability beyond this controlled environment remains an empirical question.

AI.tldr: 在受控的文件恢复环境中，监督者的干预触发工具失败，成本盲目的监督者会将失败转化为持续性行动阻断，导致任务无法完成；而基于已知诱导事件移动平均的自适应退避规则可降低干预概率，从而减少阻断并提高任务完成率。
AI.motivation: 监督型治理者（supervisory governors）在监管工具使用型智能体时可能产生干扰。作者希望探究：当监管强度增加导致工具失败时，监督者若对干预成本不敏感，是否会将这些失败转化为持续性阻断，从而阻止任务完成，并寻找可能的缓解机制。
AI.method: 在受控的文件恢复环境中开展实验，通过实验方式施加工具失败以提高监管强度。比较两类监督策略：成本盲目的监督者与基于已知诱导事件移动平均来降低干预概率的自适应退避规则。评估对象包括手工编码的随机策略智能体（在结果替换与执行损坏工具参数两种情形下）以及一个 Gemini 2.5 Flash 实验（6 个任务、共 576 个回合）。
AI.result: 在手工编码的随机策略智能体上，两种情形（结果替换与执行损坏工具参数）均出现该失败模式。对于持续性策略，自适应退避相较于干预频率大致匹配的固定弱监督者提高了任务完成率。Gemini 2.5 Flash 实验（576 回合、6 任务）同样显示退避下阻断减少、完成率提高；在所测试设置中，中等退避强度取得最高的聚合成功率。
AI.conclusion: 研究揭示了干预成本与持续性行动阻断之间的交互作用，并提出了一种可能的缓解方法。但成本机制是人为施加的，其诱导事件对退避规则直接可观测，因此该结论在受控环境之外的可推广性仍是待验证的实证问题。

title: Removing Information Content Does Not Certify Tamper Resistance in Open-Weight Models
summary: Does removing harmful information make open-weight models resistant to fine-tuning attacks? We show that mutual information at release alone cannot universally certify slow recovery. Function-preserving reparameterizations leave information unchanged while altering gradient-descent geometry, so an invariant certificate is bounded by the fastest reachable parameterization. We apply this principle to weight--data mutual information under training-data filtering and label--representation mutual information under capability removal. Training order can change recovery time at fixed weight--data information, while exact representation-level independence can preserve the entire parameter Jacobian. An explicit construction has both information quantities equal to zero and recovers in one gradient step. Controlled experiments illustrate order-dependent recovery and parameterization-dependent attack speed. These results identify the missing requirement for certification: constraints on attack dynamics beyond mutual information at release.

AI.tldr: 仅靠发布时的互信息无法普遍证明开放权重模型对微调攻击的慢恢复性；需要额外约束攻击动力学。
AI.motivation: 检验“移除有害信息即可使开放权重模型抵抗微调攻击”这一常见假设，并考察以发布时互信息作为认证依据的充分性。
AI.method: 从函数保持的重参数化出发，指出其不改变互信息却改变梯度下降几何，因此不变量证书受最快可达参数化限制；据此分别分析训练数据过滤下的权重—数据互信息与能力移除下的标签—表示互信息，并构造反例与受控实验。
AI.result: 在固定权重—数据互信息下，训练顺序可改变恢复时间；精确的表示级独立性仍可保留完整参数Jacobian；存在显式构造使两种互信息均为零且仅一步梯度即恢复。实验显示恢复具顺序依赖性，攻击速度具参数化依赖性。
AI.conclusion: 认证所需缺失条件是发布互信息之外的攻击动力学约束；互信息本身不足以普遍认证微调攻击下的慢恢复。

title: Formal Runtime Verification for Tool-Using LLM Agents: An Offline Same-Benchmark Study on AgentDojo and STAC
comment: 14 pages, 1 figure, 13 tables. Accepted at the 8th Workshop on CPS&IoT Security and Privacy (CPSIoTSec '26), co-located with ACM CCS 2026, The Hague
summary: Guardrails for tool-using LLM agents are usually application-specific rules, which makes multi-step, data-dependent safety policies hard to specify, audit and reuse. As a declarative alternative, we evaluate metric first-order temporal logic (MFOTL), replaying the recorded trajectories that AgentDojo, STAC and R-Judge already ship through the unmodified MonPoly monitor, offline and without running an agent. On these corpora, five generic obligations flag 71.8% of STAC attack chains and 70.1% of successful AgentDojo attacks, but also fire on 29.3% of benign runs. This imprecision stems from the corpora rather than the logic: they rarely record approvals and never record timestamps, so history-dependent obligations reduce to detecting risky action types. Where the trace does carry relational context, provenance-aware policies discriminate better; that context, however, is itself attackable, and one planted line defeats a naive provenance check on 94-99% of the runs it would otherwise flag. Binding provenance to the lookup that produced it closes this evasion at no cost in detection or benign firing. Taken together, these results show that formal temporal monitoring adds value exactly when the trace exposes trustworthy history. We therefore quantify how far current benchmarks are from that point and propose a twelve-field enforcement-ready trace schema.

AI.tldr: 该论文评估用度量一阶时序逻辑（MFOTL）+ MonPoly 对 LLM 智能体轨迹做声明式安全监控：在三个现有语料上能检出大部分攻击链，但误报偏高；根因是语料缺少审批与时间戳；在具备可靠关系上下文时，将溯源绑定到产生它的查询可消除规避且不损失性能；并提出十二字段的可执行 trace schema。
AI.motivation: 现有工具型 LLM 智能体的护栏多为应用特定规则，难以对多步、依赖数据的安全策略进行规范说明、审计与复用，需要一种声明式替代方案。
AI.method: 以 MFOTL 作为声明式策略语言，用未修改的 MonPoly 监控器离线回放 AgentDojo、STAC、R-Judge 已记录的轨迹（不运行智能体）；使用五条通用义务规则；并在轨迹含关系上下文时验证溯源感知策略，以及把溯源绑定到产生该溯源信息的查询这一加固方案。
AI.result: 五条通用义务标记了 71.8% 的 STAC 攻击链和 70.1% 的成功 AgentDojo 攻击，但也在 29.3% 的良性运行上触发；误报源于语料很少记录审批、从不记录时间戳，使依赖历史的义务退化为检测高风险动作类型；在轨迹携带关系上下文处，溯源感知策略区分度更好，但该上下文本身可被攻击——一行植入内容即可使朴素溯源检查在其本应标记的 94–99% 运行上失效；将溯源绑定到产生它的查询可在不降低检测率、不增加良性触发的前提下堵住该规避。
AI.conclusion: 形式化时序监控的价值恰好取决于轨迹是否暴露可信历史；论文据此量化了现有基准与该要求的差距，并提出十二字段的 enforcement-ready trace schema。

title: Evaluating the Transfer of Co-Evolved Communication from 2D to 3D Simulation
summary: This work examines the transfer of a co-evolved communication mechanism between two robotic agents from a discrete two-dimensional (2D) simulator to a three-dimensional simulator with real physics (3D). The study focuses on whether a communication mechanism co-evolved in a 2D environment retains its functional role after transfer to a 3D physics-based simulator. To support this analysis, the effects of the episode time budget, the social cue, and the asymmetry between the two co-evolved roles were examined. The results indicate that the success rate increased approximately linearly with the evaluated time budgets, with no evidence of a plateau between 2,000 and 6,000 physics steps, suggesting that evaluations based on shorter episodes may underestimate the performance of the trained controllers. In both simulators, the social cue functioned primarily as a jam- assistance mechanism rather than as a navigation guide, although with a more pronounced effect in 2D. Analysis of eight independent evolutionary runs revealed a consistent direction of asymmetry, although its magnitude varied across runs. Controlling the processing order between agents allowed us to rule out an artifact of the physics engine. Finally, the results are discussed in terms of the factors that may contribute to the remaining performance gap observed after transfer.

AI.tldr: 该研究将一个在离散二维仿真器中共同进化的双机器人通信机制迁移到具有真实物理的三维仿真器，考察其功能角色是否保留，并分析了回合时间预算、社会线索及角色不对称性的影响。
AI.motivation: 验证在简化2D环境中共同进化的通信机制在更真实3D物理环境中的可迁移性与功能保持程度，并识别影响迁移后性能差距的关键因素（时间预算、社会线索、角色不对称）。
AI.method: 将2D离散仿真器中两个机器人代理共同进化的通信机制迁移至3D真实物理仿真器；系统操控回合时间预算（2,000–6,000物理步）、社会线索作用以及两个共同进化角色之间的不对称性；通过控制代理间的处理顺序排除物理引擎伪影；并比较八个独立进化运行的结果。
AI.result: 成功率随评估时间预算近似线性增长，在2,000至6,000物理步间未见平台期，表明短回合评估可能低估训练控制器性能；社会线索在两种仿真器中均主要作为“拥堵辅助”机制而非导航引导，但2D中效应更明显；八个独立进化运行显示不对称方向一致但幅度存在波动；控制处理顺序后排除了物理引擎伪影。
AI.conclusion: 共同进化的通信机制在迁移到3D物理环境后仍保留功能角色，但存在残余性能差距；该差距可能由时间预算不足、社会线索功能弱化及角色不对称性等因素共同导致，短回合评估需谨慎解读。

title: Arctic Questions, Missing Answers: A Dataset and Benchmark for LLM Abstention in Arctic Science
summary: Large language models (LLMs) should abstain from scientific multiple-choice questions when no option is valid, but frequent abstention alone does not demonstrate sensitivity to answer availability. We introduce ArcticQA, a dataset of 194 questions derived from primary Arctic research, with automated checks of answer support and distractor contradiction against source evidence. We further develop ArcticAbstain, a paired benchmark comparing answer-present and answer-absent conditions, with the correct answer replaced by a distractor in the latter and an explicit abstention option in both. We evaluate eight models from the Gemini, Claude, and ChatGPT families at high reasoning effort, with three trials per condition, yielding 9,312 recorded responses. Answer-present abstention rates range from 0.0% to 63.0%, whereas replacing the correct answer increases abstention by 5.05 percentage points on average. These findings highlight substantial baseline differences and the need to evaluate abstention frequency and responsiveness jointly. The dataset and benchmark are available at https://github.com/BenWilcox8/arctic-qa.

AI.tldr: 提出ArcticQA数据集（194道北极研究选择题，含答案支持与干扰项矛盾的自动校验）与ArcticAbstain配对基准（答案存在/缺失两种条件对比），评估8个模型共9,312条响应。答案存在时弃答率0.0%–63.0%，替换正确答案后弃答率平均上升5.05个百分点，说明需同时评估弃答频率与对答案可用性的响应性。
AI.motivation: LLM在科学选择题无有效选项时应弃答，但高弃答率本身不足以证明模型对"答案是否可用"具有敏感性，现有评估缺乏配对化、可控的答案可用性操控设计。
AI.method: 构建ArcticQA：源自一手北极研究的194道选择题，并自动校验答案支持性与干扰项矛盾性；进一步构建ArcticAbstain配对基准，在答案存在与答案缺失（正确答案被替换为干扰项）两种条件下对比，两条件均设显式弃答选项；评估Gemini、Claude、ChatGPT三个家族共8个模型（高推理强度，每条件3次试验）。
AI.result: 共记录9,312条响应。答案存在条件下弃答率为0.0%–63.0%，模型间基线差异显著；将正确答案替换为干扰项后，弃答率平均提升5.05个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 模型间弃答行为基线差异较大，且对答案可用性的响应性有限；应联合评估弃答频率与响应性。数据集与基准已开源。

title: StyleFields: Multi-Scale AdaIN-Modulated Implicit SDFs for Coarse-to-Fine 3D Shape Reconstruction and Editing
comment: 39 pages, 20 figures, 3 tables. Includes supplementary material
summary: We introduce StyleFields, a DeepSDF-based architecture for high-fidelity 3D reconstruction that enables controllable geometric style mixing: the coarse structure of one object can be combined with the fine-scale details of another. The core idea is depth-aware modulation: instead of a single global code, we inject latents via multi-level Adaptive Instance Normalization at several decoder depths, and supervise matching auxiliary heads with a coarse-to-fine schedule while gradually growing network depth. This aligns early layers with global shape and later layers with high-frequency detail, achieving content-style decoupling without part labels or adversarial training. StyleFields delivers faithful reconstructions, convincing cross-instance hybrids, and consistent gains in ablations over injection depth and supervision granularity. We further demonstrate a practical application in automotive aerodynamics: a learned surrogate drag predictor serves as a differentiable objective to optimize reconstructed cars, allowing targeted edits of global form or surface details by freezing the complementary latent stream. StyleFields offers a simple, effective recipe for controllable implicit reconstruction and downstream performance-driven design.

AI.tldr: StyleFields：基于DeepSDF的隐式重建框架，通过深度感知的多层级AdaIN潜码注入与由粗到细监督，实现几何风格混合与空气动力学优化。
AI.motivation: 现有隐式重建多以单一全局潜码表征形状，难以解耦粗结构（内容）与细尺度细节（风格），在无部件标注、无对抗训练条件下实现可控几何编辑仍具挑战。
AI.method: 提出深度感知调制：放弃单一全局编码，在解码器多个深度处通过多层级AdaIN注入潜码，并以由粗到细（coarse-to-fine）监督多个辅助匹配头，同时逐步增长网络深度，使浅层对应全局形状、深层对应高频细节；无需部件标签或对抗训练即可解耦内容与风格。下游以学习到的代理阻力预测器作为可微目标，通过冻结互补潜码流实现全局形态或表面细节的定向编辑。
AI.result: 获得高保真重建、令人信服的跨实例混合结果；在注入深度与监督粒度两个维度上的消融均取得一致提升；在汽车空气动力学任务中实现了面向阻力优化的定向几何编辑。
AI.conclusion: StyleFields提供了一种简单有效的可控隐式重建方案，可服务于性能驱动的下游设计。

title: From High Recall to High Utility: Dataset-Adaptive Post-Processing of LLM-Generated Customer Intents
summary: Large language models can extract useful signals from heterogeneous enterprise data, but high-recall extraction often produces outputs that are duplicated, uneven in granularity, semantically overlapping, or too numerous for downstream systems and human reviewers to use effectively.
