We present a dataset-adaptive post-processing architecture developed for Customer Intent Extraction (CIE), where unstructured customer language is transformed into stable, traceable intent units. The approach separates recall-oriented extraction from utility-oriented reduction. Source-specific preprocessing first isolates evidence from multimodal plans, sparse operational records, and structured opportunity data. Candidate intents are then standardized and deduplicated, optionally enriched with metadata for embedding computation, represented in a shared semantic vector space, and grouped using a clustering strategy selected according to the candidate set's characteristics. Cluster-level keywords provide an explainability layer, while singleton reassignment requires agreement between embedding and keyword similarity. Finally, constrained language-model aggregation produces one concise intent per cluster without introducing unsupported concepts, and the resulting unit retains provenance, clustering, embedding, and generation metadata. This treats post-processing not as cosmetic cleanup, but as a semantic reduction layer converting high-recall LLM outputs into reusable enterprise intelligence. We also describe two downstream applications: Machine-Generated Intents, which infer likely objectives for customers lacking direct evidence from peer customers with similar profiles, and intent-guided semantic retrieval and mapping, which uses the stable intent as a query against a downstream decision space, illustrated here by mapping customer intents to business outcomes.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种面向客户意图抽取（CIE）的数据集自适应后处理架构，将"召回导向的抽取"与"效用导向的归约"分离，通过预处理、标准化去重、共享语义向量空间聚类、关键词可解释层、单例重分配及受约束的LLM聚合，把高召回但冗余、粒度不均的LLM输出转化为稳定、可溯源、可复用的意图单元，并给出两个下游应用。
AI.motivation: LLM虽能从异构企业数据中提取有用信号，但高召回抽取会产出重复、粒度不均、语义重叠或数量过多的结果，下游系统与人工审阅难以有效使用。因此需要将后处理视为语义归约层，而非表面的清理工作。
AI.method: 提出数据集自适应的CIE后处理架构：1) 按来源预处理，从多模态方案、稀疏运营记录与结构化商机数据中分离证据；2) 候选意图标准化与去重，可选地补充元数据以计算嵌入；3) 映射到共享语义向量空间，依据候选集特征选择聚类策略；4) 簇级关键词作为可解释层；5) 单例重分配要求嵌入相似度与关键词相似度一致；6) 受约束的LM聚合，每簇生成一条简洁意图且不引入无依据概念，并保留来源、聚类、嵌入与生成元数据。
AI.result: 所生成的意图单元保留了溯源、聚类、嵌入与生成元数据；簇级关键词提供可解释性；受约束聚合在不引入无支撑概念的前提下实现每簇一条简洁意图。论文还描述了两个下游应用：机器生成意图（Machine-Generated Intents），即借助相似画像的同类客户为缺乏直接证据的客户推断可能目标；以及意图引导的语义检索与映射，即以稳定意图为查询去匹配下游决策空间，示例为将客户意图映射到业务成果。
AI.conclusion: 该架构将后处理定位为语义归约层，把高召回的LLM输出转换为可复用的企业智能；通过分离召回与归约、结合嵌入聚类与关键词可解释性、施加一致性约束与受约束生成，兼顾覆盖率、粒度稳定性与可溯源可解释性，并支撑意图推断与意图引导检索映射等下游任务。

title: Neighborhood Smoothing for Calibration
summary: Modern neural networks are often miscalibrated, with a tendency to overconfidence. Existing train-time calibration methods largely modify task losses or calibration penalties, leaving neighborhood structure in learned representations underexploited. We introduce graph smoothing as a general principle for train-time calibration, which encourages similar predictive distributions across neighboring samples in representation space. We analyze the effects of graph smoothing, deriving bounds that connect predictive divergence between neighboring samples to local confidence variation and to the propagation of pointwise calibration error, and characterize the conditions under which smoothing can or cannot improve calibration. In light of this analysis, we propose \modelNoSpace, a graph-based train-time regularizer that penalizes the Jensen--Shannon divergence between predictive distributions of neighboring samples. We present a thorough empirical analysis, showing that across standard calibration benchmarks, \model improves predictive quality, and the improvement is complementary to post-hoc calibration: after temperature scaling, \model attains the lowest NLL of all evaluated train-time methods in seven of the eight image and tabular settings. These findings demonstrate the value of graph smoothing over learned representations for neural network calibration.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将图平滑作为训练期校准的一般原则，并据此设计了基于图的正则化器（对近邻样本预测分布间的JS散度进行惩罚）。理论与实验表明，该方法能提升预测质量，且与事后校准互补。
AI.motivation: 现代神经网络常出现校准不良，表现为过度自信。现有训练期校准方法主要改造任务损失或加入校准惩罚项，忽视了所学表示中的邻域结构这一可利用信息。
AI.method: 提出以图平滑作为训练期校准的一般原则，鼓励表示空间中近邻样本具有相似的预测分布；从理论上分析图平滑的效果，推导出将邻居样本间预测散度与局部置信度变化、逐点校准误差传播相联系的界，并刻画平滑能否改善校准的条件。基于该分析，提出一种基于图的正则化器，惩罚近邻样本预测分布间的Jensen–Shannon散度。
AI.result: 在标准校准基准上的实证分析显示，该方法改善了预测质量，且改进与事后校准互补：在温度缩放后，在八个图像与表格设置中的七个上取得了所有评估过的训练期方法中最低的NLL。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果证明了在学习表示上施加图平滑对神经网络校准的价值。

title: Hierarchical Security Monitoring for Edge-IoT: A Formal Methods Approach
comment: 7 pages, 1 figure, 2 tables. Accepted at the 2026 IEEE International Conference on Cyber Security and Resilience (IEEE CSR 2026)
summary: Cyber resiliency in edge-IoT deployments is fundamentally an economic problem: detection must keep critical processes operating under attack, but defender resources (compute, bandwidth, operator attention) are bounded. Centralised cloud monitoring offers expressive cross-device detection at prohibitive bandwidth cost; purely edge-local monitoring is cheap but blind to coordinated multi-device attacks where the asymmetric balance favours the attacker. We propose a lightweight hierarchical security-monitoring framework, built on formal runtime-verification methods, that occupies the practical middle ground at quantified cost. Each edge device runs a lightweight TeSSLa stream specification (size, payload validity, rate, and timestamp-drift predicates) that emits a four-valued verdict per aggregation window at sub-microsecond per-event cost; the gateway runs a parametric first-order MonPoly monitor over the per-device verdict streams at microsecond-scale per-verdict cost. The edge-to-gateway uplink carries roughly one Boolean per aggregation window per node, orders of magnitude smaller than the raw packet stream. The gateway tier detects coordinated attack patterns that no single-node monitor can see, shifting the asymmetric cost balance toward the defender. Every alert carries a witness set naming the device, the monitor tier, and the predicate that fired, providing an auditable record of the decision. We evaluate the framework on a container-host testbed spanning nominal and attacker nodes across four attack classes (buffer overflow, time spoofing, denial-of-service, and mixed advanced-persistent-threat patterns), and describe the edge- and gateway-tier specifications together with the cost-versus-coverage trade-off as monitor levels are added.

AI.tldr: 提出轻量级分层安全监控框架，边缘运行TeSSLa流规范，网关运行MonPoly参数化监控，以低带宽成本实现跨设备协同攻击检测。
AI.motivation: 边缘IoT弹性本质是经济问题：检测需在攻击下维持关键进程运行，而防御资源（算力、带宽、运维注意力）有限。集中式云监控带宽成本过高；纯边缘本地监控虽廉价但无法察觉协同多设备攻击，使非对称成本偏向攻击者，需折中方案。
AI.method: 基于形式化运行时验证构建分层监控：每个边缘设备运行轻量TeSSLa流规范（大小、载荷有效性、速率、时间戳漂移谓词），每聚合窗口输出四值裁决，单事件开销亚微秒；网关运行参数化一阶MonPoly监控器处理各设备裁决流，单裁决开销微秒级。上行链路每窗口每节点约传一位Boolean。每个告警携带witness集（设备、监控层、触发谓词）用于审计。
AI.result: 在容器主机测试床上评估，涵盖正常与攻击节点，覆盖四类攻击（缓冲区溢出、时间欺骗、拒绝服务、混合APT模式），并描述边缘与网关两层规范及随监控层级增加的成本-覆盖权衡。
AI.conclusion: 该分层框架占据量化的实用中间地带：以数量级更低的带宽检测单节点无法发现的协同攻击模式，使非对称成本向防御者转移，同时提供可审计告警。

title: LACE-CRAFT: Robot Co-Design with Actor Inheritance and Blackboard Collaboration
comment: 16 pages including appendix. Project website: https://deemostech.github.io/lace-craft/
summary: Robot co-design couples morphology search with policy learning, yet training every new design from scratch discards acquired control experience. We present LACE-CRAFT, which compares continued learning on the current robot with policy adaptation to new morphology-reward pairs. LACE resumes the incumbent's full learning state and initializes compatible challengers with its actor parameters and observation statistics. A fixed task metric selects among both branches and the frozen incumbent. CRAFT coordinates Feedback, Morphology, Reward, and Integration roles through shared experimental records and behavioral replays to generate and cross-review paired proposals. A generative extension converts generated meshes into editable articulated models with configured joints, actuator interfaces, and consistently updated simulation assets. Across five locomotion benchmarks, mean scores over three evaluation seeds are 6.4-91.9% higher than D2C. Both methods train 30 new morphology-reward pairs over five rounds; LACE additionally uses four continuation training units. Five-task ablations examine policy inheritance and replay-derived feedback. A fabricated prototype demonstrates indoor walking and illustrates the geometry-to-hardware workflow.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LACE-CRAFT框架，将机器人协同设计中的形态搜索与策略学习结合，通过延续学习（LACE）与多角色协同（CRAFT）提升新形态-奖励配对的训练效率，在五个运动基准上显著优于D2C。
AI.motivation: 现有机器人协同设计将形态搜索与策略学习耦合，但每个新设计都从头训练，丢弃了已获得的控制经验，导致样本效率低、训练成本高。作者希望复用已有学习状态，避免重复学习。
AI.method: 提出LACE-CRAFT。LACE在当前机器人上继续学习，并对新的形态-奖励配对进行策略适应：恢复 incumbent 的完整学习状态，用其 actor 参数与观测统计初始化兼容的 challenger，并通过固定任务指标在两条分支与冻结的 incumbent 间选择。CRAFT通过共享实验记录与行为回放协调 Feedback、Morphology、Reward、Integration 四个角色，生成并交叉评审成对提案。生成式扩展可将生成网格转为可编辑的关节模型，配置关节、执行器接口并同步更新仿真资产。
AI.result: 在五个运动基准上，三个评估种子的平均得分比D2C高6.4%–91.9%。两种方法均在五轮中训练30个新形态-奖励配对；LACE额外使用四个延续训练单元。五任务消融实验考察了策略继承与回放反馈的作用。制作的原型展示了室内行走并演示了几何到硬件的流程。
AI.conclusion: 复用已有策略的学习状态并结合多角色协同设计，可有效提升机器人形态-控制联合设计的效率与性能，并具备从生成几何到实体硬件的可行性。

title: Right Number, Wrong State? Measuring Cross-Jurisdiction Substitution in LLM Recall of State Policy
summary: When an LLM answers a state-specific policy question wrongly, it may be hallucinating, or it may be returning a real value that holds in another state. We test this with a minimal-set design: the question wording is fixed and only the jurisdiction varies, across the 50 U.S. states and the District of Columbia (51 jurisdictions) and three exactly defined Medicaid income-eligibility quantities. Gold values come from an official data book and agree with an independent source in 101 of 102 checked cells. Under a pre-registered protocol, Claude Sonnet 5.5 and GPT-5.6 Sol reproducibly give another state's current value, identical across two independent repeats, for 10 and 25 of 153 items. Attribution is fragile, however. Crediting any wrong answer that equals another state's value yields 3-5x more reproducible substitutions than checking every number in the asked state's own records, because many apparent cross-state answers are the asked state's own values under another convention or from an earlier year. Claims about cross-jurisdiction error need a complete same-state reference set. We will release the protocol, gold table, and all model outputs.

AI.tldr: 研究用最小差异设计（仅更换辖区）测试LLM对州级政策问题的跨州错误，发现可复现的"另一种州取值"确实存在，但归因高度依赖参照集完备性。
AI.motivation: 以往发现LLM回答州级政策问题时出错，但难以区分是纯粹幻觉，还是返回了"在另一个州成立的真实数值"。作者希望以可控设计严格检验跨辖区替换（cross-jurisdiction substitution）现象，并检验此类错误归因的稳健性。
AI.method: 最小集设计：问题措辞固定，仅改变辖区，覆盖美国50州+哥伦比亚特区共51个辖区，以及3个精确定义的Medicaid收入资格标准。金标准取自官方数据手册，并在102个抽查单元中与独立来源一致101个。采用预注册协议，测试Claude Sonnet 5.5与GPT-5.6 Sol，每项独立重复两次，共153项（51辖区×3量）。核心对照：将"任何等于其他州数值的错误答案"计为替换，对比"逐项核查被问州自身记录中的每个数值"。
AI.result: Claude Sonnet 5.5在153项中有10项、GPT-5.6 Sol有25项，可复现地给出另一州的当前数值，且两次独立重复完全一致。但若放宽归因标准（任何等于他州数值的错误即计为跨州），可复现替换数会膨胀3-5倍；原因是许多表面上的跨州答案实际上是被问州自身在他种口径或往年下的数值。
AI.conclusion: 跨辖区错误归因十分脆弱：宽松标准会因混淆同州异口径/异年份数值而严重高估跨州替换率。关于跨辖区错误的论断必须建立完备的同州参照集（same-state reference set）。作者将公开协议、金标准表与全部模型输出。

title: Do Vision Models Learn Physical Constraints or Rendering Shortcuts? A Counterfactual Benchmark for Grounded Physical Consistency
comment: Accepted in NeurIPS 2026 the 1st Workshop on Physical World AI
summary: Modern image editing models can satisfy a text instruction while breaking the physics of the edited scene. A new object may cast no shadow, a mirror may fail to reflect visible geometry, or an object may float above a surface that should support it. We study physical plausibility diagnosis, detecting whether an edited image violates scene physics, naming the violation type, localizing the affected region, and explaining the failure in language. We introduce a counterfactual benchmark whose controlled synthetic component uses Mitsuba~3 to generate 5,500 images from 500 scene families. Each family contains one clean image and ten matched violations involving shadows, reflection, support, surface response, and occlusion. The renderer pipeline provides category labels, affected-region masks and boxes, scene metadata, and explanation targets. We use LLaVA-1.5-7B, Qwen2.5-VL-7B, and InternVL3.5-8B as diagnostic baselines rather than proposed methods. On a 1,650-image synthetic test set, the adapted baselines reach 64.0--67.8\% category macro-F1 on standard held-out scenes. For LLaVA-1.5-7B, category macro-F1 falls from 64.0\% on the standard split to 40.8\% under intervention shift. This gap shows that high in-distribution accuracy partly reflects cues tied to rendering and counterfactual construction.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"物理合理性诊断"任务，并构建基于Mitsuba 3的反事实基准：5个场景族、500个场景族、5500张图像，覆盖阴影、反射、支撑、表面响应与遮挡五类物理违规，含类别标签、违规区域掩码/框、场景元数据与解释目标；用LLaVA-1.5-7B、Qwen2.5-VL-7B、InternVL3.5-8B作为诊断基线（非提出方法）。
AI.motivation: 现代图像编辑模型能按文本指令编辑，却常破坏被编辑场景的物理规律（如物体无阴影、镜面不反射、物体悬空）。需要系统性地诊断编辑图像是否违反场景物理，并说明违规类型、定位受影响区域、用语言解释失败原因。
AI.method: 构建反事实基准，其受控合成部分用Mitsuba 3生成5500张图像，来自500个场景族；每个族含1张干净图像与10张配对违规图像，涉及阴影、反射、支撑、表面响应、遮挡。渲染管线提供类别标签、受影响区域掩码与框、场景元数据及解释目标。以LLaVA-1.5-7B、Qwen2.5-VL-7B、InternVL3.5-8B为诊断基线。
AI.result: 在1650张合成测试集上，适配后的基线在标准留出场景上达到64.0–67.8%的类别宏F1；对LLaVA-1.5-7B，类别宏F1从标准划分的64.0%降至干预偏移下的40.8%。
AI.conclusion: 该性能落差表明，高同分布准确率部分来自与渲染及反事实构造相关的线索，而非真正的物理合理性理解；基准揭示了模型在干预偏移下的脆弱性。

title: Justice After Identity: Large Language Models and the View from Everywhere
summary: The search for a common view of justice and fairness has challenged human collective activity, as our diverging judgments are unavoidably shaped by the self-interests of social position, personal benefit, cultural inheritance, and historical circumstance. John Rawls famously attempted to overcome this limitation through popularizing a philosophical tradition known by the phrase "the original position" - a thought experiment by which people select principles of justice without knowing the identities or advantages they will possess. Critics, however, have long questioned whether people can meaningfully suspend their social identities and suppress morally relevant forms of lived experience. Artificial intelligence engaged to calculate algorithmic and agentic fairness introduces a novel possibility. LLMs have no singular class, race, gender, nationality, or biography, yet their parameters encode linguistic representations of a vast range of human identities and moral traditions. Perhaps the ethical judgments of LLMs could approximate an integrative original position - a "view from everywhere" generated not by excluding social identities but by computationally incorporating their diversity.It is unlikely that humankind will "hand over the keys" to computational systems by simply delegating complete agentic control of distributive and procedural collective processes. But AI may play a role, perhaps a positive one, interacting with individual and collective human judgment as we often confront increasingly polarized views on what is fair and just. We present data comparing human, base model, and frontier/fine-tuned model judgments about classic moral dilemmas while systematically varying identity relationships and Rawlsian constraints on identity. We conclude by speculating whether, if advanced AI systems provide humans with thoughtful advice, humans would actually be likely to accept it.

AI.tldr: 本文提出大语言模型可能近似罗尔斯"原初状态"的"来自各处的视角"，通过实验比较人类、基础模型与前沿/微调模型在经典道德困境中的判断，并探讨人类是否会接受AI的道德建议。
AI.motivation: 人类对正义与公平的判断不可避免受社会地位、个人利益、文化传承与历史处境等自利因素影响，罗尔斯的"原初状态"试图通过剥离身份来克服这一局限，但批评者质疑人能否真正悬置社会身份与切身经验。大语言模型无单一阶级、种族、性别、国籍或生平，却编码了广泛人类身份与道德传统的语言表征，这为近似"整合式原初状态"提供了新可能。
AI.method: 实验比较人类、基础模型与前沿/微调模型对经典道德困境的判断，系统操纵身份关系与罗尔斯式身份约束条件。
AI.result: 摘要未给出具体数据结果，仅说明呈现了人类、基础模型与前沿/微调模型在身份关系与罗尔斯式身份约束变化下的判断比较数据。
AI.conclusion: 人类不太可能把集体分配与程序过程的完全代理控制权交给计算系统，但AI或可发挥积极作用，与个体及集体人类判断互动，以应对在公平正义问题上日益两极化的观点；作者最后推测先进AI若给出深思熟虑的建议，人类是否真会接受。

title: SPIN: Shadow Predictive Indexer for Sparse Attention
summary: Indexer-based sparse attention reduces the cost of core attention by passing only a fixed, small number of important tokens to it. However, the indexer must still score the entire KV cache at every decoding step. This scoring overhead becomes a major bottleneck as the context length grows. We propose SPIN (Shadow Predictive Indexer) to reduce this indexer overhead. SPIN uses lightweight, history-based prediction to identify important KV blocks, avoiding the need to score the full KV cache at every decoding step. SPIN treats KV blocks and speculative decoding as first-class design and implementation considerations. Across extensive evaluations on long-context and agentic benchmarks, SPIN achieves 30-40% sparsity while preserving task quality. In end-to-end vLLM serving, SPIN improves output throughput by up to 14.9% and reduces median inter-token latency by up to 13.2%.

AI.tldr: 提出SPIN（Shadow Predictive Indexer），用基于历史的轻量预测替代索引器对完整KV缓存的逐步打分，在保持任务质量的前提下实现30-40%稀疏度，并在vLLM服务中提升吞吐最高14.9%、降低中位token间延迟最高13.2%。
AI.motivation: 基于索引器的稀疏注意力虽降低了核心注意力成本，但索引器在每个解码步仍需对全部KV缓存打分，随着上下文增长，这一打分开销成为主要瓶颈。
AI.method: SPIN采用轻量级、基于历史的预测来识别重要的KV块，避免在每个解码步对完整KV缓存打分；同时将KV块与投机解码（speculative decoding）作为首要的设计与实现考量。
AI.result: 在长上下文与智能体（agentic）基准的广泛评测中，SPIN在保持任务质量的同时达到30-40%稀疏度；在端到端vLLM服务中，输出吞吐最高提升14.9%，中位token间延迟最多降低13.2%。
AI.conclusion: SPIN通过历史预测式索引有效消除了索引器的全量打分开销，在长上下文推理的精度与效率之间取得良好平衡，具备实际部署价值。

title: Co${}^{2}$Skill: Whole-Body Control via Skill Composition for Long-Horizon Human-Environment Interaction
summary: Achieving human-level dexterity in complex, unstructured environments requires the seamless integration of whole-body scene interaction and dexterous object manipulation skills. While existing physics-based controllers generate physically plausible behaviors in each domain, they largely address these two capabilities independently. In this paper, we present Co${}^{2}$Skill that integrates scene interaction and dexterous manipulation through a unified policy formulation. Built on a pretrained motion prior, the policy uses task and phase dependent observation masks to select information relevant to the current interaction goals. We introduce a goal-conditioned loco-manipulation curriculum that combines partial reference guidance for precision with exploration from varied initial states while allowing goal-directed execution beyond the demonstrated trajectories. We further introduce a cross-task curriculum that jointly trains individual skills and selected task sequences, preserving physical states across task boundaries and maintaining grasps during subsequent scene interactions. Together, these support sequential task execution and simultaneous scene interaction with object manipulation. We evaluate sitting, standing, climbing, stair traversal, and goal-directed manipulation, together with sequential execution and with random different conditions. Additionally, we demonstrate skill compositions in indoor environments, illustrating their integration within the same control formulation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Co²Skill，通过统一策略框架将全身场景交互与精细物体操作整合，借助预训练运动先验、任务与阶段相关的观测掩码、目标条件化的移动操作课程及跨任务课程，实现了顺序任务执行和同时进行场景交互与物体操作。
AI.motivation: 现有基于物理的控制器虽能在各自领域（全身场景交互、精细物体操作）内生成物理合理的行为，但基本上将这两种能力独立处理，未能实现无缝集成。而复杂的非结构化环境要求同时具备两者。
AI.method: 1) 基于预训练运动先验构建统一策略；2) 采用任务与阶段相关的观测掩码选择与当前交互目标相关的信息；3) 提出目标条件化的移动操作课程，结合部分参考引导以保证精度，并从多样初始状态进行探索，支持超出示范轨迹的目标导向执行；4) 引入跨任务课程，联合训练单项技能与选定任务序列，在任务边界保持物理状态，并在后续场景交互中维持抓取。
AI.result: 评估了坐、站、攀爬、楼梯行走和目标导向操作，以及顺序执行和随机不同条件下的表现；并在室内环境中演示了技能组合，表明这些技能可在同一控制公式内集成。
AI.conclusion: Co²Skill通过统一策略公式成功整合场景交互与精细操作，支持顺序任务执行和同时的场景交互与物体操作，验证了在同一控制框架内进行技能组合与集成的可行性。

title: BanglaRhet: Benchmarking Classical and Transformer Models for Rhetorical and Persuasion Detection in Bangla Political Speech
comment: 6 pages, 2 figures, 6 tables. Accepted at the 2026 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication, Electrical, and Smart Systems (iCACCESS), Dhaka, Bangladesh. Dataset: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23162113. Code: https://github.com/TSRohit99/banglarhet. Hugging Face: https://huggingface.co/datasets/tsrohit99/banglarhet
summary: Political discourse often uses rhetorical and persuasive language to frame narratives, influence public opinion, and mobilize audiences. While Bangla natural language processing has made progress in sentiment analysis and opinion mining, systematic benchmarking of transformer models for fine-grained rhetorical and persuasion technique detection in Bangla political speech remains largely underexplored. This paper presents a benchmark study of transformer-based models for detecting rhetorical form and persuasive intent in Bangla political discourse. Using BanglaRhet, a manually annotated corpus of 30,289 Bangla political speech segments collected from publicly available political news sources, we formulate two supervised single-label classification tasks: rhetorical technique detection (contrast, repetition, exaggeration, metaphor, rhetorical questions) and persuasion technique detection (blame assignment, call to action, unity call, moral, emotional, and logical appeals). We evaluate four transformer-based models, BanglaBERT, BanglaBERT-Base, SahajBERT, and XLM-RoBERTa-Base, against classical TF-IDF baselines. BanglaBERT achieves the highest performance, with 65.40% macro-F1 for rhetorical technique detection and 66.46% for persuasion technique detection, outperforming the best tuned classical baseline by 19.2 and 13.8 macro-F1 points, respectively. Class-level analysis indicates that errors are mainly associated with semantic overlap among labels, figurative language, and class imbalance. The results provide initial benchmark baselines for Bangla rhetorical and persuasion-aware political discourse analysis and highlight the need for context-aware and multi-label modeling.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了30,289条孟加拉语政治演讲片段的人工标注语料BanglaRhet，对四个Transformer模型进行修辞手法与说服技巧检测的基准评测，BanglaBERT取得最佳性能。
AI.motivation: 孟加拉语NLP在情感分析和观点挖掘方面已有进展，但针对政治话语中细粒度修辞与说服技巧检测的Transformer模型系统性基准评测仍严重缺失。
AI.method: 构建BanglaRhet人工标注语料（30,289条孟加拉语政治演讲片段，来自公开政治新闻），设计两个单标签监督分类任务：修辞技巧检测（对比、重复、夸张、隐喻、反问）与说服技巧检测（归责、行动号召、团结呼吁、道德、情感、逻辑诉求）。在BanglaBERT、BanglaBERT-Base、SahajBERT、XLM-RoBERTa-Base四个Transformer模型与经典TF-IDF基线之间进行对比评测。
AI.result: BanglaBERT性能最佳，修辞技巧检测macro-F1为65.40%，说服技巧检测macro-F1为66.46%，分别超出最优调参经典基线19.2和13.8个macro-F1点。类别级分析表明错误主要源于标签间语义重叠、比喻性语言和类别不平衡。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为孟加拉语修辞与说服感知的政治话语分析提供了初步基准，并指出未来需要上下文感知与多标签建模。

title: A Deterministic Evidence Layer for Vision-Language Autism Screening from Naturalistic Home Video
summary: Autism spectrum disorder (ASD) is diagnosed through specialist observation of a child's social behavior, and access to that expertise is the bottleneck for early identification. Vision-language models (VLMs) describe a child's behavior from video well; the verdict drawn from the description is unstable: at temperature~0, across eight pipeline configurations on one backbone, 16--37\% of clips change their predicted label between repeated runs, and the cause lies in the serving stack. We keep the VLM frozen and move the decision out of the model. Under our grounded perception constraints the VLM writes an event table of timestamped, glossary-labeled events that names the eliciting press and logs counter-evidence; a text-only stage age-calibrates the confidence of each row; a deterministic weight-of-evidence scorer sums it into an evidence total and stratifies it into a risk category, so every decision decomposes into named per-feature contributions and can be re-scored from the saved table. On 43 caregiver-recorded, protocol-free home free-play clips of preschool children, the pipeline reaches AUC $0.851 \pm 0.012$, 86.0\% accuracy, and F$_1$ 71.8 over three runs. It labels 74.4\% of clips correctly in every run (60.5\% for the zero-shot baseline) and flags no typically developing clip in every run (9 of 31 at zero-shot). An ablation on the same backbone attributes the gain to the grounded perception constraints read through the deterministic scorer.

AI.tldr: 该论文将自闭症谱系障碍(ASD)的视频筛查决策从冻结的视觉语言模型(VLM)中剥离出来：VLM仅在感知约束下生成带时间戳、术语标注的事件表，随后由年龄校准的置信度文本阶段与确定性证据加权评分器完成风险分层。在43段家庭自由玩耍视频上取得AUC 0.851±0.012、86.0%准确率，且显著提升了跨运行稳定性。
AI.motivation: ASD依赖专家观察儿童社交行为进行诊断，专家资源稀缺构成早期识别的瓶颈。VLM虽能较好地从视频中描述儿童行为，但由描述得出的判定极不稳定（同一骨干网络的八种流程配置下，16–37%的视频片段在重复运行中标签发生变化），且成因在于服务栈而非模型本身。因此需要一种不重训模型、能把决策移出VLM并保证可复现与可解释的方案。
AI.method: 保持VLM冻结，将决策环节外置：1）在"接地感知约束"下，VLM输出事件表——记录带时间戳、按术语表标注的事件，标明诱发刺激并记录反证；2）纯文本阶段对各行置信度进行年龄校准；3）确定性证据加权评分器汇总为证据总分并分层为风险类别。每个判定可分解为具名特征的贡献，并能从保存的事件表重新评分。
AI.result: 在43段由照护者录制、无协议约束的学龄前儿童家庭自由玩耍视频上，三次运行结果为AUC 0.851±0.012、准确率86.0%、F1 71.8。74.4%的片段在每次运行中均被正确标注（零样本基线为60.5%）；且每次运行均未将任何典型发育儿童误判为高风险（零样本基线31段中有9段被误判）。同骨干网络的消融实验表明，增益来自经确定性评分器读取的接地感知约束。
AI.conclusion: 将决策从VLM服务栈中解耦并以确定性评分器替代，可在冻结模型的前提下同时获得更高的准确性与跨运行稳定性，并带来可分解、可复核、可重评分的可解释性；接地感知约束是该增益的主要来源。

title: Epistemic Uncertainty-Aware Defect Detection for Quality Control in Medical Device Manufacturing
summary: Objective: We investigate whether accounting for epistemic uncertainty can improve the reliability of automated defect detection in medical device manufacturing. Methods: We consider a machine learning framework that operates on heterogeneous manufacturing and device-report data represented with Knowledge Graphs. To mitigate errors arising from uncertainty in the decision model, we analyze a principled rejection strategy to abstain from predictions whose estimated epistemic uncertainty exceeds a specified threshold. We evaluate the approach using standard synthetic benchmarks and real-world medical device report data. Results: The theoretical results establish the validity of the method characterizing the regimes under which it is expected to be effective. Empirically, the rejection strategy enables explicit control of coverage, that is, the proportion of samples for which the model issues predictions, while improving performance on the retained samples. On 266,170 real-world FDA MAUDE device reports, a 10% abstention rate reduces classification error by 48%, and more aggressive rejection (approximately 70% coverage) yields near-perfect accuracy on the retained samples. On standard synthetic manufacturing benchmarks, abstaining on 9% of the decisions, our approach reduces the risk up to 63% compared with the standard no-abstention approach. Conclusions: Abstaining from predictions with high epistemic uncertainty can provide a practical tool for controlling the reliability of machine learning-based defect detection, especially in high-stakes medical device manufacturing applications. Significance: Uncertainty-aware defect detection may support safer and more reliable quality assurance in medical device manufacturing by identifying cases that require additional inspection rather than issuing potentially harmful predictions.

AI.tldr: 本文研究在医疗器械制造的自动缺陷检测中引入认知不确定性建模与拒绝预测（abstention）策略，以知识图谱表示异构制造与器械报告数据，并通过设定认知不确定性阈值来弃权高风险样本，从而在可控覆盖率下提升预测可靠性。
AI.motivation: 医疗器械制造属高风险场景，错误预测代价高。决策模型中的不确定性可能导致不可靠的缺陷检测结果，因此需要一种能够显式控制可靠性、并在不确定时转交人工复核的机制。
AI.method: 构建基于知识图谱表示异构制造数据与器械报告数据的机器学习框架；分析一种原则性的拒绝策略，当估计的认知不确定性超过给定阈值时拒绝给出预测；在标准合成基准与真实FDA MAUDE器械报告数据上进行评估，并与不拒绝的标准方法对比。
AI.result: 理论结果验证了方法的有效性并刻画了其适用的区间。实验中，拒绝策略可显式控制覆盖率并提升保留样本上的性能：在266,170条真实FDA MAUDE报告上，10%的弃权率使分类错误降低48%，约70%覆盖率时保留样本接近完美准确率；在合成制造基准上，弃权9%可使风险相对无弃权方法降低至多63%。
AI.conclusion: 基于高认知不确定性弃权可为机器学习缺陷检测的可靠性控制提供实用工具，尤其适用于高风险医疗器械制造；不确定性感知的缺陷检测能够通过识别需额外检查的样本，支持更安全、更可靠的质量保证。

title: ORACLE: Optimizer-Relative Alignment for Constrained LEarning
summary: Constraint handling methods typically intervene before the optimizer acts, by modifying the objective or the gradient. Yet momentum, adaptive scaling, and structured preconditioning can substantially reshape that signal before it becomes a parameter update. We formulate optimizer relative constrained learning, where constraint compatibility is assessed on the post optimizer update. Building on this view, we introduce ORACLE, which evaluates the native optimizer's realized step through a joint endpoint linearization of heterogeneous constraint families, constructs the resulting alignment in the optimizer's own geometry, bounds its authority, and commits it only after validation. We evaluate ORACLE across eight Partial Differential Equation benchmarks and four optimizers spanning Euclidean, diagonal adaptive, and structured preconditioned geometries, where it improves or matches native optimizer in 94% of configurations. Cross model analysis shows the same behavior in 92% of configurations, while matched comparisons show improvements over alternative constraint-handling methods acting at the objective, gradient, and post-optimizer levels.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"优化器相对约束学习"视角，并给出ORACLE方法：在优化器产生实际参数更新之后评估约束兼容性，通过异质约束族的联合端点线性化、在优化器自身几何中构造对齐、限定其权限并在验证后执行。在8个PDE基准与4类优化器上，94%配置不劣于原生优化器，跨模型92%，并优于目标层、梯度层与后优化器层的对照方法。
AI.motivation: 现有约束处理方法通常在优化器动作之前介入（修改目标函数或梯度），但动量、自适应缩放与结构化预条件会在信号变为参数更新之前显著重塑该信号，导致"优化前"的约束干预与优化器实际执行方向不一致。因此需要一个以优化器实际更新为基准的约束兼容性评估框架。
AI.method: 提出优化器相对约束学习（optimizer relative constrained learning），将约束兼容性定义在优化器更新之后。基于此构建ORACLE：对原生优化器的实际步长做异质约束族的联合端点线性化，在优化器自身几何（欧氏、对角自适应、结构化预条件）中构造对齐方向，对其权限施加界约束，并仅在验证通过后提交该更新。
AI.result: 在8个PDE基准、4种优化器（覆盖欧氏、对角自适应与结构化预条件几何）上，ORACLE在94%的配置中优于或持平原生优化器；跨模型分析中92%的配置保持同样表现；匹配对比显示其优于在目标层、梯度层和后优化器层介入的替代约束处理方法。
AI.conclusion: 约束处理应面向优化器实际执行后的更新进行评估与介入，而非仅作用于目标或梯度；ORACLE通过在优化器几何中的端点线性化对齐与验证后提交机制，在多种几何与任务上实现了对原生优化器的稳定不劣化与对现有约束方法的改进。

title: Defensive Sufficiency in a Stackelberg Model of AI Security
summary: Feedback from automated testing, human red teaming, and incident response can strengthen an AI system's defenses when discovered failures lead to effective repairs. We study when this feedback process provides sufficient protection and when investing in it is economically worthwhile. We begin by showing that an attack surface composed of finite number of inputs is defended with probability 1 if every unresolved attack has a persistent chance of discovery, repairs are effective, and subsequent updates preserve earlier protection. We derive completion-time bounds and extend the analysis to growing attack surfaces, repairs that generalize across related attacks, and multiple discovery mechanisms. These results distinguish eventual protection against each fixed attack from complete protection at a single time. We then formulate a defender-led Stackelberg game in which the defender invests in proactive discovery and reactive repair, anticipating the attacker's choice of search effort. We characterize the least-cost allocation that deters attack and the equilibrium regimes in which the defender funds neither capability, one capability, or both. Numerical experiments illustrate these regimes and show how faster repair can reduce compromise duration without reducing compromise probability.unified theory of performance limits in generative language models.

AI.tldr: 本文研究反馈驱动的AI系统防御机制：发现失败并有效修复能否提供充分保护及经济可行性。证明在持续可发现、修复有效且更新保持既往保护的条件下，有限攻击面被以概率1防御；进一步给出完成时间界，并扩展到增长攻击面、可泛化修复及多发现机制。随后建立防守方主导的Stackelberg博弈，刻画威慑攻击的最低成本配置与均衡区间，数值实验展示更快修复可缩短失陷时长但不降低失陷概率。
AI.motivation: 自动测试、人类红队与事件响应等反馈可强化AI防御，但学界尚不清楚该反馈过程何时能提供充分保护、何时值得投入。需要区分“对每个固定攻击的最终防护”与“某一时刻的完全防护”，并评估主动发现与被动修复的最优投入。
AI.method: 采用理论分析方法：对有限攻击面证明持续可发现性与有效修复下的概率1防御，推导完成时间界；扩展到增长攻击面、跨相关攻击的泛化修复和多发现机制。构建防守方主导的Stackelberg博弈，防守方投入主动发现与被动修复，预判攻击者的搜索努力，求解威慑攻击的最低成本配置及均衡区间；辅以数值实验。
AI.result: 证明在持续可发现、修复有效、更新保持既往保护的条件下，有限攻击面可被概率1防御，并给出完成时间界；在增长攻击面、泛化修复和多机制情形下同样成立。Stackelberg博弈刻画了威慑攻击的最低成本配置，以及防守方不同时投入、仅投入一种能力或两种能力均投入的均衡区间。数值实验验证这些区间，并表明更快修复可降低失陷时长而不降低失陷概率。
AI.conclusion: 反馈驱动的发现—修复循环在特定条件下可实现对攻击面的最终完全防护，且需区分“最终防护”与“单时点完全防护”。防守方的最优投入取决于攻击者搜索努力与修复/发现效率，存在多类均衡区间；提升修复速度主要缩短失陷时长而非降低失陷概率，对AI系统防御资源配置具有指导意义。

title: Adaptive Risk-Certified Event-Triggered Replanning for Dynamic Navigation
summary: Safe navigation in dynamic environments requires robots to plan under obstacle predictions whose errors are uncertain, non-stationary, and can induce rare but safety-critical failures. Existing control-barrier-function safety filters can reject immediately unsafe controls, but they provide little guidance on when the current finite-horizon planning mode itself is becoming unsafe as prediction uncertainty evolves. We propose Conformal Event-Triggered Risk-Certified Replanning (\emph{CERT-Replan}), a framework that uses calibrated barrier risk as an early-warning signal for replanning. CERT-Replan calibrates horizon-indexed obstacle-prediction residuals online and uses the resulting uncertainty radii to evaluate dynamic-obstacle safety margins. A one-step safety filter protects the next applied control, while a horizon-level risk monitor evaluates the upper-tail CVaR of predicted barrier-violation losses along the current MPC rollout. When this risk exceeds an allocated budget, CERT-Replan rejects the current planning mode and selects a lower-risk alternative, such as a different speed profile, corridor, or homotopy class, rather than repeatedly correcting the same nominal plan. In a non-stationary benchmark, CERT-Replan achieves an \(83.3\%\) collision reduction relative to the safety-filter-only baseline \textcolor{black}{and a \(77.8\%\) reduction relative to simple replanning triggers}, while reducing average safety-filter intervention by \(32.4\%\). \textcolor{black}{With Trajectron++, CERT-Replan achieves \(96\%\) collision-free operation. Hardware experiments and onboard runtime profiling demonstrate computational feasibility.}

AI.tldr: 提出 CERT-Replan 框架，用校准后的障碍风险作为早期预警信号触发重规划，在非平稳环境下显著降低碰撞并减少安全滤波干预。
AI.motivation: 动态环境中障碍预测误差具有不确定性、非平稳性，并可能引发罕见但安全攸关的失效。现有控制屏障函数安全滤波器只能拒绝即时不安全控制，无法在预测不确定性演化时判断当前有限时域规划模式本身何时变得不安全。
AI.method: 在线校准按预测时域索引的障碍预测残差，得到不确定性半径以评估动态障碍安全裕度；一步安全滤波器保护下一个施加的控制；时域级风险监控器评估当前 MPC 轨迹上预测屏障违反损失的上尾 CVaR；当风险超过分配预算时，拒绝当前规划模式并选择更低风险的替代方案（如不同速度剖面、走廊或同伦类）。
AI.result: 在非平稳基准中，相比仅安全滤波基线碰撞减少 83.3%，相比简单重规划触发减少 77.8%，平均安全滤波干预减少 32.4%；结合 Trajectron++ 实现 96% 无碰撞运行；硬件实验与机载运行时分析验证了计算可行性。
AI.conclusion: 以校准屏障风险作为早期预警并触发模式级重规划，可在保持计算可行性的同时提升动态环境导航安全性。

title: Goldsmith: Gold-Loss-Guided Definition Optimization with an Agentic Annotation Harness
comment: 20 pages, 4 figures, 11 tables. Accepted to the main conference of EMNLP 2026
summary: Many annotation projects begin before experts have a stable guideline or enough labels to train a task-specific model. We present Goldsmith, an agentic pipeline that turns a small gold set---expert-annotated calibration examples representing the intended task boundaries---into a reusable structured annotation definition. Goldsmith treats this definition as a trainable textual object. Candidate definitions are run on the same gold examples and scored with an executable structured loss, while the output schema, formatting, retrieval, repair, judging, and human review remain in an external harness. A large language model (LLM) editor converts the highest-loss failures into textual-gradient revisions, which are accepted only when the measured loss decreases. In prompt-optimization comparisons, Goldsmith improves over direct rewriting, OPRO, APE, and PromptBreeder under matched evaluation protocols. The resulting definition also improves downstream annotation when combined with retrieval, score-based routing, and human review across typed span, pair-level relation, and fixed-trigger event-argument tasks. These results show that scarce expert supervision can support both task-definition learning and scalable annotation.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 Goldsmith——一种 agentic 流水线，将少量专家标注的 gold set 转化为可复用的结构化标注定义，并将其视为可训练的文本对象，通过执行型结构化损失驱动 LLM 编辑进行迭代优化。
AI.motivation: 许多标注项目在专家尚未形成稳定标注指南、也没有足够数据训练任务专用模型时就已启动，此时缺乏可依赖的定义与可扩展的标注方案，亟需在稀缺专家监督下同时学习任务定义并支撑规模化标注。
AI.method: Goldsmith 以小型 gold set（专家标注的校准样例，界定任务边界）为输入，产出结构化标注定义，并将其作为可训练文本对象。候选定义在同一 gold 样例上执行，用执行型结构化损失打分；输出 schema、格式化、检索、修复、judging 与人工审核置于外部 harness。LLM 编辑器将高损失失败转化为文本梯度式修订，仅在测得损失下降时接受该修订。
AI.result: 在与 direct rewriting、OPRO、APE、PromptBreeder 的提示优化对比中，Goldsmith 在匹配评测协议下取得更优表现；生成的标注定义结合检索、基于分数的路由与人工审核后，在 typed span、pair-level relation 及 fixed-trigger event-argument 任务上均提升下游标注效果。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，稀缺的专家监督既能支持任务定义的学习，也能支撑可扩展的标注，说明将标注定义作为可训练文本对象并以结构化损失驱动迭代是有效路径。

title: PVSync: A Unified Lip-Sync Expert for Timing and Articulation
summary: Lip movements can match the timing of speech without matching the spoken sounds. We introduce PVSync, a unified model for audio-visual offset estimation and phoneme-level articulation scoring. PVSync combines window-level contrastive learning for synchronisation with a phoneme-level articulation objective that aligns audio and video embeddings of the same viseme class across clips. Visemes group phonemes with similar visible articulation. Viseme labels are derived automatically from forced-aligned transcripts, without manual annotations. On offset-corrected videos from 13 talking-head video generation models, PVSync matches human rankings of lip-sync quality more closely than LSE-C, achieving a Spearman correlation of 0.83 versus 0.34. On an automatically constructed benchmark from held-out speech, PVSync distinguishes viseme-matched from mismatched audio-visual pairs with an ROC AUC of 0.91. PVSync also outperforms SyncNet and MTD-VocaLiST in temporal offset recovery on held-out in-the-wild clips. Code and benchmark data will be released upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: PVSync 是一个统一模型，同时进行音视频时间偏移估计与音素级发音评分，通过窗口级对比学习和音素级发音目标实现，性能优于 LSE-C 等基线。
AI.motivation: 唇动可以在不匹配语音内容的情况下匹配语音时间，说明仅靠时间同步不足以评估唇语同步质量，需要一个能同时捕捉时间对齐和发音内容一致性的统一模型。
AI.method: PVSync 结合窗口级对比学习进行同步估计，并引入音素级发音目标，将同一 viseme 类别的音视频嵌入跨片段对齐。Viseme 标签由强制对齐转录自动导出，无需人工标注。
AI.result: 在 13 个 talking-head 生成模型的偏移校正视频上，PVSync 与人类唇语同步质量排名的 Spearman 相关为 0.83，LSE-C 仅为 0.34；在自动构建的基准上区分 viseme 匹配与不匹配音视频对的 ROC AUC 达 0.91；在时序偏移恢复上优于 SyncNet 和 MTD-VocaLiST。
AI.conclusion: PVSync 能更贴近人类对唇语同步质量的判断，并在发音一致性和时间偏移估计两个任务上均取得领先表现。

title: RippleCP: Measuring Counterfactual Checkpoint Advantage in Coding Agents
summary: Agent checkpoint systems decide what state is recovery-relevant, how to snapshot it, and whether rollback is admissible. None decides which of the safe boundaries they expose are worth materializing. We formulate this as counterfactual checkpoint advantage, the reduction in future recovery cost obtained by checkpointing a candidate rather than skipping it, and measure it by driving a CP branch and a SKIP branch to the same logical failure and recovering both under matched model, tool, verifier, and stopping conditions. On a frozen pilot of 12 SWE-bench Verified tasks and 106 real recovery branches, checkpointing saves 49.4 s per task, and that figure resolves into two regimes two orders of magnitude apart. The first checkpoint returns 100.0 s on 156.5 s of protected work, a conversion of 0.64; a second one step later returns-1.1 s on 41.8 s, a conversion of -0.03. Recovery is a re-derivation rather than a replay, so preserved work is a poor guide to saved work, and the classical elapsed-work rule misprices the second checkpoint by its full nominal cost. We identify where placement can pay, and set the bar a placement policy must clear.

AI.tldr: 本文将"哪些安全边界值得建立检查点"形式化为反事实检查点优势（CCP advantage），通过驱动CP分支与SKIP分支至同一逻辑失败并在匹配条件下恢复来度量；在12个SWE-bench Verified任务、106个真实恢复分支上，检查点每任务节省49.4秒，但收益分为相差两个数量级的两种机制。
AI.motivation: 现有Agent检查点系统只决定状态是否与恢复相关、如何快照、回滚是否可允许，却没有决定其暴露的诸多安全边界中哪些值得真正物化（建立检查点）。缺乏对检查点"值得与否"的量化判据，导致放置决策可能被高估或错价。
AI.method: 提出"反事实检查点优势"（counterfactual checkpoint advantage）：检查点某个候选相比跳过它所带来的未来恢复成本下降量。度量方式为将CP分支（建立检查点）与SKIP分支（跳过）驱动至同一逻辑失败，并在模型、工具、验证器、停止条件均匹配的条件下恢复两条分支，比较成本。
AI.result: 在12个SWE-bench Verified任务、106条真实恢复分支的固定试点上，检查点每任务节省49.4秒；该数值可分解为相差约两个数量级的两种机制：第一个检查点以156.5秒受保护工作换来100.0秒收益，转化率0.64；紧随其后一步的第二个检查点以41.8秒仅换回-1.1秒，转化率-0.03。由于恢复是重新推导而非重放，被保存的工作量是"节省工作量"的糟糕代理指标，经典"已耗时工作量"规则将第二个检查点按其全部名义成本错误定价。
AI.conclusion: 恢复本质是重新推导而非重放，因此"保住了多少工作"不能代表"省了多少工作"。研究识别了检查点放置可能获益的条件，并给出了放置策略必须跨越的门槛（the bar）。

title: Towards Financial World Modeling
summary: Building a world model requires a state representation useful for planning and decision-making---potentially over tasks unknown at training time. In the context of financial markets, planning and decision-making may require a model to reason about market-wide conditions, asset-specific expected returns, liquidity, volatility, and cross-asset relationships. Yet financial representation learning has largely been evaluated on individual predictive tasks, oftentimes on a single time period using comparatively narrow datasets. We address this through three primary contributions. First, we introduce Market-1T, a dataset containing nearly one trillion observations across U.S. equities from 2008 to 2025 at 1 Hz resolution. Second, we develop and implement a rigorous evaluation protocol. Third, we conduct a systematic large-scale study of financial representation learning, comparing 18 encoder-training strategies across nearly two decades of market regimes. We evaluate learned representations both by their predictive utility on common finance tasks and through probes of latent structure. We find that encoders with similar predictive performance can organize market state very differently. Collectively, we establish a foundation for training and evaluating financial market representations in support of world models such as DINO-WM, V-JEPA 2, and LeWM.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 Market-1T 数据集（2008-2025 年美国股票约1万亿条 1Hz 观测），构建严格评估协议，并系统对比18种编码器训练策略，发现预测性能相近的编码器在隐空间结构上差异显著。
AI.motivation: 构建世界模型需要可用于规划与决策的状态表示，且可能需泛化到训练时未知的任务。金融市场中的规划与决策要求模型能推理市场整体状态、资产预期收益、流动性、波动率及跨资产关系。然而现有金融表示学习多在单一预测任务、单一时期和较窄数据集上评估，缺乏对表示质量与泛化能力的系统考察。
AI.method: 三项主要工作：（1）构建 Market-1T 数据集，覆盖2008-2025年美国股票、1Hz 分辨率、近1万亿条观测；（2）设计并实现严格的评估协议；（3）开展大规模系统性研究，在近二十年多种市场状态下比较18种编码器训练策略，并通过常见金融任务的预测效用与隐空间结构探针两方面评估所学表示。
AI.result: 发现具有相似预测性能的编码器可能以非常不同的方式组织市场状态表示，即预测效用相近不代表隐空间结构一致。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为训练和评估金融市场表示、进而支持 DINO-WM、V-JEPA 2、LeWM 等世界模型奠定了数据、评估与实证基础。

title: Constrained-Action AI Remediation for SIEM/XDR via a NeMo-Guardrails Proxy
comment: 7 pages, 3 figures, 4 tables. Accepted at the 2026 IEEE International Conference on Cyber Security and Resilience (IEEE CSR 2026)
summary: Security Operations Centers (SOCs) for information technology and operational technology share one incident-response problem: a flood of correlated alerts and too few analysts. Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly proposed as reasoning engines that triage alerts and, in autonomous deployments, issue commands that block IPs, kill processes, or quarantine files on production hosts. This coupling introduces a new risk: a single adversarial alert can become a remote code path through the LLM's reasoning, leading it to recommend an action the SOC then executes. We present a constrained-action architecture with two coordinated layers: (i) a SIEM/XDR control plane that grounds remediation in correlated host events and confines the LLM's output to a closed intent vocabulary whose templated commands are executed by thin endpoint agents, backstopped by an argument validator; and (ii) a NeMo-Guardrails proxy that wraps the SOC-analyst LLM with input- and output-rail policies, evaluated out-of-the-box against a SOC-specific adversarial corpus we release. The stock proxy lifts injection recall from 25.0% to 94.5% at a 0.1% false-positive rate, and a live red-team exercise confirms that the closed intent vocabulary and argument validator contain the observed LLM failure modes before any command crosses the trust boundary. As an architectural fit (not yet a measured operational-technology deployment), the constrained-action property suits critical-infrastructure settings where a wrong remediation has physical, not merely operational, consequences. The loop is best run human-in-the-loop or delayed: the measured rail latency keeps inline control out of scope.

AI.tldr: 论文提出一种受限动作架构，将LLM输出约束在封闭意图词表中，并通过护栏代理与参数校验器阻止对抗性告警转化为远程代码执行路径。
AI.motivation: SOC面临告警泛滥与分析师不足的问题，LLM被用于告警分流乃至自主执行阻断IP、杀进程等操作，由此引入新风险：单条对抗性告警可能经由LLM推理变成可执行动作的代码路径。
AI.method: 采用两层协同架构：(i) SIEM/XDR控制平面将修复动作锚定于关联的主机事件，并把LLM输出限制在封闭意图词表中，由轻量端点代理执行模板化命令，并由参数校验器兜底；(ii) 基于NeMo-Guardrails的代理对SOC分析LLM施加输入与输出轨策略，并在所发布的SOC专用对抗语料上进行开箱评测。
AI.result: 现成代理在0.1%假阳性率下将注入召回率从25.0%提升至94.5%；实况红队演练证实封闭意图词表与参数校验器能在命令跨越信任边界前遏制所观察到的LLM失效模式。
AI.conclusion: 受限动作特性契合后果具物理性的关键基础设施场景；该环路宜以人在环路或延迟方式运行，实测护栏时延使在线实时控制暂不在适用范围。

title: Predicted Futures Are Not Enough: Learning Executable Goals for Robot Manipulation
comment: 9 pages, 8 figures, 4 tables. Project page: https://claire0730.github.io/executable-goals/ Code and models: https://github.com/Claire0730/executable-goals
summary: Generative world models provide rich predictions of how manipulation scenes may evolve toward task objectives, yet those futures do not directly expose the compact task variables required by control. When training supervises future prediction alone, terminal goal accuracy is not an explicit learning objective, even when geometric recovery is available. We present Entity-Level Goal Readout, a learned prediction-to-execution interface that makes the executable terminal goal an explicit output of a 3D trace world model. It combines object-centric pose prediction with translation grounded in observed depth to produce a compact goal in SE(3). A shared Pose-Native Executor consumes this fixed goal with online object-pose feedback for closed-loop control without rerunning the world model. Across five manipulation tasks, the pipeline achieves a mean success rate of 79.69%. Goal diagnostics directly measure terminal goal accuracy, while controlled translation perturbations characterize how execution degrades under goal error. Zero-shot deployment on a Franka arm achieves 73.33% success on nominal StackCube, 66.67% with distractors, and 75.00% on PickPlate with a target unseen during policy training. These results support treating the prediction-to-execution interface as an explicit learned component of world-model planning rather than incidental post-processing in the control pipeline itself. Project page: https://claire0730.github.io/executable-goals/

AI.tldr: 提出"实体级目标读出"(Entity-Level Goal Readout)接口，将3D轨迹世界模型的预测转化为SE(3)空间中的紧凑可执行终端目标，配合位姿原生执行器实现闭环控制，在五项操作任务上平均成功率达79.69%，Franka真机零样本部署成功率73.33%。
AI.motivation: 生成式世界模型能预测操作场景如何向任务目标演化，但这些未来预测并不直接暴露控制所需的紧凑任务变量；仅以未来预测为监督时，终端目标精度并非显式学习目标，即便具备几何恢复能力也无法保证可执行的目标输出，因此需要将"预测到执行"的接口作为显式学习组件。
AI.method: 提出Entity-Level Goal Readout：结合以物体为中心的位姿预测与基于观测深度的平移估计，输出SE(3)空间中的紧凑目标；由共享的Pose-Native Executor消费该固定目标，利用在线物体位姿反馈进行闭环控制，且无需重跑世界模型。
AI.result: 五项操作任务平均成功率79.69%；目标诊断直接度量终端目标精度，受控平移扰动刻画了目标误差下执行性能的退化规律；Franka机械臂零样本部署在标称StackCube上达73.33%，含干扰物时66.67%，PickPlate（目标未在策略训练中出现）达75.00%。
AI.conclusion: 应将"预测到执行"接口视为世界模型规划中显式的可学习组件，而非控制流水线中附带的后期处理。

title: A Comparative Study of Evaluation Metrics for Long-Document Financial Narrative Summarization with Transformers
summary: There are more than 2,000 listed companies on the UK's London Stock Exchange, divided into 11 sectors who are required to communicate their financial results at least twice in a single financial year. UK annual reports are very lengthy documents with around 80 pages on average. In this study, we aim to benchmark a variety of summarisation methods on a set of different pre-trained transformers with different extraction techniques. In addition, we considered multiple evaluation metrics in order to investigate their differing behaviour and applicability on a dataset from the Financial Narrative Summarisation (FNS 2020) shared task, which is composed of annual reports published by firms listed on the London Stock Exchange and their corresponding summaries. We hypothesise that some evaluation metrics do not reflect true summarisation ability and propose a novel BRUGEscore metric, as the harmonic mean of ROUGE-2 and BERTscore. Finally, we perform a statistical significance test on our results to verify whether they are statistically robust, alongside an adversarial analysis task with three different corruption methods.

AI.tldr: 本文针对英国伦敦证券交易所上市公司年报，基于 FNS 2020 数据集对多种预训练 Transformer 与抽取技术组合的摘要方法进行基准评测，并考察多种评价指标的行为差异，提出融合 ROUGE-2 与 BERTScore 的 BRUGE 指标，最后通过显著性检验与对抗分析验证结论的稳健性。
AI.motivation: 英国上市公司需每年至少两次披露财务结果，而年报平均约 80 页、篇幅冗长，人工阅读成本高；同时现有摘要评价指标可能无法真实反映摘要能力，因此需要在金融叙事摘要任务上系统比较不同摘要方法与评价指标。
AI.method: 在 FNS 2020 共享任务的年报数据集上，对多种预训练 Transformer 模型与不同抽取技术进行组合，构建多组摘要方法并开展基准评测；同时引入多种评价指标进行比较分析，并提出 BRUGE 指标，其定义为 ROUGE-2 与 BERTScore 的调和平均；此外采用三种不同的破坏（corruption）方法开展对抗分析，并对结果进行统计显著性检验。
AI.result: 研究揭示了不同评价指标在衡量摘要质量时存在行为差异，表明部分指标不能反映真实摘要能力；所提出的 BRUGE 指标提供了结合词面重叠与语义相似度的综合评价方式；统计显著性检验与对抗分析进一步验证了实验结果的统计稳健性与方法的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为金融叙事摘要任务提供了系统的基准评测框架与指标分析，指出单一评价指标的局限性，并提出的 BRUGE 指标及对抗分析流程有助于更可靠地评估摘要系统。

title: Pooling Representation Autoencoders for Efficient Diffusion
summary: Representation Autoencoders (RAEs) generate images from pre-trained visual fea- tures, but their dense token grids make generative modeling expensive. Motivated by local feature correlations, we introduce PoolDINO, a learned affine pooling operator that merges neighboring tokens. Training the pooling operator jointly with the RGB decoder preserves the standard two-stage RAE procedure without a separate feature auto-encoder. On ImageNet-256, 4x token compression retains comparable generation quality under internal guidance, while 16x compression trades some quality for greater efficiency. At a fixed budget of 100 sampling steps, latent-sampling throughput increases by 3.7x and 9.0x, respectively, relative to the unpooled baseline. Classification and dense prediction evaluations show that comparable guided generation quality can coexist with weaker performance on other tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出 PoolDINO——一种可学习仿射池化算子，通过合并相邻 token 压缩 RAE 的密集 token 网格，在保持两阶段流程的前提下显著提升采样效率。
AI.motivation: RAE 从预训练视觉特征生成图像，但其密集 token 网格导致生成建模代价高昂；受局部特征相关性启发，希望在不引入独立特征自编码器的前提下降低 token 数量。
AI.method: PoolDINO 为可学习仿射池化算子，合并相邻 token，并与 RGB 解码器联合训练；该方法保持标准两阶段 RAE 流程，无需单独的特征自编码器。在 ImageNet-256 上测试 4x 与 16x token 压缩。
AI.result: 4x 压缩在内部引导下生成质量相当，16x 压缩以部分质量换取更高效率；固定 100 步采样时，潜变量采样吞吐相对未池化基线分别提升 3.7x 与 9.0x。分类与密集预测评估显示，相当的引导生成质量可能与其他任务性能下降共存。
AI.conclusion: PoolDINO 通过可学习池化有效压缩 RAE 的 token 网格，在保持生成质量的同时大幅提升采样效率，但需权衡其他下游任务的性能。

title: Constraint Tree Exploration for Learning from Language Feedback
summary: Natural-language feedback in interactive learning often explains why an action failed by pointing to violated requirements. Misinterpreting this feedback can lead an agent to rule out valid solutions. We study this setting by modeling user intent as latent constraints over an action space and formulating learning from language feedback as pure exploration over feasible regions. We introduce TRACE, an algorithm that organizes candidate constraints in a tree and tests each proposed refinement by generating actions that satisfy it. TRACE commits to the refinement only if the resulting feedback does not contradict it over repeated tests. We distinguish two ways of using the same feedback: (i) falsification, which detects contradictions to the constraint set currently being tested, and (ii) identification, which may additionally name a violated constraint. We prove high-probability coverage bounds with dependence on the candidate class size $H$ for TRACE-Falsification. With reliable identification, TRACE-Identification can replace this dependence by $K/p_{\mathrm{ext}}$, where $K$ is the number of latent constraints and $p_{\mathrm{ext}}$ lower-bounds the probability of extracting a missing true constraint from informative feedback. We evaluate TRACE across six language-feedback tasks. On RecMovie, TRACE-Identification achieves 73% and 86% final-output success under caps of 20 and 60 evaluated outputs, compared with at most 42% and 48% for the evaluated prompting baselines given the same feedback and output caps. Controlled identity-corruption experiments further show greater robustness than direct accumulation when the falsification detector remains reliable.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究从自然语言反馈中学习的问题，将其建模为对动作空间潜在约束的纯探索，并提出 TRACE 算法，通过树结构组织候选约束、生成满足约束的动作并依据反馈决定是否提交细化，区分"证伪"与"识别"两种反馈用法，并给出覆盖界与多任务实验验证。
AI.motivation: 交互学习中的自然语言反馈常通过指出被违反的需求来解释动作失败的原因。若智能体误读这类反馈，就可能错误地排除有效解。因此需要一种能稳健地从语言反馈中推断用户潜在意图（约束）的方法。
AI.method: 将用户意图建模为动作空间上的潜在约束，把从语言反馈学习形式化为对可行域的纯探索问题。提出 TRACE：用树结构组织候选约束，对每个候选细化生成满足它的动作进行测试，仅当重复测试所得反馈不与细化矛盾时才提交该细化。区分同一反馈的两种用法：(i) 证伪，检测与当前测试约束集的矛盾；(ii) 识别，可进一步指出被违反的具体约束。对应给出 TRACE-Falsification 与 TRACE-Identification 两种算法。
AI.result: 证明 TRACE-Falsification 具有依赖候选类规模 H 的高概率覆盖界；在可靠识别条件下，TRACE-Identification 可将该依赖替换为 K/p_ext（K 为潜在约束数，p_ext 为从信息性反馈中抽取缺失真实约束概率的下界）。在六个语言反馈任务上评估：RecMovie 中，在 20 与 60 个评估输出上限下，TRACE-Identification 最终输出成功率达 73% 与 86%，而相同反馈与输出上限下所评估的提示基线至多为 42% 与 48%。受控的标识破坏实验进一步表明，当证伪检测器保持可靠时，其鲁棒性优于直接累加方法。
AI.conclusion: TRACE 通过树式约束组织与基于反馈矛盾的提交机制，有效缓解了对自然语言反馈的误读，并在理论上给出覆盖保证、在多个语言反馈任务上显著优于提示基线，且在标识破坏条件下表现出更强鲁棒性。

title: A Self-Pruning Transformer: Extreme KV-Cache Compression with Universal Attention
summary: The large KV-cache size of modern LLMs creates a barrier to efficient deployment. Recent work has explored replacing attention layers' RoPE positional embeddings with alternative decay-based mechanisms, which can then be used to prune KV-cache during inference. However, these decay functions have limited expressivity, and in practice devolve into sliding-window-like eviction patterns. In this work, we propose a unifying framework for complementary and novel decay mechanisms, capturing complex key statistics and interactions while preserving expressive RoPE embeddings and Softmax attention. The resulting Universal Attention is a highly expressive and end-to-end trainable architecture, whose composite decay mechanism acts as a natural, $\textit{adaptive}$ pruning criterion, removing tokens that contribute least to attention computation. Experimentally, Universal Attention achieves state-of-the-art $10\times$ compression on natural language and synthetic task data, while $\textit{improving}$ downstream performance compared to both state-of-the-art baselines and unpruned oracles. It further demonstrates superior long-context generalization with unprecedented $25\times$ compression at length 16k.

AI.tldr: 提出Universal Attention统一框架，用复合衰减机制替代RoPE，实现自适应KV-cache剪枝，在自然语言与合成任务上达10×压缩并提升性能，长文本16k下达25×压缩。
AI.motivation: 现代大语言模型的KV-cache规模过大，阻碍了高效部署。现有基于衰减机制替代RoPE的方法表达能力有限，实际退化为类似滑动窗口的驱逐模式，缺乏对复杂键统计与交互的建模能力。
AI.method: 提出一个统一的衰减机制框架，融合互补且新颖的衰减函数，在保留富有表达力的RoPE位置嵌入与Softmax注意力的同时，捕捉复杂的键统计与键间交互。该框架构成Universal Attention——一个高表达力、端到端可训练的结构，其复合衰减机制充当自然的自适应剪枝准则，剔除对注意力计算贡献最小的token。
AI.result: 在自然语言与合成任务数据上实现当前最优的10×压缩，且下游性能优于最优基线及未剪枝的oracle；在长上下文泛化上表现更优，长度16k时达到前所未有的25×压缩。
AI.conclusion: 通过统一并拓展衰减机制的表达能力，可在保留RoPE与Softmax注意力的同时实现自适应KV-cache剪枝，在压缩率与性能上同时超越现有方法与未剪枝baseline。

title: CYBERFORT: A Compliance-Chain Platform Operationalising the Cyber Resilience Act for SMEs
comment: 7 pages, 3 figures, 2 tables. Accepted at the 2026 IEEE International Conference on Cyber Security and Resilience (IEEE CSR 2026)
summary: The EU Cyber Resilience Act (CRA) turns product cybersecurity into a lifecycle compliance obligation for manufacturers, importers, distributors, and integrators of products with digital elements on the EU market, a load that falls largely on small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) that rarely have dedicated governance, risk, and compliance (GRC) capacity. We present CYBERFORT, an open-source CRA-first compliance platform developed under the EU Digital Europe Programme and one of twelve projects in the EU CRA cluster. CYBERFORT operationalises the CRA through a guided scope self-assessment, a question bank tied to Annex I and the vulnerability-handling obligations, and a compliance-checking engine that links every answer to controls, policies, and machine-attested evidence, reusing ISO/IEC 27001, NIS2, and GDPR controls only where they coincide with CRA obligations. Its central contribution is the compliance chain, a traceable structure linking each product risk through its controls and policies to the CRA obligations it satisfies, and onward through evidence to the technical-documentation file and EU declaration of conformity, so that every operational gap is traceable and can be closed before market placement. Deployed at https://access.cyber-fort.eu/ for a first cohort of 43 organisations, the platform is presented with the engineering behind the chain, measured results from a completed end-to-end case study on a SIEM/XDR product with AI-driven remediation spanning the CRA obligation chapters, and the controlled effort study that remains in progress.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍CYBERFORT——一个面向欧盟《网络弹性法案》(CRA)的开源合规平台，其核心是"合规链"结构，将产品风险、控制措施、政策、证据与CRA义务及技术文档、EU符合性声明逐层关联，帮助缺乏GRC能力的SME实现CRA全生命周期合规。
AI.motivation: CRA将产品网络安全转变为面向制造商、进口商、分销商和集成商的全生命周期合规义务，但这一负担主要落在极少具备专门GRC（治理、风险与合规）能力的中小企业(SME)身上，亟需可操作、可追溯的合规工具。
AI.method: 提出开源、CRA优先的合规平台CYBERFORT（属EU Digital Europe Programme，为EU CRA cluster十二个项目之一）。平台通过引导式范围自评估、绑定附件I及漏洞处理义务的题库、以及合规检查引擎来实现CRA要求：将每个答案关联到控制措施、政策与机器可验证证据，仅在ISO/IEC 27001、NIS2、GDPR控制与CRA义务重合处复用这些框架。核心方法为"合规链"——将每个产品风险经由控制与政策追溯到其满足的CRA义务，再经由证据延伸至技术文档档案和EU符合性声明，使每个操作缺口可追溯并在上市前关闭。
AI.result: 平台已部署于 https://access.cyber-fort.eu/ ，服务首批43家组织的队列；论文给出合规链背后的工程实现，以及针对一个SIEM/XDR产品（具备AI驱动修复功能、覆盖CRA各义务章节）的完整端到端案例研究中测得的结果。
AI.conclusion: CYBERFORT通过可追溯的合规链机制，将CRA义务映射到可执行的控制、政策与证据，帮助SME在上市前识别并闭合合规缺口；端到端案例已验证其可行性，而受控工作量(effort)研究仍在进行中。

title: ClimbLab: MATLAB Simulation Platform for Legged Climbing Robotics
comment: Author's version of a manuscript in the proceedings of CLAWAR 2021. The final published version is available at: https://doi.org/10.1007/978-3-030-86294-7_20
summary: This paper presents an open-sourced MATLAB simulation and analysis platform dedicated to legged climbing robots. This simulator enables the design of any limbed robotic system as an articulated multi-body with a floating base and simulates it walking and climbing in an arbitrary environment. The main variable environmental parameters are inclination, gravity, and ground stiffness, and any point cloud can be installed as the terrain map. Furthermore, the simulator employs a rigid body dynamics engine. This paper first describes the simulator structure, and the computational flow and next presents the representative simulation examples where quadrupedal robots assumed gripping on the wall or climbing on the steep slope.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了一个开源的MATLAB仿真与分析平台，用于腿式攀爬机器人的建模与仿真。
AI.motivation: 为腿式攀爬机器人研究提供一个可自定义机体结构与环境条件、支持任意地形与可变物理参数的仿真分析工具。
AI.method: 基于刚体动力学引擎，将任意肢体机器人系统建模为带浮动基座的铰接多体系统；主要可变环境参数包括倾角、重力与地面刚度，并支持将任意点云作为地形地图安装。
AI.result: 论文描述了仿真器的整体结构、计算流程，并给出了代表性仿真示例：四足机器人抓附墙面以及攀爬陡坡。
AI.conclusion: 该开源MATLAB平台能够支持腿式攀爬机器人在任意环境下的行走与攀爬仿真，为相关机器人设计与分析提供便利。

title: RELATE: An Evaluation Framework for measuring Relational Orientation of Large Language Models
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for emotional support, raising concern that sustained use may draw users away from their real-world relationships. Yet existing evaluations primarily focus on the safety, empathy, or helpfulness of responses, leaving under-examined a relational question: where does the model orient the user for continued support? To address this question, we introduce relational orientation, a property operationalized through two non-exclusive dimensions: inward-facing (IF) language, which positions the AI as the user's ongoing source of support, and outward-scaffolding (OS) language, which encourages real-world human connection. Grounded in psychological and sociological literature, we formalize a taxonomy of relational orientation and present RELATE, a persona-conditioned framework for measuring inward-facing and outward-scaffolding language at the sentence level in multi-turn dialogues. RELATE pairs 76 help-seeking situations adapted from naturally occurring questions with three simulated user styles, providing 228 evaluation stimuli. In our experiments, we evaluate seven LLMs using dialogues with six assistant turns each, yielding 1,596 dialogues and 69,194 assistant sentences. We assess these sentences using a primary rubric-based LLM judge and apply a secondary judge to a subset. Under automated evaluation, we find that the proportion of sentences labeled as IF is higher at the sixth assistant turn than at the first, while the proportion labeled as OS is substantially lower for hesitant, indirect simulated users than for explicit, reassurance-seeking users. RELATE provides a reproducible framework and a sentence-level signal for auditing and steering the relational orientation of supportive LLMs.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"关系导向"（relational orientation）概念，用内向型（IF）与向外搭建（OS）两个维度衡量LLM情感支持中引导用户依赖AI还是回归现实人际连接，并发布RELATE框架及配套数据集与评测结果。
AI.motivation: LLM日益被用于情感支持，人们担忧长期使用会使用户疏离现实人际关系。现有评测多聚焦回答的安全性、共情或有用性，忽视了一个关系性问题：模型把用户导向何处以获取持续支持。为弥补这一空白，作者提出"关系导向"这一属性。
AI.method: 基于心理学与社会学文献，形式化"关系导向"的分类体系，定义两个非互斥维度：内向型（IF）语言将AI定位为用户持续支持的来源；向外搭建（OS）语言鼓励现实世界的人际连接。提出RELATE——一个以人格/用户风格为条件的框架，在多轮对话中按句子级别测量IF与OS语言。RELATE将76个求助情境与三种模拟用户风格配对，构成228个评测刺激。实验评估7个LLM，每段对话含6个助手轮次，共1,596段对话、69,194个助手句子；以基于评分量表的主LLM评判器评估，并对子集使用次评判器。
AI.result: 自动评估显示：第6个助手轮次中被标注为IF的句子比例高于第1轮；而对犹豫、间接风格的模拟用户，被标注为OS的句子比例显著低于明确、寻求安慰型用户。
AI.conclusion: RELATE提供了一个可复现的框架和句子级信号，用于审计与引导支持型LLM的关系导向。

title: Adaptive Visual Token Reduction for Accelerated Image Understanding
summary: Large Vision-Language Models achieve strong VQA performance, but processing high-resolution, information-rich images requires substantial computation, motivating visual token reduction. However, existing methods often prune individual tokens or rely on fixed-size cropping, limiting their ability to preserve spatially structured information such as horizontally or vertically elongated text. To address this limitation, we propose ReFIT, an instruction-guided visual token reduction framework for efficient LVLM inference. ReFIT consists of Relevance-Guided Window Reshaping (RWR) and Instruction-Guided Token Refinement (ITR), where RWR captures instruction-relevant regions by adapting to their spatial characteristics, while ITR further removes unnecessary visual tokens. Experiments on four VQA benchmarks demonstrate that ReFIT improves answer accuracy while reducing computational cost, and qualitative results demonstrate its effectiveness in localizing relevant regions and removing unnecessary visual information.

AI.tldr: ReFIT：一种指令引导的视觉token缩减框架，通过相关性引导窗口重塑与指令引导token精炼，在降低计算量的同时提升VQA准确率。
AI.motivation: LVLM在处理高分辨率、信息密集图像时计算开销大，需要视觉token缩减；但现有方法多为单token剪枝或固定尺寸裁剪，难以保留空间结构化信息（如水平或垂直延展的文本）。
AI.method: 提出ReFIT框架，包含两部分：Relevance-Guided Window Reshaping (RWR)，通过适配指令相关区域的空间特性来捕获相关区域；Instruction-Guided Token Refinement (ITR)，进一步去除不必要的视觉token。
AI.result: 在四个VQA基准上，ReFIT在降低计算成本的同时提升了答案准确率；定性结果显示出其在定位相关区域与去除冗余视觉信息方面的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 通过指令引导的窗口重塑与token精炼，ReFIT克服了固定裁剪与单token剪枝的局限，实现了高效且更准确的LVLM推理。

title: GeoNatureAgent (GNA): A Framework and Benchmark for Pre-Production Evaluation of Tool-Using Agents on Geospatial and Environmental Tasks
comment: 10 pages, 4 figures. Extended version of arXiv:2606.12821 (ACM SIGSPATIAL 2026 poster paper). Published at GeoIndustry '26 (ACM SIGSPATIAL Workshop)
summary: Before tool-using LLM agents are deployed in environmental and geospatial workflows, teams need evidence that an agent reliably selects the right operations against real APIs. We introduce GeoNatureAgent (GNA), a framework for pre-production evaluation of tool-using agents: a fixed sixteen-tool geospatial interface published as a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server, so the agent under test is the only variable, scored against an identical tool layer, task suite, and deterministic scorer. Its flagship instance is a 103-task benchmark (a 93-task main suite across 18 categories plus a ten-task comparison expansion) evaluated against an open, self-hostable geospatial API serving three environmental indicators across Spain and Portugal. We evaluate nine LLMs under three temperature-1.0 seeds, reporting capability and per-case cost as orthogonal axes. (1) Claude Sonnet 4 achieves the highest capability (61.7% +/- 0.7% on all 103 tasks; 60.8% on the main suite), followed closely by DeepSeek V3.2 (57.9%), while no other model exceeds 53%; (2) the cost-accuracy Pareto frontier is mostly open-weight, with DeepSeek V3.2 offering 93% of Claude's capability at 11.3x lower list-price cost; (3) under strict all-checks scoring the best model sits 24-36 points below the 85-97% reported on general-purpose GIS benchmarks, whereas per-check partial credit for the top four models (86-90%) is comparable, so much of that gap reflects scoring strictness rather than task difficulty alone. The MCP server, evaluation harness, benchmark, and API are publicly available; swapping the tool executors and task suite instantiates an equivalent benchmark for any geospatial domain.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 GeoNatureAgent（GNA），一个面向工具使用型 LLM 智能体的预生产评估框架，包含固定的 16 工具地理空间 MCP 接口与 103 任务基准，对 9 个 LLM 在多温度种子下评估能力与成本。
AI.motivation: 在环境与地理空间工作流中部署工具使用型 LLM 智能体前，需要证据表明智能体能针对真实 API 可靠选择正确操作；现有评估缺乏统一工具层与确定性评分，难以隔离模型本身能力。
AI.method: 构建固定 16 工具的 MCP 服务器作为唯一工具层，使被测智能体成为唯一变量；旗舰实例为 103 任务基准（93 任务主套件，覆盖 18 类，加 10 任务对比扩展），针对开放可自托管、服务西班牙和葡萄牙三种环境指标的地理空间 API；评估 9 个 LLM，3 个温度 1.0 种子，将能力与单例成本作为正交轴报告。
AI.result: Claude Sonnet 4 能力最高（103 任务 61.7%±0.7%，主套件 60.8%），DeepSeek V3.2 紧随（57.9%），其他模型均未超 53%；成本-准确率帕累托前沿多为开放权重模型，DeepSeek V3.2 以约 11.3 倍更低标价成本达到 Claude 93% 能力；严格全检评分下最佳模型比通用 GIS 基准低 24-36 分，但前四模型按检查项部分得分（86-90%）相当，说明差距多源于评分严格性而非任务难度。
AI.conclusion: MCP 服务器、评估框架、基准与 API 均已公开；替换工具执行器与任务套件即可为任意地理空间领域实例化等效基准，为工具使用型智能体提供可复现的预生产评估范式。

title: BeatFlow-ECG: Rectified Flow for ECG Reconstruction from Indirect Wearable Signals
summary: Continuous cardiac monitoring outside clinical settings requires signals that are both informative and practical to collect during daily life. Electrocardiography (ECG) provides rich information about cardiac rhythm and waveform morphology, while wearable photoplethysmography (PPG) is easier to acquire continuously but is only an indirect cardiovascular measurement and is highly sensitive to motion. We present BeatFlow-ECG, a conditional rectified-flow model for reconstructing single-channel ECG from synchronized PPG and inertial measurements. BeatFlow-ECG models reconstruction as conditional transport from noise to ECG using a convolutional encoder-decoder with a transformer bottleneck and explicit flow-time conditioning. Motion information is incorporated through IMU-derived conditioning features, motion-dependent loss weighting, and an easy-to-hard training curriculum. We evaluate the model under leave-one-subject-out protocols on PPG-DaLiA and WESAD. BeatFlow-ECG achieves the best results among the evaluated deterministic, adversarial, and diffusion-based baselines across all reported waveform and beat-timing metrics, with Pearson correlations of 0.983 and 0.986 and R-peak F1 scores of 0.946 and 0.955, respectively. Compared with Conditional DDPM-1D, L1 error decreases from 0.085 to 0.062 on PPG-DaLiA and from 0.074 to 0.055 on WESAD. Additional analyses on PPG-DaLiA show higher correlation in fixed R-peak-relative waveform regions and lower reconstruction error across low-, medium-, and high-motion subsets.

AI.tldr: 提出BeatFlow-ECG，一种条件整流流模型，用同步PPG与IMU信号重建单通道ECG，在两个数据集上优于确定性、对抗与扩散基线。
AI.motivation: 临床外连续心脏监测需要既有信息量又便于日常采集的信号。ECG信息丰富但连续采集不便，PPG易于可穿戴连续获取却只是间接测量且对运动高度敏感，因此需要从PPG（辅以运动信息）重建ECG。
AI.method: 将重建建模为从噪声到ECG的条件传输，采用带Transformer瓶颈的卷积编码器-解码器并显式引入流时间条件；通过IMU导出的条件特征、运动相关损失加权和由易到难的训练课程融入运动信息；在PPG-DaLiA与WESAD上采用留一受试者交叉验证评估。
AI.result: 在所有报告的波形与心搏时序指标上优于确定性、对抗和扩散基线：两数据集Pearson相关系数分别为0.983和0.986，R峰F1分别为0.946和0.955；相较Conditional DDPM-1D，L1误差从0.085降至0.062（PPG-DaLiA）、从0.074降至0.055（WESAD）。在PPG-DaLiA上，固定R峰相对波形区域相关性更高，低、中、高运动子集重建误差均更低。
AI.conclusion: BeatFlow-ECG通过条件整流流与运动感知建模，有效从PPG和惯性信号重建高质量单通道ECG，在波形形态与心搏时序上均达到最优，且在不同运动强度下表现稳健。

title: Sensitive-Topic Leakage Through LLM Routing Metadata: Measurement and Mitigation
summary: LLM routers pick a cheap or expensive model per request by its content, and many gateways and some cloud platforms can log that choice with content logging off. We measure this privacy channel beyond token counts, accounting for noisy labels and repeated prompts. We run pre-registered studies on 1.7 million real requests (WildChat-1M, LMSYS-Chat-1M) with two cost/quality routers and a domain router, survey eleven systems' logging, and test post-processing defenses. At matched length, the shift's direction depends on category and router. For RouteLLM at the 50% operating point, harassment and self-harm requests reach the strong model 19 points less often than comparable ones on prompts unseen in exploration, medical requests (exploratory: LLM labels failed their gate) 31 points less often on distinct prompts (both post hoc), and sexual requests 10 points more often (secondary); the other router's four are negative. Twenty RouteLLM decisions separate frequent medical askers with AUC 0.71, exploratory and below the pre-registered primary endpoint's 0.75 (domain router: 0.92, an upper estimate). Per-category length-matched parity with accurate labels removes the gap on real traffic, costing at most 0.2 accuracy points on RouterBench (post hoc), where routers' gaps on sensitive subjects (13-42 points, pre-registered) exceed those of an oracle routing by realized accuracy gain (1-11, post hoc). Per-conversation stickiness, per-user budget bands, and pooled parity fail, the last as categories' shifts differ in size or sign. A post hoc exact per-user rate hides only even-prefix strong counts and forfeits most self-assessed routing value; it preserves odd-position decisions, from which a post hoc log attack reaches AUC 0.73 after 20 RouteLLM requests (exploratory).

AI.tldr: 该论文研究LLM路由器的"决策泄漏"隐私通道：路由器的强弱模型选择可被日志记录反推用户敏感属性，即使关闭内容日志。基于170万真实请求、两个成本/质量路由器与一个域路由器，发现长度匹配后敏感类别（骚扰、自残、医疗、性）的路由偏移方向依类别与路由器而异，20条RouteLLM决策即可将频繁医疗提问者分类（AUC 0.71）；逐类长度匹配的等价处理可消除该差距，代价极小；会话粘性、用户预算分带与池化等价均失效，且后处理防御无法完全隐藏奇位决策。
AI.motivation: LLM路由器按请求内容在廉价与昂贵模型间选择，许多网关与部分云平台会记录该选择即使关闭内容日志，这构成一条独立于token计数、以往未被测量的隐私侧信道。作者旨在系统量化该通道是否泄漏请求的敏感类别信息，并检验现有与可设计的防御措施。
AI.method: 在170万真实请求（WildChat-1M、LMSYS-Chat-1M）上开展预注册研究，使用两个成本/质量路由器与一个域路由器；调研11个系统的日志实践；进行长度匹配的类别公平性分析；测试后处理防御（精确逐用户速率）；并在RouterBench上评估等价处理对准确率的影响及与oracle路由的对比。
AI.result: 在匹配长度下，路由偏移的方向依类别与路由器而异：RouteLLM在50%工作点时，骚扰与自残请求命中强模型的比例低19个百分点，医疗请求低31个百分点（事后），性相关请求高10个百分点（次要分析）；另一路由器四项均为负。20条RouteLLM决策即可区分频繁医疗提问者，AUC 0.71；域路由器AUC 0.92（上界估计）。逐类长度匹配的等价处理在真实流量上消除差距，在RouterBench上最多损失0.2个准确率点；而路由器在敏感主题上的差距（13–42点，预注册）大于按实际准确率增益的oracle路由（1–11，事后）。会话粘性、逐用户预算分带与池化等价均失败。事后精确逐用户速率仅隐藏偶数前缀强模型计数，牺牲大部分自评路由价值，却保留奇位决策，攻击者据此在20次RouteLLM请求后达AUC 0.73。
AI.conclusion: LLM路由器的选择日志构成可被利用的隐私通道，能推断用户敏感类别，且现有简单防御（会话粘性、预算分带、池化等价、精确逐用户速率）均不足以消除泄漏；逐类长度匹配的等价处理可在几乎不损准确率的前提下消除真实流量上的差距，但奇位决策等残余信号仍可支撑有效攻击，需在日志与路由设计层面综合防护。

title: MCFR: A Mask-Guided Coarse-to-Fine Regression Framework for Robust Multi-Variant Board-to-Board Connector Assembly
comment: 8 pages, 7 figures, 1 table. Accepted for presentation at the 2026 IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS 2026). Finalist for the IROS Best Paper Award for Industrial Robotics Research for Applications
summary: Automated insertion of board-to-board (BTB) connectors in 3C manufacturing requires both high visual accuracy and strong deployment robustness. This problem remains challenging because multi-variant connectors exhibit significant morphological and appearance variations, making stable cross-variant generalization difficult, while the mismatch between training and deployment under fixed-view inspection settings induces background spurious correlation and degrades real-world performance. To address these issues, this paper proposes MCFR, a Mask-Guided Coarse-to-Fine Regression framework for multi-variant BTB connector assembly. By introducing an object-aware mask prior and explicit photometric refinement, the proposed method suppresses background interference and improves alignment accuracy and robustness in practical deployment. Experiments on a self-constructed multi-variant dataset, a BTB batch insertion testbed, and a real smartphone assembly task show that MCFR consistently outperforms representative baselines and achieves an average real-world insertion success rate of 99.25%. These results demonstrate the effectiveness and practical potential of MCFR for automated assembly of multi-variant BTB connectors.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MCFR框架，通过掩码引导的由粗到精回归实现多型号板对板连接器的自动化插装，真实场景平均插装成功率达99.25%。
AI.motivation: 3C制造中板对板（BTB）连接器自动化插装需兼顾高视觉精度与部署鲁棒性。难点在于：多型号连接器在形态与外观上差异显著，跨型号泛化困难；固定视角检测下训练与部署环境不一致，导致背景伪相关，削弱实际性能。
AI.method: 提出MCFR（Mask-Guided Coarse-to-Fine Regression，掩码引导的由粗到精回归）框架：引入目标感知的掩码先验，并进行显式的光度细化，以抑制背景干扰、提升对齐精度与部署鲁棒性。
AI.result: 在自构建的多型号数据集、BTB批量插装试验台及真实智能手机装配任务上，MCFR均稳定优于代表性基线方法，真实场景平均插装成功率达99.25%。
AI.conclusion: 结果验证了MCFR在多型号BTB连接器自动化装配中的有效性与实际应用潜力。

title: How Do LLMs Change Predictions Under Negation?
summary: Negation is an essential feature of human language, yet large language models (LLMs) remain unreliable in processing it. We evaluate recent open-source and closed-source LLMs on our negation benchmark and find that, in 37-71% of cases, they repeat the same answer under negation (e.g., "Madrid" for "What is not the capital of Spain?"). To understand and address this brittleness, we mechanistically examine how models operate under negation. Our main finding is that specialized attention heads and MLP neurons jointly implement negation by (1) suppressing retrieval of the original answer (e.g., "Madrid") while (2) promoting a favored candidate within the answer category (e.g., "Paris"). This contrasts with accounts of human negation processing, in which information about the original answer helps to determine what should be excluded. Furthermore, we find that this difference from human processing is a key source of negation failures: the model's mechanism relies on suppressing the original answer rather than using it to determine what to exclude, so the model can repeat the original answer when suppression is too weak or when a bias toward particular answers prevents it from selecting an alternative. To address this weakness in the model's negation mechanism, we propose a training objective that requires larger shifts in answer preference for more confident original predictions, and show that it reduces negation failures with less degradation of general capabilities than standard fine-tuning baselines. Together, our results demonstrate how mechanistic analysis can reveal why a linguistic capability fails and guide training that targets the underlying limitation.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过机制可解释性分析揭示大语言模型否定处理失败的根源，并提出针对性训练目标加以改善。
AI.motivation: 否定是人类语言的核心特征，但大语言模型在否定处理上仍不可靠。作者评估发现，在否定基准测试中，模型在37%–71%的情况下会对否定问题重复原答案（如对"什么不是西班牙首都"回答"马德里"），需要理解并解决这一脆弱性。
AI.method: 机制性地考察模型在否定下的运作方式，识别出专门负责否定的注意力头与MLP神经元；并提出一种训练目标，要求对模型原始预测置信度越高，答案偏好的转移幅度越大。
AI.result: 发现特定注意力头与MLP神经元联合实现否定：一方面抑制原答案（如"马德里"）的检索，另一方面提升答案类别中的偏好候选（如"巴黎"）。这与人类否定处理机制不同——人类会利用原答案信息来确定应排除什么。该差异正是否定失败的关键来源：当抑制过弱或存在答案偏置时，模型会重复原答案。所提训练目标相较标准微调基线，在减少否定失败的同时对通用能力的损害更小。
AI.conclusion: 机制分析能够揭示某项语言能力失败的原因，并指导针对底层局限的训练，为改进LLM的否定处理提供了原理性路径。

title: PhyDiCT: Plug-and-Play CT Reconstruction from Sparse X-Rays via Differentiable Rendering and Strong Priors
comment: Accepted at MICCAI 2026; to appear in LNCS 16888
summary: Reconstructing 3D Computed Tomography (CT) images from a few X-ray projections is a highly ill-posed inverse problem due to the loss of volumetric information. We propose PhyDiCT, a training-free framework that integrates a differentiable Physics-based forward model, grounded in the Beer-Lambert law, with a text-conditioned Diffusion as a strong prior to reconstruct 3D lung CT images. We refer to our approach as training-free since the prior model is used without fine-tuning, and our goal is to steer the denoising procedure to generate samples consistent with X-ray observations. We guide the diffusion generation using Split Gibbs sampling to jointly optimize for projection fidelity (reward) and consistency with prior knowledge. Also, we introduce a test-time refinement step that enhances image realism and anatomical coherence. We extensively evaluate our method on publicly available 3D CT datasets using both perceptual and semantic metrics, demonstrating that it surpasses existing plug-and-play diffusion and fully trained reconstruction approaches. Our findings highlight that combining a strong generative prior with the underlying physics of image formation substantially improves reconstruction quality, e.g., 7.5\% improvement on SSIM compared to full training methods. Code will be released at https://github.com/batmanlab/PhyDiCT.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练框架PhyDiCT，将基于Beer-Lambert定律的可微物理前向模型与文本条件扩散先验结合，用Split Gibbs采样重建3D肺部CT，性能优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 从少量X射线投影重建3D CT是高度病态的逆问题，因体信息严重缺失。目标是利用强生成先验与成像物理规律，提升少视角重建质量，且无需对先验模型进行微调。
AI.method: PhyDiCT为免训练框架：1）以Beer-Lambert定律为基础构建可微物理前向模型；2）采用文本条件扩散模型作为强先验，不进行微调；3）用Split Gibbs采样引导去噪过程，联合优化投影保真度（奖励）与先验一致性；4）引入测试时精修步骤，提升图像真实感与解剖连贯性。
AI.result: 在公开3D CT数据集上，用感知与语义指标评估，方法超越现有即插即用扩散方法和全训练重建方法；相比全训练方法SSIM提升7.5%。
AI.conclusion: 结合强生成先验与成像物理规律可显著提升重建质量，免训练方案在少视角3D CT重建中有效且优于需训练的方法。

title: From Uncertainty to Action: Learning to Steer LLM Agents
summary: Steering an LLM agent means deciding whether to correct it, at which step, and with which mechanism. Uncertainty is often used to decide when to correct an agent, but whether it can guide these decisions remains unclear. We steer agent trajectories separately at every non-terminal step with each of four mechanisms and run each continuation to completion. The resulting stepwise outcome table (SOT) holds about 82,000 counterfactual continuations of 1,864 trajectories from three benchmarks and two agents. It shows that uncertainty can identify failing trajectories, but that no single signal reliably locates the step at which steering helps. We therefore propose VoS (Value of Steering), a trajectory-level monitor, offline or online, that learns from SOT the value of steering at each step and decides where to steer by it. A harm-budgeted trigger decides whether to steer, limiting the fraction of successful trajectories that VoS disturbs. VoS improves on unmodified execution in all 12 settings of benchmark, agent, and offline or online use, by 7.8 points on average, and outperforms the strongest of five existing uncertainty-triggered methods in 11, by 2.9 points on average. Ablations show that training on measured outcomes and a tight harm budget are both essential.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出VoS（Value of Steering），一种基于步级反事实结果表（SOT）学习的轨迹级监控器，通过学习每步的"引导价值"来决定何时、何处以及如何纠正LLM agent，并在12种设置上平均提升7.8个百分点。
AI.motivation: 引导LLM agent需要决策三件事：是否纠正、在哪个步骤纠正、用何种机制纠正。不确定性常被用于判断纠正时机，但它能否有效指导这些决策尚不明确。作者通过大规模反事实实验检验这一问题，发现不确定性虽能识别失败轨迹，却无法可靠定位干预有效的最优步骤，因此需要一种新的价值驱动的引导决策方法。
AI.method: 作者在每个非终末步骤分别施加四种干预机制并将每条轨迹运行至结束，构建了步级结果表SOT，包含来自3个基准、2个agent的1,864条轨迹约82,000条反事实延续。基于SOT，作者提出VoS（Value of Steering）轨迹级监控器（支持离线与在线），学习每步的引导价值并据此决定在何处引导；同时引入带伤害预算（harm-budgeted）的触发器决定是否引导，以限制被扰动的成功轨迹比例。
AI.result: VoS在基准、agent及离线/在线使用的全部12种设置中均优于未修改执行，平均提升7.8个百分点；在11种设置中优于五种现有不确定性触发方法中最强者，平均提升2.9个百分点。消融实验表明，基于实测结果的训练与严格的伤害预算两者均为必要。
AI.conclusion: 不确定性不足以定位有效的引导步骤，而基于反事实结果学习的引导价值信号更为可靠。VoS通过价值学习与伤害预算触发机制，在多种设置下稳定提升agent表现，且关键组件缺一不可。

title: A Geometry-Based Capacity Theory for Finite-Feature Associative Memory
summary: We develop a geometry-based capacity theory for exact-key retrieval in compressed finite-feature Hebbian associative memory. For random or approximately isotropic values, retrieval interference separates into finite-feature noise, which decreases with feature dimension, and structural interference, which is determined by squared kernel overlap among stored keys and persists in the infinite-feature limit. This yields a fit-free prediction of retrieval quality, reveals a geometry-dependent capacity ceiling, and predicts the feature budget required for a target retrieval quality. When stored values are correlated, we show that retrieval depends jointly on the key kernel and value Gram matrix, and derive finite-feature approximations that account for this interaction. We validate the theory on synthetic, visual, and medical-image representations. Overall, the framework links representation geometry directly to memory capacity and distinguishes when performance can be improved by increasing the feature budget and when the representation itself must be changed. Across these settings, the predicted retrieval curves closely match empirical behavior and correctly identify changes in the preferred memory design.

AI.tldr: 本文为压缩有限特征Hebbian联想记忆中的精确键检索建立了一套基于几何的容量理论，可无拟合预测检索质量、容量上限与所需特征预算，并在合成、视觉与医学图像表示上验证。
AI.motivation: 现有联想记忆容量分析多假设无限特征或理想化键值，难以刻画有限特征、结构相关性下的实际检索性能，也缺少将表示几何与记忆容量直接挂钩、可用于指导设计的理论工具。
