Trained on benign rollouts, its two branches assess input-token structure and prediction errors in adjacent-layer latent dynamics. A suspicious rollout identified by the token manifold branch, once confirmed through latent deviations, guides transition selection for subsequent monitoring. We further explore policy purification through self-distillation: a frozen copy of the backdoored policy provides benign-input actions to supervise a student on paired benign and triggered observations, without requiring a separate clean reference policy. For evaluation, we adapt traditional backdoor detectors and repurpose anomaly and failure detection methods as VLA backdoor detectors. In a post-hoc comparison with ten baselines, TMT achieves state-of-the-art backdoor detection performance on unseen tasks across three VLA backdoor attacks. Our project page is available at https://zzr42.github.io/tmt/.

AI.tldr: 提出运行时后门检测器TMT，通过Token流形与隐层转移建模在良性轨迹上训练，用于VLA策略后门激活检测，并结合自蒸馏进行策略净化。
AI.motivation: VLA策略被植入后门后，良性任务表现正常，仅触发时产生恶意动作，检测困难：恶意行为由单个看似合理的动作组成，且陌生任务本身会带来观测与行为的合理变化。
AI.method: TMT包含两个分支，均仅在良性rollout上训练：一支检测输入token结构（Token Manifold），另一支建模相邻层隐动态的预测误差（latent Transition）。token分支发现可疑rollout后，经隐空间偏差确认，进而指导后续监控的转移选择。此外探索基于自蒸馏的策略净化：冻结后门策略提供良性输入下的动作，监督学生在成对的良性/触发观测上学习，无需独立干净参考策略。
AI.result: 在事后对比中与十种基线方法比较，TMT在三个VLA后门攻击、未见任务上取得最先进的后门检测性能。同时将传统后门检测器适配、并将异常与失败检测方法改造为VLA后门检测器用于评测。
AI.conclusion: TMT通过token流形与隐层转移的联合建模，实现了对VLA后门激活的有效运行时检测，并可通过自蒸馏实现无需干净参考策略的策略净化。

title: From Pareto to Preference: Personalized Test-Time Scaling via Amortized Agentic Policy Discovery
summary: Test-time scaling (TTS) improves the reasoning capabilities of large language models by allocating additional inference computation. Existing approaches to improving TTS efficiency largely optimize accuracy against one resource dimension at a time, advancing either the accuracy--cost or accuracy--latency Pareto frontier. Yet user requirements are multidimensional: users may specify accuracy, latency, and inference-cost requirements jointly, and different requirements can favor different controllers. We formulate Personalized Test-Time Scaling as discovering executable controllers that maximize the joint satisfaction rate of user-specific requirements. To reduce the overhead of repeated policy discovery for new user profiles, we propose PersonTTS, an amortized agentic policy-discovery framework that reuses prior search experience through requirement-matched controller initialization and source-distilled procedural guidance, while retaining target-profile evaluation for every candidate. Experiments on AIME and HMMT show that PersonTTS substantially outperforms strong TTS baselines in joint requirement satisfaction on unseen user profiles and held-out problems. Under the same candidate-evaluation budget, cross-user experience reuse further improves policy quality while substantially reducing discovery-agent time and cost.

AI.tldr: 本文将个性化测试时缩放（TTS）形式化为发现最大化用户多维需求联合满足率的可执行控制器，提出摊销式智能体策略发现框架 PersonTTS，通过需求匹配的控制器初始化和源蒸馏过程指导复用历史搜索经验，在 AIME 与 HMMT 上显著优于强 TTS 基线。
AI.motivation: 现有 TTS 效率方法多针对单一资源维度优化，仅在准确率–成本或准确率–延迟的帕累托前沿上推进；但用户需求是多维的，可能同时指定准确率、延迟与推理成本约束，且不同需求偏好不同控制器。因此需要一个能面向个性化多维需求进行策略发现的框架。
AI.method: 将个性化 TTS 表述为：发现可执行控制器以最大化用户特定需求的联合满足率。为降低针对新用户画像重复策略发现的开销，提出 PersonTTS——一种摊销式智能体策略发现框架，包含两项机制：需求匹配的控制器初始化，以及源蒸馏的过程性指导，从而复用先前的搜索经验；同时对每个候选控制器保留目标画像上的评估。
AI.result: 在 AIME 与 HMMT 上的实验表明，PersonTTS 在未见用户画像与留出问题上的联合需求满足率显著优于强 TTS 基线。在相同候选评估预算下，跨用户经验复用进一步提升策略质量，同时大幅降低发现智能体的时间与成本。
AI.conclusion: 面向个性的多维需求，摊销式经验复用可有效提升 TTS 策略发现的质量与效率，兼顾联合需求满足率与搜索开销，为个性化测试时缩放提供了可行路径。

title: GRC-Net: Global Representation Consistency Network for Unsupervised Multimodal Anomaly Detection
summary: Automated quality inspection is essential for ensuring product reliability in manufacturing.While image-based methods effectively capture appearance-related defects, these methods are limited in detecting structural and geometric anomalies, motivating multimodal approaches incorporating 3D information. However, existing methods mainly rely on local patch-level representations, which often lead to unstable reconstruction errors even in normal regions. To address this limitation, we propose GRC-Net, which integrates a global-attention MLP to enforce global representation consistency across patch embeddings with a stable reconstruction module to improve reconstruction stability. The proposed method captures holistic contextual information through a global token and suppresses reconstruction noise by minimizing discrepancies between original and predicted embeddings. Experiments on MVTec 3D-AD and Eyecandies demonstrate that GRC-Net consistently outperforms existing methods at both image and pixel levels. Qualitative results further demonstrate reduced reconstruction errors in normal regions and more distinct reconstruction differences between normal and anomalous regions.

AI.tldr: 提出GRC-Net，通过全局注意力MLP与稳定重建模块提升多模态工业异常检测的重建稳定性与检测性能。
AI.motivation: 制造业质量检测中，基于图像的方法只能捕捉外观缺陷，难以检测结构与几何异常，因此需要引入3D信息的多模态方法。然而现有方法主要依赖局部patch级表示，导致即使在正常区域重建误差也不稳定，影响异常检测的可靠性。
AI.method: GRC-Net包含两部分：一是全局注意力MLP，通过全局token在patch嵌入间强制全局表示一致性，捕捉整体上下文信息；二是稳定重建模块，通过最小化原始嵌入与预测嵌入之间的差异来抑制重建噪声。
AI.result: 在MVTec 3D-AD与Eyecandies数据集上，GRC-Net在图像级和像素级均持续优于现有方法；定性结果显示正常区域重建误差降低，正常与异常区域间的重建差异更加显著。
AI.conclusion: 引入全局表示一致性与重建稳定性机制可有效缓解局部patch表示带来的重建不稳定问题，提升多模态工业异常检测的性能。

title: SpecGuard: Proving a Task Is Broken Before the Agent Cheats
summary: As autonomous coding agents get increasingly deployed, the risk that accidental or adversarially injected misspecifications in tasks lead to dangerous agent behavior is critical to address. Prior work has shown that agents given such tasks rarely flag the conflict and instead cheat, editing tests or hard-coding expected outputs, and the actions taken to cheat can cause real damage, such as deleting a security defense to make a corrupted test pass. It remains unclear whether such conflicts can be established with independently verifiable evidence before the agent acts. We present SpecGuard, which detects and formally certifies these conflicts between task intent and tests. Given only the task description and codebase, SpecGuard autoformalizes the intended behaviour into a Lean 4 specification. The tests are formalized independently, and the Lean kernel checks whether any implementation could satisfy both formalizations, producing a machine-checked certificate when none can. On conflicted SWE-bench tasks, SpecGuard detects up to 72.8% of conflicts and formally certifies up to 51.1%, with a nearly five-fold lower conflict miss rate than model-based judgment. SpecGuard provides a pre-execution safety check that identifies reward-hacking opportunities through formal certification of task-level conflicts, before any agent behavior is observed. Our code is available at https://github.com/prmbiy/specguard.

AI.tldr: 提出 SpecGuard，一种在智能体执行前对任务意图与测试之间的冲突进行形式化检测与认证的方法。
AI.motivation: 自主编码智能体被广泛部署，任务中意外或对抗性注入的错误规格可能导致危险行为（如作弊、改测试、硬编码期望输出，甚至删除安全防御），而现有工作发现智能体很少主动报告这类冲突；因此需要一种能在智能体行动之前以独立可验证证据判定冲突的手段。
AI.method: 给定任务描述与代码库，SpecGuard 将任务意图自动形式化为 Lean 4 规约，同时独立形式化测试；随后由 Lean 内核检查是否存在任何实现能同时满足两种形式化，若不存在则生成机器可验证的证书。
AI.result: 在存在冲突的 SWE-bench 任务上，SpecGuard 检测出多达 72.8% 的冲突，并对多达 51.1% 的冲突给出形式化认证，其冲突漏报率比基于模型的判定低近五倍。
AI.conclusion: SpecGuard 提供了一种执行前安全检查，通过任务级冲突的形式化认证，在观察任何智能体行为之前识别奖励黑客机会。

title: MaRK: Markov-adapted Recurrent Kernels for Dynamic Operator Conditioning in State Space Models
summary: State Space Models (SSMs) offer an efficient alternative to Transformers for sequence modeling, yet conditioning pre-trained SSMs for iterative generation typically operates outside the recurrent operator, through input injection or activation modulation. While such mechanisms expose the model to conditioning information, they leave the underlying temporal dynamics fixed. We introduce MaRK (Markov-adapted Recurrent Kernels), a dynamic operator-conditioning framework that maps context vectors directly into bounded modulations of a frozen SSM's recurrence ($A$), read-in ($B$), read-out ($C$), skip ($D$), and discretization ($Δ$) parameters. Viewed through the lens of LPV-SSM systems, MaRK induces a context-indexed family of Markov parameter sequences, allowing each diffusion timestep to reshape the model's input-output memory kernel. We instantiate MaRK on a frozen 111M-parameter Hydra SSM backbone and study three adapter geometries: Hypernet, Chebyshev polynomial, and Discrete Cosine Transform kernels. Since these adapters modify the Markov parameter sequence through low-rank auxiliary maps on the frozen backbone, parameter-efficient fine-tuning arises as a structural consequence of the adaptation mechanism itself, requiring only 6.3--11M trainable auxiliary parameters to transition from a bidirectional objective to an iterative diffusion regime. The bounded recurrence parameterization further yields an analytic Affine Quadratic Stability certificate for the modulated recurrence. Through synthetic LPV recovery experiments and Markov-operator diagnostics, we show that MaRK recovers coordinate-invariant temporal operators under matched assumptions and produces distinct, stable timestep-conditioned memory profiles. Empirically, the Chebyshev variant yields the strongest performance, achieving an average validation loss of 2.55, followed by the DCT (2.59) and Hypernet (3.77) geometries.

AI.tldr: 提出 MaRK 框架，将上下文向量直接映射为冻结 SSM 递归算子的有界调制，用少参数适配器实现扩散式迭代生成。
AI.motivation: 预训练 SSM 的迭代生成条件化通常发生在递归算子之外（输入注入或激活调制），虽引入条件信息，却固定了底层时间动态，无法按上下文重塑记忆核。
AI.method: MaRK 把上下文向量映射为冻结 SSM 的 A、B、C、D、Δ 参数的有界调制；从 LPV-SSM 视角看形成上下文索引的 Markov 参数序列族，使每个扩散时间步重塑输入-输出记忆核。在冻结 111M Hydra SSM 上实现 Hypernet、Chebyshev 多项式、DCT 三种适配器几何，通过低秩辅助映射修改 Markov 参数序列，从而结构性获得参数高效微调（6.3–11M 可训练参数），并由有界递归参数化给出解析仿射二次稳定性证书。
AI.result: 合成 LPV 恢复实验与 Markov 算子诊断表明，MaRK 在匹配假设下可恢复坐标不变时间算子，并产生互异且稳定的时间步条件记忆谱；Chebyshev 变体平均验证损失最低为 2.55，DCT 为 2.59，Hypernet 为 3.77。
AI.conclusion: 将条件化内化到递归算子本身可有效改造冻结 SSM 的时间动态，在极少可训练参数下完成从双向目标到迭代扩散范式的迁移，且 Chebyshev 核适配器表现最佳。

title: Precise SE(3) End-Effector Tracking in Whole-Body Humanoid Control
summary: Precise end-effector tracking during humanoid whole-body motion is challenging due to floating-base oscillations, gravity, dynamic coupling, and locomotion-induced disturbances. We propose ResGAC, a whole-body humanoid controller for precise end-effector pose tracking that combines geometric admittance control (GAC) with residual reinforcement learning. GAC provides structured $\SE$ task-space feedback and generates nominal arm joint-position targets, while residual RL compensates for unmodeled dynamics and coordinates locomotion and balance in the shared joint-position action space. The left-invariant geometric formulation allows the same GAC law to be used across manipulation reference frames. This enables the use of a ground-attached heading frame that preserves planar locomotion while removing pelvis roll, pitch, and heave from the manipulation reference, thereby reducing reference-induced end-effector motion during locomotion. ResGAC is validated on a real Unitree G1 humanoid. Across four standing end-effector tracking benchmarks, ResGAC consistently outperforms representative baselines, including SONIC, achieving lower translational and rotational errors. Real-world experiments further demonstrate reduced propagation of pelvis motion to the desired end-effector pose using the proposed ground-attached heading frame. ResGAC achieves $90\%$ success in a standing peg-in-hole task compared with $50\%$ for SONIC, and accurate world-frame $\SE$ end-effector pose tracking during lower-body motion. Experimental videos are included in the supplementary material and are also available on the project website: https://resgac.github.io/ResGAC-website/.

AI.tldr: 提出ResGAC——将几何导纳控制（GAC）与残差强化学习结合的人形全身控制器，在真实Unitree G1上实现高精度末端位姿跟踪。
AI.motivation: 人形全身运动中的精确末端执行器跟踪面临浮基振荡、重力、动态耦合及行走扰动等挑战，传统方法难以在运动状态下保持末端位姿精度。
AI.method: 将几何导纳控制（GAC）与残差强化学习结合：GAC提供结构化的SE(3)任务空间反馈并生成名义手臂关节位置目标；残差RL补偿未建模动力学，并在共享关节位置动作空间内协调行走与平衡。采用左不变几何公式，使同一GAC律可跨操作参考系使用，从而引入地面固连航向系，保留平面行走的同时去除骨盆的横滚、俯仰与升降对操作参考的影响。
AI.result: 在真实Unitree G1上验证：四项站立末端跟踪基准中持续优于SONIC等基线，平移与旋转误差更低；地面固连航向系减少了骨盆运动向末端位姿的传播；站立轴孔装配任务成功率90%（SONIC为50%），并在下肢运动时实现准确的世界系SE(3)末端位姿跟踪。
AI.conclusion: ResGAC通过GAC与残差RL的结合及其左不变几何公式，有效提升了人形机器人在全身运动下的末端位姿跟踪精度与任务成功率。

title: SpikingVLA: Asynchronous Spiking Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: ANN-to-SNN conversion offers a practical route toward energy-efficient spiking Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models by bypassing the substantial cost of training large-scale SNNs from scratch. However, existing methods often require many timesteps to maintain competitive performance, resulting in substantial inference latency for real-time VLA deployment. To address this challenge, we introduce SpikingVLA, an ANN-to-SNN conversion framework that enables accurate and low-latency spiking VLA inference. Specifically, we propose a Dendritic Integrate-and-Fire (DIF) neuron that alleviates channel-wise activation outliers through dendritic mixing and adaptive somatic firing, enabling accurate ANN-to-SNN conversion with fewer timesteps. Building on DIF neurons, we further introduce an asynchronous execution mechanism that overlaps temporal computation across VLA components, reducing synchronization overhead and latency. Extensive experiments demonstrate that SpikingVLA achieves competitive navigation performance with substantially improved inference efficiency. Compared with existing spiking VLA methods, SpikingVLA improves SR and SPL by 11.9\% and 12.6\%, respectively, while reducing first-action latency by 11.2$\times$. These results establish SpikingVLA as a practical framework for deploying pretrained VLA models with high-performance and low-latency spiking inference.

AI.tldr: 提出 SpikingVLA：一种 ANN-to-SNN 转换框架，通过 DIF 神经元与异步执行机制，实现高精度、低延迟的脉冲 VLA 推理。
AI.motivation: ANN-to-SNN 转换为构建节能脉冲 VLA 模型提供了实用路径，可避免从头训练大规模 SNN 的高成本。但现有方法需大量时间步才能保持竞争力，导致实时 VLA 部署的推理延迟过高。
AI.method: 1）提出树突积分放电（DIF）神经元，通过树突混合与自适应胞体发放缓解逐通道激活离群值，实现少时间步下的高精度转换；2）基于 DIF 神经元引入异步执行机制，重叠 VLA 各组件的时序计算，降低同步开销与延迟。
AI.result: 在导航任务上取得具竞争力的性能并显著提升推理效率：相比现有脉冲 VLA 方法，SR 与 SPL 分别提升 11.9% 和 12.6%，首动作延迟降低 11.2×。
AI.conclusion: SpikingVLA 可作为部署预训练 VLA 模型、实现高性能低延迟脉冲推理的实用框架。

title: CRT-HMAR: Causal Requirement Tracing-Guided Hierarchical Multi-Agent Regulation for Open-Task-Aware Infrared-Visible Image Fusion
summary: Infrared and visible (IR-VIS) image fusion integrates complementary multimodal information into a single fused image to support downstream vision tasks. However, existing methods are typically tailored to seen tasks within a fixed task set and struggle to generalize to unseen tasks, which restricts their applicability in real-world open-task scenarios. To address this issue, this paper proposes CRT-HMAR, a Causal Requirement Tracing-Guided Hierarchical Multi-Agent Regulation Framework for open-task-aware IR-VIS image fusion. CRT-HMAR introduces a Causal Requirement Tracing Task Localization mechanism, which actively intervenes in key image information and observes task-network response variations to map task-specific semantic preferences into image-level causal requirement maps. Based on these maps, a requirement analysis agent aggregates task-specific requirement knowledge to adaptively guide requirement-customized image fusion. Moreover, CRT-HMAR incorporates History-Analysis Multi-Objective Balancing and Task-Level-Correction Conflict Mitigation mechanisms, jointly constructing a hierarchical regulation chain of "requirement interpretation - task balancing - conflict mitigation". Through multiple collaborative agents, CRT-HMAR dynamically regulates key processes including open-task requirement modeling, multi-task balanced optimization, and gradient conflict mitigation. Extensive experiments on open-task scenarios involving five downstream tasks demonstrate that CRT-HMAR significantly improves generalization to unseen tasks while maintaining the performance and balance of seen tasks. Overall, CRT-HMAR shifts IR-VIS image fusion from task-oriented modeling toward requirement-oriented modeling, promoting its extension from closed-task settings to real-world open-task scenarios.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CRT-HMAR，一个因果需求追踪引导的分层多智能体调控框架，用于开放任务感知的红外与可见光图像融合，显著提升对未见任务的泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 现有红外与可见光图像融合方法通常针对固定任务集内的已知任务定制，难以泛化到未见任务，限制了其在真实开放任务场景中的适用性。
AI.method: CRT-HMAR引入因果需求追踪任务定位机制，主动干预关键图像信息并观测任务网络响应变化，将任务特定语义偏好映射为图像级因果需求图；基于该图，需求分析智能体聚合任务特定需求知识以自适应引导需求定制化融合。此外，框架结合历史分析多目标平衡与任务级校正冲突缓解机制，构建"需求解读—任务平衡—冲突缓解"的分层调控链，通过多智能体协作动态调控开放任务需求建模、多任务均衡优化与梯度冲突缓解等关键过程。
AI.result: 在涉及五个下游任务的开放任务场景下的大量实验表明，CRT-HMAR在保持已知任务性能与平衡的同时，显著提升了对未见任务的泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: CRT-HMAR将红外与可见光图像融合从任务导向建模转向需求导向建模，推动其从封闭任务设定扩展到真实开放任务场景。

title: Training Language Models To Be Coherent Decision-Makers
summary: Reliable decision-making requires more than accurate prediction: a model must preserve its beliefs, apply the relevant utilities, and recognize when the information needed to justify an action is missing. We study whether language models can learn this decision procedure from supervised fine-tuning and generalize it across domains and differing natural-language expressions of the decision challenge. Across 20 datasets, we explore challenges of belief instability and decision-making errors by first eliciting probabilities of outcomes and then varying only the utilities and the framing of the decision problems, while holding the evidence fixed. We train models to preserve elicited beliefs while selecting the action that maximizes expected utility, and evaluate transfer to unseen application domains, held-out framings, and different classes of payoff structures. We further introduce incomplete-information settings in which required utilities are withheld and replaced with irrelevant text, testing whether models can distinguish missing decision-relevant information from merely additional context. We find that targeted fine-tuning substantially improves coherent decision-making and that in many situations, learning transfers across domains and framings to situations unobserved during training. Further, models trained for decidability learn to identify when action cannot be justified based on missing information. Finally, we show the value of a routed system that considers separately the recognition of decision completeness and utility-sensitive decision execution.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究语言模型能否通过监督微调学会"可靠决策流程"（保持信念、应用效用、识别信息缺失），并在20个数据集上测试其跨领域与跨表述的泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 可靠决策不止于准确预测：模型需保持自身信念、应用相关效用，并在缺乏支撑行动所需信息时予以识别。现有研究多关注预测准确性，较少考察语言模型能否习得并泛化这一完整决策程序，尤其是信念稳定性与信息缺失识别。
AI.method: 在20个数据集上，先引出结果概率（elicited beliefs），随后在固定证据的前提下仅改变效用与决策问题的表述框架；训练模型在保持所引出信念的同时选择期望效用最大的行动。评估向未见应用领域、留出框架及不同收益结构的迁移。进一步引入不完全信息设置：将所需效用隐去并替换为无关文本，测试模型能否区分"缺失的决策相关信息"与"额外上下文"。最后提出并验证一个路由系统，将决策完备性识别与效用敏感决策执行分开处理。
AI.result: 针对性微调显著提升了连贯决策能力；在许多情况下，学习可跨领域与跨框架迁移到训练中未出现的情形；面向可判定性（decidability）训练的模型学会了在信息缺失时识别行动无法被正当化。此外，将决策完备性识别与效用敏感决策执行分开的路由系统展现出额外价值。
AI.conclusion: 语言模型可通过监督微调习得可靠的决策流程，并在领域、表述与收益结构上具备一定泛化能力，同时能识别信息缺失导致的不可判定情形；分解式的路由系统优于单一模型处理全部环节。

authors: Paulo Salgado Gomes de Mattos Neto
title: Are We Really Benchmarking Forecasting Models? The Impact of Preprocessing on Time Series Performance
summary: While established literature underscores the pivotal role of preprocessing in forecasting accuracy, this stage remains largely overlooked in current research. Modern benchmarks typically resort to simple scaling, failing to account for critical transformations required to address nonstationarity, such as differencing. This omission creates a significant structural preprocessing bias that favors models with built-in data treatments while obscuring the true potential of simpler architectures. We study this effect through a preprocessing-aware benchmark that evaluates 11 forecasting models across 16 reversible preprocessing pipelines on 29,000 M4 time series. Our results identify preprocessing as a key driver of forecasting performance. Optimizing preprocessing per series yields gains of approximately 27\% to 87\% across all evaluated models, with architectures lacking internalized preprocessing experiencing the most substantial improvements. This allows simpler architectures to become highly competitive with complex, state-of-the-art models in modern forecasting benchmarks. All resources and experimental results from this benchmark are stored in a comprehensive metadataset to support future metalearning tasks.

AI.tldr: 该文指出当前预测基准普遍忽视预处理，仅用简单缩放，导致有利于内置数据处理机制模型的结构性预处理偏差。作者构建了预处理感知基准，在29,000条M4序列上评估11个预测模型与16种可逆预处理流程。
AI.motivation: 已有文献强调预处理对预测精度的关键作用，但当前研究仍普遍忽视该环节。现代基准多采用简单缩放，未考虑差分等应对非平稳性的必要变换，从而产生结构性预处理偏差，偏向具备内置数据处理的模型，掩盖了更简单架构的真实潜力。
AI.method: 构建预处理感知基准，在29,000条M4时间序列上，对11个预测模型与16种可逆预处理流程进行系统评估，并开展逐序列预处理优化。
AI.result: 预处理被识别为预测性能的关键驱动因素。逐序列优化预处理可使所有评估模型获得约27%至87%的性能提升，其中缺乏内置预处理的架构提升最显著，进而使更简单的架构在现代预测基准中可与复杂的最先进模型高度竞争。所有资源与实验结果被保存为综合元数据集，以支持未来元学习任务。
AI.conclusion: 预处理是影响预测性能的关键因素，当前基准中的简单缩放造成结构性偏差。通过逐序列优化预处理，简单模型可在公平条件下与复杂模型竞争；所发布的元数据集有助于后续元学习研究。

title: SiGNgapore - An Interactive Dataset for Sign-based Visual Navigation
summary: The future of autonomous robots in human-oriented environments depends on their ability to navigate in the absence of prebuilt maps; exploiting navigational aids, such as navigational signs, designed by humans for humans is critical for enabling autonomy. This manuscript introduces a unique dataset collected using a handheld device, at various public spaces across Singapore, representing environments that humans frequent daily, and focusing on sign-centric decision making for mapless navigation. The dataset includes RGB, sparse depth, odometry and IMU measurements of scenarios centered around navigational signs and the complex environments where they are placed. Additionally, we provide 56 long-horizon navigation missions and over 450 sign-centric scenarios. All data is provided in a human- readable format, as well as utility scripts for conversion to ROS 2. Lastly, we provide venue maps and GPS aligned scene graphs of the test environments. We discuss the potential use cases for this dataset.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了一个在无预建地图环境下，围绕导航标志进行决策的无地图导航数据集，采集自新加坡多个公共空间，包含多模态传感器数据、导航任务与场景图，并提供ROS 2转换工具与场地地图。
AI.motivation: 自主机器人在人类环境中应用的关键在于无地图导航能力，而利用人类设计的导航标志（如指示牌）对实现自主性至关重要。现有数据集多依赖预建地图，缺乏针对标志中心决策、面向真实公共环境的无地图导航数据支持。
AI.method: 使用手持设备在新加坡多个公共空间采集数据，聚焦于以导航标志为中心的场景。数据包含RGB图像、稀疏深度、里程计和IMU测量，覆盖导航标志及其所处复杂环境。数据集提供56个长时程导航任务和450多个标志中心场景，并附带人类可读格式数据、ROS 2转换脚本、场地地图以及GPS对齐的场景图。
AI.result: 构建了一个多模态、多场景的无地图导航数据集，涵盖RGB、稀疏深度、里程计与IMU数据，包含56个长时程导航任务和450多个标志中心场景，并提供场地地图与GPS对齐的场景图，同时讨论了该数据集的潜在应用场景。
AI.conclusion: 该数据集为无地图、标志驱动的自主导航研究提供了真实公共环境下的多模态数据与任务基准，有助于推动机器人利用人类导航标志实现自主决策，并支持ROS 2生态下的进一步研究与应用。

title: Bridge Routing Heads: Where Multilingual Multi-hop Reasoning Lives in LLMs
summary: Multilingual LLMs answer the same multi-hop reasoning question across languages, but we lack a mechanistic account of whether they share an internal circuit. We identify Bridge Routing Heads (BRH) in two large multilingual LLMs through a three-stage pipeline. The resulting language-specific head sets exhibit near-complete mutual exclusivity across the five languages, with a mean Jaccard similarity of only 0.017 for Llama 3.1 70B and 0.057 for Qwen 2.5 72B, revealing language-idiosyncratic circuits. Ablating general BRH increases two-hop Negative Log-Likelihood (NLL) by 39-89x the random-head baseline, providing direct causal evidence of their role. Amplifying these heads in a failing target-language pass rescues up to 51.7% of cross-lingual failures, with no training. The two models share this dual-circuit pattern but allocate heads differently: Llama concentrates chaining in a large general pool, while Qwen leans on larger language-specific pools. Together these results show that activation-level intervention alone can recover correct answers from cross-lingual reasoning failures.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过三阶段流水线识别出多语言大模型中的"桥接路由头"（BRH），发现在五种语言间这些头几乎互不重叠，证明多跳推理电路具有语言特异性，但可通过激活层面的干预（放大这些头）无需训练即能挽救跨语言推理失败。
AI.motivation: 多语言大模型能跨语言回答同一多跳推理问题，但其内部是否共享同一电路缺乏机制性解释。
AI.method: 提出三阶段流水线，在Llama 3.1 70B和Qwen 2.5 72B中识别桥接路由头（BRH）；通过Jaccard相似度衡量跨语言头集合的重叠程度，用消融（ablation）测量两跳NLL变化以验证因果作用，并在失败的目标语言推理中放大这些头进行干预。
AI.result: 跨五种语言的头集合近乎完全互斥，平均Jaccard相似度仅为0.017（Llama 3.1 70B）和0.057（Qwen 2.5 72B）；消融一般BRH使两跳NLL增加随机基线39-89倍，提供因果证据；放大这些头可无训练恢复最高51.7%的跨语言失败；两模型共享双电路模式但分配方式不同——Llama集中于大型通用池，Qwen依赖更大的语言特异池。
AI.conclusion: 仅靠激活层面的干预即可从跨语言推理失败中恢复正确答案，揭示多语言模型的多跳推理电路具有语言特异性但可通过头级操控加以利用。

title: TileSkipper: Region-Adaptive Tile Pruning for 3D Gaussian Splatting
summary: Tiled 3D Gaussian Splatting rasterizers often use one scene-wide contribution cutoff for tile enumeration, although content differs in its sensitivity to support truncation. TileSkipper selects a static per-Gaussian cutoff policy for a frozen checkpoint. Calibration renders measure candidate pair savings and an isolated-removal distortion proxy that accounts for front transmittance and background color. The method allocates cutoffs across 64 Gaussian groups and accepts policies only after complete renders on disjoint selection views. The exported policy uses one byte per Gaussian, with no parameter updates, additional kernel, or per-frame policy inference. Across 13 scenes from Mip-NeRF 360, Tanks & Temples, and Deep Blending, a fixed-policy AccuTile sweep gives dataset-macro speedups of $1.088\times$ at standard resolution and $1.238\times$ at 3840 pixels wide, with $-0.007/-0.023$ dB mean PSNR change. Six integrations with existing opacity-aware bounds yield $1.009\times$--$1.121\times$ compiler-only speedups. For four ports from $3σ$ rasterizers, we separately attribute the prior exact-bound transition and our incremental gain. Matched-quality ablations show modest gains over scene-global calibration and parity with per-Gaussian control; the standalone comparison with AdaGScale is regime-dependent.

AI.tldr: TileSkipper 为冻结的 3D 高斯泼溅检查点离线校准并导出每高斯单字节的静态截断策略，在不改动参数、不增加内核、不做逐帧策略推断的前提下，实现分块枚举加速且 PSNR 损失可忽略。
AI.motivation: 现有分块 3D 高斯泼溅光栅化器通常对整个场景使用统一的贡献截断阈值，但不同内容对支撑截断的敏感度差异很大，统一阈值导致不必要的分块枚举开销。
AI.method: TileSkipper 针对冻结检查点选择静态的每高斯截断策略：通过校准渲染测量候选配对节省量与孤立移除畸变代理（计入前向透射率与背景色），将截断阈值分配到 64 个高斯组，且仅在互不重叠的选择视图上完成完整渲染后才接受策略。导出策略每高斯仅占一字节。
AI.result: 在 Mip-NeRF 360、Tanks & Temples、Deep Blending 共 13 个场景上，固定策略 AccuTile 扫描在标准分辨率下取得数据集宏平均 1.088× 加速，在 3840 像素宽度下为 1.238×，平均 PSNR 变化为 −0.007/−0.023 dB；与现有不透明度感知边界结合时获得 1.009×–1.121× 仅编译器加速。对四个来自 3σ 光栅化器的移植，分别归因了先前精确边界转换与本文的增量收益。匹配质量消融显示相对场景全局校准略有提升，与逐高斯控制持平；与 AdaGScale 的独立比较结果依赖具体场景。
AI.conclusion: 内容自适应的静态每高斯截断策略可在几乎不损失渲染质量的前提下显著降低分块枚举成本，且零运行时开销、易于部署。

title: From Probabilities to Decisions: Search and Multi-Teacher Distillation with Jev
summary: Probability-only models, which TypeSafe calls System One models, return calibrated probabilities for fixed choices in milliseconds and generate no text. We study one such model, Jev, through two tasks that require decisions under tight constraints. In bullet chess, a bot that places Jev's judgment inside Stockfish search alongside an opening book and endgame tablebases climbs above a 2200 Lichess bullet rating against other bots. Live model calls are too slow for search, so we distill pairwise judgments into a compact evaluator that runs at every position. We then ask how best to spend a fixed labeling budget when an LLM, Qwen3-32B, is available as a second teacher. In chess, averaging both judges' labels beats spending the whole budget on Qwen alone by 9.6 Elo (95% interval 4.3 to 14.9), and the gain replicates on fresh openings; a second answer from the same judge is no substitute, and Jev is the strongest partner for Qwen among the models tested. In passage reranking, Jev's labels alone train a reranker that scores as high as Qwen's, from 21 minutes of API calls instead of 5.1 GPU-hours, and adding Qwen gains at most a few thousandths in ranking quality. Search supplies the lookahead, distillation makes the judgment cheap enough to use at every position, and an LLM partner pays off in chess.

AI.tldr: 研究概率型模型Jev在严格约束决策任务中的表现：通过蒸馏使其可嵌入国际象棋搜索，并在固定标注预算下与LLM教师Qwen3-32B组合，验证了混合标注优于单一LLM标注。
AI.motivation: 概率型（System One）模型能毫秒级返回固定选项的校准概率且不生成文本，但其在需要前瞻搜索、严格约束决策的场景中如何被有效利用尚不清晰；同时，在固定标注预算下，此类模型与LLM教师如何最优组合也缺乏实证。
AI.method: 以Jev为对象，开展两项任务：(1) 子弹象棋中，将Jev的判断嵌入Stockfish搜索，配合开局库和残局表；因实时调用过慢，将成对判断蒸馏为紧凑评估器，在每个局面运行；(2) 在固定标注预算下，将Jev与LLM教师Qwen3-32B的标签进行平均等组合，并与仅用Qwen、同一judge二次回答等基线对比；另在段落重排序任务中比较Jev与Qwen训练的重排序器。
AI.result: 象棋中平均两位judge的标签比全预算用于Qwen高9.6 Elo（95%区间4.3–14.9），并在新开局上复现；同一judge的第二个答案无法替代；Jev是所测模型中对Qwen最强的搭档。段落重排序中，仅用Jev标签训练的reranker与Qwen相当，且仅需21分钟API调用而非5.1 GPU小时，加入Qwen最多提升千分之几。
AI.conclusion: 搜索提供前瞻，蒸馏使判断足够廉价以在每个局面使用，而与LLM搭档在象棋任务中带来增益；概率型模型可作为高效且有效的教师/评估器，与LLM互补。

title: Convex-Concave Reinforcement Learning
summary: Policy learning drives many of the most consequential and heavily-invested applications of reinforcement learning today. Yet the core optimization problem it rests on (maximizing expected return) is notoriously non-convex, even under a direct policy parameterization, and the field has largely responded by avoiding it: optimizing convex surrogate approximations of the return under trust-region constraints (NPG, TRPO, PPO, AWR). We show that this seemingly unstructured problem is not actually structureless. In log-density-ratio coordinates $y := \log[π/π_n]$, the exact per-iteration objective, computable via per-decision importance sampling (PDIS), is a difference-of-convex-constrained difference-of-convex (DC-constrained DC) program. This structure lets us move beyond surrogate approximations: it recovers CPI, NPG, TRPO, and AWR as special cases along interpretable axes, and it opens a multi-step axis $k$ that couples consecutive decisions. We solve the per-iteration program with sequential convex programming (SCP), the standard solver for difference-of-convex problems, and give convergence guarantees under mild conditions, bridging the difference-of-convex optimization and RL literatures. Empirically, multi-step Convex-Concave RL (CCRL) wins on diagnostic MDPs where credit must propagate across a horizon (its advantage growing with the dependency length), is competitive with a tuned PPO on classic control, and on a realistic, stochastic, mid-horizon healthcare domain converges markedly faster than tuned PPO to the same near-optimal survival, with an 11.3% higher area under the training curve.

AI.tldr: 本文将策略优化在 log-density-ratio 坐标下刻画为 DC-约束 DC 规划，用 SCP 求解并提出 CCRL，涵盖 CPI、NPG、TRPO、AWR 等特例，并在诊断 MDP、经典控制与医疗域上验证其性能。
AI.motivation: 策略学习的核心优化问题（最大化期望回报）在直接策略参数化下也是非凸的，现有方法（NPG、TRPO、PPO、AWR）多回避该问题，转而优化带信赖域约束的凸代理近似。作者希望揭示该问题隐含的结构，从而摆脱代理近似的限制。
AI.method: 在 y := log[π/π_n] 的 log-density-ratio 坐标下，将可经 per-decision importance sampling (PDIS) 计算的精确逐迭代目标表述为 difference-of-convex-constrained difference-of-convex (DC-约束 DC) 规划；用 SCP（求解 DC 问题的标准方法）求解每轮子问题并给出收敛保证；通过在坐标轴上引入多步维度 k 耦合相邻决策。
AI.result: 该结构将 CPI、NPG、TRPO、AWR 恢复为沿可解释轴的特例；多步 CCRL 在需要跨时间步信用传播的诊断 MDP 上占优（优势随依赖长度增长），在经典控制上与调优 PPO 相当，在随机、中等时域的医疗域上收敛显著快于调优 PPO，训练曲线 AUC 高 11.3%。
AI.conclusion: 策略优化并非无结构，其在 log-density-ratio 坐标下具有 DC 结构，可借助 DC 优化理论求解，打通了 difference-of-convex 优化与 RL 两个领域，并提供了优于代理近似方法的实用算法。

title: Sparse Feature Policy Unlearning Mitigates State Hallucination in Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have shown strong generalization in robotic manipulation by leveraging rich representations from pretrained vision-language models. However, their deployment in real-world environments remains limited by recurring unreliable behaviors. In this work, we study state hallucination, a recurring failure pattern in which a VLA continues acting as if an unrealized robot-object state had been achieved. Our analyses find that state hallucination coincides with weakened attention to task-relevant visual regions, and a mechanistic interpretation via sparse autoencoders reveals that hallucination-associated sparse features are activated when these failures occur. Based on this analysis, we propose SOUL (Sparse feature pOlicy UnLearning), which selectively unlearns policy knowledge associated with state hallucination behaviors, where sparse features identified from hallucination failures and successful behaviors serve as explicit forgetting and retention targets, respectively. Experiments across VLA architectures in simulated and real-world environments show that our method substantially reduces hallucinated failures and improves task success without substantially compromising the existing manipulation capabilities. These results suggest that interpretable feature analysis provides a practical basis for selectively modifying undesirable knowledge in robot policies.

AI.tldr: 本文研究VLA模型中的"状态幻觉"失效模式，通过稀疏自编码器发现幻觉相关的稀疏特征，提出SOUL方法选择性遗忘这些特征，在仿真与真实环境中显著减少幻觉失效并提升任务成功率。
AI.motivation: VLA模型虽具备强泛化能力，但在真实环境中存在反复出现的不可靠行为（状态幻觉），即模型在未实现的目标状态上继续行动，限制了其实际部署。
AI.method: 首先分析状态幻觉与任务相关视觉区域注意力减弱的相关性；利用稀疏自编码器进行机制解释，识别幻觉相关的稀疏特征；据此提出SOUL（Sparse feature pOlicy UnLearning），以幻觉失效特征为遗忘目标、成功行为特征为保留目标，选择性遗忘策略知识。
AI.result: 在多种VLA架构及仿真与真实环境实验中，方法大幅减少幻觉失效并提升任务成功率，且基本不损害已有操作能力。
AI.conclusion: 可解释的特征分析为选择性修改机器人策略中的不良知识提供了实用基础。

title: Shaer: Controlled Arabic Poetry Generation with Meter Subform and Semantic Conditioning
comment: 22 pages, 7 figures. Code: https://github.com/AhmaddAbbass/Shaer ; models and datasets: https://huggingface.co/Shaer-AI
summary: Classical Arabic poetry generation requires simultaneously satisfying semantic, linguistic, and fine-grained prosodic constraints. Existing systems typically control broad poetic attributes but do not jointly model semantic intent, meter subform, and poem length. We present Shaer, a controllable Classical Arabic poetry generation framework jointly conditioned on natural-language descriptions, meter subforms, and target hemistich counts. To support this task, we construct an enriched corpus of 116,032 classical Arabic poems derived from Ashaar, containing normalized meter-subform labels and automatically generated, validated semantic descriptions. We then adapt Yehia-7B using QLoRA-based supervised fine-tuning with a completion-only objective. Our evaluation combines automatic assessment of base-meter conformity, requested-subform adherence, and length control with three LLM judges, blinded human evaluation, and memorization analysis. Shaer achieves 95.17% base-meter accuracy, 91.75% poem-level meter-subform accuracy, and 83.40% exact count accuracy. Relative to its untuned foundation model, these results represent gains of 68.68, 57.77, and 38.93 percentage points, respectively; Shaer also attains the highest base-meter accuracy among all evaluated systems. Multi-LLM evaluation and a blinded human assessment of top-ranked outputs further indicate competitive semantic and literary quality. Finally, analysis of all 3,481 test generations finds no exact copies from the training corpus or paired source poems. Code, models, and datasets are publicly available.

AI.tldr: 提出可控古典阿拉伯诗歌生成框架Shaer，联合以自然语言描述、韵律子形式与半句数为条件，并构建富含韵律标注与语义描述的语料。
AI.motivation: 古典阿拉伯诗歌生成需同时满足语义、语言与细粒度韵律约束，但现有系统多只控制粗粒度诗歌属性，未联合建模语义意图、韵律子形式与诗长。
AI.method: 构建源自Ashaar的116,032首诗歌富化语料（含归一化韵律子形式标签和自动生成并验证的语义描述）；基于QLoRA和监督微调（completion-only目标）适配Yehia-7B；评估结合自动指标（基础韵律、指定子形式、长度控制）、三个LLM评判、盲测人工评价与记忆化分析。
AI.result: Shaer达到95.17%基础韵律准确率、91.75%诗级韵律子形式准确率、83.40%精确长度准确率，相较未调优基座分别提升68.68、57.77、38.93个百分点，并在所有评估系统中基础韵律准确率最高；多LLM与盲测人工评价显示语义与文学质量具竞争力；3,481条测试生成中未发现与训练语料或配对源诗的完全复制。
AI.conclusion: Shaer验证了联合条件控制对古典阿拉伯诗歌生成的可行性，兼顾韵律约束、长度控制与语义质量，且无明显记忆化，代码、模型与数据已公开。

title: Do Image Editors Follow Depth-Dependent Blur and Aperture Response? A Rendered-Ground-Truth Pilot Audit
summary: General image editors are asked to make a photo look as if it were taken at f/1.4, yet it is rarely checked whether the blur they add follows thin-lens optics. A physical aperture edit spreads blur across depth in thin-lens proportions and changes the blur when the aperture changes; prior evaluations check blur monotonicity, sharpness-trend correlation, effective-aperture error, or vision-language judgments, and none we found reports the two properties separately at known depths. In this pilot audit of two editors (Gemini~3.1 Flash Image and GPT-image-2.5) we compare against a rendered oracle: Blender Cycles scenes with true thin-lens depth of field, one blur-width estimator applied identically to oracle and editor outputs, and preregistered depth and aperture indices. In 24 texture scenes rendered in one three-panel geometry, accepted and measurable panels show f/1.4-to-f/2.8 width ratios, $\barσ_{1.4}/\barσ_{2.8}$, of 0.99--1.18 against 1.98--2.13 for the oracle, and ratios of pooled median Gaussian-equivalent near/far blur widths of about 1.18--1.25 (Gemini) and 0.97--1.05 (GPT-image) against 1.69--1.82. Preregistered black-box interventions show that qualitative wording changes blur strength by roughly 2--10 times, whereas a request for 2 versus 6 px changes it 1.1--1.3 times and no tested wording of the f-number meets the registered ``followed'' criterion. The depth compression appears in the original and reversed centre-focus layouts; with the focus on the near panel, the available-panel depth index reaches the registered threshold, and the aperture response stays attenuated in every layout tested. Scalar metrics adapted from published ones give oracle-like scores to synthetic editors whose proportions are compressed.

AI.tldr: 该试点审计用 Blender Cycles 薄透镜渲染作为参考真值，检验两个通用图像编辑器（Gemini 3.1 Flash Image、GPT-image-2.5）的"f/1.4 浅景深"效果是否遵循薄透镜光学：其模糊随深度与光圈的变化比例被显著压缩。
AI.motivation: 用户常要求通用图像编辑器把照片做成 f/1.4 的浅景深效果，但很少有工作检验其添加的模糊是否符合薄透镜光学。物理光圈编辑应满足两点：模糊按薄透镜比例随深度分布，且光圈改变时模糊随之改变。既有评测只检查模糊单调性、清晰度趋势相关性、有效光圈误差或视觉语言判断，未在已知深度下分别报告这两条性质。
AI.method: 对两个编辑器做预注册试点审计，对照渲染 oracle：使用 Blender Cycles 场景生成真实薄透镜景深，对 oracle 与编辑器输出采用同一模糊宽度估计器，并设定预注册的深度与光圈指标。共 24 个纹理场景，采用单一三面板几何布局；并通过预注册黑盒干预测试措辞、像素模糊量与 f 值表述的影响。
AI.result: 被接受且可测量的面板上，f/1.4 与 f/2.8 的模糊宽度比 σ̄₁.₄/σ̄₂.₈ 为 0.99–1.18，而 oracle 为 1.98–2.13；近/远高斯等效模糊宽度池化中位数比约 1.18–1.25（Gemini）与 0.97–1.05（GPT-image），oracle 为 1.69–1.82。干预显示定性措辞使模糊强度变化约 2–10 倍，而"2 px 对比 6 px"的要求仅改变 1.1–1.3 倍；没有任何 f 值措辞达到注册的"遵循"标准。深度压缩在原始与反转的中心对焦布局中均出现；近面板对焦时可用面板深度指标达到注册阈值，光圈响应在所有布局中都保持衰减。从已发表指标改造的标量度量会给比例被压缩的合成编辑器近似 oracle 的分数。
AI.conclusion: 两个受测编辑器均未按薄透镜光学实现光圈与景深编辑：模糊随深度与光圈的变化比例被压缩，且对 f 值措辞不敏感；现有标量指标有可能对这类压缩比例的合成结果给出"类 oracle"的高分，说明需要区分深度与光圈两条性质的评测方法。

title: Bookkeeping, Composition, or Unreachable Gold? Reading MemoryAgentBench's Conflict-Resolution Scores Against a Frozen Last-Write Resolver
comment: Accepted at the IAB Workshop (Interpreting Agent Behavior) at NeurIPS 2026 (non-archival). 19 pages
summary: MemoryAgentBench's Conflict Resolution split is read as measuring "selective forgetting". We execute the benchmark's own rule - the newest statement about a fact wins - as a zero-learning resolver frozen on one of the four fact lists. Under the official metric the rule answers 80.25% of the questions (74.5% on the three held-out lists). Of the rest, 67 items have a released gold that the last-write graph cannot reach but overwritten statements would ("The capital of India is New Delhi." superseded by "The capital of India is Grosseto."; gold New Delhi); such items are a third of the multi-hop questions at 262K. Two long-context models and our pre-registered approximate re-implementation of the benchmark's BM25 agent, one retained run per item and outcomes only, score 84.7%, 82.6% and 41.6% on the items the rule solves against 10.4%, 11.9% and 6.0% on those 67. The failures are a reachability split plus a small parser-scope residual; the per-item split, not the aggregate, is the unit at which a score here can be read.

AI.tldr: 该论文指出MemoryAgentBench的Conflict Resolution子集并不能真正衡量"选择性遗忘"：将其自身规则（最新声明获胜）作为零学习解析器执行即可答对80.25%的题目，剩余失败样本源于"可达性分裂"与少量解析器范围残差。
AI.motivation: MemoryAgentBench的Conflict Resolution子集被普遍解读为衡量模型的"选择性遗忘"能力，但该解读是否成立缺乏验证。作者希望检验基准分数究竟在度量什么，并指出整体聚合分数可能掩盖了样本层面的结构性差异。
AI.method: 作者直接执行基准自带的规则——关于某事实的最新陈述获胜——作为零学习解析器，并固定在四个事实列表之一上。在官方指标下评估该规则；识别最后写入图无法到达但被覆盖陈述可达的题目（含已发布gold）；再对比两个长上下文模型与预注册的基准BM25 agent近似复现（每项保留一次运行，仅记录结果），并按题项层面拆分结果。
AI.result: 规则在官方指标下答对80.25%（三个held-out列表为74.5%）。剩余题目中有67项，其已发布gold无法被最后写入图达到、但被覆盖的旧陈述可达（例：印度首都由New Delhi被后继为Grosseto，而gold仍为New Delhi），这类题目占262K上下文多跳题目的三分之一。两个长上下文模型与BM25近似复现分别在规则可解题目上得84.7%、82.6%、41.6%，而在上述67项上仅得10.4%、11.9%、6.0%。
AI.conclusion: 该基准分数主要反映"可达性分裂"而非选择性遗忘，另含少量解析器范围残差；应按题项层面的分裂而非总体聚合分数来解读。

title: Breaking Adversarial Transferability in Fine-Tuned Speech Recognition
summary: Many organizations fine-tune publicly available pretrained Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) models and deploy them in black-box settings, assuming limited access provides protection. We show this assumption is fragile: adversarial perturbations crafted on the public base model transfer effectively to fine-tuned target models, severely degrading performance and posing concerns for safety-critical applications. We propose TransferBreaker, a unified fine-tuning framework that suppresses adversarial transfer by integrating Base Adversarial Fine-Tuning, which restricts adversarial training to base-effective perturbations; Latent Jacobian Regularization, which enforces latent-space invariance by suppressing adversarially sensitive directions; and HybridGrad-AFT, which improves robustness against adaptive attacks by interpolating transferable perturbations from base and target gradients. We theoretically justify all components and evaluate TransferBreaker across three languages and four large ASR models, reducing adversarial WER from 92.6 to 27.8. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/rohban-lab/TransferBreaker.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示微调后ASR模型的对抗迁移脆弱性，提出TransferBreaker框架抑制对抗迁移，将对抗WER从92.6降至27.8。
AI.motivation: 组织普遍认为黑盒部署微调后的公开预训练ASR模型可提供安全保护，但作者发现该假设不成立：在公开基模型上构造的对抗扰动可有效迁移至微调目标模型，严重降低性能，威胁安全关键应用。
AI.method: 提出统一微调框架TransferBreaker，包含三个组件：1) 基对抗微调（Base Adversarial Fine-Tuning），将对抗训练限制于对基模型有效的扰动；2) 潜空间雅可比正则化（Latent Jacobian Regularization），通过抑制对抗敏感方向强制潜空间不变性；3) HybridGrad-AFT，通过插值来自基模型与目标模型的迁移扰动提升对自适应攻击的鲁棒性。作者对各组件进行了理论论证。
AI.result: 在三种语言和四个大型ASR模型上进行评估，对抗WER从92.6降至27.8。
AI.conclusion: 在黑盒部署微调ASR模型存在严重对抗迁移风险，TransferBreaker能有效抑制迁移攻击并显著提升鲁棒性。

title: Not All Uncertainty Matters: Simulation-in-the-Loop Fast-Slow Reasoning for Decision-Critical Autonomous Driving System
summary: Large vision-language models (VLMs) provide powerful open-world perception and reasoning for autonomous driving, but their high computational cost and inference latency make continuous cloud-side use impractical. This motivates fast--slow collaboration, where efficient onboard modules handle real-time perception and control while cloud models provide high-level reasoning only when needed. The key challenge is deciding when cloud reasoning should influence time-critical driving decisions. Existing methods often rely on perception uncertainty, heuristic triggers, or resource-driven policies, without assessing whether resolving an uncertainty will improve planning. We propose \textbf{SIGMA}, a simulation-in-the-loop framework for task-oriented fast--slow collaboration. SIGMA embeds the planner into uncertainty assessment and evaluates how plausible scene realizations under semantic and geometric uncertainty affect feasible trajectories and planning cost. Based on these outcomes, it estimates the expected reduction in planning cost from resolving uncertainty. We further introduce expected planning gain (EPG), a decision-level metric for cloud invocation, cloud-guidance integration, and request prioritization under deadline and resource constraints. Experiments in CARLA show that SIGMA reduces unnecessary cloud interactions while improving planning, efficiency, and navigation success in static and dynamic obstacle scenarios. Compared with fixed-period collaboration, SIGMA reduces unnecessary cloud interactions by 50\%, improves navigation success by more than 6\%, and cuts finish time by up to 26.2\% in dynamic scenarios.

AI.tldr: SIGMA：面向任务的快慢协同框架，通过仿真在环评估不确定性解决对规划成本的预期收益（EPG），决定云端推理何时介入自动驾驶决策。
AI.motivation: 大型视觉语言模型（VLM）具备强大的开放世界感知与推理能力，但计算开销大、推理延迟高，难以持续在云端使用。因此需要快慢协同：车端模块负责实时感知与控制，云端模型仅在必要时提供高层推理。核心难题在于判断云端推理应在何时影响时间敏感的驾驶决策；现有方法依赖感知不确定性、启发式触发或资源驱动策略，未评估"解决该不确定性是否能改善规划"。
AI.method: 提出SIGMA——仿真在环（simulation-in-the-loop）的任务导向快慢协同框架。将规划器嵌入不确定性评估过程，在语义与几何不确定性下生成合理的场景实现，评估其对可行轨迹与规划成本的影响，据此估计"解决不确定性带来的规划成本预期下降量"。进一步提出预期规划收益（EPG, expected planning gain），作为决策级指标，用于云端调用、云引导整合以及截止时间与资源约束下的请求优先级排序。
AI.result: 在CARLA中的实验表明，SIGMA在静态与动态障碍场景下减少了不必要的云端交互，同时改善规划、效率与导航成功率。相比固定周期协同，SIGMA将不必要云端交互减少50%，导航成功率提升6%以上，动态场景下完成时间最多缩短26.2%。
AI.conclusion: 以规划收益（EPG）而非单纯感知不确定性作为云端调用判据，可有效实现任务导向的快慢协同，在保证实时性的同时提升驾驶规划质量与效率。

title: Decoupling Logic from Persona: Structural Immunity of Edge LLM Agents to Context Pollution
comment: 28 pages, 3 figures. Experiment code, scoring rubric, pollution fixtures, adapters and run logs are released (see Appendix G)
summary: Small language-model agents on edge devices must hold a persona and reason correctly at once, inside one context window that fills with conversational history and persona instructions. We study what happens to the logical part of such an agent when that history is long, misleading and persona-heavy (persona-logic interference), and present a Decoupling Architecture (AO-DA) that separates logical inference ("What") from persona expression ("How") into two inference paths on one INT4 base model with hot-swappable LoRA adapters. The logic path receives only the core turn and emits a verifiable structured state (Micro-State); the persona path renders it in character with the full history. In same-base-model ablations on an Apple M2 laptop (Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct and Gemma-3-4B-it, 4-bit; 480 runs over 4 pollution levels x 3 arms x 2 tasks x 2 personas x 5 seeds) we find: (i) the decoupled logic path is structurally invariant to pollution: its prompt stays at 180 (Llama) or 167 (Gemma) tokens while the mixed single-pass prompt grows from 242 to 1,203, and its outputs are byte-identical across levels (40/40); (ii) the mixed single pass degrades monotonically (composite logic score 0.669 to 0.150 on Llama, 0.487 to 0.150 on Gemma), mostly by failing to emit the required structured output (80-95% of runs on Llama, 100% on Gemma at the two highest levels); (iii) with the same pollution fed into the decoupled logic path, the dedicated-adapter, dedicated-format path is still more robust than the single pass on the 8B model (failure 0-20% vs 80-95%; paired $Δ$ +0.30 to +0.50, Cliff's $δ$ 0.50-0.85, Holm-adjusted $p \le 0.03$) but not on the 4B model, where both collapse. Separation costs one extra decode on a topic's first turn (28.2 s vs 18.2 s on Llama) and buys persona hot-swapping in 1.7 ms without re-running the logic path. Code, rubric, fixtures, adapters and logs are released.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出解耦架构AO-DA，将小语言模型智能体的逻辑推理（What）与人格表达（How）分离到同一INT4基座模型的两条推理路径，通过可热插拔LoRA适配器实现，在边缘设备上验证了解耦逻辑路径对历史污染具有结构不变性。
AI.motivation: 边缘设备上的小语言模型智能体需在同一上下文窗口中同时维持人格并进行正确推理，而不断累积的对话历史与人格指令会挤占逻辑推理空间。作者研究长、误导性强且人格密集的历史对智能体逻辑部分的干扰（人格-逻辑干扰），旨在解决二者相互冲突的问题。
AI.method: 提出解耦架构AO-DA，在同一INT4基座模型上用可热插拔LoRA适配器将逻辑推理（What）与人格表达（How）分为两条推理路径：逻辑路径仅接收核心对话轮并输出可验证的结构化状态（Micro-State）；人格路径在完整历史下将其以角色化方式渲染。在Apple M2笔记本上进行同基座模型消融实验（Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct与Gemma-3-4B-it，4-bit；480次运行，覆盖4种污染等级×3种实验臂×2个任务×2种人格×5个随机种子）。
AI.result: (i) 解耦逻辑路径对污染具有结构不变性：提示长度恒定（Llama 180词元、Gemma 167词元），而混合单次推理提示从242增至1,203词元，输出在各污染等级下逐字节一致（40/40）；(ii) 混合单次推理单调退化（Llama综合逻辑分从0.669降至0.150，Gemma从0.487降至0.150），主要表现为无法输出所需结构化结果（Llama 80-95%运行失败，Gemma在两个最高等级为100%）；(iii) 相同污染输入解耦逻辑路径时，专属适配器+专属格式路径在8B模型上仍优于单次推理（失败率0-20% vs 80-95%；配对Δ +0.30至+0.50，Cliff's δ 0.50-0.85，Holm校正后p≤0.03），但在4B模型上两者均崩溃。分离代价是主题首轮多一次解码（Llama上28.2秒 vs 18.2秒），换来1.7毫秒的人格热切换且无需重跑逻辑路径。
AI.conclusion: 将逻辑推理与人格表达解耦可有效抵御长历史与人格指令带来的污染，在8B模型上显著提升逻辑鲁棒性并实现低开销的人格热切换，证明了解耦架构在边缘设备小语言模型智能体上的可行性与价值；但4B模型上该优势消失，存在模型规模依赖的局限。作者开源了代码、评分量表、固定装置、适配器与日志。

title: Closing the Loop on Contrail Avoidance with Satellite Verification
comment: Accepted into Tackling Climate Change with Machine Learning: workshop at NeurIPS 2026
summary: Contrails are the thin ice clouds that aircraft leave behind. They cause a large share of aviation's warming, and rerouting the few flights that produce them could avoid much of it. However, an avoided contrail only counts if a satellite can confirm that it never formed, and this check is hard: contrails are one to two pixels wide, cover only 0.18% of pixels, and look very similar to natural cirrus. We build a small diffusion model (8.4M parameters, trained on one GPU) that detects them, and we run a controlled study to find out which components matter. The model reaches 0.476 PR-AUC, compared with 0.414 for a DeepLabV3+ baseline and 0.119 for an adapted MedSegDiff. Doubling the input resolution of the CNN brings it to parity (0.499, p=0.07). Three lessons apply beyond contrails. First, check the input resolution before designing a new architecture. Second, simple flips and rotations more than double accuracy and matter more than any architectural choice we measured. Third, pretraining the model on contrail shapes is harmful: the model learns that thin strokes appear everywhere and paints them onto empty scenes. Precision collapses to 1% while recall-based metrics still rate the degraded model as excellent, and no threshold or guidance heuristic repairs this failure.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个仅8.4M参数的小型扩散模型用于卫星图像中的凝结尾迹检测，并开展受控消融实验，发现输入分辨率、简单数据增广比架构选择更重要，而基于凝结尾迹形状的预训练反而有害。
AI.motivation: 凝结尾迹（飞机留下的薄冰云）导致航空业很大一部分变暖效应，改航产生尾迹的少数航班可避免大部分影响。但"避免的尾迹"必须由卫星确认其从未形成，而该检测极难：尾迹仅1–2像素宽、只覆盖0.18%的像素，且与自然卷云高度相似。
AI.method: 构建一个小型扩散模型（8.4M参数，单GPU训练）进行凝结尾迹检测，并开展受控研究以确定各组件的重要性；与DeepLabV3+基线和改造后的MedSegDiff进行比较，并测试将CNN输入分辨率加倍的效果。
AI.result: 模型达到0.476 PR-AUC，优于DeepLabV3+（0.414）和改编版MedSegDiff（0.119）。将CNN输入分辨率加倍后达到持平水平（0.499，p=0.07）。简单翻转和旋转增广可使准确率提升一倍以上；基于尾迹形状的预训练有害，模型会学到细笔画无处不在并将其绘制到空白场景，精确率崩塌至1%，而基于召回率的指标仍将退化模型评为极优，且无阈值或引导启发式可修复该失败。
AI.conclusion: 三条结论可推广至尾迹之外：第一，设计新架构前应先核查输入分辨率；第二，简单的翻转与旋转增广可将准确率提升一倍以上，比任何所测架构选择都更重要；第三，基于尾迹形状的预训练有害，且召回率导向的指标会掩盖精确率的崩塌。

title: FreeEvolve: Learning to Evolve Beyond Fixed Loops
summary: Agent evolvers automate the design of the prompts, skills and workflows around language model agents, yet the optimization process they follow is still designed by hand: a fixed search loop decides how candidates are evaluated, which are kept and when the search stops. We propose FREEEVOLVE, which automates this process as well. An environment specifies the goal, target agent, evaluator, data and resource limits; within these limits, the evolver itself decides what to test, how much evidence to collect, which candidates to pursue and when to stop. These decisions follow an editable evolution skill, which we improve through meta-evolution by scoring each candidate skill on the fresh target agent it produces. The optimization process thus becomes a capability learned from experience rather than a loop engineered in advance. On tau3-bench, ARC-AGI-2, ARC-AGI-3 and Terminal-Bench 2.1, FREEEVOLVE controls the evolution campaign by itself, yet improves the primary held-out metric by 13.6 points on average and matches or exceeds hand-designed evolvers. The learned process keeps improving with experience: meta-evolved skills add 6.9 points over the seed skill on fresh target agents, demonstrating transferability across environments.

AI.tldr: FREEEVOLVE 将 agent evolvers 中原本手工设计的优化搜索循环本身也自动化：在该框架下，evolver 在给定目标、被优化 agent、评估器、数据与资源限制下，自主决定测试什么、收集多少证据、保留哪些候选以及何时停止，且这些决策遵循一个可编辑的 evolution skill，并通过元进化在新鲜目标 agent 上打分来改进该 skill，使优化过程成为从经验中习得的能力。实验表明其能自主掌控进化过程并平均提升 13.6 分，还具备跨环境迁移性。
AI.motivation: 现有 agent evolvers 虽能自动设计语言模型 agent 的 prompt、技能与工作流，但其优化过程仍由人工设计：固定的搜索循环预先决定候选评估方式、保留策略与停止条件。作者希望进一步自动化这一过程本身，使优化循环不再依赖人工预先设计的固定流程。
AI.method: 提出 FREEEVOLVE。环境指定目标、目标 agent、评估器、数据与资源限制；在此限制内，evolver 自主决定测试什么、收集多少证据、追求哪些候选以及何时停止。这些决策遵循一个可编辑的 evolution skill，并通过元进化改进该 skill——依据每个候选 skill 在新目标 agent 上产生的效果进行评分。由此优化过程成为从经验中习得的能力，而非预先工程化的固定循环。
AI.result: 在 tau3-bench、ARC-AGI-2、ARC-AGI-3 与 Terminal-Bench 2.1 上，FREEEVOLVE 能自行掌控进化活动，同时在主要 held-out 指标上平均提升 13.6 分，并达到或超过手工设计的 evolvers。所学过程随经验持续改进：元进化后的 skill 在新目标 agent 上比种子 skill 再提升 6.9 分，显示出跨环境的可迁移性。
AI.conclusion: FREEEVOLVE 将 agent evolver 的优化过程本身自动化，通过元进化习得的 evolution skill 替代手工设计的固定搜索循环，在多基准上优于或匹敌手工设计方法，并能跨环境迁移、随经验持续改进。

title: The Deceptive Bandit Problem: Exploratory Coupling and the Fragility of Multi-Agent Learning
summary: Randomized exploration is central to bandit learning, multi-agent reinforcement learning, and zeroth-order policy search, yet its independence and privacy are usually only treated as technical assumptions. We show that these properties are critical for security purposes and demonstrate how an adversarial agent can exploit privileged information on another agent's exploration. We analyze a deceiver-victim pair in the minimal two-player strongly monotone setting, where a deceptive player obtains leaked signals that are merely correlated with the victim's exploration. We show that, by coupling their own exploratory action with this information, the deceptive player injects an externality that steers the learning dynamics to a new steady state, called the deceptive Nash equilibrium (DNE). We prove that the deceptive bandit learning (DBL) dynamics converge to an arbitrarily small neighborhood of the DNE while retaining optimal convergence rates. Interestingly, our analysis attains these optimal rates while relaxing second-order smoothness conditions from standard bandit optimization literature. We characterize conditions under which deception strictly shifts the steady state and its effect on the deceiver's cost, illustrating the results in a resource-allocation game.

AI.tldr: 本文证明bandit学习中随机探索的独立性与隐私性是关键安全属性：欺骗者利用与受害者探索相关的泄露信号，将学习动力学引向新的“欺骗性纳什均衡”（DNE）。
AI.motivation: 随机探索的独立性与隐私性通常仅被视为技术性假设，本文旨在揭示其对安全性的关键作用，并展示对抗方可如何利用他人探索的特权信息进行攻击。
AI.method: 在最小化的双人强单调博弈中分析“欺骗者—受害者”对：欺骗者获得与受害者探索仅相关的泄露信号，并将其与自身探索动作耦合，从而注入外部性以改变学习动力学；据此建立欺骗性bandit学习（DBL）动力学并分析其收敛性。
AI.result: 证明DBL动力学以任意小邻域收敛到DNE，同时保持最优收敛速率；该最优速率可在放松标准bandit优化文献中二阶光滑性条件下取得。此外刻画了欺骗严格移动稳态的条件及其对欺骗者代价的影响，并在资源分配博弈中给出示例。
AI.conclusion: 随机探索的独立性与隐私性并非无足轻重的假设，而是可被利用来操纵学习均衡的安全漏洞；欺骗者能在不牺牲收敛速率的前提下系统性地偏移稳态并影响自身与受害者的成本。

title: Closed-Form Noise Calibration Against Membership Inference for Random-Allocation DP-SGD
summary: DP-SGD protects training data by adding Gaussian noise to clipped gradients. The amount of noise is usually chosen by running a numerical privacy accountant inside a search. We study DP-SGD with random allocation, where each epoch uses every record once, at a randomly chosen step. For this setting we give a one-line formula that bounds the accuracy of every membership inference attack (MIA) on the trained model. With $M$ steps per epoch, $E$ epochs and noise multiplier $σ$, and with membership and non-membership equally likely a priori, the attack accuracy is at most $\frac12+\frac14\sqrt{(1+(e^{1/σ^2}-1)/M)^E-1}$. The formula comes from the chi-square divergence between a Gaussian distribution and a Gaussian mixture that dominates random allocation. It is interpretable and gives $σ$ in about a microsecond. Where applicable, our formula needs at most about half the noise of the state-of-the-art closed-form bound. To measure how close the bound is, we also derive an exact expression for the attack accuracy of these two distributions and evaluate it numerically. Calibrating to this exact expression requires $13.0\%$ to $20.2\%$ less noise than the formula in our main experiments, and since it is exact, no accountant that knows only $M$, $E$ and $σ$ can certify a smaller $σ$. In training, the resulting $σ$ outperforms the formula and matches a published accountant in test accuracy. It is found in seconds and certified in minutes, whereas every search we ran with that accountant took longer or returned at least $0.62\%$ more noise. We show that MIAs on the trained models stay below the bound.

AI.tldr: 本文研究随机分配（每个epoch每条记录使用一次、于随机选取的step）下的DP-SGD，给出一个一行公式上界任何成员推断攻击（MIA）的准确率，并推导出精确表达式用于标定噪声。
AI.motivation: DP-SGD通过向裁剪梯度加高斯噪声保护训练数据，噪声量通常要靠搜索中的数值隐私会计（accountant）确定，过程缓慢且可能过度加噪。作者希望在随机分配这一实际setting下，给出可解释、计算极快且更紧的隐私上界，减少所需噪声。
AI.method: 利用高斯分布与一个支配随机分配的混合高斯分布之间的卡方散度，推导出一行闭式公式：在成员与非成员先验等概率下，攻击准确率不超过 1/2 + 1/4·sqrt((1+(e^{1/σ²}−1)/M)^E − 1)，其中M为每epoch步数、E为epoch数、σ为噪声乘子。同时推导这两个分布的精确攻击准确率表达式并数值评估，用于标定。
AI.result: 该公式约微秒级即得σ，可解释；在适用场景下所需噪声至多约为最先进闭式界的一半。标定到精确表达式在主实验中比公式少需13.0%–20.2%噪声，且因精确，任何仅知M、E、σ的会计都无法认证更小的σ。训练时所得σ优于公式并与公开会计的测试精度相当，数秒求得、数分钟认证，而该会计每次搜索更慢或至少多0.62%噪声。实验显示训练模型的MIA准确率保持在界内。
AI.conclusion: 随机分配DP-SGD存在一个简单、可解释、计算极快的MIA准确率上界；结合精确表达式可进一步收紧σ，在效率与噪声量上优于基于搜索的数值会计，且理论上界在实际攻击中被验证成立。

title: Contact-Aware Imitation Learning Through Contact Factorization
summary: Generalizable contact-rich manipulation requires robots to preserve intended task behavior while adapting its physical realization to changing contact conditions. However, interaction forces can vary substantially with small changes in surface geometry, orientation, and friction, making policies trained directly on raw force measurements difficult to transfer beyond demonstrated conditions. We introduce FACE, a contact-factorized imitation learning framework that separates intended task behavior from environment-dependent contact factors. Our representation expresses interaction forces in normalized, contact-relative coordinates, while a learned contact-normal estimator and an online friction estimator infer the local contact normal and effective friction scale. Together, these estimators enable force observations to be encoded and policy outputs to be decoded into physical motion and force commands during execution. In this way, FACE adapts execution to current contact conditions while preserving the intended task behavior, without updating the policy parameters. We evaluate FACE on real-robot contact-rich manipulation under unseen variations in surface properties and geometry, demonstrating robust generalization across contact conditions through controlled comparisons with variants that adapt prior approaches to our setting. Videos and additional materials can be found on the project page: https://rcilab.khu.ac.kr/face.

AI.tldr: FACE 是一个接触因素分解的模仿学习框架，通过将力观测表达在归一化的接触相对坐标中，并在线估计接触法向与有效摩擦尺度，使机器人无需更新策略参数即可在变化的接触条件下保持任务行为并实现泛化。
AI.motivation: 接触丰富操作的可泛化性要求机器人在保持任务意图的同时适应物理实现的变化。但交互力对表面几何、朝向和摩擦的微小变化极为敏感，直接在原始力测量上训练的策略难以迁移到示教条件之外，因此需要一种解耦任务行为与环境相关接触因素的表示方法。
AI.method: 提出 FACE 框架，将交互力表达在归一化的接触相对坐标系中；引入学习到的接触法向估计器和在线摩擦估计器，分别推断局部接触法向与有效摩擦尺度；借助这两个估计器，在推理时对力观测进行编码，并将策略输出解码为物理运动与力指令。该机制在不更新策略参数的前提下，使执行适配当前接触条件而保持任务行为。
AI.result: 在真实机器人接触丰富操作任务上，针对未见过的表面属性和几何变化进行评估；通过与将先前方法适配到该设定的变体进行受控对比，FACC 展现出跨接触条件的稳健泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 将任务意图与环境相关接触因素显式分解，并结合在线接触法向与摩擦估计，是实现接触丰富操作泛化的一条有效途径，能够在无需策略重训练的情况下适应新的接触条件。

title: Judging in Latent Space: Efficient Generative Reward Modeling via Semantics-Preserving Compression
summary: Reward modeling often requires jointly representing and reasoning over multiple evaluation criteria, yet verbalizing this process token by token can incur substantial inference cost. Recent work on latent reasoning suggests that continuous states may support this computation more compactly. We introduce LatentGRM, a latent evaluation framework built on semantic chunking, compression, and reconstruction. By using the structure of rubric-guided evaluations to guide compression, LatentGRM learns compact continuous trajectories that support autonomous pairwise judgments without generating textual assessments. A separate interpreter reconstructs evaluation text from these trajectories, providing an offline view of the information retained under compression. Under matched training data and backbones, LatentGRM achieves competitive aggregate preference accuracy relative to explicit Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) judges at both 4B and 8B scales. Across four benchmark domains, LatentGRM-8B compresses evaluation trajectories by 8.9--9.2x and reduces total judge inference time by 6.1--7.0x at vote@5. Controlled rubric interventions show that criterion-dependent preference information is carried through the latent sequence. Together, these results demonstrate that continuous latent evaluation can substantially reduce inference cost while preserving competitive judgment quality.

AI.tldr: 提出LatentGRM，一种基于语义分块、压缩与重建的潜在评估框架，用连续隐状态轨迹替代逐token文本评估，在保持竞争性判断质量的同时大幅降低推理成本。
AI.motivation: 奖励建模通常需要联合表示并推理多个评估标准，而逐token地将这一过程言语化（verbalize）会带来巨大的推理开销。近期潜在推理研究表明连续状态或许能更紧凑地承载这类计算，因此本文探索用连续潜在评估替代显式文本评估。
AI.method: LatentGRM基于语义分块（semantic chunking）、压缩与重建构建。利用评分标准引导评估的结构来指导压缩，学习紧凑的连续轨迹，从而在无需生成文本评估的情况下自主完成成对判断；另设独立解释器（interpreter）从这些轨迹重建评估文本，以离线方式呈现压缩后保留的信息。
AI.result: 在匹配的训练数据和骨干网络下，LatentGRM在4B与8B规模上均取得与显式SFT评判器相当的总体偏好准确率。在四个基准领域，LatentGRM-8B在vote@5下将评估轨迹压缩8.9–9.2倍，并将评判总推理时间降低6.1–7.0倍。受控评分标准干预实验表明，依赖标准的偏好信息确实通过潜在序列传递。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明连续潜在评估能够在保持竞争性判断质量的同时显著降低推理成本，验证了以隐状态轨迹承载多标准推理的可行性。

title: Unified Multi-plane Autoregressive Diffusion for 3D Multi-contrast MRI Synthesis
summary: Acquiring a complete set of magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) contrasts is time-intensive and uncomfortable for patients, despite the diagnostic value of multi-contrast imaging. This motivates synthesizing missing contrasts from those already acquired, which is an inherently 3D problem requiring anatomical coherence across axial, sagittal, and coronal planes. However, fully 3D generative models are often impracti- cal under computational resources that scale cubically with volume size. We propose a unified Multi-Plane Autoregressive Diffusion (MPAD), a latent diffusion framework that achieves full-volume 3D synthesis using efficient plane-wise 2D operations while preserving volumetric coherence. A 3D autoencoder first compresses MRI scans into an isotropic 3D la- tent representation. A 2D diffusion model is then trained to reconstruct masked latent slices of the target contrast, conditioned on both source- contrast slices and unmasked target-contrast slices. During inference, we introduce plane-wise autoregressive synthesis with inter-plane priors. Slices are generated autoregressively in random order within one plane orientation to maintain intra-plane continuity, then propagated as con- ditioning priors to orthogonal plane orientations to enforce inter-plane consistency. Compared to 3D latent diffusion baselines, MPAD reduces training and inference FLOPs by 7x and 3x, respectively, while also lowering inference time and peak memory consumption. Experiments on multiple datasets demonstrate that MPAD achieves superior perfor- mance, generating high-fidelity 3D volumes and supporting one-to-many translation within a single unified model.

AI.tldr: 提出MPAD——一种多平面自回归扩散的潜在扩散框架，用平面级2D操作实现全容积3D MRI对比度合成，兼顾体积连贯性并大幅降低算力开销。
AI.motivation: 完整采集多对比度MRI耗时且增加患者不适，因此希望从已有对比度合成缺失对比度。该任务本质是3D问题，需在轴状、矢状、冠状三个平面上保持解剖连贯性；但完全3D生成模型的计算量随体积呈立方增长，资源上不实用。
AI.method: 1) 用3D自编码器将MRI扫描压缩为各向同性3D潜在表示；2) 训练2D扩散模型重建目标对比度的被掩蔽潜在切片，条件为源对比度切片与未掩蔽的目标对比度切片；3) 推理时提出带层间先验的平面级自回归合成：在单一平面方向内以随机顺序自回归生成切片以保持面内连续性，再将其作为条件先验传播到正交平面方向以约束层间一致性。
AI.result: 相比3D潜在扩散基线，MPAD的训练与推理FLOPs分别降低7倍和3倍，同时缩短推理时间并降低峰值显存占用。在多个数据集上取得更优性能，能生成高保真3D体积，并在单一统一模型中支持一对多翻译。
AI.conclusion: MPAD以平面级2D高效操作实现了保持体积连贯的全容积3D MRI对比度合成，在效率与生成质量上均优于3D潜在扩散基线，并统一支持一对多翻译。

title: Few Bits, One Law: Toward W2A4KV2
summary: Extreme low-bit LLM compression is most challenging when weights, activations, and KV caches are quantized together: their distributions differ, and quantization errors interact throughout the network. We introduce CanonQ, a unified quantization-aware training framework that addresses these challenges by separating source canonicalization from task-aware adaptation. Fixed rotations and energy normalization map heterogeneous tensor sources to canonical coordinates, enabling frozen Gaussian-reference codebooks to be reused across layers and models. Joint training then adapts the network to the coupled errors of weight, activation, and cache quantization within a common scalar/vector interface. We bound frozen-codebook transfer error and local task loss, and derive an exact normalization-aware straight-through Jacobian that links quantization distortion to gradient bias. The strongest gains arise under joint W2A4KV2 compression: across LLaMA3-1B/3B/8B, CanonQ-Omni achieves up to 14.28x lower WikiText-2 perplexity and up to 57.9% higher mean zero-shot accuracy than prior state-of-the-art and representative quantization baselines. The benefits extend to Qwen3-1.7B, code generation, and mathematical reasoning: on instruction-tuned MobileLLM-Pro-1B at W2A16KV16, CanonQ achieves relative improvements of 41.7% in HumanEval pass@1 and 39.1% in GSM8K exact match over the strongest evaluated quantization baseline.

AI.tldr: CanonQ是一个统一的量化感知训练框架，通过源规范化与任务自适应分离，实现权重、激活和KV缓存联合超低比特压缩，在W2A4KV2下显著优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 极端低比特LLM压缩在权重、激活和KV缓存同时量化时最具挑战性：三者分布不同，且量化误差在网络中相互作用。
AI.method: 将源规范化与任务自适应分离：用固定旋转和能量归一化把异构张量源映射到规范坐标，使冻结的高斯参考码本可跨层、跨模型复用；随后联合训练使网络适应权重、激活、缓存量化耦合误差（统一标量/向量接口）。理论方面给出冻结码本迁移误差与局部任务损失的界限，并推导精确的归一化感知直通Jacobian，将量化失真与梯度偏差关联。
AI.result: 在联合W2A4KV2压缩下，CanonQ-Omni在LLaMA3-1B/3B/8B上WikiText-2困惑度最多降低14.28倍，零样本平均准确率最多提升57.9%，优于先前SOTA及代表性量化基线。Qwen3-1.7B、代码生成与数学推理同样受益：MobileLLM-Pro-1B在W2A16KV16下，HumanEval pass@1相对提升41.7%，GSM8K精确匹配提升39.1%。
AI.conclusion: 规范化坐标与冻结码本复用结合联合训练，可有效应对权重-激活-缓存耦合量化误差，在超低比特LLM压缩中取得显著且可迁移的性能提升。

title: Are Parameter-Efficient Fine-tuning Methods Really Different?
summary: Parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) offers many parameterizations, yet their methodological and functional differences remain unclear. We compare six methods in language and diffusion models to examine how their parameterizations relate to task performance, forgetting, and changes in pretrained weight geometry. Motivated by the spectrum-preserving design of orthogonal fine-tuning (OFT), we first ask whether spectral preservation is itself important for adaptation and retention. We find that the selected LoRA-family methods also approximately preserve pretrained geometry, and that restoring their slightly drifted singular-value spectra largely preserves task performance, questioning the necessity of explicit geometric preservation. Beyond this, we observe that some methods exhibit distinct adaptation--retention trade-offs that vary across settings: LoRA most consistently limits forgetting at competitive performance, DoRA achieves higher mean task scores than LoRA in most comparisons, while PiSSA often incurs greater retention costs. Further intervention experiments suggest that while performance gains from different PEFT methods can be attributed to modifications in different groups of spectral components, we consistently find that restoring dominant rather than intermediate or trailing components produces the largest mean reduction in general-text NLL or base-image drift. Together, these results motivate evaluating geometric constraints through their functional consequences rather than preservation alone. Code is available at https://github.com/Kuaaannn/PEFT_methods.

AI.tldr: 本文系统比较六种PEFT方法（LoRA族等）在语言与扩散模型中的参数化差异，发现谱保持并非适配与保持能力的关键，并提出应通过功能后果而非单纯几何保持来评估几何约束。
AI.motivation: PEFT方法众多，但其方法学与功能层面的差异尚不清晰，尤其不清楚几何保持（如OFT的谱保持设计）对适配与知识保持是否真正必要。
AI.method: 在语言模型与扩散模型上比较六种PEFT方法，考察参数化与任务性能、遗忘、预训练权重几何变化的关系；进行谱恢复干预实验及不同谱成分（主导/中间/尾部）恢复的干预对比。
AI.result: 所选LoRA族方法也近似保持预训练几何；恢复其轻微漂移的奇异值谱基本保持任务性能，说明显式几何保持非必要。LoRA最稳定地限制遗忘且性能有竞争力，DoRA在多数对比中任务均分高于LoRA，PiSSA保持代价更大。恢复主导谱成分（而非中间或尾部）带来通用文本NLL或基础图像漂移的最大平均下降。
AI.conclusion: 不同PEFT方法的性能增益可归因于不同谱成分的修改；应通过几何约束的功能后果而非保持本身来评估这些约束。

title: Efficient Provably Private Classification with a Tabular Foundation Model
summary: Tabular data underpin prediction and decision-making in medicine, finance, government and science, but often contain sensitive individual-level information, creating a need for accurate prediction while preserving privacy. Traditional private learning provides formal privacy guarantees, but requires slow dataset-specific optimisation, suffers substantial utility loss under strong privacy, and is often difficult to apply correctly. Tabular foundation models adapt rapidly to new datasets, but existing models lack formal privacy guarantees, and are highly vulnerable to membership-inference attacks, limiting their use on sensitive data. Here we introduce PrivTab, an easy to use tabular foundation model for differentially private classification that embeds a privacy mechanism within its architecture. Pretrained on simulated datasets, PrivTab uses in-context learning to transform sensitive rows into compact, provably private summaries---effectively learning how to learn under privacy. PrivTab outperforms private linear and neural-network baselines under moderate-to-strong privacy, shows negligible membership leakage, maintains well-calibrated predictions under strong privacy, and reduces dataset fitting time by 10,000 times, requiring only a single forward pass. By combining formal privacy, speed, and easy of use, PrivTab brings recent advances in AI to applications where sensitive individual-level data have limited their adoption.

AI.tldr: PrivTab 是一种内置隐私机制的表格基础模型，通过上下文学习将敏感行转化为可证明私有的摘要，实现高效差分隐私分类。
AI.motivation: 表格数据广泛用于医疗、金融、政府和科学领域的预测与决策，但常含敏感个体信息，需在保证预测准确性的同时保护隐私。传统隐私学习虽有形式化隐私保证，却需要缓慢的数据集专门优化、强隐私下效用损失大且难以正确应用；现有表格基础模型虽能快速适应新数据集，但缺乏形式化隐私保证，且极易受成员推断攻击，限制了其在敏感数据上的使用。
AI.method: 提出 PrivTab，一种易用的差分隐私分类表格基础模型，将隐私机制嵌入模型架构。模型在模拟数据集上预训练，利用上下文学习将敏感行转化为紧凑且可证明私有的摘要，从而"学会在隐私约束下学习"。
AI.result: 在中等至强隐私水平下，PrivTab 优于私有线性与神经网络基线；成员泄漏可忽略；在强隐私下仍保持良好校准的预测；将数据集拟合时间缩短 10,000 倍，仅需单次前向传播。
AI.conclusion: PrivTab 结合形式化隐私、速度与易用性，将AI新进展带入此前因敏感个体数据而受限的应用场景。

title: MagCilia: A Compact Magnetociliary Tactile Sensor with 3D Force Sensing for Robotic Contact Perception and Grasping Feedback
summary: Robotic grasping and surface exploration benefit from simultaneous measurement of normal and tangential forces and from surface information obtained through contact. Here, we present a compact magnetociliary tactile sensor (MagCilia) that combines a flexible magnetic-cilia structure with a Hall sensor for 3D force sensing. Quasi-static finite element analysis is used to investigate structural deformation and magnetic responses under multidirectional loading. To reconstruct forces from the coupled magnetic channels, we propose causal history fusion regression (CHFR), which combines current magnetic-field measurements with their recent changes. Five-fold cross-validation grouped by calibration record yields root-mean-square errors of 0.40, 0.57, and 0.69 N for Fx, Fy, and Fz, respectively, with corresponding coefficients of determination of 0.93, 0.90, and 0.92. Robotic experiments demonstrate tangential-force-guided gripper adjustment and multi-axis load monitoring under external perturbations. Frequency-domain features of the reconstructed forces distinguish six surface categories with 99.39% accuracy in three-fold cross-validation grouped by acquisition session. An online robotic demonstration additionally identifies all six tested surfaces. These results demonstrate 3D force reconstruction, grasping feedback, and surface recognition using a single compact tactile unit.

AI.tldr: 提出紧凑型磁纤毛触觉传感器MagCilia，结合柔性磁纤毛与霍尔传感器实现3D力感知，并通过因果历史融合回归（CHFR）重建三轴力，用于抓取反馈与表面识别。
AI.motivation: 机器人抓取与表面探索需要同时测量法向与切向力，并获取接触表面信息，而单一紧凑触觉单元同时实现3D力感知与表面识别仍具挑战。
AI.method: 设计MagCilia柔性磁纤毛+霍尔传感器的紧凑结构；采用准静态有限元分析研究多向载荷下的结构变形与磁响应；提出因果历史融合回归（CHFR），将当前磁场测量与近期变化量结合以解耦重建力。
AI.result: 按标定记录分组的五折交叉验证中，Fx、Fy、Fz的RMSE分别为0.40、0.57、0.69 N，R²为0.93、0.90、0.92；机器人实验实现切向力引导的夹爪调整与外部扰动下的多轴载荷监测；重建力的频域特征按采集会话分组三折交叉验证对六类表面识别准确率达99.39%，在线演示识别全部六种表面。
AI.conclusion: 单一紧凑触觉单元即可实现3D力重建、抓取反馈与表面识别，验证了磁纤毛触觉传感方案的有效性与集成潜力。

title: MIRROR: From Imitation to Internalization in LLM Personalization
summary: The demand for personalized LLMs is shifting from style imitation toward content quality. We investigate whether self-distillation can bridge this gap in existing fine-tuning paradigm. To address this limitation, we introduce MIRROR(Meta- personalization by Internalizing Reference-Revealed On-policy Reflections), a novel self-distillation framework that shifts LLM personalization from imitation toward preference internalization. First, we replace reference-token imitation with reference-revealed on-policy self-distillation, aligning the model's next-token distributions along its own generation trajectories with those of its reference-conditioned self, thereby internalizing user preferences rather than reproducing reference wording.Second, we introduce MIRROR-F, a focal plug-in that augments on-policy distributional alignment with selective supervision over informative reference tokens, thereby strengthening content generation while preserving user-specific expression. Across three personalized generation benchmarks, two model scales, and complementary reference-based and LLM-based evaluations, MIRROR and MIRROR-F achieve leading overall personalization performance and superior text quality, while exhibiting less catastrophic forgetting than SFT-based baselines on three unseen personalized generation tasks. The gains are consistent across model scales and application scenarios, translating to improved performance in LLM personalization tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出自蒸馏框架MIRROR及插件MIRROR-F，将LLM个性化从参考模仿转向偏好内化，在保持文本质量的同时实现领先的个性化性能并缓解灾难性遗忘。
AI.motivation: 个性化LLM的需求正从风格模仿转向内容质量，然而现有微调范式难以弥合这一差距，论文旨在探究自蒸馏能否弥补该不足。
AI.method: MIRROR通过参考揭示的在线策略自蒸馏，替代参考token模仿，使模型在自身生成轨迹上的下一token分布与参考条件化自身的分布对齐，从而内化用户偏好；MIRROR-F进一步在在线策略分布对齐的基础上，对信息量高的参考token施加选择性监督。
AI.result: 在三个个性化生成基准、两种模型规模和基于参考与基于LLM的互补评估下，MIRROR与MIRROR-F取得领先的整体个性化性能和更优文本质量，且在三个未见个性化生成任务上比SFT基线表现出更少的灾难性遗忘，收益跨模型规模与应用场景一致。
AI.conclusion: 自蒸馏可有效弥合内容质量差距，MIRROR范式将个性化由模仿转向偏好内化，具有跨规模与场景的稳定性，并能提升LLM个性化任务表现。

title: PPCAR-Net: Projection-Refined Parametric 3D Coronary Artery Reconstruction from Sparse X-ray Angiographic Views
comment: 22 pages, 5 figures, 10 tables, including references and appendix. Code and pretrained models: https://github.com/G2304138H/PPCAR-Net . Project page with video results: https://G2304138H.github.io/PPCAR-Net/
summary: Sparse-view 3D coronary reconstruction commonly relies on cross-view correspondence and triangulation, which are vulnerable to vessel overlap and foreshortening, or on volumetric prediction followed by vascular-graph extraction, which does not directly provide centrelines and radii. We introduce PPCAR-Net, a projection-refined parametric coronary artery reconstruction network that directly predicts a branch-structured centreline-and-radius representation without explicit point matching, triangulation, or an intermediate volume. Given a variable number of segmented views, a coarse predictor combines frozen VGGT features with learned branch queries to estimate branch presence, B-spline centreline trajectories, and dense radius profiles. Projection-guided geometry and radius refiners then sample local evidence from the input views and apply residual corrections learned with 3D supervision. We evaluate representation fidelity and sparse-view reconstruction quantitatively and qualitatively. On simulated angiographic masks generated from CT-derived coronary anatomy, PPCAR-Net produces better connected artery reconstructions and achieves strong centreline accuracy, particularly for RCA, while maintaining competitive volumetric overlap. Coarse-to-fine inference takes 121 ms, enabling real-time reconstruction.

AI.tldr: PPCAR-Net：投影精化的参数化冠脉重建网络，无需点匹配/三角化/中间体素，直接预测分支结构的中心线+半径表示，粗到精推理121 ms。
AI.motivation: 稀疏视角3D冠脉重建的两类主流方法各有缺陷：跨视角对应+三角化易受血管重叠与透视缩短影响；体素预测后提取血管图则无法直接给出中心线与半径。
AI.method: 输入可变数量的分割视图，冻结VGGT特征与可学习分支query结合，粗预测器估计分支存在性、B样条中心线轨迹与稠密半径剖面；投影引导的几何与半径精化器从输入视图采样局部证据，并用3D监督学习残差修正。
AI.result: 在由CT冠脉解剖生成的仿真血管造影掩膜上，重建连通性更好，中心线精度高（尤其RCA），体素重叠具竞争力；粗到精推理121 ms，可实时重建。
AI.conclusion: 参数化、免匹配的投影精化框架可直接输出中心线与半径表示，兼顾精度与实时性，适用于稀疏视角冠脉重建。

title: AGAR: a reinforcement learning substrate for LLM program evolution
summary: Given a task and an evaluator, a language model can rewrite a candidate program while a search loop decides which rewrites survive, offering a practical route to algorithm discovery. But that loop is governed by five constants set by hand: which parent to select, how hard to mutate, how to keep diversity, what to remember, and a scalar score that never says which part of the program earned it. Reinforcement learning already has an estimator for each. The obstacle is that program evolution is not usually written down as a decision process. We formalize it as a Markov decision process whose action is the modular prefix the model is conditioned on, rather than the program it emits. Credit assignment, value estimation, adaptive exploration, and experience memory can then attach to distinct components. AGAR (Algorithm Generation As RL) provides the resulting substrate: any estimator can be replaced or switched off without changing the controller, making the transfer auditable one mechanism at a time, with no gradient training of the backend model. Across 19 tasks, two backends, and three seeds under one harness, AGAR improves on the stronger of two published baselines on most tasks, with gains concentrated in the competitive-programming family. The formalization also yields a checkable reading of prior work: these systems are implicitly zero-discount, not by choice, but because fitness is exogenous to an individual rather than a return over successors, leaving a discount factor nothing to act on.

AI.tldr: 该论文将程序进化式算法发现形式化为马尔可夫决策过程（MDP），以"模块化前缀"为动作，使信用分配、价值估计、自适应探索与经验记忆等强化学习机制可模块化替换，提出AGAR框架，在19个任务上优于两个已发表基线。
AI.motivation: 现有"语言模型改写候选程序+搜索循环"的算法发现范式依赖五个手工设定的常数：父代选择、变异强度、多样性维持、记忆内容和标量评分（不指示程序哪部分贡献了分数）。强化学习虽对每一项都有现成估计器，但程序进化通常未被写成决策过程，使得这些估计器无法接入。
AI.method: 将程序进化形式化为MDP，其动作是被模型条件化的模块化前缀（modular prefix），而非模型实际生成的程序。由此信用分配、价值估计、自适应探索和经验记忆可分别附着到不同组件上。基于此构建AGAR（Algorithm Generation As RL）基座：任意估计器可被替换或关闭而不改变控制器，实现对迁移性的逐机制审计，且后端模型无需梯度训练。
AI.result: 在统一测试框架下，覆盖19个任务、2个后端、3个随机种子，AGAR在多数任务上优于两个已发表基线中较强的那一个，增益主要集中在竞赛编程（competitive-programming）任务族。此外，该形式化对先前工作给出可检验的解读：这些系统隐含地是零折扣（zero-discount）的，并非出于选择，而是因为适应度对个体而言是外生的，而非对后继者的回报，使折扣因子无从作用。
AI.conclusion: 将程序进化显式形式化为MDP（动作=条件化前缀）为算法发现提供了可审计、模块化的强化学习基座，AGAR验证了该设计在竞赛编程任务上的有效性，并揭示了既有系统隐含零折扣的成因。

title: Spatial Induction Heads: In-Context Learning of Multidimensional Cellular Automata
comment: Under review at ICLR 2027. Project page: https://kimzemian.github.io/spatial-induction-heads/
summary: Induction heads provide a mechanistic account of in-context learning in sequential data, but existing theory largely assumes that the context relevant to a prediction forms a contiguous block. In multidimensional data, serialization breaks this assumption by scattering spatial neighbors across distant positions in the token sequence. We study how transformers overcome this routing problem in multidimensional stochastic and deterministic cellular automata, where each trajectory is generated by an unknown local rule and presented as a flattened sequence without an explicit coordinate-based spatial inductive bias. We introduce spatial induction heads, two-layer gather-and-match circuits in which the first layer reconstructs the relevant spatial neighborhood and the second matches the resulting configuration against earlier occurrences. We give two explicit realizations of the gather and show that the positional dimension required for spatial routing depends only on the local neighborhood and spatial dimension, not on grid volume or trajectory horizon. We further construct a matching layer which implements Bayesian counting. The end-to-end circuit can approximate the Bayesian posterior arbitrarily closely for stochastic rules and can predict exactly for deterministic rules. Empirically, trained two-layer transformers generalize to unseen rules in one and two dimensional settings, achieving near-perfect deterministic rollouts and less than 0.005 nats KL from the Bayes-optimal predictor on stochastic rules. Attention patterns and layerwise probes align with the predicted gather-and-match computation, providing mechanistic evidence for spatial induction in trained transformers.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究Transformer在多维数据序列化后如何解决“空间路由”问题，提出“空间归纳头”（gather-and-match两阶段电路），并理论证明其可逼近贝叶斯后验、实验验证训练后的两层Transformer可泛化到未见规则。
AI.motivation: 现有归纳头理论假设与预测相关的上下文是连续块，但在多维数据（如元胞自动机）中，序列化会把空间邻居分散到序列的遥远位置，破坏该假设。论文旨在解释并刻画Transformer如何克服这一路由问题。
AI.method: 在多维随机/确定型元胞自动机（无坐标显式空间偏置，轨迹展平为序列）中，提出空间归纳头：第一层重建相关空间邻域（gather），第二层将得到的构型与之前出现进行匹配（match）；给出gather的两种显式实现，以及实现贝叶斯计数的匹配层，构造端到端电路。
