AI.result: 理论：空间路由所需的位置维度仅取决于局部邻域和空间维度，而与网格体积或轨迹长度无关；端到端电路对随机规则可任意逼近贝叶斯后验，对确定型规则可精确预测。实验：训练的两层Transformer在一维、二维设置下泛化到未见规则，确定性rollout近乎完美，随机规则下与贝叶斯最优预测器的KL小于0.005 nats；注意力模式与逐层探针与gather-and-match计算一致。
AI.conclusion: 序列化并不妨碍Transformer学习多维空间结构，空间归纳头提供了机制性解释：通过gather-and-match两阶段电路即可实现近似贝叶斯最优的上下文学习，且具备规则泛化能力。

title: PairAudit: Guiding Human Review with Graph Tokens under Distribution Shift
summary: Intrusion detectors can confidently misclassify attacks that were not seen during training. Human review can correct these errors, but only a limited number of cases can be checked. Uncertainty-based review may overlook confident errors, while anomaly scores alone do not show whether changing the review plan will correct more errors. We introduce PairAudit to find overlooked errors and improve review under a fixed budget. Its graph tokens capture prediction patterns across connected nodes. Rather than building another predictor through feature aggregation, PairAudit uses unusual relational patterns to uncover potential errors in existing predictions. Human feedback then helps decide whether these findings justify changing review priorities. Experiments across security tasks show that PairAudit corrects more errors on average than uncertainty-based review, including more errors on unseen attacks. These gains account for all review costs and do not require retraining the detector.

AI.tldr: PairAudit利用图token捕获节点间预测模式的关系异常，在不重新训练检测器的前提下发现被忽视的错误，并通过人工反馈决定是否调整审查优先级，从而在固定预算下纠正更多错误。
AI.motivation: 入侵检测器会对训练中未见的攻击给出高置信度的错误分类。人工审查可纠正这些错误，但审查数量有限。基于不确定性的审查可能遗漏高置信度错误，而单纯的异常分数无法表明改变审查计划是否能纠正更多错误。
AI.method: PairAudit通过图token捕获相连节点间的预测模式；不采用特征聚合构建新预测器，而是利用异常的关系模式揭示现有预测中的潜在错误；再借助人工反馈判断这些发现是否值得改变审查优先级。
AI.result: 在多项安全任务上，PairAudit平均纠正的错误多于基于不确定性的审查，包括在未见攻击上纠正更多错误；这些收益已计入全部审查成本，且无需重新训练检测器。
AI.conclusion: PairAudit为固定预算下的人机协同审查提供了更有效的错误发现与优先级调整机制，能够揭示被不确定性方法忽视的置信错误，并提升对未见攻击的纠正效果。

title: Targeted Modality Dropout for Real-Robot Manipulation Robust to Intermittent Vision Loss
comment: 7 pages, 5 figures, 2 tables. Submitted to the 2027 IEEE/SICE International Symposium on System Integration (SII 2027)
summary: Imitation learning policies that integrate multiple sensory modalities are prone to overreliance on a dominant modality, such as vision, during training, which can disrupt policy execution when that modality is lost at inference time. In this paper, we introduce Targeted Modality Dropout (TMD), in which the dependence on each modality is estimated using attention and the most dominant modality is selectively dropped. This is combined with entropy regularization over the dependence distribution. Through real-robot evaluation using a bimanual manipulator, we show that under vision loss the success rate of the baseline policy drops substantially, whereas TMD sustains task execution. In contrast, a conventional dropout that selects the dropped modality at random, without the entropy regularization, fails on many tasks even without vision loss.

AI.tldr: 提出Targeted Modality Dropout (TMD)，通过注意力估计各模态依赖度并选择性丢弃主导模态，配合依赖分布的熵正则，提升多模态模仿学习策略在推理时模态缺失下的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 多模态模仿学习策略易过度依赖视觉等主导模态，训练时未加约束，导致推理时该模态丢失会破坏策略执行。
AI.method: TMD：利用注意力估计每个模态的依赖度，选择性丢弃依赖度最高的主导模态；同时引入对依赖分布的熵正则化，避免依赖过度集中。
AI.result: 在双臂机械臂真实机器人实验中，视觉丢失时基线策略成功率大幅下降，而TMD仍能维持任务执行；随机选择丢弃模态且无熵正则的传统dropout即使无视觉丢失也在多任务上失败。
AI.conclusion: 针对性丢弃主导模态并结合熵正则可以有效缓解主导模态过依赖，提升多模态模仿学习在模态缺失场景下的鲁棒性，优于随机dropout。

title: A Deafening Silence: Catastrophic Forgetting Lives in the Output Embeddings of Tokens the Data Never Speaks
summary: Continual pre-training and fine-tuning in Large Language Models (LLMs) inevitably induce catastrophic forgetting, typically mitigated by replay using often-inaccessible original data. In this data-free regime, we analyze where forgetting occurs and why. Systematic parameter freezing across five settings up to 1.4B reveals that forgetting concentrates selectively in the output embeddings of tokens rarely seen in the new corpus, whereas the same sqrt(v-hat) band of the body is inert and new learning resides elsewhere. This localization is governed by the vocabulary deficiency of the corpus rather than the training mode, allowing pre-retraining risk ranking from token counts alone within a fixed base model. Mechanistically, absent tokens receive persistent one-sided softmax gradients that Adam's second-moment (sqrt(v-hat)) normalization amplifies into full-sized updates. We therefore propose an intervention: raising Adam's epsilon exclusively for the output projection during training. Across eight settings spanning 160M to 12B parameters and four model families, this removes 39.4% to 67.9% of forgetting across all seven stable configurations without degrading target learning or requiring per-model tuning. The defense combines additively or better with replay (79.8% on Qwen/Korean) and rescues released-head LoRA from a 23-fold forgetting surge. Because post-hoc editing of the drifted rows recovers under 5% of forgetting, the intervention must operate during training. Our findings indicate that a single-line optimizer adjustment may serve as the primary defense against catastrophic forgetting where the corpus starves the vocabulary.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究无原始数据情况下大语言模型持续预训练/微调中的灾难性遗忘，发现遗忘集中在新语料中罕见词的输出嵌入，并据此提出仅提高输出投影层Adam epsilon的训练期干预，可移除39.4%–67.9%的遗忘。
AI.motivation: 持续预训练与微调会不可避免地导致灾难性遗忘，常用经验回放缓解，但原始数据往往不可获取；因此需要理解在无数据（data-free）条件下遗忘发生在何处、为何发生，并寻找不依赖原始数据的防御手段。
AI.method: 在最多1.4B参数的五个设置中系统冻结参数以定位遗忘；从词汇匮乏角度分析机制，指出缺失词获得持续单边softmax梯度，并被Adam二阶矩归一化放大为满幅更新；提出训练期间仅对输出投影（output projection）提高Adam epsilon的单行优化器干预，并与回放及LoRA结合验证。
AI.result: 遗忘选择性集中在输出嵌入中在新语料罕见出现的token上，而body中对应sqrt(v-hat)带保持惰性，新学习发生在其他位置；该定位由语料词汇匮乏而非训练模式决定，可仅凭token计数进行预训练前的风险排序。干预在160M–12B、四个模型家族、八个设置中移除39.4%–67.9%的遗忘，且不损害目标学习、无需逐模型调参；与回放叠加达79.8%（Qwen/Korean），并使released-head LoRA的23倍遗忘激增得到缓解。事后编辑漂移行仅恢复不到5%的遗忘。
AI.conclusion: 遗忘主要源于语料对词汇的“饥饿”，干预必须在训练期间进行；仅调整优化器一行（提高输出投影Adam epsilon）即可作为语料词汇匮乏场景下对抗灾难性遗忘的主要防御手段。

title: Quantifying Volumetric Risk: Class-Aware Asymmetric Weighted Conformal Prediction for 3D Medical Image Segmentation
summary: Reliable volumetric segmentation is critical for clinical diagnostics, yet foundation models such as MedSAM remain deterministic and lack calibrated uncertainty under distribution shift. Existing conformal prediction methods offer statistical guarantees but are frequently applied in 2D and assume symmetric error distributions, so they do not capture the class-specific biases that arise in 3D multi-class segmentation. We propose Class-Aware Asymmetric Weighted Conformal Prediction (CA-WCP), which combines latent-space density-ratio weighting for covariate shift with directional quantiles for the lower and upper volume bounds, and scales each bound by a class-specific asymmetry factor derived from validation-set false-positive and false-negative rates. We prove that CA-WCP retains the weighted-exchangeability marginal coverage guarantee for every class, and we evaluate it on 3D brain tumor segmentation (BraTS 2020) and on a synthetic multi-organ CT benchmark constructed under covariate shift. On both benchmarks the 95\% Clopper--Pearson interval for the observed coverage of CA-WCP contains the nominal 90\% level for every semantic class, while interval width is reduced by 8--14\% relative to symmetric weighted conformal prediction. We further encode the calibrated intervals into structured prompts for a multimodal large language model to produce uncertainty-conditioned radiology reports, linking distribution-shift-aware uncertainty quantification to interpretable clinical communication.

AI.tldr: 提出类感知非对称加权保形预测（CA-WCP），为3D多类体积分割提供类别级覆盖保证并收窄预测区间，并将校准区间编码为提示用于生成不确定性条件化报告。
AI.motivation: 可靠的体积分割对临床诊断至关重要，但MedSAM等基础模型是确定性的，在分布偏移下缺乏校准的不确定性。现有保形预测虽提供统计保证，却多用于2D且假设误差对称，无法刻画3D多类分割中的类别特异偏差。
AI.method: CA-WCP结合潜空间密度比加权以应对协变量偏移，对体积上下界采用方向性分位数，并按由验证集假阳性率与假阴性率导出的类别非对称因子对每个界进行缩放；理论上证明其对每一类别保持加权可交换的边际覆盖保证。在BraTS 2020脑肿瘤分割与协变量偏移下构造的合成多器官CT基准上评估，并将校准区间编码为结构化提示驱动多模态大模型生成不确定性条件化报告。
AI.result: 在两个基准上，CA-WCP观测覆盖率的95% Clopper–Pearson区间在每个语义类别上均包含名义90%水平；相较对称加权保形预测，区间宽度降低8–14%。
AI.conclusion: CA-WCP在保持类别级加权覆盖保证的同时提升区间紧致性，并通过将校准区间转为结构化提示，将分布偏移感知的不确定性量化与可解释的临床沟通相连接。

title: RLDISCOVER: LLM-driven co-evolution of reinforcement learning algorithms
summary: LLM-guided program evolution has enabled discoveries in mathematics and computational optimization, raising the prospect of reinforcement learning (RL) algorithms that self-evolve to improve how agents learn. However, realizing this prospect faces two obstacles. Joint search over coupled algorithmic components is difficult to scale: simultaneous changes can disrupt learning, while isolated changes overlook their dependencies. Evaluating candidate algorithms also requires costly training, with fitness remaining uncertain across random seeds. We introduce RLDiscover, a framework for the self-evolution of model-free deep RL algorithms. Progressive Co-Evolution advances from targeted component edits to joint evolution, while Progressive Probabilistic Evaluation balances search breadth and evaluation fidelity through staged training and repeated evaluation. Experiments across SAC, PPO, and DQN on four benchmark suites show substantial improvements in mean return, with per-family median gains of 32%-84% and a peak return ratio of approximately 363x over a near-zero baseline. These gains include transitions from failed learning to successful task completion, and improvements persist when evolution starts from stronger open-source implementations. On measured SAC locomotion runs, evaluation uses approximately one-fifteenth the estimated compute required to fully evaluate the same candidate pool. Remarkably, independent searches repeatedly discover interpretable combinations of adaptive robust losses, progress-dependent value targets, and running statistics, with selected programs transferring to unseen tasks. These findings point toward a broader role for self-evolution in AI: discovering interpretable algorithms that improve how agents learn.

AI.tldr: RLDiscover：面向无模型深度RL算法的自演化框架，通过渐进式协同演化与渐进式概率评估，在SAC、PPO、DQN上实现显著回报提升。
AI.motivation: LLM引导的程序演化已在数学与计算优化中展现发现能力，有望催生能自我演化以改进智能体学习方式的强化学习算法。但实现这一前景面临两大障碍：一是耦合算法组件的联合搜索难以扩展，同步修改会破坏学习，孤立修改又忽略组件间依赖；二是候选算法评估需要昂贵训练，且适应度在不同随机种子下存在不确定性。
AI.method: 提出RLDiscover框架，用于无模型深度RL算法的自演化。包含两项机制：渐进式协同演化（Progressive Co-Evolution），从针对性组件编辑逐步过渡到联合演化；渐进式概率评估（Progressive Probabilistic Evaluation），通过分阶段训练与重复评估来平衡搜索广度与评估保真度。
AI.result: 在SAC、PPO、DQN及四个基准套件上，平均回报显著提升，各家族中位数增益为32%–84%，峰值回报比约为近零基线的363倍，包含从学习失败到成功完成任务的转变，且在更强开源实现上起步仍有效。实测SAC运动任务中，评估所用计算约为完整评估同一候选池估计算力的1/15。独立搜索反复发现自适应鲁棒损失、进度依赖价值目标与运行统计的可解释组合，所选程序可迁移至未见任务。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明自演化在AI中具有更广泛作用：可发现能改进智能体学习方式的可解释算法。

title: Domain-informed Adaptive Sampling for Generalizable PINNs in Metal Additive Manufacturing via Conditional Flow Matching
summary: Accurate thermal modeling is essential in metal additive manufacturing (AM) for understanding the process-structure-property chain. Physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) offer effective surrogate thermal modeling by minimizing physics-based residual losses at collocation points. However, prior works typically rely on manually-crafted, static collocation sampling strategies, which are neither principled nor scalable across process conditions, hindering their generalization capability. In this work, we provide theoretical analysis through empirical risk minimization, showing that process condition-aware adaptive sampling is strictly more favorable than conventional static sampling for generalization. Building on this insight, we propose an adaptive sampling strategy within a two-stage framework: (1) a conditional Flow Matching model that learns approximate high-residual distributions across different process conditions, and (2) a mixed sampling strategy combining this distribution with a domain-informed base distribution to generate adaptive collocation points for refining the PINN predictor. Experiments on metal AM numerical benchmarks demonstrate that our method consistently outperforms state-of-the-art PINN baselines, achieving an average 62.1\% reduction in relative $L_2$ error under an identical collocation budget, by capturing process-dependent heat dissipation regions often overlooked in the literature. To the authors' knowledge, this is the first adaptive sampling strategy for PINNs in metal AM, contributing to the enhanced generalization and broader applicability.

AI.tldr: 本文提出面向金属增材制造热建模的条件自适应采样策略，通过条件流匹配学习高残差分布并混合域先验分布生成配置点，显著提升PINN泛化性。
AI.motivation: 金属增材制造中，准确的热建模对理解工艺-结构-性能关系至关重要。PINNs可作有效的替代热建模方法，但现有工作多依赖手工设计的静态配置点采样策略，缺乏原理性且难以跨工艺条件扩展，限制了泛化能力。
AI.method: 通过经验风险最小化进行理论分析，证明工艺条件感知的自适应采样在泛化上严格优于传统静态采样。据此提出两阶段框架下的自适应采样策略：（1）条件Flow Matching模型，学习不同工艺条件下的近似高残差分布；（2）混合采样策略，将该分布与域先验基础分布结合，生成自适应配置点以精炼PINN预测器。
AI.result: 在金属增材制造数值基准上，方法持续优于最先进的PINN基线，在相同配置点预算下平均相对L2误差降低62.1%，并能捕捉文献中常被忽略的工艺相关散热区域。
AI.conclusion: 这是金属增材制造中首个面向PINN的自适应采样策略，有助于提升泛化能力与更广泛的适用性。

title: PatchBench: Measuring Collateral Damage in Activation Patching
comment: Accepted to NeurIPS 2026 (Datasets and Benchmarks Track)
summary: An LLM safety patch can pass a benchmark while still being a poor repair. This risk is especially acute for jailbreak repairs, where the goal is to correct a specific unsafe behaviour without changing unrelated behaviours. A patch may block exact evaluation prompts yet fail on close harmful variants, or suppress harmful behaviour by over-refusing benign prompts that share its wording or structure. Existing protocols primarily test whether models can be broken, while aggregate metrics (attack success, refusal rates, global capability) cannot distinguish selective repairs from broader local suppression. To address this gap, we introduce PatchBench, a benchmark of empirically observed model-specific jailbreak failures inducing actionable harmful answers. Starting from 27,870 prompts from 37 public datasets, we curate 15,314 English prompts and query 8 open-source instruction-tuned models. Combining WildGuard filtering, pairwise Elo ranking, and manual verification, we retain a curated bank of 400 high-confidence jailbreak failures. We further introduce PatchBench-Local, an evaluation protocol testing whether a patch is behaviourally precise. For each harmful source prompt, PatchBench-Local generates three families of local neighbours: harmful variants preserving malicious intent, benign prompts with matched structure, and benign prompts reusing key harmful terms. It evaluates harmful-neighbour correction and benign-neighbour preservation, distinguishing selective repair from broader local suppression. Evaluating four activation steering methods with PatchBench-Local and MMLU shows that global capability can remain nearly unchanged while local benign regressions are severe, confirming aggregate metrics miss important collateral damage. PatchBench-Local provides a more precise basis for developing and comparing jailbreak repair methods.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 PatchBench（含 400 条高置信越狱失败样本的基准）与 PatchBench-Local（局部精度评测协议），用邻居家族区分"选择性修复"与"局部抑制"，并通过激活引导方法验证聚合指标会漏掉严重副作用。
AI.motivation: 现有安全补丁可能通过基准测试却实际修复质量差，尤其针对越狱修复：补丁可能只拦截原始评测提示而在近似有害变体上失效，或通过过度拒答措辞/结构相似的良性提示来抑制有害行为。既有协议主要测试模型"能否被攻破"，而攻击成功率、拒答率、全局能力等聚合指标无法区分选择性修复与范围更广的局部抑制，因此缺少对"行为精确性"的评测。
AI.method: 构建 PatchBench：从 37 个公开数据集的 27,870 条提示出发，筛选出 15,314 条英文提示，查询 8 个开源指令微调模型，结合 WildGuard 过滤、成对 Elo 排序与人工验证，得到 400 条高置信越狱失败样本库。构建 PatchBench-Local 评测协议：为每个有害源提示生成三类局部邻居——保持恶意意图的有害变体、结构匹配的良性提示、复用关键有害词的良性提示；同时评测有害邻居的纠正率与良性邻居的保持率，从而区分选择性修复与局部抑制。用该协议与 MMLU 评估四种激活引导方法。
AI.result: 在四种激活引导方法上，全局能力（MMLU）几乎不变，但局部良性回归严重，确认聚合指标会掩盖重要的附带损害。
AI.conclusion: PatchBench-Local 为越狱修复方法的开发与比较提供了更精确的评测基础，能够区分行为精确的选择性修复与宽泛的局部抑制。

title: Point It, Strike It: Direction-Conditioned Dynamic Manipulation of Deformable Linear Objects
comment: 9 pages, 5 figures, 4 tables. Project Page: https://deformx.github.io/DeformY
summary: Goal-conditioned dynamic manipulation of deformable linear objects has mainly specified goals as positions for a rope tip to reach. Many tasks, however, depend on how the tip arrives. We therefore study single-swing rope striking with goals that specify the tip's 3D position and arrival direction, across the workspace and on different ropes. This is challenging because rope dynamics are hard to model, no demonstrations exist, distinct swings reach the same goal with different reliability, and the sim-to-real gap extends beyond the rope. To address these challenges, we extend the state-of-the-art DLO simulator DeformX with GPU acceleration, a stable Cosserat rod solver, and a cross-flow aerodynamic model, yielding DeformX2.0, which is more than $20{,}000\times$ faster. We then propose TRACE (Trace-rooted Adaptive Cross-Entropy), which generates striking data by warm-starting each new target from the stored swing whose tip path passes closest to it. Its cost penalizes rope bending and abrupt tip motion to favor repeatable swings. A conditional flow-matching policy trained on this data reaches 92.1% accuracy in simulation. Finally, we propose RECAP (Residual Calibration Policy), which fits the simulator's rope and rig parameters to a few calibration swings and adapts actions with a correction policy trained in simulation. On a real robot, across three ropes, RECAP raises success within 5cm from 72% to 87% for position goals, and within 10cm and 10° from 50% to 79% for goals that also specify the arrival direction.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究单次摆动绳索击打任务，目标同时指定绳尖的3D位置与到达方向。作者提出DeformX2.0高速仿真器、TRACE数据生成方法和RECAP实机校准策略，在仿真中达到92.1%精度，并在真实机器人上显著提升多绳索任务成功率。
AI.motivation: 现有可变形线性物体（DLO）的目标条件动态操作多将目标设为绳尖到达的位置，但许多任务（如击打）还取决于绳尖"如何到达"。现有方法面临绳索动力学难建模、缺乏示范数据、相同目标下不同摆动可靠性差异大，以及仿真到现实的差距等问题，因此需要研究同时指定位置与到达方向的目标条件击打。
AI.method: 1) 扩展SOTA DLO仿真器DeformX，加入GPU加速、稳定的Cosserat杆求解器和横流气动模型，得到快逾20000倍的DeformX2.0；2) 提出TRACE（Trace-rooted Adaptive Cross-Entropy），以存储的绳尖路径最接近新目标的摆动作为热启动来生成击打数据，其代价惩罚绳索弯曲和绳尖突变运动以提升可重复性；3) 用该数据训练条件流匹配策略；4) 提出RECAP（Residual Calibration Policy），用少量校准摆动拟合仿真器绳索与装置参数，并在仿真中训练校正策略以适配动作。
AI.result: 仿真中条件流匹配策略达到92.1%准确率；真实机器人上，对三条绳索，RECAP将位置目标5cm内成功率从72%提升至87%，将同时指定到达方向的目标（10cm与10°内）成功率从50%提升至79%。
AI.conclusion: 通过高速可微仿真、路径热启动数据生成与残差校准相结合，可实现兼顾绳尖位置与到达方向目标的单次摆动绳索击打，并有效缩小仿真到现实的差距。

title: Training Advisors for LLM Agents from Task Outcomes
summary: Large language model agents tackle multi-step tasks by interleaving reasoning and tool calls with observations from the environment. Prior work has shown that natural-language feedback can help these agents revise their decisions during task execution. We introduce Caddie, a method for training critics to provide natural-language analysis and advice as agents work through a task. Unlike approaches that rely on step-level labels or reference critiques, Caddie learns from whether the agent ultimately succeeds after receiving the critic's feedback. We optimize the critic through reinforcement learning while keeping the base model frozen. Trained on multi-hop question answering with a single base model, our Qwen3-4B critic improves success rates across four base models of different scales and architectures, including three not used during critic training. On the MuSiQue benchmark, the trained critic improves Qwen3-4B's success rate by more than 25 percentage points, surpassing the performance of Kimi K3 without a critic. The same critic also yields gains on out-of-domain interactive benchmarks, including $τ^3$ and DeepDive, with no additional training. Our results show that agents can decide when to seek help from a critic at inference time and that outcome-based critic training can produce guidance that transfers across base models and task domains.

AI.tldr: 提出 Caddie：用“最终任务是否成功”这一结果信号，通过强化学习训练一个冻结基座之外的评论者（critic），在推理过程中为 LLM 智能体提供自然语言的分析与建议，从而提升多步任务成功率且可跨模型、跨领域迁移。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM 智能体在执行多步任务时交替进行推理与工具调用，自然语言反馈有助于其修正决策；但已有的评论者训练方法依赖逐步标签或参考答案式批评，标注成本高、难以扩展。作者希望仅凭任务最终成败这一稀疏结果信号，训练出能给出自然语言分析与建议的评论者。
AI.method: Caddie 将评论者训练建模为强化学习问题：评论者在智能体执行任务期间生成自然语言分析与建议，训练信号仅为“收到反馈后智能体最终是否成功”，无需逐步级标签或参考批评。优化评论者时保持基座模型冻结；在多跳问答任务上以单一基座模型进行训练。推理阶段允许智能体自行决定何时向评论者求助。
AI.result: 用同一基座模型训练的 Qwen3-4B 评论者，在四种不同规模与架构的基座模型上均提升成功率，其中三种未参与评论者训练。在 MuSiQue 基准上，该评论者使 Qwen3-4B 成功率提升逾 25 个百分点，超过无评论者设置下的 Kimi K3。同一评论者在 τ³、DeepDive 等域外交互式基准上无需额外训练即取得增益。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明：智能体可在推理时自行决定何时求助评论者；基于结果信号的评论者训练能够产生跨基座模型、跨任务领域可迁移的指导，为低成本、可扩展的智能体自我改进提供了新路径。

title: One Frame, Full Heartbeat: ECG-Free Cardiac Cine MRI Synthesis via Phase-Conditioned Flow Matching
summary: Cine cardiovascular magnetic resonance (CMR) analysis relies on multi-frame sequences capturing the full cardiac cycle. However, standard multi-frame acquisition depends heavily on electrocardiogram (ECG) gating and repeated breath-holds, posing challenges in uncooperative populations, resource-limited settings, and temporally corrupted datasets. Existing methods that synthesize full cardiac sequences either rely on explicit ECG signals to parameterize myocardium function, or employ deformable registration without physiological constraints, failing to faithfully reproduce clinically relevant dynamic metrics such as ejection fraction (EF) and ventricular contraction magnitude. We present PhaseFlow, a unified generative framework that overcomes both limitations. PhaseFlow estimates a non-linear cardiac phase signal directly from the input sequence via a segmentation-derived left-ventricular (LV) area curve, capturing the asymmetric dynamics of systole and diastole without any ECG dependency. At inference, this phase signal is provided by a pathology-specific template, informing phase-specific frame generation. A rectified flow model conditioned on the phase and slice position synthesizes the full cardiac motion trajectory in the latent space, decoded into a diffeomorphic displacement field that warps end-diastole pixel intensities directly, eliminating the reconstruction blur often accompanying the variational autoencoder. On the ACDC benchmark, PhaseFlow achieves superior physiological fidelity and image realism, with best LV volume curve $R^2$, structural similarity (SSIM) and generative quality (FID) among all baselines. Ablation studies confirm that each proposed component contributes measurably to the overall performance.

AI.tldr: PhaseFlow：从输入序列估计非线性心动相位信号，结合相位与切片位置条件的整流流模型，在潜空间生成完整心脏运动轨迹并解码为微分同胚位移场，直接形变ED像素强度，无需ECG即可合成全心动周期cine CMR，在ACDC上取得最优生理保真度与图像真实度。
AI.motivation: 标准多帧cine CMR采集依赖ECG门控与反复屏气，在不配合人群、资源受限场景及时间受损数据集中难以实施。现有全心动序列合成方法要么依赖显式ECG参数化心肌功能，要么使用无生理约束的可变形配准，无法忠实复现EF、心室收缩幅度等临床动态指标。
AI.method: 提出统一生成框架PhaseFlow。通过分割导出的LV面积曲线，直接从输入序列估计非线性心动相位信号，捕捉收缩/舒张不对称动力学，无需ECG依赖；推理时相位信号由病理特异性模板提供，实现相位特异帧生成。以相位和切片位置为条件的rectified flow模型在潜空间合成完整心脏运动轨迹，解码为微分同胚位移场，直接形变ED像素强度，消除VAE常见的重建模糊。
AI.result: 在ACDC基准上，PhaseFlow的LV容积曲线R²、结构相似度SSIM及生成质量FID均优于所有基线；消融实验证实各组件对整体性能均有可测贡献。
AI.conclusion: PhaseFlow通过相位信号估计与整流流生成、微分同胚形变的结合，在不依赖ECG的前提下实现高生理保真度的cine CMR合成，为资源受限或不配合场景提供了可行方案。

title: CM-DPO: Constraint-Margin Direct Preference Optimization for LLM Planning
summary: Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) treats all constraint violations equally: a $1 budget overshoot and a $1,000 overshoot induce the same training signal. It is also susceptible to length and style bias when preference pairs come from different model families. We introduce Constraint-Margin DPO (CM-DPO), which replaces DPO's binary preference signal with a continuous margin derived from a deterministic symbolic verifier and scaled by violation severity. Hard and soft constraints are separated through a lexicographic objective, ensuring hard constraints are never traded off against preferences. To supply CM-DPO with bias-reduced training pairs, we generate preference data through procedurally generated constraint profiles (DCCG) and minimal-edit distillation from a reasoning teacher (RT-MED), within a framework we call SynPlan-R. On TravelPlanner, NaturalPlan, and out-of-distribution PlanBench, an 8B model fine-tuned with CM-DPO achieves 89.2% pass rate and 93.4% solve rate, matching multi-agent systems at 13x lower latency while outperforming GPT-4o on unseen Blocksworld by 9.2 points.

AI.tldr: 本文提出约束边际直接偏好优化（CM-DPO），用符号验证器产生的连续严重度边际替代DPO的二值偏好信号，并通过词典序目标分离硬/软约束；配套 SynPlan-R 框架（DCCG、RT-MED）生成低偏差训练对。在 TravelPlanner、NaturalPlan 与分布外 PlanBench 上，8B 模型微调后达 89.2% 通过率、93.4% 求解率，以 13 倍更低延迟匹配多智能体系统，并在未见 Blocksworld 上超 GPT-4o 达 9.2 分。
AI.motivation: 现有 DPO 将约束违反视为同质信号，1 美元与 1000 美元的预算超出产生相同训练梯度；同时当偏好对来自不同模型家族时，易受长度与风格偏置影响，导致约束优化缺乏严重度区分与公平偏好信号。
AI.method: 提出 CM-DPO：以确定性符号验证器导出连续边际并按违规严重度缩放，替代 DPO 的二值偏好；通过词典序目标将硬约束与软约束分离，保证硬约束不被偏好权衡。为提供低偏差训练对，构建 SynPlan-R 框架，含程序化约束剖面生成（DCCG）与推理教师最小编辑蒸馏（RT-MED）。
AI.result: 在 TravelPlanner、NaturalPlan 及分布外 PlanBench 上，经 CM-DPO 微调的 8B 模型取得 89.2% 通过率与 93.4% 求解率；以约 13 倍更低延迟匹配多智能体系统，并在未见 Blocksworld 任务上较 GPT-4o 提升 9.2 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 以严重度感知的连续边际结合硬约束词典序分离，可有效缓解 DPO 的约束同质化与偏好偏置问题；配合 SynPlan-R 的低偏差数据生成，小规模模型可在规划类基准上兼顾高约束满足率、强泛化性与显著推理效率优势。

title: Directional Evidence Guided Search-Space Reduction for Exact DAG Learning
summary: Learning a directed acyclic graph (DAG) from observational data is a challenging combinatorial problem due to the exponential growth in the number of candidate parent-set configurations. Existing exact score-based methods often require computationally intensive combinatorial search, whereas constraint-based methods can become unreliable or computationally demanding as graph size and conditioning-set complexity increase. We develop a non-parametric hybrid framework, referred to as DECO (Directional Evidence-guided Configuration Optimization), that extracts dependency and directional evidence from observation data to construct admissible parent sets prior to exact optimization. It reduces the optimization search space by eliminating empirically unsupported parent configurations while preserving flexibility for all plausible edge orientations. Theoretical analysis establishes an exponential reduction in the admissible parent-set configuration space and quantifies how bounded edge-level omission affects the probability of retaining the true parent structure. Experiments on benchmark Bayesian networks and synthetic discrete and continuous DAGs demonstrate substantial search-space reduction while achieving competitive structure-recovery performance, with favorable structural Hamming distance across many evaluated settings. These results show that directional evidence can provide an effective preprocessing mechanism for reducing the computational burden of exact DAG learning without requiring a fixed parametric structural~model.

AI.tldr: 提出非参数混合框架DECO，利用数据中的依赖与方向证据预先构造可容许父集，在精确优化前指数级缩减搜索空间，同时保持有竞争力的结构恢复性能。
AI.motivation: 从观测数据学习有向无环图（DAG）是组合难题：候选父集配置数量随节点数指数增长。现有精确评分法需要计算密集的组合搜索；约束法在图的规模与条件集复杂度增大时变得不可靠或计算负担沉重。因此需要一个既能大幅降低精确学习计算量、又不依赖固定参数结构模型的预处理机制。
AI.method: 提出非参数混合框架DECO（Directional Evidence-guided Configuration Optimization）：先从观测数据中提取依赖证据与方向性证据，据此剔除经验上不被支持的父节点配置，构造可容许父集（admissible parent sets），再进行精确优化。该方法保留所有可能边方向的灵活性，不要求固定的参数结构模型。理论分析给出可容许父集配置空间呈指数级缩减的结论，并量化了有界边级遗漏对保留真实父结构概率的影响。
AI.result: 在基准贝叶斯网络以及合成的离散、连续DAG上实验表明：搜索空间得到大幅缩减，同时结构恢复性能具竞争力，在多数评测设置下取得较优的结构汉明距离（SHD）。
AI.conclusion: 方向性证据可作为有效的预处理机制，在无需固定参数结构模型的前提下减轻精确DAG学习的计算负担。

title: Adaptive Code Generation for Controlling Robots
comment: International Symposium on Leveraging Applications of Formal Methods, Verification, and Validation 2026
summary: Deploying robots as Complex Adaptive Systems (CAS) in unknown and dynamic environments necessitates a transition from rigid command libraries toward intention-based autonomy, as natural language represents the only medium capable of articulating complex goals beyond the capacity of finite instruction sets. While Large Language Models (LLMs) offer a path toward natural language goal description, their integration introduces significant challenges: the formalization gap between imprecise intentions and executable actions, the taxonomy gap induced by unpredictable environments, and the challenge of maintaining temporal state and progress awareness. This work introduces an architectural framework that enables robotic control by leveraging generative AI. The system follows a dual-AI design: an LLM translates high-level intentions into executable program code restricted to a formal robotic library and constrained by verifiable syntax, while a Vision-Language Model (VLM) provides semantic grounding via a distillation process. To ensure robustness, the framework incorporates environment-driven replanning triggers based on geometric and semantic thresholds, complemented by continuous runtime monitoring and an adaptive planning loop. Benchmarked across frontier models, our framework architecture demonstrates that grounding generative AI in a reactive, constrained loop enables robust fulfillment of complex intentions in dynamic and unknown environments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种双AI架构框架，用LLM将高层自然语言意图翻译为受形式化机器人库约束的可执行代码，用VLM通过蒸馏提供语义落地，并通过环境驱动的重规划触发与运行时监控实现动态未知环境下的鲁棒机器人控制。
AI.motivation: 将机器人部署为未知动态环境中的复杂自适应系统（CAS）时，需要从刚性命令库转向基于意图的自主性，因为自然语言是唯一能表达超出有限指令集能力的复杂目标的媒介。LLM虽提供了自然语言目标描述的路径，但其集成面临三大挑战：不精确意图与可执行动作之间的形式化鸿沟、不可预测环境引发的分类学鸿沟，以及时序状态与进度感知的维持难题。
AI.method: 框架采用双AI设计：LLM将高层意图翻译为可执行程序代码，代码被限制在形式化机器人库内并受可验证语法约束；VLM通过蒸馏过程提供语义落地。为保证鲁棒性，引入基于几何与语义阈值的环境驱动重规划触发机制，并辅以持续运行时监控与自适应规划循环。框架在前沿模型上进行了基准测试。
AI.result: 在多个前沿模型上的基准测试表明，该框架架构通过将生成式AI锚定在反应式、受约束的闭环中，能够在动态和未知环境中鲁棒地完成复杂意图。
AI.conclusion: 将生成式AI置于反应式、受约束的闭环中有助于实现复杂意图的鲁棒执行，验证了双AI架构在动态未知环境下机器人控制的有效性。

title: Itgan at NADI 2026 shared task: Parameter-Efficient Whisper Adaptation for Robust, Mixed-Dialect and Code-Switched Arabic ASR
summary: We describe the Itgan systems for the three ASR subtasks of NADI 2026, namely robust country-level ASR (1.1), mixed-dialect ASR (1.2), and Tunisian code-switched ASR (1.3). All three share one recipe, Whisper adapted with LoRA on consumer GPUs, and each was carried by a different addition to it. On 1.1, where the dialect label is given at test time, per-dialect specialists continued from a pooled adapter gave the largest gain, and the submitted system reached 57.1% country-average WER. A post-evaluation linear probe on frozen encoder features routes utterances without the label and recovers 44% of what oracle routing gives. On 1.2 the choice of base model mattered more than adapter capacity, and system combination helped only once we added a decorrelated member, reaching 46.7% WER. On 1.3 our system placed second at 14.49% WER with the lowest CER among the leading submissions, 5.38%. Its last 0.60 WER points came without further training, mostly from an exact weight-space average of independently trained runs, with ROVER voting adding the remainder. Every comparison carries a paired-bootstrap test, and we report eight directions that did not work.

AI.tldr: 本文描述了 Itgan 系统参加 NADI 2026 三个 ASR 子任务（稳健国家级 ASR、混合方言 ASR、突尼斯语码转换 ASR）的方案：统一采用在消费级 GPU 上用 LoRA 适配 Whisper 的配方，并针对各子任务做不同扩展。任务 1.1 达到 57.1% 国家级平均 WER；任务 1.2 达到 46.7% WER；任务 1.3 以 14.49% WER 排名第二、CER 5.38% 为领先提交中最低。所有比较均含配对自助法检验，并报告了 8 个无效方向。
AI.motivation: 面向 NADI 2026 的三个阿拉伯语方言相关 ASR 子任务，探索在消费级 GPU 资源约束下，用统一轻量适配配方（LoRA 微调 Whisper）分别提升国家级方言、混合方言与语码转换场景的识别性能，并厘清各子任务中真正有效的改进来源。
AI.method: 三个子任务共用一套配方：在消费级 GPU 上用 LoRA 适配 Whisper。任务 1.1（测试时给定方言标签）在池化适配器基础上继续训练各方言专家模型；并在评测后对冻结编码器特征做线性探针，实现无标签路由。任务 1.2 比较基础模型选择与适配器容量，并采用系统融合（加入去相关成员后才见效）。任务 1.3 在无额外训练情况下，主要通过对独立训练运行做精确权重空间平均，再用 ROVER 投票补足，取得最后 0.60 WER 的改进。所有对比均使用配对自助法检验。
AI.result: 子任务 1.1：提交系统达 57.1% 国家级平均 WER，方言专家相对池化适配器增益最大；后评测线性探针的无标签路由可恢复 oracle 路由收益的 44%。子任务 1.2：基础模型选择比适配器容量更关键，系统融合仅在加入去相关成员后有效，达 46.7% WER。子任务 1.3：以 14.49% WER 位列第二，CER 5.38% 为领先提交中最低；最后 0.60 WER 的改进主要来自精确权重空间平均，其余来自 ROVER 投票。
AI.conclusion: 统一 LoRA-Whisper 配方可通过任务特定扩展适配不同方言 ASR 场景；模型选择、去相关融合与权重空间平均等方法在相应子任务中起关键作用，而无标签路由仅能部分替代标签信息。作者同时报告了 8 个无效方向，并以配对自助法检验保证结论可靠性。

title: TiTok: Audio-Visual LLM for Multi-Segment Temporal Grounding
summary: Audio-visual multi-segment grounding (AV-MSG) in untrimmed videos, reasoning over audio-visual evidence and predicting multiple segments for a query, is a fundamental problem but remains challenging. Visual-only models overlook complementary acoustic cues, while audio-visual models often fail to calibrate the number of events - a phenomenon we refer to as count miscalibration. We present TiTok, an audio-visual large language model (AV-LLM) that localizes an arbitrary number of temporal event segments for each query. For precise boundary prediction, we introduce the Time Token Interleaving (TTI) method, which explicitly injects special time tokens into the audio-visual stream to align input-side temporal perception with output-side temporal prediction. We further propose decoupled, multi-segment-oriented rewards for reinforcement learning, consisting of global, local, count, precision, and format rewards, optimized with Group reward-Decoupled Normalization Policy Optimization (GDPO). To assess the performance on AV-MSG, we establish a new UnAV-100-based evaluation protocol, and propose the CountF1 metric for quantifying count miscalibration that overlap metrics fail to capture. TiTok reaches 65.7 mIoU and 0.58 CountF1, achieving state-of-the-art performance. Our code is available at this link.

AI.tldr: 提出TiTok（音视频大语言模型）解决音视频多片段定位( AV-MSG )中的计数失准问题，通过时间令牌交错(TTI)和多片段解耦强化学习奖励(GDPO)实现任意数量事件片段的定位，达SOTA。
AI.motivation: 音视频多片段定位( AV-MSG )是基础但具挑战性的问题：纯视觉模型忽略声学线索，而音视频模型往往无法校准事件数量，即"计数失准"(count miscalibration)。此外，重叠度量指标无法反映计数失准现象，且缺乏相应评测协议。
AI.method: 1) 提出TiTok，一个音视频大语言模型(AV-LLM)，可为每个查询定位任意数量的时间事件片段；2) 时间令牌交错(TTI)，将特殊时间令牌显式注入音视频流，对齐输入侧时间感知与输出侧时间预测以实现精确边界预测；3) 解耦的多片段强化学习奖励，含全局、局部、计数、精度与格式五类奖励，并用组奖励解耦归一化策略优化(GDPO)进行优化；4) 建立基于UnAV-100的新评测协议并提出CountF1指标量化计数失准。
AI.result: TiTok达到65.7 mIoU与0.58 CountF1，取得当前最优性能(state-of-the-art)。
AI.conclusion: TiTok通过时间令牌交错与解耦多片段强化学习奖励有效解决音视频多片段定位中的计数失准与边界预测问题，并提出CountF1指标与新评测协议，验证了方法的有效性与先进性。

title: Trajectory Abstraction for the Science of Language Agent Behavior
summary: Scientific studies of language agents need behavioral variables that support hypotheses across tasks and models. We formulate this research problem as learning and testing a hierarchy of trajectory abstractions. A concrete recursive procedure first measures role- and phase-indexed events, proposes temporally constrained relations, and tests their stability across conditions. It then constructs episode-level motif variables from selected relations and repeats the analysis on those variables. Explicit measurement functions connect every abstraction level to the original trajectories. Observations and randomized protocol experiments assess the resulting hypotheses, while comparisons between intervention realizations determine whether an abstraction should be retained, refined, or restricted. We derive a finite-depth bound for accepted reductions, identify protocol effects on fixed abstractions, and characterize realization disagreement and composition of abstraction error. A finite-sample test makes projected intervention consistency operational, and constructed examples illustrate motif construction and abstraction refinement. The formulation distinguishes this experimental approach from semantic taxonomies, qualitative theory induction, and behavior-model recovery. It specifies a proposed research procedure for discovering generalizable behavioral hypotheses, with literature-relative novelty assessed separately from model-relative surprise.

AI.tldr: 该文将语言智能体的行为研究形式化为"轨迹抽象层级"的学习与检验问题：通过递归测量角色/阶段事件、提出时序约束关系、检验其跨条件稳定性，再据所选项构造情节级主题变量并重复分析，从而形成可操作的行为假设发现流程。
AI.motivation: 语言智能体的科学研究需要能跨任务、跨模型支持假设检验的行为变量，而现有做法（语义分类学、定性理论归纳、行为模型恢复）难以提供这种可泛化、可检验的抽象变量。
AI.method: 提出一个递归程序：先测量角色与阶段索引的事件，提出时序约束的关系，并检验关系在不同条件下的稳定性；再从被选关系构造情节级主题变量，并在该层级重复上述分析。每个抽象层级都通过显式测量函数与原始轨迹相连，并由观测与随机化协议实验评估假设；通过比较不同干预实现来决定抽象应保留、细化还是受限。
AI.result: 推导出被接受归约的有限深度界，识别协议效应对固定抽象的影响，刻画实现分歧与抽象误差的复合性质；给出使"投影干预一致性"可操作的有限样本检验，并用构造性示例说明主题构造与抽象细化。
AI.conclusion: 该形式化将这一实验路径与语义分类学、定性理论归纳及行为模型恢复区分开来，提出了一套发现可泛化行为假设的研究程序，并把"相对文献的新颖性"与"相对模型的意外性"分开评估。

title: A Cognitive-Aware QML-CRL Framework for Detecting Affinity and Romance-Investment Fraud
summary: We present a hybrid quantum-classical framework that detects affinity and romance-investment fraud by modelling the cognitive biases in a manipulative conversation. In our proposed framework, cognitive biases central to this fraud class are carried by dedicated qubits in a structured parameterized quantum circuit, together with a frame qubit makes the encoding sensitive to the temporal order of manipulative reframing, and a narrative qubit that aggregates co-occurrence through a trainable entanglement layer. The circuit parameters are trained jointly with a classical reinforcement-learning agent that decides, turn by turn, whether to flag the conversation, modeled as an optimal stopping problem. We evaluate the model's performance on synthetic conversations that include hard negatives, legitimate but urgent, and legitimate but pushy sales conversations.

AI.tldr: 提出一种混合量子-经典框架，通过建模操纵性对话中的认知偏差来检测情感与恋爱投资类诈骗。
AI.motivation: 此类诈骗的核心机制是操纵性对话中对受害者认知偏差的利用，而传统方法难以显式建模认知偏差、话语时间顺序与叙事共现等结构性特征。
AI.method: 采用结构化参数化量子电路：以专用量子比特承载该诈骗类别关键的认知偏差，设置"框架量子比特"使编码对操纵性重新框定的时间顺序敏感，设置"叙事量子比特"通过可训练纠缠层聚合共现信息；电路参数与经典强化学习智能体联合训练，智能体以最优停止问题建模，逐轮决定是否标记对话。
AI.result: 在包含困难负样本（合法但紧急、合法但激进推销）的合成对话上进行评估，报告了模型性能。
AI.conclusion: 该框架将认知偏差建模与量子电路表示、强化学习决策相结合，为情感与恋爱投资诈骗检测提供了可对时间顺序与叙事共现敏感的新途径，但评估目前仅基于合成对话。

title: Fast and Robust Teach-and-Repeat Navigation Using MixVPR Visual Place Recognition*
comment: 6 pages, 5 figures, 2025 European Conference on Mobile Robots (ECMR)
summary: Teach-and-repeat navigation systems employing advanced visual place recognition techniques for localization exhibit key attributes for long-term mobile robot navigation, such as the ability to operate in unstructured and dynamic environments. However, existing solutions based on deep-learning techniques are computationally demanding, limiting their applicability. This work introduces a novel and efficient teach-and-repeat system built on the modern visual place recognition method MixVPR. Real-world testing demonstrated its ability to operate both indoors and outdoors, achieving robustness and navigation precision comparable to other state-of-the-art systems. In addition, its lower hardware requirements make it suitable for a wide range of robotic platforms and practical applications.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于MixVPR视觉地点识别方法的高效示教-重复导航系统，在室内外真实环境中实现与现有先进系统相当的鲁棒性与导航精度，同时显著降低硬件需求。
AI.motivation: 现有基于深度学习的示教-重复导航系统虽具备非结构化、动态环境适应能力，但计算开销大，限制了实际部署与应用范围。因此需要一种兼顾性能与效率的方案。
AI.method: 以现代视觉地点识别方法MixVPR为核心构建示教-重复导航系统，通过降低计算与硬件负担实现高效定位，并在真实室内外场景中进行测试验证。
AI.result: 真实环境测试表明系统可同时在室内和室外运行，鲁棒性与导航精度与其他先进系统相当，且硬件需求更低。
AI.conclusion: 该系统适用于多种机器人平台与实际应用场景，为资源受限条件下的长期自主导航提供了可行且高效的解决方案。

title: EASE: Entropy-Adaptive Distribution Shaping for Evading AI-generated Text Detectors
summary: AI-generated text (AIGT) detection can be sensitive to the decoding choices of the source large language model (LLM). We observe that perturbing next-token logits or adjusting sampling temperature can reduce detection performance, providing a clear signal of detector vulnerability to decoding-time distribution changes. Building on this observation, we propose EASE (Entropy-Adaptive Distribution Shaping for Evasion), a training-free and detector-agnostic framework for evading AIGT detectors. EASE computes predictive entropy directly from the source LLM's next-token distribution and uses it to adapt both logit perturbation and sampling temperature, without detector feedback or model fine-tuning. Experiments across three source LLMs and multiple detectors demonstrate consistent reductions in detection performance, with negligible degradation in text quality and negligible inference overhead.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出EASE，一种无需训练、与检测器无关的规避框架，通过基于预测熵的自适应logit扰动与采样温度调整，降低AI生成文本检测器的性能。
AI.motivation: AI生成文本检测对源大语言模型的解码选择较为敏感。作者观察到扰动下一词logit或调整采样温度会降低检测性能，说明检测器对解码阶段分布变化存在脆弱性，因此希望利用这一脆弱性实现规避。
AI.method: EASE（Entropy-Adaptive Distribution Shaping for Evasion）。它直接从源LLM的下一词分布计算预测熵，并据此自适应地同时调整logit扰动和采样温度；不需要检测器反馈，也不需要模型微调，是一种训练无关、检测器无关的方法。
AI.result: 在三个源LLM和多种检测器上的实验表明，检测性能持续下降，同时文本质量损失可忽略，推理开销也可忽略。
AI.conclusion: 通过基于解码分布熵的自适应分布塑造，可以有效规避AIGT检测器，且方法通用、低成本，揭示了当前检测器对解码时分布变化的脆弱性。

title: trACT: temporal revelation Airborne Camera Trap
summary: Effective remote monitoring and surveillance using drones are frequently impeded by severe environmental and thermal clutter, dynamic vegetation, target camouflage, and system latency. Drawing inspiration from the hunting strategies of birds of prey that hover and stabilize their vision to isolate subtle ground motion, we introduce trACT (temporal revelation Airborne Camera Trap), a lightweight, real-time aerial robotics framework designed for autonomous consumer drones. The system integrates Temporal Max Pooling (TMP), a low-level signal processing method that transforms imperceptible movement across a rolling integration window into robust value and time encodings, with self-supervised motion anomaly detection to isolate target motion from background environmental motion caused by wind gusts and drone drift. To overcome mechanical and processing delays, trACT combines motion prediction with automated gimbal-stabilized optical zoom verification and equitable multi-target verification balancing. Extensive real-world field experiments in densely forested wildlife habitats and surveillance scenarios demonstrate that trACT successfully bridges the gap between wide-area aerial monitoring and precise, autonomous target verification under challenging operational conditions.

AI.tldr: trACT 是一个面向消费级无人机的轻量级实时空中机器人框架，融合时序最大池化与自监督运动异常检测，配合陀螺稳定光学变焦自动验证，实现复杂环境下自主目标确认。
AI.motivation: 无人机远程监测常受环境与热噪声、动态植被、目标伪装和系统延迟干扰；受猛禽悬停时稳定视觉以辨识地面微弱运动的捕猎策略启发，作者希望弥合广域空中监测与精确自主目标验证之间的差距。
AI.method: 系统集成时序最大池化（TMP），在滚动积分窗口内将难以察觉的运动转化为鲁棒的值编码与时间编码；结合自监督运动异常检测，将目标运动与大风光流和无人机漂移引起的背景运动分离；为克服机械与处理延迟，结合运动预测、自动陀螺稳定光学变焦验证以及公平的多目标验证调度。
AI.result: 在密林野生动物栖息地和监测场景中进行了大量真实野外实验，trACT 在挑战性工况下成功实现广域空中监测到精确自主目标验证的过渡。
AI.conclusion: trACT 证明低层时序信号处理与自监督异常检测、主动变焦验证相结合，可在消费级无人机上实现鲁棒、实时的自主运动目标监测与确认。

title: The Winner's Curse in LLM Self-Improvement Loops: Selection Noise, Lock-in, and Acceptance Rules
comment: 34 pages, 4 figures, 18 tables; code and saved experimental records included as ancillary files
summary: Self-improving LLM systems propose changes to themselves and keep those that score better on a small evaluation set. We treat this keep-if-better step as selection under measurement noise, model the correlated errors of the candidates in a single decision, and study empirically what happens when the evaluation set is reused. In runs where Qwen models rewrite their own instructions and every candidate is also scored on 600 held-out items, most proposals after the first are harmful, and the model gives the size of the winner's curse of a generation's best candidate. With a prior from a separate pilot, it matches the average overstatement of first-generation commits in native loops, though not setting by setting. In a pre-registered study, the final selection-set score of greedy loops exceeded held-out accuracy by 13 to 20 points with 16 selection items and by 1 to 5 points with 256. Held-out gains grew with the selection set on TREC but not on GSM8K, and the tested acceptance rules did not beat greedy acceptance over whole runs. Gains measured on the selection set also exceeded held-out gains when a current model refined a competent instruction, and in the validation scores of GEPA and MIPROv2. Scoring the starting and the current instruction on 64 items never used for selection removes the average bias of a loop's reported gain, but single estimates remain off by about 6 points. Self-improvement studies should report held-out gains with their uncertainty.

AI.tldr: 将LLM自我改进中的"保留更优候选"步骤建模为测量噪声下的选择问题，实证研究评估集重用导致的收益高估（赢家诅咒）及其随选择集规模的变化。
AI.motivation: 自我改进系统用小规模评估集挑选最优候选，并保留得分更高的版本。这一"择优保留"本质是含噪选择，重用同一评估集会使报告增益产生系统性偏差，而现有研究往往只报告选择集上的增益，缺乏对偏差大小与不确定性的量化。
AI.method: 把候选的相关误差纳入单次决策建模；在Qwen模型改写自身指令的循环中，对所有候选额外用600条留出样本评分，以刻画某一代最佳候选的赢家诅咒规模；用独立试点提供的先验与原生循环中第一代提交的平均高估进行比对；开展预注册研究，比较16条与256条选择项的贪心循环最终选择集得分与留出准确率，并在TREC与GSM8K上考察留出增益随选择集规模的变化，同时测试若干接受规则；进一步在"当前模型精修已有指令"场景以及GEPA、MIPROv2的验证分数中检验选择集增益与留出增益的差距；最后用64条从未用于选择的项目对起始指令与当前指令评分，以校正循环报告增益的平均偏差。
AI.result: 首代之后的多数提案是有害的；模型给出了一代最佳候选赢家诅咒的大小，借助外部先验可以匹配原生循环中第一代提交的平均高估，但逐设置并不吻合。预注册研究中，16条选择项时贪心循环的最终选择集得分比留出准确率高13至20分，256条时高出1至5分；留出增益在TREC上随选择集增大而增长，在GSM8K上则不然；所测接受规则在整段运行上均未超过贪心接受。当当前模型精修一个已有较好指令时，选择集增益同样高于留出增益，GEPA与MIPROv2的验证分数中也有类似现象。用64条未参与选择的项目评分可消除循环报告增益的平均偏差，但单次估计仍约有6分的误差。
AI.conclusion: 自我改进研究应报告留出增益及其不确定性，而非仅报告选择集上的增益；单次较小规模留出评分仍不足以消除个体估计偏差。

title: Noise Your Prompt: Noising Conditioning Tokens in Continuous Diffusion Language Models
comment: Published in Transactions on Machine Learning Research (TMLR), 2026
summary:
We revisit a standard accepted practice in the continuous diffusion language model
  literature of fixing conditioning prompt tokens clean during training.
  We make a very simple modification: also noise the conditioning prompt tokens during training.
  We demonstrate that under this modified training objective, we achieve better generalization
  in combinatorial reasoning tasks such as Sudoku and N-Queens, with the largest gains on harder variants
  ($3.73\% \to 24.65\%$ solve rate on Sudoku Hard), and increased diversity of generated solutions ($50.60\% \to 73.79\%$ coverage on
  10x10 N-Queens). We also show measurable improvements to natural language generation quality
  in modest dataset regimes with Gigaword summarization, but notably demonstrate that gains do not
  transfer to all natural language tasks (e.g open ended dialogue generation).
  Our method is a single line change to the training objective, requires no additional inference costs by default,
  and provides the flexibility of classifier-free guidance inspired guided sampling. Our
  \href{https://github.com/LateralIntelligence/noise-your-prompt} {code} is publicly available.

AI.tldr: 在连续扩散语言模型训练中，将条件提示词元也加噪（而非保持干净），仅改训练目标一行，即可提升组合推理任务的泛化性与解多样性，并对部分自然语言生成任务有效。
AI.motivation: 连续扩散语言模型文献中普遍将条件提示词元在训练时保持干净，这一惯例减少了模型对含噪条件的适应能力，作者希望检验是否应对条件提示词元一并加噪以提升泛化。
AI.method: 对标准训练目标做单行修改：在训练时也对条件提示词元施加噪声，使其与生成端共享同一加噪过程；无需额外推理开销，并支持类似 classifier-free guidance 的引导采样。
AI.result: 组合推理任务显著提升：Sudoku Hard 解出率 3.73% → 24.65%；10x10 N-Queens 覆盖率 50.60% → 73.79%。Gigaword 摘要等小规模数据集上的自然语言生成质量有可测改进，但增益未迁移到所有自然语言任务（如开放式对话生成）。
AI.conclusion: 对条件提示词元加噪是一种极简且低成本、可能带来显著收益的训练目标修正；但其收益依赖任务类型，并非对所有自然语言生成任务都有效。

title: Design optimization of tendon-driven robots considering tendon wrapping and shortcut
summary: This study proposes a multi-objective optimization method for tendon-driven arm design, addressing the inherent trade-off between joint torque and arm thickness through tendon wrapping and shortcut effects. We formulate the problem to simultaneously maximize torque and minimize thickness, solved using NSGA-II. The algorithm optimizes tendon routing, pulley configurations, and attachment points. Results reveal Pareto-optimal designs with effective moment arm expansion via strategic shortcuts, providing practical guidelines for compact high-torque arms. The optimized configurations demonstrate non-trivial patterns beyond conventional design intuition, offering new insights for engineering efficient robotic systems.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出一种腱驱动机械臂多目标优化方法，通过腱缠绕与捷径效应权衡关节力矩与臂厚，采用NSGA-II求解Pareto最优设计。
AI.motivation: 腱驱动机械臂设计中，关节力矩与臂厚存在固有矛盾（腱缠绕、捷径效应），需要系统化方法在两者间取得平衡。
AI.method: 将问题建模为同时最大化力矩、最小化厚度的多目标优化问题，使用NSGA-II算法，优化腱路径、滑轮配置与附着点。
AI.result: 获得Pareto最优设计，通过策略性捷径有效扩展力矩臂，呈现超越传统设计直觉的非平凡模式。
AI.conclusion: 为紧凑高力矩机械臂提供实用设计准则，并为高效机器人系统工程提供新思路。

title: The Long Road to the Same Answer: Cognitive Bias Under Escalating Reasoning Budgets in Large Language Models
comment: Accepted at the 2026 IEEE 8th International Conference on Cognitive Machine Intelligence (IEEE CogMI 2026). 8 pages, 3 figures, 5 tables. Code and data: https://github.com/obadaKraishan/anchored-minds
summary: Reasoning models allocate extra computation at inference time and present their answers as the product of deliberate thought. If this deliberation works the way dual-process accounts of human cognition suggest, longer thinking should weaken the classic decision biases that fast, intuitive judgment produces. Using 30 vignettes covering six biases (anchoring, framing, loss aversion, escalation of commitment, availability, confirmation) from an established benchmark, we run a dose-response study across four model families, pairing each reasoning model with a matched non-reasoning sibling and requesting thinking ceilings of 0, 1,024, 4,096, and 8,192 tokens, for 12,350 API calls. Because a requested ceiling is not the same as realized deliberation, we use the reasoning tokens each call consumed as the dose. First, reasoning models are not less biased than their siblings; the point estimate leans the other way in every family, but the item-level pooled contrast is not reliable (Delta = +0.031, t(29) = 1.45, p = .157). Second, bias magnitude does not reliably fall as realized deliberation grows: no slope is significantly negative, and where anything moves it is the signed score drifting further from the human direction. Third, anchoring is the only bias in the human direction (d = 1.89). Four of the other five lean the opposite way in all seven models; with five items per bias, that reversal is reliable for framing and directional for escalation of commitment, confirmation, and loss aversion, while availability is absent. A one-line instruction to restate the anchor before answering lowered anchoring on all five anchoring items, which no amount of additional thinking did, although the effect does not reach significance (p = .057). The results argue against treating test-time reasoning as a rationality guarantee and for auditing deployed models bias by bias.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过剂量-反应实验（12,350次API调用）检验推理模型的额外思考是否削弱决策偏差，发现推理模型并不比同族非推理模型偏差更小，偏差幅度也不随实际思考量增加而可靠下降，仅锚定效应方向与人类一致。
AI.motivation: 若推理过程如双加工理论所言，则更长的思考应削弱快速直觉判断带来的经典决策偏差。作者希望检验"测试时推理等于理性保证"这一假设是否成立。
AI.method: 使用涵盖六种偏差（锚定、框架、损失厌恶、承诺升级、可得性、确认）的30个情境题，跨四个模型族进行剂量-反应研究：每个推理模型与匹配的非推理同族模型配对，设定0、1,024、4,096、8,192 tokens的思考上限，共12,350次API调用。以每次调用实际消耗的推理token作为"剂量"，而非请求上限。还测试了"作答前复述锚点"的单行指令。
AI.result: 第一，推理模型并不比同族非推理模型偏差更小，各模型族点估计均偏向反面，但项目层面合并对比不显著（Δ=+0.031, t(29)=1.45, p=.157）。第二，偏差幅度不随实际思考量增加而可靠下降，无显著负斜率，变化之处多为带符号得分进一步偏离人类方向。第三，锚定是唯一与人类方向一致的偏差（d=1.89）；其余五种中有四种在全部七个模型中方向相反，框架效应可靠反转，承诺升级、确认、损失厌恶呈方向性反转，可得性缺失。"作答前复述锚点"指令降低了全部五个锚定题目的锚定效应（额外思考无法做到），但未达显著（p=.057）。
AI.conclusion: 结果不支持将测试时推理视为理性保证，主张对部署模型逐项偏差进行审计。

title: Spatial Latent Reasoning for Embodied Reference Understanding
summary: Pointing-gesture visual grounding requires connecting hand geometry with the visual identity and extent of a referred object. A central challenge for continuous latent reasoning is how to organize these complementary cues into useful intermediate supervision. We propose Spatial Latent Reasoning (SLR), a framework that structures this supervision around an ordered sequence of geometric and visual states. A spatial ray state is supervised by fingertip position and pointing direction, followed by four states aligned with target-region features. To construct the visual targets, we introduce parity pooling, which applies polyphase grouping to average region tokens on four interleaved spatial supports. All states are generated recurrently during training and inference; auxiliary annotations are required only during training. On EgoPoint-Ground, the framework improves mIoU over same-backbone supervised fine-tuning by 2.8, 17.5, and 21.1 percentage points on Qwen3.5-4B, Qwen2.5-VL-7B, and Qwen3-VL-8B, respectively, with improvements on both hard subsets. On YouRefIt, it achieves 77.6% precision at IoU 0.5, a numerical margin of 5.2 percentage points over the reported state of the art under differing evaluation protocols. Ablations support joint geometric and visual supervision on the standard and similar-object sets, and favor parity over three alternative pooling operators on the standard set. These results support task-structured supervision for continuous pointing grounding. We will release the code and supporting materials.

AI.tldr: 提出 Spatial Latent Reasoning (SLR) 框架，用有序的几何与视觉状态序列组织连续潜空间推理的中间监督，并引入 parity pooling 构造视觉目标；在 EgoPoint-Ground 与 YouRefIt 上显著超越监督微调基线。
AI.motivation: 指向手势视觉定位需将手部几何信息与被指目标的视觉身份和范围关联起来。核心挑战在于：在连续潜空间推理中，如何把这些互补线索组织为有用的中间监督信号。
AI.method: SLR 将监督组织为有序的几何与视觉状态序列：先由指尖位置与指向方向监督一个空间射线状态，随后是四个与目标区域特征对齐的状态。为构造视觉目标，提出 parity pooling，利用多相分组在四个交错空间支撑上对区域 token 求平均。所有状态在训练与推理时均递归生成，辅助标注仅训练阶段需要。
AI.result: 在 EgoPoint-Ground 上，相较同骨干监督微调，mIoU 在 Qwen3.5-4B、Qwen2.5-VL-7B、Qwen3-VL-8B 上分别提升 2.8、17.5、21.1 个百分点，且在两个困难子集上均有提升。在 YouRefIt 上达到 IoU 0.5 下 77.6% 精度，较所报告 SOTA 高出 5.2 个百分点（评估协议不同）。消融表明几何与视觉联合监督在标准集与相似目标集上有效，且 parity 优于三种替代池化算子。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持面向任务结构的监督用于连续指向定位；作者将公开代码与相关材料。

title: We Query, Therefore We Compute: On Oracle Computation beyond the Machine, with an Application to Agents
summary:
Agentic systems use large language models (LLMs) to carry out concrete tasks. Prior work often borrows abstractions such as scheduling, caching or isolation piecemeal from operating systems, so the mechanisms it builds share little common ground, and the shared view of the two forms of agentic system, Workflows and Agents, is limited. We construct an abstract machine that provides both.
  We treat the LLM as an Oracle and extend a two-stack pushdown automaton with one instruction, which hands the Oracle a whole stack as its query and appends the answer to that same stack. The machine thus performs two computations, the Oracle's and a Turing-complete one that we call the Priestess. A stack that the program only appends to grows autoregressively, as an agent's context does. Two symmetry breakings, S in storage and T in transitions, make a Priestess program the operating system of the programs the Oracle runs, and produce the Agent and the Workflow as the two placements of a task's program.
  For internally autoregressive Oracles, the two computations synchronize at the end of every answer under certain conditions, and through that synchronization we model caching and analyse scheduling. No guarantee that holds for every Oracle can fix which content crosses between the two computations, but such a guarantee does fix the boundary itself.
  The construction V fits the machine to a von Neumann computer. To show that it is realizable, we propose ArchNights, an extended RISC-V ISA and a Linux-style operating system implementing the machine by design. ArchNights-SE runs on gem5 as a computer system, becomes an agentic system when it runs an LLM as the Oracle, and will be open source.
  Agentic systems can then be designed as computer systems are. With a foundation built and a unified view, future work can share invariants and bounds, each with its conditions.

AI.tldr: 本文将 LLM 视为 Oracle，在双栈下推自动机上扩展一条指令，构造出统一 Workflow 与 Agent 的抽象机，并提出可实现的 ArchNights 系统。
AI.motivation: 现有智能体系统对调度、缓存、隔离等机制的借鉴是零散拼凑的，缺乏统一抽象基础，导致 Workflow 与 Agent 两种形态的共有视图受限。作者希望为智能体系统建立像计算机系统一样统一的理论与实现基础。
AI.method: 将 LLM 抽象为 Oracle，对双栈下推自动机增加一条指令：把整个栈作为查询交给 Oracle，并把回答追加到同一栈。机器因此执行两种计算——Oracle 的计算与被称为 Priestess 的图灵完备计算。仅追加的栈按自回归方式增长，对应智能体的上下文。通过存储上的 S 对称破缺与转移上的 T 对称破缺，使 Priestess 程序成为 Oracle 所运行程序的操作系统，并由此导出 Agent 与 Workflow 作为任务程序的两种放置方式。对内部自回归的 Oracle，两种计算在每次回答结束时于特定条件下同步，借此建模缓存并分析调度。给出把该机器适配到冯·诺依曼计算机的构造 V，并提出 ArchNights：扩展 RISC-V ISA 与 Linux 风格操作系统，ArchNights-SE 可在 gem5 上运行并充当计算机系统，运行 LLM 作为 Oracle 时即为智能体系统，且将开源。
AI.result: 构建了统一的抽象机与对称破缺框架，统一了 Workflow 与 Agent；建立了缓存建模与调度分析机制；明确了跨计算内容传输无法被普适保证所固定、但边界可被固定的结论；提出并规划了可实现的 ArchNights（扩展 RISC-V ISA 与类 Linux 操作系统）。
AI.conclusion: 智能体系统此后可以像计算机系统一样被设计。在已建立的基础与统一视图之上，未来工作可以共享不变量与界（各带其适用条件），从而推动该领域形成可复用的理论框架。

title: Context-aware Attention-based Gaussian Mixture Models for Vehicular Trajectory Prediction
comment: 6 pages, 3 figures. Presented at the 2026 IEEE 104th Vehicular Technology Conference (VTC2026-Fall), Boston, MA, USA, 6-9 September 2026
summary: Reliable and interpretable trajectory prediction is critical for cooperative and autonomous driving in complex and uncertain environments. This paper introduces a Context-Aware Attention-based Gaussian Mixture Model (CAA-GMM) for multimodal, uncertainty-aware motion forecasting. The proposed approach models future motion as a probabilistic mixture conditioned on both scene context and agent dynamics, capturing diverse behavioral modes with interpretable Gaussian components. A lightweight attention mechanism adaptively encodes inter-agent interactions and contextual salience, enabling efficient fusion of rasterized environment cues and motion history in dense traffic scenes. Comprehensive evaluations on the nuScenes and Argoverse 2 datasets demonstrate that CAA-GMM achieves competitive or superior accuracy compared with state-of-the-art raster-based baselines, while maintaining low computational complexity. Ablation analyses confirm the importance of the attention module for robust contextual reasoning and predictive precision. Furthermore, evaluations under imperfect communication and perception conditions highlight the framework's resilience to uncertainty, establishing CAA-GMM as an efficient and scalable solution for cooperative trajectory prediction in intelligent transportation systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CAA-GMM，一种基于上下文感知注意力的高斯混合模型，用于多模态、不确定性感知的轨迹预测，在nuScenes和Argoverse 2上取得与先进栅格化基线相当或更优的精度，同时计算复杂度低，并在通信与感知不完美条件下表现出鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 复杂不确定环境下的协同与自动驾驶需要可靠且可解释的轨迹预测，现有方法在多模态建模、场景上下文融合与计算效率之间难以兼顾。
AI.method: 将未来运动建模为以场景上下文与智能体动力学为条件的概率混合，用可解释的高斯分量捕捉多样行为模式；采用轻量级注意力机制自适应编码智能体间交互与上下文显著性，实现栅格化环境线索与运动历史的高效融合。
AI.result: 在nuScenes和Argoverse 2数据集上，精度与最先进的栅格化基线相当或更优，且计算复杂度低；消融实验证实注意力模块对上下文推理和预测精度的关键作用；在通信与感知不完美条件下展现出对不确定性的韧性。
AI.conclusion: CAA-GMM是一种高效、可扩展的协同轨迹预测方案，适用于智能交通系统。

title: NAViLoss: An Underwater Navigation-Aware Dual-Residual Objective for Physics-Consistent Learning
summary: Autonomous underwater vehicles (AUVs) commonly rely on inertial navigation systems (INS) aided by Doppler velocity logs (DVLs) for reliable underwater navigation. Accurate DVL velocity estimation is therefore essential for successful operation. Recent learning-based methods have demonstrated improved DVL velocity estimation, particularly under degraded measurement conditions. However, their training objectives typically rely on conventional regression losses that are highly sensitive to large residuals and corrupted observations. Additionally, they do not explicitly account for the physical consistency and measurement uncertainty associated with the underlying sensing process. To address these limitations, this paper introduces navigation-aware loss (NAViLoss), a robust and uncertainty-aware objective function for learning-based AUV velocity estimation. NAViLoss jointly penalizes the velocity-estimation residual in the navigation-state domain and the beam-consistency residual in the DVL measurement domain. Its bounded formulation limits the influence of large residuals, while an adaptive mechanism regulates the uncertainty in beam geometry. Furthermore, NAViLoss is integrated with a DeepONet architecture to form a novel NAVi-DeepONet model for seamless estimation of an underwater vehicle's velocity. Lastly, our model is evaluated using approximately 10,000m of semi-synthetic AUV experimental data collected during multiple real-world sea trials. Experimental results demonstrate a 44% improvement in velocity-estimation accuracy compared with conventional and learning-based baselines. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of navigation-aware and uncertainty-adaptive loss design for robust learning-based underwater velocity estimation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出导航感知损失函数 NAViLoss，结合 DeepONet 构建 NAVi-DeepONet 模型，用于 AUV 的 DVL 速度估计，在约 10,000 m 实测半合成数据上较基线提升 44% 的精度。
AI.motivation: AUV 依赖 INS 与 DVL 组合导航，DVL 速度估计精度至关重要。现有学习方法虽在退化测量条件下有所改进，但其训练目标多采用常规回归损失，对大残差和受损观测高度敏感，且未显式建模传感过程的物理一致性与测量不确定性。
AI.method: 提出 NAViLoss，一种鲁棒且不确定性感知的目标函数，同时在导航状态域惩罚速度估计残差、在 DVL 测量域惩罚波束一致性残差；采用有界形式抑制大残差影响，并通过自适应机制调节波束几何中的不确定性。将 NAViLoss 与 DeepONet 架构结合，构成 NAVi-DeepONet 模型进行速度估计。
AI.result: 在多次真实海试采集的约 10,000 m 半合成 AUV 实验数据上评估，速度估计精度较传统与学习型基线提升 44%。
AI.conclusion: 结果验证了导航感知与不确定性自适应损失设计在水下速度鲁棒学习估计中的有效性。

title: Cache the Encoder Within:Compact, Reusable Memory across LLM Queries
summary: Repeated queries over shared documents incur redundant encoding, while caching model states introduces persistent storage costs. Building on CoMem's intermediate-state interface, EncBank treats a pretrained LLM's lower layers as a reusable document encoder and compactly stores their outputs for an adapted upper-layer reader. A self-distilled suffix adapter is shared across storage precisions within each backbone, without quantization-specific retraining. Across five benchmark suites on three Qwen backbones spanning different sizes and full-attention and hybrid architectures, 4-bit storage keeps each reported benchmark aggregate within one score point of native-precision EncBank. In a fixed Qwen3-8B workload, it retains 28.1% of the native-precision persistent GPU store. Separate native-precision controls yield a 1.40x selected-pack prefill speedup over same-evidence, same-adapter text replay, at a 3.12-point RULER accuracy cost. A native-precision Qwen3.8-27B configuration also passes 70 of 89 Terminal-Bench 2.1 tasks. EncBank thus combines reusable computation with compact memory, while task fidelity and end-to-end benefits remain dependent on the workload, preparation costs, and reuse frequency.

AI.tldr: EncBank将预训练LLM下层作为可复用文档编码器，紧凑存储中间状态供上层适配读取器使用，通过自蒸馏后缀适配器跨存储精度共享，在4-bit下保持精度并大幅节省持久化显存。
AI.motivation: 重复查询共享文档导致冗余编码开销，而缓存模型状态又会带来持续增长的存储成本，需在复用计算与压缩内存之间取得平衡。
AI.method: 基于CoMem的中间状态接口，将预训练LLM下层视为可复用文档编码器并紧凑存储其输出；为上层适配读取器设计自蒸馏后缀适配器（self-distilled suffix adapter），在每个骨干内跨存储精度共享，无需针对量化单独重训练。
AI.result: 在三种Qwen骨干（不同规模，含全注意力与混合架构）的五个基准套件上，4-bit存储使各基准聚合分数与原生精度EncBank相差一个分点以内；固定Qwen3-8B负载下保留原生精度持久GPU存储的28.1%；原生精度对照相较同证据同适配器的文本重放实现1.40倍选中包预填充加速，RULER精度代价3.12分；原生精度Qwen3.8-27B配置通过Terminal-Bench 2.1的89个任务中的70个。
AI.conclusion: EncBank结合了可复用计算与紧凑内存，但任务保真度和端到端收益仍依赖于具体工作负载、准备成本与复用频率。

title: Event-Aligned Visual Action Reasoning for World Action Models
summary: World-Action Models (WAMs) utilize future visual prediction as an intermediate reasoning process to guide action generation. However, existing WAMs typically structure visual imagination according to predefined temporal intervals, without explicitly accounting for the different roles of task-critical interactions and connecting transitions. We argue that effective visual foresight should align directly with task-relevant interactions and their corresponding reasoning demands. To this end, we introduce an event-aligned visual action reasoning framework that organizes visual-action prediction around interaction events. Through event-aligned visual-action supervision, WAM learns to generate event-aligned visual context in each imagined rollout, placing greater emphasis on critical state changes that inform action generation. This shapes the visual reasoning granularity according to the underlying interaction dynamics, with detailed reasoning around task-critical events and coarser progression through connecting transitions. Furthermore, we introduce an execution validity head that identifies the valid portion of each predicted action sequence, avoiding redundant actions during chunked inference. Experiments demonstrate a 10.26 percentage point improvement in DOMINO success rate over baseline and competitive performance on RoboTwin 2.0. It also transfers from DOMINO Level 1 to Levels 2 and 3 without target-level adaptation.

AI.tldr: 提出事件对齐的视觉-动作推理框架（Event-Aligned WAM），围绕交互事件组织视觉想象与动作预测，并引入执行有效性头以去除分块推理中的冗余动作，在DOMINO上成功率提升10.26个百分点且在RoboTwin 2.0上具竞争力。
AI.motivation: 现有World-Action Models（WAMs）按预设时间间隔进行未来视觉预测，未区分任务关键交互与过渡连接段的不同作用，导致视觉想象粒度与任务推理需求不匹配，且分块推理中存在冗余动作。
AI.method: 以交互事件为组织单元的事件对齐视觉-动作推理框架：通过事件对齐的视觉-动作监督，使WAM在每次想象推演中生成事件对齐的视觉上下文，按交互动态决定推理粒度（关键事件处细粒度推理、过渡段粗粒度推进）；并引入执行有效性头（execution validity head）识别每个预测动作序列的有效部分，抑制分块推理中的冗余动作。
AI.result: 在DOMINO上成功率较基线提升10.26个百分点，在RoboTwin 2.0上达到有竞争力的性能；并可从DOMINO Level 1无目标层级适配地迁移至Levels 2和3。
AI.conclusion: 有效的视觉预见应与任务相关交互及其推理需求直接对齐；事件对齐的监督可自适应调节视觉推理粒度并提升动作生成质量，执行有效性头进一步提升分块推理效率，且方法具备跨难度层级的泛化能力。

title: RT-Safe: Benchmarking Agent Safety in Real-Time Embodied Environment
summary: Rapid progress in AI agents has brought growing attention to agent safety, with extensive evaluation focused on digital environments. As agents move into the physical world, embodied safety becomes increasingly important: failures can cause human injury and costly hardware damage. Beyond selecting safe actions, embodied agents must also operate under real-time constraints: the physical world does not pause while an agent reasons. As pedestrians move and vehicles approach during inference, an action that appears safe at observation time may become unsafe before execution. Real-time embodied safety therefore depends on both decision quality and decision latency. We introduce RT-SAFE, a simulated urban benchmark for evaluating embodied-agent safety under real-time constraints. RT-SAFE combines navigation tasks with moving actors, environmental hazards, and traffic rules, while allowing the world to evolve throughout inference and action execution. Across eight VLMs, agents achieve high task completion yet almost never complete safely: in the hardest setting, only 0.7% of episodes finish without a safety event. More strikingly, matched static and real-time evaluations yield task completion rates of 91.3% and 94.1%, respectively, while real-time execution increases collisions by $12.3\times$. These results reveal that standard task success can mask substantial safety failures, and that decision latency itself can become a source of physical risk. Finally, we show that RT-SAFE can support offline RL training and substantially reduce collision rates while achieving strong task completion.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 RT-SAFE——一个面向具身智能体实时安全评测的模拟城市基准，揭示标准任务成功率会掩盖严重的安全失效，且决策延迟本身即为物理风险来源。
AI.motivation: AI 智能体正从数字环境走向物理世界，具身安全愈发关键（失败可致人受伤与硬件损毁）。除选择安全动作外，智能体还必须满足实时约束：物理世界不会因推理而暂停，行人移动、车辆逼近会使"观测时安全"的动作在执行前变得不安全。因此实时具身安全同时取决于决策质量与决策延迟，而现有评测多聚焦数字环境，缺乏对此的基准。
AI.method: 构建 RT-SAFE 模拟城市基准，用于在实时约束下评测具身智能体安全。任务为导航，融入移动行为体、环境危险与交通规则，并允许世界在推理与动作执行期间持续演化。在八个 VLM 上开展评测，并设置静态与实时匹配对照，还可支持离线 RL 训练。
AI.result: 八个 VLM 任务完成率高，但几乎无法安全完成：最难设置下仅 0.7% 的回合无安全事件。静态与实时评测任务完成率分别达 91.3% 与 94.1%，而实时执行使碰撞增加 12.3 倍。RT-SAFE 可支撑离线 RL 训练，显著降低碰撞率并保持强任务完成。
AI.conclusion: 标准任务成功指标会掩盖实质性的安全失效；决策延迟本身可成为物理风险来源。RT-SAFE 为实时具身安全评测与训练提供了有效平台。

title: LayerRoPE: Dynamic Depth-wise Magnitude & Angular Superposition
summary: As data propagates through a Transformer, the norm of its hidden states grows by orders of magnitude with depth, a phenomenon framed as 'curse of depth' and nearly universally treated as a pathology to be suppressed. We take the opposite view. Across 16 pre-trained LLMs from 9 families, spanning dense, mixture-of-experts and hybrid architectures and Pre-, Peri- and Post-Norm designs, we find that this growth reflects an emergent depth-positional encoding, carried by the only learned per-layer gain on the residual stream, the normalization weight $γ$: with depth, $γ$ grows in magnitude and rotates in direction, jointly encoding the layer index. We make this depth-conditioned encoding explicit with LayerRoPE, an implicit analog of RoPE along the depth axis, which replaces all layerwise $γ$ vectors with a single shared vector and depth-conditioned scalars, at a net reduction in parameters and $<0.02\%$ change in FLOPs. Across a model ladder scaled up to $100$B+ tokens, LayerRoPE consistently outperforms Pre-, Post- and Peri-Norm and Layer-Norm Scaling, reaching Pre-Norm's 1.3B loss with $3.4\times$ less compute; LayerRoPE is the only approach that shows strong convergence and improves near monotonically as depth scales to 512 layers. It improves learning-rate sensitivity by $3$-$10\times$, and transfers naively to and consistently improves looped latent models and Vision Transformers. Inspecting its learned schedule inverts the prevailing premise: LayerRoPE does not shrink the residual stream but widens it, damping what each block reads while amplifying what it writes. Depth stability, our results suggest, calls not for suppressing the residual stream, but for depth-conditioned regulation of the computational blocks it feeds.

AI.tldr: 该论文重新审视Transformer中隐藏态范数随深度激增的"深度诅咒"现象，提出它并非病理，而是由归一化权重γ承载的涌现式深度位置编码，并据此设计LayerRoPE，用共享向量加深度条件标量替代逐层γ，在更少参数和极低FLOPs开销下显著提升深层网络的收敛与性能。
AI.motivation: 主流观点将Transformer隐藏态范数随深度呈数量级增长视为需被抑制的"深度诅咒"病理。作者对此提出相反看法，想要验证这种增长是否其实是某种有益的、结构性的编码信号，而非应被消除的缺陷。
AI.method: 作者在9个家族、16个预训练LLM（含dense、MoE与hybrid架构及Pre/Peri/Post-Norm设计）中分析隐藏态范数与归一化权重γ的演化规律；据此提出LayerRoPE，将逐层γ向量替换为单一共享向量与深度条件标量（类似沿深度轴的RoPE），并在模型阶梯（最高100B+ token）、looped latent模型与ViT上验证。
AI.result: γ随深度在幅值上增长、方向上旋转，共同编码层索引。LayerRoPE在参数净减少、FLOPs变化<0.02%的前提下，一致优于Pre-/Post-/Peri-Norm及Layer-Norm Scaling，以3.4倍更少算力达到Pre-Norm的1.3B损失；是唯一在扩展到512层时仍保持强收敛且近单调改善的方法；学习率敏感性改善3–10倍，并可朴素迁移到looped latent模型和ViT上带来稳定提升。
AI.conclusion: LayerRoPE的学习到的调度表推翻了主流前提：它并不收缩残差流，而是加宽残差流——抑制每个block读取的内容、放其写入的内容。深度稳定性不靠压制残差流，而靠对其所驱动的计算块进行深度条件化的调节。

title: Do Better Visual Representations Always Lead to Better End-to-End Autonomous Driving?
summary: Visual foundation models (VFMs) are increasingly integrated into end-to-end autonomous driving for their powerful representations, yet it remains unclear when these representations improve driving performance. To investigate this question, we introduce ViRA, a planner-agnostic visual representation alignment framework that keeps the planner architecture and inference cost unchanged. Our study reveals three findings: (1) VFM-guided visual representations consistently improve driving performance across diverse end-to-end planners, with gains extending to zero-shot closed-loop evaluation. (2) The choice of VFM target matters for planning performance, and alignment to a different VFM can further benefit planners with pre-trained VFM encoders. (3) Auxiliary perception supervision reduces sensitivity to VFM target selection, narrowing the EPDMS spread across five targets from 2.7 to 0.5 points and potentially compensating for less effective VFM targets. Guided by these findings, we develop ViRA-Diffusion, a diffusion-based planner trained without auxiliary perception supervision, which achieves 92.3 EPDMS on NAVSIM v2 navtest, outperforming recent methods in our comparison by at least 1.9 points. The results motivate jointly considering target selection and planner supervision when integrating VFMs into end-to-end autonomous driving. The results and demo are available at https://github.com/OpenDriveLab/ViRA.

AI.tldr: 提出ViRA框架研究视觉基础模型表征对端到端自动驾驶规划性能的影响，并据此开发ViRA-Diffusion，在NAVSIM v2上取得92.3 EPDMS。
AI.motivation: 视觉基础模型（VFM）被广泛集成到端到端自动驾驶中，但其表征何时能真正提升驾驶性能尚不清楚，缺乏系统性研究。
AI.method: 提出规划器无关的视觉表征对齐框架ViRA，保持规划器架构与推理成本不变；通过实验探究VFM目标选择与辅助感知监督的影响；基于发现开发无辅助感知监督训练的扩散式规划器ViRA-Diffusion。
AI.result: VFM引导表征在多种端到端规划器上均持续提升性能；不同VFM目标对规划影响不同，对预训练VFM编码器的规划器对齐其他VFM可进一步受益；辅助感知监督降低对VFM目标选择的敏感性，将五个目标的EPDMS差距从2.7分缩小到0.5分。ViRA-Diffusion在NAVSIM v2 navtest上达到92.3 EPDMS，超越对比方法至少1.9分。
AI.conclusion: 将VFM集成到端到端自动驾驶时，需联合考虑目标选择与规划器监督方式。

title: ExperienceIndex: Artifact-Grounded Memory
summary: Knowledge-intensive tasks require answering many questions by reasoning about a shared corpus of artifacts (e.g., court cases, or scientific literature). As humans interact with these corpora, they naturally accumulate experiential knowledge about artifacts, enabling them to quickly identify the complete set of relevant artifacts for each new task. However, existing AI agents lack appropriate memory solutions to build or reuse such artifact-grounded experience, leading to lower answer quality and higher online cost. Existing memory solutions extract and reuse information from prior task-solving traces, but they primarily focus on user preferences, factual attributes, or abstract reasoning patterns rather than persistent artifact-specific knowledge. We introduce ExperienceIndex, a novel experience layer for AI agents that captures and reuses knowledge about artifacts based on prior reasoning traces. ExperienceIndex stores two complementary forms of experience: (i) single-artifact experiences that summarize an artifact's contribution to prior tasks and (ii) artifact-pair experiences that encode structural relationships discovered during past reasoning. Integrated as lightweight middleware, ExperienceIndex uses an experience retrieval mechanism to guide agents toward the complete set of relevant artifacts for new tasks, improving both answer quality and efficiency. Across diverse corpora and agentic solutions with different search frameworks, ExperienceIndex delivers consistent gains, raising answer quality by up to 11.0 points and reducing online dollar cost by up to 50.5%. We further demonstrate two benefits: (i) cross-task generalization, where experiences accumulated from text-to-SQL tasks transfer to factoid QA tasks over the same artifact corpus, and (ii) teacher-student learning, where experiences from a stronger model enable a weaker model to reach comparable performance.

AI.tldr: 提出ExperienceIndex——一种面向AI智能体的经验层，通过存储和复用基于历史推理轨迹的工件相关知识，提升知识密集型任务的答案质量与效率。
AI.motivation: 知识密集型任务需在共享工件语料（如判例、科学文献）上推理作答，人类能自然积累关于工件的经验知识以快速定位相关工件，而现有AI智能体的记忆方案主要关注用户偏好、事实属性或抽象推理模式，缺乏针对工件特定知识的持久化经验，导致答案质量低、在线成本高。
AI.method: ExperienceIndex作为轻量级中间件，存储两类互补经验：（i）单工件经验，总结某工件对历史任务的贡献；（ii）工件对经验，编码过往推理中发现的工件间结构关系；并通过经验检索机制引导智能体定位新任务的完整相关工件集合。
AI.result: 在多种语料及不同搜索框架的智能体方案上取得一致增益：答案质量最高提升11.0分，在线美元成本最多降低50.5%；并验证两项收益：跨任务泛化（文本到SQL任务积累的经验可迁移至同一工件语料上的事实型问答）与师生学习（强模型经验使弱模型达到可比性能）。
AI.conclusion: ExperienceIndex通过构建工件导向的经验层，有效提升AI智能体在知识密集型任务中的答案质量与成本效率，并具备跨任务泛化与师生知识传递能力。

title: SkillCycle: Co-Evolving Agent Policies and Skill Banks
summary: Internalizing external skills changes a language agent's capabilities and, with them, the value of its remaining guidance: rules can become redundant, misleading, or insufficient for newly encountered decisions. This creates a coupled problem of learning from skills and adapting the skills that supervise further learning. We introduce SkillCycle, a framework for co-evolving agent policies and skill banks through a feedback loop between skill internalization and rule revision. Our central contribution is to give distillation feedback a second role: token-level contextual differences help locate rules for inspection, while interaction outcomes guide edits to their content and applicability. SkillCycle alternates between two phases: policy learning with a fixed skill bank and router, and rule revision with a frozen policy. Candidate edits undergo rule-level and whole-bank environment comparisons before they guide the next learning cycle. On WebShop, SkillCycle with a 3B model achieves a success rate of 74.74% and a score of 88.37 without inference-time skill inputs, representing relative improvements of 0.73% and 3.96% over the state-of-the-art (SOTA) model, respectively. In Cycle 3 ablations on ALFWorld and WebShop, SkillCycle's no-skill success rates improve by 10.18% and 18.11% relative to a static skill bank, and by 2.41% and 2.50% relative to a single bank update, respectively. These results show that continually revising skill guidance as the agent's capabilities change helps transform external skills into policy capabilities that require no skill inputs at inference. We will release code, configurations, skill banks, and evaluation protocols.

AI.tldr: SkillCycle：通过技能内化与规则修订的反馈闭环协同演化策略与技能库，使3B模型在无推理时技能输入下于WebShop达到74.74%成功率和88.37分。
AI.motivation: 语言智能体在将外部技能内化后能力会发生变化，原本的指导规则可能变得冗余、误导或不足，因此"从技能中学习"与"调整用于监督后续学习的技能"构成一个耦合问题，需要共同演化。
AI.method: SkillCycle在固定技能库与路由器下进行策略学习，与冻结策略下的规则修订之间交替进行；蒸馏反馈的token级上下文差异用于定位需检查的规则，交互结果用于指导内容与适用性的编辑；候选编辑需经过规则级与整库环境比较后才进入下一学习周期。
AI.result: WebShop上3B模型在无推理时技能输入下成功率74.74%、得分88.37，相对SOTA分别提升0.73%与3.96%；Cycle 3消融中，ALFWorld与WebShop的无技能成功率相对静态技能库提升10.18%与18.11%，相对单次技能库更新提升2.41%与2.50%。
AI.conclusion: 随智能体能力变化持续修订技能指导，有助于将外部技能转化为无需推理时技能输入的策略能力。

title: The AI Evaluation Ecosystem
summary: AI evaluation shapes the decisions of model providers, users, funders, and regulators. We argue that designing valid benchmarks requires contextualizing design choices in the dynamics of this ecosystem of actors. We develop a simulation architecture that combines rule-based market dynamics with LLM-driven strategic actors, building on advances in Generative Agent-Based Modeling (GABM). We model benchmarks, consumer needs, and provider capabilities as vectors over a six-dimensional capability space (reasoning, coding, knowledge, safety, communication, agentic), with structural information partitions across actors. As a case study, we apply this stylized simulation to explore benchmark holdout design. We find that moving from public benchmarks to private holdout benchmarks shrinks the gap between benchmark scores and user satisfaction on most benchmarks but widens it on a few, depending on where holdout weights shift scoring credit. We stress-test our findings at both the instrument and case-study level, drawing on the V&V framework of Sargent (2013) and GABM-specific evidence criteria. Beyond holdout design, our simulation is a hypothesis-generating sandbox for studying how evaluator and policy choices, in turn, reshape the ecosystem.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种结合规则驱动市场动态与LLM战略主体的仿真架构（基于GABM），将基准、消费者需求与供应商能力建模为六维能力空间（推理、编码、知识、安全、沟通、智能体）上的向量，并以"基准留出设计"为案例，发现从公开基准转向私有留出基准在多数情况下缩小、少数情况下扩大基准分数与用户满意度之间的差距。
AI.motivation: AI评估影响模型供应商、用户、资助者与监管者的决策，因此设计有效的基准需要将该生态系统中各方主体的动态纳入考量；现有基准设计往往脱离这一生态背景。
AI.method: 构建结合规则驱动市场动力学与LLM驱动战略主体的仿真架构，基于生成式主体建模（GABM）；将基准、消费者需求和供应商能力表示为六维能力空间上的向量，并在各主体间设置结构性信息分区；以基准留出（holdout）设计为案例研究，并按Sargent（2013）的V&V框架及GABM特有证据标准进行仪器层面与案例研究层面的压力测试。
AI.result: 从公开基准转向私有留出基准，在多数基准上缩小了基准分数与用户满意度之间的差距，但在少数基准上扩大了该差距，具体取决于留出权重将评分信用转移到何处。
AI.conclusion: 该仿真可作为生成假设的沙盒，用于研究评估者与政策选择如何反过来重塑整个生态系统，而非仅限于留出设计这一具体问题。

title: Q-PACE: Dynamic Precision Allocation for Quantization-Aware Training
summary: Quantization-aware training (QAT) leverages lower-precision arithmetic to reduce the cost of LLM deployment, but aggressive quantization degrades final model performance. A common remedy is mixed-precision training, in which high precision is assigned to some of the layers to maintain performance while keeping the cost constrained. This approach then requires precision assignments for model layers during training. We provide a new approach, called Q-PACE, consisting of a second-order sensitivity model that predicts the loss increase as a sum of quantization noise MSE weighted by per-layer curvature coefficients. During training, we periodically re-compute these coefficients using perturbations across layers, and re-assign precision. Pretraining and supervised fine-tuning experiments on LLMs of up to 4B parameters show that Q-PACE consistently improves over existing mixed-precision training recipes, and achieves comparable loss at substantially lower total memory budgets. We further find that quantization sensitivity is highly predictable by depth and layer type, and its stability during training allows for infrequent, cheap recalibration.

AI.tldr: Q-PACE：基于二阶敏感性模型的混合精度QAT方法，预测量化噪声导致的损失增量（MSE×逐层曲率系数），周期性重算系数并重分配精度，在4B以内LLM预训练与SFT中优于现有混合精度方案，并在大幅降低内存预算下达到可比损失。
AI.motivation: 量化感知训练（QAT）以低精度算术降低LLM部署成本，但激进量化会损害最终模型性能。常见补救是混合精度训练，即对部分层保留高精度以维持性能并约束成本，但该方案需要为各层决定精度分配。现有混合精度训练配方在精度分配策略上仍有改进空间。
AI.method: 提出Q-PACE，包含一个二阶敏感性模型：将损失增量预测为量化噪声MSE之和，并按逐层曲率系数加权。训练过程中，通过跨层扰动周期性重新计算这些曲率系数，并据此重新分配各层精度。
AI.result: 在参数量最多4B的LLM上进行预训练和有监督微调实验，Q-PACE持续优于现有混合精度训练配方，并在总内存预算显著更低的情况下达到可比损失。此外发现量化敏感性在深度和层类型上具有高度可预测性，且其在训练过程中的稳定性允许低频、低成本的重校准。
AI.conclusion: 逐层二阶敏感性可有效指导混合精度训练的精度分配；量化敏感性由深度与层类型高度决定且训练中稳定，因而无需频繁重校准，为低成本、高效的混合精度QAT提供了可行方案。

title: RoboPace: Contact-Aware Time-Optimal Retiming for Action-Chunk Policies
summary: Robot manipulation data collection has been shifting from teleoperation toward robot-free demonstrations, through interfaces such as the Universal Manipulation Interface (UMI) or directly from human hands. Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies trained on such data inherit the demonstrator's timing. Yet human timing does not directly transfer to robots: compliant hands tolerate fast contact, whereas robots may overshoot due to actuator and tracking limitations; conversely, robots can move faster in free space.
