This motivates a unified approach that reconciles execution speed with contact safety. We present RoboPace, an online retiming layer that preserves the policy's geometric path while adapting its timing, respecting the target robot's kinematic and dynamic constraints. It adapts execution speed based on predicted contact, jointly accounting for contact-dependent speed limits and the robot's motion constraints. The method requires no policy retraining and operates in real time. Across three contact-rich tasks on a dual-arm robot, faster uniform execution and physical-limit-only retiming largely fail. RoboPace instead achieves higher overall success than slow uniform execution while completing four of five commands in approximately half the time, retaining the reliability of slow execution without its time cost.

AI.tldr: RoboPace是一种在线重定时层，在保留策略几何路径的前提下自适应调整执行时序，兼顾接触安全与机器人运动学/动力学约束，无需重训练即可实时运行。
AI.motivation: 机器人操作数据采集正从遥操作转向无机器人示教（如UMI或人手直接演示），但VLA策略会继承演示者的时序。人类时序无法直接迁移到机器人：柔性手可承受快速接触，而机器人因执行器和跟踪限制可能过冲；反之机器人在自由空间可更快。因此需要统一方法协调执行速度与接触安全。
AI.method: 提出RoboPace，一个在线重定时层，保留策略的几何路径、仅调整其时序，并遵守目标机器人的运动学与动力学约束。它基于预测接触自适应执行速度，联合考虑接触相关的速度上限与机器人运动约束；方法无需策略重训练，可实时运行。
AI.result: 在双臂机器人上的三个富接触任务中，更快的均匀执行和仅按物理极限的重定时基本失败。RoboPace总体成功率高于慢速均匀执行，且五条指令中四条耗时约为一半，兼具慢速执行的可靠性与更低的耗时成本。
AI.conclusion: 通过在线重定时在保持路径不变的前提下适配时序，可在不重训练策略的情况下同时提升执行速度与接触可靠性，实现速度与接触安全之间的协调。

title: I would rather quit NLP than read another paper like this: The rise of antithesis in NLP papers
summary: For better or worse, LLMs are by now used routinely for scientific writing.\footnote{This paper is no exception; we did use AI to assist with writing some of the sections (see Acknowledgments).} Many have noticed that recent models fill papers with unnecessary antithesis, stating over and over what the work does not do, in ways that do not contribute to its precision or quality of expression and annoy reviewers \emph{rather than impressing them}. We study the construction \emph{rather than} in ACL papers from 2019, ACL-style arXiv papers from 2026, and papers written by GPT models from the same titles and abstracts. Its rate in 2026 is seven times the 2019 rate, and higher still in the GPT papers. Two annotators, blind to the source, find almost no 2019 use \emph{annoying} and about one in ten 2026 uses; they seldom agree on which, yet about half of 2026 papers contain a use that annoys each of them. \emph{Annoying} uses present the rejected alternative less favorably than legitimate uses. Raters of preference data and open reward models favor the construction, and an instruction to be honest promotes it. We conjecture that it is a side effect of post-training on pairwise preferences, which credit a disavowal in a single response and cannot register its cost across a text.

AI.tldr: 该研究考察了学术写作中"rather than"（"而非"）这一对比结构的滥用现象，发现其使用频率急剧上升（2026年arXiv论文是2019年的7倍，GPT生成论文更高），并指出这种冗余否定表达多令审稿人反感，推测其根源在于基于成对偏好的后训练机制。
AI.motivation: 作者观察到LLM被广泛用于学术写作后，近期模型倾向于在论文中堆砌不必要的对比句式，反复陈述工作"不做什么"，这种表达既不提升精确性也无助于质量，反而令审稿人反感而非留下好印象；作者希望系统研究这一现象的频率、性质与成因。
AI.method: 研究对比了三类文本中的"rather than"结构：2019年ACL论文、2026年ACL格式的arXiv论文，以及用相同标题和摘要由GPT模型生成的论文。采用双标注者（对来源盲审）判断各用例是否"令人反感"；并测试偏好数据评分者与开放奖励模型对该结构的偏好，以及诚实性指令对其出现的影响。
AI.result: 2026年的使用率是2019年的7倍，GPT生成论文中更高。两名盲审标注者几乎不认为2019年的用法令人反感，而约十分之一的2026年用法令人反感；标注者间一致性低，但约一半的2026年论文含有令各自反感的用例。"令人反感"的用法在呈现被拒备择方案时比合理用法更负面。偏好数据评分者与开放奖励模型都偏好该结构，诚实性指令也会促使其使用。
AI.conclusion: 作者推测"rather than"的滥用是基于成对偏好进行后训练所产生的副作用——此类训练在单个回复内奖励"否定/撇清"表述，却无法察觉其对整篇文本造成的累积代价。

title: Controllable Crowd Generation through World-Model Planning
summary: Crowd simulation plays a central role in robot navigation, autonomous driving, and urban planning. For these applications, realistic simulation requires crowds to adapt their behavior to environmental changes and user objectives. However, existing methods that rely on predefined control settings have limited flexibility in accommodating new user-specified objectives. To address this limitation, we propose Ctrl-CWM, a multi-agent Controllable Crowd World Model that integrates crowd generation and run-time control. Our key idea is to adapt the world-model principle of planning using imagined futures to crowd simulation. To this end, Ctrl-CWM consists of an encoder that learns a representation of human motion dynamics, an actor that proposes pedestrian displacements, a critic that evaluates imagined crowd trajectories, and a planner that selects actions. We first learn human motion dynamics through trajectory prediction on real-world pedestrian videos and then freeze the encoder to preserve them. Using this representation, the actor generates imagined crowd trajectories through repeated state updates, and the planner combines the critic's scores with user costs to select actions. Repeated planning advances the simulated crowd, while additional user costs introduce new control objectives without retraining. We extensively evaluate crowd generation under varied agent arrival conditions and run-time control across avoidance and attraction scenarios. Ctrl-CWM outperforms the state-of-the-art method on most crowd realism and collision metrics, and adapts crowd behaviors to user-specified objectives introduced during simulation. The project page is available at https://jungyu0413.github.io/Ctrl-CWM

AI.tldr: 提出Ctrl-CWM，一种多智能体可控人群世界模型，将世界模型的想象未来规划思想引入人群仿真，实现人群生成与运行时控制一体化，无需重训练即可引入新控制目标，在多数真实感与碰撞指标上优于SOTA。
AI.motivation: 人群仿真在机器人导航、自动驾驶与城市规划中十分重要，需人群能适应环境变化与用户目标。但现有方法依赖预定义控制设置，难以灵活适应新的用户指定目标，缺乏运行时可控性。
AI.method: Ctrl-CWM包含四部分：编码器学习人体运动动力学表征、actor提议行人位移、critic评估想象人群轨迹、planner选择动作。先在真实行人视频上通过轨迹预测学习运动动力学并冻结编码器；actor经重复状态更新生成想象轨迹，planner结合critic评分与用户代价选择动作；重复规划推进仿真，附加用户代价即可引入新控制目标而无需重训练。
AI.result: 在不同智能体到达条件下评估人群生成，并在避让与吸引场景中测试运行时控制。Ctrl-CWM在多数人群真实感与碰撞指标上优于SOTA，并能适应仿真过程中引入的用户指定目标。
AI.conclusion: 将世界模型"想象未来规划"范式用于人群仿真，可在不重训练的情况下实现灵活、运行时的可控人群生成，为机器人导航等应用提供更真实可调的人群仿真方案。

title: SearchWorld: Spatial Value-Grounded Imagination for UAV Object Search via World Models
summary: Autonomous unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) object search involves a closed loop of perception, decision-making, and action under partial observability. Urban environments pose several challenges: large search areas and narrow egocentric views limit coverage, dense 3D geometry constrains safe motion, and open-world instructions require identifying a specific target among distractors. Many existing methods mitigate partial observability through explicit maps or memory representations, yet remain largely reactive, reasoning over past observations without explicitly predicting future states. World models enable prospective reasoning through imagined rollouts. However, image-generating world models can incur high inference latency, while spatially grounded planning remains challenging for latent world models. We propose SearchWorld, a recurrent state-space world model that connects explicit spatial memory with value-guided imagination. The model maintains BEV exploration and obstacle memory and decodes a task-aware spatial value layer to guide search. A cognition-action network uses this learned spatial value prior to improve the policy through imagined rollouts, without training a separate scalar critic. Training progresses from world-model learning to expert imitation and imagination-based exploration refinement. On UAV-ON, SearchWorld improves the success rate to 23.8% (19.5% for the strongest published agent) and raises oracle success to 35.5%, while remaining robust on unseen scenes (19.9% success rate). By grounding imagination in explicit spatial representations, SearchWorld enables UAV agents to plan prospectively rather than react.

AI.tldr: 提出SearchWorld，一种循环状态空间世界模型，将显式空间记忆与价值引导的想象相结合，用于城市环境下无人机自主目标搜索。
AI.motivation: 城市环境中UAV目标搜索面临搜索区域大、第一人称视角狭窄、密集3D几何约束运动、开放指令需从干扰物中识别目标等挑战。现有方法多通过显式地图或记忆缓解部分可观测性，但基本是被动的，只对过去观测推理而缺乏对未来状态的显式预测。图像生成式世界模型推理延迟高，而潜在世界模型的空间规划仍具挑战。
AI.method: SearchWorld维护BEV探索记忆与障碍物记忆，解码任务感知的空间价值层以引导搜索。认知-动作网络利用该学习到的空间价值先验，通过想象rollout改进策略，无需训练单独的标量critic。训练分三阶段：世界模型学习、专家模仿、基于想象的探索精炼。
AI.result: 在UAV-ON上，SearchWorld将成功率提升至23.8%（最强已发表智能体为19.5%），oracle成功率提升至35.5%，在未见场景上仍保持鲁棒（成功率19.9%）。
AI.conclusion: 通过将想象建立在显式空间表示之上，SearchWorld使UAV智能体能够进行前瞻性规划而非被动反应。

title: The Dichotomy Between Pattern Recognition and Step-by-Step Reasoning
summary: We argue that pattern recognition and step-by-step reasoning are two ends of a spectrum. A large language model (LLM) learns to reason step-by-step when data is structured such that the next token depends on a small amount of preceding context. Inference in LLMs resembles pattern recognition when the next token depends on a large amount of preceding context. If the next token depends on only the $c$ most recent tokens, reasoning traces are paths on a De Bruijn graph whose nodes are $c$-length contexts and edges are next-token transitions between contexts. The set of reasoning traces of a task forms a directed acyclic subgraph of the De Bruijn graph. An LLM that has learned all edges of this subgraph can compose them to solve longer, unseen tasks, i.e., it reasons step-by-step. We prove that the number of edges is vanishingly small compared to the number of reasoning traces. Empirically, the number of training samples a transformer needs is a power law in the number of edges, so learning to reason step-by-step is sample efficient. We can induce De Bruijn structure in any task by maintaining a ``state'' that makes future reasoning independent of the past. The frequency of states in the reasoning trace determines $c$. We show, by fine-tuning Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct to solve equations and answer questions about stories, that frequent states (small $c$) result in higher accuracy but greater fragility to perturbations at test time. LLMs trained with a large $c$ are only as good as models that perform pattern recognition without reasoning. A moderate density of states balances accuracy and robustness. We show that real-world data has De Bruijn structure: Qwen3-14B and Qwen3-32B retain over 75% of their accuracy on GSM8K, MATH-500 and GPQA-Diamond when attention is restricted to a sliding window less than 15% as long as the full reasoning trace.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出模式识别与逐步推理是同一谱系的两端，用De Bruijn图刻画LLM推理结构，证明推理所需边数远小于推理轨迹数，并揭示状态频率（决定上下文长度c）在准确性与鲁棒性间的权衡。
AI.motivation: 作者希望从理论上统一解释LLM的两种能力：模式识别与逐步推理，并厘清二者之间的关系。核心问题是：LLM究竟在何种数据结构下学会逐步推理，以及为什么逐步推理具有样本高效性。同时，作者想说明如何通过设计任务结构来诱导推理能力，并分析其代价（鲁棒性）。
AI.method: 1. 将下一步预测依赖的前文长度作为谱系维度：依赖短前文（小c）对应逐步推理，依赖长前文对应模式识别。2. 用De Bruijn图建模：节点为c长度上下文，边为下一token转移；任务的推理轨迹构成该图的DAG子图。3. 证明子图边数相对推理轨迹数可忽略，故学会所有边即可组合求解更长未见任务。4. 通过维护"状态"使未来推理与过去无关，从而在任意任务中诱导De Bruijn结构，状态频率决定c。5. 微调Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct解方程与故事问答，考察不同c的准确性与扰动鲁棒性。6. 在GSM8K、MATH-500、GPQA-Diamond上用滑动窗口注意力验证真实数据的De Bruijn结构。
AI.result: 理论：边数远小于推理轨迹数，样本复杂度对边数呈幂律，逐步推理样本高效。实验：频繁状态（小c）带来更高准确率但测试时对扰动更脆弱；大c训练的LLM仅相当于无推理的模式识别模型；中等状态密度在准确率与鲁棒性间取得平衡。真实数据：Qwen3-14B与Qwen3-32B在注意力窗口限制为完整推理轨迹不到15%时，仍保留GSM8K、MATH-500、GPQA-Diamond上超过75%的准确率。
AI.conclusion: 逐步推理与模式识别是连续谱的两端，由下一步预测依赖的上下文长度决定。推理轨迹是De Bruijn图的DAG子图，其边数远少于轨迹数，因此学会边即可组合泛化，实现样本高效的逐步推理。状态频率决定c，进而权衡准确率与鲁棒性：小c准确但脆弱，大c稳健但退化为模式识别。真实数据具有De Bruijn结构，LLM在受限注意力下仍能保持较高性能。

title: YUBI-STAG: Contact and Semantic-Rich Alignment for VLAs via Automated Video-Language Grounding
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models acquire broad manipulation capabilities via large-scale pretraining, yet eliciting them through language requires fine-grained alignment between instructions and physical interactions. Existing robot demonstrations typically provide only coarse task descriptions, omitting how actions are executed, including which gripper acts, which object is contacted, and how it is grasped and moved. We introduce YUBI-STAG, a framework for Spatio-Temporal Annotation and Grounding that automatically enriches manipulation demonstrations with interaction-rich semantics to align pretrained VLAs with fine-grained manipulation language. Combining contact-object segmentation with vision-language models, YUBI-STAG annotates object identities, attributes and states, per-gripper actions, bimanual coordination, and spatially grounded interactions. To address YUBI-STAG's reliance on localized sequences and multi-stage VLM inference, we distill it into YUBI-VLM. YUBI-VLM directly recovers action structure and annotations from raw, unsegmented video in few inference calls and operates from wrist views alone. We evaluate both frameworks on YUBI-STAG-Bench across temporal, semantic, and spatial grounding tasks. YUBI-VLM retains much of YUBI-STAG's annotation accuracy with fewer inference calls and shorter runtime while generalizing to unseen manipulations. Finally, post-training VLA policies on these annotations aligns them with fine-grained language and contact-aware structure. Bimanual experiments demonstrate improved performance and instruction following, including control over object identity, acting gripper, target location, and spatial relations absent from original labels.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 YUBI-STAG 框架（自动为操作示范补充交互丰富语义的时空标注与接地框架）及其蒸馏版 YUBI-VLM，实现从原始未分割视频中直接恢复动作结构与细粒度标注，并用于对齐预训练 VLA 模型与细粒度操作语言。
AI.motivation: VLA 模型通过大规模预训练获得广泛操作能力，但用语言驱动这些能力需要指令与物理交互之间的细粒度对齐。现有机器人示范通常只提供粗粒度任务描述，缺失动作如何执行的信息（哪只夹爪动作、接触哪个物体、如何抓取与移动），导致 VLA 难以被细粒度语言引导。
AI.method: YUBI-STAG 结合接触物体分割与视觉语言模型，自动标注物体身份、属性与状态、单夹爪动作、双臂协调以及空间接地的交互语义。为缓解其对局部序列与多阶段 VLM 推理的依赖，将其蒸馏为 YUBI-VLM，后者可在少量推理调用下、仅凭腕部视角，直接从原始未分割视频恢复动作结构与标注。
AI.result: 在 YUBI-STAG-Bench 上评估两个框架的时间、语义与空间接地任务：YUBI-VLM 以更少推理调用与更短运行时间保留了 YUBI-STAG 大部分标注精度，并能泛化到未见操作。用这些标注后训练 VLA 策略后，其与细粒度语言及接触感知结构的对齐改善；双臂实验显示性能与指令跟随提升，包括对物体身份、动作夹爪、目标位置及原始标签中缺失的空间关系的控制。
AI.conclusion: 通过自动生成交互丰富的时空语义标注并蒸馏为高效模型，可为 VLA 提供细粒度语言对齐监督，显著提升操作策略的性能与指令跟随能力。

title: Mechanics of Long-Context Hybrid Models Part 1.1: From Hybrid Attention to Hybrid Position
summary: The architectural design of Large Language Models (LLMs) is shifting from traditional full-attention-only models to hybrid models, which combine different attention modules to improve long-context efficiency and performance in length extrapolation and context extension. To explain why hybrid models work and how to design them better, we propose Mechanics of Long-Context Hybrid Models. As Part 1.1 of this series, we begin with hybrids of full attention and either sliding-window attention (SWA) or gated variants of linear attention (LA), represented by GLA and GDN. We first observe a Seesaw Effect in Context Extension: LA hybrids benefit more from long-context continual pretraining, whereas SWA hybrids perform better under length extrapolation. We attribute this behavior to differences in the positional inductive biases induced by these attention mechanisms. We find that SWA hybrids suffer from a Short-Context Learning Trap, Short-Window Weariness, and Long-Window Laziness, and require extended windows to enhance performance in continual long-context pretraining. For LA hybrids, we summarize the Matthew Effect of Hybrid Position Extrapolation and propose Sliding-Window Linear Attention, achieving 16$\times$ training-free length extrapolation while maintaining 100\% accuracy on NIAH-SK1 in 64k context length.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"长上下文混合模型机制"研究框架（系列第1.1部分），系统对比全注意力与滑窗注意力（SWA）或门控线性注意力（GLA/GDN）混合的架构，揭示其在上下文扩展与长度外推中的"跷跷板效应"，并提出滑窗线性注意力实现16倍免训练长度外推。
AI.motivation: LLM架构正从纯全注意力转向混合注意力模型，以提升长上下文效率、长度外推与上下文扩展能力，但混合模型为何有效、如何设计更优尚缺乏机制层面的解释。
AI.method: 以全注意力与滑动窗口注意力（SWA）或线性注意力门控变体（GLA、GDN）的混合模型为研究对象，分析其位置归纳偏置差异，归纳并命名多种现象与规律（跷跷板效应、短上下文学习陷阱、短窗疲劳、长窗惰性、混合位置外推的马太效应），并据此提出Sliding-Window Linear Attention方法。
AI.result: 发现上下文扩展中的跷跷板效应：LA混合模型更受益于长上下文持续预训练，SWA混合模型在长度外推下表现更好；SWA混合模型存在短上下文学习陷阱、短窗疲劳与长窗惰性，需扩展窗口；LA混合模型呈现混合位置外推的马太效应。提出的滑窗线性注意力实现16倍免训练长度外推，并在64k上下文NIAH-SK1上保持100%准确率。
AI.conclusion: 混合注意力模型的性能差异源于不同注意力机制引入的位置归纳偏置差异；针对SWA与LA的设计缺陷可分别通过扩展窗口与滑窗线性注意力加以改进，为长上下文混合模型的设计提供了机制性指导。

title: InscriptionOCR: A Dataset and Method for Understanding Inscriptions
summary:
Ancient script image restoration is a fundamental problem in computer vision, as it directly affects the reliable analysis and interpretation of historical documents and inscriptions. Ashokan Brahmi is an ancient script extensively used during the reign of Emperor Ashoka in the 3rd century BC, primarily for inscriptions in Prakrit. These inscriptions, including major and minor rock and pillar edicts, constitute a valuable yet largely unexplored source of data for computational analysis. The degraded nature of inscription imagery and the lack of standardized digital resources pose significant challenges for automated processing.
  We present an end-to-end AI-based framework for understanding ancient inscriptions that encompasses image enhancement, optical character recognition (OCR), transliteration, and neural machine translation (NMT). The proposed pipeline processes low-quality images captured directly from stone inscriptions, performs image restoration and Brahmi script character recognition, maps the recognized characters to the Roman script, and finally translates the resulting Prakrit text into English. We also introduce two new datasets: (i) InscriptionOCR Dataset: the largest publicly usable digital OCR dataset for Brahmi script to date, consisting of over 200,000 character images across about 600 classes, and (ii) a bilingual Prakrit-English parallel corpus comprising over 2,000 sentence pairs for NMT. We believe that the proposed framework and datasets will facilitate future research in ancient script analysis, low-resource OCR, and digital epigraphy.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个端到端AI框架，用于古代阿育王婆罗米铭文的图像增强、OCR识别、转写与神经机器翻译，并发布了大规模OCR数据集与Prakrit-English平行语料。
AI.motivation: 阿育王婆罗米铭文是研究历史文献的重要数据源，但铭文图像质量退化、缺乏标准化数字资源，导致自动化处理困难，相关计算分析几乎未被探索。
AI.method: 构建端到端流水线：对石刻低质量图像进行图像复原与增强，执行婆罗米字符OCR识别，将识别字符映射为罗马字母转写，最后通过NMT将Prakrit文本翻译为英文。
AI.result: 发布两个数据集：(i) InscriptionOCR Dataset，目前最大的公开可用婆罗米OCR数据集，包含超过20万字符图像、约600个类别；(ii) Prakrit-English双语平行语料，超过2000个句对，用于NMT训练。
AI.conclusion: 该框架与数据集将为古代文字分析、低资源OCR及数字铭文学研究提供支持，推动后续研究发展。

title: Relevance Is Not Sufficiency: What Actually Closes the Evidence Gap in Long-Term Memory QA
summary:
LLM agents that interact with a user across many sessions accumulate histories that exceed their context window, so they store past interactions in an external memory and answer each question from a small set of retrieved records. Existing memory systems rank records by lexical or embedding relevance, yet the top-ranked memories can each be relevant while jointly omitting a complementary fact that the answer requires, especially for multi-session and temporal questions.
  Drawing on the distinction between relevance and sufficiency in legal evidence scholarship, we recast memory retrieval as constructing a sufficient memory set.
  To operationalize this view, we introduce a blinded LLM judgment over the retrieved set, together with Gold Hit and Turn Hit as evidence-coverage proxies. We then propose Budgeted Flat Reconstruction (BFR), which builds sufficient sets over a fixed flat memory store in two stages. Specifically, we first apply Formal Concept Analysis for Memory Selection (FCA-MS) to decompose the question into information requirements and select a compact candidate subset that jointly covers them. Then, we repeatedly acquire unseen records through deeper text search or complementary entity and session views, stopping when the budget is exhausted.
  Experiments on LoCoMo and LongMemEval-S show that BFR outperforms same-store adaptations of recent agent-memory systems in both answer quality and evidence coverage. Specifically, on LongMemEval-S it raises judged accuracy from 72.4% to 82.2% and Turn Hit to 91.4%.

AI.tldr: 该论文将LLM智能体的外部记忆检索重新定义为"充分记忆集"构建问题，提出两阶段方法BFR（FCA-MS筛选+预算化补全），在LoCoMo和LongMemEval-S上同时提升答案质量与证据覆盖率。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体跨多会话交互产生的历史超出上下文窗口，须依赖外部记忆并仅从少量检索记录中作答。现有记忆系统按词法或嵌入相关性排序记录，但排名靠前的记忆可能各自相关却在联合上缺失回答所需的互补事实，该问题在多会话与时序性问题上尤为突出。论文借鉴法律证据学中"相关性"与"充分性"的区分，指出检索目标应从"相关"转向"充分"。
AI.method: 1) 提出以"充分记忆集"为目标的检索重构，并引入对检索集进行盲评的LLM判断，以及Gold Hit、Turn Hit作为证据覆盖度的代理指标。2) 提出Budgeted Flat Reconstruction (BFR)，在固定扁平记忆库上分两阶段构建充分集：首先用形式概念分析记忆选择（FCA-MS）将问题分解为信息需求，并选出能联合覆盖这些需求的紧凑候选子集；随后通过更深层文本搜索或互补的实体/会话视角反复获取未见记录，直至预算耗尽。
AI.result: 在LoCoMo与LongMemEval-S上，BFR在同库改造的近期智能体记忆系统对比中，答案质量与证据覆盖度均更优。在LongMemEval-S上，盲评准确率从72.4%提升至82.2%，Turn Hit达到91.4%。
AI.conclusion: 记忆检索不应仅追求记录相关性，而应以构建联合充分的证据集为目标；FCA-MS的需求分解与预算化增量补全可有效提升多会话、时序问答的答案质量与证据覆盖度。

title: Patient, Place, Prior (P$^3$): What Counts as Personalization in Medical World Models?
summary: Longitudinal models forecast how a patient's imaging state evolves, but accuracy does not show whether the patient's observed trajectory drives the prediction. A population-average forecast may be useful but cannot establish a patient-specific world-model claim. We introduce Patient, Place, Prior (P$^3$), an audit asking whether a forecast benefits from the patient's longitudinal imaging history (Patient), benefits from patient-matched externally supplied spatial support (Place), and gains predictive value beyond a population-average prediction under matched support and context (Prior). We also propose Cancer JEPA, a one-step model that forecasts frozen representations of future breast dynamic contrast-enhanced MRI examinations during neoadjuvant therapy. It adds a lesion-constrained neural correction, trained with an occlusion-based latent objective, to a patient-conditioned low-complexity reduced-rank regression baseline. This factorization permits a post-hoc P$^3$ audit of the frozen model. In a validation cohort previously used in development, forecast error is lower when the neural correction receives the patient's history rather than another patient's and patient-matched lesion occupancy maps rather than substituted maps. However, the descriptive 95% interval comparing the correction computed from patient history with the population-average neural correction includes zero. P$^3$ thus separates input use from evidence of patient-specific predictive value beyond a population-level pattern.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出P³审计框架和Cancer JEPA模型，用于评估纵向影像预测是否真正利用了患者特异性信息。
AI.motivation: 纵向模型能预测患者影像状态的演变，但预测准确率本身无法说明预测是否由患者自身的纵向轨迹驱动。群体平均预测可能有用，却无法支撑"患者特异性世界模型"的主张，因此需要一个能区分输入使用与患者特异性预测价值的审计方法。
AI.method: 提出Patient, Place, Prior (P³)审计，考察预测是否从患者纵向影像史（Patient）获益、是否从患者匹配的外部空间支持（Place）获益、以及在匹配支持和上下文下是否超越群体平均预测（Prior）。同时提出Cancer JEPA：一步预测新辅助治疗期间乳腺DCE-MRI未来检查的冻结表征，在患者条件的低复杂度降秩回归基线上加入病灶约束的神经校正，并用基于遮挡的潜在目标训练；该分解允许对冻结模型进行事后P³审计。
AI.result: 在曾用于开发的验证队列中，当神经校正接收患者自身历史而非其他患者历史、接收患者匹配的病灶占用图而非替代图时，预测误差更低。但比较由患者历史计算的校正与群体平均神经校对的描述性95%区间包含零。
AI.conclusion: P³将输入使用与患者特异性预测价值（超越群体水平模式）的证据区分开来，说明准确率提升未必等于患者特异性世界模型能力。

title: ΔWAM: Distilling Action Tangent Fields into World Action Models
summary: World Action Models (WAM) improve robot policies by augmenting sparse action supervision with dense future prediction. However, much of the predictable future is dominated by appearance and scene persistence rather than action-dependent dynamics. We observe that several recent WAM designs, including optical flow, motion-centric representations, and latent actions, can be understood from a common perspective in which world supervision becomes more efficient as it contains a higher proportion of action-relevant variation. Based on this insight, we introduce Action Tangent Fields, which reformulate world supervision through a local Taylor expansion of how actions induce changes in future dynamics. We represent future dynamics in Residual-VAE space, where the future latent remains recoverable from the current latent and its residual, and use a strong action-conditioned world model (ACWM) to probe the local correspondence between action variations and residual-world variations. This local first-order structure is distilled into the WAM to guide its denoising supervision toward dynamics that are more tightly coupled to action, rather than merely predictable from appearance. Across LIBERO-Plus, RoboTwin, and RoboTwin2.0-Plus, our method consistently improves robustness to lighting, background, camera, layout, and other environmental perturbations. Despite using no large-scale embodied pretraining, it achieves stronger robustness under several distribution shifts than pretrained policies. We further distill multi-step VideoDiT denoising into a single step for efficient inference. Our results suggest that effective WAM supervision should remain information-rich while concentrating its predictive capacity on the directions along which actions change the future.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 Action Tangent Fields，通过对未来动力学做局部泰勒展开，重塑世界动作模型（WAM）中的世界监督信号，使其聚焦"动作相关变化"，从而在多个机器人基准上显著提升对光照、背景、相机、布局等扰动的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有 WAM 通过引入密集的未来预测来增强稀疏动作监督，但可预测的未来大部分由外观与场景持续性主导，而非动作驱动的动力学。作者观察到光流、运动中心表征、潜在动作等近期 WAM 设计可统一理解为：世界监督中"动作相关变化"占比越高，监督效率越高。因此需要一种能显式提取动作相关变化方向的世界监督形式。
AI.method: 提出 Action Tangent Fields：将世界监督重新表述为"动作引起未来动力学变化"的局部泰勒展开（一阶结构）。在 Residual-VAE 空间中表示未来动力学，使未来潜变量可由当前潜变量及其残差恢复；用强动作条件世界模型（ACWM）探测动作变化与残差世界变化之间的局部对应关系。将该局部一阶结构蒸馏进 WAM，引导其去噪监督偏向与动作强耦合的动力学方向，而非仅由外观可预测的内容；并进一步将多步 VideoDiT 去噪蒸馏为单步以加速推理。
AI.result: 在 LIBERO-Plus、RoboTwin、RoboTwin2.0-Plus 上，方法对光照、背景、相机、布局及其他环境扰动持续提升鲁棒性。尽管未使用大规模具身预训练，在多种分布偏移下鲁棒性强于预训练策略；单步蒸馏实现高效推理。
AI.conclusion: 有效的 WAM 监督应同时保持信息丰富，并将预测能力集中于"动作改变未来"的方向上。以动作切线场提取的一阶动作相关结构可作为一种通用且高效的世界监督组织方式。

title: LLM4Impact: Integrating Heterogeneous Information for Scientific Impact Prediction
summary: Predicting the future impact of a newly published paper is challenging because it must be inferred from heterogeneous evidence available at publication time. Existing approaches often rely on a single source of information or combine multiple sources without accounting for their different predictive roles. In this paper, we present LLM4Impact, an evidence-aware method for scientific impact prediction that learns to represent, integrate, and calibrate heterogeneous information. LLM4Impact combines semantic, graph, LLM, and temporal representations, and injects graph information into a frozen LLM through continuous prefix tokens. A context aware gating mechanism adaptively weights different evidence, while a separate calibration module accounts for domain and temporal variation in citation scales. We further construct a large-scale benchmark dataset with 2 million papers, leakage-safe point-in-time heterogeneous ego graphs, temporal splits, and both year-level and month-level citation targets. Experiments show that LLM4Impact consistently outperforms strong semantic, graph, and LLM based baselines, with a 10.13% reduction in year RMSE on the in distribution test set and a 6.87% reduction under out-of-domain distribution. Our results reveal that the value of such evidence is context dependent: different papers benefit from different sources, while domain and publication time affect how evidence translates into citations. This finding motivates adaptive evidence selection and context-conditioned calibration rather than simply richer representations. We will release our code, benchmark, and an interactive web demonstration upon publication.

AI.tldr: LLM4Impact：一种证据感知的论文影响力预测方法，融合语义、图、LLM与时间四类异构证据，自适应加权并做领域/时间校准，在200万篇论文基准上显著超越强基线。
AI.motivation: 预测新发表论文的未来影响力很难，因为只能依赖发表时可得的信息推断。现有方法要么仅用单一信息源，要么简单合并多源信息，却未区分不同证据的预测角色差异。
AI.method: 提出LLM4Impact：整合语义、图、LLM、时间四种表示；通过连续前缀token将图信息注入冻结的LLM；用上下文感知门控机制自适应加权不同证据；另设独立校准模块处理引用量在领域与时间上的尺度差异。同时构建含200万论文的大规模基准，具备防泄漏的时点异构自我图、时间切分，以及年/月级引用目标。
AI.result: LLM4Impact一致优于语义、图与LLM类强基线：在分布内测试集上年RMSE降低10.13%，在域外分布下降低6.87%。
AI.conclusion: 证据的价值是上下文相关的：不同论文受益于不同来源，领域与发表时间影响证据如何转化为引用。这支持自适应证据选择与上下文条件校准，而非简单堆叠更丰富的表示。作者将公开代码、基准与交互式网页演示。

title: Mixture of Layers: Dynamic Layer Routing for Visual Reasoning
summary: Pre-trained vision encoders contain layer-wise visual representations that differ in spatial granularity, semantic abstraction, and sensitivity to local details. However, most Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) rely on only the final or penultimate vision encoder representations or fixed aggregation rules, making visual abstraction largely query-agnostic and limiting access to fine-grained cues such as small objects, spatial details, text, and subtle visual attributes. In this work, we propose Mixture of Layers (MoL), an instruction-conditioned layer routing approach at the visual patch level that dynamically aggregates query-relevant latent representations from intermediate vision encoder layers. Given a text query, MoL predicts routing probabilities over vision encoder layers and performs a top-k sparse aggregation over selected hidden states at either the image level, patch level, or through a hybrid routing mechanism. In doing so, MoL enables query-adaptive access to layer-specific visual features for fine-grained visual reasoning. Our experiments across 7 fine-grained visual reasoning tasks demonstrate substantial performance improvements, especially across fine-grained visual grounding and understanding tasks such as +18.9% improvement on V* in overall accuracy, +4.5% on HRBench4K, and +16.3% on CharXiv compared to the baseline MLLMs, without resorting to multi-resolution inputs, simple interleaving of multiple vision encoders, or increasing the number of patch tokens. We study vision encoders' receptive field scales across different layers and their sampling behaviors to provide an in-depth analysis of why layer-wise sampling is helpful, demonstrating that conditional visual representations are a key step towards better visual perception and reasoning in MLLMs. Our project page is available at https://wjdghks950.github.io/mol.github.io/.

AI.tldr: 提出 Mixture of Layers (MoL)，在视觉 patch 级别进行指令条件化的编码器层路由，实现查询自适应的中间层特征聚合，显著提升细粒度视觉推理性能。
AI.motivation: 现有 MLLM 多仅使用视觉编码器最后一层或倒数第二层表示，或采用固定聚合规则，导致视觉抽象与查询无关，难以获取小目标、空间细节、文本及细微视觉属性等细粒度线索。
AI.method: MoL 依据文本查询预测各视觉编码器层的路由概率，对选中的隐状态执行 top-k 稀疏聚合，支持图像级、patch 级或混合路由机制，从而在 patch 级别动态融合与查询相关的中间层表示，无需多分辨率输入、多编码器交错或增加 patch token 数量。
AI.result: 在 7 项细粒度视觉推理任务上取得显著提升：V* 总体准确率 +18.9%，HRBench4K +4.5%，CharXiv +16.3%（相较基线 MLLM）。
AI.conclusion: 通过分析不同层视觉编码器的感受野尺度与采样行为，验证了层间采样有效的机理；表明条件化视觉表示是提升 MLLM 视觉感知与推理能力的关键步骤。

title: TopoGraphRAG-Bench: Evaluating Multimodal GraphRAG on Layout-Grounded Evidence Reasoning
comment: Accepted at the 40th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026)
summary: Real-world documents distribute evidence across text, tables, figures, and captions within complex page layouts. Answering complex questions over such documents therefore requires more than retrieving relevant passages: systems must recover the evidence topology that connects heterogeneous evidence units. Existing GraphRAG evaluations remain largely text-centered, while multimodal document RAG benchmarks assess cross-modal retrieval and generation without directly evaluating recovery of the intended evidence topology. We introduce TOPOGRAPHRAG-BENCH, a layout-grounded benchmark for multimodal evidence reasoning in GraphRAG, comprising 2,024 questions over 201 long, visually rich documents. Questions are constructed bottom-up from text, figure, and table evidence units under three controlled topologies: single-hop retrieval, bridge-chain reasoning, and multi-source synthesis. To ensure that questions preserve their intended structure, we apply counterfactual validation for shortcut resistance, modality necessity, and evidence necessity. We evaluate text-only GraphRAG, page-level visual retrieval, and multimodal GraphRAG systems using retrieval, generation, and topology-aware reasoning metrics. Multimodal GraphRAG systems achieve the strongest overall performance, but still fail when visual-textual evidence alignment or multi-unit composition is incomplete. Text-only GraphRAG struggles when key dependencies are grounded in figures or tables, while page-level visual retrieval lacks the fine-grained structure needed for topology recovery. These findings motivate GraphRAG systems that move beyond text-derived entity relation graphs to explicitly model document layouts, cross-modal evidence alignment, and the reasoning roles of evidence units. Code and data are available at https://richardlrc.github.io/TopoGraphRAG-Bench/.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出TOPOGRAPHRAG-BENCH，一个面向多模态证据推理的、布局感知的GraphRAG基准，包含201篇长文档上的2,024个问题，覆盖单跳检索、桥接链推理和多源综合三种拓扑结构，并采用反事实验证保证问题结构，评估揭示现有多模态GraphRAG仍需显式建模文档布局、跨模态对齐和证据单元的推理角色。
AI.motivation: 现实文档的证据分散在文本、表格、图表和题注中，跨越复杂页面布局。回答此类复杂问题不仅要检索相关段落，还需恢复连接异构证据单元的"证据拓扑"。然而现有GraphRAG评测以文本为中心，多模态文档RAG基准虽评估跨模态检索与生成，却未直接评估预期证据拓扑的恢复能力，因此缺乏针对性的评测手段。
AI.method: 构建TOPOGRAPHRAG-BENCH：基于201篇长且视觉丰富的文档，自底向上从文本、图表、表格证据单元生成2,024个问题，覆盖三种受控拓扑——单跳检索、桥接链推理、多源综合；并通过反事实验证（捷径抵抗、模态必要性、证据必要性）确保问题保留其预期结构。评测对象包括纯文本GraphRAG、页面级视觉检索和多模态GraphRAG，采用检索、生成及拓扑感知推理指标。
AI.result: 多模态GraphRAG系统整体性能最强，但在视觉-文本证据对齐不完整或多单元组合不完整时仍会失败；纯文本GraphRAG在关键依赖位于图表或表格时表现吃力；页面级视觉检索缺乏拓扑恢复所需的细粒度结构。
AI.conclusion: 这些发现推动GraphRAG系统超越基于文本派生的实体关系图，显式建模文档布局、跨模态证据对齐以及证据单元的推理角色。代码与数据已公开于 https://richardlrc.github.io/TopoGraphRAG-Bench/。

title: Exact Dynamics and Finite-Sample Trajectory Recovery of Linear Recursive Feature Machines
summary: Recursive feature machines (RFMs) learn representations of data by alternating between fitting a predictor to a dataset and updating features of that predictor using the average gradient outer product (AGOP). Connections between AGOPs and feature learning in neural networks motivate linear RFMs as a simple setting for analyzing how representations evolve during training. Here, we study the dynamics and statistics of linear RFM in noisy multi-output regression with isotropic sub-Gaussian input data and targets generated by a low-rank teacher matrix of dimension $d$. We extend the known connection between linear RFM and iteratively reweighted least squares from the interpolating setting to ridge-regularized multi-output regression with noise. We show that the learned feature matrix remains close to its infinite-data ideal counterpart at every iteration. Namely, for $n$ samples, we show the error in the feature matrix decays as $O(\sqrt{d/n})$ with high probability. Experiments on real-world text and single-cell gene-expression data illustrate the features learned by this simple linear model.

AI.tldr: 本文研究线性递归特征机（RFM）在含噪多输出回归中的动力学与统计性质，证明所学特征矩阵在每次迭代中接近无限数据理想值，误差以 $O(\sqrt{d/n})$ 高概率衰减。
AI.motivation: RFM 通过交替拟合预测器与用平均梯度外积（AGOP）更新特征来学习表示，AGOP 与神经网络中的特征学习存在联系，因此线性 RFM 可作为分析表示如何在训练中演化的简化场景。作者希望将线性 RFM 与迭代重加权最小二乘（IRLS）的已知联系从插值设定推广到含噪的岭正则化多输出回归。
AI.method: 在等距亚高斯输入数据、目标由维度为 $d$ 的低秩教师矩阵生成的设定下，研究线性 RFM 在含噪多输出回归中的动力学与统计。将线性 RFM 与迭代重加权最小二乘的联系从插值情形推广至带噪的岭正则化多输出回归，并分析特征矩阵在每次迭代中与无限数据理想对应项的接近程度。
AI.result: 证明所学特征矩阵在每次迭代中都接近其无限数据理想对应项；对于 $n$ 个样本，特征矩阵误差以高概率按 $O(\sqrt{d/n})$ 衰减。并在真实文本数据与单细胞基因表达数据上实验，展示了该简单线性模型所学到的特征。
AI.conclusion: 线性 RFM 在含噪岭正则化多输出回归中具有可分析的表示演化行为，其特征矩阵以 $O(\sqrt{d/n})$ 的速率收敛到无限数据理想值，验证了该简化模型刻画特征学习的有效性。

title: InterView-C: A Synchronized Multimodal Corpus of VR Avatar-Mediated Survey Interviews
summary: We present InterView-C, a German multimodal corpus of 27 survey interviews conducted entirely in virtual reality, with both interlocutors represented by avatars. The corpus aligns spoken interaction with synchronized behavioral data, including gaze, head and body movement, facial behavior, hand and finger tracking. Its reference transcripts and linguistic annotations provide a reliable interface between this multimodal spoken interaction and predominantly text-based NLP methods. This interface is important because automatically transcribing speech can distort linguistically relevant information, while downstream models trained on existing resources may additionally face transfer challenges when applied to transcribed spoken data. InterView-C therefore provides word-timed and manually post-edited verbatim transcripts for all 54 recordings, interview-item timings, questionnaire responses and negation cue and scope annotations for 1,422 sentences, 1,398 of them doubly annotated (α=0.87 for cues; α=0.81 for scopes). We demonstrate both challenges empirically: nine open-weight ASR systems disproportionately misrecognize short closed answers and number words, while negation models trained on existing corpora show lower and highly variable performance on our transcribed interviews than a model trained on the InterView-C annotations. InterView-C thus enables linguistic analyses of spoken interaction while retaining their alignment with rich multimodal behavior.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍 InterView-C——一个德语的虚拟现实多模态访谈语料库，包含27场由虚拟形象代表对话双方的调查访谈，并对齐了语音行为与注视、头部与身体动作、面部行为、手部与手指追踪等行为数据，同时提供转写与语言标注，用于连接多模态口语互动与以文本为中心的NLP方法。
AI.motivation: 自动语音转写会扭曲语言学相关信息，而基于现有资源训练的下游模型在应用于转写口语数据时也面临迁移挑战。因此需要一个可靠的接口，将丰富的多模态口语互动与主流的文本化NLP方法连接起来。
AI.method: 构建 InterView-C 语料库，记录27场完全在虚拟现实中进行的德语调查访谈，双方均以虚拟形象出现。语料包含语音互动的同步行为数据（注视、头部与身体运动、面部行为、手部与手指追踪），并提供可词级定位、经人工后期编辑的逐字转写（共54份录音）、访谈项目时间标注、问卷回答，以及1,422个句子的否定线索与否定范围标注（其中1,398句为双重标注，线索α=0.87，范围α=0.81）。
AI.result: 实证展示了两个问题：九个开放权重ASR系统不成比例地误识别短的封闭式回答和数字词；在现有语料上训练的否定模型在转写访谈上的表现低于且高度波动于在InterView-C标注上训练的模型。
AI.conclusion: InterView-C 既支持口语互动的语言学分析，又保留了这些分析与丰富多模态行为的对齐关系。

title: TIRA: Tumor Immune Representation Adaptation for Zero-Shot Cross-Cancer MSI and TMB Prediction
summary: Microsatellite instability-high (MSI-H) and high tumor mutational burden (TMB-H) are clinically relevant biomarkers, yet their histopathological prediction remains challenging when models are transferred across morphologically distinct cancer types. Immune-associated spatial patterns can persist across cancers despite these morphological differences, but foundation-model-based predictors trained on a single cancer do not explicitly use this information, limiting cross-cancer generalization. To address this limitation, we propose TIRA (Tumor Immune Representation Adaptation), a target-free framework that refines frozen foundation-model representations using spatial immune topology, without requiring target-domain data during model development or test-time adaptation. TIRA uses a topology-supervised biology representation to condition tile-level attention while pooling only morphological features for joint MSI and TMB prediction. We train TIRA on TCGA-COAD+READ and evaluate it zero-shot on CPTAC-COAD, TCGA-STAD, TCGA-UCEC, and CPTAC-UCEC, covering cross-site, cross-cancer, and combined cross-cancer-site distribution shifts under UNI2, CONCH, and Virchow2. With UNI2, TIRA improved zero-shot AUROC on TCGA-STAD from 0.633 to 0.766 for MSI and from 0.651 to 0.772 for TMB. Source-derived spatial immune topology improved the cross-cancer robustness of frozen pathology foundation-model representations.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出TIRA框架，利用空间免疫拓扑信息精炼冻结的病理基础模型表征，实现跨癌种的MSI与TMB联合预测，无需目标域数据即可零样本迁移。
AI.motivation: MSI-H与TMB-H是临床相关生物标志物，但其组织病理学预测在跨形态学差异明显的癌种迁移时仍具挑战。免疫相关空间模式可在不同癌种间保持稳定，但基于单癌种训练的基础模型预测器未显式利用该信息，限制了跨癌种泛化能力。
AI.method: 提出TIRA（肿瘤免疫表征自适应）目标无关框架，在不需目标域数据（无需测试时自适应）的情况下，用空间免疫拓扑精炼冻结的基础模型表征。该方法以拓扑监督的生物学表征来条件化tile级注意力，同时仅对形态学特征进行池化以联合预测MSI与TMB。在TCGA-COAD+READ上训练，并在CPTAC-COAD、TCGA-STAD、TCGA-UCEC和CPTAC-UCEC上进行零样本评估，覆盖跨站点、跨癌种及跨癌种-站点联合分布偏移，测试了UNI2、CONCH与Virchow2三种基础模型。
AI.result: 在UNI2下，TIRA将TCGA-STAD的零样本AUROC从MSI的0.633提升至0.766，TMB从0.651提升至0.772。
AI.conclusion: 源域衍生的空间免疫拓扑可提升冻结病理基础模型表征的跨癌种鲁棒性。

title: DUDA-Bench: Benchmarking LLM Agents on Multimodal Data-Driven Urban Diagnosis
summary: Urban diagnosis integrates heterogeneous observations to identify urban problems, localize affected areas, and investigate contributing factors, informing evidence-based urban planning and management. However, its reliance on labor-intensive, case-specific expert workflows limits scalability and reuse, motivating the exploration of agent-based execution. To evaluate this capability, we introduce DUDA-Bench, a hierarchical and interactive benchmark that formalizes data-driven urban diagnosis as a multi-stage agent workflow. It comprises 86 atomic and 22 workflow tasks spanning four analytical stages, grounded in multimodal data from 12 cities covering five urban problem types. Evaluations of seven backbone models and five agent systems reveal a substantial gap between isolated analytical competence and end-to-end diagnosis, with system benefits varying across backbones. Trajectory analysis shows that unresolved evidence gaps propagate across stages, while successful recovery involves revising assumptions and actions using feedback. These findings highlight limitations in coordinating analytical capabilities across stages, particularly adaptive planning, evidence integration, and verification. More broadly, DUDA-Bench provides a framework for translating expert analytical workflows into hierarchical agent tasks and process-aware evaluation, supporting systematic assessment of end-to-end analytical capabilities.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 DUDA-Bench，一个面向"数据驱动城市诊断"的分层交互式基准，把专家式城市诊断工作流形式化为多阶段智能体任务，并据此评估主流模型与智能体系统的端到端分析与流程协同能力。
AI.motivation: 城市诊断需整合多源异构观测以识别城市问题、定位受影响区域并探究成因，但传统方法依赖劳动密集型、面向个案的专家工作流，难以扩展与复用，因此需要探索基于智能体的自动化执行方式；同时缺乏能够过程感知地评估此类端到端能力的评测基准。
AI.method: 构建 DUDA-Bench 分层交互式基准，将城市诊断形式化为多阶段智能体工作流，包含 86 个原子任务与 22 个工作流任务，覆盖四个分析阶段，基于 12 座城市的多模态数据与五类城市问题；对 7 个骨干模型和 5 个智能体系统进行评测，并开展轨迹分析。
AI.result: 实验结果揭示了孤立分析能力与端到端诊断之间的显著差距，智能体系统带来的增益因骨干模型而异；轨迹分析表明未解决的证据缺口会跨阶段传播，而成功恢复依赖借助反馈修正假设与动作。
AI.conclusion: 现有模型在跨阶段协调分析能力（尤其是自适应规划、证据整合与验证）方面存在明显局限；DUDA-Bench 提供了将专家分析工作流转化为分层智能体任务并进行过程感知评估的框架，支持对端到端分析能力的系统化评测。

title: An Accuracy--Information Tradeoff for Loss-Difference Conditional Mutual Information
comment: 61 pages, of which 8 pages main text. Code, data and the Lean 4 formalization are in the ancillary files
summary: Loss-difference conditional mutual information (ld-CMI) uses the smallest of the standard observations in the supersample hierarchy of generalization bounds: it measures what a learner's loss differences reveal about which candidate of each pair it was trained on. Accuracy is known to force information into the model; data processing does not carry such lower bounds to losses. We show, by bounding three moments of the loss differences, that accuracy also forces ld-CMI. For linear predictors with a smooth convex loss of nonzero slope at zero, such as the logistic loss, plus a regularizer whose curvature and growth are both of power $r\ge2$, on product distributions over a scaled sign cube in dimension at least linear in $n$, every proper learner with expected excess risk at most $\varepsilon$ on these distributions at the optimal sample size $n\asymp\varepsilon^{-2+2/r}$ has worst-case ld-CMI of order $n$ bits, and $Θ(n/(1+(τ/\varepsilon)^2))$ bits under Gaussian noise of standard deviation $τ$ on the loss differences. The same holds without a regularizer, at $n\asymp\varepsilon^{-2}$. Consequently, range-scaled ld-CMI bounds cannot vanish on these distributions, although every proper learner's generalization gap is $O(n^{-1/2})$. We also show that model-level information does not determine noisy loss-difference information, and that the growth, slope and dimension conditions are needed, the last up to a logarithm.

AI.tldr: 本文证明准确性会强制损失差条件互信息（ld-CMI）非零：在特定线性预测器、凸损失与幂次正则化设定下，任何期望超额风险为 ε 的正当学习器在最坏情况下具有 n 比特量级的 ld-CMI，因此在给定分布上该量级界无法消失。
AI.motivation: 已知准确性会迫使信息进入模型参数，但数据处理不等式不能把这类下界传导到损失量上。作者希望在超样本层级中作为最弱标准的 ld-CMI 上建立此类下界，从而厘清基于模型级信息的泛化界与损失差信息之间的关系。
AI.method: 通过界定损失差的三个矩（而非仅用数据处理不等式），将期望超额风险与 ld-CMI 联系起来；研究对象为定义在缩放符号立方体上的乘积分布，维度至少与 n 线性相关，采用斜率非零的平滑凸损失（如逻辑损失）以及曲率和增长均为幂 r≥2 的正则化项；分别在无噪声和损失差受标准差 τ 高斯扰动的两种情形下给出界，并验证增长、斜率与维度条件的必要性（维度条件精确到对数因子）。
AI.result: 在最优样本量 n≍ε^{-2+2/r} 下，任何期望超额风险不超过 ε 的正当学习器最坏情况 ld-CMI 为 Θ(n) 比特；在损失差含标准差 τ 的高斯噪声时为 Θ(n/(1+(τ/ε)^2)) 比特；无正则化时在 n≍ε^{-2} 下同样成立。由此可见，按范围缩放的 ld-CMI 界在这些分布上不能趋于零，尽管每个正当学习器的泛化间隙仅为 O(n^{-1/2})。此外，模型级信息不能决定带噪损失差信息。
AI.conclusion: 准确性会同时强制模型级信息与损失差条件互信息，但两者并不互相决定；基于 ld-CMI 的界在合理的风险与样本量条件下具有不可消除的下界，且该下界依赖正则化的幂次、损失在零点的斜率以及问题维度。

title: On-Demand Robotic Assembly via Differentiable Geometric Part Repair
summary: Transitioning from a digital design to a robotic assembly process currently requires months of expert manual tuning to reconcile part geometries with robotic constraints. This paper presents an end-to-end, autonomous pipeline for the design and physical construction of bespoke wooden assemblies. A generative AI agent translates user prompts into initial 3D geometries, balancing the visual fidelity of the design with select physical constraints. The assemblability of the design is further improved by a gradient-based repair stage that backpropagates through a graph attention network surrogate to adjust component geometries. In addition to correcting for disjointed and overlapping components, we demonstrate hardware-specific corrections, differentiably optimizing the geometry of components to enable robot screwdriving for 86.7% of 60 novel natural language inputs, significantly outperforming prior work by a factor of ten. For ten of the structures, we physically demonstrate assemblability with two UR5e robots. This work marks a meaningful step toward on-demand robotic manufacturing, enabling the rapid production of customized, low-volume goods.

AI.tldr: 提出一个端到端自主流水线，将用户自然语言提示转化为可被机器人装配的定制木结构，通过生成式AI与可微修复阶段实现设计-制造的自动衔接，机器拧螺丝成功率达86.7%。
AI.motivation: 从数字设计到机器人装配目前需专家数月手动调参，以调和零件几何与机器人约束之间的矛盾，阻碍定制化、小批量制造的快速落地。
AI.method: 生成式AI智能体将用户提示转为初始3D几何，兼顾视觉保真度与部分物理约束；采用基于梯度的修复阶段，通过图注意力网络代理模型反向传播以调整零件几何，实现硬件特定的可微优化，修正不连接与重叠的部件。
AI.result: 在60个新自然语言输入中，86.7%可支持机器人拧螺丝，较先前工作提升约十倍；并对其中10个结构用两台UR5e机器人进行了实体装配验证。
AI.conclusion: 该工作迈向按需机器人制造，可实现定制化、低产量产品的快速生产。

title: HySPE: Positional Encoding via Symplectic Dual Shears
summary: We introduce Hyperbolic Symplectic Positional Encoding (HySPE), grounding positional attention in non-compact symplectic transformations. While canonical Rotary Position Embedding (RoPE) parameterizes the compact, elliptic branch of $\Sp(2,\R)$ via rotations, HySPE operationalizes its hyperbolic branch via a damped symmetric composition of dual shears, yielding a conformally symplectic contraction with two spectral decay rates per channel pair. To eliminate the exponential representation drift inherent to naive absolute factorizations, we diagonalize the operator in its invariant eigenbasis and introduce blockwise coordinate rebasing with adaptive centered execution. This guarantees length-independent numerical bounds while matching cached RoPE forward latency (7.21\,ms on an RTX 4090). On TinyShakespeare, HySPE-UltraLong maintains an invariant perplexity of 4.810 up to $16\times$ zero-shot extrapolation ($L=4096$), whereas RoPE degrades to 131.198. Scaled to a 51M-parameter subword Transformer on WikiText-103 ($L_{\text{train}}=512$), HySPE closely matches RoPE in-domain while robustly extrapolating to length 8192, reducing tail perplexity by 83.9\% over RoPE. While these controlled experiments establish HySPE's extrapolation robustness and numerical stability, evaluating its scaling behavior on large-scale foundation models remains an important direction for future investigation.

AI.tldr: HySPE 将位置编码建立在非紧辛变换上，通过双剪切阻尼对称复合实现 $\Sp(2,\R)$ 的双曲分支，并用特征基对角化与分块坐标重基准保证长度无关的数值稳定性；在零样本长度外推上显著优于 RoPE。
AI.motivation: RoPE 仅参数化 $\Sp(2,\R)$ 的紧致椭圆分支（旋转），缺乏对非紧双曲分支的建模能力；同时朴素绝对因子分解会带来指数级表示漂移，限制长度外推与数值稳定性。
AI.method: 提出 HySPE：以双剪切的阻尼对称复合构造共形辛收缩，每通道对具有两个谱衰减率；在不变特征基中对算子对角化，引入分块坐标重基准与自适应居中执行，以消除指数漂移并保证数值界限。
AI.result: 在 RTX 4090 上前向延迟 7.21 ms，与缓存版 RoPE 相当；TinyShakespeare 上 HySPE-UltraLong 在 $16\times$ 零样本外推（$L=4096$）下困惑度保持 4.810，RoPE 退化至 131.198；WikiText-103 上 51M 子词 Transformer（$L_{\text{train}}=512$）域内与 RoPE 接近，外推至 8192 时尾部困惑度较 RoPE 降低 83.9%。
AI.conclusion: 受控实验表明 HySPE 具备优越的外推鲁棒性与数值稳定性；在大规模基础模型上的扩展行为评估是未来重要方向。

title: LighTROcc: Lightweight 4D Occupancy Forecasting via Instance-Centric 3D Gaussians
summary: Forecasting future 3D occupancy from surround-view cameras is essential for autonomous driving, yet existing approaches rely on dense voxel or bird's-eye-view representations whose cost grows rapidly with spatial resolution and prediction horizon. Because these representations do not explicitly maintain object identities, they also struggle to preserve instance consistency over time. We present LighTROcc, a lightweight instance-centric framework that represents movable objects with a compact set of learned queries and predicts present and future occupancy in a single forward pass. LighTROcc localizes each query through attention-guided forward lifting, combining image-space cross-attention, query-specific depth, and camera geometry to estimate its 3D center. Each instance is modeled as a mixture of anisotropic 3D Gaussians and propagated across future steps using predicted displacements, producing continuous, temporally consistent occupancy forecasts. Experiments on nuScenes and supplemented nuScenes-Occupancy show that LighTROcc outperforms the evaluated dense and instance-wise baselines in instance-level forecasting accuracy while maintaining strong voxel-level occupancy quality. Across different model configurations, LighTROcc achieves a favorable balance between forecasting accuracy and computational efficiency, demonstrating the potential of compact instance-centric modeling for camera-based 4D occupancy forecasting.

AI.tldr: LighTROcc：以轻量级实例为中心、用可学习查询建模可移动物体，单次前向预测当前与未来占用，性能优于稠密与实例级基线并兼顾效率。
AI.motivation: 现有基于环视相机的3D占用预测方法依赖稠密体素或BEV表示，其计算与存储成本随空间分辨率和预测时域快速增加；且这些表示不显式维护物体身份，难以在时间维度上保持实例一致性。因此需要一种轻量、实例一致、面向未来预测的占用建模框架。
AI.method: 提出LighTROcc实例为中心的轻量框架：用紧凑的可学习查询表示可移动物体，单次前向同时预测当前与未来占用。通过注意力引导的前向提升定位每个查询，结合图像空间交叉注意力、查询特定深度与相机几何估计其3D中心。每个实例建模为各向异性3D高斯的混合，并用预测位移在后续时间步传播，从而产生连续且时间一致的占用预测。
AI.result: 在nuScenes与补充的nuScenes-Occupancy数据集上，LighTROcc在实例级预测精度上优于所评估的稠密与实例级基线，同时保持较强的体素级占用质量；在不同模型配置下实现了预测精度与计算效率的良好平衡。
AI.conclusion: 紧凑的实例为中心建模在基于相机的4D占用预测中具有潜力，可兼顾实例一致性、预测精度与计算效率。

title: From Plausible Hierarchies to Useful Taxonomies: Evaluating Agentic Harnesses on Customer Feedback
summary: Taxonomies are the symbolic representations through which AI systems organize evidence, aggregate patterns, and answer questions over large document collections. Over customer feedback, the category tree decides how every record is counted and routed, which problems get seen, and which team owns them. Agentic harnesses now make it easy to generate a plausible-looking hierarchy, and such trees are checked today with generic, individually scoped checks: each name fits its description, sits under the right parent, and stays distinct from its siblings. We ask a more operational question: when is a generated hierarchy actually useful as a production taxonomy? We build six taxonomies over two proprietary feedback corpora (1,940 and 5,000 records): for each corpus, a production reference and two repeated runs of the same harness under identical inputs. All six pass every generic naming and structure check, and a deeper product-coverage check even prefers the generated trees. Yet in every generated tree at least 97.7% of leaf names merely restate an ancestor's name (13.9% and 2.9% in the references), and in one, three of every four records fall under multiple top-level categories. We introduce two families of whole-tree metrics: structural discriminators test whether a tree's shape was learned from the data or imposed by its generator; team partitionability tests whether branches split feedback into groups teams can own. Trees the generic checks rate as equally correct differ by 27 percentage points in cross-branch leakage, and only one of the two beats a random split. Surface plausibility is an insufficient measure of taxonomy quality: evaluation must measure the whole tree as well as each node.

AI.tldr: 生成式智能体可轻松产出看似合理的分类体系，但通用逐节点检查不足以判断其生产可用性；本文提出整树层面的结构判别与团队可分区性指标，揭示表面合理性不等于分类质量。
AI.motivation: 分类体系是AI系统组织证据、聚合模式并回答大规模文档问题的符号表示。在客户反馈场景中，类别树决定了每条记录如何被计数与路由、哪些问题被看到、由哪个团队负责。当前对自动生成层级结构的评估仅依赖通用的、逐节点独立范围的检查（名称与描述相符、位于正确父节点下、与兄弟节点区分），但这类检查无法回答更关键的问题：生成层级何时真正可作为生产级分类体系使用。
AI.method: 在两个专有反馈语料（1,940条和5,000条记录）上构建六个分类体系：每个语料包含一个生产参考分类体系，以及同一智能体框架在相同输入下重复运行两次生成的分类体系。所有六个体系均通过全部通用命名与结构检查，且更深层的产品覆盖检查甚至更偏好生成树。作者随后引入两族整树层面的度量指标：结构判别器（检验树的形状是从数据中习得还是由生成器强加）与团队可分区性（检验分支是否将反馈划分为团队可负责的组）。
AI.result: 所有六个分类体系均通过通用检查，产品覆盖检查也偏好生成树。但在每个生成树中，至少97.7%的叶节点名称仅是复述某个祖先节点的名称（参考树中分别为13.9%和2.9%）；其中一个生成树中，每四条记录里有三条落在多个顶级类别之下。通用检查评为同等正确的树在跨分支泄漏上相差27个百分点，且仅有两个生成树之一优于随机划分。
AI.conclusion: 表面合理性不足以衡量分类体系质量：评估必须同时度量整棵树的结构，而不仅仅是每个节点。整树层面的指标能够揭示通用逐节点检查所掩盖的结构性缺陷与可操作性差异。

title: CurveTQ: Rotation-Free Trellis Quantization of LLM Weights via Curvature-Weighted Search
summary: The best two-bit weight quantizers for large language models, such as QTIP and Proteus, rotate each weight matrix by a random orthogonal transform, which must be undone at every decoding step, then encode it with a trellis or lattice code under a Euclidean search; the layer Hessian enters only through error feedback between coding blocks. We show that this leaves part of the Hessian unused. Error feedback turns the loss into a weighted sum of per-coordinate rounding errors whose weights, the diagonal of the Hessian's LDL factorization, existing quantizers compute but never read. We put these weights into the Viterbi branch metric, so the search follows the curvature within each coding block. This also explains the rotation: it removes this within-block variation, so weighting in the native basis and rotating are substitutes. On three models the weighted native search matches a full-dimension randomized Hadamard to within about one point of downstream accuracy, and weighting after the rotation gains little. Around this search we build CurveTQ, a trellis codec with no rotation, which handles the weights' amplitude and marginal shape with a factored scale field and a closed-form quantile table, and stores a start state per coding block so the trellis can adapt to the residual that error feedback carries into it. At two bits CurveTQ is 1-3 points higher in mean downstream accuracy than QTIP and Proteus on three 4-8B Instruct models, even after both are given our start state, which alone lifts either baseline by 1-3 points. It also leads on a 35B mixture of experts, to our knowledge the first trellis-coded result on such a model. With no rotation to undo, our decoder is the fastest of the three at all tested batch sizes and bit widths.

AI.tldr: 该论文发现现有二比特量化器（QTIP、Proteus）未充分利用Hessian信息，提出将Hessian的LDL分解对角权重引入Viterbi分支度量以在编码块内沿曲率搜索，并据此构建无旋转的格码编解码器CurveTQ，在多个模型上超越基线且解码最快。
AI.motivation: 现有最优二比特权重量化器（如QTIP、Proteus）先对权重矩阵施加随机正交旋转，再在欧氏搜索下用格码或格点编码，Hessian仅通过编码块间的误差反馈进入。作者指出这种做法使部分Hessian信息被闲置：误差反馈将损失转化为逐坐标舍入误差的加权和，其权重正是Hessian的LDL分解对角，而现有量化器只计算却从未使用这些权重。
AI.method: 1) 将Hessian的LDL分解对角权重放入Viterbi分支度量，使搜索在编码块内跟随曲率；2) 论证旋转的作用是消除块内变异，因此在原始基下加权与旋转是等价替代；3) 围绕该加权原生搜索构建CurveTQ：无旋转的格码编解码器，用因子化尺度场处理权重幅度与边缘形状，用闭式分位数表编码，并为每个编码块存储起始状态，使格码能适应误差反馈传入的残差。
AI.result: 在三个模型上，加权原生搜索与全维随机Hadamard旋转的下游精度差距约在1个百分点内，而旋转后再加权收益甚微。在两个比特下，CurveTQ在三个4-8B Instruct模型上的平均下游精度比QTIP和Proteus高1-3个百分点，即使给两个基线也加入起始状态后依然领先；仅起始状态一项就能让任一基线提升1-3个百分点。在35B混合专家模型上同样领先，据作者所知这是首个在该类模型上的格码量化结果。由于无需撤销旋转，其解码器在所有测试的批大小和比特宽度下均为三者中最快。
AI.conclusion: Hessian的LDL对角权重是现有量化器忽视的有效信号，将其纳入编码搜索可提升二比特量化精度；旋转与原生基加权可互为替代，据此构建的无旋转CurveTQ在精度与解码速度上均优于QTIP和Proteus，并首次将格码量化扩展到35B混合专家模型。

title: End-to-End Autonomous Generation of Human Assembly Plans
summary: Turning a CAD design into an assembly plan is still largely done by hand, requiring engineers to reason about geometric feasibility, tool access, stability, and the ergonomics of human assembly. In this work, we encode long-established design for assembly (DfA) principles into a contained, end-to-end approach for generating assembly plans. Our approach takes only a mesh assembly and produces either a step-by-step assembly manual or a structured failure report, requiring no joint metadata, fastener annotations, or additional information. Four major components of a manufacturing plan are addressed autonomously: an assembly tool list, the assembly sequence and subassemblies, an assembly manual, and design feedback for improving assemblability. For determining the sequence plan, we systematically disassemble the object in a physics simulator and apply a cost function that encodes DfA principles. Manual generation, tool labelling, and assembly feedback rely primarily on multimodal large language models. Compared with a baseline that always removes the outermost part first from Tian et al., DfA-aware sequence planning reduces simulated assembly time, measured with a robot-arm assembly-time proxy, by 35% on 136 assemblies of 5 to 30 parts. The correct tool is selected for 88.6% of assembly steps. A vision-language model judge compares the generated manuals against ablated variants, identifying which page elements carry the information a reader needs. The presented approach and open-source code are available for use by engineers or AI agents looking to rapidly accelerate the creation of manufacturing plans for a given product design.

AI.tldr: 该工作将设计面向装配（DfA）原则编码为端到端流水线，仅输入网格装配体即可自动生成装配工具清单、装配序列与子装配、装配手册及可装配性设计反馈，或输出结构化失败报告，无需关节或紧固件元数据。
AI.motivation: 将CAD设计转化为装配计划目前仍主要依赖人工，工程师需推理几何可行性、工具可达性、稳定性与人体装配工效，过程耗时且依赖经验；现有方法通常需要关节、紧固件等额外标注信息，且缺乏对DfA原则的系统性编码。
AI.method: 方法为端到端、自包含流程：输入仅为网格装配体。序列规划通过在物理仿真器中系统性地对物体进行拆卸，并施加编码DfA原则的代价函数来获得装配序列与子装配；装配手册生成、工具标注与装配反馈主要依赖多模态大语言模型完成。
AI.result: 在136个含5至30个零件的装配体上，相比Tian等人"总是先移除最外层零件"的基线，DfA感知序列规划使以机械臂装配时间代理指标测得的模拟装配时间降低35%；装配步骤的工具选择准确率为88.6%；视觉语言模型评审对比生成手册与消融变体，识别出对读者必要的信息页面元素。
AI.conclusion: 将DfA原则显式编码进自动化装配规划流程可显著提升装配效率与工具选择准确性，且仅凭网格输入即可覆盖制造计划的四个核心组成；方法与开源代码可供工程师或AI代理用于快速加速产品设计到制造计划的生成。

title: Beyond Outcome Rewards: Constructing and Assigning Retrieval Credit for Search Agents
summary: Search agents enable Large Language Models (LLMs) to iteratively retrieve and use information for complex multi-hop questions. Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) offers a promising approach for post-training such agents, but its reliance on sparse, outcome-based supervision can make credit assignment difficult and limit learning efficiency. In this paper, we systematically investigate how intermediate supervision can improve reinforcement learning for search agents. We study a range of reward-shaping and credit-assignment strategies that provide learning signals from intermediate retrieval steps. Building on these insights, we develop a training framework that combines intermediate signals with final outcome rewards to improve learning from multi-step search trajectories. Experiments across multiple benchmarks under matched training conditions demonstrate improvements in aggregate search-agent performance and show that both the choice of intermediate signal and where its credit is assigned affect training behaviour. These findings show that reward design and credit assignment are important design dimensions for training effective search agents.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究中间监督（奖励塑形与信用分配策略）如何提升搜索智能体的强化学习训练效率。
AI.motivation: 基于可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）用于训练搜索智能体时，仅依赖稀疏的结果监督，导致信用分配困难、学习效率低。
AI.method: 研究多种提供中间检索步骤学习信号的奖励塑形与信用分配策略，并构建结合中间信号与最终结果奖励的训练框架。
AI.result: 在相同训练条件下的多个基准测试中，搜索智能体的整体性能得到提升；中间信号的选择及其信用分配位置均影响训练行为。
AI.conclusion: 奖励设计与信用分配是训练高效搜索智能体的重要设计维度。

title: From Global Alignment to Local Grounding: Zero-Shot Chinese Character Recognition with Radical Verification
summary: Zero-shot Chinese character recognition (ZS-CCR) aims to recognize characters whose categories are never observed during training, and typically relies on the compositional structure shared between seen and unseen characters. Recent CLIP-style methods represent this structure with the Ideographic Description Sequence (IDS) and align it with glyph images in a shared embedding space. However, they rely on a single global image--IDS similarity that discards the spatial layout of radicals and, being learned only implicitly from seen classes, generalizes poorly to unseen ones; moreover, global matching often retrieves the correct character within the top candidates yet fails to rank it first when characters differ only in subtle local radicals. To address these issues, we propose a global-to-local two-stage framework. In the first stage, STG-CLIP augments the IDS with explicit tree-position and radical-level geometric priors, yielding a spatial-aware prototype that provides a consistent spatial description across seen and unseen categories for high-recall global retrieval. In the second stage, the Radical Verification Module (RVM) uses the radical instances of each retrieved candidate as queries to verify whether the corresponding radicals can be matched to spatially compatible regions in the input glyph. A margin-based gating rule activates the RVM only when the leading global candidates receive similar similarity scores. Experiments on the ICDAR2013 benchmark demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance under the character-level zero-shot setting, obtaining 83.06% top-1 accuracy with 2,755 seen classes. Ablation studies further show that the explicit geometric priors and radical-level verification provide complementary improvements.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种从全局到局部的两阶段零样本汉字识别框架，第一阶段STG-CLIP在IDS中引入树位置与部首级几何先验构建空间感知原型用于高召回全局检索，第二阶段部首验证模块(RVM)以候选部首为查询验证其与输入字形区域的匹配，并在领先候选择分数接近时通过间隔门控激活，在ICDAR2013字符级零样本设置下取得83.06%的top-1准确率（2755个可见类）。
AI.motivation: 现有CLIP式零样本汉字识别方法用IDS表示结构并与字形图像在共享空间对齐，但存在两个问题：一是仅依赖单一全局的"图像-IDS"相似度，丢弃了部首的空间布局，且只从可见类中隐式学习，对未见类泛化差；二是全局匹配常在top候选中召回到正确字符，但当字符仅在细微局部部首上有差异时难以将其排到首位。
AI.method: 提出从全局到局部的两阶段框架。第一阶段STG-CLIP：为IDS加入显式的树位置先验与部首级几何先验，生成空间感知原型，在可见与未见类别间提供一致的空间描述，用于高召回全局检索。第二阶段RVM（部首验证模块）：以每个检索候选的部首实例作为查询，验证其能否匹配到输入字形中空间上兼容的区域；采用基于间隔(margin)的门控规则，仅当领先的全局候选相似度接近时才激活RVM。
AI.result: 在ICDAR2013基准上，于字符级零样本设置下达到当前最优性能，在2755个可见类条件下取得83.06%的top-1准确率；消融实验表明显式几何先验与部首级验证带来互补的提升。
AI.conclusion: 显式的空间/几何先验与部首级验证能有效弥补全局图像-IDS匹配在空间布局建模和细粒度区分上的不足，二者互补，共同提升零样本汉字识别性能。

title: Let the Library Speak: Self-Advertised Method Selection for Formal Proving
summary: LLM-based formal provers can retrieve relevant lemmas and prior proofs, but relevance alone does not say whether a mathematical method can be used on the current theorem. A method has prerequisites, a target, an intended action, and obligations that its use leaves to prove. Methods that look equally related to a theorem may therefore differ substantially in whether they offer a plausible next step. We formulate this as an applicability-aware method-selection problem and introduce self-advertisement: before candidates are ranked, a model generates a problem-specific proposal for each one, stating what part of the goal it targets, what action it would take, and what conditions that action requires. We organize 82 reusable methods from Putnam 2000-2014 as Method Contracts, which pair applicability descriptions with Mathlib anchors, a checked example or scaffold, and expected proof obligations. A single batched call elicits proposals across the library; vague or unsupported proposals are demoted, yielding a ranked shortlist accompanied by inspectable claims about each candidate's use. We analyze when similarity-based representations cannot distinguish methods with different applicability, how errors in applicability estimates affect shortlist quality, and what a checked scaffold guarantees under its stated assumptions. Against lexical, embedding, and embedding-plus-LLM reranking baselines, self-advertisement achieves 95.0% hit@5 on Putnam 2015-2025, compared with 84.2% for the strongest reranker. On IMO ProofBench, it achieves 91.7% compared with 88.3%. These results indicate improved coverage of annotated methods in the retrieved shortlists, particularly on Putnam.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"自广告"（self-advertisement）方法选择机制：让模型为每个候选方法生成问题特定的适用性提案（目标部位、采取动作、所需条件），据此对方法排序，实现适用性感知的方法选择。
AI.motivation: 现有基于LLM的形式化证明器仅凭"相关性"检索引理与先前证明，但相关性无法判断某个数学方法能否用于当前定理。方法具有前提、目标、预期动作与遗留证明义务，因此外观同样相关的方法在实际可推进性上差异巨大，需要引入适用性感知的方法选择。
AI.method: 将Putnam 2000-2014的82个可复用方法组织为Method Contracts，每条包含适用性描述、Mathlib锚点、已校验的示例或脚手架，以及预期证明义务。排序前先让模型生成问题特定的提案（self-advertisement），说明针对目标的哪个部分、采取何种动作、该动作需要什么条件。通过单次批量调用为整个库生成提案，模糊或无依据的提案被降级，最终产出带可检查声明的排序短名单。论文还分析了相似度表示无法区分不同适用性方法的情形、适用性估计误差对短名单质量的影响，以及已校验脚手架在其陈述假设下的保证。
AI.result: 与词法、嵌入、嵌入+LLM重排等基线相比，self-advertisement在Putnam 2015-2025上达到95.0% hit@5（最强重排器为84.2%）；在IMO ProofBench上达到91.7%（对比88.3%）。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明检索短名单对已标注方法的覆盖率得到提升，在Putnam上尤为显著，验证了适用性感知方法选择优于纯相似度排序。

title: Consistent Distribution Matching for Data-Free Diffusion Distillation
summary: Flow and diffusion models suffer from slow inference due to computationally expensive numerical integration. Distillation provides a promising way for a student model to learn from a teacher's dynamics, enabling one-step or few-step generation. However, existing methods often depend on curated distillation datasets, costly teacher rollouts, or auxiliary proxy networks, which complicate model training and scaling. In this work, we propose Consistent Distribution Matching, a simulation-free and data-free distillation method for accelerating diffusion and flow models while preserving strong generative capacity. Our key insight is to unify sample generation and score estimation with one student network. Thus, our framework uses only two models, a frozen teacher and a trainable student, and optimizes one objective. We prove that minimizing our objective indicates Wasserstein convergence of the student flow-map pushforwards to the teacher marginals. On ImageNet 256$\times$256, our method attains an FID of 2.04 with a single function evaluation (1-NFE) and a 4-NFE FID of 1.37 within 40 epochs of training, surpassing the state-of-the-art distillation baselines without data. Our code code and model are available at https://consistentdmd.github.io/.

AI.tldr: 提出 Consistent Distribution Matching，一种无需模拟、无需数据的蒸馏方法，用于加速扩散与流模型，同时保持强生成能力。
AI.motivation: 扩散与流模型因数值积分计算昂贵而推理缓慢；现有蒸馏方法依赖精选数据集、昂贵的教师轨迹采样或辅助代理网络，增加训练与扩展的复杂度。
AI.method: 核心洞察是统一采样生成与分数估计于同一学生网络。框架仅含两个模型：冻结的教师与可训练的学生，并优化单一目标，实现仿真自由且数据自由的蒸馏。
AI.result: 证明最小化该目标意味着学生流映射前推分布到教师边缘分布的 Wasserstein 收敛。在 ImageNet 256×256 上，40 个训练周期内达到 1-NFE FID 2.04、4-NFE FID 1.37，超越无数据的最先进蒸馏基线。
AI.conclusion: 该方法在不依赖数据、教师轨迹或辅助网络的前提下，实现了高效且高质量的一步/少步生成，验证了统一生成与分数估计的蒸馏框架的有效性与可扩展性。

title: Enhancing Robotic Perception and Adaptability through Sensor Fusion and Origami-Inspired Designs
summary: Compact mobile robots must recover scene geometry under changing lighting and surface texture while working within tight payload and cost limits. We present a compact mobile robot that uses origami-inspired wheels for locomotion and active control of its sensing geometry. As the wheels move between terrain-adaptive configurations, the changing chassis pitch sweeps a 2D LiDAR through intermediate elevations; held wheel positions provide a chosen viewing angle. An IMU accounts for chassis attitude, and a fusion node projects LiDAR returns into the RGB-D depth stream supplied to RTAB-Map. The arrangement uses the wheel actuation already present on a sub-300 USD, sub-2 kg prototype to extend the scanner's viewing geometry. We assess depth fusion in a textureless indoor corridor and an outdoor sunlit area, with three runs per sensor configuration in each setting. Mean full-frame invalid-depth fractions fell from 21% to 11% indoors and from 48% to 18% outdoors. The prototype combines improved depth coverage with a continuously adjustable LiDAR viewpoint using the same actuation that reconfigures its wheels.

AI.tldr: 一种利用折纸启发式车轮同时实现移动与传感几何主动控制的紧凑移动机器人，通过车轮构型变化驱动底盘俯仰以扫描2D LiDAR，并与RGB-D深度融合，显著降低无效深度比例。
AI.motivation: 紧凑移动机器人需在载荷与成本严格受限的条件下，应对光照变化与表面纹理缺失带来的几何感知困难，传统固定视角传感器难以获得充分深度覆盖。
AI.method: 设计折纸启发式车轮用于运动及传感几何的主动控制：车轮在地形自适应构型间移动时，底盘俯仰变化使2D LiDAR扫过中间高度，固定车轮位置可提供选定视角；IMU补偿底盘姿态，融合节点将LiDAR回波投影至RGB-D深度流并输入RTAB-Map；复用已有车轮驱动（原型低于300美元、低于2 kg）。
AI.result: 在无纹理室内走廊与户外阳光区域评估深度融合，每种传感器配置在每个场景各运行三次。全帧无效深度比例均值室内由21%降至11%，户外由48%降至18%。
AI.conclusion: 该原型以复用车轮驱动的同一执行机构，在提升深度覆盖的同时实现了连续可调的LiDAR视点。

title: LLM Persuasion Is in the Eye of the Evaluation
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have already been shown to match or exceed human experts in persuasion. While their persuasive capabilities hold promise for beneficial uses such as education and health communication, they can also be used to manipulate and misinform, making their evaluation a growing priority for developers and regulators. That evaluation, however, remains fragmented: studies differ in what they treat as persuasion, and broad claims often rest on narrow, situation-specific assessments. Automated methods, often modelled on human studies, offer a way to compare such assessments directly, as they can be run on the same models at scale and can include high-risk forms of persuasion that would be difficult or unethical to test on people. In this study, we adapt nine published automated methods to a shared setup, run them on the same fifteen LLMs, and ask whether their rankings agree and why. We find that the methods agree only weakly (mean Spearman $ρ= 0.25$). Our analyses point to two contributing factors. Models that refuse some tasks but not others, directly or indirectly, lower agreement by about a quarter, and these refusals fall mostly on manipulation tasks. General capability also plays a part: most rational persuasion (non-manipulative) methods track it, whereas most manipulation methods do not. Together, these findings suggest that agreement depends more on the task a method sets than on how it scores persuasion, although this pattern is only indicative given the eight methods available for analysis. More broadly, our results suggest that persuasion scores combine a model's ability to persuade with its willingness to do so. A single score is therefore informative about its own setting, but says little about a model's persuasiveness across tasks.

AI.tldr: 该研究将九种已发表的自动化说服力评估方法统一到相同设置下，对十五个LLM进行测评，发现不同方法对模型说服力的排名仅弱一致（平均Spearman ρ=0.25）。拒答行为（主要集中于操纵类任务）和能力差异是导致分歧的两大因素，说明单一说服力分数只能反映特定任务情境，不能代表模型的整体说服力。
AI.motivation: LLM的说服能力已可比肩甚至超越人类专家，既能用于教育、健康传播等有益场景，也可能被用于操纵与误导，因此开发者与监管者亟需对其说服力进行评估。然而现有评估较为碎片化：不同研究对"说服"的界定不一，宽泛结论往往建立在狭窄、情境化的测评之上。自动化方法可在大规模、同一模型上直接比较这些测评，并能覆盖难以或不道德地在人身上测试的高风险说服形式，因而成为整合评估的有效途径。
AI.method: 作者将九种已发表的自动化说服评估方法适配到统一的实验设置中，在相同的十五个LLM上运行，并检验这些方法的排名是否一致及其原因。分析中还考察了模型的拒答行为和通用能力对方法间一致性的影响。
AI.result: 各方法之间仅呈现弱一致性，平均Spearman ρ=0.25。两类因素导致分歧：一是模型对部分任务拒答而对另一些不拒答（无论直接或间接），使一致性降低约四分之一，且拒答主要出现在操纵类任务上；二是通用能力的影响，多数理性（非操纵）说服方法会追踪通用能力，而多数操纵类方法则不会。
AI.conclusion: 方法间的一致性更多取决于方法所设定的任务，而非其打分方式，但鉴于可用于分析的仅八种方法，该结论仅为提示性。更广泛地看，说服力分数混合了模型的说服能力与其说服意愿，因此单一分数只对其自身的设定有信息量，难以说明模型跨任务的整体说服力。

title: Iris-3B: Going Beyond the Latent with Pixel-Space Diffusion Training, Conversion and Fine-Tuning
comment: 19 pages, 13 figures, 6 tables. Project lead: Hanqiu Li Cai. Code and models: https://github.com/speridlabs
summary: Pixel-space diffusion models avoid the lossy VAE of latent models, which suggests an advantage on downstream tasks where fine-grained detail matters. We test this claim along both routes to a pixel-space backbone. We pretrain Iris-3B, a 3B-parameter pixel-space text-to-image transformer, from scratch through a $256\to512\to1024$ curriculum, after first ablating the prediction target and representation alignment at $256^2$ to decide what to scale. We also convert a pretrained latent model, FLUX.2 Klein base 4B, to pixel space. We fine-tune both families for monocular depth estimation and for image restoration/super-resolution. We find no significant improvement from using a pixel-space generative prior. Fine-tuned for depth with one matched direct-regression recipe, Iris-3B is level with the latent FLUX.2 Klein and the converted pixel FLUX.2 Klein falls behind it, and on $4\times$ DIV2K restoration neither pixel model beats a latent FLUX.2 Klein fine-tune, the converted one trailing it slightly. We document the recipes, the failure modes and the remaining confounds behind this negative result. Nevertheless, Iris-3B shows that pixel-space pretraining with the pixel-transformer (PiT) head of PixelDiT scales to 3B parameters and to text-to-image quality competitive with latent models, matching Qwen-Image on OneIG under the official evaluators at $1024^2$. We release its weights and training code in the hope that they help pave the way for further work on pixel-space generation.

AI.tldr: 该论文系统检验了"像素空间扩散模型因不含VAE而更利于细粒度下游任务"这一说法，从零预训练3B像素空间T2I模型Iris-3B，并将预训练潜空间模型FLUX.2 Klein 4B转换为像素空间，在深度估计与图像复原任务上均未发现像素空间生成先验带来显著优势；但Iris-3B证明像素空间预训练可扩展到3B参数且T2I质量可比肩潜空间模型。
AI.motivation: 潜空间扩散模型依赖VAE压缩，可能损失细粒度细节，因此普遍推测像素空间模型在下游细粒度任务上更具优势。作者希望以受控实验证伪或证实这一假设，并探索像素空间骨干的可扩展性。
AI.method: 论文沿两条路径构建像素空间骨干：(1) 从零预训练Iris-3B，一个3B参数的像素空间文本到图像Transformer，采用256→512→1024课程学习，并在256²分辨率上先对预测目标与表征对齐进行消融以确定缩放方案；(2) 将预训练的潜空间模型FLUX.2 Klein base 4B转换为像素空间。随后以匹配的直接回归配方分别微调两个模型族，用于单目深度估计和图像复原/超分辨率。
AI.result: 在深度估计任务上，Iris-3B与潜空间FLUX.2 Klein持平，转换后的像素版FLUX.2 Klein则落后于它；在4× DIV2K复原任务上，两个像素模型均未超过潜空间FLUX.2 Klein微调版，转换版略逊。整体未观察到像素空间生成先验带来的显著改进。另一方面，Iris-3B在1024²下使用官方评测器在OneIG上与Qwen-Image持平。
AI.conclusion: 负结果：像素空间生成先验在下游细粒度任务上并无显著优势，论文记录了配方、失败模式与潜在混杂因素。正面贡献：Iris-3B证明基于PixelDiT的PiT头进行像素空间预训练可扩展至3B参数并达到与潜空间模型相当的T2I质量，作者公开权重与训练代码以推动后续研究。

title: Efficient Reasoning with Flow Language Models
summary: Flow Language Models (FLMs) have emerged as a continuous-state alternative to discrete diffusion language models, yet the role of their continuous representations in reasoning remains unclear. We investigate this question by comparing the reasoning efficiency of FLMs and discrete diffusion models, measured by solution accuracy under matched denoising steps. Unlike discrete diffusion, which passes categorical states between denoising steps, FLMs evolve a continuous sequence representation throughout denoising and decodes it into discrete tokens only at the end. Our theoretical analysis shows, from a superposition perspective, how information retained in these continuous states can benefit reasoning. Intermediate-state interventions provide further empirical support for this theoretical account, showing that removing information about alternative candidates reduces subsequent solution recovery. Together, these findings show that FLMs allow evidence for multiple candidates to persist and inform subsequent reasoning before a discrete answer is produced. Furthermore, our experiments on maze planning and Sudoku tasks show that FLMs achieve greater reasoning efficiency in the few-step regime: FLMs achieves higher sequence accuracy than discrete diffusion baselines at matched model sizes and small denoising steps. On maze planning tasks, FLMs can also achieve comparable accuracy with smaller models. For example, on Maze15, FLM reaches the 95\% accuracy target at 64 denoising steps with 36.5\% fewer parameters than MDLM. These findings point to continuous state spaces as a promising foundation for reasoning models that require fewer refinement steps.

AI.tldr: Flow Language Models（FLM）在少步去噪场景下的推理效率优于离散扩散模型，其连续状态表征能同时保留多个候选证据并服务后续推理。
AI.motivation: 连续状态语言模型（FLM）作为离散扩散模型的替代方案已出现，但其连续表征在推理中究竟起什么作用尚不清楚。作者希望在去噪步数匹配的条件下，厘清连续状态空间是否以及如何提升推理效率。
AI.method: 从叠加（superposition）视角进行理论分析，论证连续状态中保留的信息如何有益于推理；并设计中间状态干预实验，通过移除关于备选候选的信息来检验该理论解释。在迷宫规划和数独任务上，将 FLM 与离散扩散基线在相同模型规模与去噪步数下对比序列准确率。
AI.result: 中间状态干预实验表明，移除备选候选信息会降低后续答案恢复能力，支持理论分析。在迷宫规划与数独任务中，FLM 于少步去噪区间取得更高的序列准确率；在 Maze15 上，FLM 以比 MDLM 少 36.5% 的参数、在 64 步去噪时达到 95% 准确率目标；在迷宫规划任务上，FLM 还能用更小的模型达到可比准确率。
AI.conclusion: FLM 允许关于多个候选的证据在生成离散答案之前持续存在并影响后续推理，从而在少步精修条件下实现更高的推理效率；连续状态空间可作为需要更少精修步数的推理模型的有前景基础。

title: Conditional Accuracy Profiles: Diagnosing LLM Judges across Deployment Conditions
summary: LLM-as-judge is now a standard tool for scalable evaluation, but judge performance is still often summarized by a single accuracy number. This aggregate view hides the deployment conditions under which a judge succeeds or fails. We introduce \textbf{Conditional Accuracy Profiling} (CAP), a post-hoc diagnostic framework that decomposes pairwise LLM-judge accuracy into eight conditions organized into content sensitivity, robustness, and rationale quality. CAP is benchmark-agnostic: it can be applied directly when a benchmark provides the required annotations, approximately through task-subset proxies, or through controlled augmentation when perturbation pairs can be generated. We instantiate CAP on seven LLM judges across six pairwise judging benchmarks, including \textsc{judgerEva-Standard}, a controlled testbed we created to support all eight conditions. CAP exposes profile differences hidden by aggregate accuracy: on \textsc{judgerEva}'s judge-independent Hard-Constructed subset, the two judges most sensitive to omitted qualifications rank in the bottom three of seven by overall accuracy, so omission sensitivity is not predicted by aggregate accuracy. Across benchmarks, Position Robustness shows the strongest rank stability (mean Spearman $\barρ{=}0.87$) but is itself fragile under JudgeBench-Pro adversarial stress, showing the largest mean accuracy drop among the shared conditions, though the dominant degradation channel varies by judge. Condition-level profiles provide a more actionable basis than aggregate accuracy for selecting LLM judges.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出条件准确率剖析（CAP），将LLM评委的成对评判准确率分解为内容敏感性、鲁棒性与理由质量三个维度下的八个条件，用于诊断评委在不同部署条件下的表现差异。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM-as-judge评估通常仅用单一准确率数字概括评委性能，这种聚合视角掩盖了评委在何种部署条件下成功或失败，无法为评委选择提供可操作的依据。
AI.method: 提出事后诊断框架CAP，将成对LLM评委准确率分解为八个条件，归入内容敏感性、鲁棒性、理由质量三类；该框架与基准无关，可通过基准自带标注直接应用、通过任务子集代理近似应用，或在可生成扰动对时通过受控增强实现。在六个成对评判基准、七个LLM评委上实例化CAP，并构建支持全部八个条件的受控测试床judgerEva-Standard。
AI.result: 在judgerEva的评委无关Hard-Constructed子集上，对遗漏限定条件最敏感的两个评委按总体准确率在七个评委中排名后三，说明遗漏敏感性无法由聚合准确率预测；跨基准来看，位置鲁棒性排名稳定性最强（平均Spearman ρ̄=0.87），但在JudgeBench-Pro对抗压力下最脆弱，共享条件中平均准确率下降最大，且主导退化通道因评委而异。
AI.conclusion: 条件级剖析比聚合准确率为选择LLM评委提供了更具可操作性的依据。

title: Towards Accurate End-Effector Localization for UMI-Style Robotic Manipulation Teaching
comment: 9 pages, 8 figures, 5 tables. Project page: https://mild-web.github.io
summary: Robot demonstration learning requires accurate and temporally complete end-effector localization during close-range manipulation and camera occlusion. Existing SLAM benchmarks emphasize navigation motions, whereas manipulation datasets prioritize policy learning over localization evaluation. We introduce MILD, a Manipulation-Interface Localization Dataset with real-world and simulation sequences. The real-world subset provides 86 sensor sequences from Insta360 X5 and Insight9 across 15 repeated tabletop tasks, calibration assets, and a per-execution robot end-effector reference trajectory. The simulation subset, MILD-Sim, extends task coverage in Isaac Sim for controlled manipulation-replay studies. Benchmarking visual-inertial and fiducial-aided systems on instrumented real-world recordings reveals large differences in both TCP-relative trajectory error and temporal coverage, even under the same nominal task. To support marker-augmented teaching workspaces without a pre-surveyed fiducial map, we present AprilVINS, which combines fisheye visual-inertial estimation with sequence-local AprilTag geometry and separates prior admission from guarded export of the jointly optimized state. On Insta360 AprilTag4 recordings, AprilVINS(full) under a unified protocol with sequence-specific profiles reaches millimeter-level SE(3)-aligned TCP-relative APE RMSE with high time completion and lower reported error than the tested routes under their respective protocols, whereas fisheye VIO without tag factors remains at centimeter scale. Ablations separate accuracy from exportability, and a MILD-Sim replay study provides task-specific tolerance references for interpreting those error magnitudes. Together, MILD and AprilVINS provide a diagnostic benchmarking framework for UMI-style demonstration collection. Code, datasets, and evaluation manifests will be released upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MILD（面向操作的接口定位数据集，含真实86条序列与Isaac Sim仿真子集）与AprilVINS（鱼眼视觉惯性+序列局部AprilTag几何），构建UMI式演示采集的定位基准，在Insta360 AprilTag4录制上达到毫米级TCP相对APE RMSE并具高时间覆盖。
AI.motivation: 机器人演示学习在近距离操作与相机遮挡下需要准确且时间完整的末端执行器定位，但现有SLAM基准偏重导航运动，操作数据集又侧重策略学习而忽视定位评测，缺乏针对性的诊断性基准。
AI.method: 构建MILD数据集：真实子集含Insta360 X5与Insight9的86条传感器序列、15个重复桌面任务、标定资产及每次执行的机器人末端参考轨迹；仿真子集MILD-Sim在Isaac Sim中扩展任务覆盖以支持受控操作回放研究。提出AprilVINS，将鱼眼视觉惯性估计与序列局部AprilTag几何结合，并将先验准入与联合优化状态的受保护导出相分离，无需预先测绘基准标志图。
AI.result: 在仪器化真实录制上，视觉惯性与基准辅助系统在TCP相对轨迹误差与时间覆盖上差异显著。Insta360 AprilTag4上，统一协议下AprilVINS(full)配合序列特定配置达到毫米级SE(3)对齐的TCP相对APE RMSE、高时间完成度，报告误差低于各对比路线在其自身协议下的结果；无标签因子的鱼眼VIO仍为厘米级。消融实验将精度与可导出性分离，MILD-Sim回放研究提供任务特定容差参考以解释误差量级。
AI.conclusion: MILD与AprilVINS共同提供面向UMI式演示采集的诊断性基准框架，代码、数据集与评测清单将于录用后发布。

title: Nobody Truly Agrees on Sentiment: Humans, Bespoke Tools, and LLMs Struggle with Social Media Texts
comment: 11 pages, 1 figure, 2 tables, accepted for publication at TPDL 2026
summary: Social media is a rich source of real-time public sentiment, but widely used sentiment analysis tools are often applied without understanding their limitations.
