In this study, we evaluate the inter-rater reliability of three bespoke sentiment analysis tools (TextBlob, VADER, and Twitter-roBERTa-base) and three large language models (LLMs: Qwen3-32B, GPT-OSS-120B, Llama-4-Maverick-17B) against six human raters across 100 tweets. We measured agreement using two statistical measures: Cohen's kappa for pairwise comparisons and Fleiss' kappa for multiple raters. Even among the human raters, our results showed only fair agreement, highlighting the subjectivity of sentiment analysis. Higher agreement was observed under the binary sentiment classification (negative vs. non-negative and positive vs. non-positive) than under the three-class classification across both humans and automated tools. The Twitter-roBERTa-base model showed the strongest alignment with human ratings, outperforming both bespoke sentiment tools and LLMs, particularly in distinguishing negative versus non-negative sentiment. LLMs showed substantial agreement among themselves and moderate to substantial alignment with humans, performing better in positive vs. non-positive classifications. Our findings underscore that domain-specific fine-tuning remains crucial for reliable social media sentiment analysis, and human-centered evaluation remains essential for establishing gold-standard labels.

AI.tldr: 本研究对3种情感分析工具（TextBlob、VADER、Twitter-roBERTa-base）与3个大语言模型（Qwen3-32B、GPT-OSS-120B、Llama-4-Maverick-17B）在100条推文上与6名人工评分者进行一致性评估，发现人类评分者间仅为中等一致性，二元分类一致性高于三类分类，Twitter-roBERTa-base与人类评分最契合。
AI.motivation: 社交媒体是实时公众情绪的重要来源，但常用情感分析工具常在其局限性未被充分理解的情况下被直接使用，缺乏对工具与人类标注一致性的系统性评估，因此需要检验其评分者间信度并明确可靠使用的边界。
AI.method: 构建包含3种专用情感分析工具与3个大语言模型的对比评估框架，以100条推文为数据集、6名人工评分者为基准；采用Cohen's kappa进行两两比较、Fleiss' kappa进行多评分者一致性度量，并在三类分类与二元分类（negative vs. non-negative、positive vs. non-positive）两种设定下分别评测。
AI.result: 即便在人工评分者之间也仅达到fair（中等）一致性，凸显情感分析的主观性；人类与自动化工具在二元分类下的一致性均高于三类分类；Twitter-roBERTa-base与人类评分对齐度最强，优于专用工具与大语言模型，尤其在negative vs. non-negative区分上表现突出；大语言模型之间一致性较高（substantial），与人类为中等至较高一致性，在positive vs. non-positive分类上表现更好。
AI.conclusion: 领域特定微调对于可靠的社交媒体情感分析仍然至关重要，且以人为中心的评估仍是建立金标准标签的必要环节；情感分析工具的使用需结合其一致性局限进行审慎解读。

title: RLHND: Video Foundation Models as Physically Grounded Hand Trackers for Robot Learning
summary: Recently, approaches that leverage human video datasets for robot policy training have become increasingly prevalent. However, most existing hand trackers regress pose from cropped frames with limited priors on hand motion and object interaction, resulting in inaccurate and physically inconsistent estimates. Moreover, the lack of physical cues, e.g., contact and force, limits the use of human videos for robot policy training. To this end, we propose RLHND, a video foundation model-based hand tracking model that jointly estimates hand pose and realistic tactile information from monocular egocentric videos. RLHND turns the pre-trained Cosmos 3 video diffusion backbone into a deterministic clip-level feature extractor via clean-latent conditioning, carrying its learned priors on hand motion and hand-object interaction into tracking. For pose estimation, RLHND (i) predicts hand poses with anatomically plausible joint angles and (ii) enables optional conditioning on the shape parameter to maintain consistent hand shape within the same video and even across videos recorded by the same actor. For tactile estimation, a separate tactile expert stream, trained with the pose stream frozen, predicts dense contact and force over the hand surface. We further adopt LBS-based feature spreading to enable vertex-wise feature extraction without costly per-vertex attention. RLHND achieves state-of-the-art performance across various benchmark datasets for pose estimation, while also achieving state-of-the-art performance in contact and force estimation. Moreover, we demonstrate the utility of RLHND for robot learning through retargeting results and real-world robot experiments. The code will be publicly available at https://seungjun-moon.github.io/rlhnd/.

AI.tldr: 提出RLHND，一种基于视频基础模型的手部追踪模型，从单目第一视角视频中联合估计手部姿态与真实触觉信息，用于机器人策略训练。
AI.motivation: 现有手部追踪器多基于裁剪帧回归姿态，缺乏手部运动与物体交互先验，估计不准确且物理不一致；同时缺少接触、力等物理线索，限制人类视频用于机器人策略训练。
AI.method: 将预训练Cosmos 3视频扩散骨干通过干净潜变量条件化为确定性片段级特征提取器，注入手部运动与手-物交互先验。姿态估计预测解剖合理的关节角，并可选以形状参数为条件保持同一视频甚至同一演员跨视频的手形一致。触觉估计采用独立专家流（姿态流冻结），预测手表面稠密接触与力。采用基于LBS的特征传播实现逐顶点特征提取，避免昂贵的逐顶点注意力。
AI.result: 在手部姿态估计多个基准数据集上达到SOTA，在接触与力估计上同样达到SOTA；并通过重定向结果和真实机器人实验验证了RLHND对机器人学习的实用性。
AI.conclusion: RLHND通过视频基础模型联合建模手部姿态与触觉信息，提升估计精度与物理一致性，为人类视频用于机器人策略训练提供了有效途径，代码将公开。

title: RSI-Forge: From Research Papers to Environments for Recursive Self-Improvement
summary: Environments are the foundation of recursive self-improvement: they provide the problems agents work on and the feedback used to evaluate progress. Yet constructing challenging research environments with reliable evaluation still depends on domain experts, limiting their scale and disciplinary coverage. We introduce RSI-Forge, a multi-agent pipeline that turns published papers into executable environments for self-improvement. Three agents coordinate construction, reproduction, and review to produce tasks with automated evaluators; each paper's method is independently reimplemented to establish a baseline score. We present 210 environments across 18 fields, including 90 reviewed by independent human domain experts. Both experts and agent judges give high ratings to the potential for improving the provided starting solutions and the evaluators' ability to distinguish solution quality, whereas experts are more critical of shortcut resistance, faithfulness to the source paper, and whether a single idea can exhaust a task. To validate their use for repeated improvement, we evaluate four models over 3 successive attempts on 120 environments, with each attempt inheriting prior code and notes while model weights remain fixed. At least one model improves after the first attempt in 84% of environments. Models also outperform the reproduced paper methods in 68 of the 120 environments, demonstrating room for gains beyond these baselines. Transcript analysis identifies work beyond parameter tuning in 95% of these successful attempts. Analysis of the resulting trajectories shows that models scoring lower on these tasks explore less, more often accept gains smaller than the reported standard error, and rely more heavily on tuning to the development set. RSI-Forge provides a scalable approach to constructing research environments for training and evaluating self-improving agents.

AI.tldr: 提出RSI-Forge多智能体流水线，将已发表论文自动转化为可执行的自改进研究环境，构建了覆盖18个领域的210个环境，并验证其用于模型多轮自改进评估的有效性。
AI.motivation: 递归自改进依赖环境提供问题与反馈，但构建具有可靠评估的挑战性研究环境仍依赖领域专家，限制了规模与学科覆盖范围，因此需要一种可扩展的自动化环境构建方法。
AI.method: RSI-Forge由三个智能体协作完成构建、复现与评审，生成带自动评估器的任务，并对每篇论文方法进行独立重实现以建立基线分数；共构建210个环境、覆盖18个领域，其中90个由独立人类领域专家评审。随后在120个环境上对四个模型进行连续3次尝试的评估，每次继承前次代码与笔记而模型权重固定。
AI.result: 专家与智能体评审均高度认可改进初始解的潜力及评估器区分解质量的能力，但专家对捷径抗性、对源论文的忠实度、以及单一想法能否穷尽任务更为挑剔。至少一个模型在84%的环境中于首次尝试后取得提升；模型在120个环境中的68个超越复现的论文方法。转录分析显示95%的成功尝试超出单纯调参。轨迹分析表明，得分较低的模型探索更少、更易接受小于报告标准误的增益，并更依赖对开发集的调参。
AI.conclusion: RSI-Forge为构建用于训练与评估自改进智能体的研究环境提供了可扩展途径，同时揭示了当前模型在探索策略与增益判定上的局限。

title: Symmetry-Informed Causal Partial Identification
summary: Partial identification (PI) entails estimating bounds on causal effects by encoding different assumptions on data generation as a constrained optimization problem. Such bounds can suffice to inform policy decisions even if the causal effect itself is not identifiable. Often vacuous in practice, practitioners seek to exhaustively encode domain knowledge as additional constraints to make the PI bounds more informative. We introduce known data symmetries -- invariance of the causal effect under certain data transformations -- as a new source of constraints to inform PI. We operationalize this as a shape constraint on the causal function, and via a change of measure against which PI is posed using simple data pre-processing. Both approaches are shown to sharpen bounds under two canonical PI models. This is shown both theoretically for the population case, and via experiments in the finite-sample case. More broadly, our framework establishes data symmetries as a natural, underutilized source of background knowledge for robust causal inference.

AI.tldr: 本文将数据对称性（因果效应在特定数据变换下的不变性）作为部分识别（PI）的新约束来源，通过在因果函数上施加形状约束或经测度变换的数据预处理来实现，理论上和实验上均证明其在两个典型PI模型中能收紧因果效应的界限。
AI.motivation: 部分识别通过将数据生成假设编码为约束优化问题来估计因果效应的界限，即使因果效应本身不可识别，这些界限也可能足以指导政策决策。然而在实践中，PI界限往往过于宽松（vacuous），因此研究者希望尽可能多地编码领域知识作为额外约束，使界限更具信息量。本文旨在寻找新的约束来源。
AI.method: 作者引入"已知数据对称性"，即因果效应在某些数据变换下的不变性，作为PI的新约束来源。具体通过两种方式实现：一是将其作为因果函数上的形状约束；二是通过简单数据预处理进行测度变换（change of measure）来重新表述PI问题。
AI.result: 在两个典型PI模型下，两种方法均能收紧界限。这一结论在总体情形（population case）通过理论证明，在有限样本情形（finite-sample case）通过实验验证。
AI.conclusion: 本文框架将数据对称性确立为稳健因果推断中一种自然但尚未充分利用的背景知识来源。

title: Juno: Taming Predictive Latents for Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Joint-embedding predictive architectures (JEPAs) predict masked or future observations in representation space, offering a natural source of predictive latents for vision-language-action (VLA) models. Yet making these latents useful across pretraining, policy learning, and deployment requires addressing three failures: mismatch with embodiment-specific control, interference with action learning, and teacher miscalibration under distribution shifts. We introduce Juno, a unified framework built around one action-conditioned JEPA that serves as a control-aligned representation backbone, a predictive teacher, and an adaptable dynamics model. During pretraining, we train it on embodiment-matched trajectories and use a dynamic CLS loss to transfer motion-weighted patch dynamics to a compact global state. During policy learning, we fuse current-frame JEPA patches into VLA perception and use a decoupled reasoning branch with separate transformation parameters to distill future latent states for action generation. During deployment, we adapt the world model on all observed transitions, including failed rollouts, freeze the adapted teacher, and re-align the policy on verified executions using LoRA adapters and a trainable action head, without expert corrections or task rewards. On SimplerEnv, Juno raises average success from $60.9\%$ to $68.5\%$ over Qwen3GR00T, the strongest baseline, and test-time adaptation further reaches $72.7\%$; on a real robot, it retains $70\%$--$75\%$ success under background, height, and object shifts where the base policy collapses to $0\%$.

AI.tldr: Juno提出统一的动作条件JEPA框架，将同一预测模型分别用作控制对齐表征骨干、预测教师与可适应动力学模型，在仿真与真机任务上显著优于基线。
AI.motivation: JEPA在表征空间预测掩码或未来观测，可为VLA模型提供预测性隐变量，但要在预训练、策略学习与部署中同时可用，需解决三个问题：与具身控制不匹配、对动作学习产生干扰、分布偏移下教师失准。
AI.method: 构建单一动作条件JEPA，兼作控制对齐表征骨干、预测教师和可适应动力学模型。预训练阶段在具身匹配轨迹上训练，并用动态CLS损失将运动加权patch动力学迁移到紧凑全局状态；策略学习阶段把当前帧JEPA patch融入VLA感知，并用解耦推理分支（独立变换参数）蒸馏未来隐状态以生成动作；部署阶段在所有观测转移（含失败rollout）上适应世界模型，冻结适应后的教师，并用LoRA适配器与可训练动作头在验证过的执行上重新对齐策略，无需专家纠正或任务奖励。
AI.result: 在SimplerEnv上，Juno相对最强基线Qwen3GR00T将平均成功率从60.9%提升至68.5%，测试时适应进一步提升至72.7%；在真实机器人上，于背景、高度和物体偏移条件下保持70%–75%成功率，而基础策略降至0%。
AI.conclusion: 单一动作条件JEPA可统一承担表征、教师与动力学模型三重角色，配合动态CLS损失、解耦推理蒸馏及无需奖励的部署期适应，能有效提升VLA策略的鲁棒性与跨分布泛化能力。

title: Learning to Act with Task Progress: Distilling Small Agents from Compact Teacher Supervision
summary: Learning from large-model demonstrations offers a way to train small agents that can complete recurring tasks without calling a large model at every step. A central design choice is what to retain from teacher trajectories that contain reasoning, actions, and information about task progress. We introduce Task-Progress Distillation (TPD), an offline approach that pairs each demonstrated action with a short label describing the current task stage. The student learns these compact targets and selects actions by jointly scoring admissible stage--action pairs, which a deterministic harness executes in the environment. On ALFWorld, a 1.7B student trained with 404 demonstrations achieves 72.4\% mean unseen task success with either TPD or action-only supervision, compared with 48.3\% for a reasoning-trained student using constrained action selection. Explicit stages provide an additional benefit at 200 demonstrations, improving success from 48.0\% to 67.7\% over action-only supervision. With more demonstrations, the action-only student closes the gap, and both approaches reach 76.9\% at 808 demonstrations. Shared-history analyses link part of TPD's local advantage to better decisions when moving between subgoals, particularly from object acquisition to processing. These results show that compact supervision can train effective small task agents, while explicit task progress provides additional guidance at an intermediate demonstration budget.

AI.tldr: 本文提出任务进度蒸馏（TPD），将教师轨迹中的每个动作与描述当前任务阶段的短标签配对，学生模型通过联合评分"阶段-动作"对来选择动作并由确定性执行器在环境中执行。在ALFWorld上，1.7B学生模型在404条演示下达到72.4%的平均未见任务成功率，与仅动作监督相当，显著优于推理训练的48.3%；在200条演示下，显式阶段标签将成功率从48.0%提升至67.7%；演示增至808条时两者均达76.9%。
AI.motivation: 小模型智能体若要在重复任务中无需每步调用大模型，需要从大模型演示中学习。核心设计问题在于：教师轨迹包含推理、动作与任务进展信息，究竟应保留哪些内容作为监督信号。作者试图探究紧凑的监督（阶段标签）与仅动作监督、推理监督之间的效果差异。
AI.method: 提出离线方法TPD：将每条演示动作与一个描述当前任务阶段的短标签配对；学生模型学习这些紧凑目标，通过对可行的"阶段-动作"对进行联合评分来选择动作；所选动作由确定性执行器（deterministic harness）在环境中执行。文中对比了TPD、仅动作监督以及基于推理训练并使用受限动作选择的学生模型。
AI.result: 在ALFWorld上，1.7B学生模型使用404条演示时，TPD与仅动作监督均达到72.4%的未见任务平均成功率，而推理训练且受限动作选择的学生仅为48.3%。在200条演示时，显式阶段标签带来额外收益，成功率由48.0%提升至67.7%。演示数量增加后，仅动作监督的学生追平差距，两者在808条演示时均达76.9%。共享历史分析显示，TPD的局部优势部分源于子目标切换时（尤其是从物体获取到处理阶段）决策更优。
AI.conclusion: 紧凑监督足以训练出有效的小型任务智能体；显式任务进度标签在中等演示规模下能提供额外指导，但在演示数据充足时其优势被仅动作监督追平甚至消除。研究揭示了阶段标签在子目标转换决策上的关键作用。

title: An Invariant Tangent-Angle Descriptor and a Band U-Net for 2D Fragment Adjacency Prediction
summary: This paper addresses the prediction of adjacency between pairs of 2D fragments based on their contours. We improved the two-stage architecture proposed in Beaulac's thesis, in which a rotation-equivariant Siamese convolutional neural network scores pairs of local image windows along the two contours of two fragments. The scores are gathered in an adjacency matrix in which a ResNet detects the partial anti-diagonal band that reveals the adjacency of two fragments. In the current work, we keep the pipeline and replace the local score by a comparison of tangent-angle profiles of contour windows, making it, by construction, invariant to fragment rotation and agnostic to the selected contour-starting point. These adaptations may be either a training-free likelihood ratio or a small one-dimensional convolutional model trained on corresponding points. We also replaced the final classifier by a band U-Net that segments the band and classifies the pair, so that the shared arc is obtained along with the decision. In the synthetic data set of the original thesis, the tangent descriptor performs as well as or better than the image-window approach in all tested configurations. The proposed pipeline reaches an accuracy of 98%, vs 93% to 95% for the original approach once its evaluation is corrected. We tested our pipeline, with models trained only on synthetic data, on the PairingNet benchmark, and obtained an AUC of 0.93. Furthermore, under the PairingNet pair-searching protocol conditions, our learned descriptor obtains a Recall@10 of 0.82 on the real set against 0.56 from the best model of the original paper.

AI.tldr: 本文改进Beaulac两阶段碎片配对框架：用切线角轮廓描述子替换图像窗口局部打分，并以带状U-Net替代ResNet分类器，在合成与真实数据上均显著提升性能。
AI.motivation: 二维碎片轮廓邻接预测是碎片重组的关键步骤。原方法依赖旋转等变Siamese卷积网络对局部图像窗口打分，计算开销大且对碎片旋转、轮廓起点选择敏感，跨数据集泛化能力有限。
AI.method: 保留原两阶段流水线，将局部得分替换为轮廓窗口切线角轮廓的比较，天然具备旋转不变性且不依赖轮廓起点；该描述子可为免训练的似然比，也可为基于对应点训练的一维小卷积模型。最终分类器由ResNet改为带状U-Net，实现带区分割与配对分类联合输出，同时给出共享弧段。
AI.result: 在原始论文合成数据集上，切线描述子在各配置下均不劣于图像窗口方法；流水线准确率达98%（原方法修正评估后为93%–95%）。仅用合成数据训练的模型在PairingNet基准上取得AUC 0.93；在PairingNet配对搜索协议下，真实集Recall@10达0.82，而原论文最佳模型仅为0.56。
AI.conclusion: 基于切线角轮廓的局部描述子结合带状U-Net，在保持甚至简化架构的同时显著提升碎片邻接预测的准确率与跨域泛化能力，并额外输出共享弧段信息。

title: LLM-Enabled UAV Dispatch: A System-Level Survey and Taxonomy
summary: Unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) dispatch is beginning to move beyond isolated path planning and optimization-driven resource allocation toward system-level coordination supported by semantic reasoning and LLM-based interfaces. This survey provides a unified characterization of LLM-enabled UAV dispatch systems that bridges semantic intent, symbolic decision-making, and physical UAV execution. Rather than treating LLMs as standalone add-ons, we conceptualize them as a cross-layer semantic orchestration layer connecting human instructions, external solvers, and distributed control modules. We organize the literature into four representative dispatch paradigms: pipeline dispatch, global assignment dispatch, decentralized agentic dispatch, and divide-and-conquer dispatch. For each paradigm, we analyze its decision logic, system structure, control flow, representative methods, and potential LLM roles. We further examine how LLMs support semantic parsing, retrieval-grounded planning, solver orchestration, local agent reasoning, multi-agent coordination, safety assessment, and human-facing explanation. We discuss the implications of these paradigms for scalability, robustness, coordination burden, and verification requirements, and identify open challenges including latency-aware reasoning, grounding reliability, physical feasibility guarantees, edge deployment, privacy protection, and distributed consistency. This survey provides a system-level taxonomy and design perspective for integrating LLMs into safety-critical UAV dispatch systems.

AI.tldr: 该综述提出LLM赋能无人机调度的统一系统级刻画，将LLM视为连接语义意图、符号决策与物理执行的跨层语义编排层，归纳四类调度范式并分析其决策逻辑、系统结构与开放挑战。
AI.motivation: 无人机调度正从孤立的路径规划与优化驱动的资源分配，转向由语义推理和LLM接口支持的系统级协调；然而已有研究多将LLM视为独立附加组件，缺乏对语义意图、符号决策与物理执行之间衔接的统一刻画。
AI.method: 采用综述与分类学研究方法：将LLM概念化为跨层语义编排层，把文献组织为流水线调度、全局分配调度、去中心化智能体调度、分而治之调度四类代表性范式；对每类范式分析其决策逻辑、系统结构、控制流、代表性方法与LLM潜在角色，并考察LLM在语义解析、检索接地规划、求解器编排、局部智能体推理、多智能体协调、安全评估与人机解释等方面的作用。
AI.result: 形成覆盖四类调度范式的系统级分类体系，明确LLM在各层的功能定位，并讨论各范式在可扩展性、鲁棒性、协调负担与验证需求方面的影响。
AI.conclusion: 为将LLM集成到安全攸关的无人机调度系统提供了系统级分类与设计视角，并指出时延感知推理、接地可靠性、物理可行性保证、边缘部署、隐私保护与分布式一致性等开放挑战。

title: An Informational Curse of Horizon in Goal-Conditioned Policy Learning
summary: The difficulty of learning goal-reaching policies is often attributed to a "curse of horizon" that manifests as bias accumulation in temporal-difference backups and noisy advantage estimates. In this work, we identify an additional informational curse of horizon in goal-conditioned policy learning, where increasing the goal relabeling horizon can significantly reduce policy generalization and performance. Through a series of controlled experiments with oracle planners, we decouple the goal horizons sampled during training from those that the policy is asked to reach at test time. Even when evaluated only on a sequence of nearby subgoals, goal-conditioned behavioral cloning (BC) policies suffer from severe, training horizon-dependent performance degradation that is mitigated by reinforcement learning (RL) objectives. We explain this phenomenon as a horizon-dependent decrease in the conditional mutual information between actions and hindsight-relabeled goals, and find empirically that both BC and RL policies trained on longer-horizon goals exhibit a shift in sensitivity from goal to state information, as measured by the policy's input Jacobians. Motivated by this observation, we find that distilling the input Jacobians of short-horizon policies into long-horizon policies yields significant performance gains, especially in combinatorial manipulation tasks. Taken together, our results highlight goal relabeling horizon as an important consideration when learning generalist policies from offline data.

AI.tldr: 本文识别出目标条件策略学习中的一种"信息层面的时间跨度诅咒"：增大目标重标注跨度会显著降低策略泛化能力，其根源在于动作与事后重标注目标之间的条件互信息随跨度下降；通过将短跨度策略的输入雅可比蒸馏到长跨度策略可显著提升性能。
AI.motivation: 以往将目标到达策略的学习困难归因于"时间跨度诅咒"，表现为时序差分备份中的偏差累积与噪声优势估计。作者认为还存在另一种被忽视的、信息层面的时间跨度诅咒，即目标重标注跨度的增大会损害策略泛化与性能。
AI.method: 通过一系列使用预言机规划器的受控实验，将训练时采样的目标跨度与测试时要求达到的目标跨度解耦；对比目标条件行为克隆(BC)与强化学习(RL)目标；分析动作与事后重标注目标间的条件互信息随跨度的变化；用策略输入雅可比度量策略对目标信息与状态信息的敏感度；并将短跨度策略的输入雅可比蒸馏到长跨度策略中。
AI.result: 即使仅在邻近子目标序列上评估，目标条件BC策略也会出现严重的、依赖训练跨度的性能退化，而RL目标可缓解该问题；BC与RL策略在长跨度目标上训练时，其敏感度都从目标信息转向状态信息（由输入雅可比测得）；蒸馏短跨度策略的输入雅可比到长跨度策略可带来显著性能提升，在组合式操作任务中尤为明显。
AI.conclusion: 目标重标注跨度是离线数据上学习通用策略时的重要考量因素；所提出的信息层面时间跨度诅咒及其基于雅可比蒸馏的缓解方法，为提升目标条件策略的泛化性提供了新的视角与手段。

title: Many Ways to Succeed: Diversity-Driven RL Fine-Tuning for VLA Generalization
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) fine-tuning improves vision-language-action (VLA) policies through closed-loop experience, yet generalization beyond the fine-tuning distribution remains limited. Our analysis reveals a selective reshaping of exploration: RL contracts behavior globally, yet diversifies successful trajectories, elicits success with fewer rollouts, and covers more of the latent task-valid solution space than supervised fine-tuning. Broader successful-mode coverage may provide alternative strategies under distribution shifts. Inspired by this, we introduce DRIVE (Diversity-driven RL fIne-tuning for VLA gEneralization), which turns successful-behavior diversity into an explicit RL objective. DRIVE groups rollouts under matched task conditions, compares their trajectories with temporal alignment, and derives a success-conditioned intrinsic reward from relative behavioral diversity. This design encourages broader coverage of feasible solutions without rewarding diverse failures or superficial timing differences. Across LIBERO-Plus, ManiSkill3, and RoboTwin 2.0, DRIVE improves the average out-of-domain (OOD) performance over vanilla RL fine-tuning by 5.3 points on $π_0$ and 2.0 points on $π_{0.5}$. On a dual-arm AgileX PiPER-X platform, DRIVE further increases average OOD success from 64.1% to 73.3% (+9.2 points), demonstrating gains that persist under physical deployment.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DRIVE，一种将成功行为多样性显式建模为RL目标的方法，用于提升VLA策略在分布偏移下的泛化能力。
AI.motivation: RL微调虽通过闭环经验提升VLA策略，但超出微调分布的泛化能力仍然有限。作者分析发现，RL会全局收缩探索行为，却同时使成功轨迹更加多样、以更少rollout获得成功，并覆盖更多潜在任务有效解空间，这种成功模式覆盖可能为分布偏移提供替代策略。
AI.method: DRIVE将成功行为多样性转化为显式RL目标：在匹配任务条件下对rollout分组，通过时间对齐比较轨迹，并基于相对行为多样性推导成功条件下的内在奖励。该设计鼓励覆盖更广的可行解，同时避免奖励失败的多样性或表面的时序差异。
AI.result: 在LIBERO-Plus、ManiSkill3和RoboTwin 2.0上，DRIVE相较vanilla RL微调平均OOD性能在π0上提升5.3分，在π0.5上提升2.0分。在双臂AgileX PiPER-X平台上，DRIVE将平均OOD成功率从64.1%提升至73.3%（+9.2分），表明增益在物理部署下依然持续。
AI.conclusion: 成功行为多样性可作为显式优化目标，有效提升VLA策略在分布偏移及真实部署场景下的泛化性能。

title: Document-Level Text Simplification in Estonian Using Large Language Models
comment: 12 pages, 2 figures, 2 tables. Published at LREC 2026
summary: Document-level text simplification involves transformations that go beyond sentence-internal edits, addressing discourse coherence, anaphora resolution, and cross-paragraph consistency. Despite advances in sentence-level simplification for high-resource languages, document-level simplification in morphologically rich, low-resource languages such as Estonian remains largely unexplored. This study presents a comprehensive evaluation of five state-of-the-art multilingual large language models (LLMs) for document-level simplification in Estonian. Three prompting strategies are examined: single-pass generation, pipeline-based modular agents, and guideline-augmented pipelines. The evaluation framework integrates automatic metrics assessing readability, semantic preservation, and discourse coherence, alongside a structured manual annotation protocol. The findings indicate that Gemini-2.0 and LLaMA-3.3 produce outputs with near-native fluency and strong meaning preservation, whereas other models display notable grammatical and semantic limitations. This work contributes novel document-level coherence metrics, evidence-based prompting strategies, and publicly available resources for reproducibility.

AI.tldr: 本研究对五种多语言大语言模型在爱沙尼亚语（形态丰富、低资源语言）文档级文本简化任务上进行了系统评测，比较三种提示策略，并构建融合自动指标与人工标注的评估框架。
AI.motivation: 文档级简化需处理语篇连贯、指代消解与跨段落一致性，比句内编辑更复杂；然而现有研究多集中于高资源语言的句子级简化，形态丰富、低资源的爱沙尼亚语在文档级简化上几乎未被探索。
AI.method: 评测五种先进多语言大语言模型，考察三种提示策略：单次生成、基于流水线的模块化智能体、以及引入指南增强的流水线；评估框架整合了可读性、语义保真度与语篇连贯性的自动指标，并配合结构化人工标注协议。
AI.result: Gemini-2.0 与 LLaMA-3.3 的输出接近母语者流畅度且语义保真度强，而其他模型表现出明显的语法与语义局限。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提出了新的文档级连贯性指标、基于证据的提示策略，并公开了可复现资源，为低资源语言文档级简化研究提供了参考。

title: InstanceBench: Diagnosing Referential Reasoning and Target Identity in Referring Expression Segmentation
summary: Referring Expression Segmentation (RES) links natural-language descriptions to pixel-level object masks. Yet standard evaluation provides limited insight into instance-level referential reasoning: it does not systematically distinguish referential logics, test target preservation across valid grounding paths, or separate target-selection from mask-generation errors. We introduce InstanceBench, an instance-centered diagnostic benchmark comprising 6,194 images, 9,264 target instances, and 25,077 human-verified expressions. Each target-centric expression set (TCES) fixes the image and target mask while pairing a minimal expression with a same-target variant that uses another valid cue or grounding path. A compact referential-logic taxonomy spans direct target evidence, same-class selection, relational and compositional grounding, and exclusion, while logic-critical construction suppresses simpler shortcuts. Identity-aware metrics measure target retention and set-level success while separating selection from mask-generation errors. Across 22 native-mask RES checkpoints from 18 model families, the strongest checkpoint reaches 67.1% mIoU but only 59.6% All@0.7. Controlled interventions confirm language sensitivity, while failure decomposition identifies target selection rather than mask decoding as the main bottleneck. On a controlled training subset, matched supervision improves identity-aware performance, showing that the diagnosed capability responds to targeted supervision. Collectively, InstanceBench supports a measure-diagnose-improve cycle: measuring target consistency across grounding paths, localizing failure sources, and evaluating targeted interventions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 InstanceBench，一个以实例为中心的 Referring Expression Segmentation (RES) 诊断基准，用于系统评估实例级指代推理能力。
AI.motivation: 标准 RES 评测难以深入揭示实例级指代推理：它无法系统区分指代逻辑，不能检验在多种有效 grounding 路径下目标是否被保持，也未将目标选择错误与掩码生成错误分开。因此需要一个更精细的诊断性评测框架。
AI.method: 构建 InstanceBench，包含 6,194 张图像、9,264 个目标实例和 25,077 条人工核验表达。每个目标中心表达集 (TCES) 固定图像与目标掩码，将极简表达与使用另一有效线索或 grounding 路径的同目标变体配对。设计紧凑的指代逻辑分类体系，涵盖直接目标证据、同类选择、关系与组合 grounding、排除等，并通过逻辑关键构造抑制简单捷径。提出身份感知指标，衡量目标保持与集合级成功率，并分离选择错误与掩码生成错误。
AI.result: 在来自 18 个模型家族的 22 个原生掩码 RES 检查点上评测，最强检查点达到 67.1% mIoU，但 All@0.7 仅 59.6%。受控干预证实模型对语言敏感；失败分解表明主要瓶颈是目标选择而非掩码解码。在受控训练子集上，匹配监督提升了身份感知性能。
AI.conclusion: InstanceBench 支持“测量—诊断—改进”循环：测量跨 grounding 路径的目标一致性，定位失败来源，并评估针对性干预，表明所诊断能力可通过定向监督改善。

title: MIMESIS: Learning User Simulators as Training Environments for Interactive Agents
summary: Training and evaluating interactive language agents typically requires rich user interactions, yet collecting human feedback is expensive and difficult to scale. Simulated users offer a scalable alternative, but they must both resemble real user behavior and provide useful learning experiences for agents. In contrast, most agent-training frameworks rely on off-the-shelf assistant LLMs, whose helpfulness can make them overly cooperative, explicit, and behaviorally homogeneous compared with real users. We introduce MIMESIS, a purpose-built user simulator trained on human conversations with explicit reasoning supervision and 13 realistic behavioral patterns derived from real user interactions. Empirically, our 9B model achieves a SOUL-Index of 65.7, surpassing the strongest frontier model. Compared with Claude-Opus-5, the strongest baseline on RealUserSim and SimulatorArena, MIMESIS improves behavioral fidelity by 13.4 points and reduces Turing distance by 3.6 points, respectively. We then freeze the simulator and train an agent by interacting with the frozen simulator using multi-turn reinforcement learning. Across eight environments, training with MIMESIS yields better agent performance than training with GPT-5.5 under all nine unseen user simulators, demonstrating stronger generalization to new user simulators. Moreover, we propose Coached On-Policy Self-Distillation (CSD), which leverages simulator-generated private reasoning traces and subsequent utterances as feedback on how well the agent addresses user needs. A coach converts this information into concise coaching notes that describe how the agent can better anticipate user needs and adapt its behavior over the course of an interaction. CSD turns this feedback into dense, token-level supervision beyond sparse task rewards, yielding further gains across all nine evaluation user models.

AI.tldr: 提出用户模拟器 MIMESIS，专门用于训练交互式语言智能体；其 9B 模型在行为保真度上超过最强前沿模型，并可冻结后用于多轮强化学习提升智能体的泛化能力，同时提出 CSD 方法提供密集 token 级监督。
AI.motivation: 训练与评估交互式语言智能体需要丰富用户交互，但人工反馈成本高、难以扩展。模拟用户虽可扩展，却需既接近真实用户行为又能提供有效学习信号。而现有智能体训练框架多依赖现成助手 LLM 作为模拟用户，其"有帮助性"导致过度配合、表达过于直白、行为同质化，与真实用户差异明显。因此需要专门构建更真实、更具行为多样性的用户模拟器。
AI.method: 1. 构建 MIMESIS：基于真实人机对话训练的用户模拟器，引入显式推理监督与 13 种源自真实交互的行为模式。2. 将模拟器冻结，智能体通过多轮强化学习与其交互进行训练。3. 提出 Coached On-Policy Self-Distillation（CSD）：利用模拟器生成的私有推理轨迹与后续话语作为反馈，由 coach 转化为简洁的 coaching notes，说明智能体如何更好预判用户需求并动态调整行为，从而将反馈转为密集的 token 级监督，补充稀疏任务奖励。
AI.result: 9B 的 MIMESIS 取得 65.7 的 SOUL-Index，超过最强前沿模型；相比 RealUserSim 与 SimulatorArena 上最强基线 Claude-Opus-5，行为保真度提升 13.4 分，Turing 距离降低 3.6 分。在八个环境中用 MIMESIS 训练智能体，在全部九个未见用户模拟器上均优于用 GPT-5.5 训练，泛化更强。CSD 在全部九个评估用户模型上带来进一步提升。
AI.conclusion: 专门设计的用户模拟器比通用助手 LLM 更能提供高保真、可泛化的交互训练信号；冻结模拟器＋多轮 RL 可有效训练智能体；结合模拟器私有推理的 CSD 能提供超出稀疏任务奖励的密集监督，进一步提升智能体表现。

title: Efficient Best-of-N policy evaluation for inference-time alignment
summary: Best-of-N (BoN) is a common inference-time alignment method that selects the highest-scoring response among N samples from a reference model. Evaluating BoN policies from logged data is challenging under sample-only access because standard off-policy estimators require density ratios that depend on unavailable response likelihoods. In this paper, we propose a sample-only framework for evaluating and selecting BoN policies without access to these likelihoods. We show that the order-statistic structure of BoN allows the required density ratios to be expressed through score-rank probabilities that are estimable from samples alone. We then develop a doubly robust estimator of the BoN policy value (BoN-DR) that efficiently reuses a shared auxiliary sample pool across candidate budgets. We establish valid asymptotic inference even under reward estimator misspecification and prove the efficiency of our BoN-DR estimator. Since larger budgets can amplify errors in the score function and lead to reward overoptimization, we derive two selection rules: (i) maximizing the estimated policy value and (ii) maximizing a lower confidence bound on the improvement over the reference policy, which accounts for estimation uncertainty and provides a no-harm guarantee. Across synthetic experiments and GSM8K with multiple reference and reward models, our framework accurately estimates BoN policy values and selects effective sampling budgets.

AI.tldr: 提出仅依赖样本的 BoN 策略评估与选择框架：用序统计结构将密度比转化为可由样本估计的分数-排名概率，构造双稳健估计量 BoN-DR，并给出两种采样预算选择规则。
AI.motivation: Best-of-N（BoN）是常见的推理期对齐方法，从参考模型采样 N 个响应并选取分数最高者。但在仅有样本、无响应似然的设定下，标准离线策略评估所需的密度比不可得，导致 BoN 策略难以评估与选择预算；同时较大 N 会放大分数函数误差并引起奖励过度优化。
AI.method: 利用 BoN 的序统计（order-statistic）结构，将所需密度比表达为可由样本单独估计的分数-排名概率；据此提出 BoN 策略价值的双稳健估计量 BoN-DR，在候选预算间高效复用共享辅助样本池；并在奖励估计器设定错误下建立有效渐近推断、证明估计效率。进一步推导两种预算选择规则：最大化估计策略价值，以及最大化相对参考策略改进的下置信界（兼顾估计不确定性并提供无害保证）。
AI.result: 在合成实验以及 GSM8K 上、使用多种参考模型与奖励模型的实验中，该框架能准确估计 BoN 策略价值，并选出有效的采样预算。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为无法获取似然的样本级场景提供了可用的 BoN 评估与预算选择方案，兼具双稳健性与效率，并通过下置信界规则缓解奖励过度优化。

title: Borrowed Eyes: Markerless Nano-UAV Flight with an Active Quadruped Observer
comment: 8 pages, 7 figures, 2 tables. Submitted to ICRA 2027
summary: Nano unmanned aerial vehicles (nano-UAVs) can navigate confined spaces that larger robots cannot, but their payload capacity severely limits the sensors and compute available for self-localization in global navigation satellite system (GNSS)-denied environments. We present a vision-based system that localizes a nano-UAV from a quadruped robot with an arm-mounted camera. The quadruped tracks the drone, estimates its position in its own coordinate system using segmentation masks and depth, and transmits that position over a real-time radio link. To ensure continuous tracking, we developed a perception-aware nonlinear Model Predictive Controller (NMPC) that dynamically adjusts the quadruped's body and arm to maximize the drone's visibility, treating observation reliability as a primary control objective. Relying solely on this external estimate, the nano-UAV executed predefined trajectories from takeoff to landing with a median 3D localization error of 59 mm. The system demonstrates robustness against short visual occlusions by smoothly transitioning to onboard inertial flight when line-of-sight is temporarily lost. Ultimately, this framework allows a quadruped to offload the localization burden of a nano-UAV, enabling inspection of complex spaces that neither robot could navigate alone.

AI.tldr: 提出一种由四足机器人臂载相机为纳米无人机提供外部视觉定位的系统，采用感知感知NMPC保证持续观测，实现中位3D定位误差59 mm的自主起降飞行。
AI.motivation: 纳米无人机可进入大型机器人无法通行的狭窄空间，但其载荷能力严重限制机载传感器与算力，在GNSS拒止环境下难以自定位，因此需要借助外部平台卸载定位负担。
AI.method: 四足机器人通过臂载相机对无人机进行跟踪，利用分割掩膜与深度信息估计其在自身坐标系中的位置，并通过实时无线电链路将位置发送给纳米无人机；同时设计感知感知的非线性模型预测控制器（NMPC），动态调整四足机体与机械臂姿态，将观测可靠性作为主要控制目标以最大化无人机可见性。
AI.result: 纳米无人机仅依赖此外部估计即完成从起飞到着陆的预设轨迹飞行，3D定位误差中位数为59 mm；在视线短暂丢失时可平滑切换至机载惯性飞行，对短时视觉遮挡表现出鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 该框架使四足机器人能够卸载纳米无人机的定位负担，从而支持对任一机器人单独均无法通行的复杂空间进行巡检。

title: CoTrace: Data Recipes for Training Terminal Agents with Harness-Model Co-Evolution
summary: Terminal-agent capability depends jointly on model weights and the runtime harness that formats prompts, binds tools, and handles error recovery. Existing harness-model co-evolution approaches improve both components, yet often treat trajectories produced during harness search as an undifferentiated replay buffer. This practice overlooks that a trajectory's value for model training depends on the harness under which it was generated. To systematically analyze this interface, we establish an alternating co-evolution framework that decouples harness search and policy training through component-wise promotion decisions. Within this framework, we introduce CoTrace, a harness-aware data recipe that explicitly governs trajectory routing, provenance matching, and curriculum refresh. Under CoTrace, recurring execution failures guide harness synthesis, while policy training is strictly conditioned on verified rollouts matched to the adopted runtime for supervised fine-tuning (SFT) or fresh online interactions for reinforcement learning (RL). On the Tmax promotion split, CoTrace advances Qwen3.5-9B from 78 to 88 solved tasks under supervised fine-tuning while an online reinforcement variant reaches 90. Specifically, a compact harness-matched corpus produces steady model gains at substantially lower compute than much larger corpora pooled across sibling harnesses. Furthermore, evaluations on Terminal-Bench 2.1 and SWE-bench Lite show that out-of-distribution transfer depends fundamentally on harness compatibility, where maintaining consistency between training and evaluation runtimes prevents procedural execution breakdowns observed under foreign scaffolds.

AI.tldr: 本文提出交替式 harness–模型协同进化框架，并给出 harness 感知的数据配方 CoTrace，通过轨迹路由、来源匹配和课程刷新，使 SFT/RL 训练严格使用与运行时匹配的已验证轨迹，在 Tmax 上将 Qwen3.5-9B 从 78 提升至 88（SFT）/90（在线 RL）。
AI.motivation: 终端智能体能力同时取决于模型权重与运行时 harness（负责提示格式化、工具绑定与错误恢复）。现有协同进化方法虽能同时改进两者，但通常将 harness 搜索过程中产生的轨迹视为无差别的回放缓冲区，忽视了"轨迹对模型训练的价值取决于其生成时所用的 harness"这一关键事实。作者希望系统性地分析并利用这一接口。
AI.method: 建立交替式协同进化框架，通过组件级晋升决策将 harness 搜索与策略训练解耦。在此框架内提出 CoTrace：一种 harness 感知的数据配方，显式管理轨迹路由、来源（provenance）匹配与课程刷新。具体而言，反复出现的执行失败用于指导 harness 合成；策略训练严格基于经过验证的、与所采用运行时匹配的 rollout——用于 SFT 或用于 RL 的全新在线交互。
AI.result: 在 Tmax 晋升划分上，CoTrace 使 Qwen3.5-9B 在 SFT 下从 78 提升到 88 个已解决任务，在线 RL 变体达到 90。一个紧凑的 harness 匹配语料即可带来稳定增益，且计算量显著低于跨同类 harness 汇集的大规模语料。在 Terminal-Bench 2.1 与 SWE-bench Lite 上的评估显示，分布外迁移根本取决于 harness 兼容性：保持训练与评估运行时一致可避免在异构脚手架（foreign scaffolds）下出现的程序化执行崩溃。
AI.conclusion: 轨迹训练价值与生成它的 harness 强耦合，不能被视为无差别数据。通过 CoTrace 的 harness 感知路由与来源匹配，紧凑且匹配的语料优于跨 harness 汇集的大语料，并显著提升终端智能体能力。分布外泛化的关键在于 harness 兼容性，训练与评估运行时的保持一致是防止执行流程崩溃的必要条件。

title: Gaussian Material Fields for Volumetric Multi-Energy CT Decomposition
summary: Volumetric material decomposition in multi-energy computed tomography requires a representation that organizes multiple three-dimensional material fields in a common spatial domain while retaining differences in composition and local structure. We observe that spatial primitives can be shared across materials without tying their coefficients, but their local capacity must respond to material-specific reconstruction needs. We introduce Gaussian material fields, which represent multiple material distributions with shared anisotropic 3D Gaussian primitives and independent nonnegative material coefficients. The shared geometry defines a continuous spatial basis, while the coefficients determine each primitive's contribution to the individual material fields. To reconstruct this representation from multi-energy projections, a differentiable spectral forward model combines Gaussian material path integrals with a calibrated basis matrix, enabling joint optimization of spatial geometry and material composition. Material-aware adaptive density control retains material-specific refinement evidence before aggregation and adjusts local representation capacity to accommodate both spatially extensive components and sparse details. Experiments use synthesized multi-energy projections generated from pseudo-reference material maps constructed by conventional methods from publicly available CT data. Across 15 cases, our approach improves average PSNR by 4.03 dB and SSIM by 4.96% over the strongest baseline, while reducing NRMSE by 33.45%. Material-wise comparisons and component ablations support improved recovery of localized structures, while runtime and memory measurements show favorable computational scaling. These results establish Gaussian material fields as an explicit, adaptive representation for volumetric multi-material reconstruction.

AI.tldr: 提出高斯材料场（Gaussian material fields），用共享各向异性3D高斯基元与独立非负材料系数表示多材料分布，并通过可微光谱前向模型与材料感知自适应密度控制从多能投影中联合优化几何与成分。
AI.motivation: 多能CT体材料分解需要一种表示，既能将多个三维材料场组织在同一空间域，又要保留成分与局部结构差异；现有表示难以同时兼顾跨材料共享空间基元与材料特异的重建需求。
AI.method: 以共享各向异性3D高斯基元定义连续空间基，各基元对每种材料拥有独立非负系数；构建结合高斯材料路径积分与标定基矩阵的可微光谱前向模型，实现空间几何与材料成分的联合优化；引入材料感知自适应密度控制，在聚合前保留材料特异的细化证据，动态调整局部表示容量以兼顾广域成分与稀疏细节。
AI.result: 在由公开CT数据经传统方法构建的伪参考材料图生成的合成多能投影上，15个案例中平均PSNR提升4.03 dB、SSIM提升4.96%、NRMSE降低33.45%；材料级比较与组件消融验证了局部结构恢复的改善，运行时与内存测量显示计算扩展性良好。
AI.conclusion: 高斯材料场可作为多材料体素重建的一种显式、自适应表示，在精度与计算效率上均优于强基线，为体材料分解提供了新的表示范式。

title: The Attribution Blind Spot: Layerwise Trajectory Diagnostics for Source Reliance in Retrieval-Augmented Language Models
summary: A retrieval-augmented model can match a document without relying on it. Controlled knowledge conflicts make source choice observable and let us ask a second question that prediction alone cannot answer: which internal-state properties define useful intervention directions? We study paired hidden-state changes with Latent Trajectory Shift (LTS), a signed projection onto a training-fitted first principal component (PC1), and keep verified training exposure separate from behavioral source choice. Across the evaluated conflicts, state-change magnitude is often the stronger predictor, whereas signed PC1 is the stronger selective controller: equal-norm interventions change source preference while better preserving non-target behavior, and the frozen direction transfers across the tested datasets and aligned model pairs. A same-system OLMo study further combines positive choice and control results with inconclusive exposure detection at the achieved power. The central result is a separation: representations that diagnose what a model will choose need not be the representations that best control that choice.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过受控知识冲突设置，将"预测来源选择"与"干预来源选择"分离：状态变化幅度更擅长预测选择，而有符号的PC1投影（LTS）是更强的选择性控制器，且该方向可跨数据集与对齐模型对迁移。
AI.motivation: 检索增强模型可在不依赖文档的情况下匹配文档，这使知识冲突与来源选择问题难以观测；同时，仅靠预测无法回答"哪些内部状态属性定义了有用的干预方向"这一问题。作者希望厘清诊断性表征与控制性表征是否一致。
AI.method: 在受控知识冲突下构造配对隐藏状态变化；提出Latent Trajectory Shift (LTS)，即对训练拟合的第一主成分（PC1）做有符号投影；将已验证的训练暴露（exposure）与行为层面的来源选择严格区分；进行比较等范数干预实验，并测试方向在不同数据集和对齐模型对间的迁移性；另在同一系统的OLMo上开展研究。
AI.result: 在所评估的冲突中，状态变化幅度通常是更强的预测因子；而签名PC1是更强的选择性控制器——等范数干预能改变来源偏好，同时更好保留非目标行为；冻结方向可迁移到所测试的数据集和对齐模型对上。OLMo研究将正向的选择与控制结果与在当前统计功效下不具结论性的暴露检测相结合。
AI.conclusion: 核心结论是一种分离：能够诊断模型将如何选择的表征，未必是能最好地控制该选择的表征。诊断性与控制性应被视为两种不同性质的分析目标。

title: The Symbol of the Surrogate: Measuring Numerical Provenance in Neural PDE Solvers
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026 AI for Science Workshop
summary: Neural PDE surrogates are trained on numerical solver outputs that contain both physical evolution and solver-specific discretization errors. Because surrogates are also evaluated against held-out trajectories from the same solver, standard benchmarks cannot distinguish fidelity to the exact evolution from imitation of the numerical scheme. We introduce an empirical Fourier-symbol diagnostic that probes a trained surrogate's linearized one-step operator with individual Fourier modes and compares it with both exact-evolution and training-scheme references. To address architectural spectral bias, we train identical networks on schemes with orthogonal dissipative and dispersive signatures and compare their learned operators. In linear advection, the learned surrogates reproduce the training schemes' amplitude and phase errors, with the twin-scheme difference reaching more than 99.8\% of the analytically predicted full-imitation ceiling. The same behavior occurs for a non-local Fourier neural operator and at the operator level for nonlinear Burgers dynamics. These results show that agreement with solver-generated test data does not by itself establish fidelity to the exact evolution. Fourier-symbol measurements provide a direct diagnostic of numerical provenance.

AI.tldr: 提出Fourier符号诊断法，证明神经PDE代理模型可能只是模仿训练所用数值格式的离散误差，而非逼近真实物理演化。
AI.motivation: 神经PDE代理模型在数值求解器输出上训练，这些数据同时包含物理演化和求解器特有的离散误差。由于代理模型也在同一求解器的留出轨迹上评估，标准基准无法区分模型是忠实于精确演化，还是模仿了数值格式。需要一种直接诊断数值来源的手段。
AI.method: 提出经验性Fourier符号诊断：用单个Fourier模态探测训练好的代理模型线性化单步算子，并与精确演化参考和训练格式参考对比。为应对架构的谱偏置，在两个具有正交耗散与色散特征的格式上训练相同网络并比较其学到的算子。
AI.result: 在线性平流中，学到的代理模型复现了训练格式的振幅与相位误差，双格式差异达到解析预测的完全模仿上限的99.8%以上。对于非局部Fourier神经算子以及非线性Burgers动力学的算子层面，也出现相同行为。
AI.conclusion: 与求解器生成的测试数据一致，本身并不能确立对精确演化的忠实性。Fourier符号测量为数值来源提供了直接诊断。

title: Decoding Neural Population Dynamics through Robotic Analog
summary: Animal evidence shows that precise voluntary movements arise from rotational neural population dynamics in motor cortex, but their physical effects remain unknown. We developed a robotic analog of biological motor systems with artificial muscles, multimodal sensors, and a neural network controller trained via reinforcement learning. The robotic analog exhibited accurate movements, robustness to damage, and neural population dynamics akin to animals. This task-driven, embodied model illuminates the causal link between neural population dynamics and motor outcomes. We discovered that neural rotations generate oscillatory maneuvers orthogonal to the reaching direction, optimizing trajectory adjustments, which is confirmed by primate neural data. The model also revealed counterintuitive neural energy principles under sensor and motor redundancies, and striking Eureka moments during motor learning, bridging biological and artificial systems. These findings provide new perspectives on how neural dynamics contribute to accurate and flexible movement, inspiring future intelligent robots with animal-like mobility.

AI.tldr: 该研究构建了带人工肌肉、多模态传感器与强化学习神经控制器的机器人类比系统，复现了动物运动皮层中的旋转神经群体动力学，揭示了其与运动结果的因果联系。
AI.motivation: 动物实验表明精确自主运动源于运动皮层的旋转神经群体动力学，但其物理效应与因果作用尚不明确，缺乏可控、可干预的具身验证平台。
AI.method: 开发机器人类比系统：采用人工肌肉、多模态传感器，并用强化学习训练神经网络控制器，实现任务驱动的具身建模。
AI.result: 模型展现出精确运动能力、抗损伤鲁棒性以及与动物相似的神经群体动力学；发现神经旋转可产生与到达方向正交的振荡动作以优化轨迹调整，并经灵长类神经数据验证；同时揭示传感器与运动冗余下的反直觉神经能量原理，以及运动学习中的"顿悟"现象。
AI.conclusion: 研究架起了生物与人工系统之间的桥梁，为神经动力学如何支撑精确灵活运动提供新视角，并启发未来具备类动物运动能力的智能机器人。

title: PHRBench: A Behavioral Evaluation of Post-Hallucination Reasoning in LLMs
summary: Hallucinated information can propagate through multi-stage LLM systems and become part of the context for subsequent reasoning. Existing studies of post-hallucination reasoning (PHR) mainly characterize changes in final outcomes and aggregate reasoning dynamics, leaving how models resolve hallucinated premises at the response level insufficiently understood. In this work, we introduce PHRBench, a controlled benchmark for behaviorally structured PHR across four domains and 18 large language models. PHRBench characterizes each reasoning trajectory independently of final-answer correctness through Hallucination Compliance, Hallucination Avoidance, and Heuristic Correction, and defines an insightful trajectory as successful correction that ultimately reaches the correct answer. Across 4820 controlled instances, we find that successful recovery remains relatively rare and is associated with more frequent belief updates along the reasoning trajectory. We further find that properties of the hallucinated prompt contain substantial predictive signal for successful recovery, with a lightweight predictor achieving an AUROC of 0.847. These findings provide a behavioral view of post-hallucination reasoning, characterizing how LLMs resolve erroneous context and when successful recovery is likely to occur.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PHRBench基准，从行为层面刻画大模型在多阶段系统中如何处理幻觉前提，覆盖4个领域与18个模型，基于4820条实例分析其纠错轨迹与成功恢复的预测因素。
AI.motivation: 幻觉信息会在多阶段LLM系统中传播并成为后续推理的上下文。现有后幻觉推理（PHR）研究主要关注最终结果变化与整体推理动态，缺乏在响应层面理解模型如何处理幻觉前提，即模型究竟如何解决错误语境尚不清楚。
AI.method: 构建受控基准PHRBench，覆盖4个领域、18个LLM。对每条推理轨迹独立于最终答案正确性进行行为刻画，定义三类行为：幻觉遵从（Hallucination Compliance）、幻觉规避（Hallucination Avoidance）、启发式纠正（Heuristic Correction）；并将"最终得出正确答案的成功纠正"定义为有洞察力的轨迹。共收集4820条受控实例，并训练轻量预测器。
AI.result: 成功恢复相对罕见，且与推理轨迹中更频繁的信念更新（belief updates）相关；幻觉提示本身的性质对成功恢复具有显著预测信号，轻量预测器AUROC达0.847。
AI.conclusion: 研究提供了后幻觉推理的行为视角，刻画了LLM如何解决错误上下文，以及何时更可能发生成功恢复。PHRBench为理解并预测模型纠错行为提供了受控评估工具。

title: SpatialUQ: Post-Hoc Uncertainty Quantification from Spatial Consistency in Black-Box Vision Models
summary: Clinical vision models are often deployed as frozen black boxes with no access to internals, retraining, or ground truth at inference time. We introduce \textbf{SpatialUQ}, a post-hoc uncertainty method using only output probabilities. It measures the Jensen-Shannon divergence between the global prediction and the mean of five fixed spatial crops in six deterministic forward passes. The premise is simple, trustworthy predictions are spatially consistent. On NIH ChestX-ray14 (DenseNet-121, $N{=}25{,}596$), our Multicrop Uncertainty Score (MUS) reaches $0.784$ failure-detection AUC versus $0.664$ for MC-Dropout ($p{<}10^{-6}$) at one-fifth the compute, with native calibration ($\text{SCE}{=}0.049$ vs.\ $0.127$ for $\ell_1$), the best-calibrated among methods above 0.78 AUC. A supervised fusion of MUS with entropy, confidence, and $\ell_1$ reaches $0.832$, outperforming a five-member ensemble ($0.813$). MUS scales with model quality, reaching $0.899$ with BiomedCLIP ($ρ= 0.846$), while this relationship remains meaningful in-distribution ($ρ= 0.523$) but breaks down under severe distribution shift (VinBigData, $ρ= 0.027$). MUS is well-suited to diffuse findings but is less dependable for small focal lesions such as nodules. Code and experimental materials are publicly available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/kawsher11/SpatialUQ.

AI.tldr: SpatialUQ是一种仅依赖输出概率的事后不确定性方法，通过度量全局预测与五个固定空间裁剪均值的Jensen-Shannon散度来检测失败。在NIH ChestX-ray14上，其MUS指标失败检测AUC为0.784，显著优于MC-Dropout（0.664），计算量仅其五分之一，且校准性更佳。
AI.motivation: 临床视觉模型常以冻结黑盒形式部署，推理时无法访问内部结构、重训练或真实标签，现有不确定性方法（如MC-Dropout）计算开销大且校准差，因此需要一种轻量、仅用输出概率的事后不确定性方法。
AI.method: 提出SpatialUQ，仅使用输出概率。在六次确定性前向传播中，计算全局预测与五个固定空间裁剪均值的Jensen-Shannon散度，并以Multi-crop Uncertainty Score（MUS）作为失败检测与不确定性度量，核心假设是可信预测应具有空间一致性。
AI.result: 在NIH ChestX-ray14（DenseNet-121，N=25,596）上，MUS失败检测AUC达0.784，MC-Dropout为0.664（p<10^-6），计算量仅五分之一；SCE=0.049优于ℓ1的0.127，是AUC>0.78方法中校准最好的。MUS与熵、置信度、ℓ1的监督融合达0.832，超过五成员集成（0.813）。MUS随模型质量提升，BiomedCLIP下达0.899（ρ=0.846）；分布内关系有效（ρ=0.523），但在严重分布偏移（VinBigData，ρ=0.027）下失效。MUS适合弥漫性病变，对结节等小病灶可靠性较低。
AI.conclusion: SpatialUQ是一种计算高效、仅需输出概率的事后不确定性方法，在失败检测与校准上优于MC-Dropout及集成方法，且随模型质量提升而增强；但其有效性依赖分布内假设，在严重分布偏移下退化，且更适合弥漫性病变而非小病灶。

title: Cognitive Schemas, Laws and Tasks
summary:
This paper asks how explicit representations can support reusable cognitive schemas in knowledge-based problem solving. We develop a structural framework in which schemas are organized by the information and relations required for their use, rather than introduced as unrelated primitives. The framework also distinguishes context-dependent relations from more stable structures that can be reused across different representations.
  Tasks are described through the information available, the unknowns to be determined, and the constraints that admissible solutions must satisfy. This makes it possible to separate limitations of the representation from limitations of the solving procedure. In particular, we distinguish inconsistency, underdetermination, and contextual insufficiency, where the current representation lacks distinctions or relations required by the external task meaning. We also show formally when a reduction of representation preserves the task-relevant solution structure.
  The resulting task--schema interface offers a structured way to describe representational conditions relevant to problem solving. It supports the reuse and stabilization of derived knowledge while remaining independent of the particular mechanism used to generate candidate solutions. This may provide a useful component for future solver architectures that combine structured knowledge, verification, and learned proposal mechanisms.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个结构化框架，用"信息与关系"组织认知图式，并将任务刻画为可用信息、待求未知量与约束的组合，从而区分不一致、欠定与情境不足三类表征局限，并形式化给出表征约简保持任务相关解结构的条件。
AI.motivation: 知识型问题求解中，认知图式常被当作互不相关的原语引入，缺乏可复用性与结构性；同时，表征本身的局限与求解过程的局限难以分离，导致无法判断失败源于表征还是算法。
AI.method: 构建结构化框架：图式按其使用所需的信息与关系来组织，而非作为孤立原语；区分情境依赖关系与可跨表征复用的稳定结构。将任务描述为可用信息、待定未知量与可接受解须满足的约束，并据此划分不一致、欠定与情境不足，同时形式化证明表征约简何时保持任务相关解结构。
AI.result: 提出"任务—图式接口"，可结构化描述与问题求解相关的表征条件；支持派生知识的复用与稳定化，且独立于生成候选解的特定机制；在形式上给出了表征约简保持任务相关解结构的条件。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为融合结构化知识、验证与学习式提议机制的未来求解器架构提供了一个可用组件。

title: Evaluating Trajectory Features for Routing Final-Layer Attention
summary: Attention routing requires a signal that predicts the value of attention on the current prefix. We evaluate whether hidden-state extrapolation error, curvature and error change improve this prediction beyond uncertainty, one-step displacement, position and state projections. Paired executions of the final attention layer supply signed next-token loss differences in frozen SmolLM3-3B-Base and Qwen3.5-4B-Base checkpoints. Utility-supervised routers are tested on 100 held-out PG-19 books at an identical causal 20 percent invocation quota. None of six prespecified comparisons shows a positive gain after familywise correction. In Qwen3.5, a parameter-matched fixed-projection control lowers NLL by 0.00356 nats/token relative to the trajectory router (95 percent interval 0.00218 to 0.00487). Secondary results depend on the operation removed, feature location and scoring horizon; frozen thresholds also drift substantially at longer horizons. Actual selected-query execution yields small long-sequence latency reductions with increased NLL, while learned routers remain slower during cached continuation. The study identifies limits on the incremental value of these trajectory summaries and separates allocation quality from measured inference benefit.

AI.tldr: 研究检验隐藏状态轨迹摘要（外推误差、曲率、误差变化）能否在不确定性、一步位移、位置与状态投影之外提升注意力路由预测；六项预设比较经族错误校正后均无正增益，固定投影对照反而更优。
AI.motivation: 注意力路由需要一个能预测当前前缀上注意力价值的信号。已有可用特征包括不确定性、一步位移、位置和状态投影，但尚不清楚隐藏状态轨迹的几何摘要（外推误差、曲率、误差变化）是否带来额外信息。
AI.method: 在冻结的 SmolLM3-3B-Base 与 Qwen3.5-4B-Base 检查点上，对最终注意力层进行成对执行，获取带符号的下一 token 损失差作为监督信号；训练效用监督路由器，并在 100 本留出 PG-19 书籍上以相同的 20% 因果调用配额测试；六项预设比较采用族错误校正；并设置参数匹配的固定投影对照与冻结阈值、实际选中查询执行等消融。
AI.result: 六项预设比较经族错误校正后均无正增益。在 Qwen3.5 中，参数匹配的固定投影对照相比轨迹路由器降低 NLL 0.00356 nats/token（95% 区间 0.00218–0.00487）。次要结果依赖于被移除的操作、特征位置与评分视野；冻结阈值在更长视野下显著漂移。实际选中查询执行可带来小幅长序列延迟下降，但 NLL 升高；学习型路由器在缓存续写时仍较慢。
AI.conclusion: 该研究界定了这些轨迹摘要在预测注意力价值方面增量价值的边界，并将分配质量与实测推理收益区分开来：轨迹摘要未提供超越现有特征的稳定增益，且分配质量提升未必转化为推理效率收益。

title: Tactile Reconstruction of Contact Task Frames and Forces for Hybrid Force/Motion Control
comment: 14 pages, 9 figures, 7 tables. Video: https://youtube.com/playlist?list=PLejKMZmW8AvI. Dataset: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23209032
summary: Hybrid force/motion control requires knowledge of the interaction force and of a task frame defining the force- and motion-controlled directions. These quantities are usually obtained from force/torque sensing or model-based residuals, often assuming also a nominal environment model. This work addresses the online estimation of the contact force and a possibly time-varying task frame using only soft optical tactile sensing, under the assumption of locally planar contact with a negligible contact moment. The proposed method maps a single image of the deformed elastomer of a soft optical tactile sensor to observable contact variables: indentation depth, two surface-to-sensor tilt angles, and 3D contact force, each with a per-sample uncertainty estimate. The mapping is learned through a self-labeling acquisition procedure, in which a manipulator imposes controlled contacts while an auxiliary Force/Torque sensor is used offline to provide ground-truth labels. The tactile measurement is then fused with robot proprioceptive data in an Extended Kalman Filter, producing a continuously updated estimate of the contact task frame and of the interaction force. Control experiments with a DigiTac sensor mounted on a UR10 manipulator demonstrate closed-loop contact force regulation against a flat rigid board in linear and angular motion by a human operator, with touch as the only exteroceptive feedback.

AI.tldr: 仅用软光学触觉传感在线估计接触力与可能时变的任务坐标系，并在闭环力调节中仅以触觉作为外部反馈。
AI.motivation: 混合力/运动控制需已知交互力与划分力/运动控制方向的任务坐标系，传统上依赖力/力矩传感或模型残差，且常假设标称环境模型。本文旨在摆脱这些依赖，仅凭软光学触觉感知实现上述量的在线估计，以支持在未知、运动环境中的力控任务。
AI.method: 假设局部平面接触且接触力矩可忽略，将软光学触觉传感器变形弹性体的单张图像映射为可观测接触变量：压入深度、两个表面—传感器倾斜角、3D接触力，并为每个量给出逐样本不确定性估计。映射通过自标注采集流程学习：由机械臂施加受控接触，离线用辅助力/力矩传感器提供真值标签。随后将触觉测量与机器人本体感知数据在扩展卡尔曼滤波中融合，持续更新接触任务坐标系与交互力的估计。
AI.result: 在UR10机械臂上安装DigiTac传感器的控制实验表明，当人类操作者使平板刚性板做线性与角运动时，仅以触觉作为唯一外部反馈，即可实现闭环接触力调节。
AI.conclusion: 软光学触觉传感结合自标注学习与EKF融合，能够在不使用在线力/力矩传感或环境模型的前提下，在线估计接触力与时变任务坐标系，并支撑仅靠触觉反馈的闭环力控制，验证了该方法在实际机械臂系统中的可行性。

title: Your Prompt Should Do More: Effects of Retrieval Instructions in Embedding Models
summary: Prompted embedding models have recently received increasing attention, particularly for retrieval, where detailed retrieval instructions are provided as part of the retrieval prompt. Several new datasets and studies have examined this setting, showing that the current embedding models often struggle to follow such instructions reliably. In this paper, we study the mechanism of how instructions actually affect the representations of retrieval queries in asymmetric retrieval tasks. We show that models can fail to follow even simple task instructions when query-side distractors are included in the evaluation. We hypothesize that this behavior is driven by the training setup of current embedding models and their evaluation, and show that fine-tuning with added query-side distractors leads to substantial improvements, with minimal effect on other tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文研究检索提示中指令如何影响非对称检索查询表示，发现加入查询侧干扰项后模型即使简单指令也难以遵循，并通过添加此类干扰项的微调显著提升遵循能力且对其他任务影响极小。
AI.motivation: 当前嵌入模型在带指令的检索设置中难以可靠遵循指令，此前研究多关注新数据集与现象观察，但缺乏对指令如何影响查询表示这一机制的深入分析，尤其是查询侧干扰项存在时指令遵循失效的原因尚不清楚。
AI.method: 作者研究非对称检索任务中指令影响查询表示的机制；在评测中引入查询侧干扰项以测试指令遵循；假设该失效行为源于现有嵌入模型的训练设置与评测方式；随后在微调阶段加入查询侧干扰项进行训练。
AI.result: 实验表明，当评测包含查询侧干扰项时，模型即使面对简单任务指令也会遵循失败；而采用加入查询侧干扰项的微调后，指令遵循能力获得显著提升，同时对其他任务的影响极小。
AI.conclusion: 指令遵循失败主要归因于训练与评测设置中缺乏对查询侧干扰项的处理；通过在微调中引入查询侧干扰项，可有效缓解该问题并保持其他任务性能。

title: RT-DETR-World: Transferring Rich LLM Semantics to Real-Time Open-Vocabulary Detection
summary: Open-vocabulary detection (OVD) recognizes categories unseen during training through textual category queries, yet achieving strong generalization with real-time efficiency remains challenging. Beyond vocabulary scaling, zero-shot generalization may benefit from reusable visual--semantic cues learned from seen data, including attributes, actions, states, and contextual relations. Existing real-time OVD methods primarily emphasize vocabulary coverage and efficient region/query--text matching; under strict efficiency constraints, compact detectors may struggle to absorb rich instance semantics and scene context. We propose RT-DETR-World, a compact DETR-style detector that transfers the rich semantics conveyed by descriptions during training while retaining lightweight query--text matching at inference. We construct GroundingCapv2 with three levels of supervision: category names for standard OVD, object descriptions conveying instance-level semantics, and image descriptions conveying object relations and scene context. These descriptions serve only as training-time semantic supervision. To help the compact detector absorb these semantics, we propose Dual-Path Description Alignment (DDA), combining a deployment-consistent MiniLM pathway with a training-only LLM teacher. MiniLM provides query--category supervision and object-description alignment, while offline teacher features supervise matched queries and global visual representations at the object and image levels, respectively. All teacher features are precomputed, and the teacher-side modules are removed after training. We further propose Relation-Aware Negative Relaxation (RNR), which uses teacher-derived semantic similarities to relax related negatives while preserving exact positives. Experiments demonstrate competitive zero-shot accuracy and a favorable accuracy--efficiency trade-off. The code will be released.

AI.tldr: 提出紧凑型 DETR 检测器 RT-DETR-World，通过训练期描述语义监督与双路径对齐，在保持实时效率的同时提升开放词汇检测的零样本泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 现有实时开放词汇检测（OVD）方法主要关注词汇覆盖与高效的区域/查询—文本匹配，但在严格效率约束下，紧凑检测器难以吸收丰富的实例语义与场景上下文，零样本泛化受限。作者认为可复用已见数据中的属性、动作、状态与上下文关系等视觉—语义线索来提升泛化。
AI.method: 1）提出紧凑的 DETR 式检测器 RT-DETR-World，训练时迁移描述语义，推理时仅保留轻量查询—文本匹配；2）构建 GroundingCapv2，含三级监督：类别名（标准 OVD）、对象描述（实例级语义）、图像描述（对象关系与场景上下文），描述仅作训练期监督；3）提出双路径描述对齐（DDA），结合部署一致的 MiniLM 路径与仅训练用的 LLM 教师：MiniLM 提供查询—类别监督与对象描述对齐，离线教师特征分别在对象级监督匹配查询、在图像级监督全局视觉表示；教师特征预计算，训练后移除教师侧模块；4）提出关系感知负样本松弛（RNR），利用教师导出的语义相似度松弛相关负样本，同时保留精确正样本。
AI.result: 实验表明该方法具有有竞争力的零样本精度，并在精度与效率之间取得良好权衡。
AI.conclusion: 通过训练期的多级描述语义监督与双路径对齐，紧凑检测器可在不增加推理开销的前提下有效吸收实例语义与场景上下文，实现高效且泛化的开放词汇检测。代码将开源。

title: Ream: Unfolding Mutual Awareness in Human-Agent Workspaces
summary: As AI agents work alongside humans in shared workspaces, a mutual awareness challenge arises: agents act at speeds that outpace human monitoring, and users' evolving interests are not always expressed in chat. This challenge is especially pressing in literature review, where both parties retrieve, read, and synthesize a growing body of papers. We present Ream, a literature review workspace that supports mutual awareness through structured artifacts, bidirectional engagement tracking, and localized visualizations. Users can see each party's activity within these documents, and agents can retrieve the same history to guide their work. In studies with eighteen researchers, participants used these traces to inspect evidence, steer agents, communicate through annotations, and reflect on their research focus. Shared histories also helped agents build on earlier work. These findings inform how engagement traces within shared documents can support transparency, personalized assistance, and coordination in human-agent knowledge work.

AI.tldr: 提出文献综述协作工作空间Ream，通过结构化工件、双向参与追踪与本地化可视化，实现人与AI代理的相互感知与协作。
AI.motivation: AI代理与人类在同一工作空间中协作时存在"相互感知"挑战：代理行动速度超过人类监控能力，而用户兴趣变化未必体现在聊天中。文献综述场景下双方均需检索、阅读与综合不断增长的论文，该问题尤为突出。
AI.method: 构建Ream工作空间：采用结构化工件承载研究内容，设计双向参与追踪机制记录双方活动轨迹，并提供本地化可视化。用户可查看各方在文档中的活动，代理亦可检索同一历史以指导自身工作。随后开展十八名研究者的用户研究。
AI.result: 参与者利用这些活动痕迹检查证据、引导代理、通过标注进行沟通，并反思自身研究焦点；共享历史也帮助代理在既有工作上继续推进。
AI.conclusion: 共享文档中的参与痕迹可支持人类-代理知识工作场景下的透明度、个性化协助与协作协调。

title: Twist Flow for Inverse Problems
summary: In Bayesian inverse problems, posterior sampling requires generating samples that are consistent with given observations while capturing the range of plausible solutions. Direct conditional generative models introduce latent noise to model this ambiguity, but paired inverse-problem training can still encourage an almost deterministic map from the observation to the target. As a result, generated samples may be observation-consistent while under-representing posterior variability, especially when the posterior is multimodal, leading to undercoverage, mode distortion, or artificial transitions between distinct feasible solutions. We propose joint twist-flow, an augmented flow-matching formulation that learns a continuous transport from the augmented source state $(z_x, y)$ to the augmented terminal state $(x, z_y)$. Here x is the target variable, $y$ is the observation, $z_x$ is the Gaussian reference coordinate for posterior sampling, and $z_y$ is a Gaussian likelihood-side coordinate associated with the observation branch. Under a Gaussian observation model, $z_y$ is motivated by the normalized observation residual associated with observation compatibility. Its role is not to replace uncertainty in $x$, but to couple generated samples of x to observation consistency, helping reduce likelihood-inconsistent variation while preserving variability in weakly constrained directions. We validate the method on low-dimensional inverse problems with reference posterior samples, where joint twist-flow better preserves multimodal posterior support than a direct conditional-flow baseline. We further evaluate the method on image restoration and seismic subsurface velocity-model inversion, showing increased posterior variability while maintaining observation consistency.

AI.tldr: 提出 joint twist-flow，一种增强流匹配公式，通过学习从增强源状态 $(z_x, y)$ 到增强终端状态 $(x, z_y)$ 的连续传输，实现贝叶斯逆问题中兼顾观测一致性与后验变异性的采样。
AI.motivation: 贝叶斯逆问题中，后验采样需在满足观测约束的同时捕捉合理解的范围。直接条件生成模型虽引入潜在噪声建模歧义，但配对训练容易倾向学习近似确定性的观测到目标映射，导致样本虽观测一致却低估后验变异性，尤其在后验多模态时出现覆盖不足、模态扭曲或不同可行解间的人为过渡。
AI.method: 提出 joint twist-flow，一种增强流匹配公式，学习从增强源状态 $(z_x, y)$ 到增强终端状态 $(x, z_y)$ 的连续传输。其中 $x$ 为目标变量，$y$ 为观测，$z_x$ 为后验采样的高斯参考坐标，$z_y$ 为与观测分支关联的高斯似然侧坐标。在高斯观测模型下，$z_y$ 由归一化观测残差驱动，用于观测兼容性；其作用并非替代 $x$ 的不确定性，而是将生成的 $x$ 样本与观测一致性耦合，减少似然不一致的变异，同时保留弱约束方向上的变异性。
AI.result: 在具参考后验样本的低维逆问题上验证，joint twist-flow 相比直接条件流基线更好地保持多模态后验支撑。进一步在图像恢复与地震地下速度模型反演中评估，显示在保持观测一致性的同时提升了后验变异性。
AI.conclusion: joint twist-flow 通过增强流匹配引入似然侧坐标耦合，有效缓解条件生成模型的确定性坍缩问题，在多模态与高维逆问题中兼顾观测一致性与后验变异性的平衡。

title: Video-to-Model: Automatic Modeling of Deformable Linear Objects
summary: This paper presents a video-to-model framework for automatically modeling the motion of a deformable suture thread from an input video. We utilize a recently developed CBF--CLF--QP numerical model that simplifies the characterization of deformable string motion through the selection of a small number of parameters. A perception module first localizes and tracks the thread in video, producing an ordered sequence of thread nodes. The observed thread motion is then processed by a spatio-temporal CNN network that estimates the effective parameters of a structured CBF--CLF--QP model. These parameters are used to simulate the thread under a user-defined needle velocity input. Experiments using unseen thread configurations and motion demonstrate that the framework can reliably reconstruct the thread behavior from video, automatically configure the structured model, and reproduce the expected thread motion with low tracking error. The proposed approach reduces the need for manual parameter tuning and provides a step toward automatic video-based modeling of deformable linear objects.

AI.tldr: 提出视频到模型的框架，通过感知模块跟踪缝合线节点，用时空CNN估计CBF-CLF-QP模型参数，实现从视频自动建模可变形缝合线运动。
AI.motivation: 可变形线性物体（如缝合线）的建模通常需要繁琐的手动参数调节，缺乏从视频自动建模的能力，本文旨在减少人工调参并提供视频驱动的自动建模途径。
AI.method: 采用CBF-CLF-QP数值模型简化可变形线运动表征（仅少量参数）；感知模块定位并跟踪视频中的线，输出有序节点序列；时空CNN网络估计结构化CBF-CLF-QP模型的有效参数；参数用于在用户定义的针速度输入下仿真线运动。
AI.result: 在未见过的线与运动配置实验中，框架能可靠地从视频重建线行为，自动配置结构化模型，并以低跟踪误差复现预期线运动。
AI.conclusion: 该方法减少手动参数调节需求，向基于视频的可变形线性物体自动建模迈进一步。

title: EngramEdit: Decoupled Knowledge Updates in LLMs through Conditional Memory
summary: Conditional memory architectures such as DeepSeek Engram use input n-grams to look up learned embeddings, expanding the capacity of large language models (LLMs) with limited additional computation. Beyond model scaling, this architecture has demonstrated the potential to decouple factual knowledge storage from general-purpose computation, offering a promising route to updating factual knowledge while keeping the Transformer backbone fixed. Realizing this potential is challenging because different expressions of a fact may activate different n-gram embeddings, while updating shared embeddings can unintentionally change the model's predictions about other facts. We propose EngramEdit for decoupled knowledge updates through conditional memory. EngramEdit first computes target memory representations that make the model predict the updated fact across multiple expressions. It then jointly updates the shared n-gram embeddings to match these targets across expressions and edits, penalizing updates to frequently reused embeddings more strongly to preserve unrelated knowledge. Experiments show that EngramEdit enables independent factual knowledge updates through conditional memory, achieving near-perfect editing success. Revised knowledge is usable across unseen expressions and in multi-hop reasoning, with nearly three times the strongest baseline's accuracy under chain-of-thought (CoT) prompting. Unrelated knowledge and general capabilities are largely preserved even as factual updates accumulate. These findings show that EngramEdit turns conditional memory into an editable knowledge interface, extending its role beyond model scaling to support decoupled knowledge updates.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 EngramEdit，一种通过条件记忆架构实现解耦知识更新的方法，先计算能促使模型在多种表达下预测更新事实的目标记忆表示，再联合更新共享 n-gram 嵌入并对高频复用嵌入施加更强惩罚，实验证明其可近完美地完成事实编辑且保留无关知识与通用能力。
AI.motivation: 条件记忆架构（如 DeepSeek Engram）虽显示出将事实知识存储与通用计算解耦的潜力，但实现该潜力面临两大难题：同一事实的不同表达会激活不同的 n-gram 嵌入；而更新共享嵌入又可能无意间改变模型对其他事实的预测。因此需要一种能够在条件记忆中实现解耦知识更新的专门方法。
AI.method: EngramEdit 分两步进行：首先计算目标记忆表示，使模型在多种表达方式下都能预测更新后的事实；随后联合更新共享 n-gram 嵌入，使其在多种表达与多次编辑中匹配这些目标，并对被频繁复用的嵌入施加强烈惩罚，以保护无关知识。
AI.result: 实验表明，EngramEdit 能够通过条件记忆实现独立的事实知识更新，达到接近完美的编辑成功率；修改后的知识可在未见表达和多跳推理中使用，在思维链（CoT）提示下准确率约为最强基线的三倍；即便事实更新不断累积，无关知识和通用能力也基本得以保留。
AI.conclusion: 这些发现表明 EngramEdit 将条件记忆转变为一种可编辑的知识接口，使其作用超越模型扩展，可用于支持解耦的知识更新。

title: TERRA: Learning Transportable Latent Actions through Temporal Effect Representation and Relational Alignment
comment: Preprint. Code and project page coming soon
summary: Latent actions supervise robot policies with action-like codes inferred from visual transitions, and their usefulness hinges on two questions: what a code keeps from a transition, and whether it still means the same thing when reused in a different initial state. The first is a tension in time: an endpoint difference discards how motion unfolds, while the full sequence admits nuisance variation. The second is left open by reconstruction, which only ever observes a latent together with the state it came from. We argue that both questions can be answered in the same place. TERRA (Temporal Effect Representation and Relational Alignment) describes a transition by a compact temporal effect, its net feature change together with a low-order within-window dynamics component, and learns a continuous latent from this effect. The same effect space then serves as the reference for reuse: Effect-Anchored Transport (EAT) decodes a latent in other initial states and anchors the resulting effect to the one observed at its source, so that the latent is shaped by what it does across contexts rather than only by the transition it came from. With frozen linear readers, TERRA predicts actions more accurately than UniVLA and a LAPA-style baseline, degrades more slowly under visual distractors, and keeps transported transitions faithful to the donor action as the recipient context moves farther away; a same-budget control shows that these gains come largely from EAT. At matched pretraining scale, the complete system reaches 93.4% average success on LIBERO, compared with 91.8% for UniVLA.

AI.tldr: TERRA 提出用紧凑的"时序效应"描述视觉转移并学习连续潜动作，配合 Effect-Anchored Transport 实现跨初始状态的潜动作复用，在冻结线性读出下优于 UniVLA 与 LAPA 类基线，LIBERO 平均成功率 93.4%。
AI.motivation: 潜动作（latent action）从视觉转移中推断类动作编码来监督机器人策略，其有效性取决于两个未决问题：一是编码从转移中保留了什么（端点差分丢失运动过程，完整序列引入无关扰动）；二是编码在换到不同初始状态后语义是否保持一致（重构式方法只观察到潜变量及其来源状态，无法回答）。作者主张这两个问题可在同一表征空间中被统一解决。
AI.method: 提出 TERRA（Temporal Effect Representation and Relational Alignment）：用紧凑的时序效应描述一次转移，即净特征变化加上低阶窗口内动态分量，并由此效应学习连续潜变量。同一效应空间同时充当复用的参照：Effect-Anchored Transport (EAT) 在其他初始状态下解码潜变量，并将解码得到的效应锚定到其在源状态下观测到的效应，使潜变量由跨情境的行为表现塑造，而非仅由来源转移决定。
AI.result: 在使用冻结线性读出的条件下，TERRA 的动作预测精度高于 UniVLA 和 LAPA 风格基线；在视觉干扰下性能退化更慢；当接收方情境远离源情境时，迁移后的转移仍与供体动作保持一致。同算力预算的对照实验表明增益主要来自 EAT。在匹配预训练规模下，完整系统在 LIBERO 上达到 93.4% 平均成功率，UniVLA 为 91.8%。
AI.conclusion: 将"保留什么"与"跨状态是否同义"这两个问题统一到同一个时序效应空间中求解是可行且有效的：以紧凑效应表征学习潜动作、并以效应为锚进行跨情境迁移（EAT），能显著提升动作预测鲁棒性、迁移保真度与下游策略成功率，且增益主要归因于 EAT 而非表征本身。

title: Reliability of LLM Judges for Evaluating Entity Alignment
summary: Entity Alignment (EA) identifies equivalent entities across knowledge graphs and is critical for knowledge base integration and ontology merging. Evaluating EA systems at scale requires expensive expert annotation, making systematic assessment across diverse domains practically infeasible. LLM-as-judge evaluation offers a potentially scalable alternative, yet its reliability for structured prediction tasks like EA remains unstudied. We present the first systematic benchmarking study across three frontier models, three datasets, and four EA systems, using perturbation bias diagnostics, meta-evaluation across all dataset-judge-prompt combinations, and counterfactual label-flip tests. We identify anchor bias, a failure mode in which judges invert discrimination when the system's decision label is visible. Label exposure causally collapses judge discrimination (J-ROC-AUC 0.12-0.87), while a label-free protocol recovers near-ceiling capability on distinctive-name datasets (0.93-1.00) and significant recovery on biomedical pairs (0.93-0.95). Counterfactual experiments confirm causality (FSR 53-99%) and reveal a frontier model paradox: stronger judges exhibit greater label sensitivity, not less. A blinded two-annotator human evaluation (102 pairs, Cohen's kappa=0.902) confirms this mechanism directly. We release the first biomedical EA benchmark (MeSH-SNOMED CT, 15K pairs) and a reproducible auditing framework for LLM judge reliability in EA. Code and data are available at https://github.com/vaibhavalakshmiravideshik/llm-as-a-judge-entity-alignment.

AI.tldr: 本文首次系统评估LLM-as-judge在实体对齐(EA)任务中的可靠性，识别出"锚点偏置"失效模式：暴露系统决策标签会导致评判判别力崩塌，而无标签协议可显著恢复性能，且发现前沿模型悖论——更强的模型反而标签敏感度更高。
AI.motivation: 实体对齐(EA)对知识库集成与本体合并至关重要，但大规模评估EA系统依赖昂贵的专家标注，难以在多领域进行系统评估。LLM-as-judge提供了可扩展的替代方案，但其在EA这类结构化预测任务上的可靠性尚属空白。
AI.method: 首次开展系统性基准测试：涵盖3个前沿模型、3个数据集、4个EA系统；采用扰动偏置诊断、跨所有"数据集-评判者-提示词"组合的元评估，以及反事实标签翻转测试；并辅以102对样本的双标注者盲测人工评估。
AI.result: 识别出锚点偏置：当系统决策标签可见时，评判者判别力发生反转；标签暴露使J-ROC-AUC崩塌至0.12-0.87，而无标签协议在独特名称数据集上恢复至近满分(0.93-1.00)、在生物医学对上显著恢复(0.93-0.95)。反事实实验确认因果性(FSR 53-99%)，并揭示"前沿模型悖论"：更强评判者的标签敏感度反而更高。人工评估(Cohen's kappa=0.902)直接验证了该机制。
AI.conclusion: LLM-as-judge在EA任务中存在严重的锚点偏置，可靠性受限；需采用无标签协议以恢复评判能力。论文发布了首个生物医学EA基准(MeSH-SNOMED CT，15K对)及可复现的LLM评判可靠性审计框架，为EA评估提供实践指导。

title: Self-attention summary networks for subsurface velocity-model building from common-image gathers
summary: Common-image gathers (CIGs) contain physically meaningful information about velocity-model errors through reflector focusing and residual moveout, but in conventional imaging workflows they are typically used only as diagnostic tools. In this work, we propose a multiscale self-attention summary network that maps high-dimensional 3D CIG volumes into compact conditioning embeddings for probabilistic subsurface velocity inversion. These learned embeddings preserve offset-dependent kinematic structure and spatial coherence while reducing variability caused by background-velocity mismatch. Conditioned on these summary embeddings, a flow-matching model learns a transport from a Gaussian source distribution to the posterior distribution of plausible velocity fields. Numerical experiments show that, compared with direct conditioning on raw CIGs, the proposed summary network improves posterior velocity inference. In particular, the multiscale attention design provides greater robustness to background-model mismatch, yielding more accurate posterior reconstructions and lower predictive uncertainty.

AI.tldr: 提出多尺度自注意力摘要网络，将三维CIG体压缩为条件嵌入，结合流匹配模型实现概率速度反演，效果优于直接条件化原始CIG。
AI.motivation: CIG包含反射层聚焦和残余动校正所反映的速度模型误差信息，但在传统成像流程中仅作为诊断工具使用；同时直接以原始CIG作为条件进行反演存在高维、背景速度失配导致变异大的问题。
AI.method: 设计多尺度自注意力摘要网络，将高维三维CIG体映射为紧凑的条件嵌入，保留随偏移距变化的运动学结构与空间相干性；以该嵌入为条件，训练流匹配模型学习从高斯源分布到速度场后验分布的输运映射。
AI.result: 数值实验表明，相比直接条件化原始CIG，所提摘要网络提升了速度后验推断质量；多尺度注意力设计对背景模型失配具有更强鲁棒性，后验重建更准确、预测不确定性更低。
AI.conclusion: CIG可被有效转化为反演的条件信息；多尺度自注意力摘要嵌入配合流匹配生成模型，是提升概率地下速度反演精度与鲁棒性的可行方案。

title: Distributed Motion Planning for Multi-Robot Systems under Topological Constraints
summary: Efficient and distributed coordination of mobile robots is one of the main challenges in multi-robot systems. Topological constraints, often expressed as topological braids, are a popular tool to encode complex coordination patterns between multiple mobile robots, as they offer a compact and abstract representation of the desired qualitative relation between the space-time trajectories of the robots. However, execution of joint motion plans encoded as braid-based topological constraints via distributed controllers is challenging, with existing approaches, generally based on the execution of one braid generator at a time, producing slow and suboptimal trajectories. We propose a distributed controller based on Model Predictive Control (MPC) to efficiently execute braid-based topological specifications. Rather than directly tracking the braid specification, we propose to use winding numbers, which are topological invariants for braids, as a proxy. This has the twofold benefit of converting braids into a continuous function, which can be easily tracked by an MPC controller through an appropriate term in the cost function, and of decoupling the global braid specification into a set of pairwise specifications, which can be tracked distributedly through the solution of only local MPC problems. To maintain global coordination, we propose a consensus-based progress estimation approach, which allows the robots to synchronize their motion toward the desired specification. We validate the proposed approach in simulation and in real-world experiments, where we demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed approach and the improvement over existing approaches in terms of execution speed and control effort.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于模型预测控制（MPC）的分布式控制器，用于高效执行以拓扑辫（braid）编码的多机器人协调规格。核心思想是用绕数（winding number，辫的拓扑不变量）作为代理，将辫转化为连续函数以便MPC跟踪，并将全局辫规格解耦为成对规格以分布式求解局部MPC问题；同时引入基于共识的进度估计实现全局同步。仿真与实物实验表明，该方法在执行速度与控制代价上优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 多机器人系统的分布式协调是一大挑战。拓扑辫约束能紧凑、抽象地编码机器人时空轨迹间的定性关系，但现有基于辫的分布式执行方法通常一次只执行一个辫生成元，导致轨迹缓慢且次优。因此需要一种能高效、分布式执行辫拓扑规格的控制方法。
AI.method: 提出基于MPC的分布式控制器。不直接跟踪辫规格，而是采用绕数（辫的拓扑不变量）作为代理：一方面将辫转化为可被MPC通过代价函数项跟踪的连续函数，另一方面将全局辫规格解耦为一组成对规格，从而仅通过求解局部MPC问题即可分布式跟踪。为维持全局协调，提出基于共识的进度估计方法，使各机器人同步其朝向目标规格的运动。
AI.result: 在仿真和真实世界实验中验证了所提方法，证明其有效性，并在执行速度与控制代价方面相较现有方法有改进。
AI.conclusion: 以绕数为代理的分布式MPC控制框架能够高效执行辫基拓扑规格，通过局部MPC与共识式进度估计实现全局协调，在速度与控制代价上优于现有逐生成元执行方法。

title: LiG-DETR: Local-in-Global Reassembly in Latent Space for Aerial Object Detection
summary: Aerial object detection faces substantial scale and density variations. Small objects are easily degraded by downsampling and feature compression, while medium and large objects require sufficient global context. Existing methods mainly follow two paradigms: image slicing provides clearer local evidence but relies on independent crop-level prediction and post-processing, whereas feature- and query-level optimization preserves unified inference but operates on already compressed full-image representations, limiting recovery of fine-grained information. This raises a key question: can aerial detection directly acquire high-fidelity local evidence before feature degradation and integrate it into a unified end-to-end framework? To this end, we propose LiG-DETR, an Efficient Global-Local Reassembly framework that reformulates image slicing as high-fidelity local feature acquisition. A shared encoder extracts global and locally magnified features, which are projected into the detector feature space. The projected local features are reassembled according to their original spatial locations to form a globally aligned local feature level, and a single DETR decoder jointly decodes global and local features. To reduce redundant computation, Context-Preserved Selective Reassembly focuses high-resolution encoding on informative regions while preserving a dense feature layout, and Density-Aware Adaptive Query Allocation adapts the decoder query budget using encoder proposal scores. Experiments show substantial gains on small and medium objects while retaining strong large-object performance, with favorable accuracy--efficiency trade-offs and improved cross-domain generalization. The code will be released.

AI.tldr: 提出LiG-DETR，将图像切片重新表述为高保真局部特征获取，通过全局-局部特征重组装与单一DETR解码器实现统一端到端航空目标检测。
AI.motivation: 航空目标检测面临显著的尺度与密度变化：小目标易因下采样和特征压缩而退化，中大型目标需充分全局上下文。现有两类范式各有不足——图像切片提供清晰局部证据但依赖独立的裁剪级预测与后处理；特征/查询级优化保留统一推理但作用于已压缩的全图表示，难以恢复细粒度信息。核心问题：能否在特征退化之前直接获取高保真局部证据，并整合进统一端到端框架？
AI.method: LiG-DETR为高效全局-局部重组装框架。共享编码器提取全局与局部放大特征，投影到检测器特征空间；投影后的局部特征按原始空间位置重组装，形成全局对齐的局部特征层级，由单一DETR解码器联合解码全局与局部特征。为降低冗余计算，提出上下文保持的选择性重组装（Context-Preserved Selective Reassembly），将高分辨率编码集中于信息量大的区域并保持稠密特征布局；并设计密度感知自适应查询分配（Density-Aware Adaptive Query Allocation），依据编码器提议分数自适应调整解码器查询预算。
AI.result: 实验显示在小目标和中目标上取得显著增益，同时保持较强的大目标性能，具有有利的精度-效率权衡以及更好的跨域泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 该方法验证了在特征退化前获取高保真局部证据并融入统一端到端检测框架的可行性与有效性。代码将开源。

title: DrugTargetWorld: A Synthetic Biobank for Training and Benchmarking AI Scientists
comment: 34 pages main text, 92 pages supplementary material; 6 main figures. Project: https://DrugTargetWorld.vercel.app. Code: https://github.com/sammargolis/DrugTargetWorld. Data: https://huggingface.co/datasets/sammargolis/DrugTargetWorld-assets
summary: Drug target discovery requires distinguishing molecules that causally drive disease from those that are merely associated with it. Training and evaluating AI agents to perform this workflow end-to-end is difficult because real world biobanks lack known causal ground truth and participant-level data is access controlled. We introduce DrugTargetWorld, a framework that procedurally generates simulated biobanks, or "worlds," with known but concealed causal structure. Each world contains genotypes, proteins, health records, outcomes, and synthetic magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) for 54,000 participants. Agents must construct a disease phenotype, identify causal driver proteins, infer the beneficial direction of modulation, and optionally conduct virtual 'wet lab' experiments. We evaluated nine agents in 540 episodes across 20 cardiovascular worlds and three experimental budgets.
