Opus 5 and GPT-5.6 Sol achieved the highest mean composite scores, 39.98 and 35.38 of 100, respectively, and both recovered 64% of causal drivers on average. However, no agent reliably distinguished misleading non-causal proteins, and performance remained limited by the integrative judgments required to connect phenotype construction, causal evidence, and intervention decisions. By making each world's causal structure known to the evaluator but hidden from the agent, DrugTargetWorld turns end-to-end drug target discovery into a scalable training and evaluation problem with verifiable reward.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 DrugTargetWorld 框架，通过程序化生成具有已知但隐藏因果结构的模拟生物样本库，将端到端的药物靶点发现转化为可规模化训练与评估的问题，并发现现有 AI 智能体在区分非因果干扰蛋白与整合判断方面仍表现有限。
AI.motivation: 药物靶点发现的核心难点在于区分"因果驱动疾病"的分子与"仅相关"的分子。然而，训练和评估能端到端执行该流程的 AI 智能体十分困难：真实生物样本库缺乏已知的因果金标准，且参与者级数据受访问权限限制。
AI.method: 提出 DrugTargetWorld 框架，程序化生成模拟生物样本库（"worlds"），其因果结构对评估者已知但对智能体隐藏。每个 world 包含 54,000 名参与者的基因型、蛋白质、健康记录、结局指标及合成 MRI 影像。智能体需构建疾病表型、识别因果驱动蛋白、推断调控的有益方向，并可选择性地进行虚拟"湿实验"。评估在 20 个心血管 world、3 种实验预算下对 9 个智能体进行 540 个回合测试。
AI.result: Opus 5 与 GPT-5.6 Sol 取得最高平均综合得分，分别为 100 分制的 39.98 和 35.38，且二者平均恢复了 64% 的因果驱动因子。但没有任何智能体能可靠区分具有误导性的非因果蛋白，且性能受限于连接表型构建、因果证据与干预决策所需的整合性判断。
AI.conclusion: 通过让每个 world 的因果结构对评估者可见、对智能体隐藏，DrugTargetWorld 将端到端药物靶点发现转变为具有可验证奖励的可扩展训练与评估问题，为 AI 智能体在该领域的系统评测提供了新范式。

title: LeCuration: A Tiny World Model as a Data Curation Multi-Tool
summary: Many applications of physical AI run within finite or closed physical worlds with a limited set of physical laws governing object behavior. Examples include robots working in a warehouse and agents moving around in a video game. In order to better organize, filter, and curate data for physical AI applications, we propose a new approach centered on the unique settings and physical laws of individual datasets. We train LeCuration, a small world model intended to serve as a data curation tool for a separate, larger downstream model. To build this model, we choose LeWorldModel (LeWM)as our latent encoder and predictor, adding a diffusion transformer (DiT) decoder to add visuals to autoregressive gameplay rollout. We find that the embeddings of this model can be used as an anomaly detection signal and as a content-based clustering heuristic, and that auto-regressively predicting the game state with this model allows us to qualitatively check for action-state consistency. This paper presents a qualitative, proof-of-concept case study on CS:GO gameplay data; we do not yet report quantitative curation metrics or downstream training results, which we identify as the key next step.

AI.tldr: 论文提出以单个数据集独特物理法则为中心的数据策展思路，训练小型世界模型LeCuration（基于LeWM潜编码器+预测器并加DiT解码器）作为下游大模型的数据策展工具，在CS:GO数据上给出定性的概念验证案例。
AI.motivation: 物理AI应用多运行于有限或封闭的物理世界（如仓库机器人、视频游戏智能体），需针对其特定物理法则组织、筛选与策展数据。作者主张以各数据集独有的设置与物理规律为中心开展数据策展。
AI.method: 构建LeCuration小型世界模型，用作独立下游大模型的数据策展工具：以LeWM（LeWorldModel）作为潜空间编码器与预测器，并增加扩散Transformer（DiT）解码器，为自回归游戏推演生成视觉画面。
AI.result: 模型嵌入可作为异常检测信号与内容聚类启发式；借助该模型自回归预测游戏状态，可定性检查动作-状态一致性。研究为CS:GO游戏数据的定性概念验证案例，尚未报告定量策展指标或下游训练结果。
AI.conclusion: 该方法在小世界模型用于数据策展的方向上具备可行性，下一步关键工作是引入定量策展指标与下游训练验证。

title: RealtimeWAM: How Fast Can I Run My World Action Model?
summary: World Action Models (WAMs) combine visual dynamics modeling with action generation, but their high inference latency limits responsive robot control. Recent efforts accelerate inference by removing explicit future-video generation at test time, as in FastWAM, an approach that requires a specially tailored architectural design. More general caching strategies exploit feature redundancy, but redundancy alone does not capture the changing computational demands of closed-loop control. To address these challenges, we present RealtimeWAM, a general, training-free framework that coordinates parallel execution with adaptive computation for low-latency inference across diverse WAM architectures. We exploit layerwise dependencies to overlap observation processing with prediction. However, concurrent branches still compete for GPU resources, limiting the benefit of parallel execution. We therefore adapt computation throughout the pipeline through selective reuse, caching observation features in visually stable regions and reusing Transformer residuals while reserving additional refinement for small predicted adjustments. We evaluate RealtimeWAM on FastWAM and OpenWAM across RoboTwin, LIBERO, and LIBERO-Plus. On an RTX 4090, measured mean inference latencies are 24.09 and 63.09 ms, corresponding to average speedups of 8.90$\times$ and 10.67$\times$. Average success rates are 82.75% and 87.41%, respectively, within 0.02 and 0.53 percentage points of native inference. Across five real-world tasks, RealtimeWAM improves average success rates over native inference by 17.2 and 37.2 percentage points on FastWAM and OpenWAM, respectively.

AI.tldr: RealtimeWAM 是一个通用、免训练框架，通过并行执行与自适应计算协同，实现多类世界动作模型（WAM）的低延迟推理。
AI.motivation: 世界动作模型（WAM）融合视觉动态建模与动作生成，但高推理延迟限制了机器人闭环控制的响应速度。FastWAM 需专门架构设计，而通用缓存策略仅利用特征冗余，无法刻画闭环控制中变化的计算需求。
AI.method: 利用层级依赖将观测处理与预测重叠以并行执行；针对并行分支的 GPU 资源竞争，引入自适应计算：在视觉稳定区域缓存观测特征实现选择性复用，复用 Transformer 残差，同时为小幅预测调整保留额外细化。
AI.result: 在 FastWAM 与 OpenWAM 上，RTX 4090 上 RoboTwin、LIBERO、LIBERO-Plus 平均推理延迟为 24.09 ms 与 63.09 ms，加速 8.90× 与 10.67×；平均成功率 82.75% 与 87.41%，较原生推理分别仅低 0.02 与 0.53 个百分点。五项真实任务中，成功率较原生推理分别提升 17.2 与 37.2 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: RealtimeWAM 作为免训练通用框架，可跨多种 WAM 架构显著降低推理延迟，并在仿真与真实任务中保持或提升成功率。

title: OmniCam: Omni-Camera Trajectory Generation via Geometry-Grounded Pose Token Learning
summary: Camera trajectories control viewpoint changes in video generation, scene reconstruction, and robotic perception. Generating them from language requires both scene geometry and target-aware framing. We introduce OmniCam, an autoregressive model that generates camera pose sequences from a single panorama and textual trajectory descriptions. Its geometry-grounded pose token learning combines three components: a panoramic point-cloud encoder for omnidirectional geometric context; hybrid absolute-rotation and relative-translation tokenization with temporally consistent quaternion signs; and separate geometric and semantic conditioning streams with an explicit 3D target anchor. We also construct OmniCaT, containing 267,700 trajectories across four camera behaviors. On the reported OmniCaT evaluation, OmniCam reduces trajectory errors by 28--47% and collision rate by 65.8% relative to GenDoP retrained on OmniCaT. Against the best baseline for each metric, the ATE and collision reductions are 43.0% and 62.3%, respectively. Component ablations support the use of geometric and target-aware conditioning, while downstream experiments examine camera-controlled video generation and robotic active perception.

AI.tldr: OmniCam：一个从单张全景图与文本轨迹描述自回归生成相机位姿序列的模型，配套OmniCaT数据集（267,700条轨迹、四类相机行为），在轨迹误差上降低28–47%、碰撞率降低65.8%。
AI.motivation: 相机轨迹控制视频生成、场景重建与机器人感知中的视角变化；从语言生成轨迹需同时具备场景几何信息与目标感知的取景能力，而现有方法在这两方面均有欠缺。
AI.method: 提出OmniCam自回归模型，输入单张全景图与文本轨迹描述，输出相机位姿序列。其几何锚定的位姿token学习包含三部分：(1) 全景点云编码器，提供全向几何上下文；(2) 混合式绝对旋转与相对平移token化，并采用时间一致的四元数符号；(3) 几何流与语义流分离的条件注入，并引入显式3D目标锚点。
AI.result: 构建OmniCaT数据集，含267,700条轨迹、四类相机行为。在OmniCaT评测中，相对在OmniCaT上重训的GenDoP，轨迹误差降低28–47%、碰撞率降低65.8%；相对各指标最优基线，ATE降低43.0%、碰撞率降低62.3%。组件消融验证了几何条件与目标感知条件的有效性；下游实验考察了相机可控视频生成与机器人主动感知。
AI.conclusion: 几何锚定与目标感知的条件设计对文本驱动相机轨迹生成有效，OmniCam在精度与安全性上显著优于基线，并可迁移至视频生成与机器人主动感知等下游任务。

title: World Potential Model: Pretrained World Knowledge as Progress Potentials
summary: Long-horizon language agents often receive supervision only from terminal task outcomes, leaving little signal for distinguishing productive intermediate behavior from stagnation or even regression. Rather than learning a separate value function or process reward model for every task, we ask whether pretrained models can recognize task progress from their existing world knowledge. We formalize this capability with a World Potential Model (WPM), a goal-conditioned evaluator of task-relative realized progress in agent contexts. In ALFWorld and ScienceWorld, off-the-shelf pretrained models substantially outperform chance at recovering realized-progress structure without task-specific evaluator fine-tuning. We further anchor these progress judgments to task-specific milestones to obtain scalar world potentials, whose temporal differences provide process-sensitive step-level credit for policy optimization. Under matched comparisons, WPM-guided optimization improves success over outcome-only GRPO across all evaluated configurations. Together, these results provide initial evidence that pretrained world knowledge can support reusable realized-progress evaluation and provide useful supervision for long-horizon agents.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出World Potential Model (WPM)，用预训练模型的世界知识评估长时程智能体的任务相对已完成进度，并将进度判断锚定到任务里程碑以获得标量世界势能，其时间差分提供步级信用用于策略优化。
AI.motivation: 长时程语言智能体通常只从最终任务结果获得监督，难以区分有效的中间行为与停滞乃至退步。为避免为每个任务学习单独的价值函数或过程奖励模型，作者希望验证预训练模型能否利用已有世界知识识别任务进展。
AI.method: 形式化World Potential Model (WPM)，作为目标条件下评估智能体上下文中任务相对已完成进度的评估器；在ALFWorld和ScienceWorld上使用现成预训练模型，无需任务特定评估器微调即可恢复进度结构；将进度判断锚定到任务特定里程碑，得到标量世界势能，并通过其时间差分提供过程敏感的步级信用用于策略优化，与仅使用结果的GRPO进行匹配比较。
AI.result: 在ALFWorld和ScienceWorld中，现成预训练模型在恢复已完成进度结构方面显著优于随机水平，且无需任务特定评估器微调。在匹配比较下，WPM引导的优化在所有评估配置中均比仅使用结果的GRPO提高了成功率。
AI.conclusion: 结果提供了初步证据，表明预训练世界知识能够支持可复用的已完成进度评估，并为长时程智能体提供有用的监督信号。

title: Node-level Graph Neural Architecture Search Framework
summary: In recent years, Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) and architecture search frameworks have gained extensive application in non-Euclidean data processing, attributable to their superior capacity in managing unstructured data. Nevertheless, traditional approaches typically apply uniform convolution operations to all nodes, regardless of their varying structural and feature characteristics, which can undermine model performance and result in over-smoothing issues as the number of layers increases. To overcome this limitation, in this work, we propose a \textbf{N}ode-Level \textbf{G}raph \textbf{N}eural \textbf{A}rchitecture \textbf{S}earch (N-GNAS) algorithm. It can automatically choose an appropriate network architecture for each subset of nodes when updating node features. N-GNAS also introduces a contrastive learning loss to separate sample features from different categories and vice versa. In experiments conducted on eight datasets for node and graph classification, our methodology outperforms current leading GNAS techniques and traditional human-designed GNNs. For example, it achieves an accuracy rate of 78.26\% on the CiteSeer dataset.

AI.tldr: 本文提出节点级图神经架构搜索算法N-GNAS，可为不同节点子集自动选择合适架构更新特征，并引入对比学习损失，在八个数据集上优于现有GNAS方法与传统手工设计GNN。
AI.motivation: 传统GNN与架构搜索框架对所有节点施加统一卷积操作，忽视节点在结构与特征上的差异，导致模型性能下降并随层数增加出现过度平滑问题。
AI.method: 提出节点级图神经架构搜索（N-GNAS）算法，在更新节点特征时为每个节点子集自动选择适宜的网络架构；同时引入对比学习损失，使不同类别的样本特征相互分离、同类特征相互靠近。
AI.result: 在八个节点分类与图分类数据集上进行实验，方法性能优于当前主流GNAS技术及传统人工设计的GNN；例如在CiteSeer数据集上达到78.26%的准确率。
AI.conclusion: 节点级差异化架构选择结合对比学习能有效提升图表示学习性能，缓解统一卷积带来的局限与过度平滑问题。

title: Lifelong small-object navigation in changing object layouts: a benchmark and method
summary: Household robots need to continually navigate to different objects in the same environment, many of which are small and portable, such as tools and toys. Their small visual footprint and frequent occlusion make reliable observation difficult, and they may be moved by people without the robot observing the changes. We formulate this challenging task as Lifelong Small-object Navigation in Changing Object Layouts (LiSoNav-COL). Agents must seek suitable viewpoints for reliable observation, accumulate and reuse scene knowledge to efficiently locate subsequent targets, and update outdated memory after object relocation. To eliminate the need for prior scene scanning, we also require agents to start navigation with empty scene memory. Although practical, this task still lacks benchmarks designed around its defining assumptions. To bridge this gap, we introduce LiSoNav-Eval, a dedicated benchmark spanning 28 indoor scenes with 45 small-object categories. Its lifelong navigation sequences include both unchanged and relocated targets to evaluate memory reuse and adaptation to object relocation. To address this challenging task, we propose a navigation method based on multi-view Inspection with Viewpoint-Anchored Memory, dubbed IVAM-Nav. IVAM-Nav actively observes supporting surfaces from complementary viewpoints for reliable small-object perception and anchors the resulting memory to their observation viewpoints, supporting relational memory reuse and revalidation under similar viewing conditions. Extensive experiments on LiSoNav-Eval demonstrate favorable performance of IVAM-Nav against representative methods. Benchmark analyses also show that smaller objects, larger environments, and longer relocation distances pose greater challenges. The dataset and code are available here.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LiSoNav-COL任务、LiSoNav-Eval基准以及IVAM-Nav方法，解决家庭机器人在动态布局中长期导航到小型可移动物体的难题。
AI.motivation: 家庭机器人需在同一环境中反复导航到小型可携带物体（如工具、玩具），这类物体视觉占位小、易被遮挡，且可能被人移动而机器人未观察到变化。现有任务缺乏针对"空场景记忆起步+物体重定位"这一设定假设的基准。
AI.method: 提出IVAM-Nav：基于多视角检视（multi-view Inspection）与视点锚定记忆（Viewpoint-Anchored Memory）。主动从互补视角观察支撑表面以可靠感知小物体，并将记忆锚定到观察视点，支持在相似观察条件下的关系型记忆复用与再验证。
AI.result: 构建LiSoNav-Eval基准，涵盖28个室内场景、45类小物体，导航序列包含未变化与已重定位目标。实验表明IVAM-Nav优于代表性方法；分析显示更小的物体、更大的环境和更长的重定位距离带来更大挑战。
AI.conclusion: LiSoNav-COL任务与LiSoNav-Eval基准填补了该设定下的评估空白，IVAM-Nav通过多视角感知与视点锚定记忆有效应对小物体导航与物体重定位。数据集与代码已公开。

title: STRIKE: Learning Visual State Transitions for Physical World Modeling
summary: Physical world modeling requires predicting how interactions change a scene, not merely generating coherent motion. We propose STRIKE, a framework that separates visual state transition learning from dense video generation. We construct event-aligned supervision by extracting observed states from training videos and pairing them with transition descriptions and temporal offsets. An image-based transition model learns to predict the next scene configuration from the current image, a local transition specification, and elapsed time. At inference, a pretrained vision-language planner predicts time transition specifications, and recursive application of the learned transition model produces a sequence of future visual states. A separately trained dynamic model then generates the complete rollout conditioned on these states and their temporal locations. Experiments on Physics-IQ Verified, PhyGenBench, Pisa-Experiments, and RoboTwin2.0 show improvements of STRIKE over the corresponding video-backbone baselines in benchmark measures of physical consistency and manipulation-video fidelity. These results support learned visual state transitions as an effective intermediate representation for physical world modeling.

AI.tldr: STRIKE 将视觉状态转移学习与稠密视频生成解耦，用基于图像的转移模型递归预测未来场景状态，再由动态模型生成完整 rollout，在多个物理一致性基准上超越视频骨干基线。
AI.motivation: 物理世界建模需要预测交互如何改变场景，而不仅是生成连贯运动。现有稠密视频生成方法难以显式建模状态转移与时间跨度，物理一致性不足。
AI.method: 构建事件对齐监督：从训练视频提取观测状态，并与转移描述和时间偏移配对。训练基于图像的转移模型，从当前图像、局部转移规范与已历时间预测下一场景配置。推理时由预训练视觉语言规划器给出时间转移规范，递归应用转移模型得到未来视觉状态序列；再用单独训练的动态模型以这些状态及其时间位置为条件生成完整 rollout。
AI.result: 在 Physics-IQ Verified、PhyGenBench、Pisa-Experiments 和 RoboTwin2.0 上，STRIKE 在物理一致性与操作视频保真度指标上均优于对应的视频骨干基线。
AI.conclusion: 学习到的视觉状态转移可作为物理世界建模的有效中间表示。

title: Dual- versus Single-Suggestion AI Support for Radiographic Interpretation in Residents: Randomized Multireader Study
summary:
Purpose: To compare dual- and single-suggestion AI support for radiographic interpretation by residents, particularly when the shared AI suggestion was incorrect.
  Materials and Methods: This prospective, multicenter, randomized three-arm reader study was conducted at three hospitals in China from July to September 2026 (ChiCTR2600129243). After specialty stratification, 132 residents with fewer than 3 years of clinical experience were randomized 1:1:1 to GPT-5.4 alone (group A), GPT-5.4 plus Kimi-K2.6 (group B), or GPT-5.4 plus Gemini-3.6 Flash (group C); 123 were analyzed. Participants interpreted 60 radiographs before and after AI support. The primary outcome was accuracy change. Welch ANOVA and Holm-adjusted t tests compared support conditions; HC3 linear models assessed specialty interaction.
  Results: Among 123 residents (mean age, 24.1 years +/- 1.4; 65 women), radiology residents showed greater accuracy improvement with dual- than single-suggestion support (B-A, 6.69 percentage points [95% CI, 0.97-12.40]; C-A, 7.87 percentage points [95% CI, 1.64-14.11]; Holm-adjusted P = .030 for both), whereas accuracy change did not differ in non-radiology residents (P = .20). When GPT-5.4 was incorrect, AI-assisted accuracy was higher with dual- than single-suggestion support in radiology residents (40.1% and 40.4% vs 20.0%) and non-radiology residents (31.3% and 31.0% vs 12.1%) (all Holm-adjusted P < .001). The dual-suggestion effect differed by specialty (interaction difference, 10.44 percentage points; 95% CI, 4.36-16.52; P < .001).
  Conclusion: Dual-suggestion support may mitigate the influence of erroneous AI suggestions, with greater accuracy improvement observed in radiology but not non-radiology residents.

AI.tldr: 在123名经验不足3年的住院医师中，双AI建议（GPT-5.4+Kimi/Gemini）较单AI建议更能提升影像判读准确性，尤其在放射科住院医师中；当首个AI建议错误时，双建议优势最明显。
AI.motivation: 单一大模型建议一旦出错，住院医师易受误导，导致判读准确性下降；需评估双建议AI支持能否削弱错误建议的影响，并检验该效应是否因专业背景而异。
AI.method: 前瞻性、多中心、随机三臂读者研究（中国3家医院，2026年7–9月，ChiCTR2600129243）。132名（分析123名）临床经验<3年的住院医师按专业分层后1:1:1随机分为GPT-5.4单独（A组）、GPT-5.4+Kimi-K2.6（B组）、GPT-5.4+Gemini-3.6 Flash（C组）；每人对60张X线片在AI支持前后各判读一次。主要结局为准确性变化；采用Welch方差分析与Holm校正t检验比较支持条件，HC3线性模型评估专业交互作用。
AI.result: 123名住院医师（平均年龄24.1±1.4岁；65名女性）。放射科住院医师双建议组准确性提升高于单建议组（B-A 6.69个百分点，95% CI 0.97–12.40；C-A 7.87个百分点，95% CI 1.64–14.11；Holm校正P均为.030），非放射科组无差异（P=.20）。当GPT-5.4错误时，双建议组AI辅助准确性更高：放射科40.1%、40.4% vs 20.0%，非放射科31.3%、31.0% vs 12.1%（Holm校正P均<.001）。双建议效应存在专业差异（交互差异10.44个百分点，95% CI 4.36–16.52；P<.001）。
AI.conclusion: 双建议AI支持可能缓解错误AI建议的误导效应，准确性提升主要体现在放射科住院医师，而非放射科住院医师未观察到同等获益。

title: Kuration SDK: Addressing the Virtual2Real Gap via Data Curation
summary: Benchmarks for measuring the quality of action-conditioned world models are still evolving and shifting away from visual similarity-based metrics to action-semantic and physically-grounded metrics. However, for domain and task-agnostic action-conditioned world model training, existing benchmarks provide a limited signal. By training and evaluating diffusion world models on CounterStrike gameplay data, we confirm that qualitative playability does not correspond with metrics such as FVD, LPIPS, and JEDi. We term this the Virtual2Real gap. We posit that, in lieu of reliable benchmarks, curating raw gameplay data and measuring a variety of diagnostic properties provides a more robust signal to bridge the gap, before the training even begins. We present several curation strategies and a general-purpose kit for physical AI data curation called Kuration SDK, which is being open-sourced with this paper. The SDK was instrumental in uncovering the root cause of the virtual2real gap in a specific case: why two world models trained on identical gameplay map, action and state distribution, behaved very differently when played in spite of having very similar LPIPS and FVD scores. Thus, Kuration SDK has the potential to uncover the root causes of Virtual2Real gap in specific datasets and accelerate development of sample-efficient training datasets.

AI.tldr: 论文指出动作条件世界模型的现有基准受限于视觉指标，提出 Virtual2Real gap 概念，并开源 Kuration SDK 用于数据策展以弥合该差距。
AI.motivation: 现有基准正从视觉相似性指标转向动作语义与物理落地的指标，但对领域与任务无关的动作条件世界模型训练而言，现有基准提供的信号有限，视觉指标与实际可玩性不一致。
AI.method: 在 CounterStrike 游戏数据上训练并评估扩散世界模型，比较 FVD、LPIPS、JEDi 等指标与实际可玩性的关系；提出多种数据策展策略，并开源 Kuration SDK 物理 AI 数据策展工具包。
AI.result: 实验确认定性可玩性与 FVD、LPIPS、JEDi 等指标不匹配，即 Virtual2Real gap；Kuration SDK 成功定位了根因：两个在相同地图、动作与状态分布上训练、LPIPS 与 FVD 相近的世界模型在实际游玩时表现差异巨大。
AI.conclusion: 在训练开始前，策展原始游戏数据并测量多种诊断属性可提供更稳健的信号以弥合 Virtual2Real gap；Kuration SDK 有望揭示特定数据集中的根因，并加速样本高效训练数据集的开发。

title: Do Vision-Language-Action Models Understand Instructions? A Mechanistic Interpretability Study on Language Grounding
summary: Vision-Language-Action models are designed to generalise across environments and task descriptions, raising the question of whether their action generation actually depends on the language instruction, or whether they largely rely on visual cues and superficial correlations. Robustness to variance in the visual and linguistic observation space is critical for real-world deployment, yet VLAs lack explicit grounding modules and instead rely on the intrinsic language grounding capabilities of their Vision-Language model backbones. For this reason, we conduct a controlled mechanistic interpretability study on the language grounding capabilities of two state-of-the-art Vision-Language-Action models, $π_{0.5}$ and GR00T N1.7, by applying activation and attribution patching to the residual stream of the action generation modules. We systematically corrupt the task instruction of input samples of the LIBERO benchmark following five strategies: synonym replacement, semantic scaling, directional corruption, random object substitution, and empty string. Our experiments find that both models are comparatively insensitive to abstract rephrasing and to referencing non-existent objects, but react strongly to empty task descriptions and, especially, to directional language. During action generation, this sensitivity is concentrated in different loci for each model: mainly in the early, periodic cross-attention layers for GR00T N1.7, versus distributed across the earliest and selected later layers for $π_{0.5}$. For GR00T N1.7, directional perturbations drive some of the largest causal effects while leaving the internal representational geometry comparatively unchanged, a dissociation we do not observe clearly for $π_{0.5}$. Finally, the reliability of attribution patching is model-dependent: it closely tracks activation patching for GR00T N1.7 but not for $π_{0.5}$.

AI.tldr: 该研究对π_{0.5}和GR00T N1.7两个视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型进行机制可解释性分析，通过激活修补与归因修补考察其语言指令依赖程度。结果显示模型对抽象改写和非存在物体不敏感，但对空指令和方向性语言高度敏感，且敏感层位与归因修补可靠性存在模型差异。
AI.motivation: VLA模型宣称能在不同环境和任务描述下泛化，但其动作生成是否真正依赖语言指令，还是主要依赖视觉线索与浅层相关性，尚不明确。VLA缺乏显式语言落地模块，仅依赖VLM骨干的内在落地能力，而视觉与语言观测空间的稳健性对实际部署至关重要。
AI.method: 对π_{0.5}与GR00T N1.7两个SOTA VLA模型的动作生成模块残差流施加激活修补与归因修补，进行受控机制可解释性研究。在LIBERO基准上按五种策略系统破坏任务指令：同义词替换、语义缩放、方向性破坏、随机物体替换、空字符串。
AI.result: 两模型对抽象改写和引用非存在物体相对不敏感，但对空任务描述、尤其对方向性语言反应强烈。动作生成中的敏感性集中于不同层位：GR00T N1.7主要在早期周期性交叉注意力层，π_{0.5}则分布于最早期与部分后期层。GR00T N1.7中方向性扰动产生最大因果效应之一，但内部表征几何基本不变，π_{0.5}未清晰出现此解离。归因修补可靠性具模型依赖性：对GR00T N1.7与激活修补高度一致，对π_{0.5}则不一致。
AI.conclusion: VLA模型的语言落地有限且呈选择性：对抽象语义与物体真实性不敏感，而对方向性语言与指令缺失高度敏感；语言依赖的因果定位与表征变化在不同模型间存在显著差异，归因修补作为近似方法的可靠性也因模型而异。

title: It Is Not Seeing the Hazard: A Frozen Vision-Language Safety Score Measures Its Caption Bank
summary: Frozen vision-language models increasingly provide safety signals for reinforcement learning. Their use assumes that similarity to language describing danger indicates the hazard itself. Yet policy return and collision rate cannot reveal whether a score detects hazards or responds to correlated features of the scene. VLM-based methods have reported gains in driving and safe-RL benchmarks by converting image-text similarity into rewards, costs, or confidence weights. Such signals promise to reduce reliance on manually designed feedback. They may also reflect prompt structure, embedding geometry, or camera viewpoint, leaving their safety meaning unverified. To address this gap, we present a controlled evaluation of a frozen CLIP prompt-margin safety score. We apply the score to trajectories generated by policies that never receive it, match pre-contact observations to contact-free observations with comparable hazard geometry, and vary the captions, encoder, and camera view. Across three policies, 180 episodes, and 130 isolated contact onsets, the score decreases for about twenty steps before contact. Mechanism controls indicate that the score mainly tracks resemblance to the scene shared by its captions and changes with caption separation and camera view. A constant-confidence control retains the lower catastrophe-rate point estimate, so policy gains do not establish hazard perception.

AI.tldr: 本文对冻结CLIP提示边际安全分数进行受控评估，发现在约20步前接触时分数下降，但机制对照表明该分数主要追踪字幕与场景共有的相似性，而非危险本身，因此策略收益不能证明危险性感知。
AI.motivation: 冻结视觉语言模型日益被用作强化学习的安全信号，其核心假设是"与描述危险的语言相似"即代表危险本身。然而策略回报与碰撞率无法区分该分数是在检测危险，还是在对场景中相关特征作出响应；VLM方法虽在驾驶与安全RL基准上有增益，但可能反映提示结构、嵌入几何或相机视角，其安全含义未经检验。
AI.method: 作者提出对冻结CLIP提示边际安全分数的受控评估：将该分数应用于从未接收该分数的策略所生成的轨迹；将接触前观测与具有可比危险几何的无接触观测匹配；并改变字幕、编码器与相机视角进行对照，同时设置机制对照与恒定置信度对照。
AI.result: 在三个策略、180个回合、130个孤立接触起始点上，分数在接触前约20步开始下降。机制对照显示该分数主要追踪其字幕与场景所共有的相似性，并随字幕分离度与相机视角变化。恒定置信度对照仍保留较低的灾难率点估计。
AI.conclusion: VLM安全分数可能主要反映提示与嵌入的几何特性及视角相关性，而非真正的危险性感知；策略收益不足以确立危险感知能力，需通过机制对照加以验证。

title: Learning Situation-Conditioned Thinking Policies for Long-Term LLM Agents
summary: Long-running autonomous agents must reuse accumulated reasoning experience without allowing explicit historical memory and LLM context to grow indefinitely. However, existing memory mechanisms mainly retrieve, summarize, or compress past content and do not directly learn when particular kinds of thinking should be activated or discover new thinking knowledge from temporally dispersed experiences. This paper proposes a situation-conditioned thinking memory framework that transforms historical reasoning experience into a lightweight policy for predicting what should be thought about in the current situation, while leaving detailed reasoning to a large language model. Situations may represent temporal or spatiotemporal evolution rather than only current states. Temporary experiences are also periodically analyzed across multiple independent episodes to identify repeated long-range regularities, which are consolidated into new thinking knowledge and further internalized by the lightweight policy. Experiments show that the learned policy achieves 1.000 F1 on temporal-rule generalization, improves DeepSeek reasoning F1 from 0.789 to 0.868, reduces online processing time from 0.3636 ms to 0.0382 ms per query at 30,000 historical situations, and reaches 1.000 relation-discovery F1 and future-thinking accuracy after sufficient repeated cross-experience evidence.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出情境条件化思考记忆框架，将历史推理经验转化为轻量策略，用于预测当前情境下应思考什么，从而在不让记忆与上下文无限增长的前提下复用推理经验。
AI.motivation: 长时运行的自主智能体需要复用积累的推理经验，但不能让显式历史记忆与LLM上下文无限增长。现有记忆机制主要对过去内容进行检索、总结或压缩，并不会直接学习何时应激活某类思考，也难以从时间上分散的经验中发现新的思考知识。
AI.method: 提出情境条件化思考记忆框架：将历史推理经验转化为轻量策略，用于预测当前情境下应思考的内容，详细推理仍交给大语言模型；情境可表示时间或时空演化而非仅当前状态；周期性跨多个独立回合分析临时经验，识别重复的长程规律，并将其固化为新的思考知识，再由轻量策略进一步内化。
AI.result: 在时间规则泛化上达到1.000 F1；将DeepSeek推理F1从0.789提升至0.868；在30,000个历史情境下将在线处理时间由每查询0.3636 ms降至0.0382 ms；在获得足够重复跨经验证据后，关系发现F1与未来思考准确率均达到1.000。
AI.conclusion: 通过将历史推理经验压缩为情境条件化思考策略，并周期性跨回合提炼长程规律以形成新思考知识，该方法可有效提升推理性能与效率，并支持关系发现和未来思考，同时避免显式记忆与上下文的无限增长。

title: Design of a Fully Actuated 4-DOF Robotic Finger With Joint-Specific Hybrid Remote Actuation
comment: 10 pages, 10 figures. This manuscript has been submitted for possible publication
summary: This paper presents a fully actuated 4-DOF robotic finger using a joint-specific hybrid remote-actuation architecture. The metacarpophalangeal (MCP) joint is driven by two coordinated rigid-link transmission sets, whereas the proximal interphalangeal (PIP) and distal interphalangeal (DIP) joints are independently actuated by closed-loop wire transmissions incorporating circular rolling-contact joints (RCJs). A larger transmission radius is used at the PIP joint than at the DIP joint. The RCJ wire geometry maintains the total wire-loop length during joint rotation, and the DIP wire routing is designed so that PIP motion does not affect its differential actuation for a fixed MCP configuration. The distal wire transmission, MCP linkage, and fingertip kinematics are analytically modeled. In experiments, the transmission behavior was quantitatively evaluated from the ball-screw displacements measured using ArUco-marker tracking. MCP actuation produced measurable displacements of the PIP and DIP transmission units, whereas isolated PIP and DIP actuation with the MCP fixed supported the intended mechanical decoupling between the distal transmissions. The mean peak fingertip forces under isolated MCP, PIP, and DIP actuation were 21.28 N, 9.22 N, and 5.75 N, respectively. The resulting finger postures were also examined using objects of different geometries and sizes.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种全驱动4自由度机械手指，采用关节定制的混合远程驱动架构，并对其建模、解耦特性与抓握性能进行评估。
AI.motivation: 实现机械手指的高自由度全驱动，同时兼顾远端传动效率、关节间运动解耦与结构紧凑性，避免驱动单元堆叠在指节内。
AI.method: MCP关节由两组协同刚性连杆传动驱动；PIP与DIP关节由嵌入圆滚动接触关节的闭环丝传动独立驱动，PIP传动半径大于DIP。RCJ丝几何保证关节转动时丝环总长不变，DIP丝路设计使固定MCP配置下PIP运动不影响其差动驱动。对远端丝传动、MCP连杆及指尖运动学进行解析建模。
AI.result: 实验中用ArUco标记追踪测量滚珠丝杠位移以定量评估传动行为：MCP驱动引起PIP、DIP传动单元可测位移；MCP固定时单独驱动PIP、DIP支持远端传动间的机械解耦。MCP、PIP、DIP单独驱动下平均峰值指尖力分别为21.28 N、9.22 N、5.75 N；并用不同几何与尺寸物体检验了指尖姿态。
AI.conclusion: 该混合远程驱动架构可实现4自由度全驱动机械手指，远端传动具备预期解耦特性并输出可观的指尖力，适用于不同几何尺寸物体的抓握。

title: ActiveLang: Active Open-Vocabulary 3D Mapping with Semantic-Uncertainty-Guided Exploration
summary: As robots increasingly assist humans with diverse tasks, they need both geometric and semantic understanding of their surroundings. Moreover, robots often operate in unfamiliar environments and take on new tasks without knowing the relevant concepts ahead of time. This motivates language-annotated 3D maps that support open-vocabulary scene understanding and human-robot interaction. We introduce ActiveLang, an autonomous system for active open-vocabulary 3D mapping with semantic-uncertainty-guided exploration. ActiveLang performs online language-feature adaptation on a compact dual-Gaussian representation to jointly reconstruct scene geometry, appearance, and open-vocabulary semantics with modest memory overhead. Its planner efficiently selects informative viewpoints, enabling effective mapping with fewer observations and lower computational cost. Experiments on Replica and ScanNet++ demonstrate substantial improvements in 2D and 3D open-vocabulary segmentation over both online and offline baselines, highlighting that actively exploring scenes builds language-annotated 3D maps more efficiently.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ActiveLang，一个基于语义不确定性引导探索的自主主动式开放词汇3D建图系统，采用紧凑双高斯表示实现在线语言特征适应，联合重建几何、外观与开放词汇语义，并以高效规划器选取信息量大的视角，在Replica与ScanNet++上显著优于在线和离线基线。
AI.motivation: 机器人需在陌生环境中执行新任务，无法预先获知相关概念，因此既需要几何理解也需要语义理解。这促使构建带语言标注的3D地图，以支持开放词汇场景理解与人机交互。然而现有方法在未知场景中建图效率低、语义不确定，缺乏主动探索机制，且内存与计算开销较大。
AI.method: 提出ActiveLang自主系统，用于主动开放词汇3D建图，并以语义不确定性引导探索。系统在紧凑的双高斯表示上进行在线语言特征适应，联合重建场景几何、外观与开放词汇语义，内存开销适中。其规划器高效选取信息量大的视角，从而以更少观测和更低计算成本实现有效建图。
AI.result: 在Replica和ScanNet++数据集上的实验表明，ActiveLang在2D与3D开放词汇分割任务上相较于在线与离线基线均有显著提升，证明主动探索场景能更高效地构建带语言标注的3D地图。
AI.conclusion: 主动探索结合语义不确定性引导可显著提升开放词汇3D建图的效率与语义质量，紧凑双高斯表示与在线语言特征适应在有限内存下兼顾几何、外观与语义重建，为开放词汇场景理解与人机交互提供了有效方案。

title: SafeEvo: Deciphering the Safety Alignment Mechanism and Evolution in Language Models
summary: Safety interpretability advances the study of Large Language Model (LLM) alignment from behavioral constraints driven by data or algorithms towards a deeper understanding of internal mechanisms. However, existing works have focused primarily on safety-related representations, attention heads, or neurons after alignment, while largely overlooking the safety mechanisms in pretrained-only models and their evolution across alignment checkpoints. To address this, we propose SafeEvo, an interpretability framework from the circuit (sparse subgraphs of an LLM) perspective. SafeEvo first applies an optimization-based extraction algorithm to identify weak refusal circuits in pretrained base LLMs that can independently express refusal behavior. Causally ablating these circuits completely eliminates the base model's refusal of harmful inputs. SafeEvo then traces the evolution of refusal circuits across successive alignment checkpoints and finds that their structures change progressively, suggesting that the alignment tax may result from refusal-circuit updates affecting utility-related parameters. To validate this, SafeEvo introduces Safety Circuit Alignment (SCA), which confines safety updates to the refusal circuits. Experiments across three LLMs and two alignment algorithms show that, on average, SCA outperforms vanilla alignment in three aspects: \textbf{(1) stronger alignment}, lowering harmfulness score by 63.21\%; \textbf{(2) less over-refusal}, yielding a 58.44\% decrease in refusal rates for benign queries; and \textbf{(3) better utility}, retaining 99.58\% of the original model capabilities.

AI.tldr: 提出SafeEvo电路级可解释性框架，提取预训练基座模型中的弱拒绝电路，追踪其跨对齐checkpoint的演化，并提出SCA将安全更新限制于拒绝电路，在三个LLM和两种对齐算法上同时提升对齐强度、降低过度拒绝、保持效用。
AI.motivation: 现有安全可解释性研究主要关注对齐后的安全相关表征、注意力头或神经元，忽略了预训练-only模型中的安全机制及其跨对齐checkpoint的演化过程，导致对对齐税来源缺乏机制性理解。
AI.method: SafeEvo从电路（LLM的稀疏子图）视角出发：先用基于优化的提取算法识别预训练基座模型中可独立表达拒绝行为的弱拒绝电路；再通过因果消融验证；随后追踪拒绝电路在连续对齐checkpoint间的演化结构；最后提出Safety Circuit Alignment (SCA)，将对齐中的安全更新约束在拒绝电路内。
AI.result: 因果消融弱拒绝电路可完全消除基座模型对有害输入的拒绝。跨checkpoint追踪显示拒绝电路结构逐步变化，提示对齐税可能源于拒绝电路更新影响效用相关参数。在三个LLM和两种对齐算法上，SCA平均使有害性得分降低63.21%，良性查询拒绝率下降58.44%，并保留原模型99.58%的能力。
AI.conclusion: 拒绝行为在预训练基座模型中已由可独立表达的弱电路承载，且其结构随对齐逐步演化；将对齐更新局部化到拒绝电路可同时获得更强安全对齐、更低过度拒绝与更高效用保留，为缓解对齐税提供了电路级机制解释与可操作方案。

title: Denoising Blocks, Not Tokens: Efficient Compressed Continuous Diffusion with Branching Token Realization
summary: Diffusion language models (DLMs) generate text through iterative parallel refinement, offering the potential for higher throughput than autoregressive (AR) decoding. However, most DLMs still maintain one generative state per token, so every denoising step processes a state sequence as long as the output sequence, limiting the throughput gains from parallel generation. Continuous DLMs provide an additional degree of freedom: a single continuous state can represent multiple tokens, allowing diffusion to operate on a much shorter latent sequence. We introduce \emph{Branching Latent Diffusion (BLD)}, which exploits this flexibility by compressing a 1024-token sequence into only 64 block latents, a $16\times$ reduction. BLD combines latent compression with \emph{branching token realization}, where each latent is decoded by a local AR branch and all branches run in parallel. Because strong compression makes joint latent generation difficult, BLD generates the latents in groups, conditioning each group on previously generated latents. In end-to-end evaluation on the same GPU, BLD reduces generation FLOPs by more than $80\times$ and increases throughput by more than $6\times$ relative to the similarly sized ELF-L baseline. Compared with the AR baseline, BLD achieves more than $6\times$ higher throughput and more than $4\times$ lower latency. Despite the compression, BLD maintains competitive local fluency and diversity, although long-range coherence remains challenging. Overall, BLD shows that moving diffusion from token-level states to compressed latent sequences can substantially improve the efficiency of long-sequence generation.

AI.tldr: BLD 将 1024 个 token 压缩为 64 个块潜变量（16× 压缩），通过并行分支自回归解码实现高效长序列生成，FLOPs 降低 80× 以上、吞吐提升 6× 以上。
AI.motivation: 扩散语言模型虽具备并行精炼带来的高吞吐潜力，但多数模型仍对每个 token 维护一个生成状态，导致每步去噪需处理与输出等长的状态序列，限制了并行生成的效率收益。连续 DLM 提供了新自由度：单个连续状态可表示多个 token，从而让扩散在更短的潜序列上进行。
AI.method: 提出 Branching Latent Diffusion (BLD)：将 1024 token 序列压缩为 64 个块潜变量；结合潜压缩与"分支 token 实现"——每个潜变量由一个局部 AR 分支解码，所有分支并行运行；由于强压缩使联合潜生成困难，采用分组生成潜变量，每组以前序潜变量为条件。
AI.result: 同 GPU 端到端评测中，相比同等规模 ELF-L 基线，生成 FLOPs 减少 80× 以上，吞吐提升 6× 以上；相比 AR 基线，吞吐提升 6× 以上、延迟降低 4× 以上。局部流畅性与多样性具竞争力，但长程连贯性仍具挑战。
AI.conclusion: 将扩散从 token 级状态迁移到压缩潜序列，可显著提升长序列生成效率，BLD 验证了该方向的可行性。

title: Benchmarking Behavioral Steerability in Behavior Foundation Models
summary: Behavior Foundation Models (BFMs) are emerging as a paradigm for translating human intentions into executable humanoid behaviors. As these models evolve beyond behavior generation toward general-purpose behavioral systems, a fundamental question arises: can they be reliably steered according to user intentions? In this paper, we introduce the concept of behavioral steerability, defined as the ability of BFMs to faithfully generate behaviors that satisfy user-specified intentions. To study this capability, we present RoboSteer, the first benchmark for behavioral steerability in BFMs. RoboSteer organizes behavioral steerability into a three-level hierarchy-Conditional Steering, Constraint Steering, and Compositional Steering-and establishes a unified evaluation framework supported by a large-scale multimodal motion corpus. Using RoboSteer, we conduct the first large-scale empirical study of behavioral steerability across 9 existing BFMs. We view behavioral steerability as more than a capability for controlling motion: it concerns how embodied systems translate human intentions into purposeful actions. We hope RoboSteer will advance research on intention realization as a foundation for general-purpose embodied intelligence.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"行为可操控性"概念并构建首个评测基准RoboSteer，将可操控性划分为条件操控、约束操控与组合操控三级层次，对9个行为基础模型进行了首次大规模实证研究。
AI.motivation: 行为基础模型（BFM）正从单纯的行为生成演化为通用行为系统，但其能否依据用户意图被可靠操控尚缺乏系统研究。为此需要明确"行为可操控性"这一核心能力并建立统一的评估手段。
AI.method: 提出行为可操控性定义，即BFM忠实生成满足用户指定意图行为的能力；构建首个基准RoboSteer，建立三层级体系（条件操控、约束操控、组合操控），搭建统一评估框架，并配套大规模多模态运动语料。
AI.result: 基于RoboSteer对9个现有BFM开展了首次大规模行为可操控性实证研究，覆盖三个层级并给出统一评测结果。
AI.conclusion: 行为可操控性不只是运动控制能力，更关乎具身系统如何将人类意图转化为有目的的行动；RoboSteer有望推动以意图实现为基础的通用具身智能研究。

title: KASALv2: Fully Automatic 3D Rotational Symmetry Classification and Axis Localization
comment: CVPR 2026. 10 pages, 4 figures. Mengxin Zhang and Yulin Wang contributed equally. Corresponding authors: Chen Luo and Yijun Zhou
summary: Rotational symmetry is an important prior in 6D pose estimation, improving pose accuracy and supporting symmetry-aware evaluation. However, current symmetry annotations for 3D objects remain largely manual or semi-automatic, often requiring predefined types or orders, which limits scalability. This work introduces a fully automatic, reference-free framework for symmetry-type classification, rotational-order identification, and full-axis localization across all eight canonical 3D rotational symmetry types. The method localizes a dominant high-order axis, infers its rotational order through self-consistency analysis, and reconstructs the complete symmetry structure under a hierarchy-guided formulation. A texture-aware extension further models appearance-induced reductions in rotational order while preserving axis orientations. Experiments on idealized and real-world datasets demonstrate strong accuracy and generalization, achieving 94.75% accuracy on 438 symmetric objects in GSO. Training FoundationPose with these priors improves accuracy by up to 0.9% across five BOP datasets, showing that automatically estimated rotational priors improve downstream 6D pose estimation. Code is available at https://github.com/WangYuLin-SEU/KASAL.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种全自动、无需参考的框架，可对三维物体的旋转对称性进行分类、识别旋转阶数并定位完整对称轴，覆盖八种标准旋转对称类型，并在理想与真实数据集上验证其精度与泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 旋转对称性是6D位姿估计的重要先验，可提升位姿精度并支持对称性感知评估。但现有三维物体的对称性标注多为人工或半自动，常需预定义类型或阶数，难以扩展。
AI.method: 方法定位主导高阶轴，通过自一致性分析推断其旋转阶数，并在层级引导的公式下重建完整对称结构；另提出纹理感知扩展，在保持轴方向的同时建模外观导致的旋转阶数下降。
AI.result: 在理想与真实数据集上实验显示较强精度与泛化能力，在GSO的438个对称物体上达到94.75%准确率；用这些先验训练FoundationPose，在五个BOP数据集上精度提升最高达0.9%。
AI.conclusion: 自动估计的旋转先验可有效改善下游6D位姿估计，表明该全自动对称性分析框架具备实用价值与推广潜力。

title: How Do Agentic LLMs Decide to Call Tools? A Tool-Call Vector Shaped by Suppression
summary: Tool calling, invoking external tools on demand, is central to agentic LLMs, yet the mechanism that decides whether a model calls a tool or responds directly remains poorly understood. Agentic prompts are long and heavily scaffolded, combining role instructions, tool schemas, format templates, and the user's request across hundreds of tokens, creating a noisy, highly entangled context in which no single controllable variable for mechanistic analysis is obvious. To obtain such a variable, we propose a method that converts complex agentic prompts into minimal contrastive pairs in which a single request verb determines the tool-call decision: replacing an execution-verb (e.g., \textit{write}) with an analysis-verb (e.g., \textit{discuss}) reliably flips the decision, suggesting it is mediated by a compact internal state. We construct 500 such paired prompts across Python, Java, and C++ (300 for mechanistic analysis, 200 held out for evaluation). We trace the decision to a vector, $μ_Δ$, that is both causally necessary and sufficient and generalizes beyond the discovery prompts to native multi-turn $τ^2$-Bench trajectories and verb-free requests. Behavioral ablations show that the scaffold establishes a tool-call prior; Transcoder decomposition then reveals that analysis verbs suppress this prior through features signaling that tool use is unnecessary, whereas execution verbs largely leave it intact. Downstream scaffold-reading attention heads and MLP features read out the resulting state, and the same mechanism recurs across seven models from the Qwen, Mistral, and Granite families. Our code is available at https://github.com/XijieGo/MI4ToolCalling.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将复杂智能体提示词转换为"执行动词 vs 分析动词"最小对比对的方法，从而定位控制工具调用决策的紧凑内部状态，并追踪到因果必要且充分的向量 μ_Δ。
AI.motivation: 工具调用是智能体 LLM 的核心能力，但其"调用工具还是直接回答"的决策机制尚不清楚。智能体提示词冗长、高度脚手架化（角色指令、工具 schema、格式模板、用户请求交织数百 token），上下文噪声大、纠缠严重，缺乏可用于机制分析的可控单一变量。
AI.method: 构造最小对比提示对：仅替换请求动词（执行动词如 write ↔ 分析动词如 discuss）即可稳定翻转工具调用决策。构建 500 对提示（Python/Java/C++ 三语言，300 对用于机制分析，200 对留作评测）。用激活追踪定位决策向量 μ_Δ；通过行为消融、Transcoder 分解、脚手架读取注意力头与 MLP 特征分析机制；并在七个模型（Qwen、Mistral、Granite 家族）上验证复现性。
AI.result: μ_Δ 既具因果必要性又具充分性，且可泛化到原生多轮 τ²-Bench 轨迹与无动词请求。行为消融显示脚手架建立了"工具调用先验"；Transcoder 分解表明分析动词通过"工具使用非必要"特征抑制该先验，执行动词则基本保留该先验；下游脚手架读取注意力头与 MLP 特征读出最终状态；该机制在七个模型中一致复现。
AI.conclusion: 工具调用决策由执行/分析动词介导的紧凑内部状态（向量 μ_Δ）控制，其机制可解释、可泛化并跨模型家族复现，为智能体 LLM 的机制可解释性分析提供了可控实验范式。代码已开源。

title: Benign Overfitting under Heterogeneous Input Fusion
summary: Benign overfitting is extensively studied when learning from a single high-dimensional input, but its behavior under heterogeneous input fusion remains largely unexplored. We study this question for minimum-norm linear interpolation under a heterogeneous Gaussian design, comparing two statistically dependent input blocks with their fusion while holding the underlying population task fixed. For regression, we identify a full-spectrum covariance certificate whose asymptotic status is independent of the cutoff threshold and prove that it is preserved by every positive-semidefinite joint covariance consistent with the two marginals. This protection is sharp, yet it does not extend to all benign regression problems: outside the certified regime, two benign marginals can have a harmful fusion. For one-sparse Gaussian classification, benignity in the regular regime is characterized by the balance between surviving predictive signal and nuisance contamination. Fusion can move these two quantities in opposite directions, and within this model class every marginal-to-joint benign/non-benign pattern is attainable. We further show that the same fused input can have qualitatively different effects on regression and classification. These results establish that benign overfitting under heterogeneous fusion is determined by the joint signal and spectral geometry created by input interaction, rather than by marginal benignity alone.

AI.tldr: 本文研究异质高斯设计下最小范数线性插值的良性过拟合行为，比较两个统计相关输入块及其融合，分别在回归与一稀疏分类中刻画良性过拟合是否随融合保持或破坏。
AI.motivation: 良性过拟合已在单一高维输入下被广泛研究，但在异质输入融合下的行为尚不清楚。核心问题是：两个各自良性的边缘输入，其融合是否仍良性，还是可能产生有害融合。
AI.method: 在固定总体任务的异质高斯设计下，研究最小范数线性插值。对回归，寻找与截断阈值无关的全谱协方差证书，并证明其被所有与两个边缘一致的正半定联合协方差保持；对一稀疏高斯分类，以"幸存预测信号"与"干扰污染"的平衡刻画正则区间内的良性，并构造各类边缘到联合的良性/非良性模式。
AI.result: 回归中获得与截断阈值无关、且被所有兼容联合协方差保持的全谱协方差证书，该保护是尖锐的，但并非覆盖全部良性回归问题，证书区间外两个良性边缘可出现有害融合；一稀疏分类中，融合可使幸存预测信号与干扰污染反向移动，且该模型类内每种边缘到联合的良性/非良性模式均可实现；同一融合输入对回归与分类的影响可定性不同。
AI.conclusion: 异质融合下的良性过拟合由输入交互产生的联合信号与谱几何决定，而非仅由边缘良性决定。

title: Making Task Abstractions Executable: Control-Aware Layout Repair for a Fixed Controller
summary: A task abstraction can specify the intended events while its spatial layout prevents a fixed agent and controller from completing them. Starting from a supplied structured task record, we compile whole-task tracking, clearance, and actuation requirements into auditable affine layout constraints. We repair only declared continuous coordinates, preserving event order, timing, topology, and the controller. A most-violated-row update admits conditional finite-certification and net-displacement bounds; a same-compiler quadratic projection separates the representation from the optimizer. On three researcher-authored task abstractions, both backends certify all three layouts and complete all 300 fresh paired rollouts per backend. A risk-target sweep also exposes fixed event tests that the chosen certificate cannot satisfy through layout edits alone.

AI.tldr: 提出一种将结构化任务记录编译为可审计仿射布局约束的方法，仅修复声明的连续坐标以完成全任务跟踪、间隙与驱动要求，并提供条件有限认证与净位移界。
AI.motivation: 任务抽象可指定预期事件，但其空间布局可能使固定智能体与控制器无法完成任务；需在保持事件顺序、时序、拓扑与控制器不变的前提下修复布局。
AI.method: 从结构化任务记录出发，将全任务跟踪、间隙和驱动要求编译为可审计的仿射布局约束；仅修复声明的连续坐标；采用最违例行更新获得条件有限认证与净位移界；用同一编译器的二次投影分离表示与优化器；在两种后端上验证。
AI.result: 在三个研究者编写的任务抽象上，两种后端均认证全部三个布局，并各完成300次新的配对 rollout；风险目标扫描还暴露了所选证书仅通过布局编辑无法满足的固定事件测试。
AI.conclusion: 该方法能在不改变事件顺序、时序、拓扑与控制器的情况下，通过修复连续坐标编译可审计约束，实现布局修复与认证，并揭示证书与布局编辑的固有限制。

title: WAPR: A Foundation Model for Wide-Angle Refinement in Unseen Object Pose Estimation
comment: Accepted to ECCV 2026. 19 pages, 4 figures. Yulin Wang and Mengting Hu contributed equally. Corresponding author: Chen Luo
summary: Real-world applications require 6D pose estimation to be accurate, fast, and scalable to unseen objects. This paper introduces WAPR, a zero-shot wide-angle pose refinement model that refines candidate poses with rotational deviations up to 90 degrees. With as few as 12 candidate poses per detected object instance, WAPR supports fast inference within 1 s per frame and reaches a pose-estimation throughput of up to 25 detected object instances per second. To support wide-angle training for rotationally symmetric objects, WAPR uses rotational symmetry priors to canonicalize symmetry-equivalent pose targets before loss computation. We further construct SA6D, a large-scale 6D training dataset with such priors. SA6D obtains KASAL-assisted rotational symmetry priors for 944 GSO scans and expands them through geometry and texture augmentation into about 50K augmented object instances and about 2M rendered RGB-D images. In addition, an angle-balanced loss stabilizes learning across different angular ranges by reducing the influence of uninformative large-error cases. Experiments on seven BOP core datasets show that WAPR achieves state-of-the-art performance in unseen-object 6D pose localization and detection under both fast and unconstrained inference settings. Project page: https://github.com/WangYuLin-SEU/WAPR.

AI.tldr: WAPR是一种零样本广角位姿精化模型，支持最大90度旋转偏差的精化，配合SA6D大规模数据集与角度平衡损失，在七个BOP核心数据集上实现未见过物体6D位姿定位与检测的SOTA性能，并保持单帧1秒内的快速推理。
AI.motivation: 现实应用要求6D位姿估计兼具准确性、快速性与对未见过物体的可扩展性，而现有方法在宽角度旋转偏差下精化能力不足，且缺乏带旋转对称先验的大规模训练数据。
AI.method: 提出WAPR零样本广角位姿精化模型，每个检测实例仅需12个候选位姿即可支持宽达90度的旋转偏差；利用旋转对称先验在损失计算前对对称等价位姿目标进行规范化以支持旋转对称物体的广角训练；构建SA6D大规模数据集，基于KASAL辅助获取944个GSO扫描的旋转对称先验，经几何与纹理增强扩展至约5万物件实例与约200万张渲染RGB-D图像；并采用角度平衡损失降低无信息大误差样本影响以稳定跨角度区间学习。
AI.result: 在七个BOP核心数据集上，WAPR在快速与无约束两种推理设置下均于未见过物体的6D位姿定位与检测任务中取得SOTA性能；推理速度上支持单帧1秒内完成，估计吞吐量可达每秒25个检测物体实例。
AI.conclusion: WAPR通过广角精化、对称先验规范化、大规模带先验数据集与角度平衡损失的组合设计，兼顾了精度、速度与可扩展性，为未见过物体的6D位姿估计提供了有效方案。

title: Automatically Building and Updating a Knowledge Graph of MLIP Models
summary: Complementing the many efforts in providing semantic representations of concepts, notions, and entities in materials science, we report and illustrate a process by which we can automatically build a knowledge graph of the fast evolving field of machine learning applied to the prediction of material properties, focusing on MLIP (Machine Learning Interatomic Potential). This LLM-based process relies on multiple steps, from information extraction in documents and articles to a validation loop using SHACL constraints to detect and correct errors. It is carried out on a model-by-model basis, focusing on the consistency of representation, therefore enabling an iterative construction where the addition of new models is facilitated. We illustrate the process by showing a few interesting aspects that can be queried from a knowledge graph built from the models listed in the Matbench Discovery leaderboard.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于LLM的自动化流程，用于为机器学习原子间势（MLIP）领域构建知识图谱，通过信息抽取与SHACL约束校验环实现模型级迭代构建，并在Matbench Discovery榜单数据上验证。
AI.motivation: 材料科学领域已有大量概念、术语与实体的语义表示工作，但机器学习预测材料性质、尤其是MLIP这一快速演进方向，缺乏系统化、可自动构建且保持一致性的知识组织方式。
AI.method: 以LLM为基础的多阶段流程：从论文与文献中抽取信息，再利用SHACL形状约束构建校验闭环以检测并纠正错误；以单个模型为粒度推进，强调表示一致性，从而支持新模型持续迭代纳入。
AI.result: 在由Matbench Discovery排行榜所列模型构建的知识图谱上展示了若干可查询的有趣方面，验证了流程的可行性。
AI.conclusion: 该流程可实现MLIP领域知识图谱的自动化、可迭代构建，兼顾表示一致性，并具备扩展到更多模型与查询场景的潜力。

title: Shared Low-rank Basis Factorization for Data-free Mixture-of-Experts Compression
summary: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) large language models decouple capacity from compute through sparse routing, but their large parameter count creates storage and serving challenges. We analyze three MoE compression families: expert pruning, expert merging, and weight reconstruction, and derive structural error bounds showing that pruning and merging can incur non-vanishing errors tied to routing and expert heterogeneity. In contrast, weight reconstruction avoids these structural costs by preserving expert structure and routing. Motivated by the analysis, we propose Shared Low-rank Basis Factorization (SLBF), a data-free weight reconstruction method that uses rank-$k$ bases shared among experts, enabling richer cross-expert sharing, faster convergence, and lower reconstruction error. A post-hoc gauge fixing removes redundant parameters at no representational cost. Across five MoE architectures spanning 16B to 122B parameters, SLBF consistently outperforms methods from all three compression families.

AI.tldr: 本文分析MoE压缩的三类方法（专家剪枝、专家合并、权重重建），并证明剪枝和合并存在与路由及专家异质性相关的结构性误差，而权重重建可避免此类误差。据此提出免数据权重重建方法SLBF，通过共享低秩基实现跨专家参数共享，并在16B至122B参数的五个MoE架构上一致优于三类基线。
AI.motivation: MoE大模型通过稀疏路由将容量与计算解耦，但参数量巨大，带来存储与部署挑战，因此需要有效的压缩方法。然而，现有压缩方法缺乏对误差来源的结构性分析，尤其是剪枝与合并是否引入不可消除的误差尚不明确。
AI.method: 作者先对三类压缩方法进行理论分析，推导结构性误差界；在此基础上提出共享低秩基分解（SLBF），一种免数据的权重重建方法：让多个专家共享秩-k基以实现更强的跨专家共享、更快收敛和更低重建误差；并通过后验规范固定（gauge fixing）在不损失表达能力的前提下移除冗余参数。
AI.result: 理论分析表明，专家剪枝与合并会因路由和专家异质性产生非消失误差，而权重重建通过保留专家结构和路由避免这些结构性代价。实验上，在参数规模16B至122B的五个MoE架构中，SLBF一致优于三类压缩方法。
AI.conclusion: 权重重建是比剪枝和合并更具结构性优势的MoE压缩路径，SLBF作为免数据、共享低秩基的重建方法，在大规模MoE模型上有效且通用，为MoE压缩提供了理论与实证支撑。

title: Temporal Visuo-Tactile Learning for Dexterous Grasp Stability
summary: Humans can grasp everyday objects with almost perfect success rates using fingertip tactile feedback, yet much of the robotic grasping literature emphasizes vision-based grasp selection with parallel grippers. In this work, we systematically investigate how high-resolution, dynamic tactile sensing contributes to grasp stability prediction and model-guided grasping in dexterous robotic hands. To this end, we collected a dataset of 10,000 grasp trials across 200 objects using a multi-fingered robotic hand equipped with four Digit 360 tactile sensors, recording external vision, proprioception, and tactile streams throughout each grasp. With this dataset, we trained end-to-end temporal multimodal models to predict post-lift stability from pre-lift grasp observations and compared sensing modalities and encoding backbones. Experimental results and controlled input ablations show that incorporating touch, and particularly high-resolution, dynamic touch, improves grasp stability prediction. Finally, we deployed the learned predictor as an online stability gate on the real robot, where visuo-tactile model-guided regrasping improved the success rate among executed lifts by 10.5 percentage points over a non-tactile gate. These results show how rich fingertip sensing and expressive temporal models that capture the dynamics of touch can support learned grasping with multi-fingered hands without explicit contact or force modeling, providing a scalable data-driven path from tactile experience toward stable dexterous manipulation. The dataset is publicly available at https://lasr-lab.github.io/dexterous-grasp-stability/.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究了高分辨率动态触觉传感对多指灵巧手抓取稳定性预测与模型引导抓取的作用，采集了200个物体、10000次抓取试验的多模态数据集，训练时序多模态模型预测提升前抓取的提升后稳定性，并将预测器部署为在线稳定性门控，使执行提升的成功率相比非触觉门控提升10.5个百分点，且无需显式接触或力建模。
AI.motivation: 人类依靠指尖触觉几乎能完美抓取日常物体，但机器人抓取研究多侧重基于视觉的平行夹爪抓取选择，触觉尤其是高分辨率动态触觉在多指灵巧手中的贡献尚缺乏系统性研究。
AI.method: 搭建配备四个Digit 360触觉传感器的多指灵巧手，采集200个物体共10000次抓取试验，同步记录外部视觉、本体感觉与触觉流；训练端到端时序多模态模型，从提升前观测预测提升后稳定性，并比较不同传感模态与编码骨干网络，进行受控输入消融；最后将学习到的预测器作为在线稳定性门控部署到真实机器人上进行视觉-触觉模型引导的重新抓取。
AI.result: 实验与受控消融表明，引入触觉、尤其是高分辨率动态触觉，能提升抓取稳定性预测效果；在线部署中，视觉-触觉模型引导的重新抓取使执行提升的成功率相比非触觉门控提高了10.5个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 丰富的指尖传感与能捕捉触觉动力学的高表达能力时序模型，可在不做显式接触或力建模的情况下支撑多指手的学习式抓取，为从触觉经验走向稳定灵巧操作提供了可扩展的数据驱动路径，数据集已公开。

title: Visual Evidence Under Cross-Examination: Evaluating and Controlling Decision-Level Evidence Use in Vision-Language Models
summary: Vision-language models increasingly reason through crops, regions, and tool-produced observations. Yet an observation can influence the answer without benefiting the candidate it supports. We study candidate-bound visual contribution: valid evidence should help, invalidating its supporting relation should remove its additional effect, and valid rebinding should redirect that effect to the newly supported candidate. We introduce CROSS-Bench, a benchmark of 28,000 decision problems, with matched invalidation and rebinding tests on a dedicated evaluation subset. Our RIVET interface preserves evidence identity and uncertainty, composes a candidate-conditioned response, and separately controls its strength. Shared-evidence experiments show that task accuracy and evidence ownership can diverge. Under matched capacity and training, RIVET increases normalized effect transfer from 0.512 to 0.651 where clean evidence has a positive effect. The advantage persists on common evaluation examples and across repeated decision-layer fits. With evidence predicted from raw inputs, RIVET improves CROSS-Bench accuracy by an average of 5.70 pp across four frozen backbones, relative to the same models without auxiliary evidence. These results separate the utility of visual evidence from the candidate-specific destination of its effect.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"候选绑定视觉贡献"这一衡量标准，并构建 CROSS-Bench 基准（含失效与重绑定测试），通过 RIVET 接口分离视觉证据的效用与其效应的候选归属。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型中，一条观察可能影响答案却并未真正支持其所对应的候选。作者希望区分"证据是否有用"与"证据效应是否落到正确候选上"，以检验证据贡献的候选绑定性质。
AI.method: 定义候选绑定视觉贡献的三项条件：有效证据应有益、失效其支持关系应移除额外效应、有效重绑定应将该效应导向新候选。构建 CROSS-Bench（28,000 决策问题，评估子集含配对的失效与重绑定测试）。提出 RIVET 接口，保留证据身份与不确定性，生成候选条件化响应并单独控制其强度；在相同容量与训练下与基线比较，并测试由原始输入预测证据的情形。
AI.result: 共享证据实验显示任务准确率与证据归属可分离。RIVET 将归一化效应转移从 0.512 提升至 0.651（清洁证据具正效应处），优势在常见评估样本和多次决策层拟合中保持。在四个冻结骨干上用原始输入预测证据时，CROSS-Bench 准确率平均提升 5.70 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 结果将视觉证据的效用与其效应的候选特定去向区分开来，表明仅凭准确率不足以刻画证据的候选绑定贡献，需要如 RIVET 那样显式保留证据身份并控制其作用对象与强度。

title: MeshSIPP: Efficient Lattice Planning in Dynamic Environment
summary: Autonomous navigation in dynamic environments requires computing spatiotemporal trajectories that satisfy non-holonomic motion constraints. When the trajectories of the moving obstacles are predictable or known, a promising approach is to rely on the combination of state lattices constructed from precomputed feasible motion primitives and Safe Interval Path Planning -- a search-based algorithm with strong theoretical guarantees. While this approach yields feasible paths, the rich primitive sets needed for smooth navigation induce a large branching factor, which becomes costly when coupled with time-dependent obstacle intervals. To this end, we present MeshSIPP, an efficient planner that removes the computational bottleneck by exploiting the fact that many primitives sweep the same regions and can therefore be validated together. MeshSIPP propagates primitives as spatial bundles, screens them with lightweight bounding-interval checks, and defers the expensive exact departure-time search until a primitive reaches its terminal state. A time-aware pruning rule additionally discards redundant space-time branches early in the search. We prove that the resulting search is complete and optimal. Extensive experiments over more than 6,000 benchmark instances and real-time ROS~2 simulations show that MeshSIPP achieves up to a 3$\times$ speedup over state-of-the-art spatiotemporal planners.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MeshSIPP，一种高效时空路径规划器，通过将运动基元以空间束方式传播、绑定区间快速筛选并延迟精确出发时间搜索，解决了状态格与安全区间路径规划结合时分支因子过大的问题。
AI.motivation: 动态环境中自主导航需满足非完整运动约束的时空轨迹。当障碍轨迹可预测或已知时，状态格与安全区间路径规划（SIPP）结合具有理论保证，但平滑导航所需的丰富基元集导致分支因子大，与时间相关障碍区间结合后计算代价高昂。
AI.method: MeshSIPP利用许多基元扫过相同区域可一起验证的特性，将基元作为空间束传播，用轻量级绑定区间检查进行筛选，将昂贵的精确出发时间搜索推迟到基元到达终止状态时；并引入时间感知剪枝规则，在搜索早期丢弃冗余时空分支。
AI.result: 在超过6000个基准实例和实时ROS 2仿真中，MeshSIPP相比最先进的时空规划器实现了最高3倍的加速。作者证明了该搜索具有完备性和最优性。
AI.conclusion: MeshSIPP通过空间束传播、区间筛选和延迟出发时间搜索有效消除了计算瓶颈，在保证完备性与最优性的同时显著提升动态环境时空路径规划效率。

title: Multimodal LLMs Can Learn to Read Brain Signals: A Vision--Language Model for Unified Multi-Task EEG Decoding
summary: Learning EEG representations that generalize across cognitive tasks, subjects, and recording conditions remains a key challenge in electroencephalography (EEG) decoding. Recent advances in foundation models have improved EEG decoding performance, yet a fundamental open question remains: how to effectively interface neural signals with these models to enable multi-task learning across datasets. To investigate this question, we introduce BraVista, a visual-language framework that encodes multichannel EEG signals as structured images and enables multi-task learning through instruction-conditioned vision-language models (VLMs). Our approach relies on continued post-training of a general-domain VLM, leveraging its visual and linguistic priors to adapt to neural signals without a separate large-scale EEG-specific pretraining stage. We evaluate BraVista on four datasets spanning sleep staging, emotion recognition, cognitive workload classification, and abnormal EEG detection, showing strong performance across these tasks. Further analyses show that the choice of EEG-to-image representation is critical to performance. Moreover, through controlled perturbations of the EEG signal, we observe a gradual performance degradation under increasing noise, suggesting that the model relies on EEG-relevant information rather than superficial visual patterns. Together, these findings establish structured visual representations as an effective and scalable interface between neural signals and general-domain foundation models for unified multi-task EEG decoding.

AI.tldr: 提出BraVista框架，将多通道EEG信号编码为结构化图像，通过指令条件化的视觉-语言模型（VLM）实现跨数据集多任务EEG解码，无需专门的大规模EEG预训练。
AI.motivation: EEG表征跨认知任务、受试者和记录条件的泛化仍是难题；基础模型虽提升了解码性能，但如何有效将神经信号与基础模型对接、实现跨数据集多任务学习仍是未解问题。
AI.method: 将多通道EEG编码为结构化图像，利用指令条件化VLM进行多任务学习；对通用域VLM进行持续后训练，借助其视觉与语言先验适应神经信号，不设独立的大规模EEG预训练阶段。
AI.result: 在睡眠分期、情绪识别、认知负荷分类、异常EEG检测四个数据集上均表现良好；EEG到图像的表示方式对性能至关重要；随噪声增强性能逐渐下降，表明模型依赖EEG相关信息而非表面视觉模式。
AI.conclusion: 结构化视觉表示为神经信号与通用域基础模型之间提供了有效且可扩展的接口，可实现统一的多任务EEG解码。

title: Energy-Efficient Gait Adaptation via Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning for Quadrupedal Locomotion Across Diverse Terrains
comment: 9 pages. Submitted to IEEE ICRA 2027. Ammar Issa, Anubhav Singh, and Anton Tsaritsin contributed equally
summary: While energy efficiency is a critical objective for legged-robot locomotion control, achieving low energy consumption while maintaining robust performance across different velocity ranges and terrain conditions remains a key challenge. This is particularly true for end-to-end RL policies, where gait generation, motion execution, and energy optimization are tightly coupled, leading to high sensitivity to reward design. In this work, we propose a hierarchical reinforcement learning (HRL) framework that separates a high-frequency policy for stable and robust joint-level motion execution from low-frequency gait adaptation that explicitly minimizes the cost of transport (CoT). The three-stage Isaac-based training procedure enables zero-shot sim-to-real transfer with improved tracking accuracy, robustness, and energy efficiency. The learned hierarchy exhibits automatic speed-dependent gait adaptation, transitioning from pacing at low speeds to trotting at higher speeds. We validate the proposed approach in simulation against representative single-policy and hierarchical locomotion baselines, demonstrating reduced CoT over a broad range of commanded velocities, while maintaining robust locomotion across flat, uneven rough, and inclined terrains. We further demonstrate its practical feasibility through zero-shot deployment on a physical Unitree AlienGo quadruped.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种分层强化学习（HRL）框架，将高频关节级运动执行策略与低频步态自适应策略解耦，后者显式最小化运输成本（CoT），并通过三阶段Isaac训练实现零样本仿真到现实迁移。
AI.motivation: 腿式机器人运动控制中，能效是关键目标，但要在不同速度范围和地形条件下同时实现低能耗与鲁棒性能仍是挑战。端到端RL策略将步态生成、运动执行与能量优化紧耦合，导致对奖励设计高度敏感。
AI.method: 提出分层强化学习框架：高频策略负责稳定鲁棒的关节级运动执行，低频步态自适应策略显式最小化运输成本（CoT）；采用基于Isaac的三阶段训练流程，实现零样本sim-to-real迁移。
AI.result: 学习到的分层结构表现出自动的速度相关步态自适应，低速时踱步（pacing）、高速时小跑（trotting）。仿真中与代表性单策略及分层运动基线对比，在广泛指令速度范围内降低CoT，并在平坦、崎岖不平和倾斜地形上保持鲁棒运动；在Unitree AlienGo四足机器人上完成零样本部署验证。
AI.conclusion: 该HRL框架通过解耦运动执行与步态能量优化，提升了跟踪精度、鲁棒性和能效，并验证了仿真到现实零样本迁移的可行性。

title: Gradient-Based Trajectory Optimisation over Continuous Poses for Sparse-View Cone-Beam CT
summary: Trajectory optimisation for cone-beam computed tomography (CT) determines which information sparse-view scans acquire. Fixed candidate pools prevent off-grid refinement and require new object-specific precomputation for each acquisition manifold. We make every source pose an individual continuous variable and move all poses jointly by gradient ascent on the scanner's kinematic manifold. The objective combines soft-Tuy plane coverage, continuous View Covariance Loss, and an analytic attenuation-aware ray-bundle penalty. The same optimiser handles circular, limited C-arm, two-axis, and freesphere parametrisations. On a Defrise flange, continuous selection recovers laminar defects invisible to a circular orbit, matches discrete swap search on the free sphere at the sparser budget, and leads at the denser one, with the same objective evaluated in every arm. A moderate elevation band already recovers most of the free-sphere gain at the defects, so the same optimiser transfers to bounded scanner envelopes. Photon noise preserves the ordering on the flange and compresses it on a dense fuel nozzle. Sparseprescan planning benefits from matching prescan and planned acquisition manifolds. Selection takes seconds rather than minutes without an object-specific reconstruction basis. Prescan-planned poses were executed on a robot CT bench and reconstructed in a common frame, demonstrating feasibility but no consistent metric gain over uniform band sampling. Continuous pose optimisation incorporates attenuation and scanner constraints directly into sparse-view acquisition design.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种连续轨迹优化方法：将每个CT源位姿视为连续变量，在扫描仪运动流形上联合梯度上升优化，融合软Tuy平面覆盖、连续视角协方差损失与解析衰减感知射线束惩罚，统一支持圆形、C形臂、双轴与自由球面参数化。
AI.motivation: 稀疏视角CT的轨迹优化决定采集哪些信息，但现有方法依赖固定候选池，无法进行离网格细化，且每换一种采集流形都需重新进行对象特定的预计算。作者希望直接纳入衰减与扫描仪约束，实现可迁移、无需对象特定重建基的连续采集设计。
AI.method: 将所有源位姿设为独立连续变量，在扫描仪运动流形上联合梯度上升；目标函数由软Tuy平面覆盖、连续视角协方差损失（View Covariance Loss）和解析衰减感知射线束惩罚组成；同一优化器适配圆形、受限C形臂、双轴和自由球面参数化；与离散交换搜索在各臂使用同一目标函数进行对比。
AI.result: 在Defrise法兰上，连续选择恢复了圆形轨道不可见的层状缺陷；在自由球面上，稀疏预算下与离散交换搜索持平，较密预算下领先；中等仰角带即可恢复自由球面大部分增益，表明可迁移到受限扫描仪包络。光子噪声在法兰上保持排序、在密集燃料喷嘴上压缩差距。预扫描与计划采集流形匹配时规划受益；选择耗时由分钟级降至秒级且无需对象特定重建基；机器人CT平台上执行预扫描规划位姿并统一重建，验证可行性，但相对均匀带采样无一致指标增益。
AI.conclusion: 连续位姿优化可将衰减和扫描仪约束直接融入稀疏视角采集设计，性能优于或持平离散搜索、计算高效且适配受限包络；物理执行可行性已验证，但实际增益尚不稳定。

title: Shared and structured inputs undermine collective random choice by reasoning AI agents
summary: Random selection is widely used in resource allocation and auditing, making reliable implementation essential for AI-agent systems. Behavioural tests across six reasoning models uncovered threshold and divisibility rules used in identifier-based choices. For threshold-following GPT-6 Sol and Gemini 3.8 Flash, single-agent measurements prospectively predicted correlated participation under shared identifiers and biased participation under distinct identifiers with common timestamp bits. Changing dates, formats and identifier labels revealed when these predictions held. Explicit instructions to randomize independently reduced but did not eliminate shared-input correlation. To test implications for oversight, we asked four models to select customer requests randomly for human review. GPT-6 Sol approached the target rate while selecting predictably from identifiers; the others rarely selected requests. All four closely followed supplied random draws. These findings expose collective and audit vulnerabilities that selection rates alone miss, making input-dependent bias, correlation and predictability central targets for agent evaluation.

AI.tldr: 对六种推理模型的行为测试揭示了基于标识符的随机选择中存在的阈值与可整除性规则，这些规则会导致输入依赖的偏差、共享输入下的相关性及可预测性，进而威胁资源分配与审计的公平性。
AI.motivation: 随机选择广泛应用于资源分配与审计，其可靠实现对AI智能体系统至关重要；然而仅凭选择率无法揭示其在共享标识符或共同时间戳下产生的相关性、偏差与可预测性等潜在漏洞。
AI.method: 对六种推理模型开展行为测试，通过改变日期、格式与标识符标签，考察单智能体测量能否前瞻性预测共享标识符下的相关参与以及相异标识符加共同时间戳位下的偏差参与；并让四种模型从客户请求中随机挑选送人工复核，检验其对随机输入的遵循程度及对监督的实际影响。
AI.result: GPT-6 Sol与Gemini 3.8 Flash遵循阈值规则，单智能体测量可前瞻性预测共享标识符下的相关参与和相异标识符加共同时间戳位下的偏差参与；显式要求独立随机化只能减弱而无法消除共享输入的关联。在复核任务中，GPT-6 Sol接近目标选择率但选择仍可从标识符预测，其余模型极少选中请求，但四者均高度遵循给定的随机抽取结果。
AI.conclusion: 这些发现暴露了仅靠选择率无法发现的集体与审计漏洞，说明输入依赖的偏差、相关性及可预测性应成为智能体评估的核心目标。

title: Global Exponential Convergence of Two-Layer Linear Network Training
summary: We prove global exponential (linear) convergence with an explicit rate in the rich scaling for wide two-layer linear networks trained with smooth Polyak-Lojasiewicz predictor losses. Gradient flow in the factors closes exactly in terms of a finite-dimensional Bures flow of the neuron law covariance, in which the predictor dynamics are preconditioned by hidden covariance blocks. Mean-field conservation laws provide uniform spectral lower bounds on the hidden preconditioning blocks when the initial covariance satisfies a spectral support gap condition. This condition encompasses positive definiteness while still allowing for singular initializations. For an initial covariance $Σ_0 = σ^2 \mathrm{Id}$, the loss converges to the global minimum with linear rate at least $4σ^2κ$, where $κ$ is the PL constant. We establish stability of this rate under finite-width sampling, as well as global convergence of factor gradient descent for an explicit stepsize interval depending on smoothness, the initial loss, and conserved spectral margins. Our argument extends layerwise to deep linear ResNets, subject to a residual-path bound. In the case of heavy-ball momentum, training dynamics close instead over positions and velocities in terms of a lifted phase covariance. Linear convergence holds under an explicit condition on the energy and damping, specifying a window of admissible dampings. For two-scale white initializations, this interval is nonempty for sufficiently large position scales, with a fixed initial loss gap and velocity covariance. Numerical experiments illustrate the covariance geometry and compare the predicted and observed rates.

AI.tldr: 论文证明了宽两层线性网络在光滑PL预测损失下梯度流以显式速率全局线性收敛，通过Bures流与守恒律刻画协方差动力学，并扩展至深度线性ResNet与动量情形。
AI.motivation: 研究宽两层线性网络在一般PL型损失下训练动力学的全局收敛速率，刻画协方差几何结构，并给出有限宽度与动量加速下的稳定性条件。
AI.method: 将因子梯度流精确闭合为神经元律协方差的有限维Bures流，预测器动力学由隐藏协方差块预条件；利用均场守恒律在初始协方差满足谱支撑间隙条件时给出预条件块的谱下界；进一步扩展至深度线性ResNet及重球动量（提升相位协方差）。
AI.result: 对Σ0=σ²Id，损失以至少4σ²κ的线性率收敛到全局最优；速率在有限宽度采样下稳定；给出因子梯度下降显式步长区间；动量情形下得到能量与阻尼条件及容许阻尼窗口，两尺度白初始化下窗口非空。
AI.conclusion: 显式收敛速率可由协方差谱与守恒量控制，谱支撑间隙条件涵盖正定与奇异初始化，结果对深层与动量加速具可扩展性，并与数值实验预测一致。

title: Hall Effect-Based Tactile Force Detection Sensor for Robot-Assisted Minimally Invasive Surgery
summary: Robotic minimally invasive surgery has revolutionized surgical practice. However, as the surgeons are mechanically separated from the surgical tools, loss of tactile feedback occurs. We present a compact force sensor with three, millimeter scale sensing elements (taxels) that can be affixed to the grasping face of a robotic surgical tool. The sensor features a miniaturized design using Hall effect sensors and magnets embedded in a deformable elastomer contact layer. Sensor calibration is achieved with a 6 degree of freedom (DoF) parallel robot. Each taxel can detect applied normal and shear forces with average RMSE of 2.133 kPa. The calibrated sensor was validated on phantom and ex vivo porcine tissue, demonstrating tactile sensing during retraction as well as slip. This work introduces a small-scale Hall effect based tactile sensor, enabling sensing for force-sensitive robotic surgical applications.

AI.tldr: 提出一种可贴附于机器人手术器械夹持面的紧凑型三传感单元（taxel）霍尔效应触觉传感器，经6自由度并联机器人标定后可同时检测法向与剪切力，并在体模及离体猪组织上验证了牵拉与滑移感知能力。
AI.motivation: 机器人微创手术虽已革新外科实践，但由于术者与手术器械之间被机械隔离，导致触觉反馈缺失，因此需要为力敏感的手术操作提供微型化触觉感知手段。
AI.method: 设计一种含三个毫米级传感单元（taxel）的紧凑力传感器，可直接贴附于机器人手术工具的夹持面；结构上采用霍尔效应传感器与磁体嵌入可变形弹性体接触层的微型化方案；利用6自由度（DoF）并联机器人完成标定。
AI.result: 每个taxel均可检测施加的法向力与剪切力，平均RMSE为2.133 kPa；标定后的传感器在体模和离体猪组织上完成验证，实现了牵拉过程中的触觉感知以及滑移检测。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提出了一种基于霍尔效应的小尺度触觉传感器，可为力敏感的机器人手术应用提供触觉感知能力。

title: STORK: Spatio-Temporal Observation of uterine contRactions via neural networKs
comment: Accepted at the PIPPI Workshop at MICCAI 2026 and will appear in the workshop proceedings (Springer)
summary: Uterine contractions in fetal MRI are typically identified manually and discarded, limiting insights into contraction dynamics. We formalize Uterine Contractile Activity Detection (UCAD) as a weakly-supervised learning problem and introduce STORK, a multi-instance learning model trained on dynamic MRI series using only coarse, series-level labels. STORK factorizes 3D spatio-temporal convolutions into parallel branches across temporal hyperplanes to capture coherent tissue motion without the cost of full 4D convolutions. Per-frame embeddings, combining intensity and Demons-estimated displacement fields, are aggregated by a linear mean-pooling head. This ensures that frame-level contraction scores can be recovered post-hoc without frame-level training supervision. Evaluated on around 700 multi-vendor dynamic fetal MRI series, STORK achieves a series-level AUROC of 95.0% and AUPRC of 94.6%, substantially outperforming 3D ResNet and ConvNeXt baselines. Grad-CAM analysis suggests that the model draws on predictive features extending beyond the placenta into the uterine tissue, offering an automated tool for richer phenotyping of uterine behavior.

AI.tldr: 本文提出弱监督的子宫收缩活动检测任务（UCAD）与STORK模型，仅用序列级粗标签从动态胎儿MRI中检测子宫收缩，序列级AUROC达95.0%、AUPRC达94.6%。
AI.motivation: 胎儿MRI中的子宫收缩通常靠人工识别并被直接丢弃，导致对收缩动力学的研究受限；同时缺乏帧级标注，难以用常规监督方法训练。
AI.method: 将UCAD形式化为弱监督的多示例学习问题；STORK将3D时空卷积沿时间超平面分解为并行分支以捕捉连贯组织运动，避免完整4D卷积的高计算代价；帧级嵌入融合强度特征与Demons估计的位移场，经线性均值池化头聚合，从而在无帧级监督下事后恢复帧级收缩分数。
AI.result: 在约700例多厂商动态胎儿MRI序列上评估，序列级AUROC为95.0%，AUPRC为94.6%，显著优于3D ResNet与ConvNeXt基线；Grad-CAM分析显示模型依赖的预测特征超出胎盘范围，延伸至子宫组织。
AI.conclusion: STORK为子宫行为提供了自动化、更丰富的表型分析工具，并表明弱监督多示例学习可有效用于动态MRI中的子宫收缩检测。

title: Cost-Efficient Theorem Proving via Agent Orchestration in Program Verification
summary: Program verification establishes software correctness through machine-checkable proofs constructed in theorem provers. It's a guarantee especially valuable for code generated by large language models (LLMs), which is fluent but carries no assurance of correctness. Almost all existing provers, however, pursue pass rates alone at whatever sampling or search budget it takes, and overlook the success-vs-cost frontier; yet real software often carries hundreds of interdependent proof obligations, so what matters at scale is not whether one theorem can be proved, but how many can be proved economically. We introduce CoCo-Prover, which formalizes cost-efficient program proving as metalevel decision-making under cost, grounded on two-level proof graphs: an AND/OR proof hypergraph within each declaration is joined to a lemma-dependency graph across declarations; and at each step, it answers two questions: which open goals to select, and which actions to purchase on these goals. Selection stays symbolic as a topological pass over the proof graphs. Action choice is agent orchestration via metalevel decision-making: an agentic router treats every bounded specialist invocation as a separately priced, best-effort computation, matching heterogeneous specialist agents together with configurations, under evolved routing rules as evidence accumulates. On five program verification benchmarks in Lean 4 including function-level CLEVER, VERINA, and AlgoVeri, and repository-level NTP4VC and Vero, we show that CoCo-Prover achieves a better success-vs-cost frontier than baselines including frontier coding agents and state-of-the-art LLM-based provers: it achieves the best solve rate on every benchmark and up to 100% on two benchmarks. It also reduces cost by up to 30.9% compared to the strongest baseline with the strongest LLM in our evaluation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 CoCo-Prover，将代价高效的程序证明形式化为代价下的元层决策问题，基于双层证明图实现目标选择与动作购买，在 Lean 4 的五个基准上取得更优的成功-代价前沿。
AI.motivation: 现有定理证明器几乎只追求通过率，不惜任何采样或搜索预算，忽视了成功-代价前沿；而真实软件常含数百个相互依赖的证明义务，规模化场景下关键不是单个定理能否证明，而是能以多经济的方式证明多少个。LLM 生成的代码流畅但缺乏正确性保证，程序验证尤为有价值。
AI.method: 将代价高效的程序证明形式化为代价下的元层决策问题，构建双层证明图：声明内的 AND/OR 证明超图与跨声明的引理依赖图相连。每一步回答两个问题：选择哪些开放目标，以及在这些目标上购买哪些动作。目标选择以符号方式对证明图做拓扑遍历；动作选择采用元层决策的智能体编排，智能体路由器将每次有界的专家调用视为单独定价的尽力而为计算，将异构专家智能体与配置匹配，并随证据积累演化路由规则。
AI.result: 在 Lean 4 的五个程序验证基准上验证：函数级 CLEVER、VERINA、AlgoVeri，仓库级 NTP4VC、Vero。CoCo-Prover 相比包括前沿编码智能体和最先进基于 LLM 的证明器在内的基线，取得更优的成功-代价前沿：在每个基准上取得最佳求解率，两个基准上达 100%。在最强 LLM 下，相比最强基线降低成本最高达 30.9%。
AI.conclusion: CoCo-Prover 通过将代价高效证明建模为元层决策，兼顾目标选择与动作购买，在成功率和代价上均优于现有方案，为规模化程序验证提供了更经济的路径。

title: From Retrieval to Customer Context: Evaluating Frontier-Model Systems for Voice-of-Customer Analysis
summary: Organizations increasingly use frontier language models to analyze customer feedback, but answer quality also depends on how that feedback is organized and made available. We define a \emph{customer context graph} as a unified model of customer and business context. Typed relationships connect customer objects (feedback, conversations, users, and accounts), operational objects (tickets, support agents, opportunities, and competitors), and analytical or action objects (taxonomy concepts, evidence, insights, work items, and outcomes). This lets an agent investigate not only what customers say, but why, who is affected, what action followed, who owns it, and whether it was resolved. For this experiment, the graph is populated from public Cursor feedback; the same architecture can support any type of feedback source. We compare Agentic RAG, a Deep Research Agent, and a Customer Context Graph-backed Agent on the same 9,432 public Cursor feedback records using 30 realistic product, incident, comparison, and metadata questions. Without exhaustive ground truth, we jointly score responses on answer quality (coverage and organization), analytical depth (specificity and decomposition), and evidence quality (citation support and traceability), using a comparative rubric calibrated on 28 of the 30 questions. We sample cited records against their claims and weight the three dimensions equally. Under this aligned rubric, the Customer Context Graph-backed Agent scores 0.961 overall, versus 0.710 for the Deep Research Agent and 0.651 for Agentic RAG, and leads the Deep Research Agent on 27 of 30 paired questions (sign-test p < 10^(-5); strictly best on 26 of 30). Its largest advantage is analytical depth (0.967 versus 0.642), reflecting more specific, hierarchically developed findings with quantified themes and traceable evidence...

AI.tldr: 本文提出"客户上下文图"（Customer Context Graph），将客户对象、运营对象与分析/行动对象以类型化关系统一建模，并据此构建图支撑的智能体。在9,432条公开Cursor反馈与30个真实问题上，对比Agentic RAG、Deep Research Agent与图支撑智能体。基于覆盖度、组织性、分析深度与证据可追溯性的校准评分表，图支撑智能体总体得分0.961，显著高于Deep Research Agent的0.710和Agentic RAG的0.651，在30个配对问题中27个领先，优势主要来自分析深度（0.967 vs 0.642）。
AI.motivation: 组织越来越多地用前沿语言模型分析客户反馈，但答案质量不仅取决于模型本身，还取决于反馈如何被组织与调用。现有检索或深度研究式方法缺乏对客户与业务上下文的统一结构化建模，难以回答"客户说了什么、为何说、谁受影响、采取了什么行动、由谁负责、是否已解决"这类多跳问题。
AI.method: 定义客户上下文图：以类型化关系连接客户对象（反馈、对话、用户、账户）、运营对象（工单、客服坐席、商机、竞品）与分析/行动对象（分类概念、证据、洞察、工作项、结果）。实验用公开Cursor反馈填充该图（架构可迁移至其他反馈源）。在相同9,432条记录与30个产品、事故、对比、元数据问题上，对比Agentic RAG、Deep Research Agent与图支撑智能体。无完备真值时，使用在30题中28题上校准的比较型评分表，从答案质量（覆盖度与组织性）、分析深度（具体性与分解性）、证据质量（引用支持与可追溯性）三维度联合打分，对引用记录与其论断进行抽样核对，三维度等权。
AI.result: 在统一评分表下：客户上下文图支撑智能体总体0.961，Deep Research Agent为0.710，Agentic RAG为0.651。图支撑智能体在30个配对问题中27个优于Deep Research Agent（符号检验p < 10^(-5)），其中26个严格最优。其最大优势在分析深度（0.967 vs 0.642），表现为更具体、层级化展开的发现，含量化主题与可追溯证据。
AI.conclusion: 将客户反馈与业务上下文以类型化关系图统一组织，可显著提升智能体问答的答案质量、分析深度与证据可追溯性，优于纯检索增强（Agentic RAG）与深度研究式智能体。该架构与反馈来源解耦，具备跨反馈源的通用性。

title: MultiFly: A Real-World Multimodal Aerial Dataset with Annotation-Efficient Label Transfer and Cross-Modal Semantic Consistency
summary: We introduce MultiFly, a real-world, low-altitude UAV dataset for semantic perception across RGB, thermal, LiDAR, and radar modalities. MultiFly provides 17,272 synchronized samples from four suburban scenes with frame-wise annotations for 15 semantic classes, together with calibration and GNSS-RTK/IMU measurements. To avoid costly and inconsistent modality-specific annotation, we propagate labels from only 115 manually annotated RGB images through shared geometric representations to all four modalities. This approach generates semantic labels for 17,157 additional RGB images, 17,272 thermal images, 840M LiDAR points, and 3.4M radar points. Transferred annotations achieve 89.93% average agreement with held-out manual annotations, and 90.94% average semantic consistency across all six modality pairs. We further establish semantic segmentation benchmarks for all four modalities, revealing distinct architectural behavior for dense LiDAR and sparse radar data. Taken together, MultiFly provides a scalable foundation for multimodal aerial perception and, to the best of our knowledge, the first public real-world low-altitude aerial benchmark that combines consistent frame-wise semantic annotations for RGB, thermal, LiDAR, and radar. Data at https://github.com/markus-42/multifly.

AI.tldr: 提出MultiFly——首个公开真实低空无人机多模态语义感知数据集，涵盖RGB、热成像、LiDAR、雷达四种模态，通过几何标签传播实现一致标注并建立分割基准。
AI.motivation: 低空无人机多模态语义感知缺乏带有跨模态一致帧级语义标注的真实世界公开数据集；逐模态人工标注成本高且不一致。
AI.method: 采集4个郊区场景、17,272个同步样本，含标定与GNSS-RTK/IMU数据，涵盖15类语义；仅人工标注115张RGB图像，借助共享几何表示将标签传播至其余模态（生成17,157张RGB、17,272张热成像、840M LiDAR点、3.4M雷达点）；并对四种模态建立语义分割基准。
AI.result: 迁移标注与留出人工标注平均一致率89.93%，六种模态对平均语义一致性90.94%；四模态分割基准显示稠密LiDAR与稀疏雷达数据呈现不同的架构行为。
AI.conclusion: MultiFly为多模态空中感知提供可扩展基础，是首个融合RGB、热成像、LiDAR与雷达一致帧级语义标注的公开真实低空航空基准。

authors: for the Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging Initiative
title: Identity-Duplication Auditing in National-Scale Neuroimaging Repositories
summary: National-scale magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) repositories increasingly integrate data from different studies and institutions. However, subject identifiers that are valid only within individual datasets are no longer guaranteed to remain globally unique after aggregation, making it possible for the same subject to be assigned multiple identifiers, which we define as identity duplication. Such duplication can create leakage between training and test data and inflate apparent performance in downstream biomedical studies. Existing methods do not provide an end-to-end, image-based workflow for auditing this problem at repository scale. In this work, we present HAPPEN, a human-in-the-loop pipeline for auditing identity duplication in T1-weighted brain MRI repositories. It combines SHA-256 fingerprinting for exact-duplicate detection with supervised contrastive retrieval of non-identical scans that may originate from the same person. Retrieved pairs are reviewed as candidates in a locally hosted interface rather than automatically classified as duplicates.
