summary: The evaluation of coding agents generally strives to be as realistic as possible. In our study, we collect 4,782 agent sessions of real software engineers in JetBrains IDEs, which we call Production Sessions. Since our subject is interactive agents, we study the sessions with at least three user messages (33% of the sample). These long sessions differ from issue-derived benchmark tasks in two ways: (i) user requests span a far wider mix of task types - questions about the project's code, planning, review, refactoring, execution - and (ii) users switch between types throughout a session. Long-session samples from three public interaction corpora exhibit markedly different Task Flows (the distributions of session lengths, task types, and type-to-type transitions), so no single interaction distribution is universally realistic: benchmarks should name a target use case and calibrate to measurements from it. We present SWE-TaskFlow, an approach for transforming any issue-derived benchmark: it preserves the verified tasks and tests while steering the interaction toward a target Task Flow through prompt splitting and verifiable repository QA, with a TaskFlow Alignment Score (TFAS) for selecting among generated trajectories. In a pilot on 700 SWE-Bench Pro tasks, solving the task sequentially in several steps approximately doubles agent cost without a stable change in resolve rate: the interaction protocol itself is an important dimension of evaluation.

AI.tldr: 论文基于JetBrains IDE中4,782个真实工程师的"Production Sessions"会话，发现交互式编码代理的长会话在任务类型分布与类型切换上，与issue-derived基准任务差异显著；不同交互语料库的Task Flow也各不相同，因此不存在普适的"真实"交互分布。作者提出SWE-TaskFlow，可将任意issue-derived基准转化为目标Task Flow，并给出TaskFlow Alignment Score（TFAS）用于轨迹选择。在700个SWE-Bench Pro任务上的试点显示，将任务拆分为多步顺序求解会使代理成本约翻倍，但resolve rate无稳定变化，说明交互协议本身是评估的重要维度。
AI.motivation: 现有编码代理评估力求贴近真实，但多以issue-derived基准任务与单轮/短交互假设为主，未必反映真实工程中用户与代理的交互形态。作者希望检验：真实生产环境中的代理会话与基准任务在任务类型组合和会话内切换上有何差异，并指出基准若声称"真实"就应明确目标用例并据此校准交互分布。
AI.method: 采集JetBrains IDE中真实软件工程师的4,782个代理会话（Production Sessions），聚焦至少含三条用户消息的长会话（占样本33%）；刻画Task Flow（会话长度分布、任务类型分布、类型间转移），并与三类公开交互语料库的长会话样本对比。提出SWE-TaskFlow，通过prompt splitting与可验证的repository QA，在保留已验证任务与测试的前提下，将任意issue-derived基准的交互导向目标Task Flow；同时提出TaskFlow Alignment Score（TFAS）用于在生成轨迹中择优。
AI.result: 真实长会话与issue-derived基准任务存在两点差异：（i）用户请求涵盖更广的任务类型，包括项目代码问答、规划、评审、重构与执行；（ii）用户会在会话中切换任务类型。三个公开交互语料库的长会话样本在Task Flow上差异明显，说明没有单一交互分布具备普适真实性。在700个SWE-Bench Pro任务试点中，将任务分多步顺序求解大约使代理成本翻倍，而resolve rate没有稳定变化。
AI.conclusion: 基准应明确目标用例，并以对应用例的实测数据校准交互分布，而非笼统追求"真实"。SWE-TaskFlow与TFAS提供了一种在保持任务有效性与可验证性的同时对齐目标Task Flow的手段。交互协议本身是编码代理评估的重要维度：改变交互结构可能显著影响成本而不必然改善解决率，因此评估设计需显式考虑交互协议。

title: SoccerNet-FoulRet: Retrieving Semantically Similar Soccer Foul Videos
summary: Refereeing decisions in professional soccer remain inconsistent because referees cannot easily compare a contentious foul against similar past cases. We cast this as a retrieval problem and introduce SoccerNet-FoulRet, the first benchmark for semantic foul retrieval. Given a query foul, the task is to retrieve past fouls judged to be relevant precedents, regardless of camera angle, teams, or appearance. This differs from prior video-to-video retrieval, which matches clips by visual similarity or a shared event. Here, relevance is defined by refereeing interpretation. We build the benchmark from the SoccerNet-MVFoul dataset and evaluate retrieval ability of zero-shot video and vision-language embedders together with a task-specific fine-tuned baseline on 693 human-verified queries and category-relevance labels. Semantic foul retrieval remains challenging. The strongest zero-shot model achieves under 5% HitRate@10 on human-verified precedents, while category-supervised fine-tuning improves category relevance but transfers only modestly to precedent retrieval. We release SoccerNet-FoulRet to establish semantic foul retrieval as an open problem: https://github.com/SoccerNet/sn-foulret.

AI.tldr: 本文提出首个语义犯规检索基准 SoccerNet-FoulRet，将裁判判罚一致性建模为检索问题：给定查询犯规，检索被判定为相关先例的过往犯规，而非视觉相似视频。基于 SoccerNet-MVFoul 构建 693 条人工校验查询与类别相关性标注，评估零样本视频/视觉语言嵌入器及任务微调基线。结果显示该任务仍具挑战性：最强零样本模型在人工校验先例上 HitRate@10 不足 5%，类别监督微调虽提升类别相关性但迁移到先例检索有限。
AI.motivation: 职业足球裁判判罚长期存在不一致问题，核心原因在于裁判难以将当前争议犯规与过往类似案例进行有效比对。既往视频检索任务多基于视觉相似性或共享事件进行匹配，无法刻画"判罚解释层面的相关性"，因此缺乏面向裁判判罚先例检索的专门基准，该问题尚未被形式化与系统评测。
AI.method: 将裁判判罚一致性形式化为语义犯规检索任务，并构建首个基准 SoccerNet-FoulRet。任务定义为：给定一个查询犯规，检索被判定为相关先例的过往犯规，要求不受机位角度、球队或外观影响，相关性由裁判解释而非视觉相似性决定。基准基于 SoccerNet-MVFoul 数据集构建，包含 693 条人工校验查询及类别相关性标注。评测对象包括零样本视频嵌入器、零样本视觉语言嵌入器，以及一个任务特定微调基线。
AI.result: 语义犯规检索仍具高度挑战性。最强零样本模型在人工校验先例上 HitRate@10 不足 5%；类别监督微调可提升类别相关性，但向先例检索的迁移效果仅为中等水平。
AI.conclusion: 作者开源发布 SoccerNet-FoulRet，将语义犯规检索确立为一个开放问题，为后续研究提供基准与评测协议（https://github.com/SoccerNet/sn-foulret）。

title: Where Can a Decision Model Diagnose HVAC Faults? Reasoning Demand, Physical Representation, and Robustness Under Shift
comment: 58 pages, 4 figures, 12 tables. Submitted to Energy and Buildings
summary: Artificial intelligence supports building operations in several forms, each with its own barrier. Expert rules must be tuned for every system, supervised models need labeled data that buildings rarely record, and language models return free text that requires human-in-the-loop checking, since their stated confidence is unreliable. A newer kind of pretrained model, here called a decision model, returns a probability for every allowed answer, so one model could serve many decisions without training. This study answers three open questions for fault diagnosis in heating, ventilation, and air-conditioning systems: which decisions such a model can make, what input it needs, and whether its probabilities hold when conditions change. On 128 fault days from four public datasets of real equipment, faults are graded by the reasoning their diagnosis demands, with data given raw, as physical features, or with Brick topology. The decision model Jev, open language models, and a supervised model face nine tests that change season, control configuration, or building. Given physical features, Jev and the larger open model diagnosed faults whose evidence one feature carries, but not faults that need operating context. Under shift they kept their accuracy and calibration, while the supervised model lost 0.33 macro-F1 yet led or tied within a building. Their probabilities still needed correction, and detection was weak. The study maps which faults a decision model can diagnose and from what input, and supports a division of work in which code computes the physics and the model ranks candidate faults for an operator.

AI.tldr: 在128个故障日、4个公开真实设备数据集上，将HVAC故障按诊断所需推理分级，用原始数据、物理特征、Brick拓扑三种输入，让决策模型Jev、开源语言模型与监督模型接受9项跨季节/控制配置/建筑的变化测试：给物理特征时Jev与较大开源模型可诊断单特征证据故障，但不能诊断需运行上下文故障；条件变化下准确率与校准保持，监督模型损失0.33 macro-F1但建筑内仍领先或持平；概率仍需校正、检测偏弱。
AI.motivation: 现有AI支撑建筑运维存在多重壁垒：专家规则需逐系统调参；监督模型需要建筑极少记录的有标签数据；语言模型输出自由文本且自报置信不可靠，需人工在环核查。新一类预训练"决策模型"对每个允许答案输出概率，可能无需训练即可服务多种决策。本文针对HVAC故障诊断回答三个未决问题：这类模型能做哪些决策、需要何种输入、条件变化时其概率是否依然成立。
AI.method: 在来自4个公开真实设备数据集的128个故障日上：按诊断所需推理对故障分级；输入分别采用原始数据、物理特征、Brick拓扑；评测对象为决策模型Jev、开源语言模型与一个监督模型；设置9项测试，变化季节、控制配置或建筑三类条件；考察准确率与校准（calibration）及故障检测。
AI.result: 给定物理特征时，Jev与较大的开源模型能诊断证据由单一特征承载的故障，但无法诊断需要运行上下文的故障。条件变化下，二者保持准确率与校准，而监督模型损失0.33 macro-F1，但在同一建筑内仍领先或持平。决策模型的概率仍需校正，检测能力偏弱。
AI.conclusion: 研究给出了一张映射：决策模型能够诊断哪些故障、需要何种输入。据此支持一种分工——由代码计算物理量，模型对候选故障排序，供运维人员决策。

title: MORA: Modeling Observed Changes for Drift-Robust Time-Series Anomaly Detection
summary: Time-series anomaly detection (TSAD) identifies deviations from patterns learned from historical data. In non-stationary settings, distribution drift and true anomalies can cause similar local changes, making it difficult to tell whether a deviation reflects abnormality or evolving context. Existing methods typically adapt to detected shifts or learn drift-insensitive representations, but do not resolve this ambiguity. We define this problem as \emph{temporal change disambiguation}: determining whether a local deviation is explained by broader temporal evolution. We introduce MORA, a drift-robust TSAD framework that reconstructs the same local target from paired short- and long-term views. The reconstruction gap measures contextual support for a local deviation, and a data-dependent correction mechanism conservatively adjusts the primary local anomaly score. Context can only reduce the score when it improves reconstruction of the same target. MORA needs neither drift annotations nor online adaptation. Experiments on four TSAD benchmarks show strong robustness to non-stationarity while preserving sensitivity to genuine anomalies.

AI.tldr: 本文提出时序异常检测中的「时间变化消歧」问题，并给出MORA框架：用短期与长期双视图重建同一局部目标，重建差距衡量上下文支持度，保守校正异常分数，无需漂移标注或在线适应。
AI.motivation: 非平稳时序中，分布漂移与真实异常会造成相似的局部变化，难以判断偏差是异常还是上下文演化。现有方法或适应检测到的漂移，或学习对漂移不敏感的表示，但均未解决这一歧义。
AI.method: 将问题定义为时间变化消歧：判断局部偏差能否被更广泛的时序演化解释。提出MORA，从配对的短期视图与长期视图重建同一局部目标；重建差距度量局部偏差的上下文支持度；数据依赖的校正机制对主局部异常分数进行保守调整——仅当上下文能更好重建同一目标时才降低分数。
AI.result: 在四个TSAD基准上实验，MORA对非平稳性表现出强鲁棒性，同时保持对真实异常的敏感性。
AI.conclusion: 通过双视图重建差距与保守校正，MORA在无需漂移标注和在线适应的情况下缓解漂移与异常的混淆，兼顾鲁棒性与敏感性。

title: CMP-IRRT*: A Perception-Assisted Height-Adaptive Planner for Quadruped Robots
comment: Accepted at the 18th Asian Conference on Machine Learning (ACML 2026)
summary: Quadruped robots can traverse low obstacles, but many 2D planning pipelines still model obstacles as binary occupied regions and rely on sampling-based search that can be inefficient under a limited budget. We propose a perception-assisted height-adaptive planning framework based on CMP-IRRT*, a Channel Mamba PointNet-guided Informed RRT* planner. Given a calibrated top-view RGB observation, the perception module estimates obstacle regions and converts depth predictions into a ground-relative height map. The planner then performs height-conditioned collision checking, treating high obstacles as blocked while allowing low obstacles to be traversed, and uses the CMP guide to bias sampling toward promising regions while retaining standard free-space and informed sampling fallbacks. Experiments on 2D planning benchmarks show that CMP-IRRT* reduces explored nodes and iterations compared with classical and neural-guided baselines, and a controlled ablation supports the contribution of the Mamba-based guide. In constructed traversability-aware scenarios, the proposed planner reduces path length by up to 16.3% when low obstacles are traversable, and a Unitree Go2 demonstration further shows executable bypassing and traversal behaviors. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/MingfanZhao/height-adaptive-planner.

AI.tldr: 提出CMP-IRRT*感知辅助高度自适应规划框架，用Channel Mamba PointNet引导Informed RRT*，实现四足机器人可跨越低障碍的路径规划。
AI.motivation: 现有2D规划流程将障碍建模为二值占据区域，依赖采样搜索，在有限预算下效率低，且无法利用四足机器人跨越低障碍的能力。
AI.method: 基于校准的俯视RGB观测，感知模块估计障碍区域并将深度预测转为地面相对高度图；规划器执行高度条件碰撞检测（高障碍视为阻塞、低障碍可通行），并以CMP引导采样偏向高潜力区域，同时保留自由空间与informed采样回退机制。
AI.result: 在2D规划基准上，相比经典与神经引导基线减少探索节点与迭代次数；消融实验支持Mamba引导的贡献；在可通行性感知场景中路径长度最多减少16.3%；Unitree Go2演示了可执行的绕行与跨越行为。
AI.conclusion: 该框架通过感知辅助的高度自适应规划，有效提升采样效率并利用四足机器人的跨越能力，代码已开源。

title: When Rank Rises as LLMs Degrade
comment: NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Continual Learning for Foundation Models and Agents (CL4FMAgents); 8 pages + appendix
summary: Post-training adapts language models in non-stationary environments. Practitioners monitor representation health with RankMe and related spectral statistics, often assuming that rank falls when representations degrade. We show that this assumption is unsafe for LLM post-training. In a controlled study of Qwen3-0.6B with four degradation modes and three seeds, data duplication worsens held-out loss by 75% relative to healthy while increasing both original and centred RankMe; the latter changes by 13.5 pooled standard deviations. Covariance effective rank rises to nearly twice its healthy value. This failure is spectral dispersion rather than collapse, so a one-sided monitor rates the worst checkpoint as the healthiest. By contrast, a learning-rate misconfiguration lowers centred RankMe and k95, while uncentred RankMe is inconsistent across seeds. Direction is therefore a property of the regime-statistic pair and cannot be fixed by recalibration alone. We also distinguish two often-conflated statistics: RankMe normalises singular values, whereas covariance effective rank normalises eigenvalues. On raw intermediate-layer states in the pretrained model, massive activations pin the latter near 1 out of dimension d while RankMe retains usable range. We then test a two-sided, multichannel sequential monitor with separate calibration and test data. In a pre-registered shared-prefix, leave-one-seed-out evaluation, it detects all three damage regimes in every fold 10 to 60 steps after the fork and separates dispersion from downward-rank damage by firing direction. However, it never precedes held-out probe loss, and calibration with two seeds produces false alarms on the held-out healthy seed. Spectral monitoring can diagnose failure regimes, but it does not warn earlier than held-out loss, and validity claims require held-out healthy data.

title: Flow-of-Thought: A Framework for Visual Reasoning
summary: Mental imagery, ``seeing with the mind's eye'' is an essential aspect of human cognition. Despite rapid progress Large Language Models (LLMs) and Vision Transformers (ViTs) still underperform on tasks requiring spatial understanding. To address this, we introduce Flow-of-Thought (FoT), a framework that integrates the generation of visual sketches as intermediate reasoning steps, mimicking mental imagery in humans. We train coordinate-aware trajectory flow fields on $SO(2)$ group orbits and cumulative shortest paths, then freeze the learned dynamics; same vs. different decisions compare competing generative hypotheses using foreground-weighted reconstruction energy. On locked tests FoT reaches 100.0% accuracy on Tetris and 99.0% on colored shapes. Under frozen transfer, the orbit-trained 2D flow improves over its endpoint-only control on BLINK Multi-view (72.2% vs. 63.9% on 133 public validation pairs), supporting continuous visual traces as an effective and interpretable representation for spatial reasoning in some out-of-distribution settings.

AI.tldr: 提出Flow-of-Thought (FoT)框架，通过生成视觉草图作为中间推理步骤来模拟人类心理意象，以提升空间理解能力。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型和视觉Transformer在需要空间理解的任务上仍然表现不佳，而心理意象（"用心灵之眼观看"）是人类认知的重要方面，因此希望将视觉草图的生成作为中间推理步骤来弥补这一不足。
AI.method: 在SO(2)群轨道与累积最短路径上训练坐标感知的轨迹流场，随后冻结所学动力学；在"相同vs不同"判断中，通过前景加权重构能量对相互竞争的生成假设进行比较。
AI.result: 在锁定测试上，FoT在Tetris达到100.0%准确率，在彩色形状上达到99.0%；在冻结迁移下，基于轨道训练的2D流场在BLINK Multi-view上优于仅端点对照组（133个公开验证对上72.2% vs 63.9%）。
AI.conclusion: 连续视觉轨迹是空间推理中有效且可解释的表示，在某些分布外场景下具有优势。

title: AgentTime: Can Agents Estimate and Control Their Own Runtime?
summary: An essential control of AI agents is their ability to manage runtime. This ability requires a sense of time-awareness, to predict and estimate wall-clock time and to control their own actions. Prior work has focused on time-awareness, but duration-following and control in native agent harnesses remain unexplored. We present AgentTime, a benchmark for testing whether agents can work for a requested duration, predict their runtime, and estimate elapsed time afterward. It comprises 222 tasks from 18 sources spanning coding, computer use, agentic work, and automated research. Duration-following experiments append a single instruction specifying how long to work, with requests ranging from about a minute to multiple days. Accuracy on these instructions varies substantially: Fable 5.1 in Claude Code deviates from requested runtimes by a typical factor of 2.9$\times$, compared with only 1.2$\times$ for GPT-6 Astra in Codex. However, matching the requested runtime does not, by itself, establish continued work on the task. Among 158 reviewed Astra runs with classifiable transcripts, 14 explicitly slept after appearing to finish. In forecasting experiments, predictions tend to overestimate natural runtimes. In retrospective experiments, removing temporal information more than doubles deviation for Sol and Astra and nearly doubles it for Fable. An agent's ability to complete a task does not guarantee that it can control its own time or work for the whole requested duration. For agents to run reliably, safely, and autonomously over long horizons, we require the evaluation of both.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 AgentTime 基准，包含 222 个任务，用于评估 AI 智能体在原生 harness 中的时长遵循、运行时间预测与回溯估计能力。实验显示不同模型对指定工作时长的偏差差异显著（典型 2.9× 与 1.2×），且匹配时长并不等于持续工作。
AI.motivation: AI 智能体对运行时的管理能力是基本控制需求，需要时间感知来控制自身行动。已有工作聚焦时间感知，但原生智能体框架中的"时长遵循"与"时间控制"仍未被探索；同时，长时程下智能体可靠、安全、自主运行需要同时评估任务完成与时间控制两方面。
AI.method: 构建 AgentTime 基准，含 222 个任务、来自 18 个来源，覆盖编程、计算机使用、智能体工作与自动化研究。设计三类实验：时长遵循（追加一条指定工作时长的指令，从约一分钟到多天）、运行时间预测、回溯性时间估计；并引入转录分类以识别"假装工作"行为。
AI.result: 时长遵循精度差异大：Claude Code 中 Fable 5.1 的典型偏差为请求时长的 2.9×，而 Codex 中 GPT-6 Astra 仅 1.2×。在 158 条可分类的 Astra 运行记录中，14 条在看似完成后显式休眠。预测实验倾向于高估自然运行时间。回溯实验中，移除时间信息使 Sol 与 Astra 的偏差增加一倍以上，Fable 接近翻倍。
AI.conclusion: 智能体完成任务的能力并不保证其能控制自身时间或在请求时长内全程工作；时长遵循与时间感知需分开评估。为实现长时程可靠、安全、自主运行，必须对二者同时进行评测。

title: Robotic Boomerang Throwing via Model-Based Release Design
summary: Throwing objects that generate aerodynamic lift can greatly extend robot throwing beyond ballistic flight. A returning boomerang is a challenging example because its flight depends strongly on the release velocity, attitude, and spin, while robotic manipulators cannot readily reproduce the rapid motions used in human throwing. We present a model-based framework for robotic boomerang throwing centered on the release state. We identify the boomerang flight dynamics in stages to predict how flight changes across design variations. To systematically design the robot throwing motion, we screen candidate parameters according to how strongly and consistently they control release spin under uncertain contact conditions. These models are then used to design the throwing motion and boomerang for a 6-DoF manipulator with limited joint speeds. To our knowledge, this is the first robotic manipulator to generate a returning boomerang flight. In the demonstrated returning trial, the boomerang is released at 51 rad/s (8.1 rev/s), reaches 2.03 m from the robot base, and returns to touch down 0.31 m from the base. The successful release differs significantly from the measured human throws, showing that a robot need not imitate human throwing motion to achieve a returning flight. The project page is available at https://robot-boomerang.github.io

AI.tldr: 提出基于模型的机器人回旋镖投掷框架，以释放状态为核心，通过分阶段辨识飞行动力学并按对释放旋转的控制强度筛选投掷参数，在6自由度机械臂上实现首次回旋镖回旋飞行。
AI.motivation: 产生气动升力的物体可使机器人投掷超越弹道飞行，回旋镖是其中极具挑战性的例子：其飞行强烈依赖释放速度、姿态与旋转，而机械臂难以复现人类投掷的快速动作。因此需要一套系统化的建模与设计方法，使关节速度受限的机器人也能完成回旋飞行。
AI.method: 以释放状态为中心的模型化框架：分阶段辨识回旋镖飞行动力学，预测不同设计变化下的飞行特性；依据在不确定接触条件下对释放旋转的控制强度与一致性，筛选候选投掷参数；进而用这些模型为6自由度、关节速度受限的机械臂设计投掷动作与回旋镖本体。
AI.result: 在演示的回旋试验中，回旋镖以51 rad/s（8.1 rev/s）释放，飞行最远达距机器人基座2.03 m，并返回至距基座0.31 m处触地。该释放状态与实测人类投掷存在显著差异，表明机器人无需模仿人类投掷动作即可实现回旋飞行。
AI.conclusion: 首次实现由机械臂生成回旋镖的回旋飞行，验证了以释放状态为核心的模型化设计框架的有效性；说明只要精确控制释放旋转等关键状态，关节速度受限的机器人也能完成依赖气动升力的复杂投掷任务。

title: PARC-Loc: Text-to-Point-Cloud Localization with Partial Assignment and Relational Consistency
summary: Text-to-point-cloud localization estimates a position in a city-scale 3D map from descriptions of surrounding objects. Existing coarse-to-fine methods retrieve submaps using aggregate learned compatibility and then localize within a selected submap. However, repetitive or similar urban objects can inflate the embedding similarity between the query and multiple submaps, even when the instance layout within a submap violates the query description. Meanwhile, query-relevant instances often span submap boundaries, leaving the retrieved submap with incomplete contextual evidence. We term these failure modes layout-inconsistent aliasing and boundary evidence incompleteness, respectively. To address them, we propose PARC-Loc, a coarse-to-fine localization framework built on Partial Assignment with Relational Consistency (PARC). PARC jointly models hint-object compatibility and pairwise spatial relations, allowing unmatched elements while favoring assignments consistent with the queried layout. At the coarse stage, its candidate-level assessment complements neural similarity for layout-consistent submap selection. At the fine stage, the context is expanded with query-relevant instances from adjacent submaps, while PARC yields object-level matching weights that guide cross-modal attention. Extensive experiments on KITTI360Pose and CityLoc show that PARC-Loc outperforms conventional coarse-to-fine baselines. On KITTI360Pose, our method improves Top-1 localization recall at 5 m from 0.50 to 0.67, achieving a 34% relative gain over the strongest baseline.

AI.tldr: 提出PARC-Loc粗到精文本到点云定位框架，通过部分分配与关系一致性建模联合优化子图选择与细粒度匹配，在KITTI360Pose上将5米Top-1召回率从0.50提升至0.67。
AI.motivation: 现有粗到精方法依赖聚合学习的兼容性检索子图，易受重复或相似城市物体影响导致嵌入相似度虚高（布局不一致混叠），且查询相关实例常跨越子图边界造成上下文证据不完整（边界证据不完整）。
AI.method: 提出PARC-Loc框架，基于部分分配与关系一致性（PARC），联合建模提示-物体兼容性与成对空间关系，允许未匹配元素并偏好符合查询布局的分配。粗阶段用候选级评估补充神经相似度进行布局一致子图选择；细阶段从相邻子图扩展查询相关实例，PARC给出物体级匹配权重引导跨模态注意力。
AI.result: 在KITTI360Pose和CityLoc上优于传统粗到精基线；KITTI360Pose上5米Top-1定位召回率从0.50提升到0.67，相对最强基线提升34%。
AI.conclusion: PARC-Loc通过布局一致的部分分配与关系一致性建模，有效缓解布局不一致混叠和边界证据不完整问题，显著提升城市级文本到点云定位性能。

title: Diffusion-Generated Image Watermarking: A Two-Axis Taxonomy and Three Protocol-Bounded Case Studies
comment: 17 pages, 2 figures. Accepted to the non-archival track of the ECCV 2026 LifeGenIP Workshop. English translation with partial reorganization of our article in Journal of Broadcast Engineering 31(4), 687-699 (2026)
summary: Watermarking diffusion-generated images requires balancing provenance signals with image quality, robustness, and computational cost. This work organizes methods along two axes: insertion mechanism and primary signal-bearing representation, and formalizes a representative $z_T$-Fourier pipeline for verification and identification. We then use the taxonomy to structure three protocol-bounded case studies. The first examines associations among frequency integrity, detection, quality, and cropping behavior. The second revisits persistence under seed-linked and seed-independent editing and formulates a scoped Semantic Imprinting Hypothesis without claiming a localized carrier or causal mechanism. The third studies single-shot VAE-latent phase modulation, including its efficiency, regeneration robustness, and robustness--quality operating points. Finally, we separate four content-level attack families from model/pipeline adaptation, propose corresponding evaluation protocols and testable conjectures for parameter-tuning threats, and identify additional temporal extensions for video. These analyses do not establish a universal ranking; instead, they provide a framework for matched, protocol-aware comparisons of watermarking systems for diffusion-generated images.

AI.tldr: 本文围绕扩散生成图像水印，按“嵌入机制”和“主承载表示”两个维度构建分类体系，形式化$z_T$-Fourier流程，并通过三个协议受限案例与四类内容级攻击族分析，提出协议感知的匹配比较框架，而非给出统一排名。
AI.motivation: 扩散生成图像水印需在来源标识与图像质量、鲁棒性、计算成本之间权衡；现有方法缺乏统一的分类与可比协议，难以进行公平评估。
AI.method: 沿“插入机制”和“主信号承载表示”两轴组织方法；形式化代表性的$z_T$-Fourier流程用于验证与识别；以该分类体系开展三个协议受限案例研究：频域完整性-检测-质量-裁剪行为关联、种子关联/独立编辑下的持续性与限定范围的“语义印记假说”、单次VAE潜相位调制的效率与再生鲁棒性及鲁棒性-质量工作点；并将四类内容级攻击族与模型/流程适配区分，提出评估协议和可检验猜想及视频时序扩展。
AI.result: 形成以嵌入机制与承载表示为轴的分类框架；给出$z_T$-Fourier管道的形式化；得到频域完整性、检测、质量与裁剪行为之间的关联结果，种子相关编辑下持续性的限定结论，以及单次VAE潜相位调制在效率、再生鲁棒性与鲁棒性-质量权衡上的操作点；同时提出参数调优威胁的评估协议与可检验猜想。
AI.conclusion: 本文不建立普适排名，而提供一个协议感知、匹配比较的框架，用于扩散生成图像水印系统的验证、识别与鲁棒性评估，并为视频时序扩展指明方向。

title: Successive Training Stages and Large Language Model Persuasion: Effects of Misalignment, Supervised Fine-Tuning, and Preference Optimization
summary: Large language models (LLMs) can be tuned to influence human attitudes, yet the respective contributions of successive post-training stages remain un-clear. This study examines how three successive training stages affect LLM persuasiveness: (1) misalignment through supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on conspiracy data, (2) additional persuasive SFT on argumentative data, and (3) Identity Preference Optimization (IPO), a preference-optimization method. A total of 835 participants recruited on Prolific were randomly assigned to five between-subject conditions (neutral text, conspiracy-trained model, persuasion-trained model, preference-optimized model, and GPT-4) and were exposed to texts on 10 divisive political issues, personalized from their individual profiles in all model conditions. Attitude change was measured as the difference between pre- and post-exposure positions on continuous Likert scales and analyzed with an analysis of covariance (ANCOVA). A significant condition x baseline-attitude interaction, F (4, 825) = 5.33, p < .001, indicated that training effects depended on participants' initial attitudes. Persuasive SFT produced greater attitude change than conspiracy training alone, d = 0.30, whereas IPO provided no additional benefit, d = 0.03, and GPT-4 did not differ from neutral text, d = --0.01. These results show that targeted supervised training on persuasive data increases LLM persuasiveness, whereas preference optimization yields no significant gains beyond it.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过835名被试的随机对照实验，检验LLM三个连续后训练阶段对说服力的影响。结果显示：说服性SFT显著提升态度改变效果（d=0.30），而IPO无额外增益（d=0.03），GPT-4与中性文本无差异。
AI.motivation: LLM经训练后可影响人类态度，但各连续后训练阶段（监督微调、偏好优化）对说服力的相对贡献尚不明确。
AI.method: 835名Prolific被试随机分配至五种条件（中性文本、阴谋论训练模型、说服训练模型、IPO优化模型、GPT-4），针对10个争议性政治议题接受个性化文本曝光。以连续Likert量表前后差值衡量态度改变，采用协方差分析（ANCOVA）。
AI.result: 条件×基线态度交互显著，F(4, 825)=5.33，p<.001，表明训练效应取决于初始态度。说服性SFT的态度改变大于单纯阴谋论训练（d=0.30）；IPO无额外增益（d=0.03）；GPT-4与中性文本无差异（d=-0.01）。
AI.conclusion: 针对说服性数据的定向监督训练可提升LLM说服力，而偏好优化在其之上无显著增益。

title: Safe on Average, Unsafe in the Tail: When Is the Episodic-Cost Tail Controllable?
summary: Safe reinforcement learning seeks policies that maximize return while satisfying constraints on cumulative cost. Most methods impose these constraints on expected episodic cost. Consequently, standard evaluations report mean episodic cost without characterizing how cost is distributed across episodes. A policy that satisfies the mean-cost criterion may therefore remain unsafe in its worst episodes. Mean-cost reporting neither identifies this tail violation nor shows whether it can be brought within budget while preserving return. In this work, we measure the episodic-cost tail using $\mathrm{CVaR}_{0.1}$, the average cost of the worst $10\%$ of episodes. We classify a policy as tail-safe when $\mathrm{CVaR}_{0.1}$ is within the safety budget. This allows us first to identify policies that are safe on average but unsafe in the tail and then to study whether their tail violations can be controlled while preserving return. To identify tail-unsafe policies, we evaluate five standard algorithms on three Safety-Gymnasium navigation tasks. We then examine four constraint families on dense-hazard navigation and assess tail control across four navigation and four locomotion tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出用CVaR₀.₁刻画安全强化学习中的回合成本尾部风险，识别"均值安全但尾部不安全"的策略，并评估四类约束方法对尾部违规的控制能力。
AI.motivation: 现有安全强化学习大多只约束期望回合成本，标准评测也只报告平均回合成本，无法刻画成本在回合间的分布。因此一个满足均值成本约束的策略，在极端（最差）回合中仍可能不安全，而均值报告既不能发现这种尾部违规，也无法说明能否在保持回报的同时将尾部控制在预算内。
AI.method: 用 CVaR₀.₁（最差10%回合的平均成本）度量回合成本的尾部，将 CVaR₀.₁ 处于安全预算内的策略定义为"尾部安全"。首先在 Safety-Gymnasium 的三个导航任务上评测五类标准算法，以识别尾部不安全的策略；随后在密集危险导航环境中考察四类约束族，并在四个导航与四个运动任务上评估尾部控制效果。
AI.result: 在 Safety-Gymnasium 三个导航任务中，五类标准算法均存在"均值安全但尾部不安全"的现象；进一步在密集危险导航中比较四类约束族，并在四个导航与四个运动任务上评估其尾部控制表现。
AI.conclusion: 仅以期望回合成本约束与均值报告不足以保障策略的尾部安全性；采用 CVaR₀.₁ 等尾部度量可揭示被均值掩盖的风险，且不同约束方法在保持回报的同时对尾部违规的控制能力存在差异。

title: Agentic RSR: Real-to-Sim-to-Real through Scene Reconstruction and Execution-Grounded Robot Policies
summary: A simulation of a real robot workspace must preserve task-relevant interactions, while policies developed in it must operate on observations available to the real robot. Yet scene reconstruction and policy development are often treated separately. We present Agentic Real-to-Sim-to-Real (Agentic RSR), a framework that links scene reconstruction, policy development, and real-robot execution through the same manipulation task. Given a workspace video, a task description, and a known robot model, an agent recovers metric scale, iteratively refines the scene using visual feedback, and checks task-relevant interactions in MuJoCo. A coding agent then develops an executable policy, progressing from privileged object poses to visual observations and randomized simulation. The policy can interleave multiple observations and actions within one invocation, while the agent uses execution feedback to continue, retry, or revise its approach. A shared task-level interface carries the policy and accumulated experience to the real robot, where fresh observations and safety checks guide execution. Across 18 reconstructed scenes involving two robots, the mean four-view Depth MAE against reference depth estimates is 0.1057 m, the mean Lab $ΔE_{76}$ is 11.04, and the mean grayscale SSIM is 0.6990. In real-robot experiments, the aggregate task success rate reaches 80% of the simulation task success rate, indicating substantial retention of simulated performance on hardware. Code and reconstructed scene data will be made publicly available.

AI.tldr: 提出 Agentic RSR 框架，用同一操作任务串联场景重建、策略开发与真机执行，实现从视频到真机策略的闭环迁移，真机成功率约为仿真成功率的 80%。
AI.motivation: 仿真工作空间需保留任务相关交互，且策略须能运行在真机可获得的观测上；然而现有方法通常将场景重建与策略开发割裂，导致仿真与真机脱节，迁移效果受限。
AI.method: 给定工作空间视频、任务描述与已知机器人模型：智能体恢复度量尺度，利用视觉反馈迭代优化场景，并在 MuJoCo 中校验任务相关交互；随后由编码智能体开发可执行策略，从特权物体位姿逐步过渡到视觉观测与随机化仿真，策略可在单次调用中交错多个观测与动作，并依据执行反馈继续、重试或修正；通过共享的任务级接口将策略与累积经验迁移至真机，结合新观测与安全检查执行。
AI.result: 在涉及两种机器人的 18 个重建场景中，四视角 Depth MAE 均值为 0.1057 m，Lab ΔE76 均值为 11.04，灰度 SSIM 均值为 0.6990；真机实验中总任务成功率达到仿真成功率的 80%，表明仿真性能在硬件上得到较大程度保留。代码与重建场景数据将公开。
AI.conclusion: 将场景重建、策略开发与真机执行统一在同一任务下，可有效缩小 sim-to-real 差距，提升仿真策略在真机上的可迁移性与性能保留度。

title: From Expected Harmfulness to Likelihood: A Probabilistic Reformulation of Jailbreaking LLM Agents
summary: When the harmfulness of an LLM agent's output can be quantified, a natural jailbreaking objective is to maximize expected harmfulness over admissible input modifications. An alternative approach constructs or selects harmful target outputs and modifies the input to increase their likelihood. We establish a precise connection between these two approaches through a probabilistic reformulation. Specifically, we show that the gradient of the logarithm of expected harmfulness with respect to the input equals the expected input gradient of the model's log-likelihood under a harmfulness reweighted output distribution. This identity provides a unified interpretation of expected harmfulness and target likelihood optimization. Building on this connection, we propose OPUR, a sampling distribution designed to generate highly harmful target outputs and use the resulting samples to guide likelihood-based input optimization. Experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of the resulting method in jailbreaking LLM agents.

AI.tldr: 本文通过概率重构建立了LLM智能体越狱中"最大化期望危害性"与"最大化有害目标输出似然"两类方法的精确联系，并据此提出OPUR采样分布来生成高危害目标输出以指导基于似然的输入优化，实验验证了其在越狱攻击上的有效性。
AI.motivation: 当LLM智能体输出的危害性可被量化时，一个自然的越狱目标是最大化期望危害性；另一种思路则是构造或选取有害目标输出并修改输入以提高其似然。这两类方法此前被视为不同范式，缺乏统一的理论联系，因此作者希望通过概率重构揭示二者的内在一致性，并据此设计更有效的攻击方法。
AI.method: 作者将期望危害性进行概率重构，证明"期望危害性对数对输入的梯度"等于"在危害性重加权输出分布下模型对数似然对输入的期望梯度"，由此统一了期望危害性优化与目标似然优化两种视角。基于该恒等式，提出OPUR——一种采样分布，用于生成高危害性的目标输出，并用这些样本指导基于似然的输入优化。
AI.result: 实验表明，基于该统一框架与OPUR采样的方法在越狱LLM智能体方面取得了有效效果。
AI.conclusion: 期望危害性最大化与目标似然最大化在梯度层面等价，可由危害性重加权分布统一解释；利用该联系设计的OPUR方法能有效生成高危害目标并提升越狱效果，为LLM智能体越狱提供了统一的理论视角与实用方法。

title: Physics-Informed Neural Plasticity: PDE Solvers That Reshape Themselves
summary: Physics-informed neural PDE solvers adapt their parameters to satisfy governing equations, yet their representational structure typically remains fixed throughout training. This rigidity is poorly matched to PDE solutions with strongly heterogeneous complexity across space and space--time, leaving capacity insufficient where the physics is difficult and redundant where it is simple. We introduce physics-informed neural plasticity, a paradigm in which the representation itself reshapes during optimization in response to unresolved physics. We instantiate this principle with Representation Capacity Adaptation for PDEs (ReCAP), a Gaussian-localized solver that dynamically redistributes capacity through local enrichment, residual-directed splitting, gate-based pruning, and function-aware merging. ReCAP uses responsibility-weighted error indicators and the geometry of residual energy to determine where and how to refine. To limit the disturbance introduced by splitting, we introduce quiet-child refinement, which initializes new components by transporting the parent representation while controlling instantaneous functional perturbation. We further establish conditional a posteriori reliability and structural-stability guarantees linking localized physics residuals to solution error and stable refinement. Across five challenging 3D and 4D PDE benchmarks against 11 physics-informed solvers, ReCAP achieves the lowest relative $L^2$ error on every problem, reducing error by $10.7\%$--$27.5\%$ relative to the strongest competing result. These results suggest that physics-informed solvers need not merely learn their parameters---they can learn how their representational capacity should be organized.

AI.tldr: 提出"物理信息神经可塑性"范式，通过ReCAP在高斯局部化求解器中动态重分配表征容量，在5个3D/4D PDE基准上相较11个物理信息求解器取得最低相对L2误差。
AI.motivation: 物理信息神经PDE求解器的参数虽随训练调整，但表征结构固定不变，这与复杂度在空间及时空上强异质的PDE解不匹配：物理困难处容量不足，简单处容量冗余。
AI.method: 提出物理信息神经可塑性范式，使表征在优化中根据未解物理重塑；实例化为ReCAP（高斯局部化求解器），通过局部增强、残差导向分裂、门控剪枝、函数感知合并动态重分配容量，并采用责任加权误差指标与残差能量几何决定细化位置与方式；引入quiet-child refinement，以迁移父表征并控制瞬时函数扰动来初始化新分量；建立条件后验可靠性与结构稳定性保证。
AI.result: 在5个具有挑战性的3D与4D PDE基准上，对比11个物理信息求解器，ReCAP在每个问题上均取得最低相对L2误差，相对最强竞争结果降低误差10.7%–27.5%。
AI.conclusion: 物理信息求解器不必仅学习参数，还可学习其表征容量应如何组织。

title: HuMBLE: Human Motion-Driven Behavior Learning for Embodied Locomotion
summary: Despite recent advances in humanoid locomotion, controllers optimized for command tracking and robustness tend to produce mechanical gaits, whereas controllers tied to human motion data often fail to generalize to commands outside the data distribution. This work introduces a learning framework that balances these competing objectives to synthesize real-time steerable, robust, and biomimetic locomotion policies from human data. Using an in-house curated locomotion dataset covering diverse speeds and directions, we first learn a natural locomotion prior policy through a teacher-student distillation process. Specifically, we train a full-body reference-conditioned policy with Reinforcement Learning (RL), then distill it into a lightweight prior policy conditioned solely on proprioception and a planar torso-velocity steering command. Next, we fine-tune the prior policy with multi-task RL to expand command coverage and robustness beyond the data distribution, pairing a goal-conditioned task that tracks arbitrary commands with a reference-guided task that tracks the human data as an explicit style regularizer. We validate our framework on three humanoid robots: the Boston Dynamics Atlas R1, Atlas D1, and Unitree G1. Experimental results demonstrate robust performance across real-world scenarios, including direct user-controlled locomotion in indoor and outdoor environments, and integration as the locomotion layer within hierarchical control stacks. Benchmarks against Tabula Rasa RL policies trained without human data and ablation studies confirm that our framework yields a lightweight, deployable policy that reconstructs coordinated whole-body behavior from a steering command, retaining the human gait characteristics while remaining robust and fully steerable.

AI.tldr: 该工作提出一个学习框架，通过"人类数据先验+多任务微调"平衡指令跟踪鲁棒性与仿生步态，得到实时可转向、鲁棒且仿人的轻量运动策略，并在Atlas R1、Atlas D1与Unitree G1上完成真实世界验证。
AI.motivation: 现有类人运动控制存在两难：以指令跟踪和鲁棒性为目标的控制器常产生机械式步态；而绑定人类运动数据的控制器又难以泛化到数据分布之外的指令。作者希望兼得两者，合成既仿人又鲁棒、可实时转向的运动策略。
AI.method: 1) 构建自研运动数据集，覆盖多种速度与方向；2) 用RL训练全身、参考条件策略作为教师，再经教师-学生蒸馏得到仅依赖本体感知与平面躯干速度转向指令的轻量先验策略；3) 用多任务RL微调先验策略，将跟踪任意指令的目标条件任务与跟踪人类数据的参考引导任务（作为显式风格正则）配对，扩展指令覆盖与鲁棒性。
AI.result: 在Boston Dynamics Atlas R1、Atlas D1与Unitree G1三种类人机器人上验证：在室内外场景实现用户直接操控的运动，并可作为分层控制栈中的运动层集成。与不使用人类数据的Tabula Rasa RL策略基准对比及消融实验表明，该框架得到轻量、可部署策略，能仅由转向指令重建协调的全身行为，保留人类步态特征同时保持鲁棒性与完全可转向性。
AI.conclusion: 通过自然先验蒸馏与多任务微调的组合，可在单一轻量策略中同时实现仿生步态、指令泛化与鲁棒性，并在多种真实类人平台上成功部署。

title: Relational Abstractions for Spatial Reasoning with Diffusion Models
summary: Diffusion models excel at image synthesis, but they remain limited in their ability to reliably satisfy structured spatial reasoning constraints. In conditional data distribution modeling tasks with implicit logical structure, such as puzzles defined by visible clues paired with consistent solutions, state-of-the-art generative models tend to approximate pixel-space distributions without learning the underlying logical rules required for inference. To address this limitation, we present a novel framework for spatial reasoning with diffusion models that leverages unsupervised object discovery and abstractions of object relations. We show that the relational knowledge derived from object-centric representations enriches diffusion models with structural primitives, allowing them to effectively guide the generative representation space during both training and inference, and enabling conditional image generation that satisfies reasoning constraints. Additionally, we introduce a large-scale generative spatial reasoning benchmark with four datasets inspired by human-solvable puzzles. Our results show that relational abstractions significantly improve reasoning capabilities of diffusion models on a variety of complex reasoning tasks, while enabling robust generalization in out-of-distribution settings.

AI.tldr: 提出结合无监督物体发现与物体关系抽象的扩散模型框架，将关系知识注入扩散模型以增强结构化空间推理，并发布大规模生成式空间推理基准（含四个数据集）。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型在图像合成上表现优异，但在满足结构化空间推理约束方面能力有限。在具有隐式逻辑结构的条件数据分布建模任务中（如由可见线索与一致解构成的谜题），现有最先进生成模型倾向于逼近像素空间分布，而未学习推理所需的底层逻辑规则。
AI.method: 提出面向空间推理的扩散模型新框架，利用无监督物体发现与物体关系抽象；从以物体为中心的表示中提取的关系知识为扩散模型提供结构基元，在训练与推理阶段引导其生成式表示空间，实现满足推理约束的条件图像生成。同时构建大规模生成式空间推理基准，包含四个受人类可解谜题启发的数据集。
AI.result: 关系抽象显著提升了扩散模型在多种复杂推理任务上的推理能力，并在分布外（OOD）场景下实现稳健泛化。
AI.conclusion: 关系抽象为扩散模型注入结构化先验，可有效支撑条件图像生成中的空间推理，并提升泛化性，为生成模型与逻辑推理的结合提供了新路径。

title: What the Sleeve Feels: Explainable Machine Learning for Textile Pressure-Based Postural Screening
summary: Pressure-sensing smart textiles convert body-surface contact into a dense, image-like signal closely tied to posture and movement, making them a promising low-cost route to wearable posture screening. Realizing that promise, however, requires more than classification accuracy: a deployable system must generalize to wearers unseen during training, expose the physical evidence behind its decisions, and tolerate the small donning offsets that occur whenever a garment is removed and re-worn. This paper addresses these three requirements jointly using a knitted piezoresistive sleeve worn on the forearm as a testbed. We regroup fine-grained everyday activities into three coarser screening categories (neutral, potentially undesirable, and functional or transitional), engineer 29 interpretable pressure-distribution features spanning global intensity, spatial center of pressure, quadrant asymmetry, distribution complexity, and short-horizon temporal change, and evaluate under a strict subject-wise split. A tuned XGBoost classifier reaches 0.818 accuracy, 0.788 balanced accuracy, and 0.801 macro F1 on unseen test subjects, with tight frame-level bootstrap 95% intervals of about plus-minus 0.01 and a subject-to-subject standard deviation near 0.06 under leave-one-subject-out cross-validation. A simple 2D-CNN baseline trained on raw frames achieves broadly similar performance, showing that hand-engineered features are not left behind by a learned spatial representation on this task. SHAP-based explanation, a feature-group ablation, per-activity error analysis inside the pooled undesirable class, class-mapping sensitivity, and a simulated donning-rotation stress test together locate what the model relies on, where it degrades, and why, directly targeting the generalization, interpretability, and robustness gaps that determine whether such a system is deployable.

AI.tldr: 利用针织压阻袖套将前臂压力信号用于可穿戴姿态筛查，工程化29个可解释特征并以严格跨被试划分评估，XGBoost在未见被试上达0.818准确率，且性能与2D-CNN基线相当，同时通过SHAP、消融、误差分析与佩戴旋转仿真系统检验泛化性、可解释性与鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 压力感知智能纺织品能将体表接触转化为与姿态和运动密切相关的类图像信号，是低成本可穿戴姿态筛查的有前景途径。但可部署系统不仅需要分类精度，还需对训练中未见的穿戴者具备泛化能力、能揭示决策背后的物理证据，并能容忍衣物穿脱导致的佩戴偏移。本文针对这三个需求进行联合研究。
AI.method: 以佩戴于前臂的针织压阻袖套为测试平台；将细粒度日常活动重组为三类粗筛查类别（中性、潜在不良、功能性或过渡性）；工程化29个可解释压力分布特征，涵盖全局强度、空间压力中心、象限不对称性、分布复杂度和短时程时间变化；在严格的被试独立划分下评估，采用调优的XGBoost分类器，并与基于原始帧训练的简单2D-CNN基线对比；使用SHAP解释、特征组消融、不良类内逐活动误差分析、类别映射敏感性分析及模拟佩戴旋转压力测试。
AI.result: 调优XGBoost在未见测试被试上达到0.818准确率、0.788平衡准确率和0.801宏F1，帧级bootstrap 95%置信区间约为±0.01，留一被试交叉验证下被试间标准差接近0.06。基于原始帧的2D-CNN基线性能大致相当，表明人工工程特征在该任务上未被学习到的空间表征超越。SHAP、消融、误差分析、映射敏感性与旋转压力测试共同定位了模型的依赖依据、性能退化位置及原因。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，在压力感知智能纺织品姿态筛查中，可解释的工程特征配合树模型能在未见被试上取得稳健且可解释的性能，并耐受佩戴偏移。分析工具系统性揭示了模型的依赖、退化与原因，直接针对决定系统可部署性的泛化性、可解释性与鲁棒性缺口。

title: Factorized Tactile Representation and Control for Sim-to-Real Manipulation
summary: Tactile sim-to-real learning must bridge simulated contact and device-specific sensor responses while preserving information needed for control. We propose a factorized tactile representation and control framework that maps normal force and contact patch to an effective contact response recoverable from sensor readings. The response is separated into contact geometry, force distribution, and temporal contact change, with representation-specific encoding and randomization. A Tactile Gated Policy preserves these representations separately through control and operates over all mask configurations without retraining. We evaluate the approach through response reconstruction, spatial alignment, force regulation, and contact-rich adversarial peg insertion in simulation and the real world, enabling the utility and transfer reliability of different tactile representations to be assessed independently. The approach achieves <1 mm contact localization, 1.69 N force-tracking error on unseen geometries, and a 35% improvement in real-world adversarial peg insertion over the unfactorized response, with different tactile representations benefiting different interactions.

AI.tldr: 提出分层（因子化）触觉表征与控制框架，将有效接触响应分解为接触几何、力分布与时间接触变化，并配合触觉门控策略实现无重训练的跨掩码配置控制，在仿真与真机上验证了重建、对齐、力调节及接触丰富插孔任务。
AI.motivation: 触觉sim-to-real学习需同时弥合仿真接触与器件特定传感器响应之间的差距，并保留控制所需的信息。直接使用未因子化的传感器响应难以解析不同触觉表征对具体交互任务的独立贡献，也限制了跨掩码/接触配置的泛化与迁移可靠性。
AI.method: 1) 建立因子化触觉表征：将法向力与接触斑块映射为可从传感器读数恢复的有效接触响应；2) 将该响应拆分为接触几何、力分布与时间接触变化三部分，并针对每种表征进行专属编码与随机化；3) 设计触觉门控策略（Tactile Gated Policy），在控制过程中分别保持各表征，并可在所有掩码配置下运行而无需重训练；4) 通过响应重建、空间对齐、力调节及仿真与真机中的接触丰富对抗式插孔实验进行评估。
AI.result: 接触定位误差 <1 mm；在未见几何体上力跟踪误差为 1.69 N；真实世界对抗式插孔相较未因子化响应提升 35%；不同触觉表征在不同交互中各有优势。
AI.conclusion: 因子化触觉表征可独立评估各类触觉表征的效用与迁移可靠性，提升sim-to-real触觉控制性能，并表明应根据具体交互选择或组合相应的触觉表征。

title: CIRSeg: Coarse-to-Fine Intensity-Robust Liver Segmentation with Source-Free Continual Test-Time Adaptation
comment: Accepted at the CARE 2026 Workshop at MICCAI 2026
summary: Reliable liver segmentation in contrast-enhanced MRI is essential for quantitative hepatic assessment, treatment planning, and longitudinal disease monitoring. However, limited annotated data and scanner- or vendor-dependent intensity variations can cause overfitting and poor generalization to unseen acquisition domains. Moreover, simultaneously achieving robust global localization and precise boundary delineation remains challenging, while predictions may contain isolated false-positive regions outside the main liver component. To address these challenges, we propose CIRSeg, a coarse-to-fine, intensity-robust liver segmentation framework based on nnU-Netv2. CIRSeg combines 3D CutMix with stochastic intensity transfer using either Nyul augmentation or histogram matching to improve robustness to heterogeneous MRI intensities. Its cascaded architecture decouples low-resolution anatomical localization from full-resolution boundary refinement. At inference, source-free test-time adaptation based on confidence-filtered predictions and probability-prior regularization further improves robustness to out-of-distribution inputs. As a final deterministic post-processing step, largest connected component filtering removes isolated false-positive regions. On the CARE 2026 test set, CIRSeg achieves Dice scores of 97.13\% and 97.93\% on the in-domain and unseen-domain subsets, with corresponding HD95 values of 20.18 mm and 11.30 mm, respectively. These results demonstrate consistently accurate segmentation across both in-domain and unseen acquisition settings. The code is available at https://github.com/jingkunchen/MICCAI_CARE_2026

AI.tldr: CIRSeg：基于nnU-Netv2的由粗到细、强度鲁棒的肝脏分割框架，结合3D CutMix与随机强度迁移、级联架构、无源测试时自适应及最大连通域后处理，在CARE 2026测试集上实现域内Dice 97.13%、未见域97.93%。
AI.motivation: 对比增强MRI中的可靠肝脏分割对定量肝脏评估、治疗规划和纵向疾病监测至关重要。但标注数据有限、扫描仪或厂商相关的强度差异易导致过拟合与跨采集域泛化差；同时兼顾全局定位与精确边界刻画仍具挑战，预测中可能出现主体肝脏之外的孤立假阳性区域。
AI.method: 提出CIRSeg，基于nnU-Netv2的由粗到细、强度鲁棒肝脏分割框架。训练端将3D CutMix与随机强度迁移（Nyul增强或直方图匹配）结合以提升对异质MRI强度的鲁棒性；级联架构将低分辨率解剖定位与全分辨率边界细化解耦；推理端采用基于置信度过滤预测与概率先验正则化的无源测试时自适应以增强对分布外输入的鲁棒性；最后以最大连通域滤波作为确定性后处理去除孤立假阳性区域。
AI.result: 在CARE 2026测试集上，CIRSeg在域内子集取得Dice 97.13%、HD95 20.18 mm；在未见域子集取得Dice 97.93%、HD95 11.30 mm，表明其在域内与未见采集设置下均具有一致且准确的分割性能。
AI.conclusion: CIRSeg通过强度鲁棒增强、级联粗到细架构、无源测试时自适应与连通域后处理的协同设计，有效缓解有限标注与强度异质性带来的过拟合和泛化问题，在域内及未见域均取得高精度、稳定的肝脏分割结果，代码已开源。

title: Learning to Accumulate Knowledge with Mutual Information
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents can improve their performance by reusing knowledge distilled from past interactions. However, curating new experiences into a knowledge bank that becomes more useful as it grows remains challenging. Effective knowledge accumulation should limit redundant overlap among entries and ensure that new knowledge contributes beyond what the bank already provides. Yet training a curator with Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) on standalone task success can reinforce general guidance even when it duplicates existing knowledge. Therefore, we propose Knowledge Weaver, a reinforcement learning framework that trains a language model to curate reusable knowledge from agent trajectories. We couple feedback inspired by token-wise mutual information (MI) with marginal success rewards to guide knowledge accumulation. Together, these signals encourage the curator to preserve distinct information from experience and produce entries that improve task success when added to existing knowledge. Standalone success rewards also favor entries that are useful on their own. On ALFWorld and WebShop, Knowledge Weaver achieves mean success rates of 54.0\% and 42.0\% with k=10 retrieved entries, exceeding GRPO by 16.9 and 18.7 percentage points, respectively. Its knowledge banks also outperform the evaluated prompt-based and established banks, including human-written banks, in overall ALFWorld success rate and WebShop score with the executor frozen. Our codebase is available at https://github.com/LaoKuiZe/Knowledge-Weaver.

AI.tldr: 提出 Knowledge Weaver 强化学习框架，训练语言模型将智能体轨迹提炼为可复用知识库，通过 token 级互信息与边际成功奖励引导知识积累，在 ALFWorld 和 WebShop 上显著超越 GRPO。
AI.motivation: LLM 智能体可通过复用历史交互中提炼的知识提升表现，但如何把新经验编入一个"越大越好用"的知识库仍是难题。有效的知识积累需要限制条目间的冗余重叠，并确保新知识提供超出已有库的信息增量。然而仅用 GRPO 以独立任务成功率训练"知识编辑者"，会强化那些即使与已有知识重复的泛化性指导，导致冗余。
AI.method: 提出 Knowledge Weaver，一个强化学习框架，训练语言模型从智能体轨迹中提炼可复用知识。将受 token 级互信息（MI）启发的反馈与边际成功奖励耦合，共同指导知识积累：这两类信号促使编辑者保留经验中独特的信息，并生成加入已有知识后能提升任务成功率的条目；同时独立成功奖励也偏好本身就有用的条目。
AI.result: 在 ALFWorld 与 WebShop 上，知识库检索 k=10 条条目时，Knowledge Weaver 平均成功率分别达 54.0% 和 42.0%，较 GRPO 分别高 16.9 和 18.7 个百分点。在执行器冻结条件下，其知识库在 ALFWorld 总体成功率和 WebShop 分数上均优于所评估的基于提示的方法及已有知识库（包括人工撰写的知识库）。
AI.conclusion: 将互信息启发的反馈与边际成功奖励结合，可训练出更有效地积累去重、增量知识的编辑者，构建随规模增长而更有用的知识库，并在多个智能体任务上验证了其优于 GRPO 及现有知识库方案的有效性。

title: Align Before You Combine: Reference Space Calibration for Supervision Without Ground Truth
comment: 25 pages; 14 tables; 4 figures; 5 appendices; code available at https://github.com/Lafayette-EshbaughSilveyra-Group/calibration-first
summary: We introduce a calibration-first framework that produces supervision scores without access to ground-truth labels or a shared annotation space. Our framework aligns subset-specific scorers using a synthetic ordinal reference space before fusion. This reference space is constructed from ordered calibration features that represent the latent concept, providing a common scale on which otherwise incomparable scorer outputs can be aligned. Because our calibration procedure uses the reference space rather than training samples, it is independent of the training set's empirical distribution. Across three benchmark datasets, our framework consistently outperforms uncalibrated averaging and achieves higher primary-metric point estimates on the evaluation metrics than the best individual scorer. Performance relative to sample-dependent baselines varies by domain, with absolute differences below 0.02 on Ames Housing and below 0.01 on Breast Cancer Wisconsin and Wine Quality. After Bonferroni correction, differences remain significant for all three comparisons on Ames Housing and one on Breast Cancer Wisconsin. Additionally, we show that using fewer calibration levels per feature can closely approximate higher-resolution results at substantially lower computational cost. Together, these results support our framework as a viable approach to construct supervision scores when neither ground-truth labels nor a shared annotation space is available.

AI.tldr: 提出一种"校准优先"框架，无需真值标签或共享标注空间即可生成监督分数：先通过合成序数参考空间对齐各子集评分器，再进行融合。
AI.motivation: 现有监督分数构建通常依赖真值标签或共享标注空间，而在许多实际场景中二者均不可得，导致不同子集评分器输出不可比较、无法直接融合。
AI.method: 构建由有序校准特征组成的合成序数参考空间，用以表征潜在概念；在融合前将各子集特定评分器映射并对齐到该统一尺度。校准基于参考空间而非训练样本，因而独立于训练集的经验分布；并探讨减少每个特征的校准层级以降低计算成本。
AI.result: 在三个基准数据集上，该框架一致优于未校准平均，且评测指标的主指标点估计高于最佳单一评分器。与依赖样本的基线相比，跨域表现存在差异，Ames Housing 绝对差小于 0.02，Breast Cancer Wisconsin 与 Wine Quality 均小于 0.01；经 Bonferroni 校正后，Ames Housing 三项比较全部显著，Breast Cancer Wisconsin 有一项显著。
AI.conclusion: 该框架是在既无真值标签又无共享标注空间条件下构建监督分数的可行方案，且较低校准分辨率即可近似高分辨率结果并显著节省算力。

title: Rephrase Before You Act: Characterizing and Mitigating Language Sensitivity in Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Vision-language-action models (VLAs) are strikingly sensitive to instruction phrasing and do not inherit the language robustness of the vision-language models they are built on. A one-word edit can move success by tens of points: $π_{0.5}$ turns on a LIBERO stove 100% of the time for "switch on the stove" and 2% for "switch on the hot plate", and a $π_0$ checkpoint finetuned with rephrase augmentation still shows swings of up to 61 points. We characterize this sensitivity with statistically tested single-edit swings and an oracle phrase search, which shows that phrasing alone nearly closes the 21-point gap between in-distribution and out-of-distribution tasks. We then reduce it without modifying the policy. Because the sensitivity is systematic, it can be expressed as explicit rules: we score many phrasings of a few training tasks, have a large language model distill the evidence into ten to twenty rephrasing rules, and at deployment rewrite each incoming instruction once under these rules. The rules improve the frozen $π_0$ by 16 to 27% relative on twelve held-out tasks across adversarial, VLM-generated, and human-generated phrasings, with gains concentrated on out-of-distribution tasks. The pipeline replicates on $π_{0.5}$ and LIBERO, lifting in-finetune success from 93.6% to 97.8%. The method requires no retraining and no per-step verification, and applies zero-shot to unseen tasks and instructions. Project website: https://sttawm.github.io/rephrase-before-you-act

AI.tldr: 视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA）对指令措辞高度敏感，且不继承其基座VLM的语言鲁棒性。作者用统计检验的单编辑扰动与oracle短语搜索量化该敏感性，并提出无需改策略的部署期改写方案：由LLM从少量任务评分证据中蒸馏出10–20条改写规则，对每条指令改写一次。冻结的π0在12个留出任务上相对提升16–27%，π0.5在LIBERO上将微调内成功率由93.6%提升至97.8%，且零样本适用于未见任务与指令。
AI.motivation: VLA模型对指令措辞极度敏感：一词之改即可造成数十个百分点的成功率波动（如"switch on the stove"100% vs "switch on the hot plate"2%），且即使使用改写增强微调的检查点仍有高达61点的波动。这种敏感性系统性地拉大了分布内与分布外任务的差距（约21点），说明基座VLM的语言鲁棒性并未被继承，亟需一种低代价的缓解手段。
AI.method: 不改动策略本身：（1）用统计检验的单编辑扰动和oracle短语搜索刻画敏感性；（2）对少量训练任务的大量改写进行评分，由大语言模型将证据蒸馏为10–20条改写规则；（3）部署时在给定规则下对每条输入指令仅改写一次。全程无需重训练、无需逐步验证，可零样本迁移到未见任务与指令。
AI.result: 改写规则使冻结的π0在12个留出任务上（涵盖对抗式、VLM生成与人类生成的措辞）获得16–27%的相对提升，增益主要集中在分布外任务；在π0.5与LIBERO上的流程可复现，微调内成功率由93.6%提升至97.8%。
AI.conclusion: VLA的指令敏感性强且系统化，可被显式规则表达并外置到部署阶段加以纠正。所提"先改写再行动"流程无需重训练与逐步验证，即可在多个模型与基准上稳定提升鲁棒性，并零样本泛化到未见任务与指令。

title: UltraWorld: Learning Interactive Ultrasound World Models from Untracked Clinical Videos with Acoustic Sampling Map
summary: World models can enable autonomous ultrasound scanning by predicting the outcomes of probe motions from local observations. Learning this action--observation relationship typically relies on synchronized video--pose pairs, which are costly to collect at scale and largely unavailable in routine clinical recordings. Reliable action following further requires modeling ultrasound's cross-sectional sampling geometry. We present UltraWorld, a self-distillation recipe that transfers priors from clinical ultrasound videos into interactive world models without real action annotations. Starting from clinical videos, we adapt a video foundation model into an ultrasound generator conditioned on reference images and anatomical masks. Anatomical masks sampled along programmable trajectories through 3D anatomy provide spatial guidance for synthesizing action--video pairs. We then use these synthetic pairs to self-distill the generator into a world model that predicts future observations from local observations and actions, without requiring anatomical masks or other 3D assets at inference time. To further improve action following, we introduce the Acoustic Sampling Map (AsMap), which represents probe poses and imaging settings as pixel-wise 3D sampling positions, beam directions, and depths. Experiments demonstrate improved prediction fidelity and action following. Across nine simulated closed-loop local planning episodes, UltraWorld reduces the mean final distance to the goal and orientation error by 29\% and 38\%, respectively, compared with visual servoing. Project Page: https://ultraworld-project.github.io/.

AI.tldr: UltraWorld：一种自蒸馏方法，将临床超声视频先验迁移为交互式世界模型，无需真实动作标注，并通过声学采样图（AsMap）提升动作跟随与预测保真度。
AI.motivation: 自主超声扫描需要世界模型从局部观测预测探头运动的结果，但学习"动作—观测"关系通常依赖大规模同步的视频—位姿配对，这类数据采集成本高且在常规临床记录中基本缺失；同时可靠的动作跟随还需建模超声的断面采样几何。
AI.method: 提出 UltraWorld 自蒸馏方案：先将视频基础模型适配为以参考图像和解剖掩码为条件的超声生成器；沿可编程轨迹在三维解剖中采样解剖掩码，为合成"动作—视频"对提供空间引导；再用这些合成配对将生成器自蒸馏为世界模型，推理时无需解剖掩码或三维资产。此外提出声学采样图（AsMap），以逐像素的三维采样位置、波束方向和深度表示探头位姿与成像设置。
AI.result: 实验表明预测保真度和动作跟随性能均有提升。在九个模拟闭环局部规划回合中，相比视觉伺服，UltraWorld 将到目标的平均最终距离和朝向误差分别降低 29% 与 38%。
AI.conclusion: UltraWorld 无需真实动作标注即可从临床超声视频中蒸馏出可交互的世界模型，并通过 AsMap 增强动作跟随，在闭环局部规划中显著优于视觉伺服，为自主超声扫描提供了可行路径。

title: Loud Failures, Quiet Failures: Fault Detection and Recovery in Tool-Using Language Model Agents
summary: Tool-using agents are usually scored on whether they finish a task while the tools work. Deployments are less forgiving: services time out, endpoints disappear, parameter names change, and results come back well formed but wrong. Prior work has shown that language models over-trust tool outputs that fail silently; we ask how that over-trust plays out across the stages of failure handling in multi-turn agents. Wrapping the executable environments of an established function-calling benchmark in a fault-injection layer, we inject one of four typed faults at a controlled point in the trajectory and record whether the agent notices, changes plan, recovers the task, or repeats itself. Six models from three families, half of them reasoning variants, ran 1,920 trials over 24 multi-step tasks. Agents treat a failure as a problem in 91.3% of trials when the tool returns an explicit error, but in 58.8% of trials when it returns a plausible wrong value, against a 26.8% rate of reporting problems when nothing was wrong. Reasoning models are not better placed: paired against instruct siblings, they notice less (-9.3 points, p < .001) and change plan more (+10.4 points, p < .001), and recovery is unchanged (p = .512). Because agents are stochastic, two fault-free runs of the same task end in the same state only 63.3% of the time; against that baseline, only a missing tool clearly lowers recovery (39.9%), while timeouts, schema drift, and corruption stay within run-to-run variation. After a fault, agents return to the same tool three or more times in a row in up to 22.2% of trials, though strictly identical repeats are rare. A prompt line asking the agent to check each result did not move detection. Agents respond to the error channel rather than to the content of what a tool returns, so failures that stay inside the expected format pass through.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过在函数调用基准环境中注入四类故障，系统考察多轮工具使用智能体的故障检测、改计划与恢复行为，发现智能体主要依赖"显式错误信号"而非结果内容来识别故障，静默错误大多被放过。
AI.motivation: 现有评测通常假设工具正常工作，只考察任务是否完成，而真实部署中会出现超时、端点消失、参数名变化、结果格式正确但数值错误等故障。已有工作表明语言模型会过度信任静默失败的工具输出，但尚不清楚这种过度信任在多轮智能体的故障处理各阶段（察觉、改计划、恢复、重复）中如何表现，尤其是具备推理能力的模型是否更稳健。
AI.method: 在既有函数调用基准的可执行环境外包裹故障注入层，在轨迹的受控位置注入四种类型化故障；记录智能体是否察觉、是否改变计划、是否恢复任务、是否重复行为。选取来自三个模型家族的六个模型（其中一半为推理变体），在24个多步任务上共运行1,920次试验。同时设置无故障对照与提示行（要求检查每次结果）干预，并测量无故障条件下的运行间状态一致率作为基线。
AI.result: 工具返回显式错误时，智能体在91.3%的试验中将其视为问题；返回看似合理的错误值时仅58.8%；而本身无障碍时仍有26.8%的报告率。推理模型并不更优：与同族指令模型配对比较，察觉率低9.3个百分点（p<.001），改计划率高10.4个百分点（p<.001），恢复率无差异（p=.512）。无故障重复运行状态一致率仅63.3%；以此为基线，只有"工具缺失"显著降低恢复率（39.9%），超时、模式漂移与结果损坏均落在运行间波动范围内。故障后连续三次及以上调用同一工具的比例最高达22.2%，但严格完全相同的重复很少。要求检查结果的提示行未提升察觉率。
AI.conclusion: 智能体是对"错误通道"而非工具返回内容作出反应：凡是符合预期格式的故障（静默错误、损坏、模式漂移）都能穿透检测。推理变体并未带来更好的故障稳健性，反而察觉更少、更频繁改计划。提示层面的简单约束无效，说明提升工具使用可靠性需要在故障信号与检测机制层面而非仅靠指令提示来解决。

title: CircuitGate: Logic-Consistent Circuit-Level Functional Modeling for And-Inverter Graphs
comment: 16 pages, 3 figures, 11 tables. Qifan Zhang and Ruijie Li contributed equally. Qian Ma is the corresponding author
summary: And-Inverter Graphs (AIGs) are fundamental representations for logic synthesis and verification in Electronic Design Automation (EDA). As structured representations of complex digital systems, AIGs require models to capture functional dependencies beyond local structure and remain robust to functionality-preserving transformations. In learning-based AIG representation, existing approaches are predominantly based on GNNs and rely on local gate-level message passing, limiting their ability to capture circuit-level functional context and making the learned representations sensitive to topology-specific patterns. Therefore, we propose CircuitGate, a function-aware AIG representation learning framework that advances from gate-level semantics to circuit-level functional modeling. CircuitGate explicitly encodes global primary-input (PI) support and models support-overlap-aware reconvergence between fanins, while incorporating logic-inspired Boolean constraints to encourage functionally consistent representations. We evaluate CircuitGate on the large-scale ForgeEDA benchmark and further validate it on the EPFL and ITC'99 benchmarks. Across equivalent-gate identification and signal-probability prediction tasks, CircuitGate consistently outperforms existing methods, achieving up to 21.7% and 14.2% reductions in MAE, respectively. Under direct ForgeEDA-to-OpenABC transfer without fine-tuning, CircuitGate also achieves the best equivalent-gate identification performance, demonstrating strong cross-dataset generalization. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of modeling circuit-level functional dependencies beyond local topology.

AI.tldr: 提出 CircuitGate，一个函数感知的 AIG 表示学习框架，从门级语义提升到电路级功能建模，在多个基准上超越现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有基于 GNN 的 AIG 表示学习方法主要依赖局部门级消息传递，难以捕捉电路级功能上下文，且对拓扑特定模式敏感。
AI.method: 显式编码全局主输入（PI）支持关系，建模扇入间支持重叠感知的重汇聚结构，并引入逻辑启发的布尔约束以促进功能一致的表示。
AI.result: 在 ForgeEDA、EPFL 和 ITC'99 基准上，等效门识别与信号概率预测任务的 MAE 分别最多降低 21.7% 和 14.2%；在无微调的 ForgeEDA 到 OpenABC 迁移中，等效门识别取得最佳性能。
AI.conclusion: 建模超越局部拓扑的电路级功能依赖关系是有效的，CircuitGate 展现出强跨数据集泛化能力。

title: Long-WAM: Scaling the Context of World-Action Models
summary: Real-time robot control demands enough visual history to infer motion and task progress, but processing that history can delay action. We present Long-WAM, a model-system framework for scaling the context of causal world-action models under real-time control constraints. Our central finding is that access to history is not the same as using it: longer histories pay off far more when the video foundation is pretrained autoregressively (AR). We first learn causal prediction from robot and egocentric videos without action labels, then preserve this history-to-future structure during world-action adaptation. On RoboCasa GR-1, increasing context from 0.0 to 19.2 seconds raises success from 63.3% to 78.7%, whereas a bidirectionally pretrained initialization shows no net gain; robot-domain AR pretraining further raises peak success on GR-1 and LIBERO-Long. Long-WAM also achieves the best results among compared methods on LIBERO-Long, RoboTwin 2.0, and DOMINO. Streaming observation encoding, asynchronous execution, and hardware-specific acceleration enable deployment on RTX 5090, DGX Spark, and Jetson AGX Thor without dropping future prediction; on RTX 5090, each action chunk, including future-video latent prediction, takes 107.4 ms. Real-time deployment on Unitree G1 and YAM supports dynamic and long-horizon manipulation, including 95% success on dynamic cup stacking, where Pi0.5 and Fast-WAM succeed in none of 20 trials. As a memory-informed executor, Long-WAM also complements higher-level planning in composite tasks.

AI.tldr: Long-WAM 通过自回归(AR)预训练与系统级优化，使因果世界-动作模型在实时控制约束下有效扩展历史上下文，显著提升操作任务成功率与部署效率。
AI.motivation: 实时机器人控制需要足够的视觉历史来推断运动与任务进度，但处理长历史会延迟动作执行，二者存在矛盾；且仅提供历史上下文并不等于模型能有效利用它。
AI.method: 提出 Long-WAM 模型-系统框架：先在无动作标签的机器人与第一视角视频上进行自回归因果预测预训练，再在世界-动作适配阶段保留"历史到未来"结构；配合流式观测编码、异步执行及硬件特定加速实现实时部署。
AI.result: 在 RoboCasa GR-1 上，上下文从 0.0s 增至 19.2s，成功率由 63.3% 提升至 78.7%，而双向预训练初始化无净增益；机器域 AR 预训练进一步提升 GR-1 与 LIBERO-Long 的峰值成功率。在 LIBERO-Long、RoboTwin 2.0、DOMINO 上均取得对比方法中最佳结果。RTX 5090 上每个动作块（含未来视频潜变量预测）耗时 107.4ms，可部署于 RTX 5090、DGX Spark、Jetson AGX Thor 且不损失未来预测。在 Unitree G1 与 YAM 上实现实时部署，动态叠杯任务成功率 95%，而 Pi0.5 与 Fast-WAM 在 20 次试验中均失败。
AI.conclusion: 历史访问不等于历史利用：当视频基础模型经自回归预训练时，长上下文才带来显著收益。Long-WAM 作为记忆驱动的执行器，可在实时约束下完成动态与长时程操作，并能与高层规划互补，适用于复合任务。

title: SkillSandbox: Skill Verification via Dynamic Scenario Synthesis
summary: Self-evolving agents distill task-solving experience into skills for future reuse, but these skills can encode incorrect procedures or non-transferable knowledge. It is therefore critical to verify each skill's reusability: whether its guidance remains useful beyond the experience from which it was distilled. Such verification requires observing how a skill affects execution in new tasks, yet existing tasks may not expose the situations where the target skill can actually be exercised. To construct such situations, we propose SkillSandbox, a framework that dynamically synthesizes a task and its environment for each skill that are skill-relevant yet novel. A Proposer specifies the conditions to preserve and the source-specific details to vary, a Builder constructs an executable scenario, and a Verifier compares executions with and without the skill. The Verifier assesses executability, utility, and efficiency to assign a Keep or Reject verdict, determining whether the skill enters the library. Across ALFWorld and WebShop with three models, SkillSandbox consistently yields the strongest downstream performance and improved execution efficiency. Further analyses examine whether these gains reflect accurate assessment of skill reusability and identify which components of SkillSandbox contribute to them.

AI.tldr: 提出SkillSandbox框架，通过动态合成与技能相关但新颖的任务及其环境，验证自进化智能体所蒸馏技能的可复用性，并决定其是否入库。
AI.motivation: 自进化智能体将任务求解经验蒸馏为技能以供复用，但技能可能包含错误流程或不可迁移知识，因此需验证技能的“可复用性”——即其指导在新任务中是否仍有效。然而验证需要观察技能在新任务中的执行效果，而现有任务未必能触发目标技能适用的情境。
AI.method: SkillSandbox动态为每个技能合成“技能相关但新颖”的任务与环境：Proposer指定需保留的条件与需变化的来源特定细节；Builder构建可执行场景；Verifier对比有无技能时的执行表现，从可执行性、效用与效率三方面评估，给出Keep或Reject判定，决定技能是否进入技能库。
AI.result: 在ALFWorld与WebShop上，使用三个模型，SkillSandbox均取得最强的下游性能并提升执行效率。进一步分析检验了这些增益是否反映对技能可复用性的准确评估，并识别出SkillSandbox中促成增益的组件。
AI.conclusion: SkillSandbox通过构造技能相关且新颖的任务与环境，实现对技能可复用性的系统验证，有效筛选技能并提升下游性能与效率，为自进化智能体的技能管理提供了可行方案。

title: Counterfactual Route Optimization for Gaussian Head Avatar Modeling
summary: Head avatar modeling requires jointly optimizing multiple objectives with different dominant effects on geometry, appearance, and cross-view consistency. However, their relative effectiveness varies across training states, while existing pipelines typically rely on fixed loss weights or handcrafted stage-wise schedules. A central challenge is therefore to identify which optimization direction is more beneficial at each training state. We propose a counterfactual route optimization framework for Gaussian head avatar modeling, which characterizes state-dependent optimization preference from the realized effects of alternative updates rather than predefined heuristic weighting. Starting from the same training state, we perform short-horizon route-restricted lookahead over geometry, appearance, and joint update routes and evaluate their outcomes under a unified utility. The resulting counterfactual evidence is factorized into a geometry--appearance preference and a residual joint advantage, separately capturing the relative preference between individual update directions and the additional benefit of coordinated optimization. We further amortize this offline evidence into a lightweight controller that directly estimates the current optimization preference and applies bounded modulation to the training objectives during full avatar optimization. Experiments on the NeRSemble dataset validate the effectiveness of the proposed design, consistently outperforming existing methods while preserving clearer local facial structures and finer details.

AI.tldr: 本文提出反事实路径优化框架，通过短视界路径受限前瞻评估几何、外观与联合更新方向的实际效果，得到状态相关的优化偏好，并用轻量控制器在全量训练中施加有界调制。
AI.motivation: 头部化身建模需联合优化几何、外观与跨视角一致性等多个目标，其相对有效性随训练状态变化；现有流程依赖固定损失权重或人工分阶段调度，核心难题在于每个训练状态下判断哪个优化方向更有利。
AI.method: 从同一训练状态出发，对几何、外观和联合更新三条路径进行短视界、路径受限的前瞻，用统一效用评估结果；将反事实证据分解为几何—外观偏好项与残差联合优势项，分别刻画单方向相对偏好与协同优化的额外收益；再将该离线证据摊销为轻量控制器，在线估计当前优化偏好并对训练目标进行有界调制。
AI.result: 在 NeRSemble 数据集上的实验验证了所提设计的有效性，方法持续优于现有方法，并保留更清晰的局部面部结构和更精细的细节。
AI.conclusion: 以状态相关的反事实证据替代预设启发式权重，可实现高斯头部化身优化方向的动态、有界调制，提升几何与外观的联合建模质量。

title: HGP:An on-device personalized agent memory via hybrid graph storage
summary: LLM-based agents face challenges in personalized interactive tasks due to heterogeneous, multi-typed, and implicitly constrained long-term traces. Existing memory mechanisms struggle with accurate routing and retrieval, especially on-device where personalization is critical. Most methods use single-vector representations, blurring type distinctions and relational structure. We propose HGP, a hybrid graph memory framework. HGP employs a lightweight self-enhancement classifier for personalized memory routing and constructs episodic, semantic, and procedural memories as graphs. It also extracts working memory as a state trajectory to capture current state and implicit constraints, ensuring reliable decision-making. The classifier reduces large-model calls, enabling on-device deployment, while graph storage enables accurate retrieval and incremental user profile refinement. Experiments on two benchmarks show that on PAL-Set solution selection, HGP achieves an S-score of 35.58, nearly 7 points above the strongest baseline. Code and data are at https://github.com/Ouan6/HGP-.git.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出HGP——一种混合图记忆框架，通过轻量级自增强分类器实现个性化记忆路由，并将情景、语义、程序记忆构建为图结构，同时提取工作记忆作为状态轨迹以捕获隐式约束，从而提升LLM智能体在端侧个性化交互任务中的决策可靠性。
AI.motivation: 基于LLM的智能体在个性化交互任务中面临长期记忆痕迹异构、多类型且隐式约束强的挑战。现有记忆机制在准确路由与检索上表现不足，尤其在端侧设备上个性化尤为关键。多数方法采用单向量表示，模糊了类型区分与关系结构。
AI.method: 提出HGP混合图记忆框架：（1）采用轻量级自增强分类器进行个性化记忆路由，减少大模型调用以支持端侧部署；（2）将情景记忆、语义记忆和程序记忆分别构建为图结构，实现图存储下的精准检索与用户画像增量精炼；（3）提取工作记忆作为状态轨迹，捕获当前状态与隐式约束，保障决策可靠性。
AI.result: 在两个基准数据集上开展实验。在PAL-Set的solution selection任务上，HGP取得35.58的S-score，比最强基线高出近7分。代码与数据已开源。
AI.conclusion: HGP通过混合图记忆与轻量路由机制，有效解决了多类型、隐式约束长期记忆的路由与检索难题，在提升个性化决策性能的同时实现了端侧部署的可行性。

title: A Framework for the Systematic Review of ML Assets in AI Registries
summary: Background: Modern software systems increasingly rely on Machine Learning (ML) assets (i.e., pre-trained models, datasets, benchmarks) for building, evaluating, and integrating ML-based systems. However, current exploration, selection and reuse practices of ML assets are not supported by systematic retrieval methodologies comparable to those used in traditional evidence synthesis. Consequently, in practice, ML asset selection is often presented as a settled design decision, supported by informal justification rather than a traceable, evidence-based, and updatable selection process. Aims: This paper explores how systematic review methods can support ML asset retrieval. In doing so, we aim to make their selection transparent and reproducible, grounded in explicit evidence, and ultimately better suited to its intended use. Method: We analyze established systematic review practices from scientific literature and adapt their phases (i.e., planning, conducting, and documenting) to Artificial Intelligence (AI) registries, treating ML assets as first-class units of analysis. The resulting framework integrates registry-aware search strategies, cross-registry schema alignment, and dependency-driven ML asset exploration. Results: We conceptualize ML asset retrieval as a systematic and reproducible process rather than an ad hoc activity, and propose a framework for structured ML asset discovery. \textbf{Conclusions:} This work illustrates how systematic review principles can be extended beyond scientific literature to support evidence synthesis over evolving AI registries.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将系统综述方法从科学文献迁移到AI注册库，以支持ML资产（预训练模型、数据集、基准）的系统化检索与选择。
AI.motivation: 现代软件系统日益依赖ML资产进行构建、评估与集成，但当前ML资产的探索、选择与复用缺乏类似传统证据合成的系统化检索方法，导致选择常被视为既定设计决策，仅凭非正式理由支撑，缺乏可追溯、基于证据且可更新的过程。
AI.method: 分析科学文献中的成熟系统综述实践，将其阶段（规划、执行、记录）适配到AI注册库，把ML资产视为一等分析单元，并整合注册库感知的检索策略、跨注册库模式对齐以及依赖驱动的ML资产探索。
AI.result: 将ML资产检索概念化为系统化、可复现的过程而非临时活动，并提出一个结构化ML资产发现的框架。
AI.conclusion: 本工作表明系统综述原则可超越科学文献，扩展用于演化中的AI注册库上的证据合成，使ML资产选择透明、可复现并更适合其预期用途。

title: RoboPrompt: Intuitive Robot Policy Steering with Sparse Human Input
summary: End-to-end robot policies trained through imitation learning remain constrained by limited data diversity, making reliable zero-shot deployment in real-world settings challenging. Shared-autonomy methods enable human correction through teleoperation, but specialized hardware and operator training hinder deployment at scale. Other approaches incorporate human guidance as additional policy inputs, often requiring architectural changes and dedicated training for steerability, which limits their applicability across policies. We present RoboPrompt, a general-purpose, lightweight robot policy steering system that enables users to guide policy behavior through intuitive, sparse inputs, including drawn traces, target points, and coarse directional instructions. RoboPrompt decouples human-intention translation from the underlying policy: a reusable module converts human guidance into action drafts, which are refined through the diffusion or flow-matching dynamics of the base policy. By controlling action generation in noise space, RoboPrompt balances human intent with the policy prior without modifying the base policy architecture or fine-tuning it for steerability. Experiments demonstrate effective steering across Diffusion Policy, $π_{0.5}$, and FastWAM. We further use steered rollouts for online policy improvement through DAgger. After 2-3 rounds of iteration, average success rates increase by 15.5\% for $π_{0.5}$ across three tasks and by 21.3\% across three policies(Diffusion Policy, $π_{0.5}$, FastWAM) on the Insert Bread task, while average human intervention counts decrease by 44.0\% (2.86 to 1.60) and 81.9\% (2.60 to 0.47), respectively.

AI.tldr: RoboPrompt：一种通用、轻量的机器人策略引导系统，通过稀疏人类输入（轨迹、目标点、方向）在噪声空间控制动作生成，无需修改或微调基座策略，并可结合DAgger实现在线策略改进。
AI.motivation: 端到端模仿学习策略受限于数据多样性，难以零样本部署；现有共享自主方法依赖专用硬件与操作培训，难以规模化；将人类引导作为额外策略输入的方法通常需改动架构并专门训练可引导性，通用性受限。因此需要一种无需修改基座策略、通用且轻量的人机引导方案。
AI.method: RoboPrompt将人类意图翻译与底层策略解耦：可复用模块将人类指导（绘制的轨迹、目标点、粗方向指令）转换为动作草稿，再经由基座策略的扩散或流匹配动力学进行精炼。通过在噪声空间控制动作生成，在人类意图与策略先验之间取得平衡，不修改基座策略架构，也不为其可引导性做微调。并将引导式rollout用于DAgger在线策略改进。
AI.result: 在Diffusion Policy、π₀.₅和FastWAM上均实现有效引导。经2-3轮DAgger迭代后，π₀.₅在三项任务上平均成功率提升15.5%；在Insert Bread任务上，三种策略（Diffusion Policy、π₀.₅、FastWAM）平均成功率提升21.3%；平均人工干预次数分别从2.86降至1.60（下降44.0%）和从2.60降至0.47（下降81.9%）。
AI.conclusion: RoboPrompt以轻量、免架构修改、跨策略通用的方式实现稀疏人类引导的策略控制，既能提升任务成功率又能显著减少人工干预，并可作为在线策略改进的有效数据来源。

title: YANchor-4B: Effective Long-Horizon Reasoning in O(N) Time with O(1) Memory
summary: Long-horizon reasoning demands access to earlier information at a manageable generation cost. Full-history attention incurs growing storage and computation, while recurrent compression can lose precise details. Therefore, we present YANchor-4B, a general-purpose recurrent model that preserves crucial memory as ANchors for retrieval during subsequent reasoning. Beyond $O(N)$-time generation and $O(1)$ memory, YANchor enables effective long-horizon reasoning through its multidimensional memory mechanism. For example, on challenging math problems, it achieves 82.93% mean pass@1 on AIME 2024--2026 and 63.64% on HMMT, substantially outperforming linear-time, constant-state counterparts, including larger models. It also delivers several-fold higher batched long-generation throughput than Transformer and hybrid baselines on H100. Furthermore, evaluations across dozens of benchmarks demonstrate YANchor's superiority in general-purpose capabilities.

AI.tldr: YANchor-4B 是一种通用循环模型，通过将关键记忆保存为“锚点”（ANchors）供后续推理检索，在 O(N) 生成时间与 O(1) 内存下实现有效的长程推理。
AI.motivation: 长程推理需要在可控生成成本下访问早期信息。全历史注意力导致存储与计算成本随长度增长，而循环压缩可能丢失精确细节，因此需要一种兼顾效率与记忆保真度的方案。
AI.method: 提出 YANchor-4B 通用循环模型，其核心是多维记忆机制：将关键记忆保留为 ANchors（锚点），在后续推理时进行检索，从而在保持 O(N) 生成时间与 O(1) 内存的同时支持长程推理。
AI.result: 在挑战性数学任务上，AIME 2024–2026 平均 pass@1 达 82.93%，HMMT 达 63.64%，显著优于线性时间、常数状态的同类模型（包括更大模型）。在 H100 上，批量长生成吞吐量比 Transformer 与混合基线高数倍。数十个基准评测显示其在通用能力上的优势。
AI.conclusion: YANchor-4B 通过锚点式多维记忆机制，在高效生成（O(N) 时间、O(1) 内存）与长程推理精度之间取得良好平衡，并在数学推理、长生成吞吐及通用能力上均展现出优越性能。

title: Beyond Masks and Trajectories: Flow-Guided Latent Action Injection for Stable Surgical Video Generation
summary: Surgical video generation holds substantial potential for surgical education, simulation, and data augmentation, yet generating surgical videos with realistic and clinically plausible motion remains challenging. Most existing methods rely on auxiliary conditions, such as masks, trajectories, depth, or reference videos, to achieve visually plausible synthesis. Yet, these auxiliary conditions typically require additional manual annotation or specialized acquisition, making it difficult to scale such methods beyond small, curated datasets. This motivates the need for a reference-free architecture capable of generating high-quality surgical video without requiring auxiliary visual conditions at inference time. We propose FLAIR, a Flow-guided LatentAction Injection framework for Reference-free surgical video generation. FLAIR learns action priors from optical flow of real surgical videos, dynamically predicts corresponding latent action representation from an input prompt, and injects it into a frozen base model to generate surgical videos with improved action consistency. We further construct SurgActionClip-30K, the first large-scale surgical vision dataset comprising action-centric segmented clips and structured caption labels, addressing the persistent lack of fine-grained, action-centric surgical datasets. Lastly, we introduce SurgMetrics, the first surgical domain-specific evaluation metrics for quantifying the quality of generated surgical videos, addressing the persistent absence of clinically grounded evaluation standards in this domain. Extensive experiments demonstrate that FLAIR enables generating high-quality surgical videos using text-only inference without auxiliary conditions, and validation in SurgMetrics demonstrates its strength in alignment with human perception compared to traditional metrics.

AI.tldr: 提出FLAIR框架，实现无需辅助条件的参考自由手术视频生成，并配套构建SurgActionClip-30K数据集与SurgMetrics评估指标。
AI.motivation: 现有手术视频生成方法多依赖掩码、轨迹、深度或参考视频等辅助条件，这些条件需人工标注或专门采集，难以扩展到大规模数据集，因此亟需一种推理时无需辅助视觉条件的参考自由架构。
AI.method: FLAIR为流引导的潜在动作注入框架：从真实手术视频的光流中学习动作先验，动态地从输入提示预测相应的潜在动作表示，并将其注入冻结的基础模型中，以提升动作一致性。同时构建SurgActionClip-30K数据集与SurgMetrics评估指标。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，FLAIR仅凭文本推理即可生成高质量手术视频，无需辅助条件；在SurgMetrics上的验证显示其与人类感知的一致性优于传统指标。
AI.conclusion: FLAIR为参考自由手术视频生成提供了可行方案，并通过新数据集与新评估指标弥补了细粒度动作数据与临床评估标准的缺失。

title: UniCSI Towards a Universal Wi-Fi CSI Encoder for Ubiquitous Human Sensing
summary: Wi-Fi sensing promises to turn the everyday wireless signals that already surround us into ubiquitous sensors for human sensing. However, a fundamental obstacle is that CSI is acquired under diverse device-specific configurations, including different subcarrier counts, bandwidths, and carrier bands. Consequently, the resulting CSI tensors vary in both spectral resolution and tensor shape, making heterogeneous modeling challenging. Standard architectures struggle with such heterogeneity, forcing lossy pre-processing which compromises the underlying signal. To bridge this gap, we present UniCSI, a unified foundation architecture that directly operates on heterogeneous CSI while preserving the integrity of the native waveform. UniCSI hinges on two core innovations: (1) a physics-informed RF tokenizer that encodes each frequency channel based on its fractional position within the physical spectrum rather than rigid array indices. It preserves intrinsic spectral coherence and enables seamless, frequency resolution-agnostic processing across arbitrary sensing configurations. (2) a spectral aggregator that distills variable-length channel sequences into a fixed-size spectral signature, effectively decoupling the feature dimensionality from the physical subcarrier spacing. Extensive evaluations on a large-scale corpus of 25 heterogeneous public datasets, spanning 14 to 2048 subcarriers, 20 to 160 MHz bandwidth, and the 2.4 and 5 GHz bands, demonstrate that native heterogeneous ingestion substantially improves cross-domain transfer under both supervised and self-supervised training schemes, particularly in regimes where fixed-grid architectures fail to generalize.

AI.tldr: 提出 UniCSI 统一基础架构，直接在异构 CSI 上建模，通过物理感知 RF 分词器与频谱聚合器保留原生波形完整性，在 25 个异构数据集上显著提升跨域迁移性能。
AI.motivation: Wi-Fi 感知利用环境中的无线信号实现人体感知，但 CSI 在不同设备配置下（子载波数、带宽、频段各异）导致张量的频谱分辨率和形状不一致，异构建模困难。现有标准架构难以处理这种异构性，只能采用有损预处理，破坏了原始信号。因此需要一个能直接处理异构 CSI 的统一架构。
AI.method: UniCSI 包含两项核心创新：(1) 物理感知 RF 分词器，依据每个频率信道在物理频谱中的分数位置而非固定数组索引进行编码，保持内在频谱相干性，实现频率分辨率无关的处理；(2) 频谱聚合器，将变长信道序列蒸馏为固定尺寸的频谱签名，使特征维度与物理子载波间隔解耦。
AI.result: 在 25 个异构公开数据集（14–2048 个子载波、20–160 MHz 带宽、2.4 与 5 GHz 频段）上评估，原生异构输入在监督与自监督训练下均显著提升跨域迁移，尤其在固定网格架构无法泛化的场景中表现突出。
AI.conclusion: UniCSI 作为统一基础架构，可直接消费异构 CSI 并保留原生波形完整性，有效解决设备配置多样性带来的建模难题，为跨域 Wi-Fi 感知提供了可扩展的方案。

title: GAGR-Lab: Evaluating Joint Spatial-Geometric and Analytic Function Reasoning
summary: Joint spatial-geometric and analytic function reasoning requires translating a perceived spatial configuration into a symbolic function whose executed curve satisfies geometric constraints. We present GAGR-Lab, a framework for measuring this capability through Cartesian game scenes, explicit function semantics, and authoritative Rust trajectory execution. It distinguishes spatial perception, metric grounding, geometric relations, function interpretation, function construction, and constrained synthesis. We specify four configurable scene-difficulty presets and a prospective 24-cell diagnostic design, while reporting only the subset actually evaluated.
