AI.tldr: 本文针对人脸去识别（FDeID）评估碎片化问题，从数据与指标两方面提出统一评估协议：构建了人口统计平衡、身份多样性高的基准数据集 UtilFace，并提出一致性范式下的分层评估指标 HiFD，将身份抑制、三级效用保持与图像质量统一为单一可解释分数。基于该协议对对抗、GAN及扩散类方法进行系统比较，揭示了既有协议下不可见的权衡与失效模式，并开源基准与工具包。
AI.motivation: 现有FDeID评估协议存在根本性碎片化：指标不一致、数据集异构、标注覆盖不全，导致面向不同效用维度（如关键点保持与表情保持）的方法在不同基准、不同指标下报告结果，跨方法比较不可行。因此需要从数据与指标两个层面重新审视并统一FDeID评估。
AI.method: 数据层面：提出 UtilFace 基准，通过身份感知清洗、分辨率增强与分层过滤，从四个大规模人脸数据集构建人口统计平衡、身份多样性高的评测集。指标层面：提出 HiFD 分层评估指标，采用一致性范式——所有分量均基于预训练估计器在原图与去识别图上的输出计算，直接量化身份抑制程度与下游可感知效用的保留程度；将面部信号组织为宏观（L1）、微观（L2）与不可感知（L3）三级效用层次，并将五个分量通过加权调和平均聚合为单一可解释分数，支持可配置的特定应用剖面。基于该统一协议对对抗、GAN与扩散类方法开展系统比较。
AI.result: 在统一协议下对对抗、GAN及扩散类FDeID方法进行综合比较研究，揭示了在既有协议下不可见的权衡关系与失效模式。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提供了数据与指标一体化的FDeID统一评估协议，实现跨方法的可比评估，并开源基准与评估工具包，以促进隐私保护人脸分析领域系统化、可复现的研究。

title: Force without transmission: a depth-induced rank collapse that no loss on the representation reopens
summary: Training can drive a transformer into a rank collapse: all token representations point in one direction, and learning stops. In a related collapse of attention, a loss term with a bounded corrective force repairs the network during the run. We ask whether such a term repairs rank collapse. We collapse small transformers by weakening their skip connection and treat copies of the collapsed network. No added loss term repaired the collapse, although the stronger kind pushed with about a tenth of the task gradient. The reason was the path, not the strength. The task gradient no longer reached the query and key weights, which decide where attention looks, and the added term's gradient faded before the blocks where the collapse forms. Restoring the skip connection, which changes no weight, reopened this path at once. The rank then recovered, but only far above the scale of collapse. After a burst of high learning rate the path stayed open and the rank recovered untreated. Registered predictions from the path ranked recovery times but did not transfer to this cause. In every case the loss stayed above that of a healthy network after the rank recovered. Whether a collapsed network can be repaired depends on whether the gradient still reaches the weights that must change, not on how strongly a loss term pushes.

AI.tldr: 研究探讨秩坍缩（rank collapse）可否通过附加损失项修复，发现决定修复成败的是梯度路径而非矫正力度。
AI.motivation: 过往工作中，注意力坍缩可通过一个有界矫正力的损失项在训练中修复网络。作者想检验同类损失项能否修复另一种坍缩——所有token表示指向同一方向的秩坍缩（rank collapse）。
AI.method: 通过削弱skip connection使小型transformer发生坍缩，并复制这些坍缩网络进行对照实验：加入不同强度的矫正损失项，观察梯度能否到达query/key权重；再通过恢复skip connection（不改变任何权重）来重开梯度路径；并在高学习率冲击后检验无干预下的恢复情况。
AI.result: 没有任何附加损失项能修复坍缩，即使较强的那种以约任务梯度十分之一的力度推动。原因是路径而非强度：任务梯度不再到达决定注意力关注的query/key权重，附加项的梯度在坍缩形成所在block之前就已衰减。恢复skip connection可立即重开该路径，秩随之恢复但仅在远高于坍缩的尺度上；高学习率冲击后路径保持打开，秩在无干预下自行恢复。基于路径的注册预测虽能对恢复时间排序，但并不能迁移到这一成因。所有情况下，秩恢复后损失仍高于健康网络。
AI.conclusion: 坍缩网络能否被修复取决于梯度是否仍能到达必须改变的权重，而非损失项的推动强度。

title: When to Unpair: Regulating Pairing Dependence in Medical Visual In-Context Learning
summary: Visual in-context learning (ICL), well suited to label-scarce medical imaging, uses support image-label pairs to demonstrate input-output mappings, while the labels collectively indicate the requested task. We diagnose dependence on individual pairings with a test-time derangement that reassigns every support label to another support image while preserving the query, support images, and label multiset. The resulting pairing gap, defined as shuffled-minus-matched performance, shows that all four released models depend on the pairing, to widely varying degrees. Further analysis of a paired-trained model reveals support-associated spurious regions and lesion-size biases even with real, unaltered supports, alongside sensitivity to mis-registered support labels. To regulate this dependence, we introduce a late unpairing curriculum (LUC), which starts with matched training and then applies random unpairing, replacing each support label with that of another support in the same episode. LUC nearly closes the pairing gap on two backbones while maintaining or improving matched-support performance across all evaluated task types, with gains extending to held-out tasks and cross-dataset episodes. It also mitigates these failure modes. On BraTS whole-tumor segmentation, matched-support DSC rises from 0.733 to 0.857 while the gap shrinks from -0.184 to -0.008. In a released model, brief fine-tuning with random unpairing reduces the gap. A reversed curriculum that places the same number of unpairing epochs at the start of training leaves a large gap. This shows that pairing dependence is shaped by the order of training and not only by the amount of unpaired training.

AI.tldr: 论文诊断医学视觉上下文学习中的支撑样本配对依赖，提出后置解配对课程（LUC）以削弱该依赖。
AI.motivation: 视觉上下文学习适合标注稀缺的医学影像，但其推理依赖支撑图像-标签对的配对关系。作者希望通过扰动测试验证模型的配对依赖程度，并分析其失败模式以提升鲁棒性。
AI.method: 提出测试时错排（derangement）实验：将所有支撑标签重新分配给其他支撑图像，保持查询、支撑图像与标签多重集不变，由此定义配对差距（打乱-匹配性能差）。进一步分析配对训练模型的伪相关区域、病灶大小偏置及对标签错配的敏感性。提出后置解配对课程（LUC）：先匹配训练，再随机解配对，用同一episode内其他支撑标签替换当前标签；并设置反向课程作为对照。
AI.result: 四个已发布模型均存在不同程度的配对依赖。LUC在两个骨干网络上几乎消除配对差距，并在所有任务类型上保持或提升匹配支撑性能，泛化到留出任务与跨数据集episode，同时缓解失败模式。BraTS全肿瘤分割中，匹配支撑DSC从0.733升至0.857，差距从-0.184缩至-0.008。对已发布模型少量随机解配对微调即可缩小差距；而反向课程（解配对置于训练初期）仍保留大差距。
AI.conclusion: 配对依赖由训练顺序塑造，而非仅由解配对训练量决定；后置解配对课程能有效降低配对依赖并提升医学视觉上下文学习性能与鲁棒性。

title: TR-PTQ: High-Accuracy Integer-Only Transformer Post Training Quantization via Taylor Region Reformulation
summary: Post-training quantization (PTQ) enables efficient deployment, yet transformer architectures remain challenging to quantize due to nonlinear layers. While existing methods attribute accuracy loss to insufficient numerical precision, often necessitating floating-point fallbacks, we demonstrate that degradation is actually driven by specific structural error sources. We find that learned scale parameters in normalization layers and compounded approximations in GELU are the primary error contributors, whereas SoftMax remains inherently robust to aggressive quantization. To address these bottlenecks, we introduce TR-PTQ, a unified integer-only formulation using shared Taylor Region (TR) exponential and logarithm primitives. This approach allows computationally expensive operations, including division and square roots, to be performed entirely in the log-domain via standard integer arithmetic. Combined with a calibration-free, outlier-aware optimization for LayerNorm parameters, our method eliminates the need for floating-point hardware units for nonlinearities, achieving less than 1.5\% absolute accuracy degradation across vision and language benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TR-PTQ，通过对非线性层的结构化误差分析，指出归一化层缩放参数与GELU复合近似是主要误差来源，构建基于共享Taylor Region指数/对数原语的全整数公式，实现无非浮点回退的PTQ，误差小于1.5%。
AI.motivation: 现有PTQ方法多将Transformer量化精度损失归因于数值精度不足，从而引入浮点回退，缺乏对误差来源的结构性分析，导致实现复杂且依赖浮点硬件单元。
AI.method: 通过分析非线性层的误差来源，发现LayerNorm学习缩放参数与GELU复合近似为主要误差贡献者，SoftMax对激进量化本身鲁棒。据此提出TR-PTQ：统一的整数公式，共享Taylor Region指数与对数原语，将除法、平方根等运算在log域用整数算术完成；并对LayerNorm参数采用免校准、离群值感知的优化。
AI.result: 在视觉与语言基准上实现小于1.5%的绝对精度下降，且非线性运算无需浮点硬件单元，消除了浮点回退。
AI.conclusion: 误差主要源于特定结构而非整体数值精度；采用共享Taylor Region原语的整数域统一公式可有效解决Transformer PTQ瓶颈，实现高效、纯整数部署。

title: Position Forcing: Self-Conditioning 3D Generation
summary: Recent single-stage 3D generative models commonly adopt VecSet representations, encoding 3D shapes as unordered sets of latent tokens. However, compared with two-stage methods that provide explicit positional guidance, these models must implicitly infer token positions throughout denoising, limiting their generation quality. We observe that, despite the absence of explicit positional conditioning, VecSet tokens retain recoverable spatial correspondences. Building on this observation, we propose Position Forcing, a position-based self-conditioning framework. During denoising, Position Forcing recovers token positions from the current clean latent estimate, quantizes them at progressively finer resolutions according to the denoising stage, and feeds the resulting positional encodings back into the diffusion Transformer. This progressively refined positional feedback provides spatial guidance at a granularity appropriate to each denoising stage, guiding shape generation along a coarse-to-fine trajectory and substantially improving generation quality without a separate position generation stage. Experiments demonstrate that Position Forcing achieves strong performance among single-stage 3D generative methods and outperforms several competitive multi-stage approaches.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Position Forcing，一种面向单阶段 VecSet 式 3D 生成模型的位置自条件框架。它在去噪过程中从当前干净 latent 估计中恢复 token 位置，并按去噪阶段以由粗到细的分辨率量化，将位置编码回馈给扩散 Transformer，从而在无需独立位置生成阶段的前提下显著提升生成质量。
AI.motivation: 单阶段 3D 生成模型常用 VecSet 表示，将 3D 形状编码为无序隐 token 集合，相比提供显式位置引导的两阶段方法，这类模型需在去噪全过程中隐式推断 token 位置，限制了生成质量。作者观察到，即使没有显式位置条件，VecSet token 仍保留了可恢复的空间对应关系，因此希望利用这一性质弥补位置引导的缺失。
AI.method: 提出 Position Forcing 位置自条件框架：在去噪过程中，从当前干净 latent 估计中恢复 token 位置，依据去噪阶段以逐步更细的分辨率对其进行量化，并将所得位置编码反馈回扩散 Transformer。该逐步细化的位置反馈为不同去噪阶段提供粒度匹配的空间引导，使形状生成沿由粗到细的轨迹进行，且无需单独的位置生成阶段。
AI.result: 实验表明，Position Forcing 在单阶段 3D 生成方法中取得强劲性能，并优于若干有竞争力的多阶段方法。
AI.conclusion: VecSet token 中存在可恢复的空间对应关系，可被用于构建位置自条件；通过按去噪阶段逐步细化位置反馈，可在单阶段框架内实现由粗到细的生成引导，显著提升生成质量，同时避免引入独立的位置生成阶段。

title: Efficient Patch-Based Anomaly Detection Fused with Diffusion Driven Generative Modeling for Semiconductor Wafer Bin Map Open Set Anomaly Detection
summary: Spatial defect signatures on wafer bin maps (WBMs) trace yield loss to specific process faults, yet supervised classifiers recognize only the defect types seen during training, and one-class detectors built on a single mechanism tend to capture either local structural deviations or global distributional violations, but rarely both. This work proposes a hybrid one-class framework that couples a patch-based student-teacher detector (EfficientAD) with a denoising diffusion probabilistic model (DDPM) used for partial-diffusion reconstruction, and fuses their percentile-calibrated scores through a fixed convex combination. Trained on only 700 normal wafers from the WM-38K mixed-type dataset and evaluated on 18,658 held-out wafers, the fused detector reached an AUROC of 0.9985 and reduced misclassifications from 852 (DDPM) and 1,412 (EfficientAD) to 618, with all pairwise differences significant at p < 0.001. Beyond aggregate accuracy, the analysis shows that the gain arises from weakly overlapping errors between the two modules, yet fixed-weight fusion recovers only 40-70% of the correction available to an oracle selector. Under the benchmark's inverted class balance, average precision and F1 saturate, while the Matthews correlation coefficient and negative predictive value expose unreliable normal predictions. Pixel-level maps further show that strong image-level separability does not imply spatial localization, and the diffusion module succeeds as a local density prior rather than through global geometric reasoning. These findings motivate sample-adaptive fusion and imbalance-aware evaluation of hybrid wafer anomaly detectors.

AI.tldr: 提出EfficientAD与DDPM的混合单类检测框架，经百分位校准后按固定凸组合融合，在WM-38K上AUROC达0.9985，误分类由852/1412降至618。
AI.motivation: 监督分类器仅能识别训练阶段见过的缺陷类型，而基于单一机制的单类检测器往往只能捕捉局部结构偏差或全局分布异常之一，难以兼顾；因此需要融合两类互补机制以提升晶圆图异常检测的泛化性与准确性。
AI.method: 将基于图像块的student-teacher检测器（EfficientAD）与用于部分扩散重建的去噪扩散概率模型（DDPM）耦合，对两模块分数进行百分位校准后以固定凸组合权重融合；仅用WM-38K混合类型数据集中的700片正常晶圆训练，在18,658片留出晶圆上评估。
AI.result: 融合检测器AUROC达0.9985，误分类由DDPM的852与EfficientAD的1,412降至618，所有成对差异p<0.001。增益源于两模块错误的弱重叠，但固定权重融合仅能获得oracle选择器可用纠错的40–70%。在基准的倒置类别平衡下，平均精度与F1饱和，而MCC与阴性预测值揭示了正常预测的不可靠性。像素级图显示，图像级强可分性并不意味着空间定位能力，扩散模块实为局部密度先验而非全局几何推理。
AI.conclusion: 混合单类框架在晶圆图异常检测中显著优于单机制方法，但固定权重融合远未充分利用互补性；结论支持采用样本自适应融合策略，并对混合检测器开展面向类别不平衡的评估。

title: Real-Time Joint Audio-Video Generation by Parallel Adapter Composition
summary: Deploying a joint audio-video diffusion transformer for real-time, interactive generation normally requires two essential modifications: block-autoregressive attention, so frames can be emitted before the whole clip is finished, and few-step sampling, so each block is cheap. Conventionally, the streaming video literature obtains both capabilities from a chained pipeline. It first distills a bidirectional teacher into a causal student, then into a few-step one, or proceeds in reverse order. Each stage of such a chain fine-tunes the weights the previous one produced, so a later objective can undo an earlier capability. Following the idea of model merging, we show that on a packed audio-video backbone the two capabilities can be acquired in parallel. A causal adapter is trained against the frozen backbone, and an off-the-shelf few-step adapter provides the few-step capability. As the two edit different functional axes, we predict, and then verify, that their weight-update directions are near-orthogonal, without any explicit orthogonality constraint during training. Orthogonal updates should combine without interfering, so parallel composition is a direct sum. The two adapters are simply added at inference, with no joint training, yielding few-step, streaming audio-video whose image quality tracks the bidirectional teacher. Compared to the chained baselines, the composed model matches or beats them on most metrics, making parallel composition a practical approach. The resulting streaming system generates joint audio-video in real time, $\approx$26 fps at $480\times832$ without quantization, and sustains 30 s of continuous generation with stable image quality.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出用模型合并的思路，在冻结的联合音视频扩散Transformer骨干上并行训练因果适配器与现成少步适配器，将两者直接相加即可同时获得块自回归（流式）和少步采样能力，实现实时交互式音视频生成。
AI.motivation: 传统流式视频生成通过链式流程先后蒸馏出因果学生和少步学生（或反向），每阶段都在前一阶段权重上微调，后一目标可能破坏先前获得的能力。
AI.method: 在packed音视频骨干上，对冻结骨干训练因果适配器，并复用现成的少步适配器；两者编辑不同功能轴，预测并验证其权重更新方向近似正交（无需显式正交约束），因此可并行组合（直和），推理时直接相加，无需联合训练。
AI.result: 组合模型在多数指标上匹配或超越链式基线，图像质量接近双向教师模型；流式系统在480×832下无需量化即可实时生成联合音视频，约26 fps，并可稳定持续生成30秒。
AI.conclusion: 并行组合是一种实用方法，可在不进行联合训练的情况下同时获得少步与流式音视频生成能力。

title: Temporal Predictive Multiplicity: Equally Accurate Time Series Models Yield Different Forecast Trajectories
summary: Models with near-identical predictive performance can yield substantially different predictions, a phenomenon known as predictive multiplicity. Prior work has mostly studied this at the level of individual scalar outputs. In time-series forecasting, however, predictions across horizons jointly define a trajectory, and horizon-wise comparisons can hide important differences in predictive behavior. To address this problem, we introduce temporal predictive multiplicity, a framework that characterizes disagreement over complete forecast trajectories among models with near-identical predictive performance. We show that constraining predictive performance alone can still admit a broad range of different trajectories. We further show that constraining multiplicity at individual horizons partially reduces, but does not eliminate, trajectory-level multiplicity. Experiments with 19 neural forecasting architectures on 11 datasets confirm that near-optimal models can exhibit substantial variability in the forecast trajectories they produce, and trajectory-level disagreement is largely unrelated to horizon-wise disagreement. Our framework, therefore, exposes a gap in existing multiplicity studies: models with indistinguishable predictive performance imply fundamentally different temporal trajectories, with consequential downstream effects.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"时间预测多重性"框架，刻画预测性能几乎相同的模型在完整预测轨迹上的分歧，并通过19种神经预测架构、11个数据集的实验证明轨迹级多重性无法由逐horizon约束消除。
AI.motivation: 已有关于预测多重性（predictive multiplicity）的研究主要聚焦于单个标量输出层面。然而在时间序列预测中，各horizon的预测共同构成一条轨迹，仅做逐horizon比较会掩盖预测行为的重要差异。因此需要一个刻画完整预测轨迹分歧的框架。
AI.method: 提出"时间预测多重性"框架：以"预测性能近乎相同"的模型集合为对象，刻画其在完整预测轨迹上的分歧。分析中分别考察仅约束预测性能、以及在单个horizon上约束多重性这两种情形对轨迹级多重性的影响。实验使用19种神经预测架构在11个数据集上进行验证。
AI.result: 仅约束预测性能时，仍可存在广泛的、不同的预测轨迹；在单个horizon上约束多重性只能部分降低、而不能消除轨迹级多重性。实验证实，近乎最优的模型在预测轨迹上表现出显著可变性，且轨迹级分歧与逐horizon分歧基本不相关。
AI.conclusion: 该框架揭示了现有多重性研究的缺口：性能难以区分的模型实则隐含根本不同的时间轨迹，并会带来下游影响。

title: Explicit Geometric Chain-of-Thought for Vision-Language-Action in Autonomous Driving
comment: 21 pages, 9 figures. The code is available at https://github.com/TabGuigui/GeoCoTDrive
summary: Vision-language-action~(VLA) models have emerged as a promising paradigm for autonomous driving. However, existing VLA models still suffer from a fundamental mismatch: driving actions require precise 3D geometric cues, while visual-language understanding and reasoning are largely conducted in a 2D semantic space. In this paper, we propose GeoCoTDrive, an explicit geometric chain-of-thought framework that grounds geometry in a planning-oriented manner. GeoCoTDrive follows a think with 2D first, drive with dedicated 3D priors paradigm. It first grounds 2D regions corresponding to decision-critical cues, and then retrieves localized 3D priors by sampling features from a geometric foundation model within the grounded regions. These localized geometric features are interleaved into the autoregressive context to support the trajectory generation. To supervise this process, we introduce planning-relevant grounding, a new region-level grounding task that focuses on local spatial cues directly affecting ego planning decisions, and construct the PlanningGrounding dataset to endow VLAs with planning-oriented grounding capability. Experiments across multiple end-to-end autonomous driving benchmarks show that GeoCoTDrive consistently improves safety-critical planning performance, demonstrating the effectiveness of the explicit geometric chain-of-thought process for VLA-based planning.

AI.tldr: 提出GeoCoTDrive，通过显式几何思维链将3D几何先验引入VLA自动驾驶规划，并构建规划导向的grounding任务与数据集。
AI.motivation: 现有VLA模型存在根本性错配：驾驶动作需要精确的3D几何线索，而视觉-语言理解与推理大多在2D语义空间中进行，导致几何信息缺失，影响规划决策的准确性。
AI.method: GeoCoTDrive采用"think with 2D first, drive with dedicated 3D priors"范式：先定位与决策关键线索对应的2D区域，再在定位区域内从几何基础模型中采样特征以检索局部化3D先验；这些局部几何特征被交错插入自回归上下文，用于支撑轨迹生成。同时提出规划相关grounding（planning-relevant grounding）这一区域级grounding任务，聚焦直接影响自车规划决策的局部空间线索，并构建PlanningGrounding数据集以赋予VLA规划导向的grounding能力。
AI.result: 在多个端到端自动驾驶基准上，GeoCoTDrive持续提升安全关键（safety-critical）的规划性能，验证了显式几何思维链对VLA规划的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 显式几何思维链能有效弥合2D语义推理与3D几何规划之间的鸿沟，为VLA自动驾驶规划提供了一种可行且有效的解决路径。

title: Beyond Reward Suppression: Near-Optimal Offline Attacks on Warm-Start Bandits with Bounded Rewards
summary: Adversarial attacks on bandits aim to mislead a learner toward a target arm while keeping the attack cost small. Existing attacks typically achieve this by suppressing non-target arms. In practice, however, manipulation such as fake reviews often directly promotes the target item. We study this gap through bounded offline attacks on warm-start bandits, where an attacker can inject only valid action-reward pairs into the warm-start history before deployment. We show that target promotion is not merely a heuristic: when the target arm lies near the lower reward boundary, any order-optimal-cost attack against UCB that makes it selected in nearly all online rounds must allocate a nonvanishing fraction of its cost to the target arm. We then design an attack that achieves the optimal sublinear cost and characterize its allocation between target promotion and non-target suppression. We further extend the attack to Thompson Sampling, $ε$-greedy, and a broader class of bandit algorithms. Experiments on real-world and synthetic data validate the effectiveness of our attacks.

AI.tldr: 本文研究针对热启动多臂老虎机（warm-start bandits）的有界离线攻击，提出"目标臂推广"机制：攻击者仅向热启动历史注入合法的动作-奖励对。理论证明，当目标臂位于低奖励边界附近时，任何具有最优阶攻击成本的攻击必须将不可忽略的成本份额分配给目标臂本身，而非仅抑制非目标臂。作者设计了一种达到最优次线性成本的攻击，并刻画了其在目标推广与非目标抑制间的成本分配，进而扩展至Thompson Sampling、ε-greedy及更广泛的算法类，实验验证其有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有针对老虎机的对抗攻击主要通过抑制非目标臂来误导学习器选择目标臂，但现实中诸如虚假评论等操纵手段往往直接推广目标物品。这一实践与现有攻击范式之间存在明显差距，作者据此提出需研究直接的目标臂推广策略，并探究其成本最优性与资源分配规律。
AI.method: 采用有界离线攻击设定，攻击者在部署前仅能向热启动历史中注入合法的动作-奖励对。针对UCB算法，理论分析证明：当目标臂接近低奖励边界时，任何使UCB在几乎所有在线轮次中选择目标臂的、具有最优阶成本的攻击，都必须将不可忽略比例的成本分配给目标臂。基于此设计达到最优次线性成本的攻击策略，并刻画目标推广与非目标抑制之间的成本分配。进一步将攻击拓展至Thompson Sampling、ε-greedy及更广泛的算法类，并在真实与合成数据上进行实验验证。
AI.result: 理论上证明目标推广的必要性（不可忽略成本份额必须投向目标臂），并给出达到最优次线性成本的攻击设计及其在目标推广与非目标抑制间的成本分配刻画；攻击方法可扩展至Thompson Sampling、ε-greedy等更广算法类；真实世界与合成数据实验验证了攻击的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 目标臂推广并非仅是启发式手段，而是在低奖励边界条件下实现最优阶攻击成本的必然要求。所提攻击在保证最优次线性成本的同时，明确了目标推广与非目标抑制间的资源分配，并具备对多种老虎机算法的通用性，为理解现实操纵场景下的离线攻击提供了理论基础与实用方法。

title: MOTIP2: Spatial Priors for End-to-End Multi-Object Tracking
comment: Accepted at BMVC 2026. 27 pages (14 pages main paper, appendix and references), 6 figures, 10 tables
summary:
End-to-end multi-object trackers have narrowed the gap with classical tracking-by-detection on association-difficult benchmarks. Yet they still make spatially implausible errors no classical tracker would, such as assigning one identity to objects on opposite sides of the frame. A model could learn to avoid them, but tracking annotations are scarce, so we encode spatial priors explicitly instead, while keeping inference fully end-to-end with no post-hoc association.
  We propose three spatial priors, at the data, loss, and representation stages. Spatial ID Switches bias trajectory permutations toward spatially overlapping objects, reducing the mismatch between training and inference confusions. Spatial ID Loss scales each identity's penalty by its box distance, so a distant switch costs more than a nearby one. Spatial Anchor gives each track token its frame position, an explicit spatial cue for attention.
  We instantiate the three priors in MOTIP2, a tracker adapted from MOTIP and built on the real-time DEIM detection transformer. Trained without extra data, its main model, MOTIP2-L, sets a new state of the art: 73.4 HOTA on DanceTrack, 76.0 on SportsMOT, and 71.1 IDF1 on PersonPath22. MOTIP2 is a family of models spanning the speed-accuracy trade-off: a lighter model, MOTIP2-S, matches the original MOTIP at over 3x the speed, and MOTIP2-X reaches 74.8 HOTA on DanceTrack.

AI.tldr: 本文提出在数据、损失与表示三个层面显式编码空间先验，并将其实例化于端到端跟踪器MOTIP2中，在不引入额外数据与后处理关联的前提下，刷新DanceTrack、SportsMOT与PersonPath22的最优性能。
AI.motivation: 端到端多目标跟踪器在关联困难基准上已逼近跟踪检测范式，但仍会产生经典方法不会出现的空间不合理错误（如把画面两端的目标分配为同一身份）。模型本可学会避免此类错误，但跟踪标注稀缺，因此作者选择显式编码空间先验，同时保持推理完全端到端、无后处理关联。
AI.method: 提出三种空间先验，分别作用于数据、损失与表示阶段：1) Spatial ID Switches：使轨迹置换偏向空间重叠的目标，缩小训练与推理阶段混淆分布的不匹配；2) Spatial ID Loss：按边框距离缩放各身份的惩罚，使远距离误切换代价高于近距离；3) Spatial Anchor：为每个轨迹token提供其帧内位置，作为注意力机制的显式空间线索。将三者实例化于MOTIP2，其基于MOTIP改进并构建在实时DEIM检测Transformer之上。
AI.result: 在无额外数据训练下，主模型MOTIP2-L取得新最优：DanceTrack 73.4 HOTA、SportsMOT 76.0、PersonPath22 71.1 IDF1。MOTIP2构成覆盖速度—精度权衡的模型族：轻量版MOTIP2-S以超过3倍速度匹配原MOTIP，MOTIP2-X在DanceTrack上达到74.8 HOTA。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式注入空间先验而非依赖稀缺标注学习，可在保持端到端推理的同时有效抑制空间不合理关联错误，并在多个关联困难基准上取得领先性能，同时提供可覆盖不同速度—精度需求的模型族。

title: A Drosophila Whole-Connectome Network Can Learn Human-Designed Cognitive Tasks
summary: Can a biological wiring diagram serve as a useful computational substrate beyond the behaviors for which it evolved? We use the publicly released MaleCNS v1.0 connectome, reconstructed from a single adult male Drosophila specimen, as the fixed recurrent topology of an artificial network. We train separate models for bounded addition and for a controlled grounded relational language task built from a fixed 100-word lexicon. In both models, one scalar is learned per anatomical edge. The anatomical graph reaches 92.77% mean accuracy on held-out addition, compared with 67.93% for directed degree-preserving rewires. On the strict paired language endpoint, which matches original and order-reversed scenes to their corresponding descriptions, it reaches 61.59% across four fixed interfaces, compared with 44.17% for matched rewires. At the canonical interface, it ranks first in a fixed 21-graph comparison. On the matched 48-group intervention subset, shuffling task-defined sensory features reduces its score from 60.94% to 19.27%. Together, these results show that higher-order MaleCNS wiring provides a reusable inductive bias for bounded addition and grounded relational language.

AI.tldr: 该研究将雄性果蝇全脑连接组（MaleCNS v1.0）作为固定循环拓扑的人工网络基底，训练有界加法与基于100词词表的具身关系语言任务，证明该生物接线图可提供可复用的归纳偏置。
AI.motivation: 探究生物接线图（连接组）是否能超越其进化所对应的行为，充当通用的计算基底。作者希望验证：即便不针对特定任务优化拓扑，真实的解剖连接结构本身是否具备可迁移的计算优势，从而为神经形态计算与生物学启发的网络设计提供依据。
AI.method: 以公开的MaleCNS v1.0连接组（源自单个成年雄性果蝇样本重建）作为人工网络的固定循环拓扑。每条解剖边学习一个标量权重。分别训练两类模型：有界加法任务，以及由固定100词词表构建的受控具身关系语言任务。设置对照基线为保持有向度分布的重连（directed degree-preserving rewires），并在严格配对语言端点上跨四个固定接口评估，另在规范接口上做21图固定比较，并开展48组匹配干预的子集实验（打乱任务定义的感官特征）。
AI.result: 有界加法留出集平均准确率92.77%，度保持重连为67.93%；严格配对语言端点（将原始与顺序倒置场景匹配到对应描述）四个固定接口平均61.59%，匹配重连为44.17%；在规范接口的21图固定比较中排名第一。在匹配的48组干预子集上，打乱任务定义感官特征使得分从60.94%降至19.27%。
AI.conclusion: MaleCNS的高阶接线结构能为有界加法与具身关系语言提供可复用的归纳偏置，表明生物连接组可作为通用计算基底，其优势不能仅由度分布等简单拓扑统计解释，且模型确实依赖任务定义的感官特征输入。

title: Gaussian Density Splatting Network
comment: This is the preprint version of the paper and supplemental material to appear in NeurIPS, 2026. Please cite the final published version
summary: This paper proposes a novel crowd counting approach, the Gaussian Density Splatting Network (GDSNet). Unlike methods that rely on conventional, grid-based density maps and are sensitive to spatial resolution, GDSNet represents a crowd as a superposition of continuous 2D Gaussian primitives. Our approach is built upon two key contributions. First, we introduce a control-point-based fitting mechanism to structure the prediction of the Gaussian parameters. We design a method to allocate a set of control points that define local regions, from which features are pooled to regress each primitive's parameters. Second, we adapt a differentiable Gaussian Splatting framework to the counting task by parameterizing each primitive with geometric parameters and a scalar density mass. This formulation allows the network to be trained end-to-end via spatial matching of differentiably rendered density maps, naturally providing both local density supervision and global count optimization. Extensive evaluations on four standard benchmarks show GDSNet consistently outperforms the state of the art.

AI.tldr: 本文提出高斯密度泼溅网络（GDSNet），用连续2D高斯基元叠加表示人群，替代传统网格密度图，在四个标准基准上持续超越SOTA。
AI.motivation: 传统基于网格密度图的人群计数方法依赖固定空间分辨率、对分辨率变化敏感，限制了表示的灵活性与精度。
AI.method: 两项核心设计：(1) 基于控制点的拟合机制，分配控制点定义局部区域并池化特征以回归各基元参数；(2) 将可微高斯泼溅框架适配到计数任务，每个基元由几何参数和标量密度质量参数化，通过可微渲染密度图的空间匹配进行端到端训练。
AI.result: 在四个标准基准上，GDSNet 一致优于当前最先进方法。
AI.conclusion: 将人群表示为连续高斯基元叠加并结合可微泼溅渲染，可同时提供局部密度监督与全局计数优化，是一种有效且优于网格密度图的计数范式。

title: Oscillatory Neural Dynamics over Sheaves
summary: Effective long-range propagation remains a central challenge in graph neural networks, as increasing a model's propagation depth does not guarantee that distant nodes effectively influence each other. Sheaf neural networks enrich graph propagation through matrix-valued transport between stalks; still, this expressivity alone does not automatically imply effective long-range communication. We introduce ONDA, a long-range graph learning framework based on operator-valued information waves. Stalk-valued representations evolve through second-order dynamics governed by learned sheaf transport operators, combining wave-like propagation with expressive local geometry. We characterize long-range influence through a stalk-wise sensitivity analysis and show that the cross-influence never vanishes. Across long-range propagation, severe graph bottlenecks, graph transfer, and heterophilic benchmarks, ONDA consistently improves over scalar wave propagation, diffusive sheaf baselines, and state-of-the-art models, demonstrating the benefit of coupling wave dynamics with matrix-valued transport.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出ONDA——一个基于算子值信息波的长程图学习框架。它把茎值表示放在二阶动力学中，由学习到的层传输算子驱动，将类波传播与富有表现力的局部几何结合，并通过茎级敏感度分析证明跨节点影响永不消失。
AI.motivation: 图神经网络中长程传播仍是核心挑战：单纯增加传播深度并不能保证远距离节点有效相互影响。层神经网络虽通过茎间的矩阵值传输增强了图传播，但这种表达力本身并不自动带来有效的长程通信。因此需要一种机制，将类波动力学与矩阵值传输耦合起来，以实现真正的长程信息交流。
AI.method: 提出ONDA框架：茎值表示通过由学习到的层传输算子支配的二阶动力学进行演化，从而将类波传播与富有表现力的局部几何结合。同时开展茎级敏感度分析来刻画长程影响。
AI.result: 在长程传播、严重图瓶颈、图迁移以及异配基准上，ONDA持续优于标量波传播、扩散型层基线以及当前最先进模型。
AI.conclusion: 将波动力学与矩阵值传输相耦合能够带来收益；茎级敏感度分析表明跨影响永不消失，验证了ONDA在长程图学习上的有效性。

title: Self-correction Optimization for Interleaved Multimodal Generation
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have made significant progress in visual understanding and generation. However, generating interleaved image--text content remains challenging, as it requires tightly integrated multimodal understanding and generation capabilities. Although existing MLLMs provide promising solutions, most rely on additional training with augmented data, which is computationally expensive and remains limited in preserving visual subjects, temporal consistency, and physical plausibility. In this work, we propose self-correction optimization (SCO), an effective training-free method for consistent interleaved generation. SCO treats the classifier-free guidance update as a reference and performs minimal self-correction under two complementary constraints, including new-event and state-preserving constraints. Specifically, the new-event constraint promotes temporal consistency across image--text sequences, while the state-preserving constraint maintains the coherence of visual subjects throughout subsequent generation steps. Experiments on challenging interleaved multimodal generation benchmarks demonstrate significant improvements in temporal coherence and visual-subject preservation. Furthermore, SCO can be extended to video generation and improves the modeling of physically grounded processes, including robot manipulation and long-horizon handcrafting.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练的自校正优化方法SCO，通过最小自校正约束提升交错图文生成的一致性与连贯性，并可扩展至视频生成。
AI.motivation: 多模态大模型在交错图文生成上仍面临挑战，现有方法多依赖增广数据的额外训练，计算成本高，且在视觉主体保持、时序一致性与物理合理性方面表现受限。
AI.method: 将无分类器引导更新视为参考，在两种互补约束下进行最小自校正：新事件约束促进图文序列的时序一致性；状态保持约束维持视觉主体在后续生成步骤中的连贯性。该方法无需训练。
AI.result: 在具有挑战性的交错多模态生成基准上，时序一致性与视觉主体保持均获得显著提升；并可扩展至视频生成，改善物理过程建模，包括机器人操作与长时程手工制作。
AI.conclusion: SCO是一种有效且免训练的一致交错生成方法，通过互补约束实现一致性与物理合理性的提升，具备向视频生成等任务迁移的潜力。

title: Matching of signal, noise and hardware timescales for filtering and forecasting of correlated noise signals
summary: Physical reservoir computing exploits the nonlinear dynamics of physical systems to process time-dependent data with greater energy efficiency than conventional machine learning approaches. However, physical reservoirs have fixed intrinsic response timescales, whereas real-world signals combine deterministic and stochastic components across multiple timescales. Here we show, using a nanoporous niobium oxide reservoir, synthetic noisy signals and cryptocurrency-price volatility, that the relationship among noise correlation time, reservoir memory and forecast horizon determines whether correlated noise is filtered or predicted. Noise varying faster than the relevant reservoir memory and forecast horizon is averaged by the reservoir, whereas the temporal structure of slower-varying noise is sufficient for algorithmic forecasting. We introduce the reservoir memory horizon and forecasting regime index to distinguish these operating regimes. These contributions demonstrate that timescale matching can guide the encoding of input time series and development of physical reservoir architectures that filter, analyse and predict stochastic signal components across distinct temporal scales.

AI.tldr: 利用纳米多孔氧化铌物理储池，揭示了噪声相关时间、储池记忆与预测时域三者匹配关系决定相关噪声是被滤波还是被预测，并提出储池记忆时域与预测机制指数来区分两种工作模式。
AI.motivation: 物理储池计算在能效上优于传统机器学习，但其本征响应时间尺度固定，而真实信号同时包含跨多个时间尺度的确定性与随机性成分，因此需要理解时间尺度匹配如何影响物理储池对随机成分的处理方式。
AI.method: 以纳米多孔氧化铌作为物理储池，输入合成含噪信号与加密货币价格波动数据，系统考察噪声相关时间、储池记忆与预测时域之间的关系；提出储池记忆时域（reservoir memory horizon）与预测机制指数（forecasting regime index）两个量化指标来刻画不同工作区间。
AI.result: 当噪声变化快于储池记忆与预测时域时，储池对其起平均（滤波）作用；当噪声变化较慢时，其时间结构足以支撑算法式预测。即噪声相关时间与储池记忆、预测时域的相对关系决定滤波或预测。
AI.conclusion: 时间尺度匹配可作为输入时间序列编码与物理储池架构设计的指导原则，使其能够在不同时间尺度上对随机信号成分进行滤波、分析与预测。

title: WxFM-XL: Adapting Univariate Foundation Models to Multi-Station Weather Forecasting
summary: With the rise of univariate time series foundation models (e.g., Sundial, Timer), initial efforts have been made to extend them to multivariate settings. However, these models mainly focus on modeling correlations among variables. When they are applied to multi-station weather forecasting, two important factors are often overlooked: (1) the spatial information of stations, and (2) different error priors of different stations relative to the foundation model. In this paper, we propose WxFM-XL, a model for adapting univariate time series foundation models to multi-station weather forecasting. WxFM-XL introduces a cross-station error correlation prior graph to capture stationwise error priors with respect to the foundation model. Building on this, we further propose a dynamic fusion mechanism that adaptively integrates a spatial correlation graph with the error correlation prior graph. Experiments on multiple datasets demonstrate that our model outperforms state of the art baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出WxFM-XL，将单变量时间序列基础模型适配到多站点天气预报，通过跨站点误差相关先验图与动态融合机制，性能超越现有最优基线。
AI.motivation: 现有多变量扩展方法主要建模变量间相关性，在多站点天气预报中忽略了两点关键因素：站点的空间信息，以及不同站点相对基础模型的误差先验差异。
AI.method: WxFM-XL引入跨站点误差相关先验图，刻画各站点相对基础模型的误差先验；在此基础上提出动态融合机制，自适应地整合空间相关图与误差相关先验图。
AI.result: 在多个数据集上的实验表明，该模型优于当前最先进的基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式建模站点误差先验并与空间相关性动态融合，可有效将单变量时间序列基础模型迁移至多站点天气预报任务。

title: GraphRectify: Graph-Based Transfer of Adversarial Example Detectors Across Neural Networks
summary: Adversarial example detectors are often tied to the classifier backbone they were trained on, limiting reuse when the protected model is replaced or upgraded. Directly transferring such detectors across backbones is challenging because different networks generally produce incompatible internal representations. We propose GraphRectify, a graph-based framework for transferring adversarial image detectors across classifier backbones. GraphRectify learns a structured representation of intermediate classifier features and adapts representations from a new backbone to the detector learned on the original model, enabling detector reuse. We evaluate GraphRectify across multiple datasets, backbone architectures, and adversarial attacks, including detector-aware adaptive attacks that jointly target the classifier and detector. Across the complete evaluation matrix, GraphRectify achieves higher aggregate ROC-AUC than training a detector from scratch on the new backbone and the evaluated transfer ablations. The gains are particularly strong for transfers between different backbone families and when sufficient data are available. In contrast, training from scratch remains competitive in the most data-limited settings. These results show that adversarial detection knowledge can transfer effectively across heterogeneous classifier architectures rather than being relearned whenever the protected backbone changes.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出GraphRectify，通过图结构表示与特征适配实现对抗样本检测器在分类器骨干网络间的迁移复用，在多数评估场景下优于从头训练。
AI.motivation: 对抗样本检测器通常与其训练所依赖的分类器骨干网络强绑定，当被保护模型被替换或升级时，检测器无法复用。直接迁移困难，因为不同网络产生的内部特征表示通常不兼容。作者希望实现跨异构骨干的检测知识复用，避免骨干变化时重新学习。
AI.method: GraphRectify是一个基于图的框架。它学习分类器中间特征的结构化表示，并将新骨干网络的特征表示适配到在原模型上训练得到的检测器上，从而实现检测器复用。
AI.result: 在多个数据集、骨干架构和对抗攻击（包括同时针对分类器与检测器的检测器感知自适应攻击）上评估。在整个评估矩阵中，GraphRectify的聚合ROC-AUC高于在新骨干上从头训练的检测器以及所评估的迁移消融方法。跨不同骨干族以及数据充足时增益尤为明显；而在数据极度受限的设置下，从头训练仍具竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，对抗检测知识能够在异构分类器架构间有效迁移，而无需在被保护骨干变化时重新学习。

title: SGF+: Decoupling Gradient Flows for Autoregressive Video Generation
summary: Autoregressive video generation requires denoising the current frames while writing their key-value representations as context for future predictions. However, these two roles typically share parameters, and we find that their gradients exhibit distinct patterns and systematic negative alignment, hindering the joint optimization of visual quality and temporal consistency. We introduce Self Gradient Forcing Plus (SGF+), which assigns separate parameters to context writing and denoising while preserving their interaction through causal attention. Both roles are jointly optimized using the original generation objective without auxiliary losses, with context writing supervised through its contribution to future predictions. This simple change improves visual quality and long-horizon consistency over the evaluated baselines in both framewise and chunkwise generation, without additional video training data or a longer training horizon. Trained on only 5s rollouts, SGF+ supports continuous generation for up to 24 hours without long-video fine-tuning. These results highlight role-specific parameterization as an effective design principle for high-quality autoregressive video generation and native long-horizon extrapolation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 SGF+，将自回归视频生成中"写入上下文"与"去噪当前帧"两个角色分配独立参数，仅通过因果注意力交互，联合优化后显著提升视觉质量与长时一致性。
AI.motivation: 自回归视频生成中，当前帧同时承担"去噪生成"与"写入KV表示供未来预测"两个角色，但二者通常共享参数。作者发现这两个角色的梯度模式不同且存在系统性负对齐，从而阻碍视觉质量与时序一致性的联合优化。
AI.method: 提出 Self Gradient Forcing Plus（SGF+）：为"上下文写入"与"去噪"分配分离的参数，同时通过因果注意力保留二者交互；两个角色仅用原始生成目标联合优化，不引入辅助损失，其中上下文写入通过其对未来预测的贡献获得监督。
AI.result: 在逐帧与分块两种生成方式下，相较基线均提升视觉质量与长时一致性，且无需额外视频训练数据或更长训练时长；仅在 5 秒 rollout 上训练即可支持长达 24 小时的连续生成，无需长视频微调。
AI.conclusion: 角色特定参数化（role-specific parameterization）是高质量自回归视频生成与原生长时外推的有效设计原则。

title: Activation-Aware Weight Tensorization: A Calibration-Time Preconditioner for Tensor-Network LLM Compression
summary: Post-training tensor-network compression replaces Transformer linear layers with Tensor Train (TT) or Tree Tensor Network (TTN) operators, but standard decompositions minimize weight-space Frobenius error rather than functional error under the layer's activation distribution. We propose Activation-aware Weight Tensorization (AWT), a training-free calibration wrapper that preconditions each weight matrix with a diagonal activation-derived scale before an unchanged TT/TTN solver and deploys the result with only an input-side elementwise rescaling. Across Llama 3.1 8B, Ministral 8B, and Qwen2.5 7B, AWT consistently improves vanilla TT/TTN tensorization at 2-6 times compression: under single-operator replacement, AWT closes 12-35% of the WikiText perplexity gap to the dense baseline across the three model families and 2-6 times compression settings; while under multi-operator Llama suffix replacement it closes 27-60% across attention-group and all-seven-matrix settings. The gains also transfer to downstream HellaSwag and ARC-Challenge evaluations. We further show that diagonal preconditioning is a robustness-modularity tradeoff rather than a diagonal-covariance assumption: a dense full-covariance oracle wins its own weighted objective in 80/81 cases, yet diagonal AWT gives better held-out functional fidelity in 53/81 cases. Together, these results position AWT as a principled, modular preconditioner for improving functional fidelity in fixed TT/TTN compression pipelines without modifying the decomposition solver.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AWT（激活感知权重张量化），一种免训练校准包装器，在不变更TT/TTN分解求解器的前提下，通过对权重矩阵进行激活导出的对角预条件，并在部署时仅做输入侧逐元素缩放，从而提升张量网络压缩的功能保真度。
AI.motivation: 标准TT/TTN后训练压缩最小化的是权重空间的Frobenius误差，而非激活分布下的功能误差，导致压缩后模型性能损失较大。
AI.method: AWT使用激活导出的对角尺度对每个权重矩阵做预条件，再交给未修改的TT/TTN求解器；部署时仅需输入侧逐元素重缩放，无需修改求解器。
AI.result: 在Llama 3.1 8B、Ministral 8B、Qwen2.5 7B上，2-6倍压缩下：单算子替换时AWT缩小12-35%的WikiText困惑度差距，多算子Llama后缀替换时缩小27-60%；增益可迁移至HellaSwag与ARC-Challenge。对角预条件体现为鲁棒性-模块性权衡：稠密全协方差oracle在其加权目标上80/81胜出，但对角AWT在留出功能保真度上53/81更优。
AI.conclusion: AWT是一种有原则的模块化预条件器，可在不改动TT/TTN分解求解器的固定压缩流程中提升功能保真度。

title: Detecting Adversarial Images through Response Profiles of Vision-Language Models
summary: Adversarial perturbations can alter the predictions of frozen vision-language models (VLMs) while leaving their confidence and image--text similarity patterns seemingly plausible. We investigate whether we can identify adversarial inputs based on the broader way an image interacts with a collection of general semantic prompts. Our detector summarizes these responses using category-level statistics, relationships among prompts, deviations from clean reference distributions, and stability under weak image transformations, producing a compact response profile that is classified by a lightweight model while the VLM remains fixed. We evaluate the approach on multiple public image datasets, several CLIP-style visual backbones, and a range of gradient-based, optimization-based, automated, and spatial attacks. The detector achieves strong discrimination in attack-specific settings and retains substantial performance when evaluated on attacks not seen during training. Under a controlled detector-specific protocol, the response-profile representation outperforms the evaluated embedding-geometry baselines. Additional analyses show that the feature groups provide complementary information and that the method remains effective under variations in the prompt configuration. We also examine inference cost and performance against detector-aware adaptive attacks. Overall, the results indicate that response patterns across semantic prompts provide a useful complementary signal for adversarial image detection in frozen VLMs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种针对冻结视觉语言模型（VLM）的对抗图像检测器，通过图像对一组通用语义提示的响应模式构建紧凑的响应画像，并用轻量分类器判别对抗样本，在多种数据集、骨干网络和攻击下取得较强检测性能并具备一定泛化性。
AI.motivation: 对抗扰动可改变冻结VLM的预测，但其置信度与图文相似度模式仍显得合理，导致传统基于置信度或相似度的检测信号失效。作者希望利用图像与大量通用语义提示交互的全局响应模式来识别对抗输入。
AI.method: 检测器在VLM保持冻结的前提下，汇总图像对语义提示集合的响应，提取四类特征：类别级统计量、提示间关系、相对干净参考分布的偏差、弱图像变换下的稳定性，形成紧凑响应画像（response profile），再由轻量模型进行分类。
AI.result: 在多个公开图像数据集、多种CLIP式视觉骨干及梯度、优化、自动化与空间攻击上评估，检测器在特定攻击设置下判别力强，在未见攻击上仍保持可观性能；在受控的检测器专用协议下，响应画像表示优于所评估的嵌入几何基线；特征组提供互补信息，且在提示配置变化下仍有效。
AI.conclusion: 跨语义提示的响应模式为冻结VLM的对抗图像检测提供了有用的互补信号；作者同时考察了推理开销与针对检测器感知的自适应攻击下的表现。

title: CAFE+FNO: Fourier Kernel Generation via Multiplicative Feature Composition
summary: The Fourier Neural Operator (FNO) learns solution operators of partial differential equations (PDEs) through Fourier-space kernel parameterization, but frequency truncation can limit the learning of high-frequency variations. AM-FNO and SirenFNO generate kernels for all grid modes from spectral coordinates using shared networks, making coordinate encoding and generator design important. Recent work on implicit neural representations (INRs) has proposed constructing frequency interactions through explicit feature composition rather than relying on subsequent MLPs to form them implicitly. Building on this approach, we propose CAFE+FNO, which incorporates Content-Aware Frequency Encoding+ (CAFE+) into Fourier kernel generation. CAFE+ combines Fourier--Chebyshev features through parallel affine branches and a Hadamard product, forming interactions within and across the two feature families. A kernel MLP maps the resulting representation of each normalized spectral coordinate to a complex channel-mixing matrix. Each layer shares its generator across all stored modes, making the number of trainable parameters independent of the number of modes for a fixed architecture. We compare CAFE+FNO with existing FNO variants on five PDE benchmarks and conduct ablation studies on basis configuration, multiplicative composition, and bandwidth learnability. Code and experimental configurations are available at https://github.com/fabsk101/CAFEPlusFNO.git.

AI.tldr: 提出 CAFE+FNO，将 Content-Aware Frequency Encoding+ (CAFE+) 融入傅里叶核生成，通过傅里叶–切比雪夫特征并行仿射与哈达玛积显式构建频率交互，在五个 PDE 基准上优于现有 FNO 变体。
AI.motivation: FNO 通过傅里叶空间核参数化学习 PDE 解算子，但频率截断限制高频变化的学习；AM-FNO、SirenFNO 由谱坐标经共享网络生成全部网格模态的核，使坐标编码与生成器设计变得关键。近期 INR 工作提出以显式特征组合构建频率交互，而非依赖后续 MLP 隐式形成。
AI.method: CAFE+FNO 在傅里叶核生成中引入 CAFE+：通过并行仿射分支与 Hadamard 积组合傅里叶–切比雪夫特征，形成族内与跨族交互；再由核 MLP 将每个归一化谱坐标的表示映射为复值通道混合矩阵。每层生成器在所有存储模态间共享，固定架构下可训练参数量与模态数无关。
AI.result: 在五个 PDE 基准上与现有 FNO 变体对比，并开展基配置、乘法组合与带宽可学习性的消融研究。
AI.conclusion: 显式频率交互编码（CAFE+）为傅里叶核生成提供了有效改进，参数量与模态数解耦，代码与实验配置已开源。

title: MORCA: Offline-to-Online Reinforcement Learning for Adaptive Cache Reuse in Video Diffusion Acceleration
summary: Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) achieve remarkable performance in video synthesis, but their iterative denoising process suffers from high inference latency. To address this, caching has emerged as an effective acceleration strategy by capitalizing on inter-step redundancy during denoising. Existing dynamic caching methods typically estimate the error that cache reuse would introduce at each denoising step (step error) to guide cache decisions, whereas our concern is how much quality loss cache reuse would cause in the final generated video (terminal error). We show that step error does not directly correspond to terminal error and that latent information helps capture their relationship, thereby informing cache decisions. Moreover, existing threshold-based methods cannot provide precise speedup control, making it difficult to meet practical requirements for user-specified acceleration targets. To address these limitations, we introduce MORCA, a cache scheduling framework trained through offline-to-online reinforcement learning to make latent-aware reuse/recompute decisions under user-specified acceleration targets. Extensive experiments on different video generation models across multiple target acceleration ratios demonstrate that MORCA achieves better generation fidelity than state-of-the-art caching methods under comparable computational budgets. Code is available at https://github.com/x10ngyx/MORCA.

AI.tldr: 提出MORCA：一种基于离线到在线强化学习的缓存调度框架，在用户指定加速目标下做出潜空间感知的复用/重算决策，缓解DiT视频生成推理延迟。
AI.motivation: 扩散Transformer视频合成性能优异但迭代去噪推理延迟高。现有动态缓存方法以逐步误差（step error）指导缓存决策，但作者关注复用对最终生成视频质量的影响（终端误差，terminal error），并发现二者并不直接对应，潜空间信息有助于刻画其关系。此外，阈值式方法无法提供精确的加速控制，难以满足用户指定的加速目标。
AI.method: 提出MORCA缓存调度框架，通过离线到在线强化学习（offline-to-online RL）训练，在用户指定加速目标下进行潜空间感知（latent-aware）的复用/重算决策，替代传统逐步误差阈值判断。
AI.result: 在多种视频生成模型、多个目标加速比下的实验表明，在相当计算预算下，MORCA相较最先进缓存方法具有更好的生成保真度。
AI.conclusion: 以终端误差为导向并结合潜空间信息的强化学习缓存调度，能够实现更精准的加速控制并提升生成质量，为DiT视频生成加速提供有效方案。

title: Label-free cell counting and viability prediction with brightfield imaging and deep learning
summary: Cell viability assessment is a core requirement in cell culture systems, with critical applications in biopharmaceutical manufacturing and drug development. Conventionally, it is measured by adding membrane-impermeable dyes to a sample (a process called staining), which allows compromised cell membranes to be distinguished from intact ones. However, staining has several limitations: (a) chemical agents can perturb normal cellular processes of the cells being measured, (b) it is often ambiguous to assign viability to individual cells whose membrane integrity is only partially compromised. (c) photobleaching can undermine measurement accuracy over time when using fluorescent stains, and (d) staining cannot be performed in situ or in real time. Here, we show that (1) stained cells captured under brightfield imaging contain sufficient information to distinguish live and dead cells, and (2) cells captured under unstained brightfield imaging exhibit similar image features to their stained counterparts, enabling models trained on stained cells to generalize to unstained ones. We then report the development and validation of ViabiLens, an AI-assisted software for label-free cell viability analysis. The ViabiLens combines a cell detection model for localizing individual cells with a convolutional neural network (CNN) classifier for live/dead prediction, paired with an interactive UMAP-based viewer for visualizing and exploring individual cells across the sample. Evaluated on Chinese Hamster Ovary (CHO) cells spanning a wide range of viability conditions, ViabiLens achieves a mean absolute error of 2.68\% on unstained samples against fluorescence-based reference measurements. We also release a benchmark dataset for label-free cell viability analysis to facilitate future research, available at https://amirrezavazifeh.github.io/ViabiLens-Project-Page/.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ViabiLens——一种无标记细胞活性分析AI软件，利用明场图像中蕴含的活性信息，通过细胞检测模型与CNN分类器实现活/死细胞判别，在CHO细胞上对未染色样本的平均绝对误差为2.68%，并发布基准数据集。
AI.motivation: 细胞活性评估是细胞培养系统的核心需求，但传统染色法存在四大局限：(a)化学试剂干扰细胞正常生理过程；(b)膜完整性部分受损的细胞活性难以判定；(c)荧光染料光漂白导致测量精度随时间下降；(d)无法原位或实时检测。因此需要一种无标记、非侵入的活性评估方法。
AI.method: 作者首先验证两个假设：(1)明场成像下的染色细胞图像包含足以区分活/死细胞的信息；(2)未染色明场细胞与染色对应样本具有相似图像特征，使在染色细胞上训练的模型可泛化至未染色细胞。据此构建ViabiLens系统：细胞检测模型用于定位单个细胞，CNN分类器进行活/死预测，并配备基于UMAP的交互式可视化查看器以探索样本中各个细胞的分布。
AI.result: 在覆盖广泛活性条件的中国仓鼠卵巢（CHO）细胞上评估，ViabiLens在未染色样本上相对荧光参考测量的平均绝对误差（MAE）为2.68%。同时发布了用于无标记细胞活性分析的基准数据集，供后续研究使用。
AI.conclusion: ViabiLens验证了利用明场图像进行无标记、非侵入式细胞活性分析的可行性，克服了传统染色法的干扰、模糊性和光漂白等问题。该系统结合检测、分类与可视化功能，并提供公开基准数据集，为生物制药制造和药物研发中的细胞活性实时原位监测提供了新工具。

title: What Can a Gaussian Process Design Test
summary: A Gaussian process (GP) model can agree with the data for two reasons: its assumptions are right, or the chosen inputs could never have shown that they are wrong. The distinction can be checked from the design before any responses are observed. Every model implies relations that its noiseless responses must satisfy at the chosen inputs, such as the middle value lies on the line through its two neighbours. For GPs built from finitely many features, these relations are exactly the null space of the kernel matrix. Gale duality gives them a geometric interpretation, in which each observation has a vector and the smallest groups of observations that can expose an error are the circuits. For other kernels the relations become soft: response patterns may be improbable under the prior rather than algebraically impossible. A standard test then combines two kinds of evidence. Structural evidence comes from a violated relation and grows without limit as the noise falls. Prior-based evidence only says that a departure is improbable under the prior. With all inputs at the two ends of an interval, for example, a GP can reject a straight line against a large curvature, but only because the implied intercept is improbable, never because curvature was seen. In simulations the predicted power matched the observed rejection rates. Choosing the next input by predicted power raised the power against a localised discrepancy from 0.48 to 0.72, against 0.51 when choosing by predictive variance, and a grid in two dimensions contained exact tests of additivity that a Latin hypercube lacked. The test itself is classical. The contribution is the prospective reading of that test: before observing the responses, the design already determines what kind of contradiction it can produce.

AI.tldr: 本文提出对高斯过程模型检验的"前瞻性"解读：在观测响应之前，设计本身就已决定了它能产生何种类型的矛盾，并据此区分"结构性证据"与"先验性证据"，进而用于主动设计下一个输入点。
AI.motivation: GP模型与数据一致可能有两种截然不同的原因：模型假设正确，或所选取的输入点根本不可能揭示假设错误。这一区分此前未被系统刻画。作者希望在观测响应之前，就从设计出发判断检验能提供何种证据，从而避免把"看不到错误"误认为"模型正确"。
AI.method: 对有限特征GP，模型隐含的无噪响应关系恰为核矩阵的零空间，借助Gale对偶给出几何解释：每个观测对应一个向量，能暴露误差的最小观测组即"电路"(circuits)。对其他核，这些关系变为软约束，即响应模式在先验下"概率极低"而非代数上不可能。据此将标准检验的证据分解为两类：来自被违反关系的结构性证据（随噪声减小无界增长）与仅表示偏离先验下罕见的先验性证据。并利用预测功效选择下一个输入点进行序贯设计。
AI.result: 模拟中预测功效与实测拒绝率吻合。当输入全部位于区间两端时，GP能拒绝直线以支持大曲率，但仅因隐含截距在先验下概率极低，而非真正"看到"曲率。按预测功效选择下一个输入点，对局部化偏差的功效从0.48提升到0.72，而按预测方差选择仅为0.51；二维网格包含拉丁超立方所缺乏的可加性精确检验。
AI.conclusion: 检验方法本身是经典的，本文的贡献在于对其作前瞻性解读：在观测响应之前，设计就已决定了它能产生何种矛盾。这为模型检验提供了设计层面的诊断视角，并支持基于功效的输入点选择。

title: Insights from Autoresearch for Solar Panel Segmentation
comment: Accepted at AutoML4EO 2026 (non-archival AutoML conference workshop). 4 pages + references. https://automl4eo.org/accepted-papers/
summary: This paper investigates AutoResearch, a protocol in which a coding language model edits a training program under a one-hour GPU budget and retains a change only if validation IoU improves. The protocol is applied to photovoltaic panel segmentation on a frozen real-image split, with DeepLabV3--ResNet-50 held fixed. Three campaigns of 24 experiments, using Gemma~4 12B, Qwen3-8B all improve their one-hour baselines, but retained modifications do not transfer across hardware. The Qwen3-8B configuration, trained on real images only, reaches a test IoU of 0.836 versus 0.833 for the reference GAN-augmented schedule. Research repository https://github.com/VU-AIML/automl4eo-autoresearch-segmentation.

AI.tldr: 考察 AutoResearch 协议：语言模型在 1 小时 GPU 预算内编辑训练程序，仅当验证 IoU 提升才保留改动；用于固定 DeepLabV3-ResNet-50 的光伏板分割，三组各 24 次实验均超基线，但改动不跨硬件迁移。
AI.motivation: 探索编码语言模型能否自动化改进训练程序（AutoResearch），并在遥感光伏板分割任务上验证其有效性，特别关注所获改动是否可迁移。
AI.method: 在冻结的真实影像划分上，固定 DeepLabV3--ResNet-50，使用 Gemma 4 12B、Qwen3-8B 等模型在 1 小时 GPU 预算内编辑训练程序，仅当验证 IoU 提升时保留改动，共进行三组 24 次实验。
AI.result: 三组实验均优于各自 1 小时基线；Qwen3-8B 仅用真实影像训练的配置测试 IoU 达 0.836，高于 GAN 增强参考方案的 0.833；但保留的改动未能在不同硬件间迁移。
AI.conclusion: AutoResearch 能稳定提升给定硬件下的短预算基线，但所得改动缺乏跨硬件可迁移性，其泛化性与实用价值受限。

title: m-Set Adversarial Bandits with Winner Feedback
summary: We show upper and lower bounds on the regret of $m$-set adversarial bandits for different utilities (winner reward or sum of rewards) and feedback models (winner index, winner reward, sum of rewards, and their combinations). By comparing to standard bounds for combinatorial and MNL bandits, our results reveal how subtle changes in the setting can have a dramatic impact on the learning rates. Our main technical contributions are the information-theoretic lower bounds on the regret. Experiments on synthetic data confirm our theoretical analyses.

AI.tldr: 本文研究m-set对抗性老虎机在不同效用（获胜者奖励、奖励总和）与反馈模型（获胜者索引、获胜者奖励、奖励总和及其组合）下的遗憾上界与下界，通过与组合老虎机和MNL老虎机的标准界对比，揭示设置中细微变化对学习率的显著影响；主要技术贡献为信息论遗憾下界，合成数据实验验证理论分析。
AI.motivation: 组合老虎机与MNL老虎机已有标准遗憾界，但m-set对抗性设置中效用定义与反馈模型的细微差异可能导致学习率发生剧烈变化；作者希望系统刻画这些差异并给出匹配的上下界。
AI.method: 针对winner reward或sum of rewards两类效用，以及winner index、winner reward、sum of rewards及其组合等反馈模型，推导遗憾的上界与下界；核心技术手段为信息论下界构造；并用合成数据实验验证。
AI.result: 给出了多种效用与反馈组合下的遗憾上界和下界，并与组合老虎机、MNL老虎机的标准界进行比较；合成实验与理论分析一致。
AI.conclusion: m-set对抗性老虎机中效用与反馈设置的细节会显著改变可达到的学习率；信息论下界是刻画这些差异的关键工具。

title: QuadTok: Quadtree Visual Tokenizer for Autoregressive Image Generation
summary: We introduce QuadTok, a novel framework for visual tokenization and autoregressive image generation. Compared to traditional approaches using 2D grids or 1D token sequences, we propose a hierarchical quadtree structure, bridging the gap between 2D spatial binding and 1D sequence-level flexibility. The QuadTok tokenizer dynamically allocates representational capacity to visually intricate areas while leaving homogeneous regions at a coarse resolution. Compared with a fixed 256-token grid, our ImageNet-trained tokenizer saves approximately 10% of tokens on ImageNet and 9% when transferred zero-shot to the COCO dataset, while maintaining comparable reconstruction fidelity. Furthermore, the natural causality introduced by the tree structure seamlessly enables autoregressive image generation. Conditioned on a quadtree topology supplied before generation, our 947M GPT-style generative model achieves a 2.08 gFID on the ImageNet $256 \times 256$ benchmark. Additionally, leveraging the strong spatial correlation preserved by the quadtree structure, the QuadTok generator enables zero-shot spatially controlled image generation capabilities. Code: https://github.com/myc634/QuadTok.

AI.tldr: QuadTok 提出一种基于分层四叉树结构的视觉分词与自回归图像生成框架，动态分配表示容量并在 ImageNet 与 COCO 上节省约 10%/9% token，保持相当重建质量，生成模型在 ImageNet 256×256 上达到 2.08 gFID，并支持零样本空间可控生成。
AI.motivation: 传统视觉分词采用 2D 网格或 1D token 序列：2D 网格具备空间绑定但序列灵活性差，1D 序列灵活但缺乏空间结构。作者希望弥合二者差距，同时减少冗余 token 并保留空间相关性以支持可控生成。
AI.method: 提出 QuadTok 分词器，采用分层四叉树结构组织视觉 token：对视觉复杂区域动态分配更多表示容量，对同质区域使用粗分辨率。树结构天然引入因果性，可直接用于自回归生成；生成时先提供四叉树拓扑作为条件，使用 947M GPT 风格生成模型进行建模。
AI.result: 与固定 256-token 网格相比，ImageNet 训练的分词器在 ImageNet 上节省约 10% token，零样本迁移到 COCO 节省约 9%，同时保持相当的重建保真度。947M GPT 风格生成模型在 ImageNet 256×256 上取得 2.08 gFID。利用四叉树保留的强空间相关性，还实现零样本空间可控图像生成。
AI.conclusion: QuadTok 通过四叉树结构有效统一了 2D 空间绑定与 1D 序列灵活性，在节省 token 的同时保持重建与生成性能，并支持零样本空间可控生成，代码已开源。

title: A Unified Information-Theoretic Approach to Constrained Multi-Fidelity Multi-Objective Bayesian Optimization
summary: Bayesian optimization often involves multiple objectives, constraints, and fidelity levels. We address the challenge of jointly selecting where and at which fidelity to evaluate to identify the highest-fidelity feasible Pareto frontier in this combined setting. From a unified information-theoretic perspective, we measure query utility by the information gain about this frontier, provided by an observation. Since this mutual information is intractable, we derive a variational lower bound using a mixture of under- and over-truncated approximations to the Pareto-consistent region. Multi-fidelity surrogate models propagate the information to arbitrary fidelities, yielding a cost-aware acquisition function without separate heuristics for fidelity selection or constraint handling. Experiments on synthetic, benchmark, and real-world problems demonstrate effectiveness across diverse objective, constraint, and fidelity settings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种面向多目标、约束与多保真度联合场景的贝叶斯优化方法，通过信息论视角统一衡量查询效用，自动决定评估位置与保真度，以识别最高保真度下的可行Pareto前沿。
AI.motivation: 现有贝叶斯优化在多目标、约束、多保真度三者共存时，通常需要分别设计保真度选择与约束处理的启发式策略，缺乏统一框架来共同决定“在哪评估”以及“用何种保真度评估”，从而难以高效逼近最高保真度下的可行Pareto前沿。
AI.method: 作者从统一的信息论视角出发，以一次观测对最高保真度可行Pareto前沿所产生的信息增益作为查询效用。由于该互信息难以直接计算，作者利用对Pareto一致区域的欠截断与过截断混合近似，推导出变分下界。同时使用多保真度代理模型将信息传播到任意保真度，从而构造出成本感知的采集函数，无需单独为保真度选择或约束处理设计启发式规则。
AI.result: 在合成问题、标准基准问题以及真实世界问题上的实验表明，该方法在多种目标、约束与保真度设置下均表现出有效性。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提供了一种统一的信息论框架，将多目标、约束与多保真度贝叶斯优化整合为单一的成本感知采集函数，能够自动联合选择评估位置与保真度，为高效识别最高保真度可行Pareto前沿提供了可行方案。

title: Video-Conditioned Generative Joint 2D-3D Hand Motion Recovery
summary: Recovering faithful 3D hand motion from video remains challenging due to frequent occlusions and incomplete visual observations, which make frame-wise pose estimates unreliable and temporally inconsistent. To address this problem, we propose JoHan, a unified generative framework that recovers hand motion directly from video sequences without relying on intermediate per-frame pose predictions. Trained from scratch, our model jointly generates aligned 2D and 3D local hand pose sequences by learning their temporal dynamics and cross-representation correspondence. The generated 2D trajectories exploit direct spatial and temporal cues from the 2D images to guide the following generative 3D motion reconstruction, while the learned motion prior promotes temporal consistency. Their learned 2D-3D correspondence further enables recovery of the hand's global position and orientation relative to the camera. Extensive experiments on challenging benchmarks demonstrate significantly improved accuracy and speed in local hand-pose and camera-space reconstruction. Notably, our method captures much better hand-motion dynamics, producing significantly smoother motion than previous methods while maintaining high per-frame pose accuracy.

AI.tldr: 提出JoHan统一生成框架，直接从视频序列联合生成对齐的2D与3D局部手部姿态序列，无需逐帧姿态预测，实现了更准确、更平滑的局部手部姿态与相机空间重建。
AI.motivation: 从视频恢复忠实3D手部运动存在困难，主要由于频繁遮挡与不完整视觉观测，导致逐帧姿态估计不可靠且时间上不一致。
AI.method: JoHan从零训练，学习时间动态与跨表示对应关系，联合生成对齐的2D和3D局部手部姿态序列；生成的2D轨迹利用图像中的空间与时间线索引导后续3D运动生成重建，学习到的运动先验提升时间一致性，并通过2D-3D对应恢复相机空间的手部全局位置与朝向。
AI.result: 在挑战性基准上，局部手部姿态与相机空间重建的准确性和速度显著提升；相比先前方法，能更好捕捉手部运动动态，产生明显更平滑的运动，同时保持高逐帧姿态精度。
AI.conclusion: 统一生成式框架可有效避免不可靠的逐帧估计，兼顾精度、速度与时间平滑性，为视频手部运动重建提供了有效方案。

title: Pre-training of Bayesian Optimization Algorithm through Bayesian Optimization
summary: Bayesian optimization (BO) is widely used as a standard approach for expensive black-box optimization. However, BO algorithms often involve parameters that must be specified in advance, and their performance can strongly depend on these choices. We propose a framework for optimizing such parameters using sample paths drawn from a Gaussian process (GP) inferred from the information available at the start of BO. We use cumulative regret as the performance metric for a BO algorithm. By running the BO algorithm on the generated sample paths, we obtain an empirical estimate of its expected cumulative regret for a given parameter configuration. Optimizing this estimate allows us to identify parameter configurations that, given the currently available information, are expected to achieve low cumulative regret. Since this parameter optimization is itself a black-box optimization problem, we employ another BO procedure to solve it, which we refer to as outer BO. Through experiments, we demonstrate that the proposed framework can effectively select parameter configurations that achieve strong performance among a range of candidate configurations.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于高斯过程样本路径的贝叶斯优化参数自动配置框架，通过外层BO优化内层BO的超参数以最小化期望累积遗憾。
AI.motivation: 贝叶斯优化算法通常需要预先指定超参数，而其性能对这些参数选择高度敏感，如何自动选择合适参数是一个关键问题。
AI.method: 利用BO开始时已有信息推断高斯过程，并从该GP中采样样本路径；在样本路径上运行BO算法，得到给定参数配置下期望累积遗憾的经验估计；将该估计的优化视为黑箱优化问题，采用外层BO（outer BO）求解最优参数配置。
AI.result: 实验表明，该框架能够在候选参数配置集合中有效选出性能表现优异的参数配置。
AI.conclusion: 所提框架可在信息有限的初始阶段自动确定合适的BO参数，提升贝叶斯优化的实际效果。

title: GRACE: Generation-aware latent compression for efficient video generation
summary: Highly compressed video autoencoders offer an effective way to accelerate video diffusion models, as the Diffusion Transformer (DiT) operates on far fewer tokens. However, such autoencoders are challenging to train, since a higher compression ratio degrades reconstruction quality and recovering it requires more channels, which is known to slow the convergence of the DiT. The compressed latent also differs from the one the DiT was trained on, so the pretrained DiT must be either retrained from scratch or adapted at considerable cost. Compressing the autoencoder the DiT was trained with appears to preserve compatibility, yet optimizing it for reconstruction alone still shifts the latent away from the distribution the DiT has learned. To address this, we propose Generation-Aware Latent Compression for Efficient Video Generation (GRACE), a two-stage framework that compresses a pretrained video autoencoder while keeping it compatible with the pretrained DiT. Specifically, we keep a frozen base latent from the pretrained encoder and learn a residual latent for the information lost under stronger compression, while aligning the compressed latent with the pretrained latent in the feature space of the frozen DiT so that the autoencoder is optimized for generation. We then adapt the DiT with lightweight fine-tuning and asymmetric denoising, where the base is denoised ahead of the residual. GRACE reduces the token count of Wan2.1-I2V-14B by 8x and its latency by 11.1x at 480x832x81, while matching the generation quality of the pretrained pipeline before compression on VBench.

AI.tldr: GRACE：一种两阶段框架，通过生成感知的潜空间压缩，将预训练视频自编码器压缩8倍并保持与预训练DiT兼容，在VBench上匹配原生成质量，延迟降低11.1倍。
AI.motivation: 高度压缩的视频自编码器可减少DiT的token数量从而加速视频扩散模型，但压缩率越高重建质量越差，需更多通道，拖慢DiT收敛；且压缩后的潜空间分布偏离DiT训练分布，导致预训练DiT需从头训练或高成本适配。仅针对重建优化自编码器仍会使潜空间漂移。
AI.method: GRACE采用两阶段框架，在保持与预训练DiT兼容的前提下压缩预训练视频自编码器：保留预训练编码器的冻结基础潜变量，学习残差潜变量以承载强压缩下丢失的信息；在冻结DiT的特征空间中将压缩潜变量与预训练潜变量对齐，使自编码器面向生成任务优化；随后用轻量微调与非对称去噪适配DiT，其中基础部分先于残差部分被去噪。
AI.result: 在480x832x81分辨率下，GRACE将Wan2.1-I2V-14B的token数量减少8倍、延迟降低11.1倍，同时在VBench上达到与压缩前预训练流水线相当的生成质量。
AI.conclusion: GRACE通过生成感知的潜空间压缩与残差潜变量设计，在显著提升视频扩散模型效率的同时保持了生成质量与兼容性。

title: Robust Decentralized Fairness Auditing
summary: Emerging legislation requires large language models (LLMs) to be audited for compliance with regulatory standards, particularly fairness. Such black-box audits typically assume a single auditor with access to a large, representative set of queries. In practice, it can be difficult for an auditor to obtain such a query set, but multiple auditors can together cover the relevant demographic groups by auditing the LLM collaboratively with their individual query sets. However, relying on multiple auditors raises a fundamental trust problem, as they may act on behalf of the LLM provider to portray a misleading appearance of fairness, i.e., fairwashing. We propose Auditopus, a novel approach for robust decentralized fairness auditing. In Auditopus, auditing proceeds in rounds without a central server. In each round, every auditor issues a fixed number of queries to the LLM, and sends only cumulative statistics vectors of its query results to other auditors instead of sensitive queries in clear. The fairness of the audited LLM is then estimated by aggregating all the vectors. We show theoretically and empirically that even a single adversarial auditor in the network can steer this estimate by fabricating the vectors it sends, making an unfair LLM appear fair. To address this threat, Auditopus has each honest auditor locally down-weight any auditor whose cumulative statistics vectors are statistically inconsistent with previous ones. We implement Auditopus and compare it to robust aggregation baselines on two datasets with two pre-trained LLMs. Against an attacker that optimizes the vectors it sends to make the LLM appear fair, Auditopus reduces audit error by up to 78% on average relative to no defense and at least 62% relative to the robust aggregation baselines. Even when 49% of the auditors are adversarial, Auditopus never lets a very unfair or moderately unfair LLM pass as fair.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Auditopus，一种无中心服务器的去中心化公平性审计方法，通过多轮审计、仅共享累积统计向量，并让诚实审计者按统计一致性对他人降权，从而抵御单个恶意审计者制造"公平假象"（fairwashing）。
AI.motivation: 新兴立法要求对大语言模型进行合规审计，尤其是公平性审计。黑盒审计通常假设单一审计者能获取大规模代表性查询集，但现实中单个审计者往往难以获得覆盖相关人口群体的完整查询集，因此需要多个审计者协作。然而多方协作引入了信任问题：部分审计者可能受LLM提供方指使，伪造结果制造误导性的公平假象（fairwashing）。
AI.method: Auditopus采用无中心服务器的多轮审计流程：每轮中每个审计者向LLM发出固定数量的查询，仅向其他审计者发送查询结果的累积统计向量（而非明文敏感查询），再聚合所有向量估计LLM的公平性。针对单个恶意审计者可通过伪造向量操纵估计值的问题，Auditopus让每个诚实审计者在本地对累积统计向量与既往不一致的审计者进行降权。
AI.result: 作者从理论和实验两方面证明，网络中单个对抗审计者即可通过伪造向量操纵公平性估计，使不公平的LLM显得公平。在两个数据集和两个预训练LLM上，与无防御相比Auditopus平均将审计误差降低最多78%，相对鲁棒聚合基线至少降低62%；即使49%的审计者为对抗者，Auditopus也从未让非常不公平或中度不公平的LLM被判定为公平。
AI.conclusion: Auditopus是一种鲁棒的去中心化公平性审计方案，能在无中心服务器、多审计者协作的场景下有效抵御fairwashing攻击，显著优于无防御和现有鲁棒聚合基线。

title: How to train your model organism
summary: Model organisms of alignment-relevant behaviors (e.g., backdoors, sycophancy, spurious correlations) have emerged as a key tool for evaluating whitebox interpretability techniques. We argue that the prevailing practice of training model organisms to a single objective of installing the target behavior is insufficient and propose validating model organisms with respect to three objectives with associated metrics: target-behavior installation, general-capability preservation (i.e., parametric knowledge, chat quality), and output naturalness (i.e., CoT and activations). We re-visit two publicly released organism suites using this validation framework and show that (1) chat quality and CoT naturalness degrade substantially across training recipes, and (2) validation metrics predict how well interpretability methods recover the installed behavior, e.g., a logit lens readout covaries with an organism's general capabilities. We introduce a multi-objective training approach based on model merging to train more realistic model organisms. Finally, on a new suite of model organisms targeting demographic biases in clinical reasoning, we compare training recipes and find that DPO training stays closer to the base model than supervised finetuning, and the proposed model optimization approach better preserves capabilities and naturalness. Auditing this suite with an investigator agent, we again observe validation metrics tracking bias recovery. In sum, training methods shape the interpretability conclusions an organism supports, and we argue that one should consider multiple objectives to draw generalizable conclusions about interpretability methods using (realistic) model organisms.

AI.tldr: 论文主张训练"模型生物"不能只追求植入目标行为，而应同时验证目标行为植入、通用能力保持与输出自然性三项指标；作者据此重审两个公开套件，并提出基于模型合并的多目标训练方法来构建更真实的模型生物。
AI.motivation: 模型生物（如后门、谄媚、伪相关）已成为评估白盒可解释性技术的关键工具，但当前主流做法仅以"植入目标行为"这一单一目标来训练模型生物，忽视了训练过程对模型通用能力与输出自然性的破坏，可能导致对可解释性方法的结论不可泛化、甚至被训练方式所误导。
AI.method: 提出一个三目标的验证框架及配套指标：（1）目标行为植入，（2）通用能力保持（参数化知识、对话质量），（3）输出自然性（思维链CoT与激活）。用该框架重审两个公开的模型生物套件；提出基于模型合并（model merging）的多目标训练方法；并构建一个针对临床推理中人口统计偏差的新模型生物套件，比较DPO与监督微调等训练配方，最后用investigator agent进行审计。
AI.result: （1）跨多种训练配方，对话质量与CoT自然性显著退化；（2）验证指标能预测可解释性方法恢复植入行为的效果，例如logit lens读出与模型生物的通用能力呈协变；（3）在新套件中，DPO训练比监督微调更接近基座模型，所提模型优化方法更好地保持了能力与自然性；（4）审计显示验证指标再次与偏差恢复程度相关联。
AI.conclusion: 训练方法会塑造模型生物所能支撑的可解释性结论，因此仅以单一目标训练模型生物不足取；应综合考虑多目标，才能基于（更真实的）模型生物对可解释性方法得出可泛化的结论。

title: Tetris3D: 3D Scene Generation With Objects That Fit Together
summary: We propose Tetris3D, a generative framework for single-image 3D scene reconstruction that recovers objects which are physically and geometrically coherent as a scene. Existing methods often generate objects independently or couple them implicitly, providing limited guidance for ensuring fine-grained spatial compatibility between neighboring objects that interact with one another. To address this, we explicitly condition the generation of each object on the geometry of surrounding objects and their physical relationships, guiding its shape and pose to remain geometrically and physically plausible within the scene. Moreover, we introduce ComOb, a physics simulation-based dataset of 1.2M scenes featuring physical interactions across diverse object categories, with per-object meshes and pairwise physical relation annotations. Comprehensive experiments on synthetic and realworld scenes show that Tetris3D recovers coherent object shapes and poses even when interacting regions are occluded, and achieves state-of-the-art performance in both generation quality and physical stability.

AI.tldr: Tetris3D：单图3D场景重建生成框架，显式以邻接物体几何与物理关系为条件，联合恢复几何/物理一致的对象形状与姿态；并构建含120万场景、逐物体网格与成对物理关系标注的数据集ComOb。
AI.motivation: 现有单图3D场景重建方法多独立生成各物体或仅隐式耦合，缺乏对相邻交互物体间细粒度空间兼容性的显式引导，导致形状与姿态在几何、物理上难以保持合理。
AI.method: 提出Tetris3D：对每个物体的生成显式条件化于周围物体几何及其物理关系，从而约束其形状与姿态在场景中保持几何与物理合理；同时构建ComOb数据集——基于物理仿真、含120万场景、跨多类物体物理交互，提供逐物体网格与成对物理关系标注。
AI.result: 在合成与真实场景上的实验表明，Tetris3D在交互区域被遮挡时仍能恢复连贯的物体形状与姿态，并在生成质量与物理稳定性两方面达到SOTA。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式建模物体间几何与物理关系并结合大规模物理仿真标注数据，可显著提升单图3D场景重建的连贯性与物理稳定性。

title: OrthoGen: A Generative Orthogonal Learner for Time-Varying Treatments
summary: Estimating conditional distributional potential outcomes (CDPOs) over time is important in medicine (e.g., to estimate patient-specific risks under different treatment sequences). However, this task is challenging because of time-varying confounding, yet existing adjustment strategies for this task are limited. In this paper, we aim to learn CDPOs under time-varying treatments using flexible generative models. Our contributions are two-fold. (1) We introduce a tailored adjustment strategy for our setting, namely, generative recursive g-computation. Our adjustment strategy recursively propagates full conditional outcome distributions rather than conditional means, modeling the variables of interest directly rather than full trajectories. Building on our adjustment strategy, we formulate simple generative learners for CDPO estimation. However, these learners can be sensitive to nuisance estimation errors, which motivates an orthogonal learner. (2) We thus introduce OrthoGen, a Neyman-orthogonal and doubly robust generative learner. Importantly, we show that OrthoGen further achieves rate double robustness and quasi-oracle efficiency under suitable conditions. Our learners are flexible and can be instantiated with different generative backbones (e.g., normalizing flows and diffusion models). Across experiments with synthetic, semi-synthetic and real-world datasets, we find that OrthoGen is highly effective. To the best of our knowledge, we are the first to propose a generative orthogonal learner for estimating CDPOs under time-varying treatments.

AI.tldr: 本文研究时变治疗下条件分布势结果（CDPOs）的估计问题，提出生成式递归g-computation调整策略与Neyman正交、双稳健的生成学习器OrthoGen，并证明其具有比率双稳健性与准oracle效率，在合成、半合成及真实数据上表现优异。
AI.motivation: 在医学场景中（如估计不同治疗序列下患者的个体化风险），需要对时间推移下的条件分布势结果（CDPOs）进行估计。然而该任务面临时变混杂（time-varying confounding）的挑战，而现有针对该任务的调整策略非常有限。
AI.method: (1) 提出面向该场景的调整策略——生成式递归g-computation：递归传播完整的条件结果分布而非条件均值，直接建模所关注的变量而非完整轨迹；基于该策略构建了简单的生成式学习器。(2) 针对简单学习器对冗余估计误差敏感的问题，提出OrthoGen——一种Neyman正交且双稳健的生成式学习器，可灵活实例化为不同生成式骨干（如normalizing flows、扩散模型）。
AI.result: 理论上证明OrthoGen在适当条件下具有比率双稳健性（rate double robustness）与准oracle效率（quasi-oracle efficiency）。实验上，在合成、半合成及真实世界数据集上，OrthoGen均表现出高度有效性。
AI.conclusion: 据作者所知，这是首个面向时变治疗下CDPOs估计的生成式正交学习器。该工作将正交学习与生成式建模结合，为时变治疗场景下的分布势结果估计提供了新范式。

title: Efficient Dense Crowd Trajectory Prediction Via Dynamic Clustering
summary: Crowd trajectory prediction plays a crucial role in public safety and management, where it can help prevent disasters such as stampedes. Recent works address the problem by predicting individual trajectories and considering surrounding objects based on manually annotated data. However, these approaches tend to overlook dense crowd scenarios, where the challenges of automation become more pronounced due to the massiveness, noisiness, and inaccuracy of the tracking outputs, resulting in high computational costs. To address these challenges, we propose and extensively evaluate a novel cluster-based approach that groups individuals based on similar attributes over time, enabling faster execution through accurate group summarisation. Our plug-and-play method can be combined with existing trajectory predictors by using our output centroid in place of their pedestrian input. We evaluate our proposed method on several challenging dense crowd scenes. We demonstrated that our approach leads to faster processing and lower memory usage when compared with state-of-the-art methods, while maintaining the accuracy

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于聚类的即插即用方法，通过将相似属性个体按时间分组并以质心替代行人输入，在密集人群轨迹预测中实现更快速度与更低内存占用，同时保持精度。
AI.motivation: 密集人群场景下的轨迹预测对公共安全管理（如防踩踏）至关重要。现有工作多基于人工标注数据预测个体轨迹并考虑周围目标，但在密集人群中，跟踪输出具有大规模、噪声大、不准确等特点，导致自动化困难且计算成本高，现有方法往往忽视这一问题。
AI.method: 提出一种新颖的基于聚类的方法，按时间将具有相似属性的个体分组，通过准确的群体汇总实现更快执行。该方法为即插即用式，可将输出的群体质心（centroid）替代原行人输入，与现有轨迹预测器结合使用。在多个具有挑战性的密集人群场景上进行了广泛评估。
AI.result: 与当前最先进方法相比，该方法在保持精度的同时，实现了更快的处理速度和更低的内存占用。
AI.conclusion: 通过群体聚类与质心汇总替代个体输入，可有效缓解密集人群跟踪输出的规模大、噪声高、不准确问题，降低计算与内存开销，为密集人群轨迹预测提供了一种通用且易集成的解决方案。

title: Edge Accuracy Is Not Enough: Why Dynamics-Learned Structure Fails to Transfer to Inverse Problems
summary: A natural strategy for inverse problems with scarce labelled data is to transfer relational structure learned from abundant forward-simulation data. We show this strategy fails systematically, even when it satisfies the standard theoretical justification for why structure should help. We prove that approximate structure provides estimation-error benefits whenever the edge error satisfies $Δ< n^2 - kn$, reducing sample complexity from $O(n^2)$ to $O(kn+Δ)$. Structure learned via Neural Relational Inference (NRI) from dynamics prediction satisfies this condition, yet on a source-localisation task across 180 CFD-simulated hydrogen-leak scenarios and 180 acoustic scenarios, it degrades performance by 116% and 201% relative to a flexible, task-optimised attention baseline, while a physics-based prior (Green's function) degrades by only 69-72%. Four independent lines of evidence show this is not a tuning failure: NRI improves only 0.5% when given 18x more training data (versus 16.6% for the task-optimised baseline, $p<0.001$); performance is insensitive to the NRI edge threshold across a wide range; the dynamics-learned graph overlaps the task-optimal graph on only 6% of edges; and two further dynamics-derived structure estimators (correlation- and mutual-information-based) show no measurable benefit over a structure-free baseline, with the correlation-based estimator performing markedly worse. We formalise this gap as a statement about approximation error that the edge-accuracy condition cannot control, and we provide a lightweight transferability test (Jaccard similarity against a partially-observed target-task graph) that separates successful from failed transfer in all four domain/structure pairs we evaluate, using under an hour of computation and 15-20% of target-domain data; we present this as a heuristic calibrated on few cases, not a validated general threshold.

AI.tldr: 论文证明：对稀缺标注的逆问题，从充裕正向仿真数据迁移关系结构在理论上看似合理却系统性失败。作者给出边误差条件（Δ < n²−kn）下结构迁移降低样本复杂度，但NRI学到的结构在氢泄漏与声学定位任务上反而显著劣于任务优化基线；并形式化了边精度条件无法控制的近似误差，提出基于Jaccard相似度的轻量可迁移性测试。
AI.motivation: 逆问题标注数据稀缺，常见策略是迁移从充裕正向仿真数据中学到的关系结构。标准理论认为只要结构近似足够好就应带来估计误差收益，这一直觉被广泛接受，但缺乏对"条件满足却仍失败"的系统性检验；作者旨在揭示该策略的系统性失败并解释其理论根源。
AI.method: 1) 理论：证明近似结构在边误差Δ < n²−kn时降低样本复杂度，从O(n²)降至O(kn+Δ)，并指出NRI从动力学预测中学到的结构满足该条件。2) 实证：在180个CFD仿真氢泄漏场景与180个声学场景的源定位任务上，对比NRI结构、物理先验（格林函数）与任务优化的注意力基线。3) 四条独立证据排除调参失败：数据量增18倍仅提升0.5%、对边阈值不敏感、动力学图与任务最优图仅6%边重叠、相关/互信息结构估计器无收益。4) 形式化近似误差，并提出Jaccard相似度可迁移性测试。
AI.result: 在氢泄漏与声学定位任务上，NRI学到的结构相对任务优化注意力基线分别使性能下降116%和201%；基于物理的格林函数先验仅下降69-72%。NRI在18倍训练数据下仅提升0.5%（基线提升16.6%，p<0.001）；对NRI边阈值不敏感；动力学图与任务最优图边重叠仅6%；相关与互信息结构估计器相对无结构基线无可测收益，相关法明显更差。Jaccard可迁移性测试在四组域/结构配对中均能区分成功与失败迁移，计算不足1小时、使用目标域15-20%数据。
AI.conclusion: 从正向动力学数据迁移关系结构并非普遍有效：即使满足标准边精度理论条件，仍可能因边精度条件无法控制的近似误差而系统性失败。应通过轻量的目标域结构相似度测试（如Jaccard）预先判断可迁移性；该测试目前是基于少数案例校准的启发式，而非已验证的通用阈值。

title: Finite-Sample Approximation of Hessian-Guided Perturbed Wasserstein Gradient Flows
summary: Wasserstein gradient flow extends gradient descent to probability measures. Its Hessian-guided perturbed variant (PWGF) adds Gaussian perturbations to escape saddle points in nonconvex problems. We investigate when its approximation by finitely many interacting particles remains accurate over growing time horizons. Our analysis retains the curvature accumulated along the population-driven reference path: negative curvature can amplify approximation errors, while subsequent positive curvature can damp their influence. This captures favorable scenarios in which temporary instability is compatible with accurate tracking over growing horizons. Under regularity assumptions and a prescribed common perturbation schedule, we prove particle and objective-value tracking bounds on a high-probability event for reference paths satisfying explicit conditions on accumulated curvature. To handle state-dependent Gaussian jumps, we construct a population-first coupling that preserves the reference particles' conditional independence and reduces jump errors to covariance comparison. We verify the conditions in a variance-plus-cosine model, where curvature recovery yields a growing-horizon tracking guarantee. We also establish local attraction, transverse descent, and positive second variation in two regions of a regularized matrix-factorization model, motivating a positive-negative-positive curvature pattern.

AI.tldr: 研究Wasserstein梯度流及其Hessian引导扰动变体(PWGF)在有限粒子近似下的长时间尺度追踪精度，给出高概率粒子与目标值追踪界，并在方差+余弦模型与正则化矩阵分解模型上验证条件。
AI.motivation: PWGF通过加入高斯扰动来逃离非凸问题中的鞍点，但其用有限个相互作用粒子近似连续测度流是否在时间尺度增长时仍然准确，尚缺乏理论刻画；需捕捉沿种群驱动参考路径累积的曲率对近似误差的放大与衰减作用。
AI.method: 保留沿种群驱动参考路径累积的曲率：负曲率放大近似误差，后续正曲率抑制其影响。在正则性假设与给定共同扰动日程下，针对满足显式累积曲率条件的参考路径，证明高概率事件上的粒子与目标值追踪界；对状态依赖高斯跳变构造population-first耦合，保持参考粒子条件独立并将跳变误差归约为协方差比较。
AI.result: 在方差+余弦模型中验证所提条件，曲率恢复带来随时间增长视界的追踪保证；在正则化矩阵分解模型的两个区域中证明局部吸引、横向下降与正二阶变分，从而支撑“正-负-正”曲率模式。
AI.conclusion: 有限粒子对PWGF的近似在累积曲率受控时可实现长视界精确追踪，暂时的不稳定可以与长时间精确追踪相容；结果为非凸优化中扰动梯度流的粒子近似提供了曲率层面的理论保证。

title: Evaluating Sequence Assembly Strategies for Differentially Private Synthetic Time-Series Forecasting
summary: Differentially private time-series generators commonly produce fixed-length synthetic windows, whereas downstream forecasting models often require long continuous training sequences. How these windows are assembled after generation can therefore alter the effective synthetic data presented to a forecaster, even when the trained generator remains unchanged. We study this post-generation sequence assembly process by systematically varying overlap rates and window-weighting schemes and evaluating the resulting sequences in terms of boundary continuity, statistical and temporal fidelity, and Train-on-Synthetic-Test-on-Real (TSTR) forecasting utility. Across four types of public datasets (ETTh1, ETTm1, Weather, and Appliances) and five forecasting models, the results reveal a clear forecaster-dependent assembly principle: downstream TSTR utility is jointly shaped by the forecaster, overlap rate, and window-weighting scheme, leading to distinct assembly preferences across forecasting models. Increased overlap generally improves boundary continuity, but improvements in continuity or individual fidelity diagnostics do not consistently reduce forecasting error, indicating that these diagnostics alone are insufficient for selecting assembly configurations. Complete five-forecaster assembly grids, together with matched Train-on-Real-Test-on-Real (TRTR) references, further characterize these regularities and quantify assembly-dependent utility relative to real-data training.
