We then validate the identified principles through additional analyses of robustness and generator variability.

AI.tldr: 本文研究差分隐私时间序列生成器在生成合成窗口后的“序列组装”环节：系统改变窗口重叠率与窗口加权方案，并在四个公开数据集、五类预测模型上评估边界连续性、统计/时间保真度与TSTR预测效用，揭示组装效用的预测器依赖性。
AI.motivation: 差分隐私时间序列生成器通常产出定长合成窗口，而下游预测模型需要长连续训练序列；因此生成后如何组装窗口会改变预测器实际接收的合成数据。现有工作多关注生成器本身，忽视了这一后生成组装环节对TSTR效用的影响，作者据此提出问题。
AI.method: 以生成器不变为前提，对后生成序列组装过程进行控制变量实验：系统变化窗口重叠率与窗口加权方案；在ETTh1、ETTm1、Weather、Appliances四类公开数据集与五个预测模型上构建完整的“五预测器组装网格”，并配对Train-on-Real-Test-on-Real（TRTR）参照；评估指标涵盖边界连续性、统计与时间保真度诊断以及TSTR预测效用，并补充鲁棒性与生成器可变性分析。
AI.result: TSTR效用由预测器、重叠率与窗口加权方案共同决定，不同预测模型呈现不同的组装偏好；提高重叠率总体改善边界连续性，但连续性或单项保真度诊断的改善并不稳定地降低预测误差；完整组装网格与TRTR参照刻画了上述规律，并量化了相对真实数据训练的组装依赖效用。
AI.conclusion: 序列组装是差分隐私时间序列合成流程中不可忽视的独立环节，其最优配置依赖具体下游预测器，不能仅依据连续性或单项保真度诊断选择；应通过面向预测器的组装网格评估，并相对TRTR参照衡量组装效用，相关规律经鲁棒性与生成器可变性分析得到验证。

title: ProtocolMatch: Protocol-Dependent Model Selection for Scientific Dynamics Forecasting
summary: Scientific dynamics forecasting is often framed as an architecture choice, although deployment is also determined by observed history, rollout feedback, compute budget, physical objective, and test distribution. We formulate protocol-dependent model selection and introduce ProtocolMatch, a compute-matched, validation-selected, and failure-preserving evaluation framework. On driven quantum-spin dynamics, we compare recurrent, patched-attention, causal-attention, and low-rank linear predictors across three independently generated datasets. The causal-attention--recurrence ordering reverses as the training set grows within a fixed two-spin task, while a linear predictor has the lowest mean error in the six-spin local-observable comparison. Restricting observed history worsens every refreshed-history view but improves every closed-loop view in the four-spin study. A latest-state MLP has lower error than persistence on every dataset under state refresh across all five cells, yet its closed-loop rank varies by system and includes finite explosive errors. Physical penalties improve targeted consistency without reliably improving prediction error, and in-distribution intervals lose most coverage after a driving-frequency shift. Thus scientific model selection should return a predictor with its protocol and report accuracy, physical validity, and shifted-distribution reliability separately.

AI.tldr: 论文将科学动力学预测从"架构选择"重新表述为"协议相关"的模型选择问题，提出 ProtocolMatch 评估框架，并在驱动量子自旋动力学任务上验证：性能排序随训练集规模、观测历史、刷新方式、物理约束与分布偏移而变化。
AI.motivation: 现有科学动力学预测研究常把结果优劣归结为架构差异，但实际部署性能同时受观测历史长度、闭环 rollout 反馈、计算预算、物理目标函数和测试分布影响。忽略这些协议因素会导致不公平、不可复现的模型比较与误导性的架构结论。
AI.method: 提出 ProtocolMatch——一个计算量匹配（compute-matched）、基于验证集选择（validation-selected）、保留失效案例（failure-preserving）的评估框架，实现协议依赖的模型选择。在驱动量子自旋动力学上，用三个独立生成的数据集，比较循环网络、分块注意力、因果注意力与低秩线性预测器；并系统操控训练集规模（两自旋任务）、观测历史长度（四自旋）、状态刷新/闭环视图、物理惩罚项以及驱动频率偏移等协议维度。
AI.result: (1) 两自旋任务中，随训练集增大，因果注意力与循环网络的排序发生反转；(2) 六自旋局域可观测量比较中，线性预测器平均误差最低；(3) 四自旋研究中，限制观测历史使所有刷新历史视图变差，却使所有闭环视图变好；(4) 最新状态 MLP 在五个单元的所有数据集上、状态刷新下误差均低于持续性基线，但闭环排名随系统变化，且出现有限爆炸误差；(5) 物理惩罚提升目标一致性但不能可靠降低预测误差；(6) 分布内区间在驱动频率偏移后大部分覆盖失效。
AI.conclusion: 科学模型选择应返回"预测器+其协议"的组合，并分别报告精度、物理有效性与分布偏移下的可靠性三类指标，而非仅以单一架构或单一误差指标判定优劣。ProtocolMatch 为这种协议感知、可复现、保留失效模式的评估提供了可操作范式。

title: MorphCL: Morphological Contrastive Learning for Inertial-based Human Activity Recognition
summary: Despite the ubiquity of sensors in wearable and mobile devices and the abundance of human movement data they generate, translating unlabeled recordings into foundational motion models remains an open challenge. Self-supervised learning (SSL) has alleviated the need for costly annotations, yet existing approaches leave the global structure of large-scale motion data largely untapped, relying on randomly sampled batches and local comparisons that become particularly problematic for in-the-wild inertial data dominated by stationary, low-variance behaviors. Here we introduce Morphological Contrastive Learning (MorphCL), a self-supervised pretraining framework that uses structure-aware grouping to inject explicit modeling of global structure into inertial-based SSL approaches. Building on two well-established pillars of motion analysis, the discovery of motion primitives, or motifs, and domain-specific feature descriptors, we show that MorphCL substantially improves linear probing and finetuning results of learned encoders by up to 15 percentage points in F1-score. In a comparison with existing foundation models, we demonstrate that MorphCL-pretrained encoders match or surpass them models in linear probing performance while trained on $4600\times$ less data. Qualitative analysis of the resulting embedding spaces further reveals morphologically meaningful cluster structure, with improved separation of kinematically similar activity classes.

AI.tldr: 提出MorphCL，一种结构感知分组的自监督预训练框架，将全局结构显式建模注入惯性运动数据的SSL，用更少数据取得更优性能。
AI.motivation: 可穿戴与移动设备产生大量人体运动数据，但缺乏标注；现有自监督方法依赖随机采样批次与局部对比，未利用大规模运动数据的全局结构，对以静止、低方差行为为主的野外惯性数据尤为不利。
AI.method: MorphCL基于运动分析两大支柱——运动基元（motif）发现与领域特征描述子，采用结构感知的分组策略，在对比式自监督学习中显式建模全局结构。
AI.result: 线性探测与微调F1提升最多15个百分点；与现有基础模型相比，线性探测性能持平或更优，而训练数据量少4600倍；嵌入空间呈现形态学意义的聚类结构，运动学相似活动类别分离更好。
AI.conclusion: 结构感知分组能有效提升惯性自监督预训练的表征质量与数据效率，为通用运动基础模型提供可行路径。

title: Stationary Bias and Extrapolation in Nonlinear Two-Timescale Stochastic Approximation
summary: Constant-step stochastic approximation generally has a nonzero stationary mean error that persists under time averaging. This paper studies that error for nonlinear two-timescale recursions driven by an exogenous finite-state Markov chain. Under stated smoothness assumptions and conditions on the stationary distribution, we derive a first-order bias expansion whose error bound remains uniform as the slow step size becomes much smaller than the fast step size. Fast-manifold coordinates keep the associated covariance equation regular in this limit. For fast step $η$ and slow step $\varepsilon$, the expansion reveals a mixed contribution $\varepsilon^2/η$ alongside terms linear in each step size. This dependence matters for bias reduction: along power-law step-size paths, the bias exponents need not be integers, so Richardson--Romberg extrapolation requires weights matched to the path. An exactly solvable nonlinear Markov example verifies the coefficients. We verify localization for temporal-difference learning and compare finite-run extrapolation at equal update budgets. For finite runs, we bound the initialization error of tail averages on both timescales under an additional coupling assumption. In the special case of additive independent noise, signed third-moment cancellation yields a sharper remainder.

AI.tldr: 该文研究由外生有限状态马尔可夫链驱动的非线性双时间尺度随机逼近的常数步长稳态偏差，给出在慢步长远小于快步长时仍一致的偏差展开。
AI.motivation: 常数步长随机逼近存在非零稳态均值误差，且该误差在时间平均下依然持续；理解双时间尺度递归中该偏差的结构对偏差校正与算法设计至关重要。
AI.method: 在光滑性假设与平稳分布条件下，利用快流形坐标保持协方差方程在极限下的正则性，推导一阶偏差展开；结合幂律步长路径分析偏差指数，并讨论Richardson–Romberg外推的权重匹配；对有限run的尾部平均初始化误差在额外耦合假设下给出界；对加性独立噪声情形利用有符号三阶矩抵消得到更精细余项。
AI.result: 偏差展开包含与各步长线性的项以及混合项 ε²/η；沿幂律步长路径偏差指数可非整数，故Richardson–Romberg外推需匹配路径的权重；可精确求解的非线性马尔可夫例子验证了系数；在时间差分学习上验证了局部化，并在相同更新预算下比较有限run外推效果。
AI.conclusion: 常数步长双时间尺度递归的稳态偏差具有线性项与 ε²/η 混合项，步长缩放路径决定了偏差指数与外推权重；快流形坐标与耦合假设为理论分析提供一致性保证，三阶矩抵消可进一步收紧余项。

title: Logarithmic Regret via Passive Change Detection in Piecewise-Stationary Self-Tuning Regulation
summary: We study minimum-variance control of an unknown autoregressive system with exogenous inputs and coefficients that change at unknown times. Under bounded independent disturbances, fixed detection gaps, stability and feasibility conditions, and sufficient time between changes, we prove \(O((C+1)\log((T+1)/δ))\) regret with probability at least \(1-δ\), where \(T\) is the horizon and \(C\) the number of changes. Unlike switching bandits, where unselected arms can change unobserved, admissible plant changes provide information during exploitation: the correct feasible controller leaves only the disturbance in the output, whereas a detectable change raises output energy under the old controller. PIECE-CD explores initially and after alarms, then uses gated recursive least squares for control. Its energy test compares windowed output power with a threshold above the noise floor; the extension to unstable controller mismatches also monitors the reference controller's input proposal. We control false alarms across the horizon and prove logarithmic detection delay. Inputs are clipped to prescribed bounds. Logarithmic regret also holds under an explicit condition ensuring that clipping becomes inactive after a finite burn-in. Under the stated feasibility conditions, the extended detector covers destabilizing changes with detectable excess energy over a fixed window.

AI.tldr: 研究未知ARX系统在系数于未知时刻变化下的最小方差控制，提出PIECE-CD算法，在稳定性、可行性与变化间隔充分等条件下证明高概率对数遗憾 O((C+1)log((T+1)/δ))。
AI.motivation: 经典切换赌博机中未选臂可无观测地变化，导致信息缺失；本文关注控制场景中"可容许"的系统变化在利用阶段仍能提供信息，并希望在未知变化时刻自适应地实现最小方差控制且保证低遗憾。
AI.method: 提出PIECE-CD：初始阶段及报警后进行探索，之后用门控递归最小二乘（gated RLS）进行控制；采用能量检验比较窗口输出功率与高于噪声底限的阈值，并扩展检测器以应对不稳定控制器失配，同时监测参考控制器的输入建议；输入被裁剪至给定边界。
AI.result: 在独立有界扰动、固定检测间隔、稳定性与可行性条件及变化间隔充分的假设下，以至少1−δ的概率获得 O((C+1)log((T+1)/δ)) 遗憾；控制全时域误报，证明对数级检测延迟；在使裁剪烧入后失效的显式条件下同样成立对数遗憾。
AI.conclusion: 在给出的可行性条件下，扩展检测器可在固定窗口内以可检测的超额能量覆盖致稳性变化，表明控制中的可容许变化在利用阶段提供信息，从而实现对数遗憾的最小方差控制。

title: A Closed-Loop Non-Asymptotic Convergence Analysis of PPO with Learned Critics and Clipping
summary: Despite its widespread use, Proximal Policy Optimization with clipping (PPO-Clip) remains difficult to tune, and the interactions among critic learning, clipping, and rollout reuse remain incompletely understood. We develop a \emph{non-asymptotic} analysis of PPO-Clip as a \emph{closed-loop actor--critic} system. It captures actor--critic coupling, nonsmooth probability-ratio clipping, finite-batch reuse, and predictable early stopping under explicit coverage and critic regularity assumptions, using raw GAE and Monte Carlo critic targets. Our synchronous and asynchronous guarantees jointly characterize policy stationarity and the tracking accuracy of the learned critic, with explicit dependence on algorithmic parameters. A sufficient coupling condition gives optimization, critic tracking, clipping, and finite-batch errors a common amplification bound. The asynchronous result also requires a delay-dependent critic stepsize restriction; violating these conditions does not establish divergence. For finite layered MDPs with tabular critics, a uniform bound on the actual clipped-gradient class replaces complete-trajectory counting. A verified growing-horizon family has polynomial sample complexity, and a two-time-scale schedule gives $O(T^{-2/5})$ stationarity and critic-tracking bounds with explicit fresh-rollout accounting. These results together advance our understanding about PPO and provide theoretical guidance in tuning.

AI.tldr: 该论文对PPO-Clip作为闭环actor-critic系统进行非渐近分析，同时刻画策略平稳性与critic跟踪精度，并给出显式依赖算法参数的收敛保证及调参指导。
AI.motivation: PPO-Clip应用广泛但难以调参，且critic学习、clipping与rollout复用之间的交互作用尚不完全清楚。作者旨在从理论上理解这些机制并给出调参依据。
AI.method: 建立PPO-Clip作为闭环actor-critic系统的非渐近分析，涵盖actor-critic耦合、非光滑概率比clipping、有限批次复用和可预测早停；在显式覆盖与critic正则性假设下使用原始GAE和蒙特卡洛critic目标；分别给出同步与异步保证；导出充分耦合条件将优化、critic跟踪、clipping和有限批次误差统一到共同放大界；异步结果需延迟相关的critic步长限制；对有限分层MDP与表格critic，用实际clipped梯度类的一致界替代完整轨迹计数。
AI.result: 同步与异步保证共同刻画策略平稳性和critic跟踪精度；验证的递增horizon族具有多项式样本复杂度；两时间尺度调度给出O(T^{-2/5})的平稳性和critic跟踪界，并显式计入新rollout的开销。作者指出违反上述条件并不证明发散。
AI.conclusion: 该工作推进了对PPO的理论理解，为调参提供了理论指导，揭示了critic学习、clipping与rollout复用耦合下的收敛机制与参数依赖。

title: Sparse Planning in Visual World Models via Cost Gradients
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. 20 pages, 6 figures, 8 tables. Project page and demos: https://ycxuyingchen.github.io/costgrad/
summary: Token-based world models enable fine-grained latent planning, but repeatedly processing large spatial token grids makes action search expensive. We introduce COSTGRAD, a training-free, goal-conditioned selector that ranks spatial tokens by the gradient norm of the planning cost with respect to each input token. By deriving importance from the downstream control objective, COSTGRAD targets tokens that matter for planning rather than merely for prediction. On AdaLN-conditioned predictors at $50\%$ sparsity, COSTGRAD matches or exceeds full-token planning on three of four continuous-control benchmarks, while giving a measured $2.6\times$ wall-clock speedup per environment planning step. Combining token sparsity with reduced CEM search increases this to a $\sim 5\times$ total speedup while still exceeding the full-token baseline. We also identify an architecture-dependent failure mode: in a matched AdaLN-vs-concat comparison, concat maintains comparable full-token performance but pure COSTGRAD loses its advantage over random selection. This difference tracks action-pathway drift: gradient-selected removal produces less drift than random removal on AdaLN, but more on concat. These results highlight selector-architecture compatibility as a design axis for sparse world-model planning. Project page and demos: https://ycxuyingchen.github.io/costgrad/

AI.tldr: 提出免训练、目标条件化的token选择器COSTGRAD，依据规划代价对输入token的梯度范数对空间token排序，在AdaLN预测器上实现稀疏规划加速且保持或超越全token性能，并揭示其与concat架构不兼容的失效模式。
AI.motivation: 基于token的世界模型支持细粒度隐空间规划，但反复处理大规模空间token网格导致动作搜索代价高昂。现有稀疏化方法多以预测重要性为目标，而非以规划/控制目标为导向，因此选出的token未必对规划真正关键。
AI.method: COSTGRAD是一种免训练、目标条件化的选择器：计算规划代价对每个输入token的梯度范数，据此对空间token排序并保留高重要性的子集，重要性来自下游控制目标而非仅预测目标。方法在AdaLN条件化预测器上以50%稀疏度评估，并可与缩减的CEM搜索结合；同时进行AdaLN与concat架构的匹配对照实验。
AI.result: 在AdaLN条件化预测器、50%稀疏度下，COSTGRAD在四个连续控制基准中的三个达到或超过全token规划，单步环境规划测得2.6倍墙钟加速；结合token稀疏与缩减CEM搜索可达约5倍总加速且仍优于全token基线。在AdaLN对比concat的匹配实验中，concat保持与全token相当的性能，但纯COSTGRAD相对随机选择的优势消失；该差异与动作通路漂移相关：AdaLN上梯度选择比随机移除漂移更小，concat上则更大。
AI.conclusion: 以规划目标为导向的token选择可在保持规划质量的同时显著提速，但选择器与架构的兼容性是稀疏世界模型规划的关键设计维度。

title: Physics-Aligned Electronic Ground-State Learning Improves Generalization
summary: Machine-learned interatomic potentials (MLIPs) excel at in-distribution tasks, accelerating drug and material development, yet they struggle to generalize out-of-distribution. We propose to push the cost-accuracy Pareto frontier by designing observable-agnostic electronic ground-state descriptor models (GSMs) with computational costs situated between MLIPs and Kohn-Sham density functional theory (KS-DFT). We align the learning objectives and architectures of GSMs with the governing equations of KS-DFT by enforcing physical constraints and removing optimization pressure on unphysical or irrelevant degrees of freedom. In our size-extrapolation experiments from QM9 to QM40, our combined contributions OrthoNormal-Loss (ON-Loss) and Grassmann Restricted Occupied-Orbital Training (GROOT) reach a 79.1% energy and 83.4% force mean absolute error (MAE) reduction over previous state-of-the-art density GSMs. For Hamiltonian GSMs, ON-Loss and Residual Optimal-gauge Conditioning-aware KS-Eq. Training (ROCKET) together reduce the energy and force MAEs of the strongest baseline by 99.8% and 95.9%, respectively. Using a self-consistency rejection criterion, we filter out extrapolation errors on QMugs, rejecting fewer than 0.4% of predictions while reaching an energy MAE of 0.07 mHa. Finally, we demonstrate the efficiency of label-free self-consistency fine-tuning, and transfer GSMs to reactive chemistry in Transition1x, reaching energy errors below chemical accuracy.

AI.tldr: 该工作提出"电子基态描述符模型（GSM）"，将计算成本定位在机器学习原子间势（MLIP）与Kohn-Sham密度泛函理论（KS-DFT）之间，通过物理约束对齐学习目标与KS-DFT控制方程，在能量与力的泛化精度上大幅超越既有密度/哈密顿量GSM。
AI.motivation: MLIP在分布内任务上表现优异，但分布外泛化能力差。作者希望突破成本-精度的帕累托前沿，构建一种成本介于MLIP与KS-DFT之间、可观测无关的电子基态描述符模型，以兼顾精度与效率。
AI.method: 设计可观测无关的GSM；通过施加物理约束、消除对非物理或无关自由度的优化压力，使学习目标与架构同KS-DFT控制方程对齐。具体提出：密度GSM方面采用正交归一损失（ON-Loss）与Grassmann限制占据轨道训练（GROOT）；哈密顿量GSM方面采用ON-Loss与残差最优规范条件感知KS方程训练（ROCKET）。并引入自洽拒绝准则进行误差过滤，以及无标签自洽微调。
AI.result: 在QM9→QM40尺寸外推实验中，ON-Loss+GROOT相较此前最优密度GSM降低能量MAE 79.1%、力MAE 83.4%；ON-Loss+ROCKET使最强基线的能量与力MAE分别降低99.8%与95.9%。自洽拒绝准则在QMugs上剔除小于0.4%的预测即可达到0.07 mHa的能量MAE。无标签自洽微调高效，并成功迁移至Transition1x反应化学，能量误差低于化学精度。
AI.conclusion: 通过对齐KS-DFT控制方程并施加物理约束，GSM有效提升了分布外泛化能力，显著降低能量与力误差，并提供自洽拒绝与无标签微调等实用机制，可作为介于MLIP与KS-DFT之间的高性价比建模方案。

title: Shared Gaussianization: What Gaussian Regularizers Certify About Contrastive Learning, and What They Miss
comment: 27 pages, 4 figures, 3 tables. Ruoyu Zhao and Yuting Chen contributed equally; Tong Che is the project lead
summary: What can a distribution-matching regularizer such as SIGReg in LeJEPA certify about contrastive learning? We study shared Gaussianization (SG), a characteristic-function Gaussianity test on the average of two normalized views, scaled by an independent $χ_d$ radius. Because disagreeing views shorten the average, one test detects both misalignment and non-uniformity. SG vanishes exactly at the aligned, uniform minimizers of population InfoNCE, and under equal marginals it bounds the InfoNCE excess by $4\cdot 3^{3/4}β$ times the square root of the SG loss, plus a term linear in the loss. The square-root rate and this dimension-free constant are sharp, and no squared mean-embedding distance on view pairs achieves a faster rate. With an explicit alignment term, a rotation-invariant uniformity test gives a linear bound if and only if its spectrum dominates that of InfoNCE's kernel $e^{βu^\top v}$; SG's own test does, Gaussian kernels $e^{-γ\|u-v\|^2}$ qualify exactly when $γ\ge β/2$, and moment matching never does. Away from the optimum, the objectives differ. Along an isotropic nuisance channel, pure SG lowers its loss by adding per-view nuisance whenever the shared code is non-uniform. An alignment weight above the channel's gain makes the nuisance-free solution a strict local minimizer; for LeJEPA, the same rule gives a critical SIGReg weight that decreases with the batch size. At finite batch size, an off-diagonal U-statistic removes a plug-in bias toward misalignment. In controlled latent-variable models, pure SG retains per-view style, an alignment weight above the measured gain removes it, and for LeJEPA at three batch sizes the measured gain separates the encoders that retain style from those that do not. InfoNCE training also reaches a lower SG$_{0.2}$ loss than SG$_{0.2}$ training from scratch, which points to an optimization gap.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究共享高斯化(SG)正则化器，证明其能同时检测对比学习中的错位与非均匀性，并在总体InfoNCE最优处精确消失，给出尖锐的平方根界与维度无关常数。
AI.motivation: 现有的分布匹配正则化（如LeJEPA中的SIGReg）与对比学习目标（InfoNCE）之间的关系缺乏理论刻画，尤其是这类正则化究竟能"认证"什么、其界是否尖锐、以及能否防止退化解尚不清楚。
AI.method: 对两个归一化视图的平均值施加特征函数高斯性检验，并用独立的χ_d半径缩放，定义共享高斯化(SG)。通过理论分析推导SG与InfoNCE目标之间的不等式关系、尖锐性、以及在有限批下的U统计量修正，并在受控潜变量模型中进行实验验证。
AI.result: SG在总体InfoNCE的对齐、均匀极小值处精确消失；在等边际条件下以√SG损失乘以4·3^{3/4}β加倍率线性项界定InfoNCE超额，且该平方根速率与维度无关常数是尖锐的；视图对上的平方均值嵌入距离无法达到更快速率；旋转不变均匀性检验给出线性界当且仅当其谱支配InfoNCE核e^{βuᵀv}的谱，高斯核e^{-γ‖u−v‖²}在γ≥β/2时合格而矩匹配永不满足；非最优处目标不同；沿各向同性干扰通道，对齐权重超过通道增益时无干扰解成为严格局部极小；LeJEPA的临界SIGReg权重随批大小下降；离对角U统计量消除插件偏差；实验确认增益可区分保留风格的编码器，且InfoNCE训练达到比从零训练SG更低的SG_{0.2}损失。
AI.conclusion: SG提供了一个既有理论保证又尖锐的对比学习正则化框架，其检验同时捕捉错位与均匀性，并能通过对齐权重与合适核选择抑制干扰通道与风格保留；但仍存在优化间隙，InfoNCE训练优于纯SG从零训练。

title: Revisiting Explainable AI through Model-Independent Concept Dictionaries
summary: Modern applications of AI rely on increasingly complex models. Explainable AI (XAI) has emerged as a set of techniques aimed at improving model transparency. However, existing XAI methods typically assume input features to be inherently interpretable, or they rely on intermediate internal abstractions that are difficult to characterize and highly architecture-specific, hindering consistent use across models. To address these limitations, we propose DictXAI, a method that defines concepts directly in the input domain via a dictionary---a large, potentially overcomplete set of predefined elements, each carrying an interpretable meaning. Technically, DictXAI first computes a sparse code of the input and then attributes the model's prediction to the associated dictionary elements. We demonstrate the actionable nature of DictXAI explanations, showing that they can attribute AI malfunctions (e.g., Clever Hans effects) directly to identifiable artifact patterns in the data, while fostering human-AI alignment on intricate biomedical signals. We further demonstrate our method's ability to operate across a wide variety of dictionaries, including learned image bases, analytically defined waveforms for electrocardiography, and experimentally acquired dictionary elements. Overall, our results show that DictXAI provides more interpretable, actionable, and architecture-agnostic insights than classical XAI or existing concept-based approaches.

AI.tldr: DictXAI通过输入域字典定义概念，基于稀疏编码将预测归因于字典元素，实现可解释、可操作且与架构无关的XAI。
AI.motivation: 现有XAI方法假设输入特征本身可解释，或依赖难以刻画且高度依赖架构的内部抽象，导致跨模型一致性差、解释难以应用。需要一种不依赖模型内部结构、概念定义直接建于输入域的方法。
AI.method: DictXAI在输入域中用字典（大规模、可能过完备的预定义元素集合，每个元素具有可解释含义）直接定义概念。先计算输入的稀疏编码，再将模型预测归因到相关的字典元素上。
AI.result: 解释可定位AI失效（如Clever Hans效应）于数据中可识别的伪影模式，并促进生物医学信号上的人机对齐；方法适用于多种字典：学习的图像基、心电图解析波形、实验获取的字典元素。
AI.conclusion: DictXAI比经典XAI或现有基于概念的方法提供更可解释、可操作且架构无关的洞见。

title: Continual Graph Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
summary: In Continual Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (CMARL), agents learn cooperative policies across sequences of tasks, aiming to adapt effectively to new tasks while preserving the ability to solve previously encountered ones. In many applications, tasks differ in their underlying structure, which can represent, for example, distinct operational conditions or target configurations (e.g., different network topologies in power grids or arrangements in formation control). Existing CMARL methods lack dedicated mechanisms to leverage this structural information when learning new tasks, failing to promote transfer and mitigate forgetting. To fill this gap, we propose Continual Graph Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (CGMARL), a novel framework for CMARL problems in which task sequences are mapped into a series of attributed graphs, each modeling a task-specific structure. In CGMARL, each graph determines the environment dynamics (next states and/or rewards) and the number of agents for the corresponding task. Then, we present Graph-based Formation (GRAFO), the first CGMARL benchmark, and show how forgetting arises in this setting. Finally, to address this limitation, we propose Frozen Graph Encoder (FROG), a method that relies on a frozen graph backbone to preserve past structural information in graph-based CMARL policies. Experiments on GRAFO show that pairing FROG with existing CL methods substantially improves performance on multiple CGMARL scenarios.

AI.tldr: 提出CGMARL框架，将连续多智能体任务序列映射为属性图，并给出基准GRAFO与冻结图编码器FROG方法。
AI.motivation: 现有连续多智能体强化学习（CMARL）方法缺乏利用任务底层结构信息的专门机制，难以促进知识迁移并缓解遗忘；而许多实际任务的结构差异（如电网拓扑、编队构型）正体现为图结构。
AI.method: 提出CGMARL框架：将任务序列映射为一系列属性图，每张图决定对应任务的环境动力学（下一状态和/或奖励）及智能体数量；构建首个CGMARL基准GRAFO以展示遗忘现象；提出FROG方法，依赖冻结的图骨干网络来保留图基CMARL策略中过往的结构信息。
AI.result: 在GRAFO基准上的实验表明，将FROG与现有连续学习方法结合，可显著提升多个CGMARL场景下的性能。
AI.conclusion: 利用图结构信息并冻结图编码器，是提升连续多智能体强化学习中迁移能力、抑制灾难性遗忘的有效途径。

title: How Do Transformers Learn to Represent Symmetries?
summary: Training Transformer-based architectures with finite data augmentation has become an increasingly popular approach in geometric machine learning. Despite its empirical success, the interplay between the Transformer architecture, invariance to different symmetries, and augmentation budgets remains underexplored. In this paper, we study the ability of a vanilla Transformer to learn various symmetries through finite data augmentation for point cloud datasets. We identify an ordering of increasing learnability across the following symmetry groups: (i) non-angle-preserving symmetries, (ii) angle-preserving symmetries, and (iii) base angle-preserving subgroups, such as translation, rotation, and scale. For the base angle-preserving groups, we further investigate the Transformer's extrapolation behavior and conduct a structural analysis of the trained models, allowing us to identify interpretable mechanisms that induce invariance. Finally, we extend our analysis to equivariant functions and show that the detected mechanisms for approximate invariance can also provide a key building block for learned equivariance. Our project page is available at https://transformers-learn-symmetries.github.io/

AI.tldr: 本文研究原生 Transformer 通过有限数据增强学习点云对称性的能力，发现不同对称群的学习难度分层，并揭示了诱导近似不变性的可解释机制。
AI.motivation: 有限数据增强训练 Transformer 在几何机器学习中日益流行，但 Transformer 架构、对称不变性与增强预算之间的相互作用尚缺乏深入探索。
AI.method: 在点云数据集上，用原生 Transformer 通过有限数据增强学习不同对称群；针对基础保角子群进一步分析外推行为，并对训练模型进行结构分析以识别不变性机制；将分析扩展到等变函数。
AI.result: 识别出可学习性递增的对称群排序：非保角对称 < 保角对称 < 基础保角子群（平移、旋转、缩放）；发现诱导不变性的可解释机制，且这些机制可作为学习等变性的关键构件。
AI.conclusion: 原生 Transformer 可通过有限数据增强习得多种对称性，其内在机制既能解释近似不变性，也可支撑等变性的学习。

title: RSIGym: A Flexible Environment for Recursive Self-Improvement
summary: Recursive self-improvement requires carrying accepted changes into later improvement cycles, while studying agent-proposed changes also requires substantial research infrastructure. Existing settings often leave agents to rebuild routine infrastructure or restrict exploration to individual components. We introduce RSIGym, an agent-native research environment based on Everything as a Service (EaaS). RSIGym exposes training, inference, rollout, evaluation, and sandbox execution through reusable services, with shared budget and permission controls supporting Data, Harness, and Joint improvement tracks. This design enables agents to investigate individual interventions and jointly optimize data, training settings, and execution harnesses within the same environment. We define RSI-Index as the mean fraction of the remaining performance gap closed across five benchmarks covering software engineering, terminal interaction, mathematics, scientific reasoning, and skill-based tasks. Comparing six frontier research models in independent Joint runs, Opus 5 achieves the highest RSI-Index of 0.4809 under a $500 platform-service budget per benchmark run. Its selected systems improve all five benchmarks, raising SWE-bench Verified from 17.67% to 50.33% and AIME from 31.67% to 97.78%. Additional experiments examine DSH-harness refinement, budget variation, and restricted network access, while recorded trajectories reveal how agents diagnose failures and select candidates. We open-source the full RSIGym codebase and results to support reproducibility and further research.

AI.tldr: 提出 RSIGym——基于 Everything as a Service (EaaS) 的 agent 原生研究环境,支持 Data、Harness、Joint 三类改进轨道;定义 RSI-Index 指标,Opus 5 在 Joint 独立运行中取得最高 0.4809。
AI.motivation: 递归自我改进（Recursive Self-Improvement, RSI）要求把已接受的修改带入后续改进周期,但研究 agent 自主提出的改动需要大量研究基础设施。现有设定常让 agent 反复重建常规基础设施,或只能针对单个组件进行探索,难以在同一环境中联合优化数据、训练配置与执行 harness。
AI.method: 构建 RSIGym:以 EaaS 为架构的 agent 原生研究环境,将训练、推理、rollout、评测与沙箱执行封装为可复用服务,并提供共享的预算与权限控制,支撑 Data、Harness、Joint 三条改进轨道。定义 RSI-Index 为在软件工程、终端交互、数学、科学推理与技能任务五类基准上,平均的剩余性能差距闭合比例。对比六个前沿研究模型的独立 Joint 运行,并开展 DSH-harness 精化、预算变化、受限网络访问等附加实验,同时对轨迹进行记录与分析。
AI.result: 在每基准运行 500 美元平台服务预算下,Opus 5 取得最高 RSI-Index 0.4809;其筛选出的系统在全部五项基准上均有提升,SWE-bench Verified 从 17.67% 提升至 50.33%,AIME 从 31.67% 提升至 97.78%。附加实验覆盖 DSH-harness 精化、预算变化与受限网络访问,记录的轨迹揭示了 agent 诊断失败与筛选候选方案的过程。
AI.conclusion: RSIGym 通过服务化基础设施使 agent 能在统一环境中联合优化数据、训练设置与执行 harness,并支持递归携带已接受改动;RSI-Index 提供了跨多基准的可比度量。代码库与结果全部开源,以支持可复现性与后续研究。

title: PoreML: A Data-Driven Framework for Learning Multiphase Flow in Porous Media
summary: Multiphase flow in porous microstructures is central to CO$_2$ storage, fuel-cell operation, and flip-chip packaging. Predicting these flows remains challenging because wettability and complex pore geometry govern the nonlinear evolution of fluid interfaces. Machine learning holds substantial promise for advancing the field, but progress is constrained by scarce time-resolved 3D datasets and a lack of a unified workflow for training and evaluating models. To fill this critical gap, we introduce PoreML, an open-source framework unifying data generation, model training, and evaluation grounded in pore-scale physics. The framework comprises three core components. (a) A modern GPU-native lattice Boltzmann solver, validated against analytical solutions and published experiments, enables reproducible data generation. (b) A 3.3 TB dataset contains 560 simulation runs and 158,546 stored time steps across four application-driven scenarios. These trajectories span synthetic structures and geometries derived from micro-CT scans of real materials, covering diverse wetting conditions and viscosity ratios. (c) A unified learning framework evaluates one-step prediction and autoregressive rollouts. Its domain-specific evaluation protocols assess predictive accuracy and physical consistency. We evaluate five models of diverse architecture under these protocols. Two complementary challenges assess transfer to larger domains and from synthetic to micro-CT-derived structures. PoreML provides a shared foundation for machine-learning research on multiphase flow in porous media, with the aim of empowering the community to develop reliable predictive models and advance the field.

AI.tldr: PoreML：面向多孔介质多相流的开源统一框架，整合GPU格子玻尔兹曼数据生成、3.3TB时序数据集与统一训练评估协议。
AI.motivation: 多孔微结构中多相流对CO2封存、燃料电池和倒装芯片封装至关重要，但润湿性与复杂孔隙几何使界面非线性演化难以预测。机器学习虽有潜力，却受限于缺乏时间分辨的3D数据以及缺少统一的训练与评估流程。
AI.method: PoreML包含三部分：(a) GPU原生的现代格子玻尔兹曼求解器，经解析解与已发表实验验证，支持可复现数据生成；(b) 3.3 TB数据集，含560次模拟、158,546个存储时间步，覆盖四个应用场景，涵盖合成结构与真实材料micro-CT扫描几何、多种润湿条件和黏度比；(c) 统一学习框架，评估单步预测与自回归推演，并提供领域专用评估协议衡量预测精度与物理一致性。
AI.result: 在该协议下评估了五种不同架构的模型，并通过两项互补挑战考察向更大区域的迁移以及从合成结构到micro-CT结构的迁移。
AI.conclusion: PoreML为多孔介质多相流的机器学习研究提供共享基础，旨在赋能社区开发可靠预测模型并推动领域发展。

title: Thinking in Depth: Retrospective Inference for Tabular Foundation Models
summary: Tabular foundation models (TFMs) are pretrained across diverse tabular tasks and make predictions on a new table at inference time using its labeled examples as context. Most recent TFMs perform such in-context prediction with stacked Transformer layers, repeatedly transforming how examples are represented and compared. By tracing individual queries through several strong TFMs, we find that predictive refinement is highly uneven across depth and is often concentrated in later layers. This uneven refinement motivates us to reconsider how intermediate representations are constructed and reused throughout the network. We introduce Retro, a tabular foundation model based on retrospective inference, where later stages can explicitly revisit and recombine intermediate information produced earlier in the network. Retro organizes this process around two complementary operations: which intermediate information to revisit, and how the resulting contextual update should be shaped for each query. Attention Residuals address the former by adaptively reweighting contributions from different depths, while query-conditioned Gated Attention addresses the latter by modulating the attention output element-wise across representation dimensions. Our analysis shows that Retro shifts predictive refinement earlier and more broadly across depth, with different stages revising different subsets of queries in a pattern suggestive of multi-view refinement. Across TabArena, TALENT, and RelArena, Retro ranks among the top three and lies on the Pareto frontier. These results indicate that directly reusing intermediate representations provides a practical way to better exploit depth in TFMs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Retro，一种基于回顾式推理（retrospective inference）的表格基础模型，通过重访并重组中间层信息来更充分地利用网络深度。
AI.motivation: 作者发现主流表格基础模型（TFMs）在上下文预测中，预测精炼在深度方向上高度不均匀，往往集中在较靠后的层，导致中间表示利用不足。这一现象促使作者重新思考中间表示的构建与复用方式。
AI.method: Retro 采用回顾式推理，允许后层显式重访并重组早期中间信息，围绕两个互补操作展开：Attention Residuals 自适应地对不同深度的贡献重新加权（决定重访哪些中间信息）；query-conditioned Gated Attention 按查询对注意力输出在表示维度上做逐元素调制（决定上下文更新的形态）。
AI.result: 分析表明 Retro 将预测精炼提前并更广泛地分布到各深度，不同阶段修正不同查询子集，呈多视角精炼模式。在 TabArena、TALENT 和 RelArena 上，Retro 均排名前三并位于 Pareto 前沿。
AI.conclusion: 直接复用中间表示是更充分挖掘 TFMs 深度潜力的实用途径。

title: HAN-Mamba: Hierarchical Selective State Space Networks for Multi-Scale Financial Volatility Forecasting
comment: 16 pages. Accepted for publication in Springer Lecture Notes in Artificial Intelligence (ICAART 2026 Revised Selected Papers). Extended version of the ICAART 2026 paper (DOI: 10.5220/0014264900004052)
summary: Short-horizon realized volatility forecasting requires the integration of market information that evolves at incompatible temporal resolutions, from second-level order book dynamics to weekly regime drift. Our conference work introduced HAN-T, a hierarchical architecture in which scale-specific Transformer encoders process short, mid, and long-horizon streams and a learned attention fuser weighs their contributions. This article replaces the quadratic attention encoders with selective state space (Mamba) encoders while retaining attention only in the fuser, where the input is a three-token set rather than a long sequence. The resulting hybrid, HAN-Mamba, summarizes each stream through a recurrent state whose input-dependent gating matches two structural properties of volatility: persistent but decaying memory and abrupt regime shifts. On the Optiver Realized Volatility Prediction benchmark under time-aware five-fold cross-validation, HAN-Mamba improves mean RMSPE over HAN-T (0.1942 vs. 0.1965) with 33% fewer parameters. Its linear-time encoders further allow the high-frequency context to be extended from 60 to 240 buckets, reducing error to 0.1927 where the attention variant saturates, and support constant-time streaming updates at inference. Ablations attribute the gains to the encoder swap, confirm that the hierarchical prior transfers across sequence-model families, and show that the permutation-invariant attention fuser remains the correct mechanism for cross-scale integration.

AI.tldr: 本文将 HAN-T 中的二次注意力编码器替换为选择性状态空间（Mamba）编码器，构造混合模型 HAN-Mamba，在仅保留跨尺度融合注意力的情况下实现更优的短期已实现波动率预测。
AI.motivation: 短期已实现波动率预测需要融合从秒级订单簿动态到周级机制漂移等时间分辨率极不兼容的市场信息。作者前期会议工作 HAN-T 用多尺度 Transformer 编码器加注意力融合器处理该问题，但二次注意力计算成本高，难以扩展高频上下文长度，也无法支持常数时间的流式更新。
AI.method: 保留 HAN-T 的分层多尺度结构与跨尺度注意力融合器，将短、中、长三个尺度的 Transformer 编码器替换为选择性状态空间（Mamba）编码器；融合器输入仅为三个 token 而非长序列，故仍使用注意力。由此得到的 HAN-Mamba 通过输入依赖门控的递归状态刻画波动率的两个结构特性：持续但衰减的记忆与突发的机制切换。
AI.result: 在 Optiver 已实现波动率预测基准上，采用时间感知五折交叉验证：HAN-Mamba 平均 RMSPE 由 HAN-T 的 0.1965 降至 0.1942，参数减少 33%；线性时间编码器使高频上下文由 60 个 bucket 扩展至 240 个，误差进一步降至 0.1927，而注意力版本在此已饱和，并支持推理阶段的常数时间流式更新。消融实验表明增益主要来自编码器替换，分层先验可跨序列模型族迁移，置换不变的注意力融合器仍是跨尺度整合的正确机制。
AI.conclusion: 以 Mamba 编码器替换二次注意力编码器并仅在跨尺度融合处保留注意力，可在显著降低参数量和计算复杂度、支持长上下文与流式推理的同时提升短期波动率预测精度；分层多尺度先验具有跨模型族的通用性，注意力融合器在跨尺度整合中不可替代。

title: Average-Reward Reinforcement Learning for Multichain MDPs: A Hierarchical Decomposition Approach
summary: We study learning optimal policies in average-reward multichain Markov decision processes (MDPs), where the optimal gain may depend on the initial state and recurrence structures vary across policies, creating challenges for reinforcement learning (RL) methods. We propose an asynchronous value-iteration-based RL algorithm that requires no model knowledge beyond the MDP's transition graph and leverages Bather's decomposition to hierarchically partition the state space into communicating subsystems and transient states. This decomposition induces a recasting of the global decision problem into structured subproblems, which our algorithm exploits. We show that the algorithm converges to the optimal gain and produces gain-optimal policies after finite time. Building on this base algorithm, we develop two further algorithms: one approximately solves the multichain average optimality equations to obtain near gain-optimal policies, and another targets near bias-optimality by approximating the optimal bias function and solving an induced average-reward multichain MDP using the base algorithm. We provide almost-sure convergence guarantees for all three algorithms and empirically compare their tradeoffs, showing that the latter two also consistently improve transient performance relative to the base algorithm. To our knowledge, these are the first essentially model-free average-reward RL algorithms for general multichain MDPs without reductions to discounted problems.

AI.tldr: 本文针对平均奖励多链MDP，提出首个本质上无模型的强化学习算法，基于Bather分解将状态空间分层为通信子系统与瞬态状态，实现增益最优策略的有限时间收敛。
AI.motivation: 平均奖励多链MDP中，最优增益可能依赖初始状态，且不同策略下递归结构各异，这给强化学习带来挑战。现有方法多将问题归约为折扣问题，缺乏真正无模型的处理手段。
AI.method: 提出异步值迭代型RL算法，除MDP的转移图外无需其他模型知识；利用Bather分解将状态空间分层为通信子系统与瞬态状态，把全局决策问题重构为结构化子问题。在此基础上扩展出两个算法：一个近似求解多链平均最优方程以获得近增益最优策略，另一个通过逼近最优偏置函数并求解诱导的平均奖励多链MDP来实现近偏置最优。
AI.result: 证明了基础算法能在有限时间内收敛到最优增益并产生增益最优策略；三个算法均具有几乎必然收敛保证。实验表明后两个算法在瞬态性能上始终优于基础算法，并比较了三者的权衡取舍。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提出了首批针对一般多链MDP、无需归约为折扣问题的本质无模型平均奖励RL算法，为多链场景下的强化学习提供了新的理论与算法基础。

title: AutoAdapt: Automatic Domain Discovery Enables Low-Cost Extensibility
summary: Instruction-tuned models are deployed into environments where domains are heterogeneous and evolve, yet adding new domains or data typically requires costly retraining. We present AutoAdapt, a modular framework that incorporates new domains and data via targeted single-adapter training without modifying other adapters. The framework automatically discovers latent domains, uses them to train per-domain Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) adapters independently in parallel and performs parameter-free routing. Across 14 domain-specific benchmarks and GPT-4o pairwise judgements, AutoAdapt achieves parity with a LoRA adapter trained on all domains without requiring full-model retraining. We also find evidence of specialisation effect convergence across independent discovery methods. Overall, training each adapter on its own domain prevents domain interference by construction, thus enabling modular, taxonomy-free domain specialisation without aggregate performance loss or full model retraining.

AI.tldr: 提出AutoAdapt模块化框架，通过自动发现潜在域并独立并行训练各域LoRA适配器，实现免全模型重训练的域扩展，性能与全域训练适配器持平。
AI.motivation: 指令微调模型部署环境中的域高度异构且持续演化，但新增域或数据通常需要代价高昂的全模型重训练，缺乏可扩展的增量适配方案。
AI.method: AutoAdapt自动发现潜在域，据此为每个域独立并行训练LoRA适配器，并采用无参数路由机制进行推理时适配器选择；新增域仅需训练单个适配器，不修改其他适配器。
AI.result: 在14个域特定基准及GPT-4o成对评估中，AutoAdapt达到与使用全部域数据训练的LoRA适配器相当的性能；并发现不同独立域发现方法之间存在专业化效应收敛的证据。
AI.conclusion: 按域独立训练适配器从结构上避免了域间干扰，实现了模块化、免分类体系的域专业化，且不损失聚合性能、无需全模型重训练。

title: ORDERS: An Empirical Study of Norm-Rank Aggregation for Personalized Federated Learning
summary: Personalized federated learning combines shared representations with client-specific predictors, but the contribution of a server weighting rule can be obscured by local training and evaluation choices. We study ORDERS, a configuration that combines a shared backbone, a private residual adapter and classifier, geometric weights assigned by descending update norm, feature alignment, and private-parameter perturbations. The server computes a weighted sum of updates obtained from the same broadcast model; it does not obtain an additional optimization effect from sequential addition. A fully specified evaluation comprises 80 final runs: eight configurations, two datasets, and five training seeds on one fixed partition per dataset. On two-class-per-client CIFAR-10, ORDERS achieves $80.51 \pm 0.79\%$ native mean client accuracy, compared with $79.02 \pm 1.42\%$ for FedPer-R1 and $80.27 \pm 0.73\%$ for the matched uniform-weight control. After common local fine-tuning, the difference from FedPer-R1 narrows to 0.32 percentage points. On Sent140, ORDERS reaches $74.71 \pm 0.49\%$, only 0.69 points above a post hoc client training-majority diagnostic. Ablations provide limited, endpoint-dependent evidence for norm ranking and alignment, and no clear benefit from perturbations. Parameter-payload savings are 5.47% and 0.78%, respectively.

AI.tldr: 本文研究个性化联邦学习配置ORDERS（共享骨干+私有残差适配器与分类器、按更新范数降序分配的几何权重、特征对齐、私有参数扰动）。在2类/客户端CIFAR-10上，ORDERS达80.51±0.79%，仅略高于FedPer-R1（79.02±1.42%）与匹配的均匀权重对照（80.27±0.73%）；经共同本地微调后与FedPer-R1差距缩至0.32个百分点。在Sent140上为74.71±0.49%，仅比事后客户端训练多数类诊断高0.69个百分点。消融实验对范数排序与对齐的支持有限且依赖端点，扰动无明确收益；参数传输节省仅5.47%和0.78%。
AI.motivation: 个性化联邦学习常将共享表示与客户端专属预测器结合，但服务器加权规则的贡献容易被本地训练与评估设置所掩盖，难以判断其真实增益。本文旨在厘清ORDERS配置中各组件（尤其范数降序几何权重）的实际作用，并检验其相对于均匀权重、FedPer-R1及简单诊断基线的优势是否稳健。
AI.method: 研究对象为ORDERS配置：共享骨干网络 + 私有残差适配器与分类器；服务器按更新范数降序分配的几何权重进行加权求和（各更新均来自同一广播模型，非顺序累加，故无额外优化效应）；特征对齐；私有参数扰动。评估为完整规格的80次最终运行：8种配置×2个数据集×5个训练种子，每个数据集使用一个固定划分。对照包括FedPer-R1、匹配的均匀权重控制以及事后客户端训练多数类诊断；并开展消融。
AI.result: CIFAR-10（每客户端2类）：ORDERS原生平均客户端准确率80.51±0.79%，FedPer-R1为79.02±1.42%，匹配均匀权重对照为80.27±0.73%；共同本地微调后与FedPer-R1差距缩小至0.32个百分点。Sent140：ORDERS为74.71±0.49%，仅高于事后客户端训练多数类诊断0.69个百分点。消融对范数排序与对齐仅提供有限且依赖端点的证据，扰动无明确收益。参数载荷节省分别为5.47%与0.78%。
AI.conclusion: ORDERS的增益有限且脆弱：其服务器几何加权相对均匀权重几乎无实质优势，与FedPer-R1的差异在共同微调后进一步收窄，且在Sent140上仅略优于简单多数类诊断。消融未给出范数排序、对齐与扰动的稳健支持，参数传输节省也较小。整体表明该服务器加权规则的贡献在很大程度上被本地训练与评估选择所掩盖。

title: Koopman Observers for Diffusion Acceleration: Correcting Feature Forecasts with Shallow Measurements
summary: Feature caching accelerates diffusion sampling by replacing expensive network evaluations with predictions from previously computed activations. However, forecasts based only on past features cannot directly incorporate changes in the current denoising state. We investigate whether inexpensive, freshly computed features can serve as observations for correcting these predictions. We introduce an observation-corrected Koopman framework for accelerating frozen diffusion models. Using calibration trajectories, we identify finite-dimensional, time-dependent Koopman approximations that jointly describe the increments of shallow and deep network features. During accelerated sampling, these operators predict the evolution of expensive deep features, while innovations in the observed shallow features correct the predicted state. Periodic full evaluations refresh the observer, and all generative-model parameters remain unchanged. This formulation enables controlled comparisons of temporal prediction and observation correction. Across three 10,000-image runs per dataset, our method reduces paired Inception-feature MSE by $19.9\%$ on CIFAR-10 and $11.9\%$ on a ten-class ImageNet subset relative to channelwise affine prediction under the same four-partial-step schedule. Matched ablations attribute additional reductions of $4.54\%$ and $4.67\%$ to observation correction. The observer achieves $1.89\times$ and $1.85\times$ measured speedups over DDIM-50, supporting improved reference-sampler fidelity without retraining the denoiser.

AI.tldr: 本文提出观测校正的Koopman框架加速冻结扩散模型采样，用浅层实时特征校正深层特征预测。
AI.motivation: 仅基于历史特征的外推无法直接纳入当前去噪状态的变化；作者探究廉价、实时计算的特征能否作为观测来校正预测。
AI.method: 基于标定轨迹，辨识有限维、时变的Koopman算子，联合描述浅层与深层网络特征的增量；加速采样时用算子预测昂贵深层特征演化，并用观测到的浅层特征新息校正预测状态；周期性全量评估刷新观测器，生成模型参数保持不变。
AI.result: 在相同四部分步调度下，相比逐通道仿射预测，CIFAR-10的配对Inception特征MSE降低19.9%，十类ImageNet子集降低11.9%；消融显示观测校正额外贡献4.54%和4.67%的降低；观测器相对DDIM-50测得1.89倍和1.85倍加速。
AI.conclusion: 观测校正可提升参考采样器保真度，无需重训练去噪器，并支持时间预测与观测校正的可控比较。

title: Continual Learning without Continual Training
summary: Continual learning requires models to adapt to new domains and new classes while retaining prior knowledge. Many existing methods rely on continued optimization, using regularization, replay, or parameter expansion to prevent new updates from overwriting previously learned knowledge. Instead, we propose replacing continual training with continual inference: a PFN-based model that is meta-trained, and then frozen, adapting to new classes only by extending an in-context evidence set. Our model, Latent Concept PFN, performs in-context Bayesian inference over a latent concept space that captures semantic structure shared across domains and classes. As each new domain or class arrives, exemplars are added to the memory; adaptation reflects updated posterior beliefs over latent concepts rather than gradient updates. No parameters are changed, reducing forgetting. The same method handles both domain and class incremental continual learning without task identity. Concept annotations are only used during meta-training, acting as a soft anchor on the latent space rather than a fixed bottleneck. Unlike fixed-vocabulary concept methods, the model also handles noisy, ambiguous, or incomplete annotations by combining concept labels with raw input evidence to discover distinctions beyond the predefined concept set. Experiments on class and domain incremental learning datasets demonstrate competitive continual learning performance while learning interpretable latent concepts.

AI.tldr: 本文提出用"持续推理"替代"持续训练"：Latent Concept PFN 是一个元训练后冻结的 PFN 模型，仅通过扩展上下文证据集来适应新类与新域，在潜在概念空间上执行上下文贝叶斯推理，无需梯度更新，从而减少遗忘。
AI.motivation: 现有持续学习方法多依赖持续优化，通过正则化、回放或参数扩展来防止新更新覆盖旧知识，存在遗忘风险且需改变参数。作者希望以不改参数的推理方式实现持续适应。
AI.method: 提出 Latent Concept PFN：基于 PFN 的模型先元训练再冻结；在捕捉跨域、跨类语义结构的潜在概念空间上做上下文贝叶斯推理。新域或新类到来时将样本加入记忆，适应体现为潜在概念后验更新而非梯度更新，参数不变。概念标注仅在元训练阶段使用，作为潜在空间的软锚而非固定瓶颈；通过结合概念标签与原始输入证据，可处理噪声、模糊或不完整标注，发现预定义概念集之外的区分特征。同一方法无需任务标识即可处理域增量与类增量持续学习。
AI.result: 在类增量与域增量学习数据集上的实验显示，该方法在取得有竞争力的持续学习性能的同时，学习到可解释的潜在概念。
AI.conclusion: 以"持续推理"替代"持续训练"是一种可行的持续学习范式：冻结的 PFN 通过上下文证据扩展与潜在概念上的贝叶斯后验更新，可统一处理域与类增量场景，减少遗忘并获得可解释概念表示。

title: ResidualQuant: KV Cache Quantization for Looped Transformers with 2-Bit Residuals
summary: Looped Transformers improve parameter efficiency by repeatedly applying shared Transformer blocks over multiple recurrent loops, increasing computational depth without increasing the parameter count. However, KV cache memory still scales with the number of loops, becoming a key memory bottleneck that limits batch size and inference throughput. KV cache quantization can alleviate this bottleneck, but existing methods often suffer substantial accuracy degradation at aggressive low-precision regimes. We observe that looped Transformers offer a unique opportunity: KV states across loops are highly similar. Based on this observation, we propose ResidualQuant, which uses the final-loop KV states as a reference and represents the remaining loops with low-precision residuals. Our method further combines least-square scaling and rotations applied to the residuals, as well as loop-wise mixed precision, to enable accurate quantization down to INT2 while retaining efficient reconstruction. Across multiple looped Transformer models and mathematical reasoning and code generation benchmarks, ResidualQuant consistently improves the accuracy-memory tradeoff over state-of-the-art rotation-based KV quantization. In particular, our method retains accuracy close to BF16 under mixed-precision settings while reducing theoretical KV storage by 80.7%, achieving up to 13.0% higher accuracy than the rotation-based baseline at the same memory budget. On an RTX 5090, the reduced KV memory traffic improves fixed-batch decode throughput by up to 2.73x, while the smaller memory footprint enables up to 2x larger batches, improving peak throughput by up to 4.15x.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 ResidualQuant，利用 Looped Transformer 跨循环 KV 状态高度相似的特点，以末次循环 KV 为参考、用低精度残差表示其余循环，并结合最小二乘缩放、旋转与逐循环混合精度，实现低至 INT2 的高精度 KV 缓存量化。
AI.motivation: Looped Transformer 通过复用共享块提升参数效率、增加计算深度，但 KV 缓存随循环次数线性增长，成为限制批大小与推理吞吐的内存瓶颈。现有 KV 量化方法在激进低精度下精度损失显著，亟需针对循环结构特性的量化方案。
AI.method: 观察到跨循环 KV 状态高度相似，以最终循环 KV 状态为参考，将其余循环表示为低精度残差；对残差施加最小二乘缩放与旋转以提升量化友好性；引入逐循环混合精度，在低至 INT2 下保持准确量化与高效重建。
AI.result: 在多种 Looped Transformer 及数学推理、代码生成基准上，一致优于基于旋转的 SOTA KV 量化。混合精度下精度接近 BF16，理论 KV 存储降低 80.7%，同内存预算下精度最高提升 13.0%。RTX 5090 上固定批解码吞吐提升至 2.73 倍，批次增大至 2 倍，峰值吞吐提升至 4.15 倍。
AI.conclusion: 利用循环间 KV 相似性的残差量化可显著改善精度—内存权衡，缓解 Looped Transformer 的 KV 内存瓶颈，并在实际硬件上带来吞吐与批大小的实质增益。

title: Boosting and the Expressive Power of Simple Weak Learners via the $γ$-VC Dimension
summary: Boosting converts weak hypotheses with a small edge over random guessing into highly accurate predictors, but the expressive power of the resulting classifier can depend strongly on the structure of the base class. We study this phenomenon through the $γ$-VC dimension introduced by Alon et al. (STOC 2021). Our first result shows that this parameter characterizes the sample complexity for weak-to-strong learning up to a constant factor scaling in $γ$. We then sharpen the general relationship between the classic VC dimension and the $γ$-VC dimension. Finally, we also give improved upper and lower bounds on the $γ$-VC dimension for the fundamental concept classes of decision stumps and axis-parallel rectangles in $\mathbb{R}^d$.

AI.tldr: 本文研究Boosting中基类结构对分类器表达力的影响，用γ-VC维刻画弱到强学习的样本复杂度，并改进VC维与γ-VC维关系及若干基本概念类的上下界。
AI.motivation: Boosting能将略优于随机的弱假设转化为高精度预测器，但其表达能力强烈依赖基类结构，需要刻画这一现象的理论参数。
AI.method: 基于Alon等（STOC 2021）提出的γ-VC维，研究其与弱到强学习样本复杂度的关系，并分析其与经典VC维的一般联系，对决策树桩与轴平行矩形类给出上下界。
AI.result: 证明γ-VC维以γ的常数倍缩放为尺度刻画弱到强学习的样本复杂度；收紧VC维与γ-VC维的一般关系；对决策树桩和R^d中轴平行矩形给出改进的γ-VC维上下界。
AI.conclusion: γ-VC维是刻画Boosting表达能力与样本复杂度的有效参数，研究深化了对基类结构作用的理解并改进了相关界。

title: OrBIT: Structure-Guided Embedding Compression
summary: Embedding tables are among the largest components of modern language models. Most compression methods fix a coding geometry such as coordinate blocks, low-rank subspaces, or unrestricted codebooks, and optimize within it. We instead ask whether the coding geometry can itself be discovered. We introduce \emph{OrBIT}, a structure-guided embedding compression framework that learns reusable local geometry from orbit dynamics and uses it to constrain a small set of shared codewords. The global reconstruction residual then decides where the fixed coding budget is spent, while redundant overlapping charts let local errors compensate one another after gluing. Our theory shows how tight-chart geometry controls distortion, how the global residual directs sequential allocation, and how data-geometry-guided refinement improves the codec. The resulting orbit machinery is compiled away, leaving a compact decoder in which the learned structure governs what is stored, where capacity is allocated, and how local information is assembled globally. Across four LLM embedding tables, OrBIT achieves $37.9\times$ compression on GPT-2 and over $23\times$ on each 7B table relative to 16-bit storage, while delivering competitive rate-distortion performance against established quantization and low-rank baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出OrBIT——一种结构引导的嵌入压缩框架，通过从轨道动力学中学习可复用的局部几何来约束共享码字，并结合全局重构残差指导比特分配，在多个LLM嵌入表上实现高压缩率且保持竞争力。
AI.motivation: 嵌入表是现代语言模型中最大的组成部分之一。现有压缩方法大多固定一种编码几何（如坐标块、低秩子空间或无约束码本），仅在其内部做优化，而未考虑编码几何本身能否被自动发现，从而可能限制压缩潜力。
AI.method: OrBIT从轨道动力学中学习可复用的局部几何来约束一小组共享码字；利用全局重构残差决定固定编码预算的分配位置；通过冗余重叠图卡（charts）使局部误差在拼接后相互补偿。理论分析阐明紧图卡几何如何控制失真、全局残差如何指导顺序分配、以及数据几何引导的细化如何改进编解码器。最终轨道机制被编译消除，仅留下紧凑解码器。
AI.result: 在四个LLM嵌入表上，OrBIT相对16比特存储对GPT-2实现37.9倍压缩，对每个7B表实现超过23倍压缩，并在率失真性能上与现有量化及低秩基线相比具有竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 编码几何可以被自动发现并用于指导嵌入压缩；将学习到的结构整合进紧凑解码器，让结构决定存储内容、容量分配与全局信息组装，在极高压缩率下仍保持较优的率失真表现。

title: Kernel Autoresearch for Open-Ended Model Discovery
summary: Kernels encode the inductive bias of a wide range of machine learning models, yet automated kernel design faces a fundamental dilemma. A fixed grammar of base kernels and operators guarantees validity but limits the search to structures expressible by those building blocks. Conversely, unrestricted programs remove this limitation but no longer guarantee validity. In our stress tests, 22-58% of LLM-generated kernels that pass numerical checks on random inputs fail when evaluated at different scales or dimensions. We propose Kernel Autoresearch (Kernaut), which treats kernel design as open-ended model discovery. Coding agents write kernels as programs, while construction contracts ensure that every accepted kernel is valid. A quality-diversity archive retains high-performing kernels with distinct behaviors, and novelty screening steers agents toward functionally new candidates. Our experiments demonstrate that the discovered kernels encode reusable inductive biases that generalize to unseen tasks. On held-out black-box optimization families, a discovered kernel outperforms a meta-learned deep kernel trained on the same episodes. Furthermore, kernels discovered from ten enzyme-kinetic rate laws achieve lower error than tuned ARD and deep kernel baselines on five unseen mechanisms. The discovered kernels are also interpretable programs that human researchers can refine: a human-refined version of one further reduces the held-out predictive error by 5.7% and optimization regret by 7.8%.

AI.tldr: 提出 Kernaut，将核设计视为开放式模型发现：编码代理编写核程序，构造契约保证有效性，质量-多样性档案保留高性能且行为各异的核，新颖性筛选引导探索。发现的核可跨任务泛化，优于元学习深度核与调优基线，且可被人工改进。
AI.motivation: 核函数编码了众多机器学习模型的归纳偏置，但自动化核设计面临两难：固定语法（基核+算子）能保证合法性却限制搜索空间；无限制程序虽突破限制却无法保证合法性。压力测试显示，通过随机输入数值检验的 LLM 生成核中，有 22-58% 在不同尺度或维度下失效，说明仅靠数值检验不足以保证核的有效性。
AI.method: Kernaut 将核设计视为开放式模型发现。编码代理（coding agents）以程序形式编写核；构造契约（construction contracts）确保每个被接受的核都是合法的。质量-多样性档案（quality-diversity archive）保留高性能且行为互异的核；新颖性筛选（novelty screening）引导代理趋向功能上全新的候选。
AI.result: 发现的核编码了可复用的归纳偏置并能泛化到未见任务：在留出黑箱优化族上，发现的核优于在同一批 episode 上元学习的深度核；由十个酶动力学速率方程发现的核，在五个未见机制上误差低于调优的 ARD 与深度核基线；核是可解释程序，人工改进某一核后留出预测误差再降 5.7%、优化遗憾降 7.8%。
AI.conclusion: 以开放式模型发现替代受限或不受限的程序搜索，可在保证合法性的同时突破固定语法的表达限制；所发现的核具有可复用、可泛化、可解释且可被人类进一步精炼的价值，为自动化核设计提供了有效路径。

title: Executing Causal Structure Learning with Linear-Attention Transformers
summary: Transformers can execute algorithms on data given in their input. We ask whether they can do the same for causal discovery. We study a standard continuous method that repeatedly updates a candidate causal graph while enforcing acyclicity. We explicitly construct a fixed-weight transformer whose forward pass exactly reproduces one update of this method, so repeated blocks reproduce its optimization trajectory. The transformer carries the current graph and the algorithm's multiplier between updates. We show that retaining the multiplier is essential for exact execution, since different multiplier values can lead to different next updates. We also give conditions under which, within a fixed stage, the number of updates needed to reach a target accuracy can be computed in advance and rounding errors stay bounded as depth grows. Experiments show that the constructed block agrees with a reference update to floating-point precision, while arithmetic replay on synthetic data and seven published benchmark network topologies inherits the reference solver's successes and failures. This separates accurate algorithm execution from accurate causal recovery. In contrast, the ordinary attention models tested under our training budgets do not reliably execute the update or transfer to larger graphs. Whether gradient training can learn an executor in the architecture class of the construction remains open.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究Transformer能否精确执行因果发现算法，并显式构造了一个固定权重Transformer，其前向传播精确复现标准连续因果发现方法（含无环约束）的单次更新，从而用堆叠块复现优化轨迹。
AI.motivation: Transformer已被证明能执行输入数据上的算法，但是否能同样执行因果发现算法尚不清楚，因此作者希望探究这一能力边界。
AI.method: 针对一种迭代更新候选因果图并强制无环性的标准连续方法，显式构造固定权重Transformer，使其一次前向传播精确对应算法一次更新；在块间携带当前图与算法乘子，并分析乘子保留的必要性及精度/舍入误差条件。
AI.result: 构造块与参考更新在浮点精度内一致；在合成数据和七个公开基准网络拓扑上的算术复现继承了参考求解器的成功与失败；而常规注意力模型在给定训练预算下无法可靠执行该更新或迁移到更大图。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将"精确算法执行"与"准确因果恢复"区分开来；梯度训练能否在构造所属架构类中学得执行器仍是开放问题。

title: Cross-Domain Pretraining for Steady-State Neural CFD Surrogates
summary: Neural surrogates for computational fluid dynamics (CFD) have the potential to greatly enhance engineering innovation through accelerating simulation. However, the primary limitation for neural surrogates is the lack of generalization to geometries and applications beyond the training set, which is significant given the diversity of engineering scenarios. Currently, this is addressed by generating a new dataset for a specific application; however, this requires running costly numerical solvers. In this work, we take a step toward addressing this by studying neural surrogates trained across different geometries, boundary conditions, and fidelities. We find that cross-domain pretraining improves zero- and few-shot performance on held-out datasets relative to both training from scratch and transferring from domain-specific experts. In particular, finetuning a pretrained, cross-domain model can achieve 2-3x lower errors at the same sample size and use 8x fewer samples to achieve the same error, compared to training from scratch. This benefit is architecture agnostic and improves with model size and pretraining dataset diversity. Furthermore, we study how and why cross-domain pretraining works in CFD surrogates, and find that simply pooling steady-state datasets is both sufficient and effective. Given the high cost of generating CFD data, leveraging existing datasets through cross-domain pretraining will likely be a valuable strategy as future surrogates expand to tackle new problems and use cases.

AI.tldr: 跨域预训练可显著提升CFD神经代理模型的泛化能力：微调预训练模型在相同样本量下误差降低2-3倍，达到相同误差所需样本减少8倍。
AI.motivation: CFD神经代理模型能加速仿真，但其核心瓶颈是难以泛化到训练集之外的几何形状与应用场景。当前解决方案是针对特定应用重新生成数据集，但需运行昂贵的数值求解器，成本极高。
AI.method: 研究跨越不同几何、边界条件和保真度训练的神经代理模型，采用跨域预训练策略，并与从零训练及领域专家模型迁移进行对比；同时分析跨域预训练奏效的机制，发现直接汇聚稳态数据集即可。
AI.result: 跨域预训练提升了留出数据集上的零样本与少样本性能，优于从零训练和领域专用迁移；微调后同一样本量误差降低2-3倍，同等误差下样本量减少8倍；该收益与架构无关，并随模型规模和预训练数据多样性提升而增强。
AI.conclusion: 鉴于CFD数据生成成本高昂，利用现有数据集进行跨域预训练将是未来代理模型拓展新问题与应用时的重要策略。

title: Seq-Flow: Efficient Probabilistic Forecasting with Self-Rollout Error Control
summary: Many scientific forecasting tasks require updating a distribution over future trajectories as new observations arrive. Conventional diffusion and flow models generate each forecast from Gaussian noise, often at the cost of many sampling steps. Warm-start methods reuse earlier predictions to reduce this cost, but their models are not trained to perform the forecast update itself, which can compromise quality under few-step sampling. In this work, we introduce Seq-Flow, a conditional flow model whose ODE transports samples from the previous forecast distribution to the updated one. Because successive forecasts often differ only modestly, this transport starts from an informative distribution and can produce accurate updates with few flow evaluations. Recursive reuse also creates a challenge: errors in one forecast become errors in the initial states of subsequent flows. We address this with self-rollout training, in which a moving average copy of the model generates forecasts that initialize later training updates. Unlike self-forcing methods, which reuse generated outputs as conditioning context, Seq-Flow reuses them as the source of the next flow. Experiments On particle-accelerator beam spill forecasting show Seq-Flow reduces CRPS by 65% under a few-NFE sampling budget, while remaining competitive with strong baselines on fluid-dynamics forecasting tasks. Although trained on self-rollouts of at most four updates, Seq-Flow remains accurate over more than 400 consecutive updates. Our code is available at https://github.com/Graph-COM/Seq-Flow.

AI.tldr: Seq-Flow 是一种条件流模型，将上一时刻预测分布作为初始分布，用 ODE 直接输运到更新后的预测分布，配合 self-rollout 训练，在少步采样下实现高质量的科学预测更新。
AI.motivation: 科学预测任务需随新观测不断更新未来轨迹分布。常规扩散/流模型每次从高斯噪声生成，采样步数多；warm-start 方法复用历史预测以降低成本，但模型本身未针对"预测更新"进行训练，少步采样时质量下降。此外，递归复用会使前序误差污染后续流的初始状态。
AI.method: 提出 Seq-Flow：条件流模型的 ODE 将样本从上一时刻的预测分布输运到更新后的分布，因相邻预测差异较小，可从信息量丰富的分布出发、以极少流评估完成更新。针对误差累积，采用 self-rollout 训练：用模型的滑动平均副本生成预测，作为后续训练更新的初始状态。与 self-forcing 复用生成结果为条件上下文不同，Seq-Flow 将生成结果复用为下一次流的源分布。
AI.result: 在粒子加速器束流溢出预测任务中，少 NFE 采样预算下 CRPS 降低 65%；在流体动力学预测任务上与强基线相比仍具竞争力。尽管训练时仅使用至多 4 次更新的自回归 rollout，Seq-Flow 在超过 400 次连续更新中仍保持准确。
AI.conclusion: Seq-Flow 通过"以上一预测分布为源的流输运 + self-rollout 训练"范式，在少步采样下显著提升科学预测更新的精度与长程递归稳定性，为在线分布更新提供高效方案。

title: A Good Self-Teacher Meets the Student Where They Are: Joint On-Policy Learning and Teaching
summary: Reinforcement Learning (RL) from outcome rewards suffers from sparse supervision, particularly on difficult, long-horizon tasks where successful trajectories are rare and costly to generate. On-Policy Distillation (OPD) offers an attractive alternative by providing dense token-level supervision from a stronger teacher along the student's own generations. Self-distillation methods further remove the need for a separate teacher model by conditioning the same policy on privileged information to serve as its own teacher. However, privileged conditioning alone does not guarantee that the resulting distillation update improves the student. Indeed, privileged information can lead the teacher to solve tasks through shortcuts unavailable to the student, producing supervision poorly matched to the student's current behavior. Consequently, even a higher-performing teacher can provide guidance that degrades student performance. To address this, we analyze how the choice of privileged teacher affects the student's update. We derive a necessary and sufficient condition for the teacher's local distillation update to be a positive multiple of the student's reward gradient. Our analysis suggests that the teacher should not only perform well on the task, but also provide guidance suited to the student's current capabilities. This characterization motivates a practical teacher-training surrogate that combines outcome rewards with token-level Kullback-Leibler (KL) regularization toward the student. Based on this result, we propose Joint On-Policy Learning and Teaching (JOLT), which jointly trains a single policy in two roles: a privileged teacher using a KL-regularized objective, and an unprivileged student using dense on-policy distillation. Across mathematical reasoning, coding, tool use, and terminal use, JOLT improves training efficiency and performance, with further gains from student rewards.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 JOLT 方法：通过分析特权教师对学生策略更新的影响，推导出教师蒸馏更新为学生奖励梯度的正倍数这一充要条件，据此设计 KL 正则化的教师训练代理目标，联合训练同一策略同时充当特权教师与无特权学生，在数学推理、代码、工具使用等任务上提升训练效率与表现。
AI.motivation: 强化学习依赖稀疏的结果奖励，在长视野困难任务上成功轨迹稀少且代价高；在线策略蒸馏（OPD）可提供教师对学生在自身生成上的密集 token 级监督，自蒸馏更进一步用特权信息条件化同一策略以充当自身教师。但仅凭特权条件化并不能保证蒸馏更新改善学生：特权信息可能让教师通过学生无法获得的捷径解题，导致监督与学生当前行为不匹配，即便教师表现更好也可能损害学生性能。
AI.method: 作者分析特权教师的选择如何影响学生更新，推导出教师局部蒸馏更新为学生奖励梯度正倍数的充要条件；该分析表明教师既需任务表现好，又需提供契合学生当前能力的指导。据此提出教师训练代理目标：将结果奖励与面向学生的 token 级 KL 正则化结合。基于该结果提出 JOLT，联合训练单一策略承担两种角色：以 KL 正则化目标训练的特权教师，以及采用密集在线策略蒸馏的无特权学生。
AI.result: 在数学推理、编程、工具使用和终端使用等任务上，JOLT 提升了训练效率与性能，并且加入学生奖励后还能获得进一步提升。
AI.conclusion: 特权条件化本身不足以保证蒸馏更新的有效性；从理论上刻画教师更新与学生奖励梯度的关系，可指导设计 KL 正则化的教师训练目标，从而在单一策略中联合实现高质量的在线策略学习与教学。

title: NeuralBES: A Differentiable, Control-Aware Emulator for Scalable Building Energy Modeling
summary:
Demand-side flexibility i.e. forecasting, shifting, and curtailing residential energy loads, depends on thermal models trusted across millions of heterogeneous buildings. Existing tools force a hard tradeoff: high-fidelity physics simulators such as EnergyPlus are accurate but sequential and require per-building calibration, while purely data-driven sequence models scale but abandon the physical structure that makes their predictions trustworthy.
  We introduce NeuralBES (Building Energy Simulation), a differentiable emulator that resolves this tradeoff by parameterizing a resistance--capacitance (RC) based thermal model with a shared neural encoder: static building metadata such as floor area, vintage, and HVAC type is mapped to physically bounded capacitances, conductances, and equipment coefficients, which become the coefficients of a scalar linear recurrence solved via a log-space parallel scan, and a predictor--corrector loop closes the thermostat--temperature nonlinearity while preserving full-horizon gradient flow. Trained on the ResStock dataset across three climate zones, NeuralBES handles heterogeneous building archetypes, vintages, and climate zones within a single trained encoder, while black-box baselines produce statistically plausible but physically inconsistent trajectories. On the annual full-year rollout, NeuralBES is the only data-conditioned model that is simultaneously physics-valid and accurate to within 4 MAPE points of the strongest raw-error baseline, while operating at roughly an order of magnitude fewer parameters than the transformer and recurrent baselines; among physics-valid baselines at parameter parity it more than halves the MAPE of the grey-box RC alternative.

AI.tldr: NeuralBES是一个可微分的建筑能耗模拟器，用共享神经编码器参数化RC热模型，将建筑元数据映射为物理有界的系数，通过log空间并行扫描求解线性递推并配以预测-校正回路，在单一编码器下处理异构建筑，兼顾物理有效性与预测精度。
AI.motivation: 需求侧灵活性（负荷预测、转移与削减）依赖可信的热模型，且需适用于数百万异构建筑。现有工具存在两难：EnergyPlus等物理仿真器精度高但串行且需逐建筑标定；纯数据驱动的序列模型可扩展却丢失了赋予预测可信度的物理结构。
AI.method: 提出NeuralBES：以共享神经编码器参数化RC热模型，将静态建筑元数据（面积、年代、HVAC类型）映射为物理有界的电容、电导与设备系数；这些系数构成标量线性递推并通过log空间并行扫描求解；预测-校正回路处理恒温器-温度非线性，同时保持全时域梯度流。在ResStock数据集三个气候区上训练。
AI.result: 单一编码器即可覆盖异构建筑原型、年代与气候区，而黑箱基线产生统计上合理但物理不一致的轨迹。在全年滚动预测中，NeuralBES是唯一同时物理有效、且与最强原始误差基线差距在4个MAPE点内的数据条件模型，参数量比Transformer和循环基线少约一个数量级；在参数量相当的物理有效基线中，其MAPE比灰箱RC方法降低一半以上。
AI.conclusion: NeuralBES通过将RC物理结构与可学习神经编码器结合，解决了保真度与可扩展性之间的权衡，在参数量更低的前提下同时实现物理有效与高精度，为跨异构建筑的可靠能耗建模提供了可行方案。

title: Composing What Each Teacher Learned: Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation through Teacher-Relative Shifts
summary:
Multi-teacher on-policy distillation (MOPD) is used in two settings. In common-domain composition, several teachers score each student rollout from one prompt domain and their signals form a single target; in routed-domain distillation, prompts from different domains are assigned to the corresponding specialist. Both settings usually transfer each teacher's endpoint policy, which mixes what post-training changed with preferences inherited from the teacher's base. We introduce $Δ$-MOPD, which transfers each teacher's teacher-minus-base logit shift re-anchored at the student's frozen initialization, and compare it with endpoint supervision in both settings while holding teacher selection fixed. We first expose the mechanism that impedes endpoint transfer: inherited base pull can exceed the post-training shift. Removing it reduces the teacher-term norm ratio and target--student KL.
  Across our experiments, the results suggest that shift targets are particularly useful when teacher signals are combined at a state. With three composed teachers, $Δ$-MOPD exceeds endpoint composition by $4.11$ Math and $1.95$ five-benchmark points; with two, it matches endpoint accuracy. Under phased routing, it achieves higher mean performance in both phase orders and reduces the observed order gap from $10.50$ to $6.42$ points. Under interleaved routing, where each update involves one teacher, the two targets perform comparably. The phased results provide supporting evidence that the benefit may extend to signals accumulated across training phases. Target construction is thus an independent design axis in MOPD, complementary to teacher selection.

AI.tldr: 论文提出Δ-MOPD，将多教师蒸馏的目标从"教师端点策略"改为"教师减基座的logit偏移，并在学生冻结初始化处重新锚定"，在两个多教师场景中验证其效果并揭示端点迁移的阻碍机制。
AI.motivation: 现有多教师在线策略蒸馏（MOPD）通常迁移每个教师的端点策略，但端点策略混合了后训练带来的改变与教师自身基座继承的偏好，导致继承的基座牵引可能干扰有效迁移，因此需要一种更纯粹的目标构造方式。
AI.method: 论文提出Δ-MOPD：迁移每个教师"教师减基座"的logit偏移（teacher-minus-base logit shift），并将该偏移重新锚定在学生冻结的初始化上；在common-domain composition与routed-domain distillation两种设置下，与端点监督进行对比，且保持教师选择固定不变。
AI.result: 论文首先揭示端点迁移的阻碍机制——继承的基座牵引可超过后训练偏移，去除后可降低教师项范数比与目标-学生KL。三个组合教师时，Δ-MOPD较端点组合在Math上高4.11分、五基准上高1.95分；两个教师时与端点精度持平。分阶段路由下，Δ-MOPD在两种阶段顺序下均取得更高平均性能，并将顺序差距从10.50降至6.42分。交错路由（每次更新仅涉及一个教师）下两者表现相当。
AI.conclusion: 目标构造是多教师在线策略蒸馏中一个独立的设计维度，与教师选择互补；偏移目标在教师信号于同一状态被组合时尤为有效，且分阶段路由结果提示该收益可能扩展至跨训练阶段累积的信号。

title: Two-Level Softmax Sampling Done Right: Correcting Bias from Size Imbalance and Dispersion
summary: Sampling from a softmax distribution is a fundamental operation in machine learning, but its linear complexity in the number of items makes exact sampling impractical at scale. Two-level softmax (2LS) sampling is a popular alternative enabling sublinear-time sampling. Assuming items are partitioned into clusters, 2LS first samples a cluster and then an item within it. In this paper, we show that, despite its advantages, 2LS introduces systematic and undesirable sampling biases, which arise from misweighting clusters by ignoring both cluster size imbalance and intra-cluster similarity dispersion. We propose two sampling methods, Size-Corrected 2LS (S-2LS) and Size- and Dispersion-Corrected 2LS (SD-2LS), which correct these biases and provide provably better softmax approximations with negligible to non-existent computational overhead. In-depth experiments on five large-scale datasets validate the improved sampling properties of our methods. We recommend their consistent use in place of standard 2LS in future work.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了两级softmax（2LS）采样因忽略簇大小不平衡和簇内相似度离散度而引入系统性采样偏差，提出S-2LS与SD-2LS两种修正方法，在几乎不增加计算开销的前提下提供可证明更优的softmax近似。
AI.motivation: 从softmax分布中采样是机器学习的基础操作，但其关于项目数的线性复杂度使其在大规模场景下难以精确采样。两级softmax（2LS）采样通过先采样簇、再采样簇内项目实现亚线性时间采样，是常用替代方案。然而，作者发现2LS存在系统性且不理想的采样偏差。
AI.method: 作者分析指出2LS的偏差来源于簇加权错误：既忽略了簇大小不平衡，也忽略了簇内相似度离散度。为此提出两种修正采样方法——Size-Corrected 2LS（S-2LS）和Size- and Dispersion-Corrected 2LS（SD-2LS），分别针对簇大小与离散度进行加权修正，并给出可证明的softmax近似质量保证，计算开销可忽略甚至为零。
AI.result: 在五个大规模数据集上进行的深入实验验证了所提方法在采样性质上的改进，表明其能够有效纠正2LS的采样偏差，同时保持极低的计算成本。
AI.conclusion: 2LS采样存在由簇大小不平衡和簇内相似度离散度导致的系统性偏差；S-2LS与SD-2LS可有效修正这些偏差并提供更优的softmax近似。作者建议未来工作中以其一致替代标准2LS。

title: Oracle-Efficient and Parameter-Free Agnostic Smoothed Online Learning
summary: Online learning is an attractive framework in many domains because it permits well-defined learning even when data are dependent or chosen adversarially. This generality, however, comes at a steep price, introducing significant statistical and computational barriers. Recently, smoothed online learning has emerged as a promising framework that interpolates between the fully adversarial and fully stochastic settings by assuming that the conditional law of each covariate has density at most $1/σ$ with respect to some fixed base measure $μ$, and it is known to match the statistical and computational guarantees of classical learning while still allowing for much of the flexibility of online learning. However, existing oracle-efficient algorithms require either (i) sampling access to the base measure $μ$ or (ii) labels that are perfectly predicted by a fixed hypothesis. Both assumptions limit the applicability of these algorithms, in contrast to statistical learning, where empirical risk minimization (ERM) learns efficiently in the agnostic setting without any knowledge of the data distribution. We show that neither assumption is necessary, giving the first oracle-efficient algorithm that achieves sublinear regret in the agnostic setting without knowledge of $μ$. Our algorithm, based on Gaussian Follow-The-Perturbed-Leader, is parameter-free: it requires no knowledge of $μ$, the smoothing parameter $σ$, or the horizon $T$, and it achieves regret $\widetilde O(d\sqrt{T/σ})$ for binary classes of VC dimension $d$ with a single call to an ERM oracle per round, which is optimal up to a $\sqrt{d}$ factor. En route to establishing the regret bound, we introduce several new techniques that may be of independent interest.

AI.tldr: 本文提出首个在不可知（agnostic）设定下、无需知道基测度μ的oracle-efficient算法（基于高斯FTPL），实现参数无关的次线性遗憾，达到VC维d的二分类下Õ(d√(T/σ))，仅相差√d因子。
AI.motivation: 在线学习虽通用（允许数据相关或对抗选取），但带来显著统计与计算障碍。平滑在线学习通过假设条件分布相对基测度μ的密度≤1/σ，在对抗与随机设定间取得插值，兼具经典学习的统计/计算保证与在线学习的灵活性。然而现有oracle-efficient算法要么需要μ的采样访问，要么需要被固定假设完美预测的标签，均限制了适用性——而统计学习中ERM在agnostic设定下无需分布知识即可高效学习。因此作者希望摆脱这两个假设。
AI.method: 提出基于高斯Follow-The-Perturbed-Leader（FTPL）的算法，完全参数无关：无需知道μ、平滑参数σ或时间视界T；每轮仅需一次ERM oracle调用。
AI.result: 算法在agnostic设定下无需μ知识即实现次线性遗憾，对VC维为d的二分类类别取得Õ(d√(T/σ))的遗憾界，每轮一次ERM调用，最优性仅差√d因子。
AI.conclusion: 证明了（1）采样访问μ的假设与（2）固定假设完美预测标签的假设均非必要，给出首个在agnostic、无μ知识下实现次线性遗憾的oracle-efficient算法。在建立遗憾界过程中引入若干可能有独立价值的新技术。

title: Why Forget-Only Unlearning Needs Memorization
summary: Machine unlearning asks for a deletion algorithm whose output is close to retraining from scratch without the selected forget examples. In this work, we study forget-only unlearning, where the deletion algorithm receives only the trained model and the examples to forget, with no retained data or extra training information. We ask whether forget-only unlearning is always possible. We first show that this depends on the learning method: different datasets can produce the same trained model but require very different outputs after the same examples are removed. Using this observation, we derive lower bounds on how accurately unlearning can match retraining and instantiate them for several standard learning algorithms. We then ask what must be true when forget-only unlearning succeeds. To this end, we derive lower bounds on what an algorithm must memorize about the training data to handle arbitrary deletion requests. For simple threshold learners, the required information can be as large as the entire dataset, even though ordinary training keeps only one boundary point. Overall, our results show that information discarded during ordinary learning may be needed later for deletion, so models designed for forget-only unlearning may need to retain more information than standard training does.

AI.tldr: 本文研究仅给定已训练模型和待遗忘样本、无保留数据与额外训练信息的"forget-only unlearning"，从信息论角度给出其可行性的下界，指出普通训练丢弃的信息在删除时可能被需要。
AI.motivation: 面向"机器遗忘"通常要求删除后的输出接近从头重训（retraining from scratch）。现有方法多依赖保留数据或训练过程信息，而实践中这些往往不可得。作者希望厘清在仅有模型与待遗忘样本的最弱条件下，遗忘是否总能实现，以及实现它需要模型保留哪些信息。
AI.method: 1）构造性反例：不同数据集可训练出相同模型，但在删除相同样本后所需输出差异极大，据此推导遗忘结果与重训结果匹配精度的下界，并对若干标准学习算法具体化；2）推导任何算法为应对任意删除请求必须记忆训练数据的信息量下界，并以简单阈值学习器（threshold learner）为例给出紧致刻画。
AI.result: 遗忘可行性依赖于具体学习算法：存在学习算法使得仅凭模型与待遗忘样本无法逼近重训结果，且这种不匹配程度有可量化的下界。对阈值学习器，尽管普通训练只保留一个边界点，处理任意删除请求所需记忆的信息量可高达整个数据集。
AI.conclusion: 普通学习中丢弃的信息可能在后续删除时变得必要；面向 forget-only unlearning 设计的模型可能需要比标准训练保留更多信息，遗忘算法的设计与学习算法的信息保留策略需协同考虑。

title: Distilling Graph Geometry: Knowledge Gap from GNNs to MLPs
summary: GNN-to-MLP distillation aims to retain the predictive accuracy of a message-passing teacher while deploying a graph-free MLP at inference. Existing methods mainly transfer node-wise predictions or use confidence-based reweighting, but they do not specify where the student should preserve the teacher's graph-induced geometry. We show that this omission leads to two spectral failure modes in the student's representation space. On sparse graphs, the student suffers from spectral underfit, missing high-energy teacher directions concentrated near boundary regions. On dense graphs, it suffers from spectral overfit, retaining spurious directions that the teacher has collapsed through aggregation. Motivated by an energy-weighted teacher-student alignment objective, we propose Graph Geometry-aware MLP (G^2MLP), a training-time distillation framework guided by Ollivier-Ricci curvature. Curvature identifies where the two spectral errors concentrate and is used to allocate supervision between prediction-level and representation-level alignment. The deployed model remains a standard MLP and requires no graph access at inference. Across node-classification benchmarks, G^2MLP consistently improves over graph-free distillation baselines, reduces the teacher-student rank gap in both regimes, and transfers without architectural changes to Graph Transformer teachers and link prediction.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出G^2MLP，一个基于Ollivier-Ricci曲率引导的GNN-to-MLP蒸馏框架，通过区分预测级与表示级对齐的监督分配，解决学生表征空间中的谱欠拟合与谱过拟合问题；部署时仍为标准MLP，无需图结构。
AI.motivation: 现有GNN-to-MLP蒸馏方法主要迁移节点级预测或采用基于置信度的重加权，但未明确学生应在何处保留教师由图结构诱导的几何。该缺陷导致学生表征空间出现两种谱失败模式：稀疏图上谱欠拟合（缺失集中于边界区域的高能教师方向），稠密图上谱过拟合（保留教师经聚合已坍缩的虚假方向）。
AI.method: 受能量加权的师生对齐目标启发，提出Graph Geometry-aware MLP（G^2MLP）训练时蒸馏框架。以Ollivier-Ricci曲率作为引导信号，利用曲率识别两类谱误差集中的位置，并据此在预测级对齐与表示级对齐之间分配监督权重。推理阶段部署模型仍为标准MLP，无需访问图结构。
AI.result: 在节点分类基准上，G^2MLP持续优于无图蒸馏基线；在稀疏与稠密两种情形下均缩小了师生秩差；并在不做架构改动的情况下可迁移至Graph Transformer教师与链接预测任务。
AI.conclusion: 明确学生应保留教师图诱导几何的位置对GNN-to-MLP蒸馏至关重要。以曲率为引导、在预测级与表示级对齐间动态分配监督，可同时缓解谱欠拟合与谱过拟合，并具备良好的可扩展性与任务通用性。

title: HE-OFT: Privacy-Preserving One-Shot Federated Fine-Tuning under Homomorphic Encryption
comment: Technical report. 32 pages, 7 figures, 12 tables. Code: https://github.com/CRYPTO-KU/HE-OFT
summary: Many organizations adapt large pretrained models to their own tasks by fine-tuning on private data. Several of these parties often hold data for the same task and wish to fine-tune a model together without pooling that data. Federated learning (FL) enables joint fine-tuning, but reconstruction attacks on shared intermediate values (the model or its gradients) remain a privacy risk. A one-shot protocol that exchanges one encrypted contribution exposes no intermediate value. Such a protocol still gives the trained model to every participant, which is not permitted where the model is a regulated or proprietary asset. We present HE-OFT, the first cryptographically secure one-shot federated fine-tuning protocol in which no party receives the trained model. Each client fine-tunes a low-rank adapter and a classifier head on a frozen public backbone and keeps the adapter. The client uploads one encrypted head displacement, which the server combines under multiparty CKKS and never decrypts. A quorum of clients returns only the predicted label to the querier. On four text classification tasks and one vision task, HE-OFT reaches 61 to 79 per cent accuracy, against 20 to 48 per cent for a client training alone. HE-OFT keeps 85 to 96 per cent of the accuracy of a disclosed model. A test-time query takes 443.1 to 1713.1 s on one core, or 56.1 to 255.1 s with level restoration on a GPU. Restoring levels at the server cuts the traffic per query from up to 1.6 GiB to 13.5 MiB.

AI.tldr: HE-OFT：首个加密安全的一次性联邦微调协议，任何参与方都拿不到训练后的模型；客户端本地微调低秩适配器与分类头并保留适配器，仅上传一次加密的头部偏移量，服务器在多方CKKS下合成且从不解密，查询时仅多数客户端返回预测标签。
AI.motivation: 多方常对同一任务各自持有私有数据，希望在不共享数据的前提下联合微调大模型；联邦学习虽支持联合微调，但对共享中间值（模型或梯度）的重建攻击仍是隐私风险。一次性协议只交换一次加密贡献，不暴露中间值，但仍会把训练好的模型交给每个参与方，这在模型属于受监管或专有资产时不被允许。因此需要一种既不暴露中间值、又不向任何参与方交付训练模型的方案。
AI.method: 客户端在冻结的公共骨干网络上微调低秩适配器与分类器头，并保留适配器；客户端上传一次加密的头部偏移量，服务器在多方CKKS同态加密下进行合成且从不解密；查询时由达到法定人数的客户端群返回预测标签给查询方。方法核心为：一次性（one-shot）交互、多重参与方CKKS、低秩适配（LoRA类）冻结骨干、头部偏移量加密聚合、以及服务器端级别恢复（level restoration）以降低通信。
AI.result: 在四个文本分类任务和一个视觉任务上，HE-OFT达到61%–79%准确率，而单客户端独立训练仅为20%–48%；相对公开模型保留了85%–96%的准确率。一次测试时查询在单核上需443.1–1713.1秒，GPU上采用级别恢复后为56.1–255.1秒。服务器端进行级别恢复可将每次查询的通信量从最高1.6 GiB降至13.5 MiB。
AI.conclusion: HE-OFT是首个密码学安全的一次性联邦微调协议，实现"任何参与方均不获得训练后模型"的强隐私目标，同时通过加密头部偏移量与多方CKKS保持了可用的准确率与可接受的查询开销，级别恢复显著降低通信成本。
